\subsection*{Job 39}
\markright{JOB 39}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} [Say] if you know the time of the bringing forth of the wild goats of the rock, and [if] you have marked the calving of the hinds: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} and [if] you have have numbered the full months of their being with young, and [if] you have relieved their pangs: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and have reared their young without fear; and will you loosen their pangs? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Their young will break forth; they will be multiplied with offspring: [their young] will go forth, and will not return to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And who is he that sent forth the wild ass free? and who loosed his bands? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} whereas I made his habitation the wilderness, and the salt land his coverts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} He laughs to scorn the multitude of the city, and hears not the chiding of the tax-gatherer. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} He will survey the mountains [as] his pasture, and he seeks after every green thing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And will the unicorn be willing to serve you, or to lie down at your manger? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And will you bind his yoke with thongs, or will he plow furrows for you in the plain? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And do you trust him, because his strength is great? and will you commit your works to him? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And will you believe that he will return to you your seed, and bring [it] in [to] your threshing floor? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} The peacock has a beautiful wing: if the stork and the ostrich conceive, [it is worthy of notice], {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} for [the ostrich] will leave her eggs in the ground, and warm them on the dust, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} and has forgotten that the foot will scatter them, and the wild beasts of the field trample them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} She has hardened [herself] against her young ones, as though [she bereaved] not herself: she labors in vain without fear. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For God has withholden wisdom from her, and not given her a portion in understanding. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} In her season she will lift herself on high; she will scorn the horse and his rider. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Have you invested the horse with strength, and clothed his neck with terror? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And have you clad him in perfect armor, and made his breast glorious with courage? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} He paws exulting in the plain, and goes forth in strength into the plain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} He laughs to scorn a king as he meets him, and will by no means turn back from the sword. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} The bow and sword resound against him; and [his] rage will swallow up the ground: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} and he will not believe until the trumpet sounds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And when the trumpet sounds, he says, Aha! and afar off he smells the war with prancing and neighing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And does the hawk remain steady by your wisdom, having spread out her wings unmoved, looking toward the region of the south? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And does the eagle rise at your command, and the vulture remain sitting over his nest, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} on a crag of a rock, and in a secret [place]? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Thence he seeks food, his eyes observe from far. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And his young ones roll themselves in blood, and wherever the carcasses may be, immediately they are found. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And the Lord God answered Job, and said, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Will [any one] pervert judgment with the Mighty One? and he that reproves God, let him return it for answer. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And Job answered and said to the Lord, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Why do I yet plead? being rebuked even while reproving the Lord: hearing such things, whereas I am nothing: and what shall I answer to these [arguments]? I will lay my hand upon my mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} I have spoken once; but I will not do so a second time.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{5} the wild, ; who hath loosed \textsuperscript{6} barren land Heb. salt places \textsuperscript{13} peacocks; wings and feathers unto the or, the feathers of the stork and, *marg. \textsuperscript{20} the glory; terrible Heb. terrors \textsuperscript{21} He paweth or, His feet dig, and; he goeth; armed men Heb. armour \textsuperscript{26} the hawk Netz, Arabic naz, Latin nisus, the hawk, so called from natzah, to shoot away, fly, because of the rapidity of its flight. It probably comprehends various species of the falcon family, as the ger-falcon, goshawk, and sparrowhawk.; stretch Is it through thy teaching that the falcon, or any other bird of passage, knows the precise time for taking flight, and the direction in which she is to go to arrive at a warmer climate? \textsuperscript{27} the eagle; at thy command Heb. by thy mouth make \textsuperscript{29} she her The eagle is proverbial for her strong and clear sight.\par}

\subsection*{Job 40}
\markright{JOB 40}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the Lord yet again answered and spoke to Job out of the cloud, [saying], {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Nay, gird up now your loins like a man; and I will ask you, and do you answer me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Do not set aside my judgment: and do you think that I have dealt with you in any other way, than that you might appear to be righteous? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Have you an arm like the Lord's? or do you thunder with a voice like his? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Assume now a lofty bearing and power; and clothe yourself with glory and honor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And send forth messengers with wrath; and lay low every haughty one. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Bring down also the proud man; and consume at once the ungodly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And hide them together in the earth; and fill their faces with shame. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} [Then] will I confess that your right hand can save [you]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} But now look at the wild beasts with you; they eat grass like oxen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Behold now, his strength is in his loins, and his force is in the navel of his belly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} He sets up his tail like a cypress; and his nerves are wrapped together. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} His sides are sides of brass; and his backbone is [as] cast iron. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} This is the chief of the creation of the Lord; made to be played with by his angels. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And when he has gone up to a steep mountain, he causes joy to the quadrupeds in the deep. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} He lies under trees of every kind, by the papyrus, and reed, and bulrush. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And the great trees make a shadow over him with their branches, and [so do] the bushes of the field. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} If there should be a flood, he will not perceive it; he trust that Jordan will rush up into his mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} [Yet one] shall take him in his sight; [one] shall catch [him] with a cord, and pierce his nose. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But will you catch the serpent with a hook, and put a halter about his nose? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Or will you fasten a ring in his nostril, and bore his lip with a clasp? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Will he address you with a petition? softly, with the voice of a suppliant? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And will he make a covenant with you? and will you take him for a perpetual servant? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And will you play with him as with a bird? or bind him as a sparrow for a child? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And do the nations feed upon him, and the nations of the Phoenicians share him? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And all the ships come together would not be able to bear the mere skin of his tail; neither [shall they carry] his head in fishing vessels. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} But you shall lay your hand upon him [once], remembering the war that is waged by his mouth; and let it not be done any more.\par

\subsection*{Job 41}
\markright{JOB 41}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Have you not seen him? and have you not wondered at the things said [of him]? Do you not fear because preparation has been made by me? for who is there that resists me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Or who will resist me, and abide, since the whole [world] under heaven is mine? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} I will not be silent because of him: though because of his power [one] shall pity his antagonist. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Who will open the face of his garment? and who can enter within the fold of his breastplate? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Who will open the doors of his face? terror is round about his teeth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} His inwards are as brazen plates, and the texture of his [skin] as a smyrite stone. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} One [part] cleaves fast to another, and the air can’t come between them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} They will remain united each to the other: they are closely joined, and can’t be separated. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} At his sneezing a light shines, and his eyes are [as] the appearance of the morning star. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Out of his mouth proceed as it were burning lamps, and as it were hearths of fire are cast abroad. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Out of his nostrils proceeds smoke of a furnace burning with fire of coals. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} His breath is [as] live coals, and a flame goes out of his mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And power is lodged in his neck, before him destruction runs. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} The flesh also of his body is joined together: [if one] pours [violence] upon him, he shall not be moved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} His heart is firm as a stone, and it stands like an unyielding anvil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And when he turns, [he is] a terror to the four-footed wild beasts which leap upon the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} If spears should come against him, [men] will effect nothing, [either with] the spear or the breast-plate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} For he considers iron as chaff, and brass as rotten wood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} The bow of brass shall not wound him, he deems a slinger as grass. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Mauls are counted as stubble; and he laughs to scorn the waving of the firebrand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} His lair is [formed of] sharp points; and all the gold of the sea under him is an immense [quantity of] clay. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} He makes the deep boil like a brazen caldron; and he regards the sea as a pot of ointment, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} and the lowest part of the deep as a captive: he reckons the deep as [his] range. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} There is nothing upon the earth like to him, formed to be sported with by my angels. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} He beholds every high thing: and he is king of all that are in the waters.\par

\subsection*{Job 42}
\markright{JOB 42}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then Job answered and said to the Lord, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} I know that you can do all things, and nothing is impossible with you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For who is he that hides counsel from you? or who keeps back his words, and thinks to hide them from you? and who will tell me what I knew not, great and wonderful things which I understood not? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} But hear me, O Lord, that I also may speak: and I will ask you, and do you teach me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} I have heard the report of you by the ear before; but now my eye has seen you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Therefore I have counted myself vile, and have fainted: and I esteem myself dust and ashes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And it came to pass after the Lord had spoken all these words to Job, [that] the Lord said to Eliphaz the Thaemanite, You have sinned, and your two friends: for you⌃ have not said anything true before me, as my servant Job [has]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Now then take seven bullocks, and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and he shall offer a burnt offering for you. And my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will only accept him: for but his sake, I would have destroyed you, for you⌃ have not spoken the truth against my servant Job. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} So Eliphaz the Thaemanite, and Baldad the Sauchite, and Sophar the Minaean, went and did as the Lord commanded them: and he pardoned their sin for the sake of Job. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And the Lord prospered Job: and when he prayed also for his friends, he forgave them [their] sin: and the Lord gave Job twice as much, even the double of what he had before. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And all his brethren and his sisters heard all that had happened to him, and they came to him, and [so did] all that had known him from the first: and they ate and drank with him, and comforted him, and wondered at all that the Lord had brought upon him: and each one gave him a lamb, and four drachmas' weight of gold, even of unstamped [gold]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And the Lord blessed the latter end of Job, [more] than the beginning: and his cattle were fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, a thousand yoke of oxen, a thousand she-asses of the pastures. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And there were born to him seven sons and three daughters. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And he called the first Day, and the second Casia, and the third Amalthaea's horn. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And there were not found in comparison with the daughters of Job, fairer [women] than they in all the world: and their father gave them an inheritance among their brethren. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And Job lived after [his] affliction one hundred and seventy years: and all the years he lived were two hundred and forty: and Job saw his sons and his sons' sons, the fourth generation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And Job died, an old man and full of days: and it is written that he will rise again with those whom the Lord raises up. This man is described in the Syriac book [as] living in the land of Ausis, on the borders of Idumea and Arabia: and his name before was Jobab; and having taken an Arabian wife, he begot a son whose name was Ennon. And he himself was the son of his father Zare, one of the sons of Esau, and of his mother Bosorrha, so that he was the fifth from Abraam. And these were the kings who reigned in Edom, which country he also ruled over: first, Balac, the son of Beor, and the name of his city was Dennaba: but after Balac, Jobab, who is called Job, and after him Asom, who was governor out of the country of Thaeman: and after him Adad, the son of Barad, who destroyed Madiam in the plain of Moab; and the name of his city was Gethaim. And [his] friends who came to him were Eliphaz, of the children of Esau, king of the Thaemanites, Baldad sovereign the Sauchaeans, Sophar king of the Minaeans.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} thou; no; can be withholden from thee or, of thine can be hindered \textsuperscript{8} Therefore From this it appears that Job was considered as a priest, not only to his own family, but also to others. For his children he offered burnt offerings ( ), and now he is to make the same kind of offerings, accompanied with intercession, in behalf of his three friends. \section*{Psalms Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} David chiefly\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} with Asaph\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} sons of Korah\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} Moses\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} Solomon\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} and others\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} The superscriptions name many human authors; David remains the principal psalmist in both Scripture and tradition.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} Jesus attributes Psalm 110 to David in Matthew 22:43-45; Acts 4:25 attributes Psalm 2 to David; Acts 1:16 treats the Psalms as spoken by the Spirit through David.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} collected across Israel's history\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} chiefly 10th-5th centuries BC\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. MT Psalms preserves the Hebrew five-book Psalter with 150 psalms. The LXX Psalter differs in numbering and includes Psalm 151 in some traditions, an important issue for an LXX-based edition. | Subst. Israel's canonical hymnbook for worship, lament, kingship, repentance, wisdom, and messianic hope. To teach the people of God how to pray, praise, lament, repent, hope, and worship in covenant fellowship. | Heb. praise; lament; kingship; Messiah; wisdom; repentance; worship Books I-V of the Psalter; praise crescendo closes the collection. | Gk. Qumran Psalms manuscripts are abundant, including 11Q Psalms a 3rd-1st centuries BC\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} 11Q Psalms a is a substantial early Hebrew Psalms witness with notable collection features by Hasmonean period (Leningrad Codex)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} AD 1008\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} Codex Alexandrinus and Vaticanus preserve the Greek Psalter\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\subsection*{Psalm 1}
\markright{PSALM 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Blessed is the man who has not walked in the counsel of the ungodly, and has not stood in the way of sinners, and has not sat in the seat of evil men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} But his pleasure is in the law of the Lord; and in his law will he meditate day and night. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And he shall be as a tree planted by the brooks of waters, which shall yield its fruit in its season, and its leaf shall not fall off; and whatever he shall do shall be prospered. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Not so the ungodly; —not so: but rather as the chaff which the wind scatters away from the face of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Therefore the ungodly shall not rise in judgment, nor sinners in the counsel of the just. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} For the Lord knows the way of the righteous; but the way of the ungodly shall perish.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} am 3560, bc 444 Blessed, ; walketh; counsel; ungodly or, wicked standeth; way, ; sitteth; scornful \textsuperscript{3} tree; bringeth; shall not; wither Heb. fade whatsoever\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 2}
\markright{PSALM 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Therefore did the heathen rage, and the nations imagine vain things? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers gathered themselves together, against the Lord, and against his Christ; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} [saying], Let us break through their bonds, and cast away their yoke from us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} He that dwells in the heavens shall laugh them to scorn, and the Lord shall mock them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Then shall he speak to them in his anger, and trouble them in his fury. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} But I have been made king by him on Sion his holy mountain, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} declaring the ordinance of the Lord: the Lord said to me, You are my Son, today have I begotten you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Ask of me, and I will give you the heathen [for] your inheritance, and the ends of the earth [for] your possession. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} You shall rule them with a rod of iron; you shall dash them in pieces as a potter's vessel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Now therefore understand, you⌃ kings: be instructed, all you⌃ that judge the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice in him with trembling. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Accept correction, lest at any time the Lord be angry, and you⌃ should perish from the righteous way: whenever his wrath shall be suddenly kindled, blessed are all they that trust in him.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 3}
\markright{PSALM 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} A Psalm of David, when he fled from the presence of his son Abessalom. O Lord, why are they that afflict me multiplied? many rise up against me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Many say concerning my soul, There is no deliverance for him in his God. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} But you, O Lord, are my helper: my glory, and the one that lifts up my head. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I cried to the Lord with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy mountain. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} I lay down and slept; I awaked; for the Lord will help me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, who beset me round about. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Arise, Lord; deliver me, my God: for you have struck all who were without cause my enemies; you have broken the teeth of sinners. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Deliverance is the Lord's, and your blessing is upon your people.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 4}
\markright{PSALM 4}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} For the End, a Song of David among [the ]Psalms. When I called upon [him], the God of my righteousness heard me: you have made room for me in tribulation; pity me, and listen to my prayer. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} O you⌃ sons of men, how long [will you⌃ be] slow of heart? therefore do you⌃ love vanity, and seek falsehood? Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} But know you⌃ that the Lord has done wondrous things for his holy one: the Lord will hear me when I cry to him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Be you⌃ angry, and sin not; feel compunction upon your beds for what you⌃ say in your hearts. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Offer the sacrifice of righteousness, and trust in the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Many say, Who will show us good things? the light of your countenance, O Lord, has been manifested towards us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} You have put gladness into my heart: they have been satisfied with the fruit of their corn and wine and oil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I will both lie down in peace and sleep: for you, Lord, only have caused me to dwell securely.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 5}
\markright{PSALM 5}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} For the end, a Psalm of David, concerning her that inherits. Listen to my words, O Lord, attend to my cry. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Attend to the voice of my supplication, my King, and my God: for to you, O Lord, will I pray. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} In the morning you shall hear my voice: in the morning will I wait upon you, and will look up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For you are not a god that desires iniquity; neither shall the worker of wickedness dwell with you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Neither shall the transgressors continue in your sight: you hate, O Lord, all them that work iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} You will destroy all that speak falsehood: the Lord abhors the bloody and deceitful man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} But I will enter into your house in the multitude of your mercy: I will worship in your fear toward your holy temple. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Lead me, O Lord, in your righteousness because of my enemies; make my way plain before your face. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For there is no truth in their mouth; their heart is vain; their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Judge them, O God; let them fail of their counsels: cast them out according to the abundance of their ungodliness; for they have provoked you, O Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} But let all that trust on you be glad in you: they shall exult for ever, and you shall dwell among them; and all that love your name shall rejoice in you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For you, Lord, shall bless the righteous: you have compassed us as with a shield of favor.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 6}
\markright{PSALM 6}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} For the End, a Psalm of David among the Hymns for the eighth. O Lord, rebuke me not in your wrath, neither chasten me in your anger. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Pity me, O Lord; for I am weak: heal me, O Lord; for my bones are vexed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} My soul also is grievously vexed: but you, O Lord, how long? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Return, O Lord, deliver my soul: save me for your mercy's sake. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For in death no man remembers you: and who will give you thanks in Hades? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} I am wearied with my groaning; I shall wash my bed every night; I shall water my couch with tears. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} My eye is troubled because of my wrath; I am worn out because of all my enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Depart from me, all you⌃ that work iniquity; for the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The Lord has listened to my petition; the Lord has accepted my prayer. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Let all my enemies be put to shame and sore troubled: let them be turned back and grievously put to shame speedily.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} Sheminith or, the eighth, *title *marg. rebuke \textsuperscript{6} I am, ;, all the or, every I water \textsuperscript{10} Let all, ; sore, return; and be\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 7}
\markright{PSALM 7}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} A Psalm of David, which he sang to the Lord because of the words of Chusi the Benjamite. O Lord my God, in you have I trusted: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Lest at any time [the enemy] seize my soul as a lion, while there is none to ransom, nor to save. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} O Lord my God, if I have done this; (if there is unrighteousness in my hands;) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} if I have requited with evil those who requited me [with good]; may I then perish empty by means of my enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; and let him trample my life on the ground, and lay my glory in the dust. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Arise, O Lord, in your wrath; be exalted in the utmost boundaries of my enemies: awake, O Lord my God, according to the decree which you did command. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the congregation of the nations shall compass you: and for this cause do you return on high. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} The Lord shall judge the nations: judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness, and according to my innocence that is in me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Oh let the wickedness of sinners come to an end; and [then] you shall direct the righteous, O God that search the hearts and reins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} My help is righteous, [coming] from God who saves the upright in heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} God is a righteous judge, and strong, and patient, not inflicting vengeance every day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} If you⌃ will not repent, he will furbish his sword; he has bent his bow, and made it ready. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And on it he has fitted the instruments of death; he has completed his arrows for the raging ones. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Behold, he has travailed with unrighteousness, he has conceived trouble, and brought forth iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} He has opened a pit, and dug it up, and he shall fall into the ditch which he has made. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} His trouble shall return on his own head, and his unrighteousness shall come down on his own crown. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} I will give thanks to the Lord according to his righteousness; I will sing to the name of the Lord most high.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 8}
\markright{PSALM 8}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} For the end, concerning the wine presses, a Psalm of David. O Lord, our Lord, how wonderful is your name in all the earth! for your magnificence is exalted above the heavens. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings have you perfected praise, because of your enemies; that you might put down the enemy and avenger. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For I will regard the heavens, the work of your fingers; the moon and stars, which you have established. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} What is man, that you are mindful of him? or the son of man, that you visit him? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} You made him a little less than angels, you have crowned him with glory and honor; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} and you have set him over the works of your hands: you have put all things under his feet: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} sheep and all oxen, yes and the cattle of the field; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} the birds of the sky, and the fish of the sea, the [creatures] passing through the paths of the sea. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} O Lord our Lord, how wonderful is your name in all the earth!\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} Out; ordained Heb. founded strength; still; the enemy \textsuperscript{7} Heb. Flocks and oxen, all of them\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 9 (MT 9-10)}
\markright{PSALM 9 (MT 9-10)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} For the end, a Psalm of David, concerning the secrets of the Son. I will give thanks to you, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will recount all your wonderful works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} I will be glad and exult in you: I will sing to your name, O you Most High. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} When my enemies are turned back, they shall be feeble and perish at your presence. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For you have maintained my cause and my right; you sat on the throne, that judge righteousness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} You have rebuked the nations, and the ungodly one has perished; you have blotted out their name for ever, even for ever and ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} The swords of the enemy have failed utterly; and you have destroyed cities: their memorial has been destroyed with a noise, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} but the Lord endures for ever: he has prepared his throne for judgment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And he will judge the world in righteousness, he will judge the nations in uprightness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The Lord also is become a refuge for the poor, a seasonable help, in affliction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And let them that know your name hope in you: for you, O Lord, have not failed them that diligently seek you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Sing praises to the Lord, who dwells in Sion: declare his dealings among the nations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For he remembered them, [in] making inquisition for blood: he has not forgotten the supplication of the poor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Have mercy upon me, O Lord; look upon my affliction [which I suffer] of my enemies, you that lift me up from the gates of death: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} that I may declare all your praises in the gates of the daughter of Sion: I will exult in your salvation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} The heathen are caught in the destruction which they planned: in the very snare which they hid is their foot taken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} The Lord is known as executing judgments: the sinner is taken in the works of his hands. A song of Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Let sinners be driven away into Hades, [even] all the nations that forget God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} For the poor shall not be forgotten for ever: the patience of the needy ones shall not perish for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Arise, O Lord, let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged before you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Appoint, O Lord, a lawgiver over them: let the heathen know that they are men. Pause. (Psalm 9a) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Why stand you afar off, O Lord? [why] do you overlook [us] in times of need, in affliction? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} While the ungodly one acts proudly, the poor is hotly pursued: [the wicked] are taken in the crafty counsels which they imagine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Because the sinner praises himself for the desires of his heart; and the unjust one blesses himself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} The sinner has provoked the Lord: according to the abundance of his pride he will not seek after [him]: God is not before him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} His ways are profane at all times; your judgments are removed from before him: he will gain the mastery over all his enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} For he has said in his heart, I shall not be moved, [continuing] without evil from generation to generation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Whose mouth is full of cursing, and bitterness, and fraud: under his tongue are trouble and pain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} He lies in wait with rich [men] in secret places, in order to kill the innocent: his eyes are set against the poor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} He lies in wait in secret as a lion in his den: he lies in wait to ravish the poor, to ravish the poor when he draws him [after him]: he will bring him down in his snare. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} He will bow down and fall when he has mastered the poor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} For he has said in his heart, God has forgotten: he has turned away his face so as never to look. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Arise, O Lord God; let your hand be lifted up: forget not the poor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Therefore, has the wicked provoked God? for he has said in his heart, He will not require [it]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} You see [it]; for you do observe trouble and wrath, to deliver them into your hands: the poor has been left to you; you were a helper to the orphan. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Break you the arm of the sinner and wicked man: his sin shall be sought for, and shall not be found. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} The Lord shall reign for ever, even for ever and ever: you⌃ Gentiles shall perish out his land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} The Lord has heard the desire of the poor: your ear has inclined to the preparation of their heart; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} to plead for the orphan and afflicted, that man may no more boast upon the earth.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 10 (MT 11)}
\markright{PSALM 10 (MT 11)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (11 in KJV) For the end, a Psalm of David. In the Lord I have put my trust: how will you⌃ say to my soul, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Flee to the mountains as a sparrow? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For behold the sinners have bent their [bow], they have prepared their arrows for the quiver, to shoot privily at the upright in heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For they have pulled down what you did frame, but what has the righteous done? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} The Lord is in his holy temple, as for the Lord, his throne is in heaven: his eyes look upon the poor, his eyelids try the sons of men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} The Lord tries the righteous and the ungodly: and he that loves unrighteousness hates his own soul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} He shall rain upon sinners snares, fire, and brimstone, and a stormy blast [shall be] the portion of their cup. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For the Lord [is] righteous, and loves righteousness; his face beholds uprightness.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} The wicked etc. Heb. In the pride of the wicked he doth, etc., ; let \textsuperscript{3} boasteth, ; heart's Heb. soul's and blesseth etc. or, the covetous blesseth himself, he abhorreth the Lord, ; whom; abhorreth \textsuperscript{4} the pride; will not; God etc. or, all his thoughts are, There is no God, ; thoughts \textsuperscript{5} His; thy judgments;, ; he puffeth \textsuperscript{6} said; not; never Heb. unto generation and generation \textsuperscript{7} full; and deceit Heb. deceits, ; under mischief; vanity or, iniquity \textsuperscript{8} sitteth; his eyes; are privily set Heb. hide themselves\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 11 (MT 12)}
\markright{PSALM 11 (MT 12)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (12) For the end, A Psalm of David, upon the eighth. Save me, O Lord; for the godly man has failed; for truth is diminished from among the children of men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Every one has spoken vanity to his neighbor: their lips are deceitful, they have spoken with a double heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Let the Lord destroy all the deceitful lips, and the tongue that speaks great words: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} who have said, We will magnify our tongue; our lips are our own: who is Lord of us? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Because of the misery of the poor, and because of the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, says the Lord, I will set [them] in safety; I will speak [to them] thereof openly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} The oracles of the Lord are pure oracles; as silver tried in the fire, proved [in] a furnace of earth, purified seven times. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} You, O Lord, shall keep us, and shall preserve us, from this generation, and for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} The ungodly walk around: according to your greatness you have greatly exalted the sons of men.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 12 (MT 13)}
\markright{PSALM 12 (MT 13)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (13) For the end, a Psalm of David. How long, O Lord, will you forget me? for ever? how long will you turn away your face from me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} How long shall I take counsel in my soul, [having] sorrows in my heart daily? how long shall my enemy be exalted over me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Look on me, listen to me, O Lord my God: lighten my eyes, lest I sleep in death; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} lest at any time my enemy say, I have prevailed against him: my persecutors will exult if ever I should be moved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} But I have hoped in your mercy; my heart shall exult in your salvation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} I will sing to the Lord who has dealt bountifully with me, and I will sing psalms to the name of the Lord most high.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 13 (MT 14)}
\markright{PSALM 13 (MT 14)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (14) For the end, Psalm of David. The fool has said in his heart, There is no God. They have corrupted [themselves], and become abominable in their devices; there is none that does goodness, there is not even so much as one. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The Lord looked down from heaven upon the sons of men, to see if there were any that understood, or sought after god. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} They are all gone out of the way, they are together become good for nothing, there is none that does good, no not one. Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips: whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness; their feet are swift to shed blood: destruction and misery are in their ways; and the way of peace they have not known: there is no fear of God before their eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Will not all the workers of iniquity know, who eat up my people as they would eat bread? they have not called upon the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} There were they alarmed with fear, where there was no fear; for God is in the righteous generation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} You⌃ have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the Lord is his hope. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Who will bring the salvation of Israel out of Sion? when the Lord brings back the captivity of his people, let Jacob exult, and Israel be glad.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} am 3464, bc 540 (Title), chief. or, overseer. How, forget; wilt thou hide\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 14 (MT 15)}
\markright{PSALM 14 (MT 15)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (15) A Psalm of David. O Lord, who shall sojourn in your tabernacle? and who shall dwell in your holy mountain? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} He that walks blameless, and works righteousness, who speaks truth in his heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Who has not spoken craftily with his tongue, neither has done evil to his neighbor, nor taken up a reproach against them that lived nearest to him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} In his sight an evil-worker is set at nothing, but he honors them that fear the Lord. He swears to his neighbor, and disappoints [him] not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} He has not lent his money on usury, and has not received bribes against the innocent. He that does these things shall never be moved.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} fool, ;, ; no *marg.; They are; abominable; there \textsuperscript{3} all gone; filthy Heb. stinking; there \textsuperscript{5} were etc. Heb. they feared a fear; God, ;, ; the generation\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{X: }}\textsuperscript{1} Ps 73:3; Ps 92:6; Ps 107:17; 1Sam 25:25; Prov 1:7; Prov 1:22; Prov 13:19; Prov 27:22; Luke 12:20; Ps 10:4; Ps 52:1-6; Job 22:13; Rom 1:28; Eph 2:12; Ps 36:1-4; Ps 94:4-8; Gen 6:5; Gen 6:11-12; Isa 1:4; Job 15:16; Matt 12:34; Matt 15:19; John 3:19-20; Rom 1:21-32; Titus 1:16; Titus 3:3; Rev 21:8; Rom 3:10-12; Eph 2:1-3 \textsuperscript{2} Ps 33:13-14; Ps 102:19-20; Gen 6:12; Gen 11:5; Gen 18:21; Isa 63:15; Isa 64:1; Lam 3:50; Ps 82:5; Ps 107:43; Prov 2:9; Prov 8:5; Prov 9:4; Prov 9:16; Isa 27:11; Jer 4:22; Dan 12:10; Matt 13:15; Rom 3:11; Ps 69:32; 2Chr 19:3; 2Chr 30:19; Isa 8:19; Isa 55:6; Heb 11:6 \textsuperscript{3} Ps 119:176; Eccl 7:29; Isa 53:6; Isa 59:7-8; Isa 59:13-15; Jer 2:13; Rom 3:10-12; Rom 3:23; Eph 2:3; 2Pet 2:13-15; Ps 38:5; Job 15:16; Isa 64:6; Ezek 36:25; 2Cor 7:1; Ps 14:1; Exod 8:31; Exod 12:30; Deut 1:35; Job 14:4; Rom 3:10; 1Cor 6:5 \textsuperscript{4} Ps 94:8-9; Isa 5:13; Isa 27:11; Isa 29:14; Isa 44:19-20; Isa 45:20; Rom 1:21-22; Rom 1:28; 2Cor 4:3-4; Eph 4:17-18; Jer 10:25; Amos 8:4; Mic 3:2-3; Gal 5:15; Ps 79:6; Job 21:15; Job 27:10; Isa 64:7 \textsuperscript{5} Ps 53:5; Exod 15:16; Esth 8:7; Prov 1:26-27; Prov 28:1; Ps 46:5; Ps 46:7; Ps 46:11; Isa 8:10; Isa 12:6; Isa 41:10; Isa 43:1-2; Matt 1:23; Ps 22:30; Ps 24:6; Ps 73:15; Ps 112:2; 1Pet 2:9\par}
\subsection*{Psalm 15 (MT 16)}
\markright{PSALM 15 (MT 16)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (16) A writing of David. Keep me, O Lord; for I have hoped in you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} I said to the Lord, You are my Lord; for you have no need of my goodness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} On behalf of the saints that are in his land, he has magnified all his pleasure in them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Their weaknesses have been multiplied; afterward they hasted. I will by no means assemble their bloody meetings, neither will I make mention of their names with my lips. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and of my cup: you are he that restores my inheritance to me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} The lines have fallen to me in the best places, yes, I have a most excellent heritage. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} I will bless the Lord who has instructed me; my reins too have chastened me even till night. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I foresaw the Lord always before my face; for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Therefore my heart rejoiced and my tongue exulted; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} because you will not leave my soul in hell, neither will you suffer your Holy One to see corruption. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} You have made known to me the ways of life; you will fill me with joy with your countenance: at your right hand [there are] delights for ever.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} Lord, ;, abide Heb. sojourn holy \textsuperscript{3} backbiteth; doeth; taketh up or, receiveth or, endureth \textsuperscript{5} putteth; nor taketh; He that doeth\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{X: }}\textsuperscript{1} Ps 1:1-4; Ps 23:6; Ps 21:3-5; Ps 27:4; Ps 61:4; Ps 84:4; Ps 92:13; John 3:3-5; John 14:3; John 17:24; Rev 7:14-17; Rev 21:3-4; Rev 21:23-24; Ps 2:6; Ps 3:4; Ps 43:3-4; Ps 87:1-3; Heb 12:22; Rev 14:1 \textsuperscript{2} Ps 84:11; Prov 2:7-8; Prov 28:18; Isa 33:15; Mic 2:7; Luke 1:6; Gal 2:14; 1John 2:6; Acts 10:35; Rom 2:10; Eph 2:10; Heb 11:33; 1John 2:29; 1John 3:7; Rev 22:14-15; Ps 34:12-13; Isa 63:8; Zech 8:16-17; Eph 4:25; Col 3:9; Rev 21:8 \textsuperscript{3} Ps 101:5-8; Exod 23:1-33; Lev 19:16; Jer 9:4-9; Rom 1:30; Titus 3:2; Jas 4:11; 1Pet 2:1-2; 1Sam 24:11; Isa 56:2; Matt 7:12; Rom 12:17; Rom 13:10; 3John 1:11; Prov 22:10; Prov 25:3 \textsuperscript{4} Ps 101:4; 2Kgs 3:13-14; Esth 3:2; Job 32:21-22; Isa 32:5-6; Dan 5:17-31; Acts 24:2-3; Acts 24:25; Jas 2:1-9; Ps 16:3; Ps 101:6; Ps 119:63; Matt 12:49-50; 1John 3:14; Josh 9:18-20; Judg 11:35; 2Sam 21:1-2; Matt 5:33 \textsuperscript{5} Exod 22:25; Lev 25:35-37; Deut 23:19-20; Neh 5:2-5; Neh 5:7-13; Ezek 18:8; Ezek 18:17; Ezek 22:12; Exod 23:7-8; Deut 16:19; Isa 33:15; Mic 7:3; Matt 26:15; Matt 27:3-5; Ps 16:8; Ps 55:22; Ps 106:3; Ps 112:6; Prov 12:3; Ezek 18:27; Matt 7:21-25; John 13:17; Jas 1:22-25; 2Pet 1:10-11\par}
\subsection*{Psalm 16 (MT 17)}
\markright{PSALM 16 (MT 17)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (17) A prayer of David. Listen, O Lord of my righteousness, attend to my petition; give ear to my prayer not [uttered] with deceitful lips. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Let my judgment come forth from your presence; let my eyes behold righteousness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} You have tested my heart; you have visited [me] by night; you have tried me as with fire, and unrighteousness has not been found in me: [I am purposed] that my mouth shall not speak [amiss]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} As for the works of men, by the words of your lips I have guarded [myself from] hard ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Direct my steps in your paths, that my steps slip not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} I have cried, for you heard me, O God: incline your ear to me, and listen to my words. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Show the marvels of your mercies, you that save them that hope in you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Keep me as the apple of the eye from those that resist your right hand: you shall screen me by the covering of your wings, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} from the face of the ungodly that have afflicted me: my enemies have compassed about my soul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} They have enclosed [themselves with] their own fat: their mouth has spoken pride. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} They have now cast me out and compassed me round about: they have set their eyes [so as] to bow them down to the ground. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} They laid wait for me as a lion ready for prey, and like a lion's whelp dwelling in secret [places]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Arise, O Lord, prevent them, and cast them down: deliver my soul from the ungodly: [draw] your sword, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} because of the enemies of your hand: O Lord, destroy them from the earth; scatter them in their life, though their belly has been filled with your hidden [treasures]: they have been satisfied with uncleanness, and have left the remnant [of their possessions] to their babes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} But I shall appear in righteousness before your face: I shall be satisfied when your glory appears.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{3} But; the saints; the excellent; Song 4:1-7:13; in whom \textsuperscript{4} Their; hasten etc. or, give gifts to another drink; take \textsuperscript{5} The Lord, ; mine inheritance Heb. my part of my, ; thou \textsuperscript{6} The lines; in pleasant; I have \textsuperscript{7} who hath;, my reins; in the \textsuperscript{8} I have; he is, I shall \textsuperscript{9} my heart my glory; my flesh; rest in hope Heb. dwell confidently \textsuperscript{10} my, *marg.; hell The word hell, from the Saxon hillan or helan, to hide, or from holl, a cavern, though now used only for the place of torment, anciently denoted the concealed or unseen place of the dead in general; corresponding to the Greek αδηϚ, i.e., ο αιδηϚ τοπος, the invisible place and the Hebrew sheol, from shaal, to ask, seek, the place and state of those who are out of the way, and to be sought for. neither; thine \textsuperscript{11} path;, ; in thy; at thy; pleasures\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 17 (MT 18)}
\markright{PSALM 17 (MT 18)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (18) For the end, [a Psalm] of David, the servant of the Lord; [the words] which he spoke to the Lord, [even] the words of this Song, in the day in which the Lord delivered him out the hand of all his enemies, and out the hand of Saul: and he said: I will love you, O Lord, my strength. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The Lord is my firm support, and my refuge, and my deliverer; my God is my helper, I will hope in him; [he is] my defender, and the horn of my salvation, and my helper. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} I will call upon the Lord with praises, and I shall be saved from my enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} The pangs of death compassed me, and the torrents of ungodliness troubled me exceedingly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} The pangs of hell came round about me: the snares of death prevented me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And when I was afflicted I called upon the Lord, and cried to my God: he heard my voice out of this holy temple, and my cry shall enter before him, [even] into his ears. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Then the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains were disturbed, and were shaken, because God was angry with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} There went up a smoke in his wrath, and fire burst into a flame at his presence: coals were kindled at it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And he bowed the heaven, and came down: and thick darkness was under his feet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And he mounted on cherubs and flew: he flew on the wings of winds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And he made darkness his secret place: round about him was his tabernacle, [even] dark water in the clouds of the air. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} At the brightness before him the clouds passed, hail and coals of fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} The Lord also thundered from heaven, and the Highest uttered his voice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And he sent forth [his] weapons, and scattered them; and multiplied lightnings, and routed them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And the springs of waters appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed, at your rebuke, O Lord, at the blasting of the breath of your wrath. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} He sent from on high and took me, he drew me to himself out of many waters. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} He will deliver me from my mighty enemies, and from them that hate me; for they are stronger than I. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} They prevented me in the day of my affliction: but the Lord was my stay against [them]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And he brought me out into a wide place: he will deliver me, because he has pleasure in me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And the Lord will recompense me according to my righteousness; even according to the purity of my hands will he recompense me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For I have kept the way of the Lord and have not wickedly departed from my God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} For all his judgments were before me, and his ordinances departed not from me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And I shall be blameless with him, and shall keep myself from my iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And the Lord shall recompense me according to my righteousness, and according to the purity of my hands before his eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} With the holy you will be holy; and with the innocent man you will be innocent. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And with the excellent [man] you will be excellent; and with the perverse you will show frowardness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} For you will save the lowly people, and will humble the eyes of the proud. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} For you, O Lord, will light my lamp: my God, you will lighten my darkness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} For by you shall I be delivered from a troop; and by my God I will pass over a wall. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} [As for] my God, his way is perfect: the oracles of the Lord are tried in the fire; he is a protector of all them that hope in him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} For who is God but the Lord? and who is a God except our God? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} [It is] God that girds me with strength, and has made my way blameless: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} who strengthens my feet as hart's feet, and sets me upon high places. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} He instructs my hands for war: and you have made my arms [as] a brazen bow. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And you have made me secure in my salvation: and your right hand has helped me, and your correction has upheld me to the end; yes, your correction itself shall instruct me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} You have made room for my goings under me, and by footsteps did not fail. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them; and I will not turn back until they are consumed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} I will dash them to pieces and they shall not be able to stand: they shall fall under my feet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} For you have girded me with strength for war: you have beaten down under me all that rose up against me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And you have made my enemies turn their backs before me; and you have destroyed them that hated me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} They cried, but there was no deliverer: [even] to the Lord, but he listened not to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} I will grind them as the mud of the streets: and I will beat them small as dust before the wind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} Deliver me from the gain sayings of the people: you shall make me head of the Gentiles: a people whom I knew not served me, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} at the hearing of the ear they obeyed me: the strange children lied to me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} The strange children waxed old, and fell away from their paths through lameness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} The Lord lives; and blessed [be] my God; and let the God of my salvation be exalted. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} [It is] God that avenges me, and has subdued the nations under me; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} my deliverer from angry enemies: you shall set me on high above them that rise up against me: you shall deliver me from the unrighteous man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} Therefore will I confess to you, O Lord, among the Gentiles, and sing to your name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} [God] magnifies the deliverances of his king; and deals mercifully with David his anointed, and his seed, for ever.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 18 (MT 19)}
\markright{PSALM 18 (MT 19)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (19) For the end, a Psalm of David. The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament proclaims the work of his hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Day to day utters speech, and night to night proclaims knowledge. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} There are no speeches or words, in which their voices are not heard. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Their voice is gone out into all the earth, and their words to the ends of the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} In the sun he has set his tabernacle; and he comes forth as a bridegroom out of his chamber: he will exult as a giant to run his course. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} His going forth is from the extremity of heaven, and his circuit to the [other] end of heaven: and no one shall be hidden from his heat. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} The law of the Lord is perfect, converting souls: the testimony of the Lord is faithful, instructing babes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} The ordinances of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the Lord is bright, enlightening the eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The fear of the Lord is pure, enduring for ever and ever: the judgments of the Lord are true, [and] justified altogether. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} To be desired more than gold, and much precious stone: sweeter also than honey and the honey-comb. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For your servant keeps to them: in the keeping of them [there is] great reward. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Who will understand [his] transgressions? purge you me from my secret [sins]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And spare your servant [the attack] of strangers: if they do not gain the dominion over me, then shall I be blameless, and I shall be clear from great sin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} So shall the sayings of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be pleasing continually before you, O Lord my helper, and my redeemer.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} in the day; I will; my \textsuperscript{2} Lord, ; fortress; strength Heb. rock whom buckler; horn; high \textsuperscript{3} I will, ; who; so shall \textsuperscript{4} sorrows; floods;, ; ungodly men Heb. Belial \textsuperscript{5} The sorrows or, cords, ; snares \textsuperscript{8} went, ; , out of his Heb. by his fire \textsuperscript{9} He bowed Jehovah is here represented as a mighty warrior going forth to fight the battles of David. When He descended to the engagement, the very heavens bowed to render his descent more awful: His military tent was substantial darkness; the voice of His thunder was the warlike alarm which sounded to battle; the chariot in which He rode was the thick clouds of heaven, conducted by cherubs, and carried on by the irresistible force and rapid wings of an impetuous tempest; and the darts and weapons He employed were thunder-bolts, lightnings, fiery hail, deluging rains, and stormy winds! No wonder that when God arose all His enemies were scattered, and those that hated Him fled before Him.; darkness\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 19 (MT 20)}
\markright{PSALM 19 (MT 20)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (20) For the end, a Psalm of David. The Lord hear you in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Send you help from the sanctuary, and aid you out of Sion. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Remember all your sacrifice, and enrich your whole burnt offering. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Grant you according to your heart, and fulfill all your desire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} We will exult in your salvation, and in the name of our God shall we be magnified: the Lord fulfil all your petitions. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Now I know that the Lord has saved his Christ: he shall hear him from his holy heaven: the salvation of his right hand is mighty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Some [glory] in chariots, and some in horses: but we will glory in the name of the Lord our God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} They are overthrown and fallen: but we are risen, and have been set upright. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} O Lord, save the king: and hear us in whatever day we call upon you.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} The heavens, ; the firmament Rakeea, from raka, to stretch out, the expanse, not only containing the celestial bodies, but also the air, light, rain, dews, etc., all of which display the infinite power and wisdom of their Almighty Creator. \textsuperscript{3} There Or, "They have no speech, nor words, nor is their voice heard; yet into all the earth hath gone out their sound, and to the extremity of the world their words." The Hebrew, kav, rendered, line, like the Greek φθογγος, by which the LXX (who are followed by St. Paul), render it, no doubt signifies the sound as well as the cord which emits it. The Vulgate, Jerome, and Symmachus, render it to the same purpose. where or, without these their voice is heard, Heb. without their voice heard \textsuperscript{4} Their; line or, rule, or, direction In them \textsuperscript{7} law or, doctrine, ; perfect; converting or, restoring, ; testimony, ; sure; making \textsuperscript{8} statutes, ; right; rejoicing, ; is pure; enlightening \textsuperscript{9} The fear, ; enduring, judgments, ; , true Heb. truth\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 20 (MT 21)}
\markright{PSALM 20 (MT 21)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (21) For the end, a Psalm of David. O Lord, the king shall rejoice in your strength; and in your salvation he shall greatly exult. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} You have granted him the desire of his soul, and have not withheld from him the request of his lips. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For you have prevented him with blessings of goodness: you have set upon his head a crown of precious stone. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} He asked life of you, and you gave him length of days for ever and ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} His glory is great in your salvation: you will crown him with glory and majesty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} For you will give him a blessing for ever and ever: you will gladden him with joy with your countenance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For the king trusts in the Lord, and through the mercy of the Highest he shall not be moved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Let your hand be found by all your enemies: let your right hand find all that hate you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} You shall make them as a fiery oven at the time of your presence: the Lord shall trouble them in his anger, and fire shall devour them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} You shall destroy their fruit from the earth, and their seed from [among] the sons of men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For they intended evils against you; they imagined a device which they shall by no means be able to perform. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For you shall make them [turn their] back in your latter end, you will prepare their face. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Be you exalted, O Lord, in your strength: we will sing and praise your mighty acts.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} am 2968, bc 1036 hear, ; name; God; defend Heb. set thee on an high place \textsuperscript{2} thee help Heb. thy help from; strengthen Heb. support thee out \textsuperscript{3} Remember; accept Heb. turn to ashes, or, make fat \textsuperscript{6} Now, ; he will; his holy heaven Heb. the heaven of his holiness, with etc. Heb. by the strength of the salvation of his right hand \textsuperscript{9} Save etc. or, "O Jehovah, save the king; answer us when we call upon thee."; let\par}
