\subsection*{Psalm 21 (MT 22)}
\markright{PSALM 21 (MT 22)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (22) For the end, concerning the morning aid, a Psalm of David. O God, my God, attend to me: why have you forsaken me? the account of my transgressions is far from my salvation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} O my God, I will cry to you by day, but you will not hear: and by night, and [it shall] not [be accounted] for folly to me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} But you, the praise of Israel, dwell in a sanctuary. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Our fathers hoped in you; they hoped, and you did deliver them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} They cried to you, and were saved: they hoped in you, and were not ashamed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} But I am a worm, and not a man; a reproach of men, and scorn of the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} All that saw me mocked me: they spoke with [their] lips, they shook the head, [saying], {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} He hoped in the Lord: let him deliver him, let him save him, because he takes pleasure in him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For you are he that drew me out of the womb; my hope from my mother's breasts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} I was cast on you from the womb: you are my God from my mother's belly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Stand not aloof from me; for affliction is near; for there is no helper. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Many bullocks have compassed me: fat bulls have beset me round. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} They have opened their mouth against me, as a ravening and roaring lion. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} I am poured out like water, and all my bones are loosened: my heart in the midst of my belly is become like melting wax. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} My strength is dried up, like a potsherd; and my tongue is glued to my throat; and you have brought me down to the dust of death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} For many dogs have compassed me: the assembly of the wicked doers has beset me round: they pierced my hands and my feet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} They counted all my bones; and they observed and looked upon me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} They parted my garments [among] themselves, and cast lots upon my raiment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} But you, O Lord, remove not my help afar off: be ready for my aid. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Deliver my soul from the sword; my only-begotten one from the power of the dog. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Save me from the lion's mouth; and [regard] my lowliness from the horns of the unicorns. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} I will declare your name to my brethren: in the midst of the church will I sing praise to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} You⌃ that fear the Lord, praise him; all you⌃ seed of Jacob, glorify him: let all the seed of Israel fear him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} For he has not despised nor been angry at the supplication of the poor; nor turned away his face from me; but when I cried to him, he heard me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} My praise is of you in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} The poor shall eat and be satisfied; and they shall praise the Lord that seek him: their heart shall live for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the Lord: and all the kindred of the nations shall worship before him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} For the kingdom is the Lord's; and he is the governor of the nations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} All the fat ones of the earth have eaten and worshipped: all that go down to the earth shall fall down before him: my soul also lives to him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And my seed shall serve him: the generation that is coming shall be reported to the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And they shall report his righteousness to the people that shall be born, whom the Lord has made.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} The king, ; joy, in thy \textsuperscript{6} made Heb. set him to be blessings; made him exceeding glad Heb. gladdened him with joy \textsuperscript{7} For the, ; most; he shall \textsuperscript{9} Thou; , ; the Lord; in his; the fire \textsuperscript{12} Therefore, make etc. or, set them as a butt, ; back Heb. shoulder thou shalt \textsuperscript{13} Be thou, *marg.; so will\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 22 (MT 23)}
\markright{PSALM 22 (MT 23)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (23) A Psalm of David. The Lord tends me as a shepherd, and I shall lack nothing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} In a place of green grass, there he has made me dwell: he has nourished me by the water of rest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} He has restored my soul: he has guided me into the paths of righteousness, for his name's sake. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Yes, even if I should walk in the midst of the shadow of death, I will not be afraid of evils: for you are with me; your rod and your staff, these have comforted me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} You have prepared a table before me in presence of them that afflict me: you have thoroughly anointed my head with oil; and your cup cheers me like the best [wine]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Your mercy also shall follow me all the days of my life: and my dwelling [shall be] in the house of the Lord for a very long time.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} my God; why hast, ; far, helping Heb. my salvation, words \textsuperscript{2} I cry, ; but; in the night, am not silent Heb. there is no silence to me\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{X: }}\textsuperscript{1} Ps 31:14-16; Ps 43:1-5; Matt 27:46; Mark 15:34; Luke 24:44; Ps 26:9; Ps 37:28; Ps 71:11; 1Sam 12:22; Heb 13:5; Ps 22:11; Ps 16:1; Isa 46:13; Ps 32:3-4; Ps 38:8; Job 3:24; Isa 59:11; Luke 22:44; Heb 5:7 \textsuperscript{2} Ps 42:3; Ps 55:16-17; Ps 88:1; Luke 18:7; 1Thess 3:10; 2Tim 1:3; Ps 80:4; Lam 3:8; Lam 3:44; Luke 6:12; Luke 22:41-46; Matt 26:44 \textsuperscript{3} Ps 145:17; Isa 6:3; Rev 4:8; Ps 50:23; Ps 65:1; Deut 10:21 \textsuperscript{4} Ps 44:1-7; Gen 15:6; Gen 32:9-12; Gen 32:28; Exod 14:13-14; Exod 14:31; 1Sam 7:9-12; Rom 4:18-22; Heb 11:8-32 \textsuperscript{5} Ps 99:6-7; Ps 106:44; Judg 4:3; Judg 6:6; Judg 10:10-16; Ps 25:2-3; Ps 31:1; Ps 69:6-7; Ps 71:1; Isa 45:17; Isa 49:23; Rom 9:33; Rom 10:11; 1Pet 2:6 \textsuperscript{6} Job 25:6; Isa 41:14; Ps 31:1; Ps 69:7-12; Ps 69:19-20; Ps 88:8; Isa 49:7; Isa 53:3; Lam 3:30; Matt 11:19; Matt 12:24; Matt 27:20-23; John 7:15; John 7:20; John 7:47-49; John 8:48; Rev 15:3; Heb 13:12\par}
\subsection*{Psalm 23 (MT 24)}
\markright{PSALM 23 (MT 24)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (24) A Psalm for David on the first day of the week. The earth is the Lord's and the fullness thereof; the world, and all that dwell in it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} He has founded it upon the seas, and prepared it upon the rivers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Who shall go up to the mountain of the Lord, and who shall stand in his holy place? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} He that is innocent in his hands and pure in his heart; who has not lifted up his soul to vanity, nor sworn deceitfully to his neighbor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} He shall receive a blessing from the Lord, and mercy from God his Saviour. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek the face of the God of Jacob. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Lift up your gates, you⌃ princes, and be you⌃ lifted up, you⌃ everlasting doors; and the king of glory shall come in. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Who is this king of Glory? the Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Lift up your gates, you⌃ princes; and be you⌃ lift up, you⌃ everlasting doors; and the king of glory shall come in. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Who is this king of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is this king of glory.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} maketh; green pastures Heb. pastures of tender grass leadeth;, still waters Heb. waters of quietness \textsuperscript{3} restoreth *marg., ; leadeth, ; for his \textsuperscript{4} through; I will, ; for thou; thy rod \textsuperscript{5} preparest, ; thou anointest Heb. makest fat, ; my cup \textsuperscript{6} goodness, ; and I, ; for ever Heb. to length of days\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 24 (MT 25)}
\markright{PSALM 24 (MT 25)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (25) A Psalm of David. To you, O Lord, have I lifted up my soul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} O my God, I have trusted in you: let me not be confounded, neither let my enemies laugh me to scorn. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For none of them that wait on you shall in any wise be ashamed: let them be ashamed that transgress without cause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Show me your ways, O Lord; and teach me your paths. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Lead me in your truth, and teach me: for you are God my Saviour: and I have waited on you all the day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Remember your compassions, O Lord, and your mercies, for they are from everlasting. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Remember not the sins of my youth, nor [my sins] of ignorance: remember me according to your mercy, for your goodness' sake, O Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Good and upright is the Lord: therefore will he instruct sinners in [the] way. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The meek will he guide in judgment: the meek will he teach his ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} All the ways of the Lord are mercy and truth to them that seek his covenant and his testimonies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For your name's sake, O Lord, do you also be merciful to my sin; for it is great. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Who is the man that fears the Lord? he shall instruct him in the way which he has chosen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} His soul shall dwell in prosperity; and his seed shall inherit the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} The Lord is the strength of them that fear him; and his covenant is to manifest [truth] to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} My eyes are continually to the Lord; for he shall draw my feet out of the snare. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Look upon me, and have mercy upon me; for I am an only child and poor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} The afflictions of my heart have been multiplied; deliver me from my distresses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Look upon my affliction and my trouble; and forgive all my sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Look upon my enemies; for they have been multiplied; and they have hated me with unjust hatred. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I have hoped in you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} The harmless and upright joined themselves to me: for I waited for you, O Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Deliver Israel, O God, out of all his afflictions.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{4} He that etc. Heb. the clean of hands, ; pure; , lifted; sworn \textsuperscript{6} This is; that seek; O Jacob or, O God of Jacob\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 25 (MT 26)}
\markright{PSALM 25 (MT 26)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (26) [A Psalm] of David. Judge me, O Lord; for I have walked in my innocence: and hoping in the Lord I shall not be moved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Prove me, O Lord, and try me; purify as with fire my reins and my heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For your mercy is before my eyes: and I am well pleased with your truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I have not sat with the council of vanity, and will in nowise enter in with transgressors. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} I have hated the assembly of wicked doers; and will not sit with ungodly [men]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} I will wash my hands in innocency, and compass your altar, O Lord: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} to hear the voice of praise, and to declare all your wonderful works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} O Lord, I have loved the beauty of your house, and the place of the tabernacle of your glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Destroy not my soul together with the ungodly, nor my life with bloody men: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} in whose hands [are] iniquities, [and] their right hand is filled with bribes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} But I have walked in my innocence: redeem me, and have mercy upon me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} My foot stands in an even place: in the congregations will I bless you, O Lord.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 26 (MT 27)}
\markright{PSALM 26 (MT 27)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (27) [A Psalm] of David, before he was anointed. The Lord is my light and my Saviour; whom shall I fear? the Lord is the defender of my life; of whom shall I be afraid? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} When evil-doers drew near against me to eat up my flesh, my persecutors and my enemies, they fainted and fell. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Though an army should set itself in array against me, my heart shall not be afraid: though war should rise up against me, in this am I confident. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} One thing have I asked of the Lord, this will I earnestly seek: that I should dwell in the house of the Lord, all the days of my life, that I should behold the fair beauty of the Lord, and survey his temple. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For in the day of my afflictions he hid me in his tabernacle: he sheltered me in the secret of his tabernacle; he set me up on a rock. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And now, behold, he has lifted up my head over my enemies: I went round and offered in his tabernacle the sacrifice of joy; I will sing even sing psalms to the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Hear, O Lord, my voice which I have uttered aloud: pity me, and listen to me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} My heart said to you, I have diligently sought your face: your face, O Lord, I will seek. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Turn not your face away from me, turn not you away from your servant in anger: be you my helper, forsake me not; and, O God my Saviour, overlook me not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For my father and my mother have forsaken me, but the Lord has taken me to himself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Teach me, O Lord, in your way, and guide me in a right path, because of my enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Deliver me not over to the desire of them that afflict me; for unjust witnesses have risen up against me, and injustice has lied within herself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} I believe that I shall see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Wait on the Lord: be of good courage, and let your heart be strengthened: yes wait on the Lord.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 27 (MT 28)}
\markright{PSALM 27 (MT 28)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (28) [A Psalm] of David. To you, O Lord, have I cried; my God, be not silent toward me: lest you be silent toward me, and so I should be likened to them that go down to the pit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Listen to the voice of my supplication, when I pray to you, when I lift up my hands toward your holy temple. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Draw not away my soul with sinners, and destroy me not with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace with their neighbors, but evils are in their hearts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Give them according to their works, and according to the wickedness of their devices: give them according to the works of their hands; render their recompense to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Because they have not attended to the works of the Lord, even to the works of his hands, you shall pull them down, and shall not build them up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Blessed be the Lord, for he has listened to the voice of my petition. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} The Lord is my helper and my defender; my heart has hoped in him, and I am helped: my flesh has revived, and willingly will I give praise to him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} The Lord is the strength of his people, and the saving defender of his anointed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Save your people, and bless your inheritance: and take care of them, and lift them up for ever.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 28 (MT 29)}
\markright{PSALM 28 (MT 29)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (29) A Psalm of David [on the occasion] of the solemn assembly of the Tabernacle. Bring to the Lord, you⌃ sons of God, bring to the Lord young rams; bring to the Lord glory and honor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Bring to the Lord glory, [due] to his name; worship the lord in his holy court. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} The voice of the Lord is upon the waters: the God of glory has thundered: the Lord is upon many waters. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} The voice of the Lord is mighty; the voice of the Lord is full of majesty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} [There is] the voice of the Lord who breaks the cedars; the Lord will break the cedars of Libanus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And he will beat them small, [even] Libanus itself, like a calf; and the beloved one is as a young unicorn. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} [There is] a voice of the Lord who divides a flame of fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} A voice of the Lord who shakes the wilderness; the Lord will shake the wilderness of Cades. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The voice of the Lord strengthens the hinds, and will uncover the thickets: and in his temple every one speaks [of his] glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} The Lord will dwell on the waterflood: and the Lord will sit a king for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} The Lord will give strength to his people; the Lord will bless his people with peace.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} Unto, O; *marg. be, to Heb. from I become \textsuperscript{2} when, ; thy holy oracle or, the oracle of thy sanctuary \textsuperscript{4} Give, ; and; the work, ; render \textsuperscript{7} strength, ; shield; heart, therefore, ; with \textsuperscript{8} their or, his saving strength Heb. strength of salvations his \textsuperscript{9} Save, ; bless; feed or, rule; *marg. lift *marg.\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 29 (MT 30)}
\markright{PSALM 29 (MT 30)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (30) For the end, a Psalm and Song at the dedication of the house of David. I will exalt you, O Lord; for you have lifted me up, and not caused my enemies to rejoice over me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} O Lord my God, I cried to you, and you did heal me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} O Lord, you have brought up my soul from Hades, you have delivered me from [among] them that go down to the pit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Sing to the Lord, you⌃ his saints, and give thanks for the remembrance of his holiness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For anger is in his wrath, but life in his favor: weeping shall wait for the evening, but joy shall be in the morning. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And I said in my prosperity, I shall never be moved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} O Lord, in your good pleasure you did add strength to my beauty: but you did turn away your face, and I was troubled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} To you, O Lord, will I cry; and to my God will I make supplication. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to destruction? Shall the dust give praise to you? or shall it declare your truth? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} The Lord heard, and had compassion upon me; the Lord is become my helper. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} You have turned my mourning into joy for me: you have torn off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} that my glory may sing praise to you, and I may not be pierced [with sorrow]. O Lord my God, I will give thanks to you for ever.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} Give, ; mighty Heb. sons of the mighty \textsuperscript{2} Give glory etc. Heb. honour of his name, worship; the beauty of holiness or, his glorious sanctuary \textsuperscript{3} The voice; God; thundereth, ; , many waters or, great waters \textsuperscript{4} powerful Heb. in power; full of Heb. in \textsuperscript{7} divideth Heb. cutteth out flames \textsuperscript{9} maketh Or as Bp. Lowth and others, "maketh the oaks to tremble and maketh bare the forests; " understanding ayyaloth, as denoting here, not hinds, but oaks, as it signifies in Syriac. calve or, be in pain discovereth; in his temple, doth etc. or, every whit of it uttereth\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 30 (MT 31)}
\markright{PSALM 30 (MT 31)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (31) For the end, a Psalm of David, [an utterance] of extreme fear. O Lord, I have hoped in you; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in your righteousness and rescue me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Incline your ear to me; make haste to rescue me: be you to me for a protecting God, and for a house of refuge to save me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For you are my strength and my refuge; and you shall guide me for your name's sake, and maintain me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} You shall bring me out of the snare which they have hidden for me; for you, O Lord, are my defender. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Into your hands I will commit my spirit: you have redeemed me, O Lord God of truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} You have hated them that idly persist in vanities: but I have hoped in the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} I will exult and be glad in your mercy: for you have looked upon my affliction; you have saved my soul from distresses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And you have not shut me up into the hands of the enemy: you have set my feet in a wide place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Pity me, O Lord, for I am afflicted: my eye is troubled with indignation, my soul and by belly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For my life is spent with grief, and my years with groanings: my strength has been weakened through poverty, and my bones are troubled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} I became a reproach among all my enemies, but exceedingly so to my neighbors, and a fear to my acquaintance: they that saw me without fled from me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} I have been forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am become as a broken vessel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} For I heard the slander of many that lived round about: when they were gathered together against me, they took counsel to take my life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} But I hoped in you, O Lord: I said, You are my God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} My lots are in your hands: deliver me from the hand of my enemies, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} and from them that persecute me. Make your face to shine upon your servant: save me in your mercy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} O Lord, let me not be ashamed, for I have called upon you: let the ungodly be ashamed, and brought down to Hades. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Let the deceitful lips become dumb, which speak iniquity against the righteous with pride and scorn. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} How abundant is the multitude of your goodness, O Lord, which you have laid up for them that fear you! you have wrought [it] out for them that hope on you, in the presence of the sons of men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} You will hide them in the secret of your presence from the vexation of man: you will screen them in a tabernacle from the contradiction of tongues. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Blessed be the Lord: for he has magnified his mercy in a fortified city. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} But I said in my extreme fear, I am cast out from the sight of your eyes: therefore you did listen, O Lord, to the voice of my supplication when I cried to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Love the Lord, all you⌃ his saints: for the Lord seeks for truth, and renders [a reward] to them that deal very proudly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Be of good courage, and let your heart be strengthened, all you⌃ that hope in the Lord.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} at the;, extol, ; for, hast not \textsuperscript{4} Sing, ; at the remembrance or, to the memorial, *marg. holiness \textsuperscript{5} For; his anger etc. Heb. there is but a moment in his anger in his, ; weeping, ; for a night Heb. in the evening joy Heb. singing in the *marg.; *marg. \textsuperscript{7} by thy, ; made etc. Heb. settled strength for my mountain; thou \textsuperscript{12} my glory that is, my tongue, or my soul, ; and; I will\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 31 (MT 32)}
\markright{PSALM 31 (MT 32)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (32) [A Psalm] of instruction by David. Blessed [are they] whose transgressions are forgiven, and who sins are covered. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin, and whose mouth there is no guile. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Because I kept silence, my bones waxed old, from my crying all the day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For day and night your hand was heavy upon me: I became thoroughly miserable while a thorn was fastened in [me]. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} I acknowledged my sin, and hid not my iniquity: I said, I will confess my iniquity to the Lord against myself; and you forgave the ungodliness of my heart. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Therefore shall every holy one pray to you in a fit time: only in the deluge of many waters they shall not come near to him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} You are my refuge from the affliction that encompasses me; my joy, to deliver me from them that have compassed me. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I will instruct you and guide you in this way wherein you shall go: I will fix my eyes upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Be you⌃ not as horse and mule, which have no understanding; [but you must] constrain their jaws with bit and curb, lest they should come near to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Many are the scourges of the sinner: but him that hopes in the Lord mercy shall compass about. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Be glad in the Lord, and exult, you⌃ righteous: and glory, all you⌃ that are upright in heart.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} Bow, ; deliver, ; my strong rock Heb. to me for a rock of strength, ; an house \textsuperscript{11} I was, ; especially, ; a fear\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 32 (MT 33)}
\markright{PSALM 32 (MT 33)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (33) [A Psalm] of David. Rejoice in the Lord, you⌃ righteous; praise becomes the upright. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Praise the Lord on the harp; platy to him on a lute of ten strings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Sing to him a new song; play skillfully with a loud noise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For the word of the Lord is right; and all his works are faithful. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} He loves mercy and judgment; the earth is full the mercy of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} By the word of the Lord the heavens were established; and all the host of them by the breath of his [mouth]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Who gathers the waters of the sea as [in] a bottle; who lays up the deeps in treasuries. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Let all the earth fear the Lord; and let all that dwell in the world be moved because of him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For he spoke, and they were made; he commanded, and they were created. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} The Lord frustrates the counsels of the nations; he brings to nothing also the reasonings of the peoples, and brings to nothing the counsels of princes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} But the counsel of the Lord endures for ever, the thoughts of his heart from generation to generation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord; the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} The Lord looks out of heaven; he beholds all the sons of men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} He looks from his prepared habitation on all the dwellers on the earth; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} who fashioned their hearts alone; who understands all their works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} A king is not saved by reason of a great host; and a giant shall not be delivered by the greatness of his strength. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} A horse is vain for safety; neither shall he be delivered by the greatness of his power. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Behold, the eyes of the Lord are on them that fear him, those that hope in his mercy; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} to deliver their souls from death, and to keep them alive in famine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Our soul waits on the Lord; for he is our helper and defender. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For our heart shall rejoice in him, and we have hoped in his holy name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Let your mercy, O Lord, be upon us, according as we have hoped in you.\par

I will counsel thee, mine eye shall be upon thee\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 33 (MT 34)}
\markright{PSALM 33 (MT 34)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (34) [A Psalm] of David, when he changed his countenance before Abimelech; and he let him go, and he departed. I will bless the Lord at all times: his praise shall be continually in my mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} My soul shall boast herself in the Lord: let the meek hear, and rejoice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Magnify you⌃ the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I sought the Lord diligently, and he listened to me, and delivered me from all my sojournings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Draw near to him, and be enlightened: and your faces shall not [by any means] be ashamed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} This poor man cried, and the Lord listened to him, and delivered him out of all his afflictions. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} The angel of the Lord will encamp round about them that fear him, and will deliver them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Taste and see that the Lord is good: blessed is the man who hopes in him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Fear the Lord, all you⌃ his saints: for there is no lack to them that fear him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} The rich have become poor and hungry: but they that seek the Lord diligently shall not lack any good thing. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Come, you⌃ children, hear me: I will teach you the fear of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} What man is there that desires life, loving to see good days? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking guile. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Turn away from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} The eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears [are open] to their prayer: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil, to destroy their memorial from the earth. The righteous cried, and the Lord listened to them, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} and delivered them out of all their afflictions. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} The Lord is near to them that are of a contrite heart; and will save the lowly in spirit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but out of them all Lord will deliver them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} He keeps all their bones: not one of them shall be broken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} The death of sinners is evil: and they that hate righteousness will go wrong. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} The Lord will redeem the souls of his servants: and none of those that hope in him shall go wrong.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 34 (MT 35)}
\markright{PSALM 34 (MT 35)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (35) [A Psalm] of David. Judge you, O Lord, them that injure me, fight against them that fight against me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Take hold of shield and buckler, and arise for my help. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Bring forth a sword, and stop [the way] against them that persecute me: say to my soul, I am your salvation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Let them that seek my soul be ashamed and confounded: let them that devise evils against me be turned back and put to shame. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Let them be as dust before the wind, and an angel of the Lord afflicting them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Let their way be dark and slippery, and an angel of the Lord persecuting them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For without cause they have hid for me their destructive snare: without a cause they have reproached my soul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Let a snare which they know not come upon them; and the gin which they hid take them; and let them fall into the very same snare. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} But my soul shall exult in the Lord: it shall delight in his salvation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} All my bones shall say, O Lord, who is like to you? delivering the poor out of the hand of them that are stronger than he, yes, the poor and needy one from them that spoil him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Unjust witnesses arose, and asked me of things I new not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} They rewarded me evil for good, and bereavement to my soul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} But I, when they troubled me, put on sackcloth, and humbled my soul with fasting: and my prayer shall return to my [own] bosom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} I behaved agreeably towards them as [if it had been] our neighbor [or] brother: I humbled myself as one mourning and sad of countenance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Yet they rejoiced against me, and plagues were plentifully brought against me, and I knew [it] not: they were scattered, but repented not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} They tempted me, they sneered at me most contemptuously, they gnashed their teeth upon me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} O Lord, when will you look upon me? Deliver my soul from their mischief, my only-begotten one from the lions. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} I will give thanks to you even in a great congregation: in an abundant people I will praise you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Let not them that are my enemies without a cause rejoice against me; who hate me for nothing, and wink with their eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} For to me they spoke peaceably, but imagined deceits in [their] anger. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And they opened wide their mouth upon me; they said Aha, aha, our eyes have seen [it]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} You have seen [it], O Lord: keep not silence: O Lord, withdraw not [yourself] from me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Awake, O Lord, and attend to my judgment, [even] to my cause, my God and my Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Judge me, O Lord, according to your righteousness, O Lord my God; and let them not rejoice against me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Let them not say in their hearts, Aha, aha, [it is pleasing] to our soul: neither let them say, We have devoured him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Let them be confounded and ashamed together that rejoice at my afflictions: let them be clothed with shame and confusion that speak great swelling words against me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Let them that rejoice in my righteousness exult and be glad: and let them say continually, The Lord be magnified, who desire the peace of his servant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And my tongue shall meditate on your righteousness, [and] on your praise all the day.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{5} They; and were, ; lightened or, flowed unto him their \textsuperscript{17} The righteous There is no word for the righteous in the present Hebrew Text; but it is preserved in all the versions; and it was probably lost from its similitude to tzaakoo, "they cry:" - tzaakoo tazddeekim, "the righteous cry." cry \textsuperscript{18} is nigh, ; unto them etc. Heb. to the broken of heart, ; such as etc. Heb. the contrite of spirit \textsuperscript{21} Evil; they, ; desolate or, guilty\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 35 (MT 36)}
\markright{PSALM 35 (MT 36)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (36) For the end, by David the servant of the Lord. The transgressor, that he may sin, says within himself, [that] there is no fear of God before his eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} For he has dealt craftily before him, to discover his iniquity and hate it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} The words of his mouth are transgression and deceit: he is not inclined to understand [how] to do good. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} He devises iniquity on his bed; he gives himself to every evil way; and does not abhor evil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} O Lord, your mercy is in the heaven; and your truth [reaches] to the clouds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Your righteousness is as the mountains of God, your judgments are as a great deep: O Lord, you will preserve men and beasts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} How have you multiplied your mercy, O God! so the children of men shall trust in the shelter of your wings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} They shall be fully satisfied with the fatness of your house; and you shall cause them to drink of the full stream of your delights. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For with you is the fountain of life: in your light we shall see light. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Extend your mercy to them that know you; and your righteousness to the upright in heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of sinners move me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} There have all the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast out, and shall not be able to stand.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{6} their; dark and slippery Heb. darkness and slipperiness \textsuperscript{8} Let destruction All the verbs in these verses ( ), in the original, are in the future tense, as a prediction, and should probably be so rendered; though as that tense is frequently used in Hebrew for the imperative, most translators, both ancient and modern, have considered them as an imprecation.; at unawares Heb. which he knoweth not of net, ; into \textsuperscript{11} False witnesses Heb. Witnesses of wrong; , laid etc. Heb. asked me \textsuperscript{12} They; spoiling Heb. depriving; my soul Or, "my life, " as the word nephesh frequently denotes.\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 36 (MT 37)}
\markright{PSALM 36 (MT 37)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (37) [A Psalm] of David. Fret not yourself because of evil-doers, neither be envious of them that do iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} For they shall soon be withered as the grass, and shall soon fall away as the green herbs. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Hope in the Lord, and do good; and dwell on the land, and you shall be fed with the wealth of it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Delight [yourself] in the Lord; and he shall grant you the requests of your heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Disclose your way to the Lord, and hope in him; and he shall bring [it] to pass. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And he shall bring forth your righteousness as the light, and your judgment as the noon-day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Submit yourself to the Lord, and supplicate him: fret not yourself because of him that prospers in his way, at the man that does unlawful deeds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} ease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not yourself so as to do evil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For evil-doers shall be destroyed: but they that wait on the Lord, they shall inherit the land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And yet a little while, and the sinner shall not be, and you shall seek for his place, and shall not find [it]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight [themselves] in the abundance of peace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} The sinner will watch for the righteous, and gnash his teeth upon him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} But the Lord shall laugh at him: for he foresees that his day will come. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Sinners have drawn their swords, they have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy one, [and] to kill the upright in heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Let their sword enter into their [own] heart, and their bows be broken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} A little is better to the righteous than abundant wealth of sinners. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For the arms of sinners shall be broken; but the Lord supports the righteous. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} The Lord knows the ways of the perfect; and their inheritance shall be for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} They shall not be ashamed in an evil time; and in days of famine they shall be satisfied. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} For the sinners shall perish; and the enemies of the Lord at the moment of their being honored and exalted have utterly vanished like smoke. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} The sinner borrows, and will not pay again: but the righteous has compassion, and gives. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} For they that bless him shall inherit the earth; and they that curse him shall be utterly destroyed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} The steps of a man are rightly ordered by the Lord: and he will take pleasure in his way. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} When he falls, he shall not be ruined: for the Lord supports his hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} I was [once] young, indeed I am now old; yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed seeking bread. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} He is merciful, and lends continually; and his seed shall be blessed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Turn aside from evil, and do good; and dwell for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} For the Lord loves judgment, and will not forsake his saints; they shall be preserved for ever: the blameless shall be avenged, but the seed of the ungodly shall be utterly destroyed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} But the righteous shall inherit the earth, and dwell upon it for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} The mouth of the righteous will meditate wisdom, and his tongue will speak of judgment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} The law of his God is in his heart; and his steps shall not slide. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} The sinner watches the righteous, and seeks to kill him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} But the Lord will not leave him in his hands, nor by any means condemn him when he is judged. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, and he shall exalt you to inherit the land: when the wicked are destroyed, you shall see [it]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} I saw the ungodly very highly exalting himself, and lifting himself up like the cedars of Libanus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Yet I passed by, and behold! he was not: and I sought him, but his place was not found. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Maintain innocence, and behold uprightness: for there is a remnant to the peaceful man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} But the transgressors shall be utterly destroyed together: the remnants of the ungodly shall be utterly destroyed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} But the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord; and he is their defender in the time of affliction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And the Lord shall help them, and deliver them: and he shall rescue them from sinners, and save them, because they have hoped in him.\par

There is no fear of God before his eyes; " for instead of libbi, "my heart, " four manuscripts, have libbo, "his heart, " which is also the reading of the LXX, Vulgate, Syriac, Arabic, Ethiopic, and Anglo-Saxon.; no \textsuperscript{2} For he; until etc. Heb. to find his iniquity to hate \textsuperscript{4} deviseth; mischief or, vanity setteth; abhorreth \textsuperscript{6} righteousness, ; great mountains Heb. mountains of God; *marg. judgments; thou \textsuperscript{7} How, ; excellent Heb. precious; put their \textsuperscript{8} abundantly, ; satisfied Heb. watered, Yirweyun, "they shall be saturated, " as a thirsty field by showers from heaven. and thou; thy pleasures Or, adanacha, "thy pleasure, " as four manuscripts, read; in which there is probably a reference to the garden of Eden, and the river that ran through, and watered it. \textsuperscript{10} continue Heb. draw out at length; that; and thy\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 37 (MT 38)}
\markright{PSALM 37 (MT 38)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (38) A Psalm of David for remembrance concerning the Sabbath-day. O Lord, rebuke me not in your wrath, neither chasten me in your anger. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} For your weapons are fixed in me, and you have pressed your hand heavily upon me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For there is no health in my flesh because of your anger; there is no peace to my bones because of my sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For my transgressions have gone over my head: they have pressed heavily upon me like a weighty burden. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} My bruises have become noisome and corrupt, because of my foolishness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} I have been wretched and bowed down continually: I went with a mourning countenance all the day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For my soul is filled with mockings; and there is no health in my flesh. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I have been afflicted and brought down exceedingly: I have roared for the groaning of my heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} But all my desire is before you; and my groaning is not hidden from you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} My heart is troubled, my strength has failed me; and the light of my eyes is not with me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} My friends and my neighbors drew near before me, and stood still; and my nearest of kin stood afar off. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} While they pressed hard upon me that sought my soul: and they that sought my hurt spoke vanities, and devised deceits all the day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and was as a dumb man not opening his mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And I was as a man that hears not, and who has no reproofs in his mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For I hoped in you, O Lord: you will hear, O Lord my God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} For I said, Lest my enemies rejoice against me: for when my feet were moved, they spoke boastingly against me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For I am ready for plagues, and my grief is continually before me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} For I will declare my iniquity, and be distressed for my sin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} But my enemies live, and are mightier than I: and they that hate me unjustly are multiplied. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} They that reward evil for good slandered me; because I followed righteousness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Forsake me not, O Lord my God: depart not from me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Draw near to my help, O Lord of my salvation.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} (Title), This is the third alphabetical Psalm. It seems to have been intended as an instructive and consoling ode for the captives in Babylon, who might feel themselves severely tempted when they saw those idolaters in prosperity, and themselves in adversity. Fret;, neither \textsuperscript{3} Trust; so shalt; verily Heb. in truth, or stableness be fed \textsuperscript{5} Commit Heb. Roll thy way upon, ; *marg.; and \textsuperscript{7} Rest in Heb. Be silent to; *marg. wait; fret; the man \textsuperscript{9} evildoers;, inherit, ; the earth Or, "the land, " airetz, probably the land of Judea, given by God himself as an inheritance to their fathers, and their posterity forever, and this verse seems to contain a promise of their return thither. \textsuperscript{14} wicked;, slay; such as etc. Heb. the upright of way \textsuperscript{20} But the; as the fat of lambs Heb. preciousness, That is, as the fat was wholly consumed in sacrifices, by the fire on the altar, so the wicked shall consume away in the fire of God's anger. smoke\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 38 (MT 39)}
\markright{PSALM 38 (MT 39)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (39) For the end, a Song of David, to Idithun. I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I set a guard on my mouth, while the sinner stood in my presence. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} I was dumb, and humbled myself, and kept silence from good [words]; and my grief was renewed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} My heart grew hot within me, and a fire would kindle in my meditation: I spoke with my tongue, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} O Lord, make me to know my end, and the number of my days, what it is; that I may know what I lack. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Behold, you have made my days old; and my existence [is] as nothing before you: nay, every man living [is] altogether vanity. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Surely man walks in a shadow; nay, he is disquieted in vain: he lays up treasures, and knows not for whom he shall gather them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And now what [is] my expectation? [is it] not the Lord? and my ground [of hope] is with you. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Deliver me from all my transgressions: you have made me a reproach to the foolish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} I was dumb, and opened not my mouth; for you are he that made me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Remove your scourges from me: I have fainted by reason of the strength of your hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} You chasten man with rebukes for iniquity, and you make his life to consume away like a spider's web; nay, every man is disquieted in vain. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} O Lord, listen to my prayer and my supplication: attend to my tears: be not silent, for I am a sojourner in the land, and a stranger, as all my fathers [were]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Spare me, that I may be refreshed, before I depart, and be no more.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} (Title), This deeply penitential Psalm is supposed to have been composed by David under some grievous affliction, either bodily or mental, or both, after his illicit intercourse with Bathsheba. to bring *title rebuke, ; hot \textsuperscript{3} soundness; neither, rest Heb. peace, or, health because \textsuperscript{5} My wounds The soul being invisible, its distempers are also so; therefore the sacred writers describe them by the distempers of the body. (See the parallel texts on these verses.) On reading these and similar passages, say Bp. Lowth, some, who were but little acquainted with the genius of Hebrew poetry, have pretended to enquire into the nature of the disease with which the poet was afflicted; not less absurdly, in my opinion, than if they had perplexed themselves to discover in what river he was plunged, when he complains that "the deep waters had gone over his soul." \textsuperscript{6} troubled Heb. wearied bowed, *marg., mourning \textsuperscript{9} Lord Instead of adonay, "Lord, " several manuscripts read yehowah, "Jehovah." groaning \textsuperscript{10} heart, ; the light, ; gone from Heb. not with \textsuperscript{11} lovers; stand sore Heb. stroke kinsmen or, neighbours afar off\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 39 (MT 40)}
\markright{PSALM 39 (MT 40)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (40) For the end, a Psalm of David. I waited patiently for the Lord; and he attended to me, and listened to my supplication. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And he brought me up out of a pit of misery, and from miry clay: and he set my feet on a rock, and ordered my goings aright. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And he put a new song into my mouth, [even] a hymn to our God: many shall see [it], and fear, and shall hope in the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Blessed [is] the man whose hope is in the name of the Lord, and [who] has not regarded vanities and false frenzies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} O Lord my God, you have multiplied your wonderful works, and in your thoughts there is none who shall be likened to you: I declared and spoke [of them]: they exceeded number. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Sacrifice and offering you would not; but a body have you prepared me: whole burnt offering and [sacrifice] for sin you did not require. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Then I said, Behold, I come: in the volume of the book it is written concerning me, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I desired to do your will, O my God, and your law in the midst of my heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} I have preached righteousness in the great congregation; behold! I will not refrain my lips; O Lord, you know my righteousness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} I have not hid your truth within my heart, and I have declared your salvation; I have not hid your mercy and your truth from the great congregation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} But you, Lord, remove not your compassion far from me; your mercy and your truth have helped me continually. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For innumerable evils have encompassed me; my transgressions have taken hold of me, and I could not see; they are multiplied more than the hairs of my head; and my heart has failed me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me; O Lord, draw near to help me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Let those that seek my soul, to destroy it, be ashamed and confounded together; let those that wish me evil be turned backward and put to shame. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Let those that say to me, Aha, aha, quickly receive shame for their reward. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Let all those that seek you, O Lord, exult and rejoice in you; and let them that love your salvation say continually, The Lord be magnified. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} But I am poor and needy; the Lord will take care of me; you are my helper, and my defender, O my God, delay not.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} I said; that I, ; my mouth etc. Heb. a bridle, or muzzle, for my mouth, while \textsuperscript{2} I was; even my sorrow; stirred Heb. troubled \textsuperscript{4} make; how frail I am or, what time I have here \textsuperscript{5} Behold; as nothing; verily, ; at his best state Heb. settled \textsuperscript{6} a vain show Heb. an image, There is but the semblance of being. He appeareth for a little, and then vanisheth.; surely, ; he heapeth \textsuperscript{10} Remove; I am consumed blow Heb. conflict \textsuperscript{11} When; his beauty etc. Heb. that which is to be desired in him to melt away; surely \textsuperscript{12} hold; *marg.; for I am; as all\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 40 (MT 41)}
\markright{PSALM 40 (MT 41)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (41) For the end, a Psalm of David. Blessed [is the man] who thinks, on the poor and needy: the Lord shall deliver him in an evil day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} May the Lord preserve him and keep him alive, and bless him on the earth, and not deliver him into the hands of his enemy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} May the Lord help him upon the bed of his pain; you have made all his bed in his sickness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I said, O Lord, have mercy upon me; heal my soul; for I have sinned against you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Mine enemies have spoken evil against me, [saying], When shall he die, and his name perish? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And if he came to see [me], his heart spoke vainly; he gathered iniquity to himself; he went forth and spoke in like manner. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} All my enemies whispered against me; against me they devised my hurt. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} They denounced a wicked word against me, [saying], Now that he lies, shall he not rise up again? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For even the man of my peace, in whom I trusted, who ate my bread, lifted up [his] heel against me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} But you, O Lord, have compassion upon me, and raise me up, and I shall requite them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} By this I know that you have delighted in me, because my enemy shall not rejoice over me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} But you did help me because of [my] innocence, and have established me before you for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Blessed [be] the Lord God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. So be it, so be it.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} am 2970, bc 1034 (Title), This psalm is supposed to have been composed by David about the same time, and on the same occasion, as the two preceding; with this difference, that here he magnifies God for have obtained the mercy which he sought there. It also contains a remarkable prophecy of the incarnation and sacrifice of Jesus Christ. I waited Heb. In waiting I waited, ; inclined \textsuperscript{2} brought, ; horrible pit Heb. pit of noise, the miry; set; established \textsuperscript{5} Many;, thoughts, ; they cannot etc. or, none can order them unto thee \textsuperscript{6} Sacrifice; mine ears; opened Heb. digged \textsuperscript{8} I delight, ; yea; within my heart Heb. in the midst of my bowels \textsuperscript{10} not hid; righteousness, ; faithfulness; salvation; lovingkindness \textsuperscript{11} Withhold From this verse to the end, we have quite a new subject; for the former contains a thanksgiving, and this contains a supplication. It is nearly the same as the seventieth, and probably formed a distinct Psalm., let thy \textsuperscript{12} innumerable; mine; they are, heart; faileth Heb. forsaketh\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 41 (MT 42)}
\markright{PSALM 41 (MT 42)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (42) For the end, [a Psalm] for instruction, for the sons of Core. As the hart earnestly desires the fountains of water, so my soul earnestly longs for you, O God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} My soul has thirsted for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} My tears have been bread to me day and night, while they daily said to me, Where is your God? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I remembered these things, and poured out my soul in me, for I will go to the place of your wondrous tabernacle, [even] to the house of God, with a voice of exultation and thanksgiving and of the sound of those who keep festival. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Therefore are you very sad, O my soul? and therefore do you trouble me? hope in God; for I will give thanks to him; [he is] the salvation of my countenance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} O my God, my soul has been troubled within me: therefore will I remember you from the land of Jordan, and of the Ermonites, from the little hill. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Deep calls to deep at the voice of your cataracts: all your billows and your waves have gone over me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} By day the Lord will command his mercy, and manifest [it] by night: with me [is] prayer to the God of my life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} I will say to God, You are my helper; why have you forgotten me? therefore do I go sad of countenance, while the enemy oppresses [me]? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} While my bones were breaking, they that afflicted me reproached me; while they said to me daily, Where is your God? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Therefore are you very sad, O my soul? and therefore do you trouble me? hope in God; for I will give thanks to him; [he is] the health of my countenance, and my God.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} (Title), This Psalm is supposed to have been written on the same occasion as the three former; and to relate to David's affliction, and the evil treatment he received from his enemies during its continuance. Blessed; the poor or, the weak, or sick; Lord, ; time of trouble Heb. the day of evil \textsuperscript{2} preserve; blessed; thou wilt not or, do not thou \textsuperscript{7} whisper, *marg.; against; my hurt Heb. evil to me \textsuperscript{8} An evil disease Heb. A thing of Belial; and \textsuperscript{9} Yea; mine own familiar friend Heb. the man of my peace which; lifted up Heb. magnified\par}
