\subsection*{Psalm 84 (MT 85)}
\markright{PSALM 84 (MT 85)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (85) For the end, a Psalm for the sons of Core. O Lord, you have taken pleasure in your land: you have turned back the captivity of Jacob. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} You have forgiven your people their transgressions; you have covered all their sins. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} You have caused all your wrath to cease: you have turned from your fierce anger. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Turn us, O God of our salvation, and turn your anger away from us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Wouldest you be angry with us for ever? or will you continue your wrath from generation to generation? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} O God, you will turn and quicken us; and your people shall rejoice in you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Show us your mercy, O Lord, and grant us your salvation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I will hear what the Lord God will say concerning me: for he shall speak peace to his people, and to his saints, and to those that turn their heart toward him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Moreover his salvation is near them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Mercy and truth are met together: righteousness and peace have kissed [each other]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Truth has sprung out of the earth; and righteousness has looked down from heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For the Lord will give goodness; and our land shall yield her fruit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set his steps in the way.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} A Psalm Some suppose this Psalm was composed by David when driven from Jerusalem by Absalom's rebellion, but it is more probable that it was written at the foundation of the second temple. for or, of How, ; O Lord \textsuperscript{3} Yea etc. Or, rather, "Even as the sparrow findeth a house, and the swallow ( deror, or the ring-dove, according to some, but probably the bird which Forskal mentions among the migratory birds of Alexandria, by the name of dururi ) a nest for herself where she may lay her young (so I seek) thine altars, O Jehovah, God of hosts, my King and my God." That is, as nature inclines birds to seek and prepare their nests, so grace has taught me to desire thy altars, and to worship there. sparrow \textsuperscript{6} Who; Baca etc. or, mulberry-trees, make him a well, etc. Baca is probably a large shrub, which the Arabs still call baca, (see note on ); and this valley, as Celsius observes, seems to be one "embarrassed with (such) bushes and thorns, which could not be passed without labour and tears" - bacah, as 7; MSS, LXX, Aquila, and Vulgate read. the rain; filleth Heb. covereth \textsuperscript{7} They; strength to strength Heb. company to company, in Zion \textsuperscript{10} For, ; I had etc. Heb. I would choose rather to sit at the threshold, to dwell \textsuperscript{11} a sun; shield, ; the Lord; no; walk\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 85 (MT 86)}
\markright{PSALM 85 (MT 86)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (86) A Prayer of David. O Lord, incline your ear, and listen to me; for I am poor and needy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Preserve my soul, for I am holy; save your servant, O God, who hopes in you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Pity me, O Lord: for to you will I cry all the day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Rejoice the soul of your servant: for to you, O Lord, have I lifted up my soul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For you, O Lord, are kind, and gentle; and plenteous in mercy to all that call upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Give ear to my prayer, o Lord; and attend to the voice of my supplication. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} In the day of my trouble I cried to you: for you did hear me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} There is none like to you, O Lord, among the gods; and there are no [works] like to your works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} All nations whom you have made shall come, and shall worship before you, O Lord; and shall glorify your name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For you are great, and do wonders: you are the only [and] the great God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Guide me, O Lord, in your way, and I will walk in your truth: let my heart rejoice, that I may fear your name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} I will give you thanks, O Lord my God, with all my heart; and I will glorify your name for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} For your mercy is great toward me; and you have delivered my soul from the lowest hell. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} O God, transgressors have risen up against me, and an assembly of violent [men] have sought my life; and have not set you before them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} But you, O Lord God, are compassionate and merciful, longsuffering, and abundant in mercy and true. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Look you upon me, and have mercy upon me: give your strength to your servant, and save the son of your handmaid. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Establish with me a token for good; and let them that hate me see [it] and be ashamed; because you, O Lord, have helped me, and comforted me.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 86 (MT 87)}
\markright{PSALM 86 (MT 87)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (87) A Psalm of a Song for the sons of Core. His foundations are in the holy mountains. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The Lord loves the gates of Sion, more than all the tabernacles of Jacob. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Glorious things have been spoken of you, O city of God. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I will make mention of Raab and Babylon to them that know me: behold also the Philistines, and Tyre, and the people of the Ethiopians: these were born there. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} A man shall say, Sion [is my] mother; and [such] a man was born in her; and the Highest himself has founded her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} The Lord shall recount [it] in the writing of the people, and of these princes that were born in her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} The dwelling of all within you is [as the dwelling] of those that rejoice.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} Preserve, ; holy or, one whom thou favourest; save; trusteth \textsuperscript{3} Be merciful, for I; daily or, all the day \textsuperscript{5} thou, ; ready; plenteous, ; unto all\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{X: }}\textsuperscript{1} Ps 31:2; Isa 37:17; Dan 9:18; Ps 10:14; Ps 34:6; Ps 40:17; Ps 72:12-14; Ps 102:17; Ps 119:22; Ps 140:12; Isa 66:2; Matt 5:3; Luke 4:18; Jas 1:9-10; Jas 2:5 \textsuperscript{2} Ps 4:3; Ps 37:28; Ps 119:94; 1Sam 2:9; John 10:27-29; John 17:11; 1Pet 5:3-5; Ps 18:19; Deut 7:7-8; Rom 9:18; Rom 9:23-24; Ps 119:124-125; Ps 143:12; John 12:26; Ps 13:5; Ps 16:1; Ps 31:1; Isa 26:3-4; Rom 15:12-13; Eph 1:12-13 \textsuperscript{3} Ps 56:1; Ps 57:1; Ps 55:17; Ps 88:9; Luke 2:37; Luke 11:8-13; Luke 18:7; Eph 6:18; Ps 25:5 \textsuperscript{4} Ps 51:12; Isa 61:3; Isa 65:18; Isa 66:13-14; Ps 25:1; Ps 62:8; Ps 143:8 \textsuperscript{5} Ps 86:15; Ps 25:8; Ps 36:7; Ps 52:1; Ps 69:16; Ps 119:68; Ps 130:7; Ps 145:8-9; Exod 34:6; Joel 2:13; 1John 4:8-9; Neh 9:17; Isa 55:7; Dan 9:9; Mic 7:18; Ps 103:8; Ps 130:4; Rom 5:20-21; Eph 1:6-8; Eph 2:4; Ps 145:18; Jer 33:3; Ezek 36:33; Ezek 36:37; Luke 11:9-10; John 4:10; Acts 2:21; Rom 10:12-13 \textsuperscript{6} Ps 5:1-2; Ps 17:1; Ps 130:2 \textsuperscript{7} Ps 18:6; Ps 34:4-6; Ps 50:15; Ps 55:16-18; Ps 77:1-2; Ps 91:15; Ps 142:1; Ps 142:3; Isa 26:16; Lam 3:55-57; Jonah 2:2; Luke 22:44; Heb 5:7\par}
\subsection*{Psalm 87 (MT 88)}
\markright{PSALM 87 (MT 88)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (88) A song of a Psalm for the sons of Core for the end, upon Maeleth for responsive [strains], of instruction for Aeman the Israelite. O Lord God of my salvation, I have cried by day and in the night before you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Let my prayer come in before you; incline your ear to my supplication, O Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For my soul is filled with troubles, and my life has drawn near to Hades. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I have been reckoned with them that go down to the pit; I became as a man without help; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} free among the dead, as the slain ones cast out, who sleep in the tomb; whom you remember no more; and they are rejected from your hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} They laid me in the lowest pit, in dark [places], and in the shadow of death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Your wrath has pressed heavily upon me, and you have brought upon me all your billows. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} You have removed my acquaintance far from me; they have made me an abomination to themselves; I have been delivered up, and have not gone forth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} My eyes are dimmed from poverty; but I cried to you, O Lord, all the day; I spread forth my hands to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Will you work wonders for the dead? or shall physicians raise [them] up, that they shall praise you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Shall any one declare your mercy in the tomb? and your truth in destruction? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Shall your wonders be known in darkness? and your righteousness in a forgotten land? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} But I cried to you, O Lord; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Therefore, O Lord, do you reject my prayer, [and] turn your face away from me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} I am poor and in troubles from my youth; and having been exalted, I was brought low and into despair. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Your wrath has passed over me; and your terrors have greatly disquieted me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} They compassed me like water; all the day they beset me together. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} You have put far from me [every] friend, and my acquaintances because of [my] wretchedness.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} for or, of His; the holy \textsuperscript{4} Rahab; Babylon; 50:1-51:64; Tyre; Ezek. 27:1-28:26 Ethiopia; this man\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 88 (MT 89)}
\markright{PSALM 88 (MT 89)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (89) [A Psalm] of instruction for Aetham the Israelite. I will sing of your mercies, O Lord, for ever: I will declare your truth with my mouth to all generations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} For you have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: your truth shall be established in the heavens. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} I made a covenant with my chosen ones, I swore to David my servant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I will establish your seed for ever, and build up your throne to all generations. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} The heavens shall declare your wonders, O Lord; and your truth in the assembly of the saints. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} For who in the heavens shall be compared to the Lord? and who shall be likened to the Lord among the sons of God? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} God is glorified in the council of the saints; great and terrible toward all that are round about him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} O Lord God of hosts, who is like to you? you are mighty, O Lord, and your truth is round about you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} You rule the power of the sea; and you calm the tumult of its waves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} You have brought down the proud as one that is slain; and with the arm of your power you have scattered your enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} The heavens are your, and the earth is your: you have founded the world, and the fullness of it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} You have created the north and the west: Thabor and Hermon shall rejoice in your name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Your is the mighty arm: let your hand be strengthened, let your right hand be exalted. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Justice and judgment are the establishment of your throne: mercy and truth shall go before your face. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Blessed is the people that knows the joyful sound: they shall walk, O Lord, in the light of your countenance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And in your name shall they rejoice all the day: and in your righteousness shall they be exalted. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For you are the boast of their strength; and in your good pleasure shall our horn be exalted, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} for [our] help is of the Lord; and of the Holy One of Israel, our king. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Then you spoke in vision to your children, and said, I have laid help on a mighty one; I have exalted one chosen out of my people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} I have found David my servant; I have anointed him by [my] holy mercy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For my hand shall support him; and my arm shall strengthen him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} The enemy shall have no advantage against him; and the son of transgression shall not hurt him again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And I will hew down his foes before him, and put to flight those that hate him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} But my truth and my mercy shall be with him; and in my name shall his horn be exalted. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And I will set his hand in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} He shall call upon me, [saying], You are my Father, my God, and the helper of my salvation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And I will make him [my] firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} I will keep my mercy for him for ever, and my covenant [shall be] firm with him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And I will establish his seed for ever and ever, and his throne as the days of heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} If his children should forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} if they should profane my ordinances, and not keep my commandments; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} I will visit their transgressions with a rod, and their sins with scourges. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} But my mercy I will not utterly remove from him, nor wrong my truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Neither will I by any means profane my covenant; and I will not make void the things that proceed out of my lips. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Once have I sworn by my holiness, that I will not lie to David. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} and as the moon [that is] established for ever, and as the faithful witness in heaven. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} But you have cast off and set at nothing, you have rejected your anointed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} You have overthrown the covenant of your servant; you have profaned his sanctuary, [casting it] to the ground. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} You have broken down all his hedges; you have made his strong holds a terror. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} All that go by the way have spoiled him: he is become a reproach to his neighbors. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} You have exalted the right hand of his enemies; you have made all his enemies to rejoice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} You have turned back the help of his sword, and have not helped him in the battle. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} You have deprived him of glory: you have broken down his throne to the ground. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} You have shortened the days of his throne: you have poured shame upon him. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} How long, O Lord, will you turn away, for ever? shall your anger flame out as fire? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} Remember what my being is: for have you created all the sons of men in vain? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} What man is there who shall live, and not see death? shall [any one] deliver his soul from the hand of Hades? Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} Where are your ancient mercies, O Lord, which you swore to David in your truth? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} Remember, O Lord, the reproach of your servants, which I have borne in my bosom, [even the reproach] of many nations; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} wherewith your enemies have reviled, O Lord: wherewith they have reviled the recompense of your anointed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} Blessed be the Lord for ever. So be it, so be it.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} Maschil etc. or, A Psalm of Heman the Ezrahite, giving instruction, Supposed to have been written by Heman, son of Zerah, and grandson of Judah, on the oppression of the Hebrews in Egypt. \subsection*{Psalm 89 (MT 90)}
\markright{PSALM 89 (MT 90)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (90) A Prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, you have been our refuge in all generations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Before the mountains existed, and [before] the earth and the world were formed, even from age to age, You are. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Turn not man back to [his] low place, whereas you said, Return, you⌃ sons of men? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For a thousand years in your sight are as the yesterday which is past, and as a watch in the night. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Years shall be vanity to them: let the morning pass away as grass. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} In the morning let it flower, and pass away: in the evening let it droop, let it be withered and dried up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For we have perished in your anger, and in your wrath we have been troubled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} You have set our transgressions before you: our age is in the light of your countenance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For all our days are gone, and we have passed away in your wrath: our years have spun out their tale as a spider. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} [As for] the days of our years, in them are seventy years; and if [men should be] in strength, eighty years: and the greater part of them would be labor and trouble; for weakness overtakes us, and we shall be chastened. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Who knows the power of your wrath? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} and [who knows how] to number [his days] because of the fear of your wrath? So manifest your right hand, and those that are instructed in wisdom in the heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Return, O Lord, how long? and be entreated concerning your servants. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} We have been satisfied in the morning with your mercy; and we did exult and rejoice: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} let us rejoice in all our days, in return for the days wherein you did afflict us, the years wherein we saw evil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And look upon your servants, and upon your works; and guide their children. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us: and do you direct for us the works of our hands.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} Ethan; I will, with, thy faithfulness, ; all generations Heb. generation and generation, *marg. \textsuperscript{6} For who, ; the sons *marg. \textsuperscript{8} O Lord; a strong, ; like \textsuperscript{10} Thou hast; Exod. 7:1-15:27 Rahab or, Egypt scattered, ; thy strong arm Heb. the arm of thy strength \textsuperscript{13} a mighty arm Heb. an arm with might \textsuperscript{14} Justice, ; habitation or, establishment, mercy\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 90 (MT 91)}
\markright{PSALM 90 (MT 91)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (91) Praise of a Song, by David. He that dwells in the help of the Highest, shall sojourn under the shelter of the God of heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} He shall say to the Lord, You are my helper and my refuge: my God; I will hope in him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For he shall deliver you from the snare of the hunters, from [every] troublesome matter. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} He shall overshadow you with his shoulders, and you shall trust under his wings: his truth shall cover you with a shield. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} You shall not be afraid of terror by night; nor of the arrow flying by day; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} [nor] of the [evil] thing that walks in darkness; [nor] of calamity, and the evil spirit at noon-day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} A thousand shall fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it shall not come near you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Only with your eyes shall you observe and see the reward of sinners. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For you, O Lord, are my hope: you, my soul, have made the Most High your refuge. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} No evils shall come upon you, and no scourge shall draw near to your dwelling. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For he shall give his angels charge concerning you, to keep you in all your ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} They shall bear you up on their hands, lest at any time you dash your foot against a stone. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} You shall tread on the asp and basilisk: and you shall trample on the lion and dragon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For he has hoped in me, and I will deliver him: I will protect him, because he has known my name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} He shall call upon me, and I will listen to him: I am with him in affliction; and I will deliver him, and glorify him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} I will satisfy him with length of days, and show him my salvation.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} the man; Lord, ; all generations Heb. generation and generation, *marg. \textsuperscript{2} Before; or ever; even from, ; thou \textsuperscript{3} Thou; Return ye children of men Rather, "Return ye children of Adam; " i.e., to that dust out of which ye were originally formed. \textsuperscript{4} For is past or, when he hath passed them and as \textsuperscript{5} Thou, ; as a sleep; morning; groweth up or, is changed \textsuperscript{9} For passed Heb. turned we spend The Vulgate has, Anni nostri sicut aranea mediatabuntur, "Our years pass away like those of the spider." Our plans and operations are like the spider's web. Life is as frail, and the thread of it as brittle, as one of those which constitute the well-wrought and curious, but fragile habitation of that insect. All the versions have the word spider, but it is not found in any Hebrew manuscripts, or edition yet collated. The Hebrew might be rendered, "We consume our lives with a groan, " kemo hegeh . a tale Heb. a meditation \textsuperscript{10} The days etc. Heb. As for the days of our years, in them are seventy years; yet; for; *marg. \textsuperscript{12} So; that;, ;, apply our hearts Heb. cause our hearts to come\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 91 (MT 92)}
\markright{PSALM 91 (MT 92)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (92) A Psalm of a Song for the Sabbath-day. It is a good thing to give thanks to the Lord, and to sing praises to your name, O you Most High; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} to proclaim your mercy in the morning, and your truth by night, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} on a lute of ten strings, with a song on the harp. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For you, O Lord, have made me glad with your work: and in the operations of your hands will I exult. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} How have your works been magnified, O Lord! your thoughts are very deep. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} A foolish man will not know, and a senseless man will not understand this. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} When the sinners spring up as the grass, and all the workers of iniquity have watched; [it is] that they may be utterly destroyed for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} But you, O Lord, are most high for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For, behold, your enemies shall perish; and all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} But my horn shall be exalted [as the horn] of a unicorn; and my old age with rich mercy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And my eye has seen my enemies, and my ear shall hear the wicked that rise up against me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} The righteous shall flourish as a palm tree: he shall be increased as the cedar in Libanus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} They that are planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of our God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Then shall they be increased in a fine old age; and they shall be prosperous; that they may declare {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} that the Lord my God is righteous, and there is no iniquity in him.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} (Title), This Psalm is supposed by some to have been composed by Moses on the same occasion as the preceding; but others think it was written by David, after his advice to his son Solomon. dwelleth, ; abide Heb. lodge, *marg. under \textsuperscript{2} I will, ; my God, ; in him \textsuperscript{13} tread; adder or, asp; the dragon \textsuperscript{14} set; I will set *marg.; known \textsuperscript{15} He shall, ; I will be; deliver; honour\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 92 (MT 93)}
\markright{PSALM 92 (MT 93)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (93) For the day before the Sabbath, when the land was [first] inhabited, the praise of a Song by David. The Lord reigns; he has clothed himself with honor: the Lord has clothed and girded himself with strength; for he has established the world, which shall not be moved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Your throne is prepared of old: you are from everlasting. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} The rivers have lifted up, O Lord, the rivers have lifted up their voices, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} at the voices of many waters: the billows of the sea are wonderful: the Lord is wonderful in high places. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Your testimonies are made very sure: holiness becomes your house, O Lord, for ever.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} show, ; every night Heb. in the nights \textsuperscript{3} instrument, ; the harp etc. or, the solemn sound with the harp a solemn sound Heb. Higgaion\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 93 (MT 94)}
\markright{PSALM 93 (MT 94)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (94) A Psalm of David for the fourth [day] of the week. The Lord is a God of vengeance; the God of vengeance has declared himself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Be you exalted, you that judge the earth: render a reward to the proud. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} How long shall sinners, O Lord, how long shall sinners boast? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} They will utter and speak unrighteousness; all the workers of iniquity will speak [so]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} They have afflicted your people, O Lord, and hurt your heritage. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} They have slain the widow and fatherless, and murdered the stranger. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And they said, The Lord shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob understand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Understand now, you⌃ simple among the people; and you⌃ fools, at length be wise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} He that planted the ear, does he not hear? or he that formed the eye, does not he perceive? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} He that chastises the heathen, shall not he punish, [even] he that teaches man knowledge? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} The Lord knows the thoughts of men, that they are vain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Blessed is the man whoever you shall chasten, O Lord, and shall teach him out of your law; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} to give him rest from evil days, until a pit be digged for the sinful one. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For the Lord will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} until righteousness return to judgment, and all the upright in heart shall follow it. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Who will rise up for me against the transgressors? or who will stand up with me against the workers of iniquity? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} If the Lord had not helped me, my soul had almost sojourned in Hades. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} If I said, My foot has been moved; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} your mercy, O Lord, helped me. O Lord, according to the multitude of my griefs within my heart, your consolation have soothed my soul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with you, which frames mischief by an ordinance? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} They will hunt for the soul of the righteous, and condemn innocent blood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} But the Lord was my refuge; and my God the helper of my hope. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And he will recompense to them their iniquity and their wickedness: the Lord our God shall utterly destroy them.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} (Title), It is highly probable that this Psalm was written on the same occasion as the preceding, as a part of which it is written in twelve manuscripts. Lord, ; he is; he hath; world \textsuperscript{2} Thy; of old Heb. from then thou \textsuperscript{3} The floods, ; lifted; the floods lift \textsuperscript{5} Thy, ; holiness, ; for ever Heb. to length of days\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 94 (MT 95)}
\markright{PSALM 94 (MT 95)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (95) The praise of a Song by David. Come, let us exult in the Lord; let us make a joyful noise to God our Saviour. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise to him with psalms. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For the Lord is a great God, and a great king over all gods: for the Lord will not cast off his people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For the ends of the earth are in his hands; and the heights of the mountains are his. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For the sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Come, let us worship and fall down before him; and weep before the Lord that made us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} To-day, if you⌃ will hear his voice, harden not your hearts, as in the provocation, according to the day of irritation in the wilderness: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} where your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Forty years was I grieved with this generation, and said, They do always err in their heart, and they have not known my ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} So I swore in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} am 3416, bc 588 (Title), Dr. Delaney supposes that this Psalm was written by David on occasion of his war with the Ammonites, in consequence of the indignities shewn to his messengers; but it is more probable that it was written to bewail the destruction of Jerusalem and the temple. God, to whom vengeance belongeth Heb. God of revenges, O God.; show thyself Heb. shine forth \textsuperscript{10} chastiseth, ; he correct; teacheth man\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 95 (MT 96)}
\markright{PSALM 95 (MT 96)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (96) When the house was built after the Captivity, a Song of David. Sing to the Lord a new song; sing to the Lord, all the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Sing to the Lord, bless his name: proclaim his salvation from day to day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Publish his glory among the Gentiles, his wonderful works among all people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised: he is terrible above all gods. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For all the gods of the heathen are devils: but the Lord made the heavens. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Thanksgiving and beauty are before him: holiness and majesty are in his sanctuary. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Bring to the Lord, you⌃ families of the Gentiles, bring to the Lord glory and honor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Bring to the Lord the glory [becoming] his name: take offerings, and go into his courts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Worship the Lord in his holy court: let all the earth tremble before him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Say among the heathen, The Lord reigns: for he has established the world so that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people in righteousness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Let the heavens rejoice, and the earth exult; let the sea be moved, and the fullness of it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} The plains shall rejoice, and all things in them: then shall all the trees of the wood exult before the presence of the Lord: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth; he shall judge the world in righteousness, and the people with his truth.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 96 (MT 97)}
\markright{PSALM 96 (MT 97)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (97) For David, when his land is established. The Lord reigns, let the earth exult, let many islands rejoice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Cloud, and darkness are round about him; righteousness and judgment are the establishment of his throne. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Fire shall go before him, and burn up his enemies round about. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} His lightnings appeared to the world; the earth saw, and trembled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} The mountains melted like wax at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} The heavens have declared his righteousness, and all the people have seen his glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Let all that worship graven images be ashamed, who boast of their idols; worship him, all you⌃ his angels. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Sion heard and rejoiced; and the daughters of Judea exulted, because of your judgments, O Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For you are Lord most high over all the earth; you are greatly exalted above all gods. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} You⌃ that love the Lord, hate evil; the Lord preserves the souls of his saints; he shall deliver them from the hand of sinners. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Light is sprung up for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Rejoice in the Lord, you⌃ righteous; and give thanks for a remembrance of his holiness.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 97 (MT 98)}
\markright{PSALM 97 (MT 98)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (98) A Psalm of David. Sing to the Lord a new song; for the Lord has wrought wonderful works, his right hand, and his holy arm, have wrought salvation for him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The Lord has made known his salvation, he has revealed his righteousness in the sight of the nations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} He has remembered his mercy to Jacob, and his truth to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Shout to God, all the earth; sing, and exult, and sing psalms. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Sing to the Lord with a harp, with a harp, and the voice of a psalm. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} With trumpets of metal, and the sound of a trumpet of horn make a joyful noise to the Lord before the king. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Let the sea be moved, and the fullness of it; the world, and they that dwell in it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} The rivers shall clap their hands together; the mountains shall exult. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For he is come to judge the earth; he shall judge the world in righteousness, and the nations in uprightness.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} am 3000, bc 1004 Lord, ; the earth; let the multitude of isles Heb. let the many, or great isles \textsuperscript{2} Clouds; righteousness, ; habitation or, establishment\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 98 (MT 99)}
\markright{PSALM 98 (MT 99)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (99) A Psalm of David. The Lord reigns; —let the people rage; [it is he] that sits upon the cherubs, let the earth be moved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The Lord is great in Sion, and is high over all the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Let them give thanks to your great name; for it is terrible and holy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And the king's honor loves judgment; you have prepared equity, you have wrought judgment and justice in Jacob. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Exalt you⌃ the Lord our God, and worship [at] his footstool; for he is holy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the Lord, and he heard them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} He spoke to them in a pillar of cloud; they kept his testimonies, and the ordinances which he gave them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} O Lord our God, you heard them; O God, you became propitious to them, though you did take vengeance on all their devices. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Exalt you⌃ the Lord our God, and worship at his holy mountain; for the Lord our God is holy.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} Sing, ; for he, ; his right \textsuperscript{2} made, ; righteousness; openly showed or, revealed \textsuperscript{9} for he cometh; with righteousness\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 99 (MT 100)}
\markright{PSALM 99 (MT 100)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (100) A Psalm for Thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Serve the Lord with gladness; come before his presence with exultation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Know that the Lord he is God; he made us, and not we ourselves; [we are] his people, and the sheep of his pasture. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and his courts with hymns; give thanks to him, praise his name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For the Lord is good, his mercy is for ever; and his truth [endures] to generation and generation.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} Lord, ; people, ; he sitteth; earth *marg., ; be moved Heb. stagger \textsuperscript{5} Exalt, ; footstool; he is holy or, it is holy\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{X: }}\textsuperscript{1} Ps 2:6; Ps 93:1; Ps 96:10; Ps 97:1; Luke 19:12; Luke 19:14; Rev 11:17; Ps 2:11-12; Ps 21:8-9; Ps 97:4; Luke 19:27; Phil 2:12; Ps 18:10; Ps 80:1; Exod 25:22; Ezek 10:1-22; Ps 82:5; Jer 4:24; Jer 5:22; Jer 49:21; Jer 50:46; Rev 6:14; Rev 20:11; Isa 19:14; Isa 24:19-20 \textsuperscript{2} Ps 48:1-3; Ps 50:2; Ps 76:1-2; Isa 12:6; Isa 14:32; Heb 12:22-24; Rev 14:1-5; Ps 66:7; Ps 97:9; Dan 4:34-35; Jas 4:6-7 \textsuperscript{3} Ps 66:3; Ps 76:12; Deut 7:21; Deut 28:58; Neh 1:5; Neh 4:14; Neh 9:32; Jer 20:11; Ps 111:9; Ps 145:17; Josh 24:19; 1Sam 2:2; Isa 6:3; John 17:11; Rev 4:8; Rev 15:3-4 \textsuperscript{4} Ps 45:6-7; Ps 72:1-2; Deut 32:3-4; 2Sam 23:3-4; Job 36:5-7; Job 37:23; Isa 11:3-5; Jer 23:5; Rev 19:11; Rev 19:16; Isa 9:7; Isa 42:4; Isa 61:11; Deut 10:18; Jude 1:15 \textsuperscript{5} Ps 99:9; Ps 21:13; Ps 34:3; Ps 108:5; Exod 15:2; Isa 12:4; Isa 25:1; Hos 11:7; Ps 132:7; 1Chr 28:2; Isa 66:1; Ps 99:3; Lev 19:2\par}
\subsection*{Psalm 100 (MT 101)}
\markright{PSALM 100 (MT 101)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (101) A Psalm of David. I will sing to you, O Lord, of mercy and judgment; I will sing a psalm, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} and I will be wise in a blameless way. When will you come to me? I walked in the innocence of my heart, in the midst of my house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} I have not set before my eyes any unlawful thing; I have hated transgressors. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} A perverse heart has not cleaved to me; I have not known an evil man, forasmuch as he turns away from me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Him that privily speaks against his neighbor, him have I driven from [me]: he that is proud in look and insatiable in heart, —with him I have not eaten. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} My eyes [shall be] upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walked in a perfect way, the same ministered to me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} The proud doer lived not in the midst of my house; the unjust speaker prospered not in my sight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Early did I kill all the sinners of the land, that I might destroy out of the city of the Lord all that work iniquity.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} praise or, thanksgiving Make, ; all ye lands Heb. all the earth \textsuperscript{3} Know, ; it is he, ; not we ourselves or, his we are; we are his \textsuperscript{5} For the, ; his mercy, ; and his truth, ; all generations Heb. generation and generation, *marg.\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 101 (MT 102)}
\markright{PSALM 101 (MT 102)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (102) A Prayer for the Poor; when he is deeply afflicted, and pours out his supplication before the Lord. Hear my prayer, O Lord, and let my cry come to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Turn not away your face from me: in the day [when] I am afflicted, incline your ear to me: in the day [when] I shall call upon you, speedily hear me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For my days have vanished like smoke, and my bones have been parched like a stick. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I am blighted like grass, and my heart is dried up; for I have forgotten to eat my bread. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bone has cleaved to my flesh. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} I have become like a pelican of the wilderness; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} I have become like an owl in a ruined house. I have watched, and am become as a sparrow dwelling alone on a roof. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} All the day long my enemies have reproached me; and they that praised me have sworn against me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For I have eaten ashes as it were bread, and mingled my drink with weeping; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} because of your anger and your wrath: for you have lifted me up, and dashed me down. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} My days have declined like a shadow; and I am withered like grass. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} But you, Lord, endure for ever, and your memorial to generation and generation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} You shall arise, and have mercy upon Sion: for [it is] time to have mercy upon her, for the set time is come. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For your servants have taken pleasure in her stones, and they shall pity her dust. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} So the nations shall fear your name, O Lord, and all kings your glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} For the Lord shall build up Sion, and shall appear in his glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} He has had regard to the prayer of the lowly, and has not despised their petition. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Let this be written for another generation; and the people that shall be created shall praise the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} For he has looked out from the height of his sanctuary; the Lord looked upon the earth from heaven; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} to hear the groaning of the fettered ones, to loosen the sons of the slain; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} to proclaim the name of the Lord in Sion, and his praise in Jerusalem; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} when the people are gathered together, and the kings, to serve the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} He answered him in the way of his strength: tell me the fewness of my days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Take me not away in the midst of my days: your years [are] through all generations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} In the beginning you, O Lord, did lay the foundation of the earth; and the heavens are the works of your hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} They shall perish, but you remain: and [they all] shall wax old as a garment; and as a vesture shall you fold them, and they shall be changed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} But you are the same, and your years shall not fail. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} The children of your servants shall dwell [securely], and their seed shall prosper for ever.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} I will sing, ; unto thee \textsuperscript{2} behave, ; O when, walk; a perfect \textsuperscript{3} set, ; wicked thing Heb. thing of Belial, I hate; them, ; it shall not \textsuperscript{6} Mine, ; that they, ; in a perfect way or, perfect in the way, *marg. \textsuperscript{7} He that worketh; , tarry in my sight Heb. be established\par}

\subsection*{Psalm 102 (MT 103)}
\markright{PSALM 102 (MT 103)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (103) [A Psalm] of David. Bless the Lord, O my soul; and all [that is] within me, [bless] his holy name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his praises: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} who forgives all your transgressions, who heals all your diseases; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} who redeems your life from corruption; who crowns you with mercy and compassion; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} who satisfies your desire with good things: [so that] your youth shall be renewed like [that] of the eagle. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} The Lord executes mercy and judgment for all that are injured. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} He made known his ways to Moses, his will to the children of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} The Lord is compassionate and pitiful, longsuffering, and full of mercy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} He will not be always angry; neither will he be wrathful for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor recompensed us according to our iniquities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For as the heaven is high above the earth, the Lord has [so] increased his mercy toward them that fear him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} As far as the east is from the west, [so far] has he removed our transgressions from us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} As a father pities [his] children, the Lord pities them that fear him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For he knows our frame: remember that we are dust. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} [As for] man, his days are as grass; as a flower of the field, so shall he flourish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} For the wind passes over it, and it shall not be; and it shall know its place no more. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} But the mercy of the Lord is from generation to generation upon them that fear him, and his righteousness to children's children; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} to them that keep his covenant, and remember his commandments to do them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} The Lord has prepared his throne in the heaven; and his kingdom rules over all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Bless the Lord, all you⌃ his angels, mighty in strength, who perform his bidding, [ready] to listen to the voice of his words. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Bless the Lord, all you⌃ his hosts; [you⌃] ministers of his that do his will. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Bless the Lord, all his works, in every place of his dominion: bless the Lord, O my soul.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 103 (MT 104)}
\markright{PSALM 103 (MT 104)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (104) [A Psalm] of David. Bless the Lord, O my soul. O Lord my God, you are very great; you have clothed yourself with praise and honor: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} who do robe yourself with light as with a garment; spreading out the heaven as a curtain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Who covers his chambers with waters; who makes the clouds his chariot; who walks on the wings of the wind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Who makes his angels spirits, and his ministers a flaming fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Who establishes the earth on her sure foundation: it shall not be moved for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} The deep, as it were a garment, is his covering: the waters shall stand on the hills. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} At your rebuke they shall flee; at the voice of your thunder they shall be alarmed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} They go up to the mountains, and down to the plains, to the place which you have founded for them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} You have set a bound which they shall not pass, neither shall they turn again to cover the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} He sends forth his fountains among the valleys: the waters shall run between the mountains. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} They shall give drink to all the wild beasts of the field: the wild asses shall take [of them] to [quench] their thirst. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} By them shall the birds of the sky lodge: they shall utter a voice out of the midst of the rocks. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} He waters the mountains from his chambers: the earth shall be satisfied with the fruit of your works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} He makes grass to grow for the cattle, and green herb for the service of men, to bring bread out of the earth; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} and wine makes glad the heart of man, to make his face cheerful with oil: and bread strengthens man's heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} The trees of the plain shall be full [of sap]; [even] the cedars of Libanus which he has planted. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} There the sparrows will build their nests; and the house of the heron takes the lead among them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} The high mountains are a refuge for the stags, [and] the rock for the rabbits. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knows his going down. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} You did make darkness, and it was night; in it all the wild beasts of the forest will be abroad: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} [even] young lions roaring for prey, and to seek meat for themselves from God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} The sun arises, and they shall be gathered together, and shall lie down in their dens. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Man shall go forth to his work, and to his labor till evening. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} How great are your works, O Lord! in wisdom have you wrought them all: the earth is filled with your creation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} [So is] this great and wide sea: there are things creeping innumerable, small animals and great. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} There go the ships; [and] this dragon whom you have made to play in it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} All wait upon you, to give them [their] food in due season. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} When you have given [it] them, they will gather [it]; and when you have opened your hand, they shall all be filled with good. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} But when you have turned away your face, they shall be troubled: you will take away their breath, and they shall fail, and return to their dust. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} You shall send forth your Spirit, and they shall be created; and you shall renew the face of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Let the glory of the Lord be for ever: the Lord shall rejoice in his works; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} who looks upon the earth, and makes it tremble; who touches the mountains, and they smoke. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} I will sing to the Lord while I live; I will sing praise to my God while I exist. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Let my meditation be sweet to him: and I will rejoice in the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Let the sinners fail from off the earth, and transgressors, so that they shall be no more. Bless the Lord, O my soul.\par

\subsection*{Psalm 104 (MT 105)}
\markright{PSALM 104 (MT 105)}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} (105) Alleluia. Give thanks to the Lord, and call upon his name; declare his works among the heathen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Sing to him, yes, sing praises to him: tell forth all his wonderful works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Glory in his holy name: let the heart of them that seek the Lord rejoice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Seek you⌃ the Lord, and be strengthened; seek his face continually. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Remember his wonderful works that he has done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} [you⌃] seed of Abraam, his servants, [you⌃] children of Jacob, his chosen ones. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} He has remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded for a thousand generation: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} which he established as a covenant to Abraam, and [he remembered] his oath to Isaac. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And he established it to Jacob for an ordinance, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} saying To you will I give the land of Chanaan, the line of your inheritance: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} when they were few in number, very few, and sojourners in it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And they went from nation to nation, and from [one] kingdom to another people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} He suffered no man to wrong them; and he rebuked kings for their sakes: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} [saying], Touch not my anointed ones; and do my prophets no harm. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Moreover he called for a famine upon the land; he broke the whole support of bread. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} He sent a man before them; Joseph was sold for a slave. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} They hurt his feet with fetters; his soul passed into iron, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} until the time that his cause came on; the word of the Lord tried him as fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} The king sent and loosed him; [even] the prince of the people, and let him go free. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} He made him Lord over his house, and ruler of all his substance; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} to chastise his rulers at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Israel also came into Egypt, and Jacob sojourned in the land of Cham. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And he increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And he turned their heart to hate his people, to deal craftily with his servants. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} He sent forth Moses his servant, [and] Aaron whom he had chosen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} He established among them his signs, and [his] wonders in the land of Cham. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} He sent forth darkness, and made it dark; yet they rebelled against his words. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Their land produced frogs abundantly, in the chambers of their kings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} He spoke, and the dog-fly came, and lice in all their coasts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} He turned their rain into hail, [and sent] flaming fire in their land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And he struck their vines and their fig trees; and broke every tree of their coast. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} He spoke, and the locust came, and caterpillars innumerable, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} and devoured all the grass in their land, and devoured the fruit of the ground. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} He struck also every firstborn of their land, the first fruits of all their labor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And he brought them out with silver and gold; and there was not a feeble one among their tribes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Egypt rejoiced at their departing; for the fear of them fell upon them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} He spread out a cloud for a covering to them, and fire to give them light by night. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} They asked, and the quail came, and he satisfied them with the bread of heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} He clave the rock, and the waters flowed, rivers ran in dry places. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} For he remembered his holy word, which [he promised] to Abraam his servant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And he brought out his people with exultation, and his chosen with joy; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} and gave them the lands of the heathen; and they inherited the labors of the people; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} that they might keep his ordinances, and diligently seek his law.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} Bless This sublime poem on the works of God in creation and providence, is ascribed to David in the LXX, Vulgate, Ethiopic, Syriac, and Arabic; and as it opens and closes with the same words as the preceding psalm, it is probable that it was composed on the same occasion; and it is written as part of it in nine manuscripts, O Lord; art very great; clothed; honour \textsuperscript{5} Who laid the foundations of the earth Heb. He hath founded the earth upon her bases, ; that it \textsuperscript{8} They go up etc. or, The mountains ascend, the valleys descend \textsuperscript{10} He sendeth Heb. Who sendeth; The waters of the sea are not only prevented from destroying the earth, but, by the providence of God, are rendered the means of preserving every living thing; partly ascending from the great deep through the strata of the earth, partly exhaled in vapour from the surface of the ocean, and thence falling in rain, especially on the tops and sides of mountains, they break forth into fresh springs, and form streams and rivers.; run Heb. walk \textsuperscript{11} They give the wild quench Heb. break \textsuperscript{12} the fowls, ; sing Heb. give a voice \textsuperscript{13} watereth; his chambers; the earth \textsuperscript{15} wine; oil to make his etc. Heb. to make his face shine with oil, or, more than oil.; bread \textsuperscript{17} the birds; as for; the stork The stork is a species of the ardea or heron genus, about the size of a goose in its body, but when erect, about three or four feet high; its general colour is white; extremity of the wings, and small part of the head, black; legs, very long, red, and naked a great way up; the toes four, long and connected, with flat nails like those of a man; beak long, jagged, red, and somewhat compressed; the upper and under chaps both of a length, with a furrow from the nostrils. It feeds on serpents, frogs, and insects, on which account it might be deemed unclean; lays four eggs, and sits thirty days; migrates about August, and returns in spring; and is remarkable for its love to its parents, whom it never forsakes, but feeds and cherishes when old; whence it had the name chaseedah, which denotes kindness or piety, and stork, from the Greek στοργη, natural affection. \textsuperscript{18} the wild goats The yaal, is the ibex, or rock goat, so called from alah, to ascend, because it is famous for mounting to the tops of the highest rocks. Its general appearance is that of the tame goat, of a dusky brown colour; but the male is larger, with long horns, bending backwards.; the conies \textsuperscript{20} makest; of the forest do creep forth Heb. thereof do trample on the forest \textsuperscript{24} how, ; in wisdom; the earth \textsuperscript{26} There go; leviathan; *marg.; made Heb. formed to play \textsuperscript{31} The glory; endure Heb. be rejoice\par}
