\subsection*{Esaias 42}
\markright{ESAIAS 42}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Jacob is my servant, I will help him: Israel is my chosen, my soul has accepted him; I have put my Spirit upon him; he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} He shall not cry, nor lift up [his voice], nor shall his voice be heard without. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench; but he shall bring forth judgment to truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} He shall shine out, and shall not be discouraged, until he have set judgment on the earth: and in his name shall the Gentiles trust. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Thus says the Lord God, who made the heaven, and established it; who settled the earth, and the things in it, and gives breath to the people on it, and spirit to them that tread on it: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} I the Lord God have called you in righteousness, and will hold your hand, and will strengthen you: and I have given you for the covenant of a race, for a light of the Gentiles: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} to open the eyes of the blind, to bring the bound and them that sit in darkness out of bonds and the prison-house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I am the Lord God: that is my name: I will not give my glory to another, nor my praises to graven images. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Behold, the ancient things have come to pass, and [so will] the new things which I tell you: yes, before I tell [them] they are made known to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Sing a new hymn to the Lord: you⌃ [who are] his dominion, glorify his name from the end of the earth: you⌃ that go down to the sea, and sail upon it; the islands, and they that dwell in them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Rejoice, you wilderness, and the villages thereof, the hamlets, and the dwellers in Kedar: the inhabitants of the rock shall rejoice, they shall shout from the top of the mountains. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} They shall give glory to God, [and] shall proclaim his praises in the islands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} The Lord God of hosts shall go forth, and crush the war: he shall stir up jealousy, and shall shout mightily against his enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} I have been silent: shall I also always be silent and forbear: I have endured like a travailing [woman]: I will [now] amaze and wither at once. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} I will make desolate mountains and hills, and will dry up all their grass; and I will make the rivers islands, and dry up the pools. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not, and I will cause them to tread paths which they have not known: I will turn darkness into light for them, and crooked things into straight. These things will I do, and will not forsake them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} But they are turned back: be you⌃ utterly ashamed that trust in graven [images], who say to the molten [images], You⌃ are our gods. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Hear, you⌃ deaf, and look up, you⌃ blind, to see. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And who is blind, but my servants? and deaf, but they that rule over them? yes, the servants of God have been made blind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} You⌃ have often seen, and have not taken heed; [your] ears have been opened, and you⌃ have not heard. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} The Lord God has taken counsel that he might be justified, and might magnify [his] praise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And I saw, and the people were spoiled and plundered: for [there is] a snare in the secret chambers everywhere, and in the houses also, where they have hidden them: they became a spoil, and there was no one that delivered the prey, and there was none who said, Restore. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Who [is there] among you that will give ear to these things? listen you⌃ to the things which are coming to pass. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} For what did he give to Jacob up to spoil, and Israel to them that plundered him? Did not God [do it] against whom they sinned? [and] they would not walk in his ways, nor listen to his law. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} So he brought upon them the fury of his wrath; and the war, and those that burnt round about them, prevailed against them; yet no one of them knew [it], neither did they lay [it] to heart.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} my servant, ; whom I; mine elect; my soul; *marg. I have, ; he shall \textsuperscript{3} bruised, ; smoking or, dimly burning quench Heb. quench it he shall \textsuperscript{4} shall not, ; discouraged Heb. broken and the isles \textsuperscript{5} he that created, ; he that spread; he that giveth \textsuperscript{6} called, ; , and will hold, and give; , a light \textsuperscript{10} Sing, ;, ; ye that go, all that is therein Heb. the fulness thereof the isles \textsuperscript{11} Let the wilderness, ; Kedar; let the inhabitants \textsuperscript{13} as a mighty; jealousy; shall cry; prevail or, behave himself mightily \textsuperscript{14} long time; devour Heb. swallow, or sup up \textsuperscript{16} I will bring, ; lead; crooked; straight Heb. into straightness and not \textsuperscript{21} well; he will;, ; it Heb. or, him \textsuperscript{22} a people, ; they are all of them snared or, in snaring all the young men of them are hid, ; a spoil Heb. a treading \textsuperscript{23} will give; time to come Heb. after-time \textsuperscript{25} he hath poured; and it hath he knew; yet he laid\par}

\subsection*{Esaias 43}
\markright{ESAIAS 43}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And now thus says the Lord God that made you, O Jacob, and formed you, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed you, I have called you [by] your name; you are mine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And if you pass through water, I am with you; and the rivers shall not overflow you: and if you go through fire, you shall not be burned; the flame shall not burn you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For I am the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, that saves you: I have made Egypt and Ethiopia your ransom, and [given] Soene for you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Since you became precious in my sight, you have become glorious, and I have loved you: and I will give men for you, and princes for your life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Fear not; for I am with you: I will bring your seed from the east, and will gather you from the west. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} I will say to the north, Bring; and to the south, Keep not back; bring my sons from the [land] afar off, and my daughters from the ends of the earth; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} [even] all who are called by my name: for I have prepared him for my glory, and I have formed him, and have made him: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} and I have brought forth the blind people; for [their] eyes are alike blind, and they that have ears are deaf. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} All the nations are gathered together, and princes shall be gathered out of them: who will declare these things? or who will declare to you things from the beginning? let them bring forth their witnesses, and be justified; and let them hear, and declare the truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Be you⌃ my witnesses, and I [too am] a witness, says the Lord God, and my servant whom I have chosen: that you⌃ may know, and believe, and understand that I am [he]: before me there was no other God, and after me there shall be none. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} I am God; and beside me there is no Saviour. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} I have declared, and have saved; I have reproached, and there was no strange [god] among you: you⌃ are my witnesses, and I am the Lord God, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} even from the beginning; and there is none that can deliver out of my hands: I will work, and who shall turn it back? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Thus says the Lord God that redeems you, the Holy One of Israel; for your sakes I will send to Babylon, and I will stir up all that flee, and the Chaldeans shall be bound in ships. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} I am the Lord God, your Holy One, who have appointed for Israel your king. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Thus says the Lord, who makes a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty water; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} who brought forth chariots and horse, and a mighty multitude: but they have lain down, and shall not rise: they are extinct, as quenched flax. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Remember you⌃ not the former things, and consider not the ancient things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Behold, I [will] do new things, which shall presently spring forth, and you⌃ shall know them: and I will make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the dry land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} the beasts of the field shall bless me, the owls and young ostriches; for I have given water in the wilderness, and rivers in the dry land, to give drink to my chosen race, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} my people whom I have preserved to tell forth my praises. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} I have not now called you, O Jacob; neither have I made you weary, O Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} You have not brought me the sheep of your whole burnt offering; neither have you glorified me with your sacrifices. I have not caused you to serve with sacrifices, neither have I wearied you with frankincense. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Neither have you purchased for me victims for silver, neither have I desired the fat of your sacrifices: but you did stand before me in your sins, and in your iniquities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} I, [even] I, am he that blots out your transgressions for my own sake, and your sins; and I will not remember [them]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} But do you remember, and let us plead [together]: do you first confess your transgressions, that you may be justified. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Your fathers first, and your princes have transgressed against me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And the princes have defiled my sanctuaries: so I gave Jacob [to enemies] to destroy, and Israel to reproach.\par

\subsection*{Esaias 44}
\markright{ESAIAS 44}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} But now hear, Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Thus says the Lord God that made you, and he that formed you from the womb; You shall yet be helped: fear not, my servant Jacob; and beloved Israel, whom I have chosen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For I will give water to the thirsty that walk in a dry land: I will put my Spirit upon your seed, and my blessings upon your children: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} and they shall spring up as grass between brooks, and as willows on [the banks of] running water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} One shall say, I am God's; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall write with his hand, I am God's, and shall call himself by the name of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Thus says God the King of Israel, and the God of hosts that delivered him; I am the first, and I am hereafter: beside me there is no God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Who is like me? let him stand, and call, and declare, and prepare for me from the time that I made man for ever; and let them tell you the things that are coming before they arrive. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Hide not yourselves, nor go astray: have you⌃ not heard from the beginning, and [have not] I told you? you⌃ are witnesses if there is a God beside me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} But they that framed [false gods] did not then listen; and they that graved [images] are all vain, performing their own desires, which shall not profit them, but they shall be ashamed {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} that form a god, and all that grave worthless things: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} and all by whom they were made are withered: yes, let all the deaf be gathered from [among] men, and let them stand together; and let them be ashamed and confounded together: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For the artificer sharpens the iron; he fashions [the idol] with an axe, and fixes it with an awl, and fashions it with the strength of his arm: and he will be hungry and weak, and will drink no water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} The artificer having chosen a piece of wood, marks it out with a rule, and fits it with glue, and makes it as the form of a man, and as the beauty of a man, to set it up in the house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} He cuts wood out of the forest, which the Lord planted, [even] a pine tree, and the rain made it grow, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} that it might be for men to burn: and having taken part of it he warms himself; yes, they burn part of it, and bake loaves thereon; and [of] the rest they make for themselves gods, and they worship them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Half thereof he burns in the fire, and with half of it he bakes loaves on the coals; and having roasted flesh on it he eats, and is satisfied, and having warmed himself he says, I am comfortable, for I have warmed myself, and have seen the fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And the rest he makes a graven god, and worships, and prays, saying, Deliver me; for you are my God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} They have no understanding to perceive; for they have been blinded so that they should not see with their eyes, nor perceive with their heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And one has not considered in his mind, nor known in his understanding, that he has burnt up half of it in the fire, and baked loaves on the coals thereof and has roasted and eaten flesh, and of the rest of it he has made an abomination, and they worship it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Know you that their heart is ashes, and they err, and no one is able to deliver his soul: see, you⌃ will not say, [There is a] lie in my right hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Remember these things, O Jacob and Israel; for you are my servant; I have formed you [to be] my servant: and do you, Israel, not forget me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} For behold, I have blotted out as a cloud your transgressions, and your sin as darkness: turn to me, and I will redeem you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Rejoice, you⌃ heavens; for God has had mercy upon Israel: sound the trumpet, you⌃ foundations of the earth: you⌃ mountains, shout [with] joy, you⌃ hills, and all the trees therein: for God has redeemed Jacob, and Israel shall be glorified. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Thus says the Lord that redeems you, and who formed you from the womb, I am the Lord that performs all things: I stretched out the heaven alone, and established the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Who else will frustrate the tokens of those that have divining spirits, and prophecies from the heart of [man]? turning the wise back, and making their counsel foolishness; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} and confirming the word of his servant, and verifying the counsel of his messengers: who says to Jerusalem, You shall be inhabited; and to the cities of Idumea, You⌃ shall be built, and her desert places shall spring forth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Who says to the deep, You shall be dried up, and I will dry up the rivers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Who bids Cyrus be wise, and he shall perform all my will: who says to Jerusalem, You shall be built, and I will lay the foundation of my holy house.\par

\subsection*{Esaias 45}
\markright{ESAIAS 45}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Thus says the Lord God to my anointed Cyrus, whose right hand I have held, that nations might be obedient before him; and I will break through the strength of kings; I will open doors before him, and cities shall not be closed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} I will go before you, and will level mountains: I will break to pieces brazen doors, and burst iron bars. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I will give you the treasures of darkness, I will open to you hidden, unseen [treasures], that you may know that I, the Lord your God, that call you by name, am the God of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For the sake of my servant Jacob, and Israel my elect, I will call you by your name, and accept you: but you have not known me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For I am the Lord God, and there is no other God beside me; I strengthened you, and you have not known me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} That they that [come] from the east and they that [come] from the west may know that there is no God but me. I am the Lord God, and there is none beside. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} I am he that prepared light, and formed darkness; who make peace, and create evil; I am the Lord God, that does all these things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Let the heaven rejoice from above, and let the clouds rain righteousness: let the earth bring forth, and blossom [with] mercy, and bring forth righteousness likewise: I am the Lord that created you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} What excellent thing have I prepared as clay of the potter? Will the plowman plow the earth all day? shall the clay say to the potter, What are you doing that you do not work, nor have hands? shall the thing formed answer him that formed it? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} As though one should say to [his] father, What will you beget me? and to his mother, What are you bringing forth? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For thus says the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel, who has formed the things that are to come, Enquire of me concerning my sons, and concerning the works of my hands command me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} I have made the earth, and man upon it: I with my hand have established the heaven; I have given commandment to all the stars. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} I have raised him up [to be] a king with righteousness, and all his ways are right: he shall build my city, and shall turn the captivity of my people, not for ransoms, nor for rewards, says the Lord of hosts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Thus says the Lord of hosts, Egypt has laboured [for you]; and the merchandise of the Ethiopians, and the Sabeans, men of stature, shall pass over to you, and shall be your servants; and they shall follow after you bound in fetters, and shall pass over to you, and shall do obeisance to you, and make supplication to you: because God is in you; and there is no God beside you, [O Lord]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For you are God, yet we knew [it] not, the God of Israel, the Saviour. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} All that are opposed to him shall be ashamed and confounded, and shall walk in shame: you⌃ isles, keep a feast to me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Israel is saved by the Lord with an everlasting salvation: they shall not be ashamed nor confounded for evermore. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Thus says the Lord that made the heaven, this God that created the earth, and made it; he marked it out, he made it not in vain, but formed it to be inhabited: I am the Lord, and there is none beside. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} I have not spoken in secret, nor in a dark place of the earth: I said not to the seed of Jacob, Seek vanity: I, even I, am the Lord, speaking righteousness, and proclaiming truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Assemble yourselves and come; take counsel together, you⌃ that escape of the nations: they that set up wood, [even] their graven image, have no knowledge, nor they who pray to gods that do not save. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} If they will declare, let them draw near, that they may know together, who has caused these things to be heard from the beginning: then was it told you. I am God, and there is not another beside me; a just [God] and a Saviour; there is none but me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Turn you⌃ to me, and you⌃ shall be saved, you⌃ that [come] from the end of the earth: I am God, and there is none other. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} By myself I swear, righteousness shall surely proceed out of my mouth; my words shall not be frustrated; that to me every knee shall bend, and every tongue shall swear by God, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} saying, Righteousness and glory shall come to him: and all that remove them from their borders shall be ashamed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} By the Lord shall they be justified, and in God shall all the seed of the children of Israel be glorified.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} to his; whose; holden or, strengthened, to subdue;, ;, to open All the streets of Babylon, leading on each side to the river, were secured by two leaved brazen gates, and these were providentially left open when Cyrus's forces entered the city in the night, through the channel of the river, in the general disorder occasioned by the great feast which was then celebrated; otherwise, says Herodotus, the Persians would have been shut up in the bed of the river, as in a net, and all destroyed. The gates of the palace were also imprudently opened to ascertain the occasion of the tumult; when the two parties under Gobrias and Gadatas rushed in, got possession of the palace, and slew the king. \textsuperscript{3} I will give, ; that thou; which call \textsuperscript{4} Jacob, ; I have even, though \textsuperscript{5} the Lord, ; I girded thee \textsuperscript{7} form; create darkness; I make Peace \textsuperscript{8} Drop down; let the earth, ; I the Lord \textsuperscript{9} unto him; Shall the clay \textsuperscript{11} the Holy One, Ask; concerning my sons, ; concerning the work, ; command \textsuperscript{12} made the earth, ; my hands, ; all their host \textsuperscript{13} raised him, in righteousness; direct or, make straight, he shall build; let go; price \textsuperscript{14} The labour, ; the Sabeans That the Sabeans were of a most majestic appearance is particularly remarked by Agatharchides, an ancient Greek historian quoted by Bochart.; men of stature; in chains; they shall fall, ; Surely; and there \textsuperscript{17} Israel; an everlasting, ; ye shall not \textsuperscript{18} that created; he created; I am \textsuperscript{21} Tell ye, ; and bring who hath declared, and there is, a just \textsuperscript{23} sworn; the word; That unto; every tongue \textsuperscript{24} Surely etc. or, Surely he shall say of me, In the Lord is all righteousness and strength in the, ; *marg. righteousness Heb. righteousnesses strength; even; and all \textsuperscript{25} the Lord;, ; the seed, ; glory; *Gr.\par}

\subsection*{Esaias 46}
\markright{ESAIAS 46}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Bel has fallen, Nabo is broken to pieces, their graven images are gone to the wild beasts and the cattle: you⌃ take them packed up as a burden to the weary, exhausted, hungry, and [at the same time] helpless man; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} who will not be able to save themselves from war, but they themselves are led [away] captive. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Hear me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of Israel, who are borne [by me] from the womb, and taught [by me] from infancy, [even] to old age: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I am [he]; and until you⌃ shall have grown old, I am [he]: I bear you, I have made, and I will relieve, I will take up and save you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} To whom have you⌃ compared me? see, consider, you⌃ that go astray. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} They that furnish gold out of a purse, and silver by weight, will weigh it in a scale, and they hire a goldsmith and make idols, and bow down, and worship them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} They bear it upon the shoulder, and go; and if they put it upon its place, it remains, it can’t move: and whoever shall cry to it, it can’t hear; it can’t save him from trouble. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Remember you⌃ these things, and groan: repent, you⌃ that have gone astray, return in your heart; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} and remember the former things [that were] of old: for I am God, and there is none other beside me, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} telling beforehand the latter events before they come to pass, and they are accomplished together: and I said, all my counsel shall stand, and I will do all things that I have planned: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} calling a bird from the east, and from a land afar off, for the things which I have planned: I have spoken, and brought [him]; I have created and made [him]; I have brought him, and prospered his way. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Listen to me, you⌃ senseless ones, that are far from righteousness: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} I have brought near my righteousness, and I will not be slow with the salvation that is from me: I have given salvation in Sion to Israel for glory.\par

\subsection*{Esaias 47}
\markright{ESAIAS 47}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Come down, sit on the ground, O virgin daughter of Babylon: sit on the ground, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for you shall no more be called tender and luxurious. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Take a millstone, grind meal: remove your veil, uncover your white hairs, make bare the leg, pass through the rivers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Your shame shall be uncovered, your reproaches shall be brought to light: I will exact of you due vengeance, I will no longer deliver you to men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Your deliverer is the Lord of hosts, the Holy One of Israel is his name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Sit you down pierced with woe, go into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: you shall no more be called the strength of a kingdom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} I have been provoked with my people; you have defiled my inheritance: I gave them into your hand, but you did not extend mercy to them: you made the yoke of the aged man very heavy, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} and said, I shall be a princess for ever: you did not perceive these things in your heart, nor did you remember the latter end. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} But now hear these words, you luxurious one, [who are] the one that sits [at ease], that is secure, that says in her heart, I am, and there is not another; I shall not sit a widow, neither shall I know bereavement. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} But now these two things shall come upon you suddenly in one day, the loss of children and widowhood shall come suddenly upon you, for your sorcery, for the strength of your enchantments, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} for your trusting in wickedness: for you said, I am, and there is not another: know you, the understanding of these things and your harlotry shall be your shame; for you said in your heart, I am, and there is not another. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And destruction shall come upon you, and you shall not be aware; [there shall be a] pit, and you shall fall into it: and grief shall come upon you, and you shall not be able to be clear; and destruction shall come suddenly upon you, and you shall not know. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Stand now with your enchantments, and with the abundance of your sorcery, which you have learned from your youth; if you can be profited. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} You are wearied in your counsels. Let now the astrologers of the heaven stand and deliver you, let them that see the stars tell you what is about to come upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Behold, they all shall be burnt up as sticks in the fire; neither shall they at all deliver their life from the flame. Because you have coals of fire, sit you upon them; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} these shall be your help. You have wearied yourself with traffic from your youth: every man has wandered to his own home, but you shall have no deliverance.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} down, ; O virgin; daughter; there is; thou shalt \textsuperscript{5} silent; for After Babylon was taken by Cyrus, instead of being "the lady of kingdoms, " the metropolis of a great empire, and mistress of all the East, it became subject to the Persians; and the imperial seat being removed to Susa, instead of having a king, it had only a deputy residing there, who governed it as a province of the Persian empire. \textsuperscript{6} wroth; I have polluted; thou didst; upon \textsuperscript{8} given, ; I am;, ; I shall not \textsuperscript{9} these two; in a moment; they shall come; for the multitude \textsuperscript{10} thou hast trusted; thou hast said; Thy wisdom; perverted thee or, caused thee to turn away I am \textsuperscript{11} thou shalt not know; from whence it riseth Heb. the morning thereof thou shalt not be; put it off Heb. expiate \textsuperscript{13} wearied; Let now;, astrologers, the stargazers Heb. viewers of the heavens, the monthly prognosticators. All these, at the approach of Cyrus, sought to escape to their several countries.\par}

\subsection*{Esaias 48}
\markright{ESAIAS 48}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Hear these [words], you⌃ house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel, and have come forth out of Juda, who swear by the name of the Lord God of Israel, making mention [of it, but] not with truth, nor with righteousness; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} maintaining also the name of the holy city, and staying themselves on the God of Israel: the Lord of hosts is his name. The former things I have already declared; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and they that have proceeded out of my mouth, and it became well known; I wrought suddenly, and [the events] came to pass. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I know that you are stubborn, and your neck is an iron sinew, and your forehead brazen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And I told you of old what [should be] before it came upon you; I made it known to you, lest you should say, [My] idols have done [it] for me; and should say, [My] graven and molten images have commanded me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} You⌃ have heard all this, but you⌃ have not known: yet I have made known to you the new things from henceforth, which are coming to pass, and you said not, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Now they come to pass, and not formerly: and you heard not of them in former days: say not you, Yes, I know them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} You have neither known, nor understood, neither from the beginning have I opened your ears: for I knew that you would surely deal treacherously, and would be called a transgressor even from the womb. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For my own sake will I show you my wrath, and will bring before you my glorious acts, that I may not utterly destroy you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Behold, I have sold you, [but] not for silver; but I have rescued you from the furnace of affliction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For my own sake I will do [this] for you, because my name is profaned; and I will not give my glory to another. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Hear me, O Jacob, and Israel whom I call; I am the first, and I endure for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} My hand also has founded the earth, and my right hand has fixed the sky: I will call them, and they shall stand together. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And all shall be gathered, and shall hear: who has told them these things? Out of love to you I have fulfilled your desire on Babylon, to abolish the seed of the Chaldeans. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} I have spoken, I have called, I have brought him, and made his way prosperous. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Draw near to me, and hear you⌃ these words; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning: when it took place, there was I, and now the Lord, [even] the Lord, and his Spirit, has sent me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Thus says the Lord that delivered you, the Holy One of Israel; I am your God, I have shown you how you should find the way wherein you should walk. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And if you had listened to my commandments, [then] would your peace have been like a river, and your righteousness as a wave of the sea. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Your seed also would have been as the sand, and the offspring of your belly as the dust of the ground: neither now shall you by any means be utterly destroyed, neither shall your name perish before me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Go forth of Babylon, you that flee from the Chaldeans: utter aloud a voice of joy, and let this be made known, proclaim it to the end of the earth; say you⌃, The Lord has delivered his servant Jacob. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And if they shall thirst, he shall lead them through the desert; he shall bring forth water to them out of the rock: the rock shall be cloven, and the water shall flow forth, and my people shall drink. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} There is no joy, says the Lord, to the ungodly.\par

\subsection*{Esaias 49}
\markright{ESAIAS 49}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Listen to me, you⌃ islands; and attend, you⌃ Gentiles; after a long time it shall come to pass, says the Lord: from my mother's womb he has called my name: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} and he has made my mouth as a sharp sword, and he has hid me under the shadow of his hand; he has made me as a choice shaft, and he has hid me in his quiver; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and said to me, You are my servant, O Israel, and in you I will be glorified. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have given my strength for vanity and for nothing: therefore is my judgment with the Lord, and my labor before my God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And now, thus says the Lord that formed me from the womb to be his own servant, to gather Jacob to him and Israel. I shall be gathered and glorified before the Lord, and my God shall be my strength. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And he said to me, [It is] a great thing for you to be called my servant, to establish the tribes of Jacob, and to recover the dispersion of Israel: behold, I have given you for the covenant of a race, for a light of the Gentiles, that you should be for salvation to the end of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Thus says the Lord that delivered you, the God of Israel, Sanctify him that despises his life, him that is abhorred by the nations that are the servants of princes: kings shall behold him, and princes shall arise, and shall worship him, for the Lord's sake: for the Holy One of Israel is faithful, and I have chosen you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Thus says the Lord, In an acceptable time have I heard you, and in a day of salvation have I succored you: and I have formed you, and given you for a covenant of the nations, to establish the earth, and to cause to inherit the desert heritages: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} saying to them that are in bonds, Go forth; and [bidding] them that are in darkness show themselves. They shall be fed in all the ways, and in all the paths [shall be] their pasture. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} They shall not hunger, neither shall they thirst; neither shall the heat nor the sun strike them; but he that has mercy on them shall comfort [them], and by fountains of waters shall he lead them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And I will make every mountain a way, and every path a pasture to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Behold, these shall come from far: [and] these from the north and the west, and others from the land of the Persians. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Rejoice, you⌃ heavens; and let the earth be glad: let the mountains break forth [with] joy; for the Lard has had mercy on his people, and has comforted the lowly ones of his people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} But Sion said, The Lord has forsaken me, and, The Lord has forgotten me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Will a woman forget her child, so as not to have compassion upon the offspring of her womb? but if a woman should even forget these, yet I will not forget you, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Behold, I have painted your walls on my hands, and you are continually before me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And you shall soon be built by those by whom you were destroyed, and they that made you desolate shall go forth of you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Lift up your eyes round about, and look on them all; behold, they are gathered together, and are come to you. [As] I live, says the Lord, you shall clothe yourself with them all as with an ornament, and put them on as a bride her attire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} For your desert and marred and ruined [places] shall now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that devoured you shall be removed far from you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} For your sons whom you have lost shall say in your ears, The place [is too] narrow for me: make room for me that I may dwell. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And you shall say in your heart, Who has begotten me these? whereas I [was] childless, and a widow; but who has brought up these for me? and I was left alone; but whence came these to me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Thus says the Lord, [even] the Lord, Behold, I lift up my hand to the nations, and I will lift up my signal to the islands: and they shall bring your sons in [their] bosom, and shall bear your daughters on [their] shoulders. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And kings shall be your nursing fathers, and their princesses your nurses, they shall bow down to you on the face of the earth, and shall lick the dust of your feet; and you shall know that I am the Lord, and they that wait on me shall not be ashamed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Will any one take spoils from a giant? and if one should take [a man] captive unjustly, shall he be delivered? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} For thus says the Lord, If one should take a giant captive, he shall take spoils, and he who takes [them] from a mighty [man] shall be delivered: for I will plead your cause, and I will deliver your children. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And they that afflicted you shall eat their own flesh; and they shall drink their own blood as new wine, and shall be drunken: and all flesh shall perceive that I am the Lord that delivers you, and that upholds the strength of Jacob.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} Listen, ; and hearken; The Lord \textsuperscript{2} he hath made; , in the; made me The polished shaft, says Bp. Lowth, denotes the same efficacious word which is before represented by the sharp sword. The doctrine of the gospel pierced the hearts of its hearers, "bringing into captivity every thought to the obedience of Christ." \textsuperscript{4} I have laboured; spent; yet; work or, reward \textsuperscript{5} that formed to bring; Though etc. or, That Israel may be gathered to him, and I may, etc Israel; yet \textsuperscript{6} It is a light thing that or, Art thou lighter, than that, etc., preserved or, desolations I will also; that thou mayest \textsuperscript{7} the Redeemer; to him whom man despiseth or, to him that is despised in soul; , to a; Kings, ; and he \textsuperscript{8} In an; have I helped; give thee; establish or, raise up; to cause \textsuperscript{9} to the;, ; to them, ; They shall feed, ; high \textsuperscript{10} shall not; neither, ; he that \textsuperscript{15} a woman; that she should not have compassion Heb. from having compassion they may; yet \textsuperscript{17} children; haste Or, by a slight change of the points, "Thy builders shall make haste:" those appointed to build the city and walls of Zion, shall speedily begin and accomplish the work. thy destroyers \textsuperscript{18} Lift up; all these, ; As I live; thou shalt; as a bride; doeth Bp. Lowth adds from the LXX, "her jewels." \textsuperscript{23} kings Cyrus, Darius, Artaxerxes, and other Persian monarchs, as well as Alexander the Great, and his successors, particularly Demetrius, conferred many privileges and immunities on the Jewish people, and were munificent benefactors to their temple. But the prophecy was more remarkably and fully fulfilled in the favour which Constantine the Great, and other Christian princes and princesses from his time to the present day, have shewn to the church of Christ; though it cannot be disputed, that the grand and signal accomplishment of these predictions is yet future., ; Esth. 8:1-10:3;, ; nursing fathers Heb. nourishers, queens Heb. princesses bow; lick up for they \textsuperscript{24} Shall, prey; lawful captive Heb. captivity of the just \textsuperscript{25} Even; captives Heb. captivity I will contend; I will save \textsuperscript{26} I will feed; drunken, sweet wine or, new wine and all\par}

\subsection*{Esaias 50}
\markright{ESAIAS 50}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Thus says the Lord, Of what kind is your mother's bill of divorcement, by which I put her away? or to which debtor have I sold you? Behold, you⌃ are sold for your sins, and for your iniquities have I put your mother away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Why did I come, and there was no man? [why] did I call, and there was none to listen? Is not my hand strong to redeem? or can I not deliver? behold, by my rebuke I will dry up the sea, and make rivers a wilderness; and their fish shall be dried up because there is no water, and shall die for thirst. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} I will clothe the sky with darkness, and will make its covering as sackcloth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} The Lord [even] God gives me the tongue of instruction, to know when it is fit to speak a word: he has appointed for me early, he has given me an ear to hear: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} and the instruction of the Lord, even the Lord, opens my ears, and I do not disobey, nor dispute. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} I gave my back to scourges, and my cheeks to blows; and I turned not away my face from the shame of spitting: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} but the Lord God became my helper; therefore I was not ashamed, but I set my face as a solid rock; and I know that I shall never be ashamed, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} for he that has justified me draws near; who is he that pleads with me? let him stand up against me at the same time: yes, who is he that pleads with me? let him draw near to me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Behold, the Lord, the Lord, will help me; who will hurt me? behold, all you⌃ shall wax old as a garment, and a moth shall devour you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Who is among you that fears the Lord? let him listen to the voice of his servant: you⌃ that walk in darkness, and have no light, trust in the name of the Lord, and stay upon God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Behold, you⌃ all kindle a fire, and feed a flame: walk in the light of your fire, and in the flame which you⌃ have kindled. This has happened to you for my sake; you⌃ shall lie down in sorrow.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} the bill; or which; Behold Husbands often sent bills of divorcement to their wives on slight occasions; and fathers, oppressed with debt, sold their children till the year of release. But this, saith God, cannot be my case: I am not governed by any such motives, nor am I urged by any such necessity. D'Arvieux gives a remarkable instance of an Arab, who, having received a wound in his jaw, chose to hazard his life rather than suffer the surgeon to cut off his beard. \subsection*{Esaias 51}
\markright{ESAIAS 51}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Listen to me, you⌃ that follow after righteousness, and seek the Lord: look to the solid rock, which you⌃ have hewn, and to the hole of the pit which you⌃ have dug. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Look to Abraam your father, and to Sarrha that bore you: for he was alone when I called him, and blessed him, and loved him, and multiplied him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And now I will comfort you, O Sion: and I have comforted all her desert places; and I will make her desert places as a garden, and her western places as the garden of the Lord; they shall find in her gladness and exultation, thanksgiving and the voice of praise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Hear me, hear me, my people; and you⌃ kings, listen to me: for a law shall proceed from me, and my judgment [shall be] for a light of the nations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} My righteousness speedily draws near, and my salvation shall go forth as light, and on my arm shall the Gentiles trust: the isles shall wait for me, and on my arm shall they trust. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Lift up your eyes to the sky, and look on the earth beneath: for the sky was darkened like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and the inhabitants shall die in like manner: but my righteousness shall not fail. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Hear me, you⌃ that know judgment, the people in whose heart is my law: fear not the reproach of men, and be not overcome by their contempt. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For as a garment will be devoured by time, and as wool will be devoured by a moth, [so shall they be consumed]; but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation for all generations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Awake, awake, O Jerusalem, and put on the strength of your arm; awake as in the early time, as the ancient generation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Are you not it that dried the sea, the water, [even] the abundance of the deep; that made the depths of the sea a way of passage for the delivered and redeemed? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} for by [the help of] the Lord they shall return, and come to Sion with joy and everlasting exultation, for praise and joy shall come upon their head: pain, and grief, and groaning, have fled away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} I, [even] I, am he that comforts you: consider who you are, that you were afraid of mortal man, and of the son of man, who are withered as grass. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And you have forgotten God who made you, who made the sky and founded the earth; and you were continually afraid because of the wrath of him that afflicted you: for [whereas] he counselled to take you away, yet now where is the wrath of him that afflicted you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For in your deliverance he shall not halt, nor wait; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} for I am your God, that troubles the sea, and causes the waves thereof to roar: the Lord of hosts is my name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} I will put my words into your mouth, and I will shelter you under the shadow of my hand, with which I fixed the sky, and founded the earth: and [the Lord] shall say to Sion, You are my people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, that have drunk at the hand of the Lord the cup of his fury: for you have drunk out and drained the cup of calamity, the cup of wrath: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} and there was none to comfort you of all the children whom you bore; and there was none to take hold of your hand, not even of all the children whom you have reared. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Therefore these things are against you; who shall sympathize with you in your grief? downfall, and destruction, famine, and sword: who shall comfort you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Your sons are the perplexed ones, that sleep at the top of every street as a half-boiled beet; they that are full of the anger of the Lord, caused to faint by the Lord God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Therefore hear, you afflicted one, and drunken, [but] not with wine; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} thus says the Lord God that judges his people, Behold, I have taken out of your hand the cup of calamity, the cup of my wrath; and you shall not drink it any more. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And I will give it into the hands of them that injured you, and them that afflicted you; who said to your soul, Bow down, that we may pass over: and you did level your body with the ground to them passing by without.\par

\subsection*{Esaias 52}
\markright{ESAIAS 52}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Awake, awake, Sion; put on your strength, O Sion; and o you put on your glory, Jerusalem the holy city: there shall no more pass through you, the uncircumcised and unclean. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Shake off the dust and arise; sit down, Jerusalem: put off the band of your neck, captive daughter of Sion. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For thus says the Lord, You⌃ have been sold for nothing; and you⌃ shall not be ransomed with silver. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Thus says the Lord, My people went down before to Egypt to sojourn there; and were carried away forcibly to the Assyrians. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And now why are you⌃ here? Thus says the Lord, Because my people was taken for nothing, wonder you⌃ and howl. Thus says the Lord, On account of you my name is continually blasphemed among the Gentiles. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Therefore shall my people know my name in that day, for I am he that speaks: I am present, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} as a season of beauty upon the mountains, as the feet of one preaching glad tidings of peace, as one preaching good news: for I will publish your salvation, saying, O Sion, your God shall reign. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For the voice of them that guard you is exalted, and with the voice together they shall rejoice: for eyes shall look to eyes, when the Lord shall have mercy upon Sion. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Let the waste places of Jerusalem break forth [in] joy together, because the Lord has had mercy upon her, and has delivered Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And the Lord shall reveal his holy arm in the sight of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation that [comes] from our God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Depart you⌃, depart, go out from thence, and touch not the unclean thing; go you⌃ out from the midst of her; separate yourselves, you⌃ that bear the vessels of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For you⌃ shall not go forth with tumult, neither go by flight: for the Lord shall go first in advance of you; and the God of Israel shall be he that brings up your rear. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Behold, my servant shall understand, and be exalted, and glorified exceedingly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} As many shall be amazed at you, so shall your face be without glory from men, and your glory [shall not be honored] by the sons of men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Thus shall many nations wonder at him; and kings shall keep their mouths shut: for they to whom no report was brought concerning him, shall see; and they who have not heard, shall consider.\par

\subsection*{Esaias 53}
\markright{ESAIAS 53}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} O Lord, who has believed our report? and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} We brought a report as [of] a child before him; [he is] as a root in a thirsty land: he has no form nor comeliness; and we saw him, but he had no form nor beauty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} But his form was ignoble, and inferior to that of the children of men; [he was] a man in suffering, and acquainted with the bearing of sickness, for his face is turned from [us]: he was dishonored, and not esteemed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} He bears our sins, and is pained for us: yet we accounted him to be in trouble, and in suffering, and in affliction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} But he was wounded on account of our sins, and was bruised because of our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; [and] by his bruises we were healed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} All we as sheep have gone astray; every one has gone astray in his way; and the Lord gave him up for our sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And he, because of his affliction, opens not his mouth: he was led as a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before the shearer is dumb, so he opens not his mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} In [his] humiliation his judgment was taken away: who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken away from the earth: because of the iniquities of my people he was led to death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And I will give the wicked for his burial, and the rich for his death; for he practised no iniquity, nor craft with his mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} The Lord also is pleased to purge him from his stroke. If you⌃ can give an offering for sin, your soul shall see a long-lived seed: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} the Lord also is pleased to take away from the travail of his soul, to show him light, and to form [him] with understanding; to justify the just one who serves many well; and he shall bear their sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Therefore he shall inherit many, and he shall divide the spoils of the mighty; because his soul was delivered to death: and he was numbered among the transgressors; and he bore the sins of many, and was delivered because of their iniquities.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} Who, ; report or, doctrine, Heb. hearing the, ; revealed \textsuperscript{2} he shall grow; he hath no \textsuperscript{3} despised; a man; , we hid as it were our faces from him or, he hid as it were, his face from us. Heb. as a hiding of faces from him or from us. we esteemed. \textsuperscript{5} But he was; wounded or, tormented bruised; the chastisement stripes Heb. bruise \textsuperscript{6} All we; his own; laid on him the iniquity of us all Heb. made the iniquities of us all to meet on him \textsuperscript{8} from prison and from judgment; and, or, by distress and judgment; but, etc.; who; cut off; was he stricken Heb. was the stroke upon him \textsuperscript{9} made; death Heb. deaths deceit \textsuperscript{10} pleased; he hath; when thou shalt make his soul or, when his soul shall make; , ; he shall see, ; he shall prolong;, ; the pleasure \textsuperscript{11} see; by his; , my righteousness, ; justify;, ; bear \textsuperscript{12} will I; poured; *marg. and he was;, he bare; made\par}

\subsection*{Esaias 54}
\markright{ESAIAS 54}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Rejoice, you barren that bear not; break forth and cry, you that do not travail: for more are the children of the desolate than of her that has a husband: for the Lord has said, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Enlarge the place of your tent, and of your curtains: fix [the pins], spare not, lengthen your cords, and strengthen your pins; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} spread forth [your tent] yet to the right and the left: for your seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and you shall make the desolate cities to be inhabited. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Fear not, because you have been put to shame, neither be confounded, because you were reproached: for you shall forget your former shame, and shall no more at all remember the reproach of your widowhood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For [it is] the Lord that made you; the Lord of hosts is his name: and he that delivered you, he is the God of Israel, [and] shall be called [so] by the whole earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} The Lord has not called you as a deserted and faint-hearted woman, nor as a woman hated from [her] youth, says your God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For a little while I left you: but with great mercy will I have compassion upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} In a little wrath I turned away my face from you; but with everlasting mercy will I have compassion upon you, says the Lord that delivers you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} From the time of the water of Noe this is my [purpose]: as I swore to him at that time, [saying] of the earth, I will no more be angry with you, neither when you are threatened, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} shall the mountains depart, nor shall your hills be removed: so neither shall my mercy fail you, nor shall the covenant of your peace be at all removed: for the Lord [who is] gracious to you has spoken [it]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Afflicted and outcast you have not been comforted: behold, I [will] prepare carbuncle [for] your stones, and sapphire for your foundations; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} and I will make your buttresses jasper, and your gates crystal, and your border precious stones. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And [I will cause] all your sons [to be] taught of God, and your children [to be] in great peace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And you shall be built in righteousness: abstain from injustice, and you shall not fear; and trembling shall not come near you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Behold, strangers shall come to you by me, and shall sojourn with you, and shall run to you for refuge. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Behold, I have created you, not as the coppersmith blowing coals, and bringing out a vessel [fit] for work; but I have created you, not for ruin, that [I] should destroy [you]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} I will not suffer any weapon formed against you to prosper; and every voice that shall rise up against you for judgment, you shall vanquish them all; and your adversaries shall be [condemned] thereby. There is an inheritance to them that serve the Lord, and you⌃ shall be righteous before me, says the Lord.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} O barren; break, ; for more \textsuperscript{3} thou shalt, ; and thy, make \textsuperscript{4} Fear not, ; thou shalt forget \textsuperscript{5} thy Maker; the Lord; The God \textsuperscript{8} a little; I hid; but; the Lord \textsuperscript{10} the mountains; the covenant; that hath \textsuperscript{11} thou afflicted, ; tossed; not comforted, I will lay; Ezek. 40:1-42:20; sapphires \textsuperscript{14} righteousness, ; thou shalt be; for thou \textsuperscript{17} weapon; every;, ; the heritage; and their\par}

\subsection*{Esaias 55}
\markright{ESAIAS 55}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} You⌃ that thirst, go to the water, and all that have no money, go [and] buy; and eat [and drink] wine and fat without money or price. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Therefore do you⌃ value at the price of money, and [give] your labor for that which will not satisfy? listen to me, and you⌃ shall eat that which is good, and your soul shall feast itself on good things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Give heed with your ears, and follow my ways: listen to me, and your soul shall live in prosperity; and I will make with you an everlasting covenant, the sure mercies of David. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Behold I have made him a testimony among the Gentiles, a prince and commander to the Gentiles. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Nations which know you not, shall call upon you, and peoples which are not acquainted with you, shall flee to you for refuge, for the sake of the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel; for he has glorified you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Seek you⌃ the Lord, and when you⌃ find him, call upon him; and when he shall draw near to you, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} let the ungodly leave his ways, and the transgressor his counsels: and let him return to the Lord, and he shall find mercy; for he shall abundantly pardon your sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For my counsels are not as your counsels, nor are my ways as your ways, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} But as the heaven is distant from the earth, so is my way distant from your ways, and your thoughts from my mind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For as rain shall come down, or snow, from heaven, and shall not return until it have saturated the earth, and it bring forth, and bud, and give seed to the sower, and bread for food: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} so shall my word be, whatever shall proceed out of my mouth, it shall by no means turn back, until all the things which I willed shall have been accomplished; and I will make your ways prosperous, and [will effect] my commands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For you⌃ shall go forth with joy, and shall be taught with gladness: for the mountains and the hills shall exult to welcome you with joy, and all the trees of the field shall applaud with their branches. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And instead of the bramble shall come up the cypress, and instead of the nettle shall come up the myrtle: and the Lord shall be for a name, and for an everlasting sign, and shall not fail.\par

\subsection*{Esaias 56}
\markright{ESAIAS 56}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Thus says the Lord, Keep you⌃ judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my mercy to be revealed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Blessed is the man that does these things, and the man that holds by them, and keeps the sabbaths from profaning them, and keeps his hands from doing unrighteousness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Let not the stranger who attaches himself to the Lord, say, Surely the Lord will separate me from his people: and let not the eunuch say, I am a dry tree. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Thus says the Lord to the eunuchs, as many as shall keep my sabbaths, and choose the things which I take pleasure in, and take hold of my covenant; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} I will give to them in my house and within my walls an honorable place, better than sons and daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, and it shall not fail. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And [I will give it] to the strangers that attach themselves to the Lord, to serve him, and to love the name of the Lord, to be to him servants and handmaids; and [as for] all that keep my sabbaths from profaning [them], and that take hold of my covenant; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} I will bring them to my holy mountain, and gladden them in my house of prayer: their whole burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be acceptable upon my altar; for my house shall be called a house of prayer for all nations, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} says the Lord that gathers the dispersed of Israel; for I will gather to him a congregation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} All you⌃ beasts of the field, come, devour, all you⌃ beasts of the forest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} See how they are all blinded: they have not known; [they are] dumb dogs [that] will not bark; dreaming of rest, loving to slumber. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Yes, they are insatiable dogs, that know not what it is to be filled, and they are wicked, having no understanding: all have followed their own ways, each according to his [will].\par

\subsection*{Esaias 57}
\markright{ESAIAS 57}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} See how the just man has perished, and no one lays [it] to heart: and righteous men are taken away, and no one considers: for the righteous has been removed out of the way of injustice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} His burial shall be in peace: he has been removed out of the way. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} But draw you⌃ near hither, you⌃ lawless children, the seed of adulterers and the harlot. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Wherein have you⌃ been rioting? and against whom have you⌃ opened your mouth, and against whom have you⌃ loosed your tongue? are you⌃ not children of perdition? a lawless seed? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} who call upon idols under the leafy trees, slaying your children in the valleys among the rocks? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} That is your portion, this is your lot: and to them have you poured forth drink-offerings, and to these have you offered meat-offerings. Shall I not therefore be angry for these things? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} On a lofty and high mountain, there is your bed, and there you carried up your meat-offerings: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} and behind the posts of your door you did place your memorials. Did you think that if you should depart from me, you would gain? you have loved those that lay with you; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} and you have multiplied your whoredom with them, and you have increased the number of them that are far from you, and have sent ambassadors beyond your borders, and have been debased even to hell. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} You have wearied yourself with your many ways; yet you said not, I will cease to strengthen myself: for you have done these things; therefore you have not supplicated me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Through dread of whom have you feared, and lied against me, and has not remembered, nor considered me, nor regarded me, yes, though when I see you I pass you by, yet you have not feared me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And I will declare your righteousness, and your sins, which shall not profit you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} When you cry out, let them deliver you in your affliction: for all these the wind shall take, and the tempest shall carry [them] away: but they that cleave to me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And they shall say, Clear the ways before him, and take up the stumbling blocks out of the way of my people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Thus says the Most High, who dwells on high for ever, Holy in the holies, is his name, the Most High resting in the holies, and giving patience to the faint-hearted, and giving life to the broken-hearted: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} I will not take vengeance on you for ever, neither will I be always angry with you: for my Spirit shall go forth from me, and I have created all breath. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} On account of sin for a little while I grieved him, and struck him, and turned away my face from him; and he was grieved, and he went on sorrowful in his ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} I have seen his ways, and healed him, and comforted him, and given him true comfort; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} peace upon peace to them that are far off, and to them that are near: and the Lord has said, I will heal them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But the unrighteous shall be tossed as troubled waves, and shall not be able to rest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} There is no joy to the ungodly, said God.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} righteous, no man, ; merciful men Heb. men of kindness, or godliness; the righteous; the evil to come or, that which is evil \textsuperscript{2} He shall; enter into or, go in, rest; in his uprightness or before him \textsuperscript{4} Against, ; sport; make draw; are ye \textsuperscript{5} Enflaming; with idols or, among the oaks, under; , ; slaying \textsuperscript{6} the smooth; to them;, Should \textsuperscript{8} the doors, for made thee a covenant with them or, hewed it for thyself larger than theirs thou lovedst, where thou sawest it or, thou providest room \textsuperscript{9} thou wentest to the king or, thou respectedst the king, ; perfumes and didst debase \textsuperscript{10} wearied; There is; life or, living therefore \textsuperscript{11} of whom; that thou; and hast, nor have not \textsuperscript{13} let; but the; but he;, ; my holy \textsuperscript{15} the high;, that inhabiteth; whose; , I dwell;, ; with; to revive the spirit \textsuperscript{16} I will not, ; the souls \textsuperscript{17} the iniquity; I hid, and he; frowardly Heb. turning away in the \textsuperscript{18} have, ; will heal, ; will lead; restore, ; to his \textsuperscript{19} I create "The sacrifice of praise, " says St. Paul, "is the fruit of the lips." God creates this fruit of the lips, by giving new subject and cause of thanksgiving by His mercies conferred on His people. The great subject of thanksgiving is peace, reconciliation and pardon offered to them that are nigh, and to them that are afar off; not only to the Jew, but also to the Gentile. the fruit; Peace\par}
