\subsection*{Esaias 58}
\markright{ESAIAS 58}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Cry aloud, and spare not; lift up your voice as with a trumpet, and declare to my people their sins, and to the house of Jacob their iniquities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} They seek me day by day, and desire to know my ways, as a people that had done righteousness, and had not forsaken the judgment of their God: they now ask of me righteous judgment, and desire to draw near to God, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} saying, Why have we fasted, and you regard not? [why] have we afflicted our souls, and you did not know it? Nay, in the days of your fasts you⌃ find your pleasures, and all them that are under your power you⌃ wound. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} If you⌃ fast for quarrels and strifes, and strike the lowly with [your] fists, therefore do you⌃ fast to me as [you⌃ do] this day, so that your voice may be heard in crying? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} I have not chosen this fast, nor [such] a day for a man to afflict his soul; neither though you should bend down your neck as a ring, and spread under you sackcloth and ashes, neither thus shall you⌃ call a fast acceptable. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} I have not chosen such a fast, says the Lord; but do you loose every burden of iniquity, do you untie the knots of hard bargains, set the bruised free, and cancel every unjust account. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Break your bread to the hungry, and lead the unsheltered poor to your house: if you see one naked, clothe [him], and you shall not disregard the relations of your own seed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Then shall your light break forth as the morning, and your health shall speedily spring forth: and your righteousness shall go before you, and the glory of God shall compass you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Then shall you cry, and God shall listen to you; while you are yet speaking he will say, Behold, I am here. If you remove from you the band, and the stretching forth of the hands, and murmuring speech; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} and [if] you give bread to the hungry from your heart, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall your light spring up in darkness, and your darkness [shall be] as noon-day: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} and your God shall be with you continually, and you shall be satisfied according as your soul desires; and your bones shall be made fat, and shall be as a well-watered garden, and as a fountain [from] which the water has not failed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And your old waste desert [places] shall be built up, and your foundations shall last through all generations; and you shall be called a repairer of breaches, and you shall cause your paths between to be in peace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} If you turn away your foot from the sabbath, so as not to do your pleasure on the holy days, and shall call the sabbaths delightful, holy to God; [if] you shall not lift up your foot to work, nor speak a word in anger out of your mouth, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} then shall you trust on the Lord; and he shall bring you up to the good places of the land, and feed you with the heritage of Jacob your father: for the mouth of the Lord has spoken this.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} aloud Heb. with the throat spare;, ;, ; lift up like \textsuperscript{3} have we fasted; afflicted, ; in; exact; labours or, things wherewith ye grieve others, Heb. griefs. \textsuperscript{4} ye fast; and to smite; shall not fast as ye do this day or, fast not as this day, to make. \textsuperscript{5} it such; a day for a man to afflict his soul or, to afflict his soul for a day; to spread; an acceptable \textsuperscript{6} to loose; heavy burdens Heb. bundles of the yoke oppressed Heb. broken. ye break. \textsuperscript{7} to deal; bring; cast out or, afflicted the naked; thine own \textsuperscript{8} thy light; and thine; and thy;, the glory; be thy rereward Heb. gather thee up \textsuperscript{9} shalt thou, ;, ; Here; the yoke the putting; speaking \textsuperscript{10} thou draw; thy soul Instead of naphshecha "thy soul, " eleven manuscripts read lachmecha "thy bread, " which is adopted by Bp. Lowth; but "to draw out the soul" in relieving the poor, probably means to do it not of constraint, but cheerfully. then \textsuperscript{11} the Lord;, ; and satisfy; drought Heb. droughts make fat;, be like; fail Heb. lie, or deceive \textsuperscript{14} delight, ; to ride; and feed; the mouth\par}

\subsection*{Esaias 59}
\markright{ESAIAS 59}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Has the hand of the Lord no power to save? or has he made his ear heavy, so that he should not hear? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Nay, your iniquities separate between you and God, and because of your sins has he turned away [his] face from you, so as not to have mercy [upon you]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with sins; your lips also have spoken iniquity, and your tongue meditates unrighteousness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} None speaks justly, neither is there true judgment: they trust in vanities, and speak empty [words]; for they conceive trouble, and bring forth iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} They have hatched asps' eggs, and weave a spider's web: and he that is going to eat of their eggs, having crushed an addled egg, has found also in it a basilisk. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Their web shall not become a garment, nor shall they at all clothe themselves with their works; for their works are works of iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And their feet run to wickedness, swift to shed blood; their thoughts also are thoughts of murder; destruction and misery are in their ways; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} and the way of peace they know not, neither is there judgment in their ways; for their paths by which they go are crooked, and they know not peace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Therefore has judgment departed from them, and righteousness shall not overtake them: while they waited for light, darkness came upon them; while they waited for brightness, they walked in perplexity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} They shall feel for the wall as blind [men], and shall feel [for it] as if they had no eyes: and they shall feel at noon-day as at midnight; they shall groan as dying men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} They shall proceed together as a bear and as a dove: we have waited for judgment, and there is no salvation, it is gone far from us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For our iniquity is great before you, and our sins have risen up against us: for our iniquities are in us, and we know our unrighteous deeds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} We have sinned, and dealt falsely, and revolted from our God: we have spoken unrighteous words, and have been disobedient; we have conceived and uttered from our heart unrighteous words. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And we have turned judgment back, and righteousness has departed afar off: for truth is consumed in their ways, and they could not pass by a straight [path]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And truth has been taken away, and they have turned aside [their] mind from understanding. And the Lord saw it, and it pleased him not that there was no judgment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And he looked, and there was no man, and he observed, and there was none to help: so he defended them with his arm, and established [them] with [his] mercy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And he put on righteousness as a breast-plate, and placed the helmet of salvation on his head; and he clothed himself with the garment of vengeance, and with his cloak, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} as one about to render a recompence, [even] reproach to his adversaries. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} So shall they of the west fear the name of the Lord, and they [that come] from the rising of the sun his glorious name: for the wrath of the Lord shall come as a mighty river, it shall come with fury. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And the deliverer shall come for Sion's sake, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And this shall be my covenant with them, said the Lord; My Spirit which is upon you, and the words which I have put in your mouth, shall never fail from your mouth, nor from the mouth of your seed, for the Lord has spoken it, henceforth and for ever.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} the Lord's; that it cannot save; his ear \textsuperscript{2} your iniquities; hid or, made him hide \textsuperscript{4} calleth; trust; and speak; they conceive \textsuperscript{5} cockatrice' or, adder's; *marg. crushed breaketh out into a viper or, sprinkled is as if there brake out a viper \textsuperscript{7} feet; and they; their thoughts; wasting; destruction Heb. breaking \textsuperscript{8} way; no; judgment or, right, crooked; whosoever \textsuperscript{12} our transgressions;, ;, ; our sins; we know \textsuperscript{15} truth; he that; maketh himself a prey or, is accounted mad; displeased him Heb. was evil in his eyes; *marg. \textsuperscript{17} he put on righteousness; the garments; with zeal \textsuperscript{18} According; deeds Heb. recompences fury \textsuperscript{19} shall they, ; When This all the Rabbins refer to the coming of the Messiah. If, say they, ye see a generation which endured much tribulation, then expect Him, according to what is written, "When the enemy shall come in like a flood, " etc. the enemy, the Spirit; lift up a standard against him or, put him to flight \textsuperscript{21} this; My spirit;, ; my words\par}

\subsection*{Esaias 60}
\markright{ESAIAS 60}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Be enlightened, be enlightened, O Jerusalem, for your light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Behold, darkness shall cover the earth, and [there shall be] gross darkness on the nations: but the Lord shall appear upon you, and his glory shall be seen upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And kings shall walk in your light, and nations in your brightness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Lift up your eyes round about, and behold your children gathered: all your sons have come from far, and your daughters shall be borne on [men's] shoulders. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Then shall you see, and fear, and be amazed in your heart; for the wealth of the sea shall come round to you, and of nations and peoples; and herds of camels shall come to you, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} and the camels of Madiam and Gaepha shall cover you: all from Saba shall come bearing gold, and shall bring frankincense, and they shall publish the salvation of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And all the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered, and the rams of Nabaeoth shall come; and acceptable sacrifices shall be offered on my altar, and my house of prayer shall be glorified. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Who are these [that] fly as clouds, and as doves with young ones to me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The isles have waited for me, and the ships of Tharsis among the first, to bring your children from afar, and their silver and their gold with them, and [that] for the sake of the holy name of the Lord, and because the Holy One of Israel is glorified. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And strangers shall build your walls, and their kings shall wait upon you: for by reason of my wrath I struck you, and by reason of mercy I loved you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And your gates shall be opened continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; to bring in to you the power of the Gentiles, and their kings as captives. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For the nations and the kings which will not serve you shall perish; and those nations shall be made utterly desolate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And the glory of Libanus shall come to you, with the cypress, and pine, and cedar together, to glorify my holy place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And the sons of them that afflicted you, and of them that provoked you, shall come to you in fear; and you shall be called Sion, the city of the Holy One of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Because you have become desolate and hated, and there was no helper, therefore I will make you a perpetual gladness, a joy of many generations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And you shall suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shall eat the wealth of kings: and shall know that I am the Lord that saves you and delivers you, the Holy One of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And for brass I will bring you gold, and for iron I will bring you silver, and instead of wood I will bring you brass, and instead of stones, iron; and I will make your princes peaceful, and your overseers righteous. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And injustice shall no more be heard in your land, nor destruction nor misery in your coasts; but your walls shall be called Salvation, and your gates Sculptured Work. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And you shall no more have the sun for a light by day, nor shall the rising of the moon lighten your night; but the Lord shall be your everlasting light, and God your glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} For the sun shall no more set, nor shall the moon be eclipsed; for the Lord shall be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning shall be completed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Your people also shall be all righteous; they shall inherit the land for ever, preserving that which they have planted, [even] the works of their hands, for glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} The little one shall become thousands, and the least a great nation; I the Lord will gather them in [due] time.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} Arise; shine; for thy light is come or, be enlightened, for thy light cometh, ; , ; the glory \textsuperscript{5} thou shalt see; be enlarged; abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee or, noise of the sea shall be turned towards thee; forces or, wealth \textsuperscript{6} multitude; Midian, all; bring; they shall show \textsuperscript{7} the flocks; they shall; I will \textsuperscript{8} fly; a cloud as the \textsuperscript{9} the isles, ; the ships; thy sons; unto; because \textsuperscript{10} the sons; their kings; in my wrath \textsuperscript{11} Therefore The subject of this chapter, says Bp. Lowth, is the great increase and flourishing state of the church of God, by the conversion and accession of the heathen nations to it; which is set forth in such ample and exalted terms, as plainly shew that the full completion of this prophecy is reserved for future times. This subject is displayed in the most splendid colours, under a great variety of images highly poetical, designed to give a general idea of the glories of that perfect state of the church of God, which we are taught to expect in the latter times; when the fulness of the Gentiles shall come in, and the Jews shall be converted and gathered from their dispersions, and "the kingdom of this world shall become the kingdom of our Lord and of His Christ." thy gates; forces or, wealth, *marg. \textsuperscript{13} The glory That is, the cedar; and as the choice timber of Lebanon beautified Solomon's temple, that footstool of Jehovah; so shall the peculiar advantages of every nation, and of every description of men, concur to beautify the church of Christ, which He has determined to make glorious. The language then becomes more energetic, and the images employed more grand and magnificent; and nothing can answer to the glorious description but some future exalted state of the church on earth, or the church triumphant in heaven; though several expressions seem to limit it to the church below., ; to beautify the place \textsuperscript{16} suck the milk, thou shalt know \textsuperscript{21} people, ; inherit; the branch, ; that I\par}

\subsection*{Esaias 61}
\markright{ESAIAS 61}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The Spirit of the Lord is upon me, because he has anointed me; he has sent me to preach glad tidings to the poor, to heal the broken in heart, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and recovery of sight to the blind; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} to declare the acceptable year of the Lord, and the day of recompence; to comfort all that mourn; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} that there should be given to them that mourn in Sion glory instead of ashes, the oil of joy to the mourners, the garment of glory for the spirit of heaviness: and they shall be called generations of righteousness, the planting of the Lord for glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And they shall build the old waste places, they shall raise up those that were before made desolate, and shall renew the desert cities, [even] those that had been desolate for [many] generations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And strangers shall come and feed your flocks, and aliens [shall be your] plowmen and vine-dressers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} But you⌃ shall be called priests of the Lord, the ministers of God: you⌃ shall eat the strength of nations, and shall be admired because of their wealth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Thus shall they inherit the land a second time, and everlasting joy shall be upon their head. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For I am the Lord who love righteousness, and hate robberies of injustice; and I will give their labor to the just, and will make an everlasting covenant with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring in the midst of peoples: every one that sees them shall take notice of them, that they are a seed blessed of God; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} and they shall greatly rejoice in the Lord. Let my soul rejoice in the Lord; for he has clothed me with the robe of salvation, and the garment of joy: he has put a mitre on me as on a bridegroom, and adorned me with ornaments as a bride. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And as the earth putting forth her flowers, and as a garden its seed; so shall the Lord, [even] the Lord, cause righteousness to spring forth, and exultation before all nations.\par

\subsection*{Esaias 62}
\markright{ESAIAS 62}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} For Sion's sake I will not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem's sake I will not rest, until her righteousness go forth as light, and my salvation burn as a torch. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And the Gentiles shall see your righteousness, and kings your glory: and one shall call you [by] a new name, which the Lord shall name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And you shall be a crown of beauty in the hand of the Lord, and a royal diadem in the hand of your God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And you shall no more be called Forsaken; and your land shall no more be called Desert: for you shall be called My Pleasure, and your land Inhabited: for the Lord has taken pleasure in you, and your land shall be inhabited. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And as a young man lives with a virgin, so shall your sons dwell in [you]: and it shall come to pass [that] as a bridegroom will rejoice over a bride, so will the Lord rejoice over you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And on your walls, O Jerusalem, have I set watchmen all day and all night, who shall never cease making mention of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For there is none like you, when he shall have established, and made Jerusalem a praise on the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For the Lord has sworn by his glory, and by the might of his arm, I will no more give your corn and your provisions to your enemies; nor shall strangers any more drink your wine, for which you have laboured. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} But they that have gathered them shall eat them, and they shall praise the Lord; and they that have gathered [the grapes] shall drink thereof in my holy courts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Go through my gates, and make a way for my people; and cast the stones out of the way; lift up a standard for the Gentiles. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For behold, the Lord has proclaimed to the end of the earth, say you⌃ to the daughter of Sion, Behold, your Saviour has come to you, having his reward and his work before his face. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And one shall call them the holy people, the redeemed of the Lord: and you shall be called a city sought out, and not forsaken.\par

\subsection*{Esaias 63}
\markright{ESAIAS 63}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Who is this that is come from Edom, [with] red garments from Bosor? thus fair in his apparel, with mighty strength? I speak of righteousness and saving judgment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Therefore are your garments red, and your raiment as [if fresh] from a trodden winepress? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} I am full of trodden [grape], and of the nations there is not a man with me; and I trampled them in my fury, and dashed them to pieces as earth, and brought down their blood to the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For the day of recompence has come upon them, and the year of redemption is at hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And I looked, and there was no helper; and I observed, and none upheld: therefore my arm delivered them, and my anger drew near. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And I trampled them in my anger, and brought down their blood to the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} I remembered the mercy of the Lord, the praises of the Lord in all things wherein he recompenses us. The Lord is a good judge to the house of Israel; he deals with us according to his mercy, and according to the abundance of his righteousness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And he said, Is it not my people? the children surely will not be rebellious: and he became to them deliverance {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} out of all their affliction: not an ambassador, nor a messenger, but himself saved them, because he loved them and spared them: he himself redeemed them, and took them up, and lifted them up all the days of old. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} But they disobeyed, and provoked his Holy Spirit: so he turned to be an enemy, he himself contended against them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Then he remembered the ancient days, [saying], Where is he that brought up from the sea the shepherd of the sheep? where is he that put his Holy Spirit in them? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} who led Moses with his right hand, the arm of his glory? he forced the water [to separate] from before him, to make himself an everlasting name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} He led them through the deep, as a horse through the wilderness, and they fainted not, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} and as cattle through a plain: the Spirit came down from the Lord, and guided them: thus you led your people, to make yourself a glorious name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Turn from heaven, and look from your holy habitation and [from] your glory: where is your zeal and your strength? where is the abundance of your mercy and of your compassions, that you have withholden yourself from us? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} For you are our Father; for [though] Abraham knew us not, and Israel did not acknowledge us, yet do you, O Lord, our Father, deliver us: your name has been upon us from the beginning. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Why have you caused us to err, O Lord, from your way? [and] has hardened our hearts, that we should not fear you? Return for your servants' sake, for the sake of the tribes of your inheritance, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} that we may inherit a small part of your holy mountain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} We are become as at the beginning, when you did not rule over us, and your name was not called upon us.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} is this; from Edom; dyed; Bozrah glorious Heb. decked travelling; speak; mighty \textsuperscript{3} trodden; and of the people The very remarkable contained in the first six verses of this chapter seems in a manner detached from the rest, and to stand by itself; containing a prophetical representation of the victories of the Messiah over the enemies of his church, here designated by the names of Edom and Bozrah. Though, as Bp. Lowth observes, this prophecy must have its accomplishment, there is no necessity for supposing that it has been already accomplished. There are prophecies which intimate a great slaughter of the enemies of God and his people, which remain to be fulfilled. Those in, and are called Gog and Magog. This prophecy of Isaiah may possibly refer to the same, or the like event. and trample \textsuperscript{5} looked, ; mine own, ; my fury \textsuperscript{7} mention;, ;, ; the great goodness; according to his \textsuperscript{9} all their; the angel; , ; in his; carried \textsuperscript{10} they rebelled; , vexed, ; he was \textsuperscript{11} he remembered;, ; Where is he that brought; shepherd or, shepherds, where is he that put \textsuperscript{15} down; the habitation; where; sounding or, multitude thy bowels; *marg.; *marg.; Are \textsuperscript{16} thou art; though; redeemer; thy name is from everlasting or, Redeemer from everlasting is thy name \textsuperscript{19} are thine; they were not called by thy name or, thy name was not called upon them\par}

\subsection*{Esaias 64}
\markright{ESAIAS 64}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} If you would open the heaven, trembling will take hold upon the mountains from you, and they shall melt, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} as wax melts before the fire; and fire shall burn up the enemies, and your name shall be manifest among the adversaries: at your presence the nations shall be troubled, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} whenever you shall work gloriously; trembling from you shall take hold upon the mountains. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} From of old we have not heard, neither have our eyes seen a God beside you, and your works which you will perform to them that wait for mercy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For [these blessings] shall happen to them that work righteousness, and they shall remember your ways: behold, you were angry and we have sinned; therefore we have erred, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} and we are all become as unclean, and all our righteousness as a filthy rag: and we have fallen as leaves because of our iniquities; thus the wind shall carry us [away]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And there is none that calls upon your name, or that remembers to take hold on you: for you have turned your face away from us, and have delivered us up because of our sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And now, O Lord, you are our Father, and we are clay, all [of us] the work of your hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Be not very angry with us, and remember not our sins for ever; but now look on [us], for we are all your people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} The city of your holiness has become desolate, Sion has become as a wilderness, Jerusalem a curse. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} The house, our sanctuary, and the glory which our fathers blessed, has been burnt with fire: and all our glorious things have gone to ruin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And for all these things you, O Lord, has withholden, yourself, and been silent, and have brought us very low.\par

\subsection*{Esaias 65}
\markright{ESAIAS 65}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} I became manifest to them that asked not for me; I was found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold, I am [here], to a nation, who called not on my name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} I have stretched forth my hands all day to a disobedient and gainsaying people, to them that walked in a way that was not good, but after their sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} This is the people that provokes me continually in my presence; they offer sacrifices in gardens, and burn incense on bricks to devils, which exist not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} They lie down to sleep in the tombs and in the caves for the sake of dreams, [even] they that eat swine's flesh, and the broth of [their] sacrifices: all their vessels are defiled: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} who say, Depart from me, draw not near to me, for I am pure. This is the smoke of my wrath, a fire burns with it continually. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Behold, it is written before me: I will not be silent until I have recompensed into their bosom, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} their sins and [the sins] of their fathers, says the Lord, who have burnt incense on the mountains, and reproached me on the hills: I will recompense their works into their bosom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Thus says the Lord, As a grape-stone shall be found in the cluster, and they shall say, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for the sake of him that serves me, for his sake I will not destroy [them] all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And I will lead forth the seed [that came] of Jacob and of Juda, and they shall inherit my holy mountain: and my elect and my servants shall inherit it, and shall dwell there. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And there shall be in the forest folds of flocks, and the valley of Achor [shall] be for a resting-place of herds for my people, who have sought me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} But you⌃ are they that have left me, and forget my holy mountain, and prepare a table for the devil, and fill up the drink-offering to Fortune. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} I will deliver you up to the sword, you⌃ shall all fall by slaughter: for I called you, and you⌃ listened not; I spoke, and you⌃ refused to hear; and you⌃ did evil in my sight, and chose the things wherein I delighted not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Therefore thus says the Lord, Behold, my servants shall eat, but you⌃ shall hunger: behold, my servants shall drink, but you⌃ shall thirst: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but you⌃ shall be ashamed: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} behold, my servants shall exult with joy, but you⌃ shall cry for the sorrow of your heart, and shall howl for the vexation of your spirit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For you⌃ shall leave your name for a loathing to my chosen, and the Lord shall destroy you: but my servants shall be called by a new name, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} which shall be blessed on the earth; for they shall bless the true God: and they that swear upon the earth shall swear by the true God; for they shall forget the former affliction, it shall not come into their mind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For there shall be a new heaven and a new earth: and they shall not at all remember the former, neither shall they at all come into their mind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} But they shall find in her joy and exultation; for, behold, I make Jerusalem a rejoicing, and my people a joy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and will be glad in my people: and there shall no more be heard in her the voice of weeping, or the voice of crying. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Neither shall there be there any more a [child that dies] untimely, or an old man who shall not complete his time: for the youth shall be one hundred years [old], and the sinner who dies at one hundred years shall also be accursed: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} and they shall build houses, and themselves shall dwell in [them]; and they shall plant vineyards, and themselves shall eat the fruit thereof. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} They shall by no means build, and others inhabit; and they shall by no means plant, and others eat: for as the days of the tree of life shall be the days of my people, they shall long enjoy the fruits of their labors. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} My chosen shall not toil in vain, neither shall they beget children to be cursed; for they are a seed blessed of God, and their offspring with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And it shall come to pass, [that] before they call, I will listen to them; while they are yet speaking, I will say, What is it? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Then wolves and lambs shall feed together, and the lion shall eat chaff like the ox, and the serpent earth as bread. They shall not injure nor destroy in my holy mountain, says the Lord.\par

\subsection*{Esaias 66}
\markright{ESAIAS 66}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Thus says the Lord, Heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: what kind of a house will you⌃ build me? and of what kind [is to be] the place of my rest? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} For all these things are mine, says the Lord: and to whom will I have respect, but to the humble and meek, and the [man] that trembles [at] my words? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} But the transgressor that sacrifices a calf to me, is as he that kills a dog; and he that offers fine flour, as [one that offers] swine's blood; he that gives frankincense for a memorial, is as a blasphemer. Yet they have chosen their own ways, and their soul has delighted in their abominations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I also will choose their mockeries, and will recompense their sins upon them; because I called them, and they did not listen to me; I spoke, and they heard not: and they did evil before me, and chose the things wherein I delighted not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Hear the words of the Lord, you⌃ that tremble at his word; speak you⌃, our brethren, to them that hate you and abominate you, that the name of the Lord may be glorified, and may appear their joy; but they shall be ashamed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} A voice of a cry from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the Lord rendering recompence to [his] adversaries. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Before she that travailed brought forth, before the travail-pain came on, she escaped [it] and brought forth a male. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Who has heard such a thing? and who has seen after this manner? Has the earth travailed in one day? or has even a nation been born at once, that Sion has travailed, and brought forth her children? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} But I have raised this expectation, yet you have not remembered me, says the Lord: behold, have not I made the bearing and barren woman? says your God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Rejoice, O Jerusalem, and all you⌃ that love her hold in her a general assembly: rejoice greatly with her, all that [now] mourn over her: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} that you⌃ may suck, and be satisfied with the breast of her consolation; that you⌃ may milk out, and delight yourselves with the influx of her glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For thus says the Lord, Behold, I turn toward them as a river of peace, and as a torrent bringing upon them in a flood the glory of the Gentiles: their children shall be borne upon the shoulders, and comforted on the knees. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} As if his mother should comfort one, so will I also comfort you; and you⌃ shall be comforted in Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And you⌃ shall see, and your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall thrive like grass: and the hand of the Lord shall be known to them that fear him, and he shall threaten the disobedient. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For, behold, the Lord will come as fire, and his chariots as a storm, to render his vengeance with wrath, and his rebuke with a flame of fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} For with the fire of the Lord all the earth shall be judged, and all flesh with his sword: many shall be slain by the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} They that sanctify themselves and purify themselves in the gardens, and eat swine's flesh in the porches, and the abominations, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And I [know] their works and their imagination. I am going to gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And I will leave a sign upon them, and I will send forth them that have escaped of them to the nations, to Tharsis, and Phud, and Lud, and Mosoch, and to Thobel, and to Greece, and to the isles afar off, to those who have not heard my name, nor seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And they shall bring your brethren out of all nations for a gift to the Lord with horses, and chariots, in litters [drawn by] mules with awnings, to the holy city Jerusalem, said the Lord, as though the children of Israel should bring their sacrifices to me with psalms into the house of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And I will take of them priests and Levites, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} For as the new heaven and the new earth, which I make, remain before me, says the Lord, so shall your seed and your name continue. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And it shall come to pass from month to month, and from sabbath to sabbath, [that] all flesh shall come to worship before me in Jerusalem, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And they shall go forth, and see the carcasses of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, and their fire shall not be quenched; and they shall be a spectacle to all flesh.\par

\section*{Jeremiah Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} Jeremiah with Baruch as scribal associate\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} The book itself presents Jeremiah's prophetic ministry and Baruch's scribal role; conservative scholarship receives Jeremiah as the prophet behind the book.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} Matthew 2:17; Hebrews 8:8 and other NT texts receive Jeremiah as the speaking prophet.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} late 7th to early 6th century BC\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} MT chronology follows Jeremiah's ministry from Josiah through Jerusalem's fall and aftermath.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} The LXX of Jeremiah is substantially shorter and differently ordered than the MT, making it one of the most important textual comparison books in Scripture.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Judah's final decades before exile, with prophecies of judgment, exile, and new covenant hope.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To proclaim covenant judgment on Judah and the nations while promising restoration and the new covenant.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} judgment; exile; new covenant; false prophecy; restoration; nations\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Call and early oracles 1-25; Narrative and conflict 26-45; Oracles against the nations 46-51; Fall of Jerusalem 52.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. 4Q Jeremiah manuscripts, some aligning more with the LXX form 3rd-2nd centuries BC | Subst. Qumran Jeremiah manuscripts provide crucial evidence for both longer and shorter textual forms 3rd-1st centuries BC | Heb. Leningrad Codex AD 1008 | Gk. Codex Vaticanus and Alexandrinus preserve Greek Jeremiah 4th-5th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Use in later Jewish writing and heavily in the NT by Multiple (pre-Christian and 1st century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} Jeremiah is a flagship example of MT/LXX textual divergence, with major differences in order and extent and important Qumran support for shorter forms.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives Jeremiah as the true prophet of the book and treats textual plurality in transmission as a preservation issue, not as a denial of inspired prophetic authorship.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\subsection*{Jeremias 1}
\markright{JEREMIAS 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The word of God which came to Jeremias the [son] of Chelcias, of the priests, who lived in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} [accordingly] as the word of God came to him in the days of Josias son of Amos king of Juda, in the thirteenth year of his reign. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And it was in the days of Joakim, son of Josias king of Juda, until the eleventh year of Sedekias king of Juda, [even] until the captivity of Jerusalem in the fifth month. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And the word of the Lord came to him, [saying], {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Before I formed you in the belly, I knew you; and before you came forth from the womb, I sanctified you; I appointed you a prophet to the nations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And I said, O Lord, you that are supreme Lord, behold, I know not [how] to speak, for I am a child. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the Lord said to me, Say not, I am a child: for you shall go to all to whoever I shall send you, and according to all [the words] that I shall command you, you shall speak. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Be not afraid before them: for I am with you to deliver you, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And the Lord stretched forth his hand to me, and touched my mouth: and the Lord said to me, Behold, I have put my words into your mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Behold, I have appointed you this day over nations and over kingdoms, to root out, and to pull down, and to destroy, and to rebuild, and to plant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, What see you? And I said, A rod of an almond tree. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And the Lord said to me, You have well seen: for I have watched over my words to perform them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And the word of the Lord came to me a second time, saying, What see you? And I said, A caldron on the fire; and the face of it is toward the north. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And the Lord said to me, From the north shall flame forth evils upon all the inhabitants of the land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For, behold, I call together all the kingdoms of the earth from the north, says the Lord; and they shall come, and shall set each one his throne at the entrance of the gates of Jerusalem, and against all the walls round about her, and against all the cities of Juda. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And I will speak to them in judgment, concerning all their iniquity, [forasmuch] as they have forsaken me, and sacrificed to strange gods, and worshipped the works of their own hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And do you gird up your loins, and stand up, and speak all [the words] that I shall command you: be not afraid of their face, neither be you alarmed before them; for I am with you to deliver you, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Behold, I have made you this day as a strong city, and as a brazen wall, strong [against] all the kings of Juda, and the princes thereof, and the people of the land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And they shall fight against you; but they shall by no means prevail against you; because I am with you, to deliver you, says the Lord.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 2}
\markright{JEREMIAS 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And he said, Thus says the Lord, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} I remember the kindness of your youth, and the love of your espousals, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} in following the Holy One of Israel, says the Lord, Israel was the holy [people] to the Lord, [and] the first fruits of his increase: all that devoured him shall offend; evils shall come upon them, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Hear the word of the Lord, O house of Jacob, and every family of the house of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Thus says the Lord, What trespass have your fathers found in me, that they have revolted far from me, and gone after vanities, and become vain? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And they said not, Where is the Lord, who brought us up out of the land of Egypt, who guided us in the wilderness, in an untried and trackless land, in a land which no man at all went through, and no man lived there? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I brought you to Carmel, that you⌃ should eat the fruits thereof, and the good thereof; and you⌃ went in, and defiled my land, and made my heritage an abomination. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} The priests said not, Where is the Lord? and they that held by the law knew me not: the shepherds also sinned against me, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, and went after that which profited not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Therefore I will yet plead with you, and will plead with your children's children. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For go to the isles of the Chettians, and see; and send to Kedar, and observe accurately, and see if such things have been done; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} if the nations will change their gods, though they are not gods: but my people have changed their glory, [for that] from which they shall not be profited. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} The heaven is amazed at this, and is very exceedingly horror-struck, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} For my people has committed two [faults], and evil ones: they have forsaken me, the fountain of water of life, and hewn out for themselves broken cisterns, which will not be able to hold water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Is Israel a servant, or a home-born slave? why has he become a spoil? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} The lions roared upon him, and uttered their voice, which have made his land a wilderness: and his cities are broken down, that they should not be inhabited. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Also the children of Memphis and Taphnas have known you, and mocked you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Has not your forsaking me brought these things upon you? says the Lord your God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And now what have you to do with the way of Egypt, to drink the water of Geon? and what have you to do with the way of the Assyrians, to drink the water of rivers? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Your apostasy shall correct you, and your wickedness shall reprove you: know then, and see, that your forsaking me [has been] bitter to you, says the Lord your God; and I have taken no pleasure in you, says the Lord your God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} For of old you have broken your yoke, and plucked asunder your bands; and you have said, I will not serve you, but will go upon every high hill, and under every shady tree, there will I indulge in my fornication. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Yet I planted you a fruitful vine, entirely of the right sort: how are you a strange vine turned to bitterness! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Though you should wash yourself with nitre, and multiply to yourself soap, [still] you are stained by your iniquities before me, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} How will you say, I am not polluted, and have not gone after Baal? behold your ways in the burial-ground, and know what you have done: her voice has howled in the evening: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} she has extended her ways over the waters of the desert; she was hurried along by the lusts of her soul; she is given up [to them], who will turn her back? none that seek her shall be weary; at [the time of] her humiliation they shall find her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Withdraw your foot from a rough way, and your throat from thirst: but she said I will strengthen myself: for she loved strangers, and went after them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} As is the shame of a thief when he is caught, so shall the children of Israel be ashamed; they, and their kings, and their princes, and their priests, and their prophets. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} They said to a stock, You are my father; and to a stone, You have begotten me: and they have turned [their] backs to me, and not their faces: yet in the time of their afflictions they will say, Arise, and save us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And where are your gods, which you made for yourself? will they arise and save in the time of your affliction? for according to the number of your cities were your gods, O Juda; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem they sacrificed to Baal. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Therefore do you⌃ speak to me? you⌃ all have been ungodly, and you⌃ all have transgressed against me, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} In vain have I struck your children; you⌃ have not received correction: a sword has devoured your prophets as a destroying lion; yet you⌃ feared not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Hear you⌃ the word of the Lord: thus says the Lord, Have I been a wilderness or a dry land to Israel? therefore has my people said, We will not be ruled over, and will not come to you any more? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Will a bride forget her ornaments, or a virgin her girdle? but my people has forgotten me days without number. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} What fair device will you yet employ in your ways, so as to seek love? [it shall] not [be] so; moreover you have done wickedly in corrupting your ways; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} and in your hands has been found the blood of innocent souls; I have not found them in holes, but on every oak. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Yet you said, I am innocent: only let his wrath be turned away from me. Behold, I [will] plead with you, whereas you say, I have not sinned. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} For you have been so exceedingly contemptuous as to repeat your ways; but you shall be ashamed of Egypt, as you were ashamed of Assur. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} For you shall go forth thence also with your hands upon your head; for the Lord has rejected your hope, and you shall not prosper in it.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 3}
\markright{JEREMIAS 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} If a man put away his wife, and she depart from him, and become another man's, shall she return to him any more at all? shall not that woman be utterly defiled? Yet you⌃ have gone a-whoring with many shepherds, and have returned to me, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Lift up your eyes [to look] straight forward, and see where you have not been utterly defiled. You have sat for them by the wayside as a deserted crow, and have defiled the land with your fornications and your wickedness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And you did retain many shepherds for a stumbling block to yourself: you had a whore's face, you did become shameless toward all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Have you not called me as it were a home, and the father and guide of your virgin-time? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Will [God's anger] continue for ever, or be preserved to the end? Behold, you have spoken and done these bad things, and had power [to do them]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And the Lord said to me in the days of Josias the king, Have you seen what things the house of Israel has done to me? they have gone on every high mountain, and under every shady tree, and have committed fornication there. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I said after she had committed all these acts of fornication, Turn again to me. Yet she returned not. And faithless Juda saw her faithlessness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And I saw that (for all the sins of which she was convicted, wherein the house of Israel committed adultery, and I put her away, and gave into her hands a bill of divorcement,) yet faithless Juda feared not, but went and herself also committed fornication. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And her fornication was nothing accounted of; and she committed adultery with wood and stone. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And for all these things faithless Juda turned not to me with all her heart, but falsely. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And the Lord said to me, Israel has justified himself more than faithless Juda. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Go and read these words toward the north, and you shall say, Return to me, O house of Israel, says the Lord; and I will not set my face against you: for I am merciful, says the Lord, and I will not be angry with you for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Nevertheless, know your iniquity, that you have sinned against the Lord your God, and have scattered your ways to strangers under every shady tree, but you did not listen to my voice, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Turn, you⌃ children that have revolted, says the Lord; for I will rule over you: and I will take you one of a city, and two of a family, and I will bring you in to Sion: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} and I will give you shepherds after my heart, and they shall certainly tend you with knowledge. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And it shall come to pass that when you⌃ are multiplied and increased upon the land, says the Lord, in those days they shall say no more, The ark of the covenant of the Holy One of Israel: it shall not come to mind; it shall not be named; neither shall it be visited; nor shall [this] be done any more. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} In those days and at that time they shall call Jerusalem the throne of the Lord; and all the nations shall be gathered to it: and they shall not walk any more after the imaginations of their evil heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} In those days the house of Juda, shall come together to the house of Israel, and they shall come, together, from the land of the north, and from all the countries, to the land, which I caused their fathers to inherit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And I said, So be it, Lord, for [you said] I will set you among children, and will give you a choice land, the inheritance of the Almighty God of the Gentiles: and I said, You⌃ shall call me Father; and you⌃ shall not turn away from me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But as a wife acts treacherously against her husband, so has the house of Israel dealt treacherously against me, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} A voice from the lips was heard, [even] of weeping and supplication of the children of Israel: for they have dealt unrighteously in their ways, they have forgotten God their Holy One. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Turn, you⌃ children that are given to turning, and I will heal your bruises. Behold, we will be your servants; for you are the Lord our God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Truly the hills and the strength of the mountains were a lying refuge: but by the Lord our God is the salvation of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} But shame has consumed the labors of our fathers from our youth; their sheep and their calves, and their sons and their daughters. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} We have lain down in our shame, and our disgrace has covered us: because we and our fathers have sinned before our God, from our youth until this day; and we have not listened to the voice of the Lord our God.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 4}
\markright{JEREMIAS 4}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} If Israel will return to me, says the Lord, he shall return: and if he will remove his abominations out of his mouth, and fear before me, and swear, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The Lord lives, with truth, in judgment and righteousness, then shall nations bless by him, and by him they shall praise God in Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For thus says the Lord to the men of Juda, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Break up fresh ground for yourselves, and sow not among thorns. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Circumcise yourselves to your God, and circumcise your hardness of heart, you⌃ men of Juda, and inhabitants of Jerusalem: lest my wrath go forth as fire, and burn, and there be none to quench it, because of the evil of your devices. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Declare you⌃ in Juda, and let it be heard in Jerusalem: say you⌃, Sound the trumpet in the land; do you cry⌃ aloud: say you⌃, Gather yourselves together, and let us enter into the fortified cities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Gather up [your wares] and flee to Sion: hasten, stay not: for I will bring evils from the north, and great destruction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} The lion is gone up from his lair, he has roused [himself] to the destruction of the nations, and has gone forth out of his place, to make the land desolate; and the cities shall be destroyed, so as to be without inhabitant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For these things gird yourselves with sackcloth, and lament, and howl: for the anger of the Lord is not turned away from you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And it shall come to pass in that day, says the Lord, that the heart of the king shall perish, and the heart of the princes; and the priests shall be amazed, and the prophets shall wonder. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And I said, O sovereign Lord, verily you have deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, There shall be peace; whereas behold, the sword has reached even to their soul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} At that time they shall say to this people and to Jerusalem, [There is] a spirit of error in the wilderness: the way of the daughter of my people is not to purity, nor to holiness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} [But] a spirit of full vengeance shall come upon me; and now I declare my judgments against them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Behold, he shall come up as a cloud, and his chariots as a tempest: his horses are swifter than eagles. Woe to us! for we are in misery. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Cleanse your heart from wickedness, O Jerusalem, that you may be saved: how long will your grievous thoughts be within you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For a voice of one publishing from Dan shall come, and trouble out of mount Ephraim shall be heard of. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Remind you⌃ the nations; behold, they are come: proclaim [it] in Jerusalem, that bands are approaching from a land afar off, and have uttered their voice against the cities of Juda. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} As keepers of a field, they have surrounded her; because you, says the Lord, has neglected me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Your ways and your devices have brought these things upon you; this is your wickedness, for [it is] bitter, for it has reached to your heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} I am pained in my bowels, my bowels, and the sensitive powers of my heart; my soul is in great commotion, my heart is torn: I will not be silent, for my soul has heard the sound of a trumpet, the cry of war, and of distress: it calls on destruction; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} for all the land is distressed: suddenly [my] tabernacle is distressed, my curtains have been torn asunder. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} How long shall I see fugitives, and hear the sound of the trumpet? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} For the princes of my people have not known me, they are foolish and unwise children: they are wise to do evil, but [how] to do good they have not known. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} I looked upon the earth, and, behold, [it was] not; and to the sky, and there was no light in it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} I saw the mountains, and they trembled, and [I saw] all the hills in commotion. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} I looked, and behold, there was no man, and all the birds of the sky were scared. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} I saw, and, behold, Carmel was desert, and all the cities were burnt with fire at the presence of the Lord, and at the presence of his fierce anger they were utterly destroyed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Thus says the Lord, The whole land shall be desolate; but I will not make a full end. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} For these things let the earth mourn, and let the sky be dark above: for I have spoken, and I will not repent; I have purposed, and I will not turn back from it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} The whole land has recoiled from the noise of the horseman and the bent bow; they have gone into the caves, and have hidden themselves in the groves, and have gone up upon the rocks: every city was abandoned, no man lived in them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And what will you do? Though you clothe yourself with scarlet, and adorn yourself with golden ornaments; though you adorn your eyes with stibium, your beauty [will be] in vain: your lovers have rejected you, they seek your life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} For I have heard your groaning as the voice of a woman in travail, as of her that brings forth her first child; the voice of the daughter of Zion shall fail through weakness, and she shall lose the strength of her hands, [saying], Woe is me! for my soul faints because of the slain.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 5}
\markright{JEREMIAS 5}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Run you⌃ about in the streets of Jerusalem, and see, and know, and seek in her broad places, if you⌃ can find [one], if there is any one that does judgment, and seeks faithfulness; and I will pardon them, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The Lord lives, they say; do they not therefore swear falsely? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} O Lord, your eyes are upon faithfulness: you have scourged them, but they have not grieved; you have consumed them; but they would not receive correction: they have made their faces harder than a rock; and they would not return. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Then I said, It may be they are poor; for they are weak, for they know not the way of the Lord, or the judgment of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} I will go to the rich men, and will speak to them; for they have known the way of the Lord, and the judgment of God: but, behold, with one consent they have broken the yoke, they have burst the bonds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Therefore has a lion out of the forest struck them, and a wolf has destroyed them even to [their] houses, and a leopard has watched against their cities: all that go forth from them shall be hunted: for they have multiplied their ungodliness, they have strengthened themselves in their revoltings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} In what [way] shall I forgive you for these things? Your sons have forsaken me, and sworn by them that are no gods: and I fed them to the full, and they committed adultery, and lodged in harlots' houses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} They became as wanton horses: they neighed each one after his neighbor's wife. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Shall I not visit for these things? says the Lord: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Go up upon her battlements, and break [them] down; but make not a full end: leave her buttresses: for they are the Lord's. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For the house of Israel have indeed dealt treacherously against me, says the Lord: the house of Juda also {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} have lied to their Lord, and they have said, These things are not so; no evils shall come upon us; and we shall not see sword or famine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Our prophets became wind, and the word of the Lord was not in them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Therefore thus says the Lord Almighty, Because you⌃ have spoken this word, behold, I have made my words in your mouth fire, and this people wood, and it shall devour them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Behold, I [will] bring upon you a nation from far, O house of Israel, says the Lord; a nation the sound of whose language one shall not understand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} [They are] all mighty men: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} and they shall devour your harvest, and your bread; and shall devour your sons, and your daughters; and they shall devour your sheep, and your calves, and devour your vineyards, and your fig-plantations, and your olive yards: and they shall utterly destroy your strong cities, wherein you⌃ trusted, with the sword. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And it shall come to pass in those days, says the Lord your God, that I will not utterly destroy you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And it shall come to pass, when you⌃ shall say, Therefore has the Lord our God done all these things to us? that you shall say to them, Because you⌃ served strange gods in your land, so shall you⌃ serve strangers in a land that is not yours. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Proclaim these things to the house of Jacob, and let them be heard in the house of Juda. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Hear you⌃ now these things, O foolish and senseless people; who have eyes, and see not; and have ears, and hear not: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} will you⌃ not be afraid of me? says the Lord; and will you⌃ not fear before me, who have set the sand for a bound to the sea, [as] a perpetual ordinance, and it shall not pass it: yes, it shall rage, but not prevail; and its waves shall roar, but not pass over it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} But this people has a disobedient and rebellious heart; and they have turned aside and gone back: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} and they have not said in their heart, Let us fear now the Lord our God, who gives us the early and latter rain, according to the season of the fulfillment of the ordinance of harvest, and has preserved [it] for us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Your transgressions have turned away these things, and your sins have removed good things from you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} For among my people were found ungodly men; and they have set snares to destroy men, and have caught [them]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} As a snare which has been set is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: therefore have they grown great, and become rich: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} and they have transgressed [the rule of] judgment; they have not judged the cause of the orphan, nor have they judged the cause of the widow. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Shall I not visit for these things? says the Lord: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Shocking and horrible deeds have been done on the land; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} the prophets utter unrighteous prophecies, and the priests have clapped their hands: and my people has loved [to have it] thus: and what will you⌃ do for the future.\par
