\subsection*{Jeremias 6}
\markright{JEREMIAS 6}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Strengthen yourselves, you⌃ children of Benjamin, [to flee] out of the midst of Jerusalem, and sound an alarm with the trumpet in Thecue, and set up a signal over Baethacharma: for evil threatens from the north, and a great destruction is coming. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And [your] pride, O daughter of Sion, shall be taken away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} The shepherds and their flocks shall come to her; and they shall pitch [their] tents against her round about, and shall feed [their flocks] each with his hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Prepare yourselves for war against her; rise up, and let us go up against her at noon. Woe to us! for the day has gone down, for the shadows of the day fail. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Rise, and let us go up against her by night, and destroy her foundations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} For thus says the Lord, Hew down her trees, array a numerous force against Jerusalem. O false city; [there is] all oppression in her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} As a cistern cools water, so her wickedness cools her, ungodliness and misery shall be heard in her, [as] continually before her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} You shall be chastened, O Jerusalem, with pain and the scourge, lest my soul depart from you; lest I make you a desert land, which shall not be inhabited. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For thus says the Lord, Glean, glean thoroughly as a vine the remnant of Israel: turn back [your hands] as a grape-gatherer to his basket. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} To whom shall I speak, and testify, that he may listen? behold, your ears are uncircumcised, and they shall not be able to hear: behold, the word of the Lord is become to them a reproach, they will not at all desire it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And I allowed my wrath to come to full, yet I kept [it] in, and did not utterly destroy them: I will pour it out on the children without, and on the assembly of young men together: for man and woman shall be taken together, the old man with him that is full of days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And their houses shall be turned to others, [with] their fields and their wives together: for I will stretch out my hand upon the inhabitants of this land, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} For from the least of them even to the greatest they have all committed iniquity; from the priest even to the false prophet they have all wrought falsely. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And they healed the breach of my people [imperfectly], making light [of it], and saying, Peace, peace, and where is peace? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} They were ashamed because they failed; yet they were not ashamed as those who are [truly] ashamed, and they knew not their own disgrace: therefore shall they [utterly] fall when they do fall, and in the time of visitation shall they perish, said the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Thus says the Lord, Stand you⌃ in the ways, and see, and ask for the old paths of the Lord; and see what is the good way, and walk in it, and you⌃ shall find purification for your souls. But they said, We will not walk [in them]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} I have set watchmen over you, [saying], Hear you⌃ the sound of the trumpet. But they said, We will not hear [it]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Therefore have the nations heard, and they that feed their flocks. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Hear, O earth: behold, I will bring evils upon this people, [even] the fruit of their rebellions; for they have not heeded my words, and they have rejected my law. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Therefore do you⌃ bring me frankincense from Saba, and cinnamon from a land afar off? your whole burnt offerings are not acceptable, and your sacrifices have not been pleasant to me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Therefore thus says the Lord, Behold, I [will] bring weakness upon this people, and the fathers and sons shall be weak together; the neighbor and his friend shall perish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Thus says the Lord, Behold, a people comes from the north, and nations shall be stirred up from the end of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} They shall lay hold on bow and spear; [the people] is fierce, and will have no mercy; their voice is as the roaring sea; they shall array themselves for war against you as fire on horses and chariots, O daughter of Sion. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} We have heard the report of them: our hands are weakened: anguish has seized us, the pangs as of a woman in travail. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Go not forth into the field, and walk not in the ways; for the sword of the enemy lingers round about. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} O daughter of my people, gird yourself with sackcloth: sprinkle [yourself] with ashes; make for yourself pitiable lamentation, [as] the mourning for a beloved [son]: for misery will come suddenly upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} I have caused you to be tried among tried nations, and you shall know me when I have tried their way. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} [They are] all disobedient, walking perversely: [they are] brass and iron; they are all corrupted. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} The bellows have failed from the fire, the lead has failed: the silversmith works at his trade in vain; their wickedness is not consumed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Call you⌃ them reprobate silver, because the Lord has rejected them.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 7}
\markright{JEREMIAS 7}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Hear you⌃ the word of the Lord, all Judea. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Thus says the Lord God of Israel, Correct your ways and your devices, and I will cause you to dwell in this place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Trust not in yourselves with lying words, for they shall not profit you at all, saying, It is the temple of the Lord, the temple of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For if you⌃ thoroughly correct your ways and your practices, and do indeed execute judgment between a man and his neighbor; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} and oppress not the stranger, and the orphan, and the widow, and shed not innocent blood in this place, and go not after strange gods to your hurt: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} then will I cause you to dwell in this place, in the land which I gave to your fathers of old and for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} But whereas you⌃ have trusted in lying words, whereby you⌃ shall not be profited; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} and you⌃ murder, and commit adultery, and steal, and swear falsely, and burn incense to Baal, and are gone after strange gods whom you⌃ know not, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} so that it is evil with you; yet have you⌃ come, and stood before me in the house, whereon my name is called, and you⌃ have said, We have refrained from doing all these abominations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Is my house, whereon my name is called, a den of robbers in your eyes? And, behold, I have seen [it], says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For go you⌃ to my place which is in Selo, where I caused my name to dwell before, and see what I did to it because of the wickedness of my people Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And now, because you⌃ have done all these deeds, and I spoke to you, but you⌃ listened not to me; and I called you, but you⌃ answered not; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} therefore I also will do to the house whereon my name is called, wherein you⌃ trust, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I did to Selo. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And I will cast you out of my sight, as I cast away your brethren, all the seed of Ephraim. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Therefore pray not you for this people, and intercede not for them to be pitied, yes, pray not, and approach me not for them: for I will not listen [to you]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Seest you not what they do in the cities of Juda, and in the streets of Jerusalem? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Their children gather wood, and their fathers kindle a fire, and their women knead dough, to make cakes to the host of heaven; and they have poured out drink-offerings to strange gods, that they might provoke me to anger. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Do they provoke me to anger? says the Lord: do they not [provoke] themselves, that their faces may be ashamed? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Therefore thus says the Lord; Behold, my anger and wrath shall be poured out upon this place, and upon the men, and upon the cattle, and upon every tree of their field, and upon the fruits of the land; and it shall burn, and not be quenched. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Thus says the Lord, Gather your whole burnt offerings with your meat-offerings, and eat flesh. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} For I spoke not to your fathers, and commanded them not in the day wherein I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, concerning whole burnt offerings and sacrifice: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} but I commanded them this thing, saying, Hear you⌃ my voice, and I will be to you a God, and you⌃ shall be to me a people: and walk you⌃ in all my ways which I shall command you, that it may be well with you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} But they listened not to me, and their ear gave no heed, but they walked in the imaginations of their evil heart, and went backward, and not forward; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} from the day that their fathers went forth out of the land of Egypt, even until this day. And I sent to you all my servants, the prophets, by day and early in the morning: yes, I sent [them], {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} but they listened not to me, and their ear gave no heed; and they made their neck harder than their fathers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Therefore you shall speak this word to them; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} This is the nation which has not listened to the voice of the Lord, nor received correction: truth has failed from their mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Cut off your hair, and cast it away, and take up a lamentation on your lips; for the Lord has reprobated and rejected the generation that does these things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} For the children of Juda have wrought evil before me, says the Lord; they have set their abominations in the house on which my name is called, to defile it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And they have built the altar of Taphes, which is in the valley of the son of Ennom, to burn their sons and their daughters with fire; which I did not command them [to do], neither did I design it in my heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Therefore, behold, the days come, says the Lord, when they shall no more say, The altar of Taphes, and the valley of the son of Ennom, but, The valley of the slain; and they shall bury in Taphes, for lack of room. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And the dead bodies of this people shall be for food to the birds of the sky, and to the wild beasts of the earth; and there shall be none to drive [them] away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And I will destroy out of the cities of Juda, and the streets of Jerusalem, the voice of them that make merry, and the voice of them that rejoice, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride; for the whole land shall become a desolation.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 8}
\markright{JEREMIAS 8}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} At that time, says the Lord, they shall bring out the bones of the kings of Juda, and the bones of his princes, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, out of their graves; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} and they shall spread them out to the sun, and the moon, and to all the stars, and to all the host of heaven, which they have loved, and which they have served, and after which they have walked, and to which they have held, and which they have worshipped; they shall not be mourned for, neither shall they be buried; but they shall be for an example on the face of the earth, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} because they chose death rather than life, even to all the remnant that are left of that family, in every place whither I shall drive them out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For thus says the Lord, Shall not he that falls arise? or he that turns away, shall he not turn back again? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Therefore has this my people turned away with a shameless revolting, and strengthened themselves in their willfulness, and refused to return? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Listen, I pray you, and hear: will they not speak thus, There is no man that repents of his wickedness, saying, What have I done? the runner has failed from his course, as a tired horse in his neighing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Yes, the stork in the heaven knows her time, [also] the turtle-dove and wild swallow; the sparrows observe the times of their coming in; but this my people knows not the judgments of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} How will you⌃ say, We are wise, and the law of the Lord is with us? In vain have the scribes used a false pen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The wise men are ashamed, and alarmed, and taken; because they have rejected the word of the Lord; what wisdom is there in them? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Therefore will I give their wives to others, and their fields to [new] inheritors; and they shall gather their fruits, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} There are no grapes on the vines, and there are no figs on the fig-trees, and the leaves have fallen off. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Why do we sit still? assemble yourselves, and let us enter into the strong cities, and let us be cast out there: for God has cast us out, and made us drink water of gall, because we have sinned before him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} We assembled for peace, but there was no prosperity; for a time of healing, but behold anxiety. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} We shall hear the neighing of his swift horses out of Dan: the whole land quaked at the sound of the neighing of his horses; and he shall come, and devour the land and the fullness of it; the city, and them that dwell in it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For, behold, I send forth against you deadly serpents, which can’t be charmed, and they shall bite you {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} mortally with the pain of your distressed heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Behold, [there is] a sound of the cry of the daughter of my people from a land afar off: Is not the Lord in Sion? is there not a king there? because they have provoked me with their graven [images], and with strange vanities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} The summer is gone, the harvest is past, and we are not saved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For the breach of the daughter of my people I have been saddened: in my perplexity pangs have seized upon me as of a woman in travail. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And is there no balm in Galaad, or is there no physician there? why has not the healing of the daughter of my people taken place?\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} and all;, ; they shall be \textsuperscript{4} Moreover Blayney justly observes, that the change of speakers here requires to be carefully attended to. The prophet first, in the name of God, reproves the people, and threatens them with grievous calamities, . Then, apostrophising his countrymen, he advises them to retire with him to some fortified city, . God then threatens to bring foes against them, that are irresistible, . The prophet next commiserates the daughter of his people, who is heard bewailing her forlorn case; whilst the voice of God breaks in upon her complaints, and shows that all this ruin is brought upon her by her infidelities, . The prophet regrets that her wounds had not been healed, and laments over her slain; . Shall they; turn \textsuperscript{5} slidden, ; they hold; they refuse \textsuperscript{8} We, ; the law; Lo in vain etc. or, the false pen of the scribes worketh for falsehood \textsuperscript{9} The wise men are or, Have they been, etc.; lo; what wisdom Heb. the wisdom of what thing, etc \textsuperscript{10} will I; for; from the prophet \textsuperscript{13} I will surely consume or, In gathering I will consume; there; the leaf \textsuperscript{14} do enter; be silent; water; gall or, poison \textsuperscript{16} The snorting Grotius observes, after Jerome, that Nebuchadnezzar, having subdued Phoenicia, passed through Dan, in his way to Jerusalem. was heard; the whole; at the; of his strong ones Of his war-horses, This is a fine image; so terrible was the united neighings of the cavalry of the Babylonians, that the reverberation of the air caused the ground to tremble. all that is in it Heb. the fulness thereof \textsuperscript{19} the voice; them etc. Heb. the country of them that are afar off the Lord; her king; Why \textsuperscript{22} no balm; no physician; why recovered Heb. gone up\par}

\subsection*{Jeremias 9}
\markright{JEREMIAS 9}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Who will give water to my head, and a fountain of tears to my eyes? then would I weep for this my people day and night, [even] for the slain of the daughter of my people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Who would give me a most distant lodge in the wilderness, that I might leave my people, and depart from them? for they all commit adultery, an assembly of treacherous men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And they have bent their tongue like a bow: falsehood and not faithfulness has prevailed upon the earth; for they have gone on from evil to evil, and have not known me, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Beware you⌃ each of his neighbor, and trust you⌃ not in your brethren: for every one will surely supplant, and every friend will walk craftily. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Every one will mock his friend; they will not speak truth: their tongue has learned to speak falsehoods; they have committed iniquity, they ceased not, so as to return. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} [There is] usury upon usury, and deceit upon deceit: they would not know me, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Therefore thus says the Lord, Behold, I will try them with fire, and prove them; for I will do [thus] because of the wickedness of the daughter of my people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Their tongue is a wounding arrow; the words of their mouth are deceitful: [one] speaks peaceably to his neighbor, but in himself retains enmity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Shall I not visit for these things? says the Lord: and shall not my soul be avenged on such a people as this? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Take up a lamentation for the mountains, and a mournful dirge for the paths of the wilderness, for they are desolate for lack of men; they heard not the sound of life from the birds of the sky, nor the cattle: they were amazed, they are gone. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And I will remove the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and make it a dwelling-place of dragons; and I will utterly waste the cities of Juda, so that they shall not be inhabited. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Who is the wise man, that he may understand this? and he that has the word of the mouth of the Lord [addressed] to him, let him tell you therefore the land has been destroyed, has been ravaged by fire like a desert, so that no one passes through it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And the Lord said to me, Because they have forsaken my law, which I set before them, and have not listened to my voice; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} but went after the lusts of their evil heart, and after the idols which their fathers taught them [to worship]: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} therefore thus says the Lord God of Israel, Behold, I will feed them with trouble and will cause them to drink water of gall: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} and I will scatter them among the nations, to them whom neither they nor their fathers knew; and I will send a sword upon them, until I have consumed them with it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Thus says the Lord, Call you⌃ the mourning women, and let them come; and send to the wise women, and let them utter their voice; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} and let them take up a lamentation for you, and let your eyes pour down tears, and your eyelids drop water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} For a voice of lamentation has been heard in Sion, How are we become wretched! we are greatly ashamed, for we have forsaken the land, and have abandoned our tabernacles! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Hear now, you⌃ women, the word of God, and let your ears receive the words of his mouth, and teach your daughters lamentation, and [every] woman her neighbor a dirge. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For death has come up through your windows, it has entered into our land, to destroy the infants without, and the young men from the streets. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And the carcasses of the men shall be for an example on the face of the field of your land, like grass after the mower, and there shall be none to gather [them]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Thus says the Lord, Let not the wise man boast in his wisdom, and let not the strong man boast in his strength, and let not the rich man boast in his wealth; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} but let him that boasts boast in this, the understanding and knowing that I am the Lord that exercise mercy, and judgment, and righteousness, upon the earth; for in these things is my pleasure, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Behold, the days come, says the Lord, when I will visit upon all the circumcised their uncircumcision; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} on Egypt, and on Idumea, and on Edom, and on the children of Ammon, and on the children of Moab, and on every one that shaves his face round about, [even] them that dwell in the wilderness; for all the Gentiles are uncircumcised in flesh, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised [in] their hearts.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} O that, Heb. Who will give, etc., ; weep the daughter \textsuperscript{2} that I had; for; an assembly \textsuperscript{3} they bend; valiant; for they; they know \textsuperscript{4} ye heed; neighbour or, friend every brother; walk \textsuperscript{5} they will; deceive or, mock, taught; weary \textsuperscript{8} tongue;, one; in heart Heb. in the midst of him his wait or, wait for him \textsuperscript{10} the mountains, ; habitations or, pastures because, ; burned up or, desolate so;, both etc. Heb. from the fowls even to, etc. \textsuperscript{11} Jerusalem; a den; the cities; desolate Heb. desolation \textsuperscript{14} walked; imagination or, stubbornness which \textsuperscript{17} call; the mourning women Those whose office it was to sing mournful dirges, and make public lamentations at funerals. \textsuperscript{19} a voice; we are, ; our \textsuperscript{20} hear Isa. 3:16-4:1; receive and teach \textsuperscript{24} let him; *Gr:; knoweth; lovingkindness;, ; for \textsuperscript{25} that; punish Heb. visit upon \textsuperscript{26} Egypt, 46:1-52:34; Isa. 13:1-24:23; Ezek. 24:1-32:32; Amos 1:1-2:16; Zeph. 1:1-2:15 Judah in the utmost corners Heb. cut off into corners; or, having the corners of their hair polled, Dr. Durell and others justly consider the marginal reading as far preferable; as being descriptive of the mode in which the Arabians cut their hair and beard. \subsection*{Jeremias 10}
\markright{JEREMIAS 10}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Hear you⌃ the word of the Lord, which he has spoken to you, O house of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Thus says the Lord, Learn you⌃ not the ways of the heathen, and be not alarmed at the signs of the sky; for they are alarmed at them, [falling] on their faces. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For the customs of the nations are vain; it is a tree cut out of the forest, the work of the carpenter, or a molten image. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} [They are] beautified with silver and gold, they fix them with hammers and nails; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} they will set them up that they may not move; it is wrought silver, they will not walk, it is forged silver They must certainly be borne, for they can’t ride [of themselves]. Fear them not; for they can’t do any evil, and there is no good in them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Thus shall you⌃ say to them, Let the gods which have not made heaven and earth perish from off the earth, and from under this sky. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} It is the Lord that made the earth by his strength, who set up the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding stretched out the sky, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} and set abundance of waters in the sky, and brought up clouds from the ends of the earth; he made lightnings for the rain, and brought forth light out of his treasures. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Every man is deprived of knowledge, every goldsmith is confounded because of his graven images; for he has cast false gods, there is no breath in them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} They are vain works, wrought in mockery; in the time of their visitation they shall perish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Such is not the portion of Jacob; for he that formed all things, he is his inheritance; the Lord is his name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} He has gathered your substance from without the lodged in choice [vessels]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} For thus says the Lord, Behold, I [will] overthrow the inhabitants of this land with affliction, that your plague may be revealed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Alas for your ruin! your plague is grievous: and I said, Surely this is your wound, and it has overtaken you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Your tabernacle is in a ruinous state, it has perished; and all your curtains have been torn asunder: my children and my cattle are no more: there is no more any place for my tabernacle, [nor] place for my curtains. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For the shepherds have become foolish, and have not sought the Lord; therefore the whole pasture has failed, and [the sheep] have been scattered. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Behold, there comes a sound of a noise, and a great earthquake from the land of the north, to make the cities of Juda a desolation, and a resting-place for ostriches. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} I know, O Lord, that man's way is not his own; neither shall a man go, and direct his going. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Chasten us, O Lord, but with judgment; and not in wrath, lest you make us few. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Pour out your wrath upon the nations that have not known you, and upon the families that have not called upon your name: for they have devoured Jacob, and consumed him, and have made his pasture desolate.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{3} customs Heb. statutes, or ordinances, are vanity, ; one \textsuperscript{5} speak; be borne, do evil \textsuperscript{11} Thus "In the Chaldean language." \subsection*{Jeremias 11}
\markright{JEREMIAS 11}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The word that came to Jeremias from the Lord, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Hear you⌃ the words of this covenant, and you shall speak to the men of Juda, and to the dwellers in Jerusalem; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and you shall say to them, Thus says the Lord God of Israel, Cursed is the man, who shall not listen to the words of this covenant, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} which I commanded your fathers, in the day wherein I brought them up out of the land of Egypt, out of the iron furnace, saying, Listen to my voice, and do all things that I shall command you; so shall you⌃ be to me a people, and I will be to you a God; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} that I may confirm my oath, which I swore to your fathers, to give them a land flowing [with] milk and honey, as [it is] this day. Then I answered and said, So be it, O Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And the Lord said to me, Read these words in the cities of Juda, and in the streets of Jerusalem, saying, Hear you⌃ the words of this covenant, and do them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} But they did [them] not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And the Lord said to me, A conspiracy is found among the men of Juda, and among the dwellers in Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} They are turned [aside] to the iniquities of their fathers that were of old, who would not listen to my words: and, behold, they go after strange gods, to serve them: and the house of Israel and the house of Juda have broken my covenant, which I made with their fathers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Therefore thus says the Lord, Behold, I bring evils upon this people, out of which they shall not be able to come forth; and they shall presently cry to me, but I will not listen to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And the cities of Juda and the dwellers in Jerusalem shall go, and cry to the gods to whom they burn incense; which shall not deliver them in the time of their troubles. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} For according to the number of your cities were your gods, O Juda; and according to the number of the streets of Jerusalem have you⌃ set up altars to burn incense to Baal. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And you, pray not for this people, and intercede not for them in supplication and prayer: for I will not hear in the day in which they call upon me, in the day of their affliction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Why has [my] beloved wrought abomination in my house? will prayers and holy offerings take away your wickedness from you, or shall you escape by these things? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} The Lord called your name a fair olive tree, of a goodly shade in appearance, at the noise of its being lopped, fire was kindled against it; great is the affliction [coming] upon you: her branches are become good for nothing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And the Lord that planted you has pronounced evils against you, because of the iniquity of the house of Israel and the house of Juda, whatever they have done against themselves to provoke me to anger by burning incense to Baal. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} O Lord, teach me, and I shall know: then I saw their practices. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} But I as an innocent lamb led to the slaughter, knew not: against me they devised an evil device, saying, Come and let us put wood into his bread, and let us utterly destroy him from off the land of the living, and let his name not be remembered any more. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} O Lord, that judge righteously, trying the reins and hearts, let me see your vengeance [taken] upon them, for to you I have declared my cause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the men of Anathoth, that seek my life, that say, You shall not prophesy at all in the name of the Lord, but if you do, you shall die by our hands: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} behold, I will visit them: their young men shall die by the sword; and their sons and their daughters shall die of famine: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} and there shall be no remnant [left] of them; for I will bring evil upon the dwellers in Anathoth, in the year of their visitation.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 12}
\markright{JEREMIAS 12}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Righteous are you, O Lord, that I may make my defence to you, yes, I will speak to you [of] judgments. Why [is it] that the way of ungodly [men] prospers? [that] all that deal very treacherously are flourishing? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} You have planted them, and they have taken root; they have begotten children, and become fruitful; you are near to their mouth, and far from their reins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} But you, Lord, know me; you have proved my heart before you; purify them for the day of their slaughter. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} How long shall the land mourn, and the grass of the field wither, for the wickedness of them, that dwell in it? the beasts and birds are utterly destroyed; because [the people] said, God shall not see our ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Your feet run, and they cause you to faint; how will you prepare [to ride] upon horses? and you have been confident in the land of your peace? how will you do in the roaring of Jordan? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} For even your brethren and the house of your father, even these have dealt treacherously with you; and they have cried out, they are gathered together in pursuit of you; trust not you in them, though they shall speak fair [words] to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} I have forsaken my house, I have left my heritage; I have given my beloved one into the hands of her enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} My inheritance has become to me as a lion in a forest; she has uttered her voice against me; therefore have I hated her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Is not my inheritance to me a hyaena's cave, or a cave round about her? Go you⌃, gather together all the wild beasts of the field, and let them come to devour her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Many shepherds have destroyed my vineyard, they have defiled my portion, they have made my desirable portion a trackless wilderness; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} it is made a complete ruin: for my sake the whole land has been utterly ruined, because there is none that lays [the matter] to heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} The ravagers are come to every passage in the wilderness: for the sword of the Lord will devour from one end of the land to the other: no flesh has any peace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Sow wheat, and reap thorns; their portions shall not profit them: be ashamed of your boasting, because of reproach before the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For thus says the Lord, concerning all the evil neighbors that touch my inheritance, which I have divided to my people Israel; Behold, I [will] draw them away from their land, and I will cast out Juda from the midst of them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And it shall come to pass, after I have cast them out, [that] I will return, and have mercy upon them, and will cause them to dwell every one in his inheritance, and every one in his land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And it shall be, if they will indeed learn the way of my people, to swear by my name, [saying], The Lord lives; as they taught my people to swear by Baal; then shall [that nation] be built in the midst of my people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} But if they will not return, then will I cut off that nation with utter ruin and destruction.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 13}
\markright{JEREMIAS 13}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Thus says the Lord, Go and procure for yourself a linen girdle, and put it about your loins, and let it not be put in water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} So I procured the girdle according to the word of the Lord, and put it about my loins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Take the girdle that is upon your loins, and arise, and go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} So I went, and hid it by the Euphrates, as the Lord commanded me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And it came to pass after many days, that the Lord said to me, Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take thence the girdle, which I commanded you to hide there. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} So I went to the river Euphrates, and dug, and took the girdle out of the place where I [had] buried it: and, behold, it was rotten, utterly good for nothing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Thus says the Lord, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Thus will I mar the pride of Juda, and the pride of Jerusalem; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} [even] this great pride [of the men] that will not listen to my words, and have gone after strange gods, to serve them, and to worship them: and they shall be as this girdle, which can be used for nothing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For as a girdle cleaves about the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave to myself the house of Israel, and the whole house of Juda; that they might be to me a famous people, and a praise, and a glory: but they did not listen to me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And you shall say to this people, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and it shall come to pass, if they shall say to you, Shall we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine? that you shall say to them, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Thus says the Lord, Behold, I [will] fill the inhabitants of this land, and their kings the sons of David that sit upon their throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and Juda and all the dwellers in Jerusalem, with strong drink. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And I will scatter them a man and his brother, and their fathers and their sons together: I will not have compassion, says the Lord, and I will not spare, neither will I pity [to save them] from destruction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Hear you⌃, and give ear, and be not proud: for the Lord has spoken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Give glory to the Lord your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and you⌃ shall wait for light, and behold the shadow of death, and they shall be brought into darkness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} But if you⌃ will not listen, your soul shall weep in secret because of pride, and your eyes shall pour down tears, because the Lord's flock is sorely bruised. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Say you⌃ to the king and the princes, Humble yourselves, and sit down; for your crown of glory is removed from your head. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} The cities toward the south were shut, and there was none to open [them]: Juda is removed [into captivity, ]they have suffered a complete removal. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Lift up your eyes, O Jerusalem, and behold them that come from the north; where is the flock that was given you, the sheep of your glory? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} What will you say when they shall visit you, for you did teach them lessons for rule against yourself; shall not pangs seize you as a woman in travail? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And if you should say in your heart, Therefore have these things happened to me? Because of the abundance of your iniquity have your skirts been revealed, that your heels might be exposed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} If the Ethiopian shall change his skin, or the leopardess her spots, then shall you⌃ be able to do good, having learned evil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} So I scattered them as sticks carried by the wind into the wilderness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Thus is your lot, and the reward of your disobedience to me, says the Lord; as you did forget me, and trust in lies, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} I also will expose your skirts upon your face, and your shame shall be seen; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} your adultery also, and your neighing, and the looseness of your fornication: on the hills and in the fields I have seen your abominations. Woe to you, O Jerusalem, for you have not been purified so as to follow me; how long yet [shall it be]?\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 14}
\markright{JEREMIAS 14}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} AND THE WORD OF THE LORD CAME TO JEREMIAS CONCERNING THE DROUGHT. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Judea has mourned, and her gates are emptied, and are darkened upon the earth; and the cry of Jerusalem is gone up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And her nobles have sent their little ones to the water: they came to the wells, and found no water: and brought back their vessels empty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And the labors of the land failed, because there was no rain: the husbandmen were ashamed, they covered their heads. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And hinds calved in the field, and forsook [it], because there was no grass. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} The wild asses stood by the forests, and snuffed up the wind; their eyes failed, because there was no grass. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Our sins have risen up against us: O Lord, do you for us for your own sake; for our sins are many before you; for we have sinned against you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} O Lord, [you are] the hope of Israel, and deliver [us] in time of troubles; why are you become as a sojourner upon the land, or as one born in the land, yet turning aside for a resting-place? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Will you be as a man asleep, or as a [strong] man that can’t save? yet you are among us, O Lord, and your name is called upon us; forget us not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Thus says the Lord to this people, They have loved to wander, and they have not spared, therefore God has not prospered them; now will he remember their iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And the Lord said to me, Pray not for this people for [their] good: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} for though they fast, I will not hear their supplication; and though they offer whole burnt offerings and sacrifices, I will take no pleasure in them: for I will consume them with sword, and with famine, and with pestilence. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And I said, O [ever] living Lord! behold, their prophets prophesy, and say, You⌃ shall not see a sword, nor shall famine be among you; for I will give truth and peace on the land, and in this place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Then the Lord said to me, The prophets prophesy lies in my name: I sent them not, and I commanded them not, and I spoke not to them: for they prophesy to you false visions, and divinations, and auguries, and devices of their own heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the prophets that prophesy lies in my name, and I sent them not, who say, Sword and famine shall not be upon this land; they shall die by a grievous death, and the prophets shall be consumed by famine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And the people to whom they prophesy, they also shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem, because of the sword and famine; and there shall be none to bury them: their wives also, and their sons, and their daughters [shall die thus]; and I will pour out their wickedness upon them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And you shall speak this word to them; Let your eyes shed tears day and night, and let them not cease: for the daughter of my people has been sorely bruised, and her plague is very grievous. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} If I go forth into the plain, then behold the slain by the sword! and if I enter into the city, then behold the distress of famine! for priest and prophet have gone to a land which they knew not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Have you utterly rejected Juda? and has your soul departed from Sion? therefore has you struck us, and there is no healing for us? we waited for peace, but there was no prosperity; for a time of healing, and behold trouble! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} We know, O Lord, our sins, [and] the iniquities of our fathers: for we have sinned before you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Refrain for your name's sake, destroy not the throne of your glory: remember, break not your covenant with us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Is there any one among the idols of the Gentiles that can give rain? and will the sky yield his fulness [at their bidding]? Are not you he? we will even wait on you, O Lord: for you have made all these things.\par

The Hebrew batzaroth rendered dearth, signifies restraint, that is, "when the heaven is shut up that there is no rain; " which Houbigant thinks happened early in the reign of Zedekiah. the dearth Heb. the words of the dearths, or restraints \textsuperscript{2} mourneth; the gates, they; the cry \textsuperscript{3} their nobles pits; they were; covered \textsuperscript{6} the wild; they They sucked in the air, for want of water, to cool their internal heat. their \textsuperscript{8} the hope; saviour, in time, ; why a wayfaring \textsuperscript{9} cannot;, art; we are called by thy name Heb. thy name is called upon us; *marg. leave \textsuperscript{10} have they, ; refrained; the Lord; he will \textsuperscript{12} they fast; and when; but \textsuperscript{13} Ah, behold, ; assured peace Heb. peace of truth \textsuperscript{14} The prophets, ; I sent, ; divination, ;, ; and the \textsuperscript{15} Sword and famine shall not \textsuperscript{16} the people; be cast, ; for \textsuperscript{17} let mine, ;, for; with a very \textsuperscript{18} go forth; yea, ; go about etc. or, make merchandise against a land, and men acknowledge it not \textsuperscript{19} utterly; hath; no healing; we \textsuperscript{21} not abhor; for; disgrace; remember\par}

\subsection*{Jeremias 15}
\markright{JEREMIAS 15}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the Lord said to me, Though Moses and Samuel stood before my face, my soul could not be toward them: dismiss this people, and let them go forth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And it shall be, if they say to you, Whither shall we go forth? then you shall say to them, Thus says the Lord; As many as are for death, to death; and as many as are for famine, to famine; and as many as are for the sword, to the sword; and as many as are for captivity, to captivity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I will punish them with four kinds [of death], says the Lord, the sword to kill, and the dogs to tear, and the wild beasts of the earth, and the birds of the sky to devour and destroy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And I will deliver them up for distress to all the kingdoms of the earth, because of Manasses son of Ezekias king of Juda, for all that he did in Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Who will spare you, O Jerusalem? and who will fear for you? or who will turn back [to ask] for your welfare? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} You have turned away from me, says the Lord, you will go back: therefore I will stretch out my hand, and will destroy you, and will no more spare them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I will completely scatter them; in the gates of my people they are bereaved of children: they have destroyed my people because of their iniquities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Their widows have been multiplied more than the sand of the sea: I have brought young men against the mother, [even] distress at noon-day: I have suddenly cast upon her trembling and anxiety. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} She that bore seven is spent; her soul has fainted under trouble; her sun is gone down while it is yet noon; she is ashamed and disgraced: I will give the remnant of them to the sword before their enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Woe is me, [my] mother! you have born me as some man of strife, and at variance with the whole earth; I have not helped [others], nor has any one helped me; my strength has failed among them that curse me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Be it so, Lord, in their prosperity; surely I stood before you in the time of their calamities, and in the time of their affliction, for [their] good against the enemy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Will iron be known? whereas your strength is a brazen covering. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Yes, I will give your treasures for a spoil as a recompence, because of all your sins and [that] in all your borders. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And I will enslave you to your enemies round about, in a land which you have not known; for a fire has been kindled out of my wrath; it shall burn upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} O Lord, remember me, and visit me, and vindicate me before them that persecute me; do not bear long with them; know how I have met with reproach for your sake, from those who set at nothing your words; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} consume them; and your word shall be to me for the joy and gladness of my heart: for your name has been called upon me, O Lord Almighty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} I have not sat in the assembly of them as they mocked, but I feared because of your power: I sat alone, for I was filled with bitterness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Why do they that grieve me prevail against me? my wound is severe; whence shall I be healed? it is indeed become to me as deceitful water, that has no faithfulness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Therefore thus says the Lord, If you will return, then will I restore you, and you shall stand before my face: and if you will bring forth the precious from the worthless, you shall be as my mouth: and they shall return to you; but you shall not return to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And I will make you to this people as a strong brazen wall; and they shall fight against you, but they shall by no means prevail against you; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} for I am with you to save you, and to deliver you out of the hand of wicked [men]; and I will ransom you out of the hand of pestilent [men].\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 16}
\markright{JEREMIAS 16}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And you shall not take a wife, says the Lord God of Israel: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} and there shall be no son born to you, nor daughter in this place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For thus says the Lord concerning the sons and concerning the daughters that are born in this place, and concerning their mothers that have born them, and concerning their fathers that have begotten them in this land; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} They shall die of grievous death; they shall not be lamented, nor buried; they shall be for an example on the face of the earth; and they shall be for the wild beasts of the land, and for the birds of the sky: they shall fall by the sword, and shall be consumed with famine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Thus says the Lord, Enter not into their mourning feast, and go not to lament, and mourn not for them: for I have removed my peace from this people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} They shall not bewail them, nor make cuttings for them, and they shall not shave themselves [for them]: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} and there shall be no bread broken in mourning for them for consolation over the dead: they shall not give one to drink a cup for consolation over his father or his mother. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} You shall not enter into the banquet-house, to sit with them to eat and to drink. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For thus says the Lord God of Israel; Behold, I [will] make to cease out of this place before your eyes, and in your days, the voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And it shall come to pass, when you shall report to this people all these words, and they shall say to you, Therefore has the Lord pronounced against us all these evils? what is our unrighteousness? and what is our sin which we have sinned before the Lord our God? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Then you shall say to them, Because your fathers forsook me, says the Lord, and went after strange gods and served them, and worshipped them, and forsook me, and kept not my law; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} (and you⌃ sinned worse than your fathers; for, behold, you⌃ walk every one after the lusts of your own evil heart, so as not to listen to me); {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} therefore I will cast you off from this good land into a land which neither you⌃ nor your fathers have known; and you⌃ shall serve their other gods, who shall have no mercy upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Therefore, behold, the days come, says the Lord, when they shall no more say, The Lord lives, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} but, The Lord lives, who brought up the house of Israel from the land of the north, and from all countries whither they were thrust out: and I will restore them to their own land, which I gave to their fathers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Behold, I [will] send many fishers, says the Lord, and they shall fish them; and afterward I will send many hunters, and they shall hunt them upon every mountain, and upon every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For my eyes are upon all their ways; and their iniquities have not been hidden from my eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And I will recompense their mischiefs doubly, and their sins, whereby they have profaned my land with the carcasses of their abominations, and with their iniquities, whereby they have trespassed against my inheritance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} O Lord, you are my strength, and my help, and my refuge in days of evil: to you the Gentiles shall come from the end of the earth, and shall say, How vain [were the] idols [which] our fathers procured to themselves, and there is no help in them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Will a man make gods for himself, whereas these are no gods? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Therefore, behold, I will at this time manifest my hand to them, and will make known to them my power; and they shall know that my name is the Lord.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 17}
\markright{JEREMIAS 17}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Cursed is the man who trusts in man, and will lean his arm of flesh upon him, while his heart departs from the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And he shall be as the wild tamarisk in the desert: he shall not see when good comes; but he shall dwell in barren [places], and in the wilderness, in a salt land which is not inhabited. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} But blessed is the man who trusts in the Lord, and whose hope the Lord shall be. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And he shall be as a thriving tree by the waters, and he shall cast forth his root toward a moist place: he shall not fear when heat comes, and there shall be upon him shady branches: he shall not fear in a year of drought, and he shall not fail to bear fruit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The heart is deep beyond all things, and it is the man, and who can know him? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} I the Lord try the hearts, and prove the reins, to give to every one according to his ways, and according to the fruits of his devices. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} The partridge utters her voice, she gathers [eggs] which she did not lay; [so is a man] gaining his wealth unjustly; in the midst of his days [his riches] shall leave him, and at his latter end he will be a fool. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} An exalted throne of glory is our sanctuary. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} O Lord, the hope of Israel, let all that have left you be ashamed, let them that have revolted be written on the earth, because they have forsaken the fountain of life, the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Heal me, O Lord, and I shall be healed; save me, and I shall be saved; for you are my boast. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Behold, they say to me, Where is the word of the Lord? let it come. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} But I have not been weary of following you, nor have I desired the day of man; you know; the [words] that proceed out of my lips are before your face. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Be not to me a stranger, [but] spare me in the evil day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Let them that persecute me be ashamed, but let me not be ashamed: let them be alarmed, but let me not be alarmed: bring upon them the evil day, crush them with double destruction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Thus says the Lord; Go and stand in the gates of the children of your people, by which the kings of Juda enter, and by which they go out, and in all the gates of Jerusalem: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} and you shall say to them, Hear the word of the Lord, you⌃ kings of Juda, and all Judea, and all Jerusalem, [all] who go in at these gates: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} thus says the Lord; Take heed to your souls, and take up no burdens on the sabbath-day, and go not forth [through] the gates of Jerusalem; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} and carry forth no burdens out of your houses on the sabbath-day, and you⌃ shall do no work: sanctify the sabbath-day, as I commanded your fathers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} But they listened not, and inclined not their ear, but stiffened their neck more than their fathers [did], so as not to hear me, and not to receive correction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And it shall come to pass, if you⌃ will listen to me, says the Lord, to carry in no burdens through the gates of this city on the sabbath-day, and to sanctify the sabbath-day, so as to do no work [upon it], {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} that there shall enter through the gates of this city kings and princes sitting on the throne of David, and riding on their chariots and horses, they, and their princes, the men of Juda, and the dwellers in Jerusalem: and this city shall be inhabited for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And [men] shall come out of the cities of Juda, and from round about Jerusalem, and out of the land of Benjamin, and out of the plain country, and from the hill country, and from the south [country], bringing whole burnt offerings, and sacrifices, and incense, and manna, and frankincense, bringing praise to the house of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} But it shall come to pass, if you⌃ will not listen to me to sanctify the sabbath-day, to bear no burdens, nor go in [with them by] the gates of Jerusalem on the sabbath-day; then will I kindle a fire in the gates thereof, and it shall devour the streets of Jerusalem, and shall not be quenched.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 18}
\markright{JEREMIAS 18}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The word that came from the Lord to {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Jeremias, saying, Arise, and go down to the potter's house, and there you shall hear my words. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} So I went down to the potter's house, and behold, he was making a vessel on the stones. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And the vessel which he was making with his hands fell: so he made it again another vessel, as it seemed good to him to make [it]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Shall I not be able, O house of Israel, to do to you as this potter? behold, as the clay of the potter are you⌃ in my hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} [If] I shall pronounce a decree upon a nation, or upon a kingdom, to cut them off, and to destroy [them]; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} and that nation turn from all their sins, then will I repent of the evils which I purposed to do to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And [if] I shall pronounce a decree upon a nation and kingdom, to rebuild and to plant [it]; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} and they do evil before me, so as not to listen to my voice, then will I repent of the good which I spoke of, to do it to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And now say to the men of Juda, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, Behold, I prepare evils against you, and devise a device against you: let every one turn now from his evil way, and amend your practices. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And they said, We will quit ourselves like men, for we will pursue our perverse ways, and we will perform each the lusts of his evil heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Therefore thus says the Lord; Enquire now among the nations, who has heard such very horrible things as the virgin of Israel has done? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Will fertilising streams fail [to flow] from a rock, or snow [fail] from Libanus? will water violently impelled by the wind turn aside? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For my people have forgotten me, they have offered incense in vain, and they fail in their ways, [leaving] the ancient tracks, to enter upon impassable paths; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} to make their land a desolation, and a perpetual hissing; all that go through it shall be amazed, and shall shake their heads. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} I will scatter them before their enemies like an east wind; I will show them the day of their destruction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Then they said, Come, and let us devise a device against Jeremias; for the law shall not perish from the priest, nor counsel from the wise, nor the word from the prophet. Come, and let us strike him with the tongue, and we will hear all his words. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Hear me, O Lord, and hear the voice of my pleading. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Forasmuch as evil is rewarded for good; for they have spoken words against my soul, and they have hidden the punishment they [meant] for me; remember that I stood before your face, to speak good for them, to turn away your wrath from them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Therefore do you deliver their sons to famine, and gather them to the power of the sword: let their women be childless and widows; and let their men be cut off by death, and their young men fall by the sword in war. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Let there be a cry in their houses: you shall bring upon them robbers suddenly: for they have formed a plan to take me, and have hidden snares for me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And you, Lord, know all their deadly counsel against me: account not their iniquities guiltless, and blot not out their sins from before you: let their weakness come before you; deal with them in the time of your wrath.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 19}
\markright{JEREMIAS 19}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then said the Lord to me, Go and get an earthen bottle, the work of the potter, and you shall bring [some] of the elders of the people, and of the priests; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} and you shall go forth to the burial-place of the sons of their children, which is at the entrance of the gate of Charsith; and do you read there all these words which I shall speak to you: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and you shall say to them, Hear you⌃ the word of the Lord, you⌃ kings of Juda, and men of Juda, and the dwellers in Jerusalem, and they that enter in by these gates; thus says the Lord God of Israel; Behold, I [will] bring evil upon this place, so that the ears of every one that hears it shall tingle. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Because they forsook me, and profaned this place, and burnt incense in it to strange gods, which they and their fathers knew not; and the kings of Juda have filled this place with innocent blood, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} and built high places for Baal, to burn their children in the fire, which things I commanded not, neither did I design [them] in my heart: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Therefore, behold, the days come, says the Lord, when this place shall no more be called, The fall and burial-place of the son of Ennom, but, The burial-place of slaughter. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I will destroy the counsel of Juda and the counsel of Jerusalem in this place; and I will cast them down with the sword before their enemies, and by the hands of them that seek their lives: and I will give their dead bodies for food to the birds of the sky and to the wild beasts of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And I will bring this city to desolation and [make it] a hissing; every one that passes by it shall scowl, and hiss because of all her plague. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And they shall eat the flesh of their sons, and the flesh of their daughters; and they shall eat every one the flesh of his neighbor in the blockade, and in the siege wherewith their enemies shall besiege them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And you shall break the bottle in the sight of the men that go forth with you, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} and you shall say, Thus says the Lord, Thus will I break in pieces this people, and this city, even as an earthen vessel is broken in pieces which can’t be mended again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Thus will I do, says the Lord, to this place, and to the inhabitants of it, that this city may be given up, as one that is falling to ruin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses of the kings of Juda shall be as a ruinous place, because of their uncleannesses in all the houses, wherein they burnt incense upon their roofs to all the host of heaven, and poured drink-offerings to strange gods. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And Jeremias came from [the place] of the Fall, whither the Lord had sent him to prophesy; and he stood in the court of the Lord's house: and said to all the people, Thus says the Lord; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Behold I bring upon this city, and upon all the cities belonging to it, and upon the villages of it, all the evils which I have spoken against it, because they have hardened their neck, [that they might not] listen to my commands.\par
