\subsection*{Jeremias 20}
\markright{JEREMIAS 20}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Now Paschor the son of Emmer, the priest, who also had been appointed chief of the house of the Lord, heard Jeremias prophesying these words. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And he struck him, and cast him into the dungeon which was by the gate of the upper house that was set apart, which was by the house of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And Paschor brought Jeremias out of the dungeon: and Jeremias said to him, [The Lord] has not called your name Paschor, but Exile. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For thus says the Lord, Behold, I [will] give you up to captivity with all your friends: and they shall fall by the sword of their enemies, and your eyes shall see [it]: and I will give you and all Juda into the hands of the king of Babylon, and they shall carry them captives, and cut them in pieces with swords. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And I will give all the strength of this city, and all the labors of it, and all the treasures of the king of Juda, into the hands of his enemies, and they shall bring them to Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And you and all the dwellers in your house shall go into captivity: and you shall die in Babylon, and there you and all your friends shall be buried, to whom you have prophesied lies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} You have deceived me, O Lord, and I have been deceived: you have been strong, and has prevailed: I am become a laughing stock, I am continually mocked every day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For I will laugh with my bitter speech, I will call upon rebellion and misery: for the word of the Lord is become a reproach to me and a mockery all my days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Then I said, I will by no means name the name of the Lord, and I will no more at all speak in his name. But it was a burning fire flaming in my bones, and I am utterly weakened on all sides, and can’t bear [up]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For I have heard the reproach of many gathering round, [saying], Conspire you⌃, and let us conspire together against him, [even] all his friends: watch his intentions, if perhaps he shall be deceived, and we shall prevail against him, and we shall be avenged on him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} But the Lord was with me as a mighty man of war: therefore they persecuted [me], but could not perceive [anything against me]; they were greatly confounded, for they perceived not their disgrace, which shall never be forgotten. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} O Lord, that prove just [deeds], understanding the reins and hearts, let me see your vengeance upon them: for to you I have revealed my cause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Sing you⌃ to the Lord, sing praise to him: for he has rescued the soul of the poor from the hand of evil-doers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Cursed be the day wherein I was born: the day wherein my mother brought me forth, let it not be blessed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Cursed be the man who brought the glad tidings to my father, saying, A male child is born to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Let that man rejoice as the cities which the Lord overthrew in wrath, and repented not: let him hear crying in the morning, and loud lamentation at noon; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} because he killed me not in the womb, and my mother became not my tomb, and her womb always great with me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Why is it that I came forth of the womb to see troubles and distresses, and my days are spent in shame?\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} smote, ; , ; the stocks Hammahpecheth from haphach "to overturn, subvert, distort, " generally denotes an overthrow ( .; ), and seems to signify here a sort of stocks, by which the limbs were distorted into uneasy postures. So the Chaldee, keephtha and Jerome, nervus which he explains in his comment as "a kind of wooden fetter, into which the feet were thrust, vinculi lignei genus, cui pedes inseruntuṙ Some learned men understand it as merely signifying a place of confinement, or house of correction; but the word is never used for any of the prisons into which the prophet was afterwards cast; and the punishment seems to have been public and ignominious. in the high \textsuperscript{3} Pashur, hath, ; Magormissabib this is, Fear round about \textsuperscript{4} I will make; thine; I will give \textsuperscript{5} I will deliver, ; labours The word labours is here used for the produce of labour. \textsuperscript{6} Pashur, ; thy friends, ; thou hast \textsuperscript{7} deceived or, enticed, ; thou art; I am \textsuperscript{10} I heard, ; fear Report; , All my familiars Heb. \subsection*{Jeremias 21}
\markright{JEREMIAS 21}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} THE WORD THAT CAME FROM THE LORD TO JEREMIAS, WHEN KING SEDEKIAS SENT TO HIM PASCHOR THE SON OF MELCHIAS, AND SOPHONIAS SON OF BASAEAS, THE PRIEST, SAYING, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Enquire of the Lord for us; for the king of Babylon has risen up against us; if the Lord will do according to all his wonderful works, and [the king] shall depart from us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And Jeremias said to them, Thus shall you⌃ say to Sedekias king of Juda, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Thus says the Lord; Behold, I [will] turn back the weapons of war wherewith you⌃ fight against the Chaldeans that have besieged you from outside the wall, and I will gather them into the midst of this city. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And I will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, with wrath and great anger. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And I will strike all the dwellers in this city, [both] men and cattle, with grievous pestilence: and they shall die. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And after this, thus says the Lord; I will give Sedekias king of Juda, and his servants, and the people that is left in this city from the pestilence, and from the famine, and from the sword, into the hands of their enemies, that seek their lives: and they shall cut them in pieces with the edge of the sword: I will not spare them, and I will not have compassion upon them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And you shall say to this people, Thus says the Lord; Behold, I have set before you the way of life, and the way of death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} He that remains in this city shall die by the sword, and by famine: but he that goes forth to advance to the Chaldeans that have besieged you, shall live, and his life shall be to him for a spoil, and he shall live. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For I have set my face against this city for evil, and not for good: it shall be delivered into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he shall consume it with fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} O house of the king of Juda, hear you⌃ the word of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} O house of David, thus says the Lord; Judge judgment in the morning, and act rightly, and rescue the spoiled one from the hand of him that wrongs him, lest my anger be kindled like fire, and it burn, and there be none to quench [it]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Behold, I am against you that dwell in the valley of Sor; in the plain country, [even against] them that say, Who shall alarm us? or who shall enter into our habitation? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And I will kindle a fire in the forest thereof, and it shall devour all things round about it.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 22}
\markright{JEREMIAS 22}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Thus says the Lord; Go you, and go down to the house of the king of Juda, and you shall speak there this word, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} and you shall say, Hear the word of the Lord, O king of Juda, that sit on the throne of David, you, and your house, and your people, and they that go in at these gates: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} thus says the Lord; Execute you⌃ judgment and justice, and rescue the spoiled out of the hand of him that wrongs him: and oppress not the stranger, and orphan, and widow, and sin not, and shed no innocent blood in this place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For if you⌃ will indeed perform this word, then shall there enter in by the gates of this house kings sitting upon the throne of David, and riding on chariots and horses, they, and their servants, and their people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} But if you⌃ will not perform these words, by myself have I sworn, says the Lord, that this house shall be [brought] to desolation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} For thus says the Lord concerning the house of the king of Juda; You are Galaad to me, [and] the head of Libanus: [yet] surely I will make you a desert, [even] cities that shall not be inhabited: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} and I will bring upon you a destroying man, and his axe: and they shall cut down your choice cedars, and cast [them] into the fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And nations shall pass through this city, and each shall say to his neighbor, Why has the Lord done thus to this great city? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And they shall say, Because they forsook the covenant of the Lord their God, and worshipped strange gods, and served them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Weep not for the dead, nor lament for him: weep bitterly for him that goes away: for he shall return no more, nor see his native land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For thus says the Lord concerning Sellem the son of Josias, who reigns in the place of Josias his father, who has gone forth out of this place; He shall not return there any more: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} but in that place whither I have carried him captive, there shall he die, and shall see this land no more. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} He that builds his house not with justice, and his upper chambers not with judgment, who works by means of his neighbor for nothing, and will by no means give him his reward. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} You have built for yourself a well-proportioned house, airy chambers, fitted with windows, and wainscoted with cedar, and painted with vermilion. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Shall you reign, because you are provoked with your father Achaz? they shall not eat, and they shall not drink: it is better for you to execute judgment and justice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} They understood not, they judged not the cause of the afflicted, nor the cause of the poor: is not this your not knowing me? says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Behold, your eyes are not good, nor your heart, but [they go] after your covetousness, and after the innocent blood to shed it, and after acts of injustice and slaughter, to commit them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Therefore thus says the Lord concerning Joakim son of Josias, king of Juda, even concerning this man; they shall not bewail him, [saying], Ah brother! neither shall they at all weep for him, [saying], Alas Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} He shall be buried with the burial of an ass; he shall be dragged roughly along and cast outside the gate of Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Go up to Libanus, and cry; and utter your voice to Basan, and cry aloud to the extremity of the sea: for all your lovers are destroyed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} I spoke to you on [occasion of] your trespass, but you said, I will not listen. This [has been] your way from your youth, you have not listened to my voice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} The wind shall tend all your shepherds, and your lovers shall go into captivity; for then shall you be ashamed and disgraced because of all your lovers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} O you that dwell in Libanus, making your nest in the cedars, you shall groan heavily, when pangs as of a travailing woman are come upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} [As] I live, says the Lord, though Jechonias son of Joakim king of Juda were indeed the seal upon my right hand, thence would I pluck you; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} and I will deliver you into the hands of them that seek your life, before whom you are afraid, into the hands of the Chaldeans. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And I will cast forth you, and your mother that bore you, into a land where you were not born; and there you⌃ shall die. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} But they shall by no means return to the land which they long for in their souls. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Jechonias is dishonored as a good-for-nothing vessel; for he is thrown out and cast forth into a land which he knew not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Land, land, hear the word of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Write you⌃ this man an outcast: for there shall none of his seed at all grow up to sit on the throne of David, [or as] a prince yet in Juda.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} am cir, 3406, bc cir, 598 Go \textsuperscript{3} Execute, ; do no wrong do no violence, ; neither \textsuperscript{4} then upon the throne of David Heb. for David upon his throne \textsuperscript{6} unto; Thou Gilead was the most fertile part of the country, and renowned for its rich pastures; and Lebanon was the highest mountain in Israel, celebrated for its stately cedars; and both were, therefore, proper emblems of the reigning family. "But though thou art the richest and most powerful, I, who raised thee up, can bring thee down, and make thee a wilderness." surely \textsuperscript{14} I will; large Heb. through-aired windows or, my windows ceiled with cedar \textsuperscript{15} thy; eat; and do, ; , ; then \textsuperscript{17} thine eyes; covetousness; to shed; violence or, incursion \textsuperscript{21} I spake, ; prosperity Heb. prosperities This \textsuperscript{22} wind; thy pastors, ; thy lovers surely \textsuperscript{23} inhabitant Heb. inhabitress Lebanon; makest, ; how, ;, when \textsuperscript{24} Coniah; Jehoiachin, Jeconiah, the signet \textsuperscript{27} to the, ; desire Heb. lift up their mind \textsuperscript{28} Is, This appears to be the application of the whole discourse to Zedekiah; for it is to be observed, that Jeconiah is spoken of as absent, and already in captivity. Now if he and his seed had been for their sins thrown aside as a broken idol, or as a vessel which a man despises, how could Zedekiah, who copied and far exceeded them, expect to prosper on the throne of David? Coniah a despised; his seed; which \textsuperscript{30} Write Zedekiah was taken prisoner by Nebuchadnezzar; his sons slain before his eyes; and his eyes being put out, he was carried to Babylon; and we read no more either of him or his posterity.; sitting\par}

\subsection*{Jeremias 23}
\markright{JEREMIAS 23}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Woe to the shepherds that destroy and scatter the sheep of their pasture! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Therefore thus says the Lord against them that tend my people; You⌃ have scattered my sheep, and driven them out, and you⌃ have not visited them: behold, I [will] take vengeance upon you according to your evil practices. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I will gather in the remnant of my people in every land, whither I have driven them out, and will set them in their pasture; and they shall increase and be multiplied. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And I will raise up shepherds to them, who shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be alarmed, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Behold, the days come, says the Lord, when I will raise up to David a righteous branch, and a king shall reign and understand, and shall execute judgment and righteousness on the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} In his days both Juda shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell securely: and this is his name, which the Lord shall call him, Josedec among the prophets. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Therefore, behold, the days come, says the Lord, when they shall no more say, The Lord lives, who brought up the house of Israel out of the land of Egypt; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} but The Lord lives, who has gathered the whole seed of Israel from the north land, and from all the countries whither he [had] driven them out, and has restored them into their own land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} My heart is broken within me; all my bones are shaken: I am become as a broken-down man, and as a man overcome with wine, because of the Lord, and because of the excellence of his glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For because of these things the land mourns; the pastures of the wilderness are dried up; and their course is become evil, and so [also] their strength. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For priest and prophet are defiled; and I have seen their iniquities in my house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Therefore let their way be to them slippery and dark: and they shall be tripped up and fall in it: for I will bring evils upon them, in the year of their visitation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And in the prophets of Samaria I have seen lawless deeds; they prophesied by Baal, and led my people Israel astray. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Also in the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen horrible things: as they committed adultery, and walked in lies, and strengthened the hands of many, that they should not return each from his evil way: they are all become to me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrha. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Therefore thus says the Lord; Behold, I will feed them with pain, and give them bitter water to drink: for from the prophets of Jerusalem has defilement gone forth [into] all the land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Thus says the Lord Almighty, Listen not to the words of the prophets: for they frame a vain vision for themselves; they speak from their own heart, and not from the mouth of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} They say to them that reject the word of the Lord, There shall be peace to you; and to all that walk after their own lusts, and to everyone that walks in the error of his heart, they have said, No evil shall come upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} For who has stood in the counsel of the Lord, and seen his word? who has listened, and heard? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Behold, [there is] an earthquake from the Lord, and anger proceeds to a convulsion, it shall come violently upon the ungodly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And the Lord's wrath shall return no more, until he have accomplished it, and until he have established it, according to the purpose of his heart: at the end of the days they shall understand it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} I sent not the prophets, yet they ran: neither spoke I to them, yet they prophesied. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} But if they had stood in my counsel, and if they had listened to my words, then would they have turned my people from their evil practices. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} I am a God near at hand, says the Lord, and not a God afar off. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Shall any one hide himself in secret places, and I not see him? Do I not fill heaven and earth? says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} I have heard what the prophets say, what they prophesy in my name, saying falsely, I have seen a night vision. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} How long shall [these things] be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies, when they prophesy the purposes of their own heart? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} who devise that [men] may forget my law by their dreams, which they have told every one to his neighbor, as their fathers forgot my name in [the worship of] Baal. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} The prophet who has a dream, let him tell his dream; and [he] in whom is my word [spoken] to him, let him tell my word truly: what is the chaff to the corn? so are my words, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Behold, are not my words as fire? says the Lord; and as an axe cutting the rock? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Behold, I am therefore against the prophets, says the Lord God, that steal my words every one from his neighbor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Behold, I am against the prophets that put forth prophecies of mere words, and slumber their sleep. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Therefore, behold, I am against the prophets that prophesy false dreams, and have not told them [truly], and have caused my people to err by their lies, and by their errors; yet I sent them not, and commanded them not; therefore, they shall not profit this people at all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And if this people, or the priest, or the prophet, should ask, What is the burden of the Lord? then you shall say to them, You⌃ are the burden, and I will dash you down, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} [As for] the prophet, and the priests, and the people, who shall say, The burden of the Lord, I will even take vengeance on that man, and on his house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Thus shall you⌃ say every one to his neighbor, and every one to his brother, What has the Lord answered? and, what has the Lord said? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And do you⌃ name no more the burden of the Lord; for his own word shall be a man's burden. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} But therefore, [say you⌃], has the Lord our God spoken? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Therefore thus says the Lord our God; Because you⌃ have spoken this word, The burden of the Lord, and I sent to you, saying, you⌃ shall not say, The burden of the Lord; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} therefore, behold, I [will] seize, and dash down you and the city which I gave to you and your fathers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And I will bring upon you an everlasting reproach, and everlasting disgrace, which shall not be forgotten.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 24}
\markright{JEREMIAS 24}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The Lord showed me two baskets of figs, lying in front of the temple of the Lord, after Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon had carried captive Jechonias son of Joakim king of Juda, and the princes, and the artificers, and the prisoners, and the rich men out of Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The one basket was [full] of very good figs, as the early figs; and the other basket was [full] of very bad figs, which could not be eaten, for their badness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And the Lord said to me, What see you, Jeremias? and I said, Figs; the good figs, very good; and the bad, very bad, which can’t be eaten, for their badness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel; As these good figs, so will I acknowledge the Jews that have been carried away captive, whom I have sent forth out of this place into the land of the Chaldeans for good. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And I will fix my eyes upon them for good, and I will restore them into this land for good: and I will build them up, and not pull them down; and I will plant them, and not pluck them up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I will give them a heart to know me, that I am the Lord: and they shall be to me a people, and I will be to them a God: for they shall turn to me with all their heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And as the bad figs, which can’t be eaten, for their badness; thus says the Lord, So will I deliver Sedekias king of Juda, and his nobles, and the remnant of Jerusalem, them that are left in this land, and the dwellers in Egypt. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And I will cause them to be dispersed into all the kingdoms of the earth, and they shall be for a reproach, and a proverb, and an [object of] hatred, and a curse, in every place whither I have driven them out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And I will send against them famine, and pestilence, and the sword, until they are consumed from off the land which I gave them.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 25}
\markright{JEREMIAS 25}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} THE WORD THAT CAME TO JEREMIAS concerning all the people of Juda in the fourth year of Joakim, son of Josias, king of Juda; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} which he spoke to all the people of Juda, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} In the thirteenth year of Josias, son of Amos, king of Juda, even until this day for three and twenty years, I have both spoken to you, rising early and speaking, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} and I sent to you my servants the prophets, sending them early; (but you⌃ listened not, and listened not with your ears;) saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Turn you⌃ every one from his evil way, and from your evil practices, and you⌃ shall dwell in the land which I gave to you and your fathers, of old and for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Go you⌃ not after strange gods, to serve them, and to worship them, that you⌃ provoke me not by the works of your hands, to do you hurt. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} But you⌃ listened not to me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Therefore thus says the Lord; Since you⌃ believed not my words, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} behold I [will] send and take a family from the north, and will bring them against this land, and against the inhabitants of it, and against all the nations round about it, and I will make them utterly waste, and make them a desolation, and a hissing, and an everlasting reproach. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And I will destroy from [among] them the voice of joy, and the voice of gladness, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the scent of ointment, and the light of a candle. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And all the land shall be a desolation; and they shall serve among the Gentiles seventy years. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And when the seventy years are fulfilled, I will take vengeance on that nation, and will make them a perpetual desolation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And I will bring upon that land all my words which I have spoken against it, [even] all things that are written in this book. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} THE PROPHECIES OF JEREMIAS AGAINST THE NATIONS OF AeLAM. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Thus says the Lord, The bow of Aelam is broken, [even] the chief of their power. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And I will bring upon Aelam the four winds from the four corners of heaven, and I will disperse them toward all these winds; and there shall be no nation [to] which they shall not come—[even] the outcasts of Aelam. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And I will put them in fear before their enemies that seek their life; and I will bring evils upon them according to my great anger; and I will send forth my sword after them, until I have utterly destroyed them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And I will set my throne in Aelam, and will send forth thence king and rulers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} But it shall come to pass at the end of days, that I will turn the captivity of Aelam, says the Lord.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} am 3398, bc 606 in the; the first Nebuchadnezzar was associated with his father Nabopollasar two years before the death of the latter; and from this time the Jewish computation of Nebuchadnezzar's reign begins; that is, from the end of the third year of Jehoiakim; and therefore, according to them, the fourth year of Jehoiakim was the first year of Nebuchadnezzar. But the Babylonians date the commencement of his reign two years later, that is, on the death of his father; which computation is followed by Daniel, who wrote in Chaldee. \textsuperscript{4} all Urijah the son of Shemaiah, and Huldah the prophetess, lived about this time. \subsection*{Jeremias 26}
\markright{JEREMIAS 26}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} In the beginning of the reign of king Sedekias, there came this word concerning Aelam. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} FOR EGYPT, AGAINST THE POWER OF PHARAO NECHAO KING OF EGYPT, who was by the river Euphrates in Charmis, whom Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon struck in the fourth year of Joakim king of Juda. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Take up arms and spears, and draw near to battle; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} and harness the horses: mount, you⌃ horsemen, and stand ready in your helmets; advance the spears, and put on your breastplates. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Why do they fear, and turn back? even because their mighty men shall be slain: they have utterly fled, and being hemmed in they have not rallied, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Let not the swift flee, and let not the mighty man escape to the north: the [forces] at Euphrates are become feeble, and they have fallen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Who is this [that] shall come up as a river, and as rivers roll [their] waves? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} The waters of Egypt shall come up like a river: and he said, I will go up, and will cover the earth, and will destroy the dwellers in it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Mount you⌃ the horses, prepare the chariots; go forth, you⌃ warriors of the Ethiopians, and Libyans armed with shields; and mount, you⌃ Lydians, bend the bow. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And that day [shall be] to the Lord our God a day of vengeance, to take vengeance on his enemies: and the sword of the Lord shall devour, and be glutted, and be drunken with their blood: for the Lord [has] a sacrifice from the land of the north at the river Euphrates. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Go up to Galaad, and take balm for the virgin daughter of Egypt: in vain have you multiplied your medicines; there is no help in you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} The nations have heard your voice, and the land has been filled with your cry: for the warriors have fainted fighting one against another, [and] both are fallen together. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} THE WORDS WHICH THE LORD SPOKE by Jeremias, concerning the coming of the king of Babylon to strike the land of Egypt. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Proclaim [it] at Magdol, and declare [it] at Memphis: say you⌃, Stand up, and prepare; for the sword has devoured your yew tree. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Therefore has Apis fled from you? your choice calf has not remained; for the Lord has utterly weakened him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And your multitude has fainted and fallen; and each one said to his neighbor, Let us arise, and return into our country to our people, from the Grecian sword. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Call you⌃ the name of Pharao Nechao king of Egypt, Saon esbeie moed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} [As] I live, says the Lord God, he shall come as Itabyrion among the mountains, and as Carmel that is on the sea. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} O daughter of Egypt dwelling [at home], prepare you stuff for removing: for Memphis shall be utterly desolate, and shall be called Woe, because there are no inhabitants in it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Egypt is a fair heifer, [but] destruction from the north is come upon her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Also her hired [soldiers] in the midst of her are as fatted calves fed in her; for they also have turned, and fled with one accord: they stood not, for the day of destruction was come upon them, and the time of their retribution. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Their voice is as [that] of a hissing serpent, for they go upon the sand; they shall come upon Egypt with axes, as men that cut wood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} They shall cut down her forest, says the Lord, for [their number] can’t at all be conjectured, for it exceeds the locust in multitude, and they are innumerable. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} The daughter of Egypt is confounded; she is delivered into the hands of a people from the north. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Behold, I [will] avenge Ammon her son upon Pharao, and upon them that trust in him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} But fear not you, my servant Jacob, neither be you alarmed, Israel: for, behold, I will save you from afar, and your seed from their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and be at ease, and sleep, and there shall be no one to trouble him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Fear not you, my servant Jacob, says the Lord; for I am with you: she [that was] without fear and in luxury, has been delivered up: for I will make a full end of every nation among whom I have thrust you forth; but I will not cause you to fail: yet will I chastise you in the way of judgment, and will not hold you entirely guiltless.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} Stand, ; , court This was the great outer court, where the people assembled for the purpose of religious worship on ordinary occasions, when they brought no sacrifices; but when they offered a sacrifice, they were to bring it into the inner court, or that of the priests. all the words; diminish \textsuperscript{3} so; that I, see note on \textsuperscript{5} my, ;, ; whom See note on \textsuperscript{6} will I See note on; a curse \textsuperscript{9} Why; , And all;, ; in the \textsuperscript{10} the princes, ; in the entry or, at the door the new \textsuperscript{11} saying; This man is worthy to die Heb. The judgment of death is for this man for he \textsuperscript{13} amend See note on, ; repent \textsuperscript{14} As for; as seemeth good and meet unto you Heb. as it is good and right in your eyes \textsuperscript{18} Micah Zion Josephus relates that Titus, after he had taken Jerusalem, ordered his soldiers to demolish it, except three of the largest and most beautiful towers, and the western wall of the city; all the rest was levelled, so that they who had never before seen it, could scarcely persuade themselves it had been inhabited. The Jewish writers also inform us, that Turnus Rufus, whom Titus had left in command, ploughed up the very foundations of the temple. When Dr. Richardson visited this sacred spot in 1818, he found one part of Mount Zion supporting a crop of barley, and another undergoing the labour of the plough. The soil turned up consisted of stone and lime mixed with earth, such as is usually met with in foundations of ruined cities. It is nearly a mile in circumference; is highest on the west side, and, towards the east, falls down in broad terraces on the upper part of the mountain as it slopes down toward the brook Kidron. \subsection*{Jeremias 27}
\markright{JEREMIAS 27}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} THE WORD OF THE LORD WHICH HE SPOKE AGAINST BABYLON. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Proclaim you⌃ among the Gentiles, and cause the tidings to be heard, and suppress [them] not: say you⌃, Babylon is taken, Belus is confounded; the fearless, the luxurious Maerodach is delivered up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For a nation has come up against her from the north, he shall utterly ravage her land, and there shall be none to dwell in it, neither man nor beast. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} In those days, and at that time, the children of Israel shall come, they and the children of Juda together; they shall proceed, weeping as they go, seeking the Lord their God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} They shall ask the way till [they come to] Sion, for that way shall they set their face; and they shall come and flee for refuge to the Lord their God; for the everlasting covenant shall not be forgotten. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} My people have been lost sheep: their shepherds thrust them out, they caused them to wander on the mountains: they went from mountain to hill, they forgot their resting-place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} All that found them consumed them: their enemies said, Let us not leave them alone, because they have sinned against the Lord: he that gathered their fathers [had] a pasture of righteousness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Flee you⌃ out of the midst of Babylon, and from the land of the Chaldeans, and go forth, and be as serpents before sleep. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For, behold, I stir up against Babylon the gatherings of nations out of the land of the north; and they shall set themselves in array against her: thence shall she be taken, as the dart of an expert warrior shall not return empty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And Chaldea shall be a spoil: all that spoil her shall be satisfied. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Because you⌃ rejoiced, and boasted, [while] plundering my heritage; because you⌃ exulted as calves in the grass, and pushed with the horn as bulls. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Your mother is greatly ashamed; your mother that bore you for prosperity is confounded: [she is] the last of the nations, desolate, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} by reason of the Lord's anger: it shall not be inhabited, but it shall be all a desolation; and every one that passes through Babylon shall scowl, and they shall hiss at all her plague. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Set yourselves in array against Babylon round about, all you⌃ that bend the bow; shoot at her, spare not your arrows, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} and prevail against her: her hands are weakened, her bulwarks are fallen, and her wall is broken down: for it is vengeance from God: take vengeance upon her; as she has done, do to her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Utterly destroy seed out of Babylon, [and] him that holds a sickle in time of harvest: for fear of the Grecian sword, they shall return every one to his people, and every one shall flee to his own land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Israel is a wandering sheep; the lions have driven him out: the king of Assyria first devoured him, and afterward this king of Babylon [has gnawed] his bones. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Therefore thus says the Lord; Behold, I [will] take vengeance on the king of Babylon, and upon his land, as I took vengeance on the king of Assyria. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And I will restore Israel to his pasture, and he shall feed on Carmel and on mount Ephraim and in Galaad, and his soul shall be satisfied. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} In those days, and at that time, they shall seek for the iniquity of Israel, and there shall be none; and for the sins of Juda, and they shall not be found: for I will be merciful to them that are left {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} on the land, says the Lord. Go up against it roughly, and against them that dwell on it: avenge, O sword, and destroy utterly, says the Lord, and do according to all that I command you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} A sound of war, and great destruction in the land of the Chaldeans! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} How is the hammer of the whole earth broken and crushed! How is Babylon become a desolation among the nations! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} They shall come upon you, and you shall not know it, Babylon, that you will even be taken captive: you are found and taken, because you did resist the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} The Lord has opened his treasury, and brought forth the weapons of his anger: for the Lord God [has] a work in the land of the Chaldeans. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} For her times are come: open you⌃ her storehouses: search her as a cave, and utterly destroy her: let there be no remnant of her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Dry you⌃ up all her fruits, and let them go down to the slaughter: woe to them! for their day is come, and the time of their retribution. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} A voice of men fleeing and escaping from the land of Babylon, to declare to Sion the vengeance [that comes] from the Lord our God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Summon many against Babylon, [even] every one that bends the bow: camp against her round about; let no one of her [people] escape: render to her according to her works; according to all that she has done, do to her: for she has resisted the Lord, the Holy God of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Therefore shall her young men fall in the streets, and all her warriors shall be cast down, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Behold, I am against you the haughty one, says the Lord: for your day is come, and the time of your retribution. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And your pride shall fail, and fall, and there shall be no one to set it up again: and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it shall devour all things round about her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Thus says the Lord; The children of Israel and the children of Juda have been oppressed: all they that have taken them captive have oppressed them together; for they would not let them go. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} But their Redeemer is strong; the Lord Almighty is his name: he will enter into judgment with his adversaries, that he may destroy the earth; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} and he will sharpen a sword against the Chaldeans, and against the inhabitants of Babylon, and upon her nobles and upon her wise men; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} a sword upon her warriors, and they shall be weakened: a sword upon their horses, and upon their chariots: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} a sword upon their warriors and upon the mixed people in the midst of her; and they shall be as women: a sword upon the treasures, and they shall be scattered upon her water, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} and they shall be ashamed: for it is a land of graven [images]; and in the islands, where they boasted. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} Therefore shall idols dwell in the islands, and the young of monsters shall dwell in it: it shall not be inhabited any more for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} As God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities bordering upon them, says the Lord: no man shall dwell there, and no son of man shall sojourn there. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} Behold, a people comes from the north, and a great nation, and many kings shall be stirred up from the end of the earth; holding bow and dagger: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} [the people] is fierce, and will have no mercy: their voices shall sound as the sea, they shall ride upon horses, prepared for war, like fire, against you, O daughter of Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} The king of Babylon heard the sound of them, and his hands were enfeebled: anguish overcame him, pangs as of a woman in travail. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} Behold, he shall come up as a lion from Jordan to Gaethan; for I will speedily drive them from her, and I will set all the youths against her: for who is like me? and who will resist me? and who is this shepherd who will stand before me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} Therefore hear you⌃ the counsel of the Lord, which he has taken against Babylon; and his devices, which he has devised upon the Chaldeans inhabiting [it]: surely lambs of their flock shall be destroyed: surely pasture shall be cut off from them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} For at the sound of the taking of Babylon the earth shall quake, and a cry shall be heard among the nations.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} saith the Lord or, hath the Lord said, Make, put, ; Ezek. 4:1-5:17 \textsuperscript{4} to say unto their masters, Thus or, concerning their masters, saying Thus the Lord \textsuperscript{6} I given all; my, ; and \textsuperscript{8} And it There is a peculiar grandeur, as well as propriety, in this method of predicting Nebuchadnezzar's rapid successes. The God of Israel, declaring himself to be the Lord of armies, and the Creator and Owner of the whole earth, with all its inhabitants and productions, and claiming full sovereignty over his creatures, avows his determination, for reasons he does not deign to assign, to give all the countries of the world to the king of Babylon, whom he calls his servant, because he would accomplish an important part of his most righteous designs. They, therefore, who would escape the most dreadful judgments, must submit to the God of Israel, by submitting to Nebuchadnezzar; they must hearken to the prophets of Israel, and not to their own diviners; and they must observe, that Nebuchadnezzar, his son, and his grandson, would whatever opposition should be made, possess the full dominion of all these countries, till the appointed time was expired; and then, these haughty conquerors would in their turn become the prey of other powerful conquerors; all of which was most exactly fulfilled. that nation, ; with the sword \textsuperscript{9} hearken, ; *marg.; dreamers Heb. dreams \textsuperscript{15} a lie Heb. in a lie, or lyingly that I; ye\par}

\subsection*{Jeremias 28}
\markright{JEREMIAS 28}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Thus says the Lord; Behold, I stir up against Babylon, and against the Chaldeans dwelling therein, a deadly burning wind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And I will send forth against Babylon spoilers, and they shall spoil her, and shall ravage her land. Woe to Babylon round about [her] in the day of her affliction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Let the archer bend his bow, and him that has armor put it on: and spare you⌃ not her young men, but destroy you⌃ all her host. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And slain men shall fall in the land of the Chaldeans, and [men] pierced through shall fall without it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For Israel and Juda have not been forsaken of their God, of the Lord Almighty; whereas their land was filled with iniquity against the holy things of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Flee you⌃ out of the midst of Babylon, and deliver every one his soul: and be not overthrown in her iniquity; for it is the time of her retribution from the Lord; he is rendering to her a recompence. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Babylon has been a golden cup in the Lord's hand, causing all the earth to be drunken: the nations have drunk of her wine; therefore they were shaken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And Babylon is fallen suddenly, and is broken to pieces: lament for her; take balm for her deadly wound, if by any means she may be healed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} We tried to heal Babylon, but she was not healed: let us forsake her, and depart every one to his own country: for her judgment has reached to the heaven, it has mounted up to the stars. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} The Lord has brought forth his judgment: come, and let us declare in Sion the works of the Lord our God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Prepare the arrows; fill the quivers: the Lord has stirred up the spirit of the king of the Medes: for his wrath is against Babylon, to destroy it utterly; for it is the Lord's vengeance, it is the vengeance of his people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Lift up a standard on the walls of Babylon, prepare the quivers, rouse the guards, prepare the weapons: for the Lord has taken [the work] in hand, and will execute what he has spoken against the inhabitants of Babylon, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} dwelling on many waters, and amidst the abundance of her treasures; your end is come verily into your bowels. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For the Lord has sworn by his arm, [saying, ]I will fill you with men as with locusts; and they that come down shall cry against you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} The Lord made the earth by his power, preparing the world by his wisdom, by his understanding he stretched out the heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} At [his] voice he makes a sound of water in the heaven, and brings up clouds from the extremity of the earth; he makes lightnings for rain, and brings light out of his treasures. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Every man has completely lost understanding; every goldsmith is confounded because of his graven [images]: for they have cast false [gods], there is no breath in them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} They are vain works, objects of scorn; in the time of their visitation they shall perish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Not such is Jacob's portion; for he that formed all things, he is his inheritance; the Lord is his name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} You scatter for me the weapons of war: and I will scatter nations by you, and will destroy kings by means of you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And by you I will scatter the horse and his rider; and by you I will scatter chariots and them that ride in them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And by you I will scatter youth and maid; and by you I will scatter man and woman. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And by you I will scatter the shepherd and his flock; and by you I will scatter the husbandman and his husbandry; and by you I will scatter leaders and the captains. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And I will recompense to Babylon and to all the Chaldeans that dwell [there] all their mischiefs that they have done to Sion before your eyes, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Behold, I am against you, the ruined mountain, that destroys the whole earth; and I will stretch out my hand upon you, and will roll you down upon the rocks, and will make you as a burnt mountain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And they shall not take from you a stone for a corner, nor a stone for a foundation: for you shall be a desolation for ever, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Lift up a standard in the land, sound the trumpet among the nations, consecrate the nations against her, raise up kings against her by me, and [that] for the people of Achanaz; set against her engines of war; bring up against her horses as a multitude of locusts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Bring up nations against her, [even] the king of the Medes and of the whole earth, his rulers, and all his captains. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} The earth has quaked and been troubled, because the purpose of the Lord has risen up against Babylon, to make the land of Babylon a desolation, and uninhabitable. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} The warrior of Babylon has failed to fight; they shall sit there in the siege; their power is broken; they are become like women; her tabernacles have been set on fire; her bars are broken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} One shall rush, running to meet [another] runner, and one [shall go] with tidings to meet [another] with tidings, to bring tidings to the king of Babylon, that his city is taken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} At the end of his passages they were taken, and his cisterns they have burnt with fire, and his warriors are going forth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} For thus says the Lord, The houses of the king of Babylon shall be threshed as a floor in the season; yet a little while, and her harvest shall come. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} He has devoured me, he has torn me asunder, airy darkness has come upon me; Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon has swallowed me up, as a dragon has he filled his belly with my delicacies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} My troubles and my distresses have driven me out into Babylon, shall she that dwells in Sion say; and my blood [shall be] upon the Chaldeans dwelling [there], shall Jerusalem say. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Therefore thus says the Lord, Behold, I will judge your adversary, and I will execute vengeance for you; and I will waste her sea, and dry up her fountain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And Babylon shall be a desolation, and shall not be inhabited. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} For they rose up together as lions, and as lions' whelps. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} In their heat I will give them a draught, and make them drunk, that they may be stupified, and sleep an everlasting sleep, and not awake, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And bring you them down as lambs to the slaughter, and rams with kids. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} How has the boast of all the earth been taken and caught in a snare! how has Babylon become a desolation among the nations! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} The sea has come up upon Babylon with the sound of its waves, and she is covered. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} Her cities are become like a dry and trackless land; not so much as one [man] shall dwell in it, neither shall a son of man lodge in it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And I will take vengeance on Babylon, and bring forth out of her mouth what she has swallowed down, and the nations shall no more be gathered to her: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} and in Babylon the slain men of all the earth shall fall. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} Go forth of the land, you⌃ that escape, and stay not; you⌃ that are afar off, remember the Lord, and let Jerusalem come into your mind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} We are ashamed, because we have heard our reproach; disgrace has covered our face; aliens are come into our sanctuary, [even] into the house of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} Therefore, behold, the days come, says the Lord, when I will take vengeance upon her graven [images]: and slain men shall fall in all her land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} For though Babylon should go up as the heaven, and though she should strengthen her walls with her power, from me shall come they that shall destroy her, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{54}} A sound of a cry in Babylon, and great destruction in the land of the Chaldeans: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{55}} for the Lord has utterly destroyed Babylon, and cut off from her the great voice sounding as many waters: he has consigned her voice to destruction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{56}} For distress has come upon Babylon, her warriors are taken, their bows are useless: for God recompenses them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{57}} The Lord recompenses, and will make her leaders and her wise men and her captains completely drunk, says the King, the Lord Almighty is his name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{58}} Thus says the Lord, The wall of Babylon was made broad, but it shall be completely broken down, and her high gates shall be burnt with fire; and the peoples shall not labor in vain, nor the nations fail in [their] rule. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{59}} THE WORD WHICH THE LORD COMMANDED THE PROPHET JEREMIAS to say to Saraeas son of Nerias, son of Maasaeas, when he went from Sedekias king of Juda to Babylon, in the fourth year of his reign. And Saraeas was over the bounties. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{60}} And Jeremias wrote in a book all the evils which should come upon Babylon, [even] all these words that are written against Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{61}} And Jeremias said to Saraeas, When you are come to Babylon, and shall see and read all these words; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{62}} then you shall say, O Lord God, you have spoken against this place, to destroy it, and that there should be none to dwell in it, neither man nor beast; for it shall be a desolation for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{63}} And it shall come to pass, when you shall cease from reading this book, that you shall bind a stone upon it, and cast it into the midst of Euphrates; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{64}} and shall say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and not rise, because of the evils which I bring upon it.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} the same Hananiah, the prophet \textsuperscript{3} two full years Heb. two years of days, ; all the that \textsuperscript{4} I will bring This was doubtless grateful news to the people, who looked upon Zedekiah only as Nebuchadnezzar's deputy. Hananiah seems to have been more desirous of popular than regal favour; for this prediction could not be altogether agreeable to Zedekiah. But he was evidently a weak as well as a wicked prince, and very generally despised. Jeconiah, Coniah, ; Jehoiachin captives Heb. captivity, *marg. I will break \textsuperscript{8} The prophets As Hosea, Joel, Amos, Isaiah, Micah, Nahum, Habakkuk, Zephaniah, and others, all of whom had denounced similar evils against a corrupt people. So that they who opposed Jeremiah also opposed those who preceded him; and it was altogether unprecedented for a true prophet to promise deliverance to a guilty nation, without calling them to repentance. prophesied;, ;, ; Nahum 1:1-3:19 \textsuperscript{13} Thou hast; thou shalt By encouraging an unavailing resistance to Nebuchadnezzar. \textsuperscript{14} I have put, ; that they; and I \textsuperscript{15} The Lord This was a bold speech, in the presence of those priests and people who were prejudiced in favour of the false prophets, who prophesied to them smooth things. \textsuperscript{16} I will; this year; because; rebellion Heb. revolt; *marg. \textsuperscript{17} Hananiah; the seventh month The prophecy was delivered in the fifth month ( ), and Hananiah died in the seventh month; exactly two months after he had delivered his false prophecy, which he declared, in the name of God, would be fulfilled in two years. Here then the true prophet was demonstrated, and the false prophet detected. The death of Hananiah, thus predicted, was God's seal to the words of His prophet, and must have gained his other predictions great credit among the people; though it is evident that it did not induce them to forsake their sins and return to the God of Israel.\par}

\subsection*{Jeremias 29}
\markright{JEREMIAS 29}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} THUS SAITH THE LORD AGAINST THE PHILISTINES; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Behold, waters come up from the north, and shall become a sweeping torrent, and it shall sweep away the land, and its fulness; the city, and them that dwell in it: and men shall cry and all that dwell in the land shall howl, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} at the sound of his rushing, at [the sound of] his hoofs, and at the rattling of his chariots, at the noise of his wheels: the fathers turned not to their children because of the weakness of their hands, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} in the day that is coming to destroy all the Philistines: and I will utterly destroy Tyre and Sidon and all the rest of their allies: for the Lord will destroy the remaining [inhabitants] of the islands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Baldness is come upon Gaza; Ascalon is cast away, and the remnant of the Enakim. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} How long will you strike, O sword of the Lord? how long will it be ere you are quiet? return into your sheath, rest, and be removed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} How shall it be quiet, whereas the Lord has given it a commission against Ascalon, and against the regions on the sea-coast, to awake against the remaining [countries]! CONCERNING IDUMEA, thus says the Lord; There is no longer wisdom in Thaeman, counsel has perished from the wise ones, their wisdom is gone, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} their place has been deceived. Dig deep for a dwelling, you⌃ that inhabit Daedam, for he has wrought grievously: I brought trouble upon him in the time at which I visited him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For grape gatherers are come, who shall not leave you a remnant; as thieves by night, they shall lay their hand upon [your possessions]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For I have stripped Esau, I have uncovered their secret places; they shall have no power to hide themselves, they have perished [each] by the hand of his brother, my neighbor, and it is impossible {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} for your fatherless one to be left to live, but I shall live, and the widows trust in me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For thus says the Lord; They who were not appointed to drink the cup have drunk [it]; and you shall by no means be cleared: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} for by myself I have sworn, says the Lord, that you shall be in the midst of her an impassable [land], and a reproach, and a curse; and all her cities shall be desert for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} I have heard a report from the Lord, and he has sent messengers to the nations, [saying, ]Assemble yourselves, and come against her; rise you⌃ up to war. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} I have made you small among the nations, utterly contemptible among men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Your insolence has risen up against you, the fierceness of your heart has burst the holes of the rocks, it has seized upon the strength of a lofty hill; for as an eagle he set his nest on high: thence will I bring you down. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And Idumea shall be a desert: every one that passes by shall hiss at it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} As Sodom was overthrown and Gomorrha and they that sojourned in her, says the Lord Almighty, no man shall dwell there, nor shall any son of man inhabit there. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Behold, he shall come up as a lion out of the midst of Jordan to the place of Aetham: for I will speedily drive them from it, and do you⌃ set the young men against her: for who is like me? and who will withstand me? and who [is] this shepherd, who shall confront me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Therefore hear you⌃ the counsel of the Lord, which he has framed against Idumea; and his device, which he has devised against the inhabitants of Thaeman: surely the least of the sheep shall be swept off; surely their dwelling shall be made desolate for them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For at the sound of their fall the earth was scared, and the cry of the sea was not heard. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Behold, he shall look [upon her] as an eagle, and spread forth [his] wings over her strongholds; and the heart of the mighty men of Idumea shall be in that day as the heart of a woman in her pangs.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 30}
\markright{JEREMIAS 30}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} CONCERNING THE SONS OF AMMON thus says the Lord, Are there no sons in Israel? or have they no one to succeed [them]? therefore has Melchol inherited Galaad, and why shall their people dwell in their cities? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Therefore, behold, the days come, says the Lord, when I will cause to be heard in Rabbath a tumult of wars; and they shall become a waste and ruined place, and her altars shall be burned with fire; then shall Israel succeed to his dominion. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Howl, O Esebon, for Gai has perished; cry, you⌃ daughters of Rabbath, gird yourselves with sackcloth, and lament; for Melchol shall go into banishment, his priests and his princes together. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Why do you⌃ exult in the plains of the Enakim, you haughty daughter, that trust in [your] treasures, that say, Who shall come in to me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Behold, I [will] bring terror upon you, says the Lord, from all the country round about you; and you⌃ shall be scattered every one right before him, and there is none to gather you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} CONCERNING DAMASCUS. Emath is brought to shame, and Arphath: for they have heard an evil report: they are amazed, they are angry, they shall be utterly unable to rest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Damascus is utterly weakened, she is put to flight; trembling has seized upon her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} How has she not left my city, they have loved the village? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Therefore shall the young men fall in your streets, and all your warriors shall fall, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Damascus, and it shall devour the streets of the son of Ader. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} CONCERNING KEDAR THE QUEEN OF THE PALACE, WHOM NABUCHODONOSOR KING OF BABYLON SMOTE, thus says the Lord; Arise you⌃, and go up to Kedar, and fill the sons of Kedem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} They shall take their tents and their sheep, they shall take for themselves their garments, and all their baggage and their camels; and summon you⌃ destruction against them from every side. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Flee you⌃, dig very deep for a dwelling-place, you⌃ that dwell in the palace; for the king of Babylon has framed a counsel, and devised a device against you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Rise up, and go up against a nation settled [and] dwelling at ease, who have no doors, nor bolts, nor bars, [who] dwell alone. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And their camels shall be a spoil, and the multitude of their cattle shall be destroyed: and I will scatter them as chaff with every wind, having their hair cut about their foreheads, I will bring on their overthrow from all sides, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And the palace shall be a resting-place for ostriches, and desolate for ever: no man shall abide there, and no son of man shall dwell there.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{3} the days, ; that I, ; and I \textsuperscript{5} a voice, ; , of fear, and not of peace or, there is fear, and not peace \textsuperscript{23} the whirlwind; continuing Heb. cutting fall or, remain\par}
