\subsection*{Jeremias 31}
\markright{JEREMIAS 31}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Thus has the Lord said concerning MOAB, Woe to Nabau! for it has perished: Cariathaim is taken: Amath and Agath are put to shame. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} There is no longer any healing for Moab, [nor] glorying in Esebon: he has devised evils against her: we have cut her off from [being] a nation, and she shall be completely still: after you shall go a sword; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} for [there is] a voice of [men] crying out of Oronaim, destruction and great ruin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Moab is ruined, proclaim [it] to Zogora: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} for Aloth is filled with weeping: one shall go up weeping by the way of Oronaim; you⌃ have heard a cry of destruction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Flee you⌃, and save your lives, and you⌃ shall be as a wild ass in the desert. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Since you have trusted in your strong-hold, therefore you shall be taken: and Chamos shall go forth into captivity, and his priests, and his princes together. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And destruction shall come upon every city, it shall by no means escape; the valley also shall perish, and the plain country shall be completely destroyed, as the Lord has said. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Set marks upon Moab, for she shall be touched with a plague-spot, and all her cities shall become desolate; whence [shall there be] an inhabitant for her? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Cursed is the man that does the works of the Lord carelessly, keeping back his sword from blood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Moab has been at ease from a child, and trusted in his glory; he has not poured out [his liquor] from vessel to vessel, and has not gone into banishment, therefore his taste remained in him, and his smell departed not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Therefore, behold, his days come, says the Lord, when I shall send upon him bad leaders, and they shall lead him astray, and they shall utterly break in pieces his possessions, and shall cut his horns asunder. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And Moab shall be ashamed of Chamos, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Baethel their hope, having trusted in them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} How will you⌃ say, We are strong, and men strong for war? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Moab is ruined, [even] his city, and his choice young men have gone down to slaughter. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} The day of Moab is near at hand, and his iniquity moves swiftly [to vengeance]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Shake [the head] at him, all you⌃ that are round about him; all [of you] utter his name; say you⌃, How is the glorious staff broken to pieces, the rod of magnificence! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Come down from [your] glory, and sit down in a damp place: Daebon shall be broken, because Moab is destroyed: there has gone up against you one to ravage your strong-hold. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Stand by the way, and look, you that dwell in Arer; and ask him that is fleeing, and him that escapes, and say, What has happened? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Moab is put to shame, because he is broken: howl and cry; proclaim in Arnon, that Moab has perished. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And judgment is coming against the land of Misor, upon Chelon, and Rephas, and Mophas, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} and upon Daebon, and upon Nabau, and upon the house of Daethlathaim, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} and upon Cariathaim, and upon the house of Gaemol, and upon the house of Maon, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} and upon Carioth, and upon Bosor, and upon all the cities of Moab, far and near. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} The horn of Moab is broken, and his arm is crushed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Make you⌃ him drunk; for he has magnified himself against the Lord: and Moab shall clap with his hand, and shall be also himself a laughing stock. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} For surely Israel was to you a laughing stock, and was found among your thefts, because you did fight against him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} The inhabitants of Moab have left the cities, and lived in rocks; they have become as doves nestling in rocks, at the mouth of a cave. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And I have heard of the pride of Moab, he has greatly heightened his pride and his haughtiness, and his heart has been lifted up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} But I know his works: is it not enough for him? has he not done thus? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Therefore howl you⌃ for Moab on all sides; cry out against the shorn men [in] a gloomy place. I will weep for you, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} O vine of Aserema, as with the weeping of Jazer: your branches are gone over the sea, they reached the cities of Jazer: destruction has come upon your fruits, [and] upon your grape gatherers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Joy and gladness have been utterly swept off the land of Moab: and [though] there was wine in your presses, in the morning they trod it not, neither in the evening did they raise the cry of joy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} From the cry of Esebon even to Aetam their cities uttered their voice, from Zogor to Oronaim, and their tidings [as] a heifer of three years old, for the water also of Nebrin shall be dried up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And I will destroy Moab, says the Lord, as he comes up to the altar, and burns incense to his gods. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Therefore the heart of Moab shall sound as pipes, my heart shall sound as a pipe for the shorn men; forasmuch as what [every] man has gained has perished from him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} They shall all have their heads shaved in every place, and every beard shall be shaved; and all hands shall beat [the breasts], and on all loins shall be sackcloth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And on all the housetops of Moab, and in his streets [shall be mourning]: for I have broken [him], says the Lord, as a vessel, which is useless. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} How has he changed! how has Moab turned [his] back! Moab is put to shame, and become a laughing stock, and an object of anger to all that are round about him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} For thus said the Lord; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} Carioth is taken, and the strongholds have been taken together. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And Moab shall perish from being a multitude, because he has magnified himself against the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} A snare, and fear, and the pit, are upon you, O inhabitant of Moab. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} He that flees from the terror shall fall into the pit, and he that comes up out of the pit shall even be taken in the snare: for I will bring these things upon Moab in the year of their visitation.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{3} of old Heb. from afar I have, ; an; with lovingkindness have I drawn or, have I extended loving-kindness unto \textsuperscript{4} build, ; O, ; again; tabrets or, timbrels \textsuperscript{5} yet; mountains; eat Heb. profane \textsuperscript{8} I, ; the coasts;, them the \textsuperscript{9} come; supplications or, favours I will;, ; in a, ; for I, ; Ephraim \textsuperscript{12} Therefore;, the height; and shall; wheat; and their, and they \textsuperscript{15} A; Ramah; Rama refused; because \textsuperscript{18} surely; Ephraim, ; Thou hast; as a; turn;, ; for \textsuperscript{19} Surely after; I smote; I was ashamed; , ; I did \textsuperscript{20} Is Ephraim; for; my bowels; are troubled Heb. sound; I will \textsuperscript{21} Set thee, set thine; *marg.; *marg. turn; O \textsuperscript{22} How, ; backsliding, ; created A woman πχαδ ϊρεαα βαψ, literally "A female ('one who is only a woman, not a wife, namely a virgin, ' says Cocceius) shall encompass a man, " or a male child. Comp. . Which, together with the addition of a new creation, may well be understood to denote the miraculous conception. Hence the Jews have applied it determinately to the Messiah. In Berashith Rabba (Parash 89) it is said, that as God punished Israel in a virgin, so would he also heal; and in Midrash Tillim, on, R. Huna, in the name of R. Idi, speaking of the sufferings of the Messiah, says, that when his hour is come, God shall say, "I must create him with a new creation; and so he saith, This day I have begotten thee." \textsuperscript{23} As; The Lord;, O; and mountain \textsuperscript{28} that like; to pluck, so \textsuperscript{32} Not; in the; which; although I was or, should I have continued \textsuperscript{33} But this shall be the I will; and will \textsuperscript{34} teach; Know the; for they;, ; for I \textsuperscript{35} which giveth; , ;, ; which divideth;, ; when; The Lord \textsuperscript{38} the days, that; the tower; the gate \textsuperscript{40} the whole, ; the brook; Cedron unto; shall be; it shall\par}

\subsection*{Jeremias 32}
\markright{JEREMIAS 32}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Thus said the Lord God of Israel; Take the cup of this unmixed wine from my hand, and you shall cause all the nations to drink, to whom I send you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And they shall drink, and vomit, and be mad, because of the sword which I send among them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} So I took the cup out of the Lord's hand, and caused the nations to whom the Lord sent me to drink: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Jerusalem, and the cities of Juda, and the kings of Juda, and his princes, to make them a desert place, a desolation, and a hissing; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} and Pharao king of Egypt, and his servants, and his nobles, and all his people; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} and all the mingled [people], and all the kings of the Philistines, and Ascalon, and Gaza, and Accaron, and the remnant of Azotus, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} and Idumea, and the land of Moab, and the children of Ammon, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} and the kings of Tyre, and the kings of Sidon, and the kings in the [country] beyond the sea, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} and Daedan, and Thaeman, and Ros, and every one that is shaved round about the face, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} and all the mingled [people] lodging in the wilderness, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} and all the kings of Aelam, and all the kings of the Persians, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} and all the kings from the north, the far and the near, each one with his brother, and all the kingdoms which are on the face of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And you shall say to them, Thus said the Lord Almighty; Drink you⌃, be you⌃ drunken; and you⌃ shall vomit, and shall fall, and shall in nowise rise, because of the sword which I send among you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And it shall come to pass, when they refuse to take the cup out of your hand, to drink it, that you shall say, Thus said the Lord; You⌃ shall surely drink. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} For I am beginning to afflict the city whereon my name is called, and you⌃ shall by no means be held guiltless: for I am calling a sword upon all that dwell upon the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And you shall prophesy against them these words, and shall say, The Lord shall speak from on high, from his sanctuary he will utter his voice; he will pronounce a declaration on his place; and these shall answer like men gathering grapes: and destruction is coming on them that dwell on the earth, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} [even] upon [the extreme] part of the earth; for the Lord [has] a controversy with the nations, he is pleading with all flesh, and the ungodly are given to the sword, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Thus said the Lord; Behold, evils are proceeding from nation to nation, and a great whirlwind goes forth from the end of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And the slain of the Lord shall be in the day of the Lord from [one] end of the earth even to the [other] end of the earth: they shall not be buried; they shall be as dung on the face of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Howl, you⌃ shepherds, and cry; and lament, you⌃ rams of the flock: for your days have been completed for slaughter, and you⌃ shall fall as the choice rams. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And flight shall perish from the shepherds, and safety from the rams of the flock. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} A voice of the crying of the shepherds, and a moaning of the sheep and the rams: for the Lord has destroyed their pastures. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And the peaceful abodes that remain shall be destroyed before the fierceness of my anger. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} He has forsaken his lair, as a lion: for their land is become desolate before the great sword.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{17} Ah, ; thou, ; , ; there; , to hard for thee, or, hid from thee \textsuperscript{18} showest; recompensest; the Great; the Lord \textsuperscript{19} Great, ; work Heb. doing; for; to give \textsuperscript{23} possessed;, but; they have; therefore \textsuperscript{24} mounts or, engines of shot; The mounts were huge terraces raised up to plant their engines on; and so formed as to be capable of being moved forwards towards the city. See note on . the city is, because, ; what \textsuperscript{31} this city, ; a provocation of mine anger Heb. for my anger that I \textsuperscript{33} turned, ; back Heb. neck rising \textsuperscript{35} they built; which; to cause \textsuperscript{37} I will gather "This promise, " says Jerome, "taken in its full extent was not made good to those that returned from captivity; because they were frequently infested with wars, as well by the kings of Syria and Egypt as by the rest of their neighbours; and they were finally subdued and destroyed by the Romans." God's word cannot fail; therefore there remaineth yet a rest for the ancient people of God., ; , ; I will cause\par}

\subsection*{Jeremias 33}
\markright{JEREMIAS 33}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} IN THE BEGINNING OF THE REIGN OF KING JOAKIM SON OF JOSIAS THERE CAME THIS WORD FROM THE LORD. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Thus said the Lord; Stand in the court of the Lord's house, and you shall declare to all the Jews, and to all that come to worship in the house of the Lord, all the words which I commanded you to speak to them; abate not one word. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Peradventure they will hear, and turn every one from his evil way: then I will cease from the evils which I purpose to do to them, because of their evil practices. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And you shall say, Thus said the Lord; If you⌃ will not listen to me, to walk in my statutes which I set before you, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} to listen to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I send to you early in the morning; yes, I sent them, but you⌃ listened not to me; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} then will I make this house as Selo, and I will make [this] city a curse to all the nations of all the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the priests, and the false prophets, and all the people heard Jeremias speaking these words in the house of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And it came to pass, when Jeremias had ceased speaking all that the Lord had ordered him to speak to all the people, that the priests and the false prophets and all the people took him, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} You shall surely die, because you have prophesied in the name of the Lord, saying, This house shall be as Selo, and this city shall be made quite destitute of inhabitants. And all the people assembled against Jeremias in the house of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And the princes of Juda heard this word, and they went up out of the house of the king to the house of the Lord, and sat in the entrance of the new gate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Then the priests and the false prophets said to the princes and to all the people, The judgment of death [is due] to this man; because he has prophesied against this city, as you⌃ have heard with your ears. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Then Jeremias spoke to the princes, and to all the people, saying, The Lord sent me to prophesy against this house and against this city, all the words which you⌃ have heard. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And now amend your ways and your works, and listen to the voice of the Lord; and the Lord shall cease from the evils which he has pronounced against you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And behold, I am in your hands; do to me as is expedient, and as it is best for you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} But know for a certainty, that if you⌃ kill me, you⌃ bring innocent blood upon yourselves, and upon this city, and upon them that dwell in it; for in truth the Lord has sent me to you to speak in your ears all these words. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Then the princes and all the people said to the priests and to the false prophets; Judgment of death is not [due] to this man; for he has spoken to us in the name of the Lord our God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And there rose up men of the elders of the land, and said to all the assembly of the people, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Michaeas the Morathite lived in the days of Ezekias king of Juda, and said to all the people of Juda, Thus says the Lord; Sion shall be plowed as a field, and Jerusalem shall become a desolation, and the mountain of the house shall be a thicket of trees. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Did Ezekias and all Juda in any way kill him? Was it not that they feared the Lord, and they made supplication before the Lord, and the Lord ceased from the evils which he [had] pronounced against them? whereas we have wrought great evil against our own souls. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And there was [another] man prophesying in the name of the Lord, Urias the son of Samaeas of Cariathiarim; and he prophesied concerning this land according to all the words of Jeremias. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And king Joakim and all the princes heard all his words, and sought to kill him; and Urias heard [it] and went into Egypt. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And the king sent men into Egypt; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} and they brought him thence, and brought him into the king; and he struck him with the sword, and cast him into the sepulchre of the children of his people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Nevertheless the hand of Achicam son of Saphan was with Jeremias, to prevent his being delivered into the hands of the people, or being killed.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 34}
\markright{JEREMIAS 34}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Thus said the Lord; Make to yourself bonds and yokes, and put [them] about your neck, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and you shall send them to the king of Idumea, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the children of Ammon, and to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Sidon, by the hands of their messengers that come to meet them at Jerusalem to Sedekias king of Juda. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And you shall commission them to say to their lords, Thus said the Lord God of Israel; Thus shall you⌃ say to your lords; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} I have made the earth by my great power, and with my high arm, and I will give it to whoever it shall seem [good] in my eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} I gave the earth to Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon to serve him, and the wild beasts of the field to labor for him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And the nation and kingdom, all that shall not put their neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, with sword and famine will I visit them, says the Lord, until they are consumed by his hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And listen you⌃ not to your false prophets, nor to them that divine to you, nor to them that foretell events by dreams to you, nor to your auguries, nor your sorcerers, that say, You⌃ shall by no means work for the king of Babylon: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} for they prophesy lies to you, to remove you far from your land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} But the nation which shall put its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him, I will even leave it upon its land, and it shall serve him, and dwell in it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} I spoke also to Sedekias king of Juda according to all these words, saying, Put your neck into [the yoke], and serve the king of Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For they prophesy unrighteous [words] to you, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} for I sent them not, says the Lord; and they prophesy [in] my name unjustly, that I might destroy you, and you⌃ should perish, and your prophets, who unrighteously prophesy lies to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} I spoke to you, and to all this people, and to the priests, saying, Thus said the Lord; Listen not to the words of the prophets that prophesy to you, saying, Behold, the vessels of the Lord's house shall return from Babylon: for they prophesy to you unrighteous [words]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} I sent them not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} If they are prophets, and if the word of the Lord is in them, let them meet me, for thus has the Lord said. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And as for the remaining vessels, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} which the king of Babylon took not, when he carried Jechonias prisoner out of Jerusalem, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} they shall go into Babylon, says the Lord.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 35}
\markright{JEREMIAS 35}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it came to pass in the fourth year of Sedekias king of Juda, in the fifth month, [that] Ananias the false prophet, the son of Azor, from Gabaon, spoke to me in the house of the Lord, in the sight of the priests and all the people, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Thus says the Lord; I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Yet two full years, and I will return into this place the vessels of the house of the Lord, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} and Jechonias, and the captivity of Juda: for I will break the yoke of the king of Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Then Jeremias spoke to Ananias in the sight of all the people, and in the sight of the priests that stood in the house of the Lord, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} and Jeremias said, May the Lord indeed do thus; may he confirm your word which you do prophesy, to return the vessels of the house of the Lord, and all the captivity, out of Babylon to this place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Nevertheless hear you⌃ the word of the Lord which I speak in your ears, and in the ears of all the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} The prophets that were before me and before you of old, also prophesied over much country, and against great kingdoms, concerning war. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} [As for] the prophet that has prophesied for peace, when the word has come [to pass], they shall know the prophet whom the Lord has sent them in truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Then Ananias took the yokes from the neck of Jeremias in the sight of all the people, and broke them to pieces. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And Ananias spoke in the presence of all the people, saying, Thus said the Lord; Thus will I break the yoke of the king of Babylon from the necks of all the nations. And Jeremias went his way. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And the word of the Lord came to Jeremias, after that Ananias had broken the yokes off his neck, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Go and speak to Ananias, saying, Thus says the Lord; You have broken the yokes of wood; but I will make instead of them yokes of iron. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For thus said the Lord, I have put a yoke of iron on the neck of all the nations, that they may serve the king of Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And Jeremias said to Ananias, The Lord has not sent you; and you have caused this people to trust in unrighteousness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Therefore thus said the Lord: Behold, I [will] cast you off from the face of the earth: this year you shall die. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} So he died in the seventh month.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} am 3397, bc 607 The word This discourse was probably delivered in the fourth year of Jehoiakim's reign, when the king of Babylon made war against him. in the \textsuperscript{4} into the chamber a man; , ;, ; the princes the keeper; door Heb. threshold, or vessel \textsuperscript{6} Jonadab; Ye shall Jonadab, a man of fervent zeal for the pure worship of God, and who lived about three hundred years before this time (, etc.) had probably practised these rules himself; and having trained up his children to habits of abstemiousness, he enjoined them and their posterity to adhere to them. In these regulations he seems to have had no religious, but merely a prudential view, as is intimated in the reason annexed to them "that ye may live many days in the land where ye be strangers." And this would be the natural consequence of observing these rules; for their temperate mode of living would very much contribute to preserve health and prolong life; and they would avoid giving umbrage, or exciting the jealousy or envy of the Jews, who might have been provoked, by their engaging and succeeding in the principal business in which they themselves were engaged, agriculture and vine-dressing to expel them their country; by which they would have been deprived of the religious advantages they enjoyed. In, they are termed scribes, which intimates that they were engaged in some kind of literary employments.; all; that ye \textsuperscript{15} I have; Return, ; ye shall dwell, ; ye have \textsuperscript{17} Therefore God having, by the conduct of the Rechabites, convicted the Jews of ingratitude and rebellion, He now proceeds to pass sentence against them. Chardin observes, "In the Lower Asia, in particular, the day is always hot; and as soon as the sun is fifteen degrees above the horizon, no cold is felt in the depth of winter itself. On the contrary, in the height of summer the nights are as cold as at Paris in the month of March. It is for this reason that in Persia and Turkey they always make use of furred habits in the country, such only being sufficient to resist the cold of the nights. I have travelled in Arabia, and in Mesopotamia (the theatre of the adventures of Jacob), both in winter and in summer, and have found the truth of what the Patriarch said, "That he was scorched with the heat in the day, and stiffened with cold in the night" ( ). This contrariety in the qualities of the air in twenty-four hours is extremely great in some places, and not conceivable by those that have not felt it; one would imagine that he had passed in a moment from the violent heats of summer to the depth of winter. Thus it had pleased God to temper the heat of the sun by the coldness of night, without which the greatest part of the East would be barren, and a desert." \textsuperscript{31} punish Heb. visit upon, *marg. will bring, ; but \textsuperscript{32} took who; there, ; like words Heb. words as they\par}

\subsection*{Jeremias 37}
\markright{JEREMIAS 37}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} THE WORD THAT CAME TO JEREMIAS FROM THE LORD, SAYING, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Thus speaks the Lord God of Israel, saying, Write all the words which I have spoken to you in a book. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For, behold, the days come, says the Lord, when I will bring back the captivity of my people Israel and Juda, said the Lord: and I will bring them back to the land which I gave to their fathers, and they shall be lords of it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} AND THESE ARE THE WORDS WHICH THE LORD SPOKE CONCERNING ISRAEL AND JUDA; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Thus said the Lord: You⌃ shall hear a sound of fear, [there is] fear, and there is not peace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Enquire, and see if a male has born a child? and [ask] concerning the fear, wherein they shall hold their loins, and [look for] safety: for I have seen every man, and his hands are on his loins; [their] faces are turned to paleness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For that day is great, and there is not such [another]; and it is a time of straitness to Jacob; but he shall be saved out of it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} In that day, said the Lord, I will break the yoke off their neck, and will burst their bonds, and they shall no longer serve strangers: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} but they shall serve the Lord their God; and I will raise up to them David their king. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Thus says the Lord; I have brought on [you] destruction; your stroke is painful. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} There is none to judge your cause: you have been painfully treated for healing, there is no help for you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} All your friends have forgotten you; they shall not ask [about you] at all, for I have struck you with he stroke of an enemy, [even] severe correction: your sins have abounded above all your iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Your sins have abounded beyond the multitude of your iniquities, [therefore] they have done these things to you. Therefore all that devour you shall be eaten, and all your enemies shall eat all their [own] flesh. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And they that spoil you shall become a spoil, and I will give up to be plundered all that have plundered you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For I will bring about your healing, I will heal you of your grievous wound, says the Lord; for you are called Dispersed: she is your prey, for no one seeks after her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Thus said the Lord; Behold, I will turn the captivity of Jacob, and will have pity upon his prisoners; and the city shall be built upon her hill, and the people shall settle after their manner. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And there shall go forth from them singers, [even] the sound of men making merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not at all be diminished. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And their sons shall go in as before, and their testimonies shall be established before me, and I will visit them that afflict them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And their mighty ones shall be over them, and their prince shall proceed of themselves; and I will gather them, and they shall return to me: for who is this that has set his heart to return to me? says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} For the wrathful anger of the lord has gone forth, [even] a whirlwind of anger has gone forth: it shall come upon the ungodly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} The fierce anger of the Lord shall not return, until he shall execute [it], and until he shall establish the purpose of his heart: in the latter days you⌃ shall know these things.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 38}
\markright{JEREMIAS 38}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} At that time, says the Lord, I will be a God to the family of Israel, and they shall be to me a people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Thus says the Lord, I found him warm in the wilderness with them that were slain with the sword: go you⌃ and destroy not Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} The Lord appeared to him from afar, [saying], I have loved you with an everlasting love: therefore have I drawn you in compassion. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For I will build you, and you shall be built, O virgin of Israel: you shall yet take your timbrel, and go forth with the party of them that make merry. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For you⌃ have planted vineyards on the mountains of Samaria: plant you⌃, and praise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} For it is a day when those that plead on the mountains of Ephraim shall call, [saying], Arise you⌃, and go up to Sion to the Lord your God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For thus says the Lord to Jacob; Rejoice you⌃, and exult over the head of the nations: make proclamation, and praise you⌃: say, The Lord has delivered his people, the remnant of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Behold, I bring them from the north, and will gather them from the end of the earth to the feast of the passover: and [the people] shall beget a great multitude, and they shall return hither. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} They went forth with weeping, and I will bring them back with consolation, causing them to lodge by the channels of waters in a straight way, and they shall not err in it: for I am become a father to Israel, and Ephraim is my firstborn. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Hear the words of the Lord, you⌃ nations, and proclaim [them] to the islands afar off; say, He that scattered Israel will also gather him, and keep him as one that feeds his flock. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For the Lord has ransomed Jacob, he has rescued him out of the hand of them [that were] stronger than he. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And they shall come, and shall rejoice in the mount of Sion, and shall come to the good things of the Lord, [even] to a land of corn, and wine, and fruits, and cattle, and sheep: and their soul shall be as a fruitful tree; and they shall hunger no more. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Then shall the virgins rejoice in the assembly of youth, and the old men shall rejoice; and I will turn their mourning into joy, and will make them merry. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} I will expand and cheer with wine the soul of the priests the sons of Levi, and my people shall be satisfied with my good things: thus says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} A voice was heard in Rama, of lamentation, and of weeping, and wailing; Rachel would not cease weeping for her children, because they are not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Thus says the Lord; Let your voice cease from weeping, and your eyes from your tears: for their is a reward for your works; and they shall return from the land of [your] enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} [There shall be] an dwelling [home] for your children. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} I have heard the sound of Ephraim lamenting, [and saying], You have chastened me, and I was chastened; I as a calf was not [willingly] taught: turn you me, and I shall turn; for you [are] the Lord my God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} For after my captivity I repented; and after I knew, I groaned for the day of shame, and showed you that I bore reproach from my youth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Ephraim is a beloved son, a pleasing child to me: for because my words are in him, I will surely remember him: therefore I made haste [to help] him; I will surely have mercy upon him, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Prepare yourself, O Sion; execute vengeance; look to your ways: return, O virgin of Israel, by the way by which you went, return mourning to your cities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} How long, O disgraced daughter, will you turn away? for the Lord has created safety for a new plantation: men shall go about in safety. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} For thus says the Lord; They shall yet speak this word in the land of Juda, and in the cities thereof, when I shall turn his captivity; blessed be the Lord on his righteous holy mountain! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And there shall be dwellers in the cities of Juda, and in all his land, together with the husbandman, and [the shepherd] shall go forth with the flock. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} For I have saturated every thirsting soul, and filled every hungry soul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Therefore I awake, and saw; and my sleep was sweet to me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Therefore, behold, the days come, says the Lord, when I will sow the house of Israel and the house of Juda with the seed of man, and the seed of beast. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And it shall come to pass, that as I watched over them, to pull down, and to afflict, so will I watch over them, to build, and to plant, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} In those days they shall certainly not say, The fathers ate a sour grape, and the children's teeth were set on edge. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} But every one shall die in his own sin; and the teeth of him that eats the sour grape shall be set on edge. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Behold, the days come, says the Lord, when I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel, and with the house of Juda: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} not according to the covenant which I made with their fathers in the day when I took hold of their hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt; for they abode not in my covenant, and I disregarded them, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} For this is my covenant which I will make with the house of Israel; after those days, says the Lord, I will surely put my laws into their mind, and write them on their hearts; and I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And they shall not at all teach every one his [fellow] citizen, and every one his brother, saying, Know the Lord: for all shall know me, from the least of them to the greatest of them: for I will be merciful to their iniquities, and their sins I will remember no more. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Thus says the Lord, who gives the sun for a light by day, the moon and the stars for a light by night, and [makes] a roaring in the sea, so that the waves thereof roar; the Lord Almighty is his name: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} if these ordinances cease from before me, says the Lord, then shall the family of Israel cease to be a nation before me forever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Though the sky should be raised to a [greater] height, says the Lord, and though the ground of the earth should be sunk [lower] beneath, yet I will not cast off the family of Israel, says the Lord, for all that they have done. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Behold, the days come, says the Lord, when the city shall be built to the Lord from the tower of Anameel to the gate of the corner. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And the measurement of it shall proceed in front of them as far as the hills of Gareb, and it shall be compassed with a circular wall of choice stones. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And all the Asaremoth even to Nachal Kedron, as far as the corner of the horse-gate eastward, shall be holiness to the Lord; and it shall not fail any more, and shall not be destroyed for ever.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} Shephatiah; Jucal, Jehucal Pashur, Melchiah, Malchijah, heard \textsuperscript{4} the princes, ; thus; , welfare Heb. peace \textsuperscript{6} took; into; Hammelech or, the king, and they And in This dungeon, which seems to have belonged to one of Zedekiah's sons, appears to have been a most dreadful place; the horrors of which were probably augmented by the cruelty of the jailor. "The eastern people, " observes Sir J. Chardin, "have not different prisons for the different classes of criminals; the judges do not trouble themselves about where the prisoners are confined, or how they are treated, considering it merely as a place of safety; and all that they require of the jailor is, that the prisoner be forthcoming when called for. As to the rest, he is master to do as he pleases; to treat him well or ill; to put him in irons or not; to shut him up close, or hold him in easier restraint; to admit people to him, or to suffer nobody to see him. If the jailor and his servants have large fees, let the person be the greatest rascal in the world, he shall be lodged in the jailor's own apartment, and the best part of it; and on the contrary, if those that have imprisoned a man give the jailor greater presents, or that he has a greater regard for them, he will treat the prisoner with the greatest inhumanity." This adds a double energy to those passages which speak of "the sighing of the prisoner, " and to Jeremiah's supplicating that he might not be remanded to the dungeon of Jonathan (; ). \textsuperscript{7} Ebedmelech Ethiopian; eunuchs; *marg. the king \textsuperscript{9} these; is like to die Heb. will die for there \textsuperscript{10} the king; with thee Heb. in thine hand \textsuperscript{14} sent, third or, principal; I will \textsuperscript{16} sware; that made; of these \textsuperscript{17} the God of hosts; the God of Israel; If thou \textsuperscript{22} all; and those Mr. Harmer would render, "and here ( hennah or reading hinneh behold), the women (wont to sing on public occasions) shall say, " etc.; observing "that these bitter speeches much better suit the lips of women belonging to the conquering nation, singing before a captive prince, than of his own wives and concubines." This he illustrates by the following extract from Della Valle: When he was at Lar, in Persia, the king of Ormuz was brought thither in triumph; and "this poor unfortunate king entered Lar, with his people, in the morning, music playing, and girls and women singing and dancing before him, according to the custom of Persia, and the people flocking together with a prodigious concourse, and conducting him in a pompous and magnificent manner, particularly with colours displayed, like what the Messenians formerly did to Philopoemen, the general of the Athenians, their prisoner of war, according to the report of Justin." Thy friends Heb. The men of thy peace, ; *marg. have set; thy feet; they are \textsuperscript{23} they shall, ; shalt cause etc. Heb. shalt burn, etc. \textsuperscript{27} and he told; left off speaking with him Heb. were silent from him\par}

\subsection*{Jeremias 39}
\markright{JEREMIAS 39}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The word that came from the Lord to Jeremias in the tenth year of king Sedekias, this is the eighteenth year of king Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And the host of the king of Babylon had made a rampart against Jerusalem: and Jeremias was kept in the court of the prison, which is in the king's house; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} in which king Sedekias [had] shut him up, saying, Therefore do you prophesy, saying, Thus says the Lord, Behold, I [will] give this city into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} and Sedekias shall by no means be delivered out of the hand of the Chaldeans, for he shall certainly be given up into the hands of the king of Babylon, and his mouth shall speak to his mouth, and his eyes shall look upon his eyes; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} and Sedekias shall go into Babylon, and dwell there? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} AND THE WORD OF THE LORD CAME TO JEREMIAS, SAYING, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Behold, Anameel the son of Salom your father's brother is coming to you, saying, Buy you my field that is in Anathoth: for you [have] the right to take [it] as a purchase. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} So Anameel the son of Salom my father's brother came to me into the court of the prison, and said, Buy you my field that is in the land of Benjamin, in Anathoth: for you [have] a right to buy it, and you are the elder. So I knew that it was the word of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And I bought the field of Anameel the son of my father's brother, and I weighed him seventeen shekels of silver. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And I wrote [it] in a book, and sealed [it], and took the testimony of witnesses, and weighed the money in the balance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And I took the book of the purchase that was sealed; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} and I gave it to Baruch son of Nerias, son of Maasaeas, in the sight of Anameel my father's brother's son, and in the sight of the men that stood by and wrote in the book of the purchase, and in the sight of the Jews that were in the court of the prison. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And I charged Baruch in their presence, saying, Thus says the Lord Almighty; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Take this book of the purchase, and the book that has been read; and you shall put it into an earthen vessel, that it may remain many days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For thus says the Lord; There shall yet be bought fields and houses and vineyards in this land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And I prayed to the Lord after I had given the book of the purchase to Baruch the son of Nerias, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} O [ever] living Lord! you have made the heaven and the earth by your great power, and with your high and lofty arm: nothing can be hidden from you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Granting mercy to thousands, and recompensing the sins of the fathers into the bosoms of their children after them: the great, the strong God; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} the Lord of great counsel, and mighty in deeds, the great Almighty God, and Lord of great name: your eyes are upon the ways of the children of men, to give to every one according to his way: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} who have wrought signs and wonders in the land of Egypt even to this day, and in Israel, and among the inhabitants of the earth; and you did make for yourself a name, as at this day; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} and you did bring out your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, with a mighty hand, and with a high arm, and with great sights; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} and you gave them this land, which you did swear [to give] to their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} and they went in, and took it; but they listened not to your voice, and walked not in your ordinances; they did none of the things which you did command them, and they caused all these calamities to happen to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Behold, a multitude is come against the city to take it; and the city is given into the hands of the Chaldeans that fight against it, by the power of the sword, and the famine: as you have spoken, so has it happened. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And you say to me, Buy you the field for money; and I wrote a book, and sealed [it], and took the testimony of witnesses: and the city is given into the hands of the Chaldeans. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} I am the Lord, the God of all flesh: shall anything be hidden from me! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Therefore thus says the Lord God of Israel; This city shall certainly be delivered into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} and the Chaldeans shall come to war against this city, and they shall burn this city with fire, and shall burn down the houses wherein they burnt incense on the roofs thereof to Baal, and poured drink-offerings to other gods, to provoke me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} For the children of Israel and the children of Juda alone did evil in my sight from their youth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} For this city was [obnoxious] to my anger and my wrath, from the day that they built it even to this day; that I should remove it from my presence, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} because of all the wickedness of the children of Israel and Juda, which they wrought to provoke me, they and their kings, and their princes, and their priests, and their prophets, the men of Juda, and the dwellers in Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And they turned the back to me, and not the face: whereas I taught them early in the morning, but they listened no more to receive instructions. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And they set their pollutions in the house, on which my name was called, by their uncleannesses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And they built to Baal the altars that are in the valley of the son of Ennom, to offer their sons and their daughters to king Moloch; which things I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind that they should do this abomination, to cause Juda to sin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And now thus has the Lord God of Israel said concerning this city, of which you say, it shall be delivered into the hands of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by famine, and banishment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Behold, I [will] gather them out of every land, where I have scattered them in my anger, and my wrath, and great fury; and I will bring them back into this place, and will cause them to dwell safely: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} and they shall be to me a people, and I will be to them a god. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And I will give them another way, and another heart, to fear me continually, and [that] for good to them and their children after them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And I will make with them an everlasting covenant, which I will by no means turn away from them, and I will put my fear into their heart, that they may not depart from me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And I will visit [them] to do them good, and I will plant them in this land in faithfulness, and with all my heart, and with all [my] soul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} For thus says the Lord; As I have brought upon this people all these great evils, so will I bring upon them all the good things which I pronounced upon them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And there shall yet be fields bought in the land, of which you say, it shall be destitute of man and beast; and they are delivered into the hands of the Chaldeans. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And they shall buy fields for money, and you shall write a book, and seal [it], and shall take the testimony of witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and round about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Juda, and in the cities of the mountain, and in the cities of the plain, and in the cities of the south: for I will turn their captivity.\par

\subsection*{Jeremias 40}
\markright{JEREMIAS 40}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to Jeremias the second time, when he was yet bound in the court of the prison, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Thus says the Lord, who made the earth and formed it, to establish it; the Lord is his name; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Cry to me, and I will answer you, and I will declare to you great and mighty things, which you know not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For thus says the Lord concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the king of Juda, which have been pulled down for mounds and fortifications, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} to fight against the Chaldeans, and to fill it with the corpses of men, whom I struck in my anger and my wrath, and turned away my face from them, for all their wickedness: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Behold, I bring upon her healing and cure, and I will show [myself] to them, and will heal her, and make both peace and security. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I will turn the captivity of Juda, and the captivity of Israel, and will build them, even as before. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And I will cleanse them from all their iniquities, whereby they have sinned against me, and will not remember their sins, whereby they have sinned against me, and revolted from me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And it shall be for joy and praise, and for glory to all the people of the earth, who shall hear all the good that I will do: and they shall fear and be provoked for all the good things and for all the peace which I will bring upon them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Thus says the Lord; There shall yet be heard in this place, of which you⌃ say, it is destitute of men and cattle, in the cities of Juda, and in the streets of Jerusalem, [the places] that have been made desolate for lack of men and cattle, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} the voice of gladness, and the voice of joy, the voice of the bridegroom, and the voice of the bride, the voice of men saying, Give thanks to the Lord Almighty: for the Lord is good; for his mercy [endures] fore ever: and they shall bring gifts into the house of the Lord; for I will turn all the captivity of that land as before, said the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Thus says the Lord of hosts; There shall yet be in this place, that is desert for lack of man and beast, in all the cities thereof, resting-places for shepherds causing their flocks to lie down. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} In the cities of the hill country, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south, and in the land of Benjamin, and in the [cities] round about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Juda, flocks shall yet pass under the hand of him that numbers [them], says the Lord.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} The word This, and the four following chapters, record the events which occurred in Judea from the taking of Jerusalem to the retreat of the remnant of the people to Egypt; and contain several prophecies of Jeremiah concerning them there; which were "the word which came to Jeremiah from the Lord." It appears that Jeremiah, after being freed from prison, continued among the Jews, till he was bound, with others of them, and carried to Ramah; where he was set a liberty in the manner related. after Ramah; bound; *marg. chains or, manacles \textsuperscript{5} Go back; Ahikam; or go; gave him; victuals and a reward Rather, "victuals ( aruchah a stated allowance, sufficient for the journey), and a present, " masseatḣ \textsuperscript{6} Then It has been doubted whether Jeremiah acted prudently in this decision, as the event seems to indicate the contrary, and as it was the evident meaning of all his predictions that the Jews should not prosper in their own country till the expiration of seventy years. But he was evidently influenced by the most unbounded love to his country, for whose welfare he had watched, prayed, and lived; and he now chose rather to share her adversities, her sorrows, her wants, her afflictions, and her disgrace, than to be the companion of princes, and to sit at the table of kings. His patriotism was as unbounded as it was sincere. He only ceased to live for country when he ceased to breathe. Mizpah; Mizpeh \textsuperscript{8} came, even; Johanan, Jonathan, Netophathite; Maachathite \textsuperscript{10} serve Heb. stand before; gather summer \textsuperscript{13} Johanan and his companions seem to have acted honestly in this affair. They had received intelligence of designs formed against Gedaliah's life, and consequently against the whole new settlement. Ishmael, being a branch of David's family, was probably displeased that another was preferred above him; and the king of the Ammonites, out of hatred to the Jews, employed him to slay Gedaliah. But Gedaliah, conscious of his own integrity and benevolence, took the portrait of others from his own mind; and therefore believed evil of no man, because he felt none towards any in his own breast. He may be reproached for being too credulous and confiding; but this only serves to shew the greatness of his soul; for a little mind is always suspicious, and ready to believe the worst of every person and thing.\par}

\subsection*{Jeremias 41}
\markright{JEREMIAS 41}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The word that came to Jeremias from the Lord (now Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, and all his army, and all the country of his dominion, were warring against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Juda,) saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Thus has the Lord said; Go to Sedekias king of Juda, and you shall say to him, Thus has the Lord said, This city shall certainly be delivered into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it, and shall burn it with fire: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and you shall not escape out of his hand, but shall certainly be taken, and shall be given into his hands; and your eyes shall see his eyes, and you shall enter into Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} But hear the word of the Lord, O Sedekias king of Juda; Thus says the Lord, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} You shall die in peace: and as they wept for your fathers that reigned before you, they shall weep also for you, [saying], Ah lord! and they shall lament for you down to the grave: for I have spoken the word, said the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And Jeremias spoke to king Sedekias all these words in Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the host of the king of Babylon warred against Jerusalem, and against the cities of Juda, and against Lachis, and against Azeca: for these strong cities were left among the cities of Juda. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} The word that came from the Lord to Jeremias, after king Sedekias had concluded a covenant with the people, to proclaim a release; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} That every one should set at liberty his servant, and every one has handmaid, the Hebrew man and Hebrew woman, that no man of Juda should be a bondman. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Then all the nobles, and all the people who had entered into the covenant, [engaging] to set free every one his man-servant, and every one his maid, turned, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} and gave them over to be menservants and maidservants. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And the word of the Lord came to Jeremias, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Thus says the Lord; I made a covenant with your fathers in the day wherein I took them out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} When six years are accomplished, you shall set free your brother the Hebrew, who shall be sold to you: for he shall serve you six years, and [then] you shall let him go free: but they listened not to me, and inclined not their ear. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And this day they turned to do that which was right in my sight, to proclaim every one the release of his neighbor; and they had concluded a covenant before me, in the house whereon my name is called. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} But you⌃ turned and profaned my name, to bring back every one his servant, and every one his handmaid, whom you⌃ had sent forth free [and] at their own disposal, to be to you menservants and maidservants. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Therefore thus said the Lord; You⌃ have not listened to me, to proclaim a release every one to his neighbor: behold, I proclaim a release to you, to the sword, and to the pestilence, and to the famine; and I will give you up to dispersion [among] all the kingdoms of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And I will give the men that have transgressed my covenant, who have not kept my covenant, which they made before me, the calf which they prepared to sacrifice with it, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} the princes of Juda, and the men in power, and the priests, and the people; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} I will even give them to their enemies, and their carcasses shall be food for the birds of the sky and for the wild beasts of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And I will give Sedekias king of Judea, and their princes, into the hands of their enemies, and the host of the king of Babylon [shall come upon] them that run away from them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Behold, I [will] give command, says the Lord, and will bring them back to this land; and they shall fight against it, and take it, and burn it with fire, and the cities of Juda; and I will make them desolate without inhabitants.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} the seventh month This was the month Tisri answering to the new moon of September, the seventh of the sacred, but the first of the civil year; on the third day of which the Jews keep a fast, in commemoration of the death of Gedaliah, to which the prophet Zechariah refers; ., .; . Ishmael, Elishama, of the; seed; they did \textsuperscript{5} came Shechem; Shiloh; Samaria, their beards All these were signs of deep mourning; which, though forbidden on funeral occasions, were customary, and perhaps counted allowable, on seasons of public calamity, and this mourning was probably on account of the destruction of Jerusalem.; to the \textsuperscript{6} weeping etc. Heb. in going and weeping \textsuperscript{8} Slay; treasures These "treasures hid in the field" were doubtless laid up in subterranean pits, similar to the mattamores in Barbary, in which, Dr. Shaw informs us, they deposit the grain when winnowed; two or three hundred of them being sometimes together, and the smallest holding four hundred bushels. The same mode of keeping corn prevails in Syria and the Holy Land. \textsuperscript{9} the pit This was probably a large reservoir for receiving rain water, which Asa had caused to be made in the midst of the city, in case of a siege. because of Gedaliah or, near Gedaliah, Heb. by the hand, or the side of Gedaliah. was it.;, ; for fear \textsuperscript{10} all the even, whom to the \textsuperscript{13} that when They appear to have been weary of the tyranny of Ishmael, and glad of an opportunity to abandon him. \textsuperscript{17} Chimham to go As Johanan and the other princes had taken a decided part against Ishmael, they had no sufficient reason to fear that the Chaldeans would revenge on them the murder of Gedaliah; but perhaps Johanan was unwilling to be superseded in the command which he had rightly assumed, and so used his influence to induce the whole company to take refuge in Egypt; and their old attachment to the Egyptians rendered them more ready to concur in this ruinous measure.\par}

\subsection*{Jeremias 42}
\markright{JEREMIAS 42}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} THE WORD THAT CAME TO JEREMIAS from the Lord in the days of Joakim, king of Juda, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Go to the house of the Archabin, and you shall bring them to the house of the Lord, into one of the courts, and give them wine to drink. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} So I brought forth Jechonias the son of Jeremin the son of Chabasin, and his brethren, and his sons, and all the family of the Archabin; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} and I brought them into the house of the Lord, into the chamber of the sons of Joanan, the son of Ananias, the son of Godolias, a man of God, who dwells near the house of the princes that are over the house of Maasaeas the son of Selom, who kept the court. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And I set before them a jar of wine, and cups, and I said, Drink you⌃ wine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} But they said, We will on no account drink wine, for our father Jonadab the son of Rechab commanded us, saying, You⌃ shall on no account drink wine, [neither] you⌃, nor your sons for ever: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} nor shall you⌃ at all build houses, nor sow any seed, nor shall you⌃ have a vineyard: for you⌃ shall dwell in tents all your days; that you⌃ may live many days upon the land, in which you⌃ sojourn. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And we listened to the voice of Jonadab our father, so as to drink no wine all our days, we, and our wives, and our sons, and our daughters; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} and so as to build no houses to dwell in: and we have had no vineyard, nor field, nor seed: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} but we have lived in tents, and have listened, and done according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And it came to pass, when Nabuchodonosor came up against the land, that we said we would come in; and we entered into Jerusalem, for fear of the host of the Chaldeans, and for fear of the host of the Assyrians: and we lived there. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Thus says the Lord, Go, and say to the men of Juda, and to them that dwell in Jerusalem, Will you⌃ not receive correction to listen to my words? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} The sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have kept the word which he commanded his children, that they should drink no wine; and they have not drunk [it]: but I spoke to you early, and you⌃ listened not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And I sent to you my servants the prophets, saying, Turn you⌃ every one from his evil way, and amend your practices, and go not after other gods to serve them, and you⌃ shall dwell upon the land which I gave to you and to your fathers: but you⌃ inclined not your ears, and listened not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} But the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have kept the command of their father; but this people has not listened to me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Therefore thus says the Lord; Behold, I [will] bring upon Juda and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evils which I pronounced against them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Therefore thus says the Lord; Since the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab have listened to the command of their father, to do as their father commanded them: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} there shall never be lacking a man of the sons of Jonadab the son of Rechab to stand before my face while the earth remains.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} all the, Jezaniah;, Jaazaniah from, ; came \textsuperscript{2} be accepted before thee Heb. fall before thee, *marg. and pray, ; left \textsuperscript{4} Jeremiah The princes seem to have wholly neglected Jeremiah, till on this occasion they wanted his sanction to their purpose of going to Egypt. In order to induce him to favour them, they applied to him with one consent, in the most respectful and plausible manner. They used language to prepossess him with a favourable opinion of them, and to move his compassion; and, in words expressing great humility, they entreated his prayers in their behalf, and that he would enquire of the Lord what he would have them to do. The prophet readily acquiesced; and doubted not but that he should receive an answer from God, which he would unreservedly declare to them; and they called the Lord to witness that they would implicitly follow his directions. I will pray; whatsoever; I will keep \textsuperscript{5} The Lord be; if we \textsuperscript{6} it be good, that it \textsuperscript{7} At this time he was waiting for a revelation from God in answer to the enquiries of the people; who probably thus delayed to make known his will, in order to shew them that Jeremiah did not speak of his own mind, but when and as he was directed. The delay was also suited to give time for consideration, and to retard their rash project; and, as it would render them impatient, it tended to detect their hypocrisy, and to shew more clearly their determined rebellion against God. \textsuperscript{14} we will go; nor hear \textsuperscript{15} If ye are determined to go into Egypt, the evils which ye dreaded by staying in your own land shall overtake and destroy you there; "and there shall ye die." God turned the policy of the wicked to their own destruction; for while they thought themselves safe in Egypt, there Nebuchadnezzar destroyed both them and the Egyptians. \textsuperscript{16} that the sword, ; follow close Heb. cleave there ye \textsuperscript{17} it be with all the men Heb. all the men be they shall, none \textsuperscript{18} As mine The people had witnessed the tremendous effects of the wrath of God, in the siege and destruction of Jerusalem; and had they not been past feeling, this denunciation must have made their ears tingle, and appalled their very souls., ; ye shall be, ; and ye shall see \textsuperscript{19} Go God knew, that such was their miserable propensity to idolatry, that they would adopt the idolatrous worship of Egypt. Add to which, their going thither for protection was in effect refusing to submit to the king of Babylon, to whom God had decreed the rule of Judah and the neighbouring kingdoms.; know; admonished you Heb. testified against you\par}
