\subsection*{Ezekiel 12}
\markright{EZEKIEL 12}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Son of man, you dwell in the midst of the iniquities of those, who have eyes to see, and see not; and have ears to hear, and hear not: because it is a provoking house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} You therefore, son of man, prepare yourself baggage for going into captivity by day in their sight; and you shall be led into captivity from your place into another place in their sight; that they may see that it is a provoking house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And you shall carry forth your baggage, baggage for captivity, by day before their eyes: and you shall go forth at even, as a captive goes forth, in their sight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Dig for yourself into the wall [of the house], and you shall pass through it in their sight: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} you shall be lifted up on [men's] shoulders, and shall go forth in secret: you shall cover your face, and shall not see the ground: because I have made you a sign to the house of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I did thus according to all that he commanded me; and I carried forth my baggage for captivity by day, and in the evening I dug through the wall for myself, and went out secretly; I was taken up on [men's] shoulders before them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And the word of the Lord came to me in the morning, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Son of man, have not the house of Israel, the provoking house, said to you, What do you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Say to them, Thus says the Lord God, the Prince and the Ruler in Israel, even to all the house of Israel who are in the midst of them: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} say, I am performing signs: as I have done, so shall it be to him: they shall go into banishment and captivity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And the prince in the midst of them shall be borne upon shoulders, and shall go forth in secret through the wall, and shall dig so that he may go forth thereby: he shall cover his face, that he may not be seen by [any] eye, and he himself shall not see the ground. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And I will spread out my net upon him, and he shall be caught in my toils: and I will bring him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldeans; but he shall not see it, though he shall die there. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And I will scatter to every wind all his assistants round about him, and all that help him; and I will draw out a sword after them; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And they shall know that I am the Lord, when I have scattered them among the nations; and I will disperse them in the countries. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And I will leave of them [a few] men in number [spared] from the sword, and from famine, and pestilence; that they may declare all their iniquities among the nations whither they have gone; and they shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Son of man, eat your bread with sorrow, and drink [your] water with torment and affliction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And you shall say to the people of the land, Thus says the Lord to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, on the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread in scarcity, and shall drink their water in desolation, that the land may be desolate with all that it contains: for all that dwell in it are ungodly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And their inhabited cities shall be laid utterly waste, and the land shall be desolate; and you⌃ shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Son of man, what is your parable on the land of Israel, that you⌃ say, The days are long, the vision has perished? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Therefore say to them, Thus says the Lord; I will even set aside this parable, and the house of Israel shall no more at all use this parable: for you shall say to them, The days are at hand, and the import of every vision. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} For there shall no more be any false vision, nor any one prophesying flatteries in the midst of the children of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} For I the Lord will speak my words; I will speak and perform [them], and will no more delay, for in your days, O provoking house, I will speak the word, and will perform [it], says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Son of man, behold, the provoking house of Israel boldly say, The vision which this man sees is for many days, and he prophesies for times afar off. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Therefore say to them, Thus says the Lord; Henceforth none of my words shall linger, which I shall speak: I will speak and do, says the Lord.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{3} prepare;, stuff or, instruments, By stuff our translators meant furniture or goods, as the word frequently denotes in our early writers; but the original, keley has not only this sense (as in ), but is also used for any kind of utensils or instruments whatever; and here probably denotes carriages, or other means for removing goods. This was intended to signify that the captivity was at hand. it may \textsuperscript{4} at even; they that go forth into Heb. the goings forth of \textsuperscript{5} Dig thou Heb. Dig for thee, This was to shew that Zedekiah should escape from the city through a breach in the wall. \textsuperscript{6} thou shalt This intimated that Zedekiah should steal out of the city in the twilight, carrying on his shoulders some of his property, with his head covered, not only as in distress but to escape detection. These prophecies, which were accurately fulfilled, are supposed to have been delivered in the sixth year of Zedekiah, five years before the taking of Jerusalem. cover; for I \textsuperscript{7} I did so, ; I brought digged Heb. digged for me \textsuperscript{10} This; prince That is, Zedekiah king of Judah. \textsuperscript{11} I am remove and go Heb. by removing go \textsuperscript{13} My net This was to intimate, that though he escaped out of the city, the Chaldeans should overtake him, and carry him to Babylon. Jeremiah had predicted that his "eyes should see the eyes of the king of Babylon, " and here Ezekiel foretold that he should not see Babylon, though he should die there; and Josephus says that he thought the two prophecies so inconsistent with each other, that he believed neither; yet both were exactly fulfilled, and the enigma of Ezekiel explained, when Zedekiah was brought to Nebuchadnezzar at Riblah, where he had his eyes put out, and was then carried to Babylon, and there died., ; and I \textsuperscript{14} I will scatter; I will draw \textsuperscript{16} I will;, ; a few men Heb. men of number; that they; and they \textsuperscript{19} with carefulness that her, ;, ; all that is therein Heb. the fulness thereof; because \textsuperscript{25} I will; in your; O rebellious\par}

\subsection*{Ezekiel 13}
\markright{EZEKIEL 13}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel, and you shall prophesy, and shall say to them, Hear you⌃ the word of the Lord: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Thus says the Lord, Woe to them that prophesy out of their own heart, and who see nothing at all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Your prophets, O Israel, are like foxes in the deserts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} They have not continued steadfast, and they have gathered flocks against the house of Israel, they that say, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} In the day of the Lord, have not stood, seeing false [visions], prophesying vanities, who say, The Lord says, and the Lord has not sent them, and they began [to try] to confirm the word. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Have you⌃ not seen a false vision? and spoken vain prophecies? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And therefore say, Thus says the Lord; Because your words are false, and your prophecies are vain, therefore, behold, I am against you, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And I will stretch forth my hand against the prophets that see false [visions], and those that utter vanities: they shall not partake of the instruction of my people, neither shall they be written in the roll of the house of Israel, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel; and they shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Because they have caused my people to err, saying, Peace; and there is no peace; and one builds a wall, and they plaster it, —it shall fall. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Say to them that plaster [it], It shall fall; and there shall be a flooding rain; and I will send great stones upon their joinings, and they shall fall; and there shall be a sweeping wind, and it shall be broken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And behold! the wall has fallen; and will they not say to you, Where is your plaster wherewith you⌃ plastered [it]? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Therefore thus says the Lord; I will even cause to burst forth a sweeping blast with fury, and there shall be a flooding rain in my wrath; and in [my] fury I will bring on great stones for complete destruction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And I will break down the wall which you⌃ have plastered, and it shall fall; and I will lay it on the ground, and its foundations shall be revealed, and it shall fall; and you⌃ shall be consumed with rebukes: and you⌃ shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And I will accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that plaster it; it shall fall: and I said to you, The wall is not, nor they that plaster it, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} even the prophets of Israel, who prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and who see [visions of] peace for her, and there is no peace, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And you, son of man, set your face firmly against the daughters of your people, that prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy against them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And you shall say, Thus says the Lord, Woe to the [women] that sew pillows under every elbow, and make kerchiefs on the head of every stature to pervert souls! The souls of my people are perverted, and they have saved souls alive. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And they have dishonored me before my people for a handful of barley, and for pieces of bread, to kill the souls which should not die, and to save alive the souls which should not live, while you⌃ speak to a people hearing vain speeches. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Therefore thus says the Lord God, Behold, I am against your pillows, whereby you⌃ there confound souls, and I will tear them away from your arms, and will set at liberty their souls which you⌃ pervert to scatter them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And I will tear your kerchiefs, and will rescue my people out of your hands, and they shall no longer be in your hands to be confounded; and you⌃ shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Because you⌃ have perverted the heart of the righteous, whereas I perverted him not, and [that] in order to strengthen the hands of the wicked, that he should not at all turn from his evil way and live: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} therefore you⌃ shall not see false [visions], and you⌃ shall no more utter prophecies: but I will deliver my people out of your hand; and you⌃ shall know that I am the Lord.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} prophesy against, ; , ; prophesy out of Heb. are prophets out of, ;, Hear \textsuperscript{3} Woe; foolish; follow Heb. walk after have seen nothing or, things which they have not seen \textsuperscript{4} prophets Crafty, mischievous, and ravenous; always scheming something for their own interest; while they would not risk their persons to avert the mischief which they had caused. like \textsuperscript{5} have not; gaps or, breaches; made up the hedge Heb. hedged the hedge to stand; the day \textsuperscript{6} have seen, ; lying; saying;, made \textsuperscript{9} mine;, ; assembly or, secret, or council neither shall they be; , neither shall they enter and ye \textsuperscript{10} seduced; Peace;, ; and one These false prophets pretend to be a wall of defence; but their wall is bad, and their morter is worse. \subsection*{Ezekiel 14}
\markright{EZEKIEL 14}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And there came to me men of the people of Israel, of the elders, and sat before me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Son of man, these men have conceived their devices in their hearts, and have set before their faces the punishment of their iniquities: shall I indeed answer them? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Therefore speak to them, and you shall say to them, Thus says the Lord; Any man of the house of Israel, who shall conceive his devices in his heart, and shall set the punishment of his iniquity before his face, and shall come to the prophet; I the Lord will answer him [according to the things] in which his mind is entangled, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} that he should turn aside the house of Israel, according to their hearts that are estranged from me in their thoughts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord God, Be converted, and turn from your [evil] practices, and from all your sins, and turn your faces back again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For any man of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, who shall separate himself from me, and conceive his imaginations in his heart, and set before his face the punishment of his iniquity, and come to the prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I the Lord will answer him, [according to the things] wherein he is entangled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And I will set my face against that man, and will make him desolate and ruined, and will cut him off from the midst of my people; and you⌃ shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And if a prophet should cause to err and should speak, I the Lord have caused that prophet to err, and will stretch out my hand upon him, and will utterly destroy him from the midst of my people Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And they shall bear their iniquity according to the trespass of him that asks; and it shall be in like manner to the prophet according to the trespass: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} that the house of Israel may no more go astray from me, and that they may no more defile themselves with any of their transgressions: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Son of man, if a land shall sin against me by committing a trespass, then will I stretch out my hand upon it, and will break its staff of bread, and will send forth famine upon it, and cut off from it man and beast. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And though these three men should be in the midst of it, Noe, and Daniel, and Job, they [alone] should be delivered by their righteousness, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} If again I bring evil beasts upon the land, and take vengeance upon it, and it be ruined, and there be no one to pass through for fear of the wild beasts: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} and [if] these three men should be in the midst of it, [as] I live, says the Lord, neither sons nor daughters shall be saved, but these only shall be saved, and the land shall be destroyed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Or again if I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Let the sword go through the land; and I cut off from them man and beast: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} though these three men were in the midst of it, as I live, says the Lord, they shall not deliver sons or daughters, but they only shall be saved themselves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Or [if] again I send pestilence upon that land, and pour out my wrath upon it in blood, to destroy from off it man and beast: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} and should Noe, and Daniel, and Job, be in the midst of it, [as] I live, says the Lord, there shall be left [them] neither sons nor daughters; [only] they by their righteousness shall deliver their souls. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Thus says the Lord, And if I even send upon Jerusalem my four sore judgments, sword, and famine, and evil beasts, and pestilence, to destroy from out of it man and beast; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} yet, behold, [there shall be] men left in it, the escaped thereof, who [shall] lead forth of it sons and daughters: behold, they [shall] go forth to you, and you⌃ shall see their ways and their thoughts: and you⌃ shall mourn over the evils which I have brought upon Jerusalem, [even] all the evils which I have brought upon it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And they shall comfort you, because you⌃ shall see their ways and their thoughts: and you⌃ shall know that I have not done in vain all that I have done in it, says the Lord.\par

\subsection*{Ezekiel 15}
\markright{EZEKIEL 15}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And you, son of man—of all the wood, of the branches that are among the trees of the forest, what shall be made of the wood of the vine? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Will they take wood of it to make [it fit] for work? will they take of it a peg to hang any vessel upon it? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} It is only given to the fire to be consumed; the fire consumes that which is yearly pruned of it, and it is utterly gone. Will it be useful for [any] work? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Not even while it is yet whole will it be [useful] for [any] work: if the fire shall have utterly consumed it, will it still be [fit] for work? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Therefore say, Thus says the Lord, As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given up to the fire to be consumed, so have I given up the inhabitants of Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I will set my face against them; they shall go forth of the fire, and [yet] fire shall devour them; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I have set my face against them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And I will give up the land to ruin, because they have utterly transgressed, says the Lord.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} What The vine is only noble and useful while producing fruit: for, when cut down, its wood is fit only for fuel. So Israel, having ceased to be fruitful, they are good for nothing, but, like a withered branch of a vine, to be burnt.;, ; among \textsuperscript{4} it is cast; the fire; Is it meet Heb. Will it prosper \textsuperscript{5} meet Heb. made fit, *marg. \textsuperscript{7} I will set; they shall; and ye shall \textsuperscript{8} I will, ; committed a trespass Heb. trespassed a trespass\par}

\subsection*{Ezekiel 16}
\markright{EZEKIEL 16}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Moreover the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Son of man, testify to Jerusalem [of] her iniquities; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and you shall say, Thus says the Lord to Jerusalem; Your root and your birth are of the land of Chanaan: your father was an Amorite, and your mother a Chettite. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And [as for] your birth in the day wherein you were born, you did not bind your breasts, and you were not washed in water, neither was you salted with salt, neither was you swathed in swaddling-bands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Nor did my eye pity you, to do for you one of all these things, to feel at all for you; but you were cast out on the face of the field, because of the deformity of your person, in the day wherein you were born. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And I passed by to you, and saw you polluted in your blood; and I said to you, [Let there be] life out of your blood: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} increase; I have made you as the springing grass of the field. So you did increase and grow, and did enter into great cities: your breasts were set, and your hair grew, whereas you were naked and bare. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And I passed by you and saw you, and, behold, [it was] your time and a time of resting; and I spread my wings over you, and covered your shame, and swear to you: and I entered into covenant with you, says the Lord, and you became mine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And I washed you in water, and washed your blood from you, and anointed you with oil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And I clothed you with embroidered [garments], and clothed you beneath with purple, and girded you with fine linen, and clothed you with silk, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} and decked you also with ornaments, and put bracelets on your hands, and a necklace on your neck. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And I put a pendant on your nostril, and rings in your ears, and a crown of glory on your head. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} So you were adorned with gold and silver; and your raiment was of fine linen, and silk, and variegated work: you did eat fine flour, and oil, and honey, and did become extremely beautiful. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And your name went forth among the nations for your beauty: because it was perfected with elegance, [and] in the comeliness which I put upon you, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} You did trust in your beauty, and did go a-whoring because of your renown, and did pour out your fornication on every passer by. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And you did take of your garments, and made to yourself idols of needlework, and did go a-whoring after them; therefore you shall never come in, nor shall [the like] take place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And you took your fair ornaments of my gold and of my silver, of what I gave you, and you made to yourself male images, and you did commit whoredom with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And you did take your variegated apparel and did clothe them, and you did set before them my oil and my incense. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And [you took] my bread which I gave you, ([yes] I fed you with fine flour and oil and honey) and did set them before them for a sweet smelling savor: yes, it was so, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And you took your sons and your daughters, whom you bore, and did sacrifice [these] to them to be destroyed. You did go a-whoring as [if that were] little, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} and did kill your children, and gave them up in offering them to them for an expiation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} This is beyond all your fornication, and you did not remember your infancy, when you were naked and bare, [and] did live [though] defiled in your blood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And it came to pass after all your wickedness, says the Lord, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} that you did build yourself a house of fornication, and did make yourself a public place in every street; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} and on the head of every way you did set up your fornications, and did defile your beauty, and did open your feet to every passer by, and did multiply your fornication. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And you did go a-whoring after the children of Egypt your neighbors, great of flesh; and did go a-whoring, often to provoke me to anger. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And if I stretch out my hand against you, then will I abolish your statutes, and deliver [you] up to the wills of them that hate you, [even to] the daughters of the Philistines that turned you aside from the way wherein you sinned. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And you did go a-whoring to the daughters of Assur, and not even thus was you satisfied; yes, you did go a-whoring, and was not satisfied. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And you did multiply your covenants with the land of the Chaldeans; and not even with these was you satisfied. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Why should I make a covenant with your daughter, says the Lord, while you do all these things, the works of a harlot? and you have gone a-whoring in a threefold degree with your daughters. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} You have built a house of harlotry in every top of a way, and have set up your high place in every street; and you did become as a harlot gathering hires. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} An adulteress resembles you, taking rewards of her husband. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} She has even given rewards to all that went a-whoring after her, and you have given rewards to all your lovers, yes, you did load them with rewards, that they should come to you from every side for your fornication. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And there has happened in you perverseness in your fornication beyond [other] women, and they have committed fornication with you, in that you give hires over and above, and hires were not given to you; and [thus] perverseness happened in you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Therefore, harlot, hear the word of the Lord: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Thus says the Lord, Because you have poured forth your money, therefore your shame shall be revealed in your harlotry with your lovers, and [with] regard to all the imaginations of your iniquities, and for the blood of your children which you have given to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Therefore, behold, I [will] gather all your lovers with whom you have consorted, and all whom you have loved, with all whom you did hate; and I will gather them against you round about, and will expose your wickedness to them, and they shall see all your shame. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And I will be avenged on you with the vengeance of an adulteress, and I will bring upon you blood of fury and jealousy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And I will deliver you into their hands, and they shall break down your house of harlotry, and destroy your high place; and they shall strip you of your garments, and shall take your proud ornaments, and leave you naked and bare. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And they shall bring multitudes upon you, and they shall stone you with stones, and pierce you with their swords. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And they shall burn your houses with fire, and shall execute vengeance on you in the sight of many women: and I will turn you back from harlotry, and I will no more give [you] rewards. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} So will I slacken my fury against you, and my jealousy shall be removed from you, and I will rest, and be no more careful [for you]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} Because you did not remember your infancy, and you did grieve me in all these things; therefore, behold, I have recompensed your ways upon your head, says the Lord: for thus have you wrought ungodliness above all your [other] iniquities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} These are all the things they have spoken against you in a proverb, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} As is the mother, so is your mother's daughter: you are she that has rejected her husband and her children; and the sisters of your sisters have rejected their husbands and their children: your mother was a Chettite, and [your] father an Amorite. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} Your elder sister who dwells on your left hand is Samaria, she and her daughters: and your younger sister, that dwells on the right hand, is Sodom and her daughters. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} Yet notwithstanding you have not walked in their ways, neither have you done according to their iniquities within a little, but you have exceeded them in all your ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} [As] I live, says the Lord, this Sodom and her daughters have not done as you and your daughters have done. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} Moreover this was the sin of your sister Sodom, pride: she and her daughters lived in pleasure, in fullness of bread [and] in abundance: this belonged to her and her daughters, and they helped not the hand of the poor and needy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} And they boasted, and wrought iniquities before me: so I cut them off as I saw [fit]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} Also Samaria has not sinned according to half of your sins; but you have multiplied your iniquities beyond them, and you have justified your sisters in all your iniquities which you have committed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} You therefore bear your punishment, for that you have corrupted your sisters by your sins which you have committed beyond them; and you have made them [appear] more righteous than yourself: you therefore be ashamed, and bear your dishonor, in that you have justified your sisters. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} And I will turn their captivity, [even] the captivity of Sodom and her daughters; and I will turn the captivity of Samaria and her daughters; and I will turn your captivity in the midst of them: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{54}} that you may bear your punishment, and be dishonored for all that you have done in provoking me to anger. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{55}} And your sister Sodom and her daughters shall be restored as they were at the beginning, and you and your daughters shall be restored as you⌃ were at the beginning. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{56}} And surely your sister Sodom was not mentioned by your mouth in the days of your pride: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{57}} before your wickedness was revealed, even now you are the reproach of the daughters of Syria, and of all that are round about her, [even] of the daughters of the Philistines that compass you round about. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{58}} [As for] your ungodliness and your iniquities, you have borne them, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{59}} Thus says the Lord; I will even do to you as you have done, as you have dealt shamefully in these things to transgress my covenant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{60}} And I will remember my covenant [made] with you in the days of your infancy, and I will establish to you an everlasting covenant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{61}} Then you shall remember your way, and shall be utterly dishonored when you receive your elder sisters with your younger ones: and I will give them to you for building up, but not by your covenant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{62}} And I will establish my covenant with you; and you shall know that I am the Lord: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{63}} that you may remember, and be ashamed, and may no more be able to open your mouth for your shame, when I am reconciled to you for all that you have done, says the Lord.\par

\subsection*{Ezekiel 17}
\markright{EZEKIEL 17}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Son of man, relate a tale, and speak a parable to the house of Israel: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and you shall say, Thus says the Lord; A great eagle with large wings, spreading them out very far, with many claws, which has the design of entering into Libanus—and he took the choice [branches] of the cedar: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} he cropped off the ends of the tender twigs, and brought them into the land of Chanaan; he laid them up in a walled city. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And he took of the seed of the land, and sowed it in a field planted by much water; he set it in a conspicuous place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And it sprang up, and became a weak and little vine, so that the branches thereof appeared [upon] it, and its roots were under it: and it became a vine, and put forth shoots, and sent forth its tendrils. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And there was another great eagle, with great wings and many claws: and, behold, this vine bent itself round toward him, and her roots [were turned] towards him, and she sent forth her branches towards him, that [he] might water her together with the growth of her plantation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} She thrives in a fair field by much water, to produce shoots and bear fruit, that she might become a great vine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Therefore say, Thus says the Lord; Shall it prosper? shall not the roots of her tender stem and her fruit be blighted? yes, all her early shoots shall be dried up, and [that] not by a mighty arm, nor by many people, to tear her up from her roots. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And, behold, it thrives: shall it prosper? shall it not wither as soon as the east wind touches it? it shall be withered together with the growth of its shoots. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Moreover the word of the Lord came to me saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Son of man, say now to the provoking house, Know you⌃ not what these things were? say [to them], Whenever the king of Babylon shall come against Jerusalem, then he shall take her king and her princes, and shall take them home to Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And he shall take of the seed royal, and shall make a covenant with him, and shall bind him with an oath: and he shall take the princes of the land: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} that it may become a weak kingdom, so as never to lift itself up, that he may keep his covenant, and establish it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And [if] he shall revolt from him, to send his messengers into Egypt, that [they] may give him horses and much people; shall he prosper? shall he that acts as an adversary be preserved? and shall he that transgresses the covenant be preserved? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} [As] I live, says the Lord, verily in [the] place where the king is that made him king, who dishonored my oath, and who broke my covenant, shall he die with him in the midst of Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And Pharaoh shall make war upon him not with a large force or great multitude, in throwing up a mound, and in building of forts, to cut off souls. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Whereas he has profaned the oath so as to break the covenant, when, behold, I engage his hand, and he has done all these things to him, he shall not escape. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Therefore say, Thus says the Lord; [As] I live, surely my oath which he has profaned, and my covenant which he has transgressed, I will even recompense it upon his head. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And I will spread a net upon him, and he shall be caught in its snare. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} In every battle of his they shall fall by the sword, and I will scatter [his] remnant to every wind: and you⌃ shall know that I the Lord have spoken it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} For thus says the Lord; I will even take of the choice [branches] of the cedar from the top [thereof], I will crop off their hearts, and I will plant it on a high mountain: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} and I will hang it on a lofty mountain of Israel: yes, I will plant it, and it shall put forth shoots, and shall bear fruit, and it shall be a great cedar: and every bird shall rest beneath it, even every fowl shall rest under its shadow: its branches shall be restored. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And all the trees of the field shall know that I am the Lord that bring low the high tree, and exalt the low tree, and wither the green tree, and cause the dry tree to flourish: I the Lord have spoken, and will do [it].\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{6} Gk. vocab: klados (κλάδος) = branch. Common English renderings: branch. Used of a branch or shoot.\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{3} A great Nebuchadnezzar, so called from his towering ambition and rapaciousness.; great wings Extensive empire, both in length and breadth., full Numerous subjects, of various nations, and of different languages and manners. divers colours Heb. embroidering came Came against Judah and Jerusalem.; the highest Jeconiah, whom he took captive to Babylon. the cedar The royal and ancient family of David. \textsuperscript{4} the top The princes of Judah. into; a land Chaldea a city Babylon, which by means of the Euphrates and Tigris, had communications with the richest and most distant nations. \textsuperscript{5} the seed Zedekiah, brother to Jeconiah.; planted it in a fruitful field Heb. put it in a field of seed, Made him king of Judea. he placed Made him dependent on Babylon, the city of great waters, as the willow is on humidity. \textsuperscript{6} it grew; whose The Jewish state had then no height of dominion; and Zedekiah was wholly dependent on Nebuchadnezzar. \textsuperscript{7} another Pharaoh-hophra, or Apries, king of Egypt.; did bend Looked to him for support, in his intended rebellion. \textsuperscript{8} soil Heb. field, and that Though he was dependent on Babylon, yet he was in such a situation as would have enabled him to reign in credit, and be useful to his people. \textsuperscript{9} Shall it Shall he succeed in casting off the yoke of the king of Babylon, to whom he had sworn fealty?; shall he He shall come and dethrone him, and carry him captive.;, the fruit The children of Zedekiah. even \textsuperscript{12} to the, ; Know; Behold; and led \textsuperscript{13} hath taken; taken an oath of him Heb. brought him to an oath; he hath also \textsuperscript{14} the kingdom; base Or, low; a tributary kingdom, dependent on the king of Babylon. but that by keeping of his covenant it might stand Heb. to keep his covenant, to stand to it \textsuperscript{15} he rebelled; in; Shall he prosper; shall he escape;, ; or shall \textsuperscript{18} Seeing Though Zedekiah's oath had been given to a heathen, a conqueror, and a tyrant, yet God considered the violation of it a most aggravated sin against Him, and determined to punish him for it. he; \subsection*{Ezekiel 18}
\markright{EZEKIEL 18}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Son of man, what mean you⌃ by this parable among the children of Israel, saying, The fathers have eaten unripe grapes, and the children's teeth have been set on edge? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} [As] I live, says the Lord, surely this parable shall no more be spoken in Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son, they are mine: the soul that sins, it shall die. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} But the man who shall be just, who executes judgment and righteousness, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} who shall not eat upon the mountains, and shall not at all lift up his eyes to the devices of the house of Israel, and shall not defile his neighbor's wife, and shall not draw near to her that is removed, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} and shall not oppress any man, [but] shall return the pledge of the debtor, and shall be guilty of no plunder, shall give his bread to the hungry, and clothe the naked; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} and shall not lend his money upon usury, and shall not receive usurious increase, and shall turn back his hand from injustice, shall execute righteous judgment between a man and his neighbor, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} and has walked in my commandments and kept my ordinances, to do them; he is righteous, he shall surely live, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And if he beget a mischievous son, shedding blood and committing sins, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} who has not walked in the way of his righteous father, but has even eaten upon the mountains, and has defiled his neighbor's wife, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} and has oppressed the poor and needy, and has committed robbery, and not restored a pledge, and has set his eyes upon idols, has wrought iniquities, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} has lent upon usury, and taken usurious increase; he shall by no means live: he has wrought all these iniquities; he shall surely die; his blood shall be upon him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And if he beget a son, and [the son] see all his father's sins which he has wrought, and fear, and not do according to them, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} and [if he] has not eaten on the mountains, and has not set his eyes on the devices of the house of Israel, and has not defiled his neighbor's wife, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} and has not oppressed a man, and has not retained the pledge, nor committed robbery, has given his bread to the hungry, and has clothed the naked, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} and has turned back his hand from unrighteousness, has not received interest or usurious increase, has wrought righteousness, and walked in my ordinances; he shall not die for the iniquities of his father, he shall surely live. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} But if his father grievously afflict, or plunder, he has wrought enmity in the midst of my people, and shall die in his iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} But you⌃ will say, Why has not the son borne the iniquity of the father? Because the son has wrought judgment and mercy, has kept all my statues, and done them, he shall surely live. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But the soul that sins shall die: and the son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, nor shall the father bear the iniquity of the son: the righteousness of the righteous shall be upon him, and the iniquity of the transgressor shall be upon him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And if the transgressor turn away from all his iniquities which he has committed, and keep all my commandments, and do justice and mercy, he shall surely live, and shall by no means die. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} None of his trespasses which he has committed shall be remembers: in his righteousness which he has done he shall live. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Shall I at all desire death of the sinner, says the Lord, as I [desire] that he should turn from [his] evil way, and live? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} But when the righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, according to all the transgressions which the transgressor has wrought, none of his righteousness which he has wrought shall be at all remembered: in his trespass wherein he has trespassed, and in his sins wherein he has sinned, in them shall he die. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Yet you⌃ have said, The way of the Lord is not straight. Hear now, all the house of Israel; will not my way be straight? Is your way straight? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} When the righteous turns away from his righteousness and commits a trespass, and dies in the trespass he has committed, he shall [even] die in it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And when the wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he has committed, and shall do judgment and justice, he has kept his soul, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} and has turned away from all his ungodliness which he has committed: he shall surely live, he shall not die. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Yet the house of Israel say, The way of the Lord is not right. Is not my way right, O house of Israel? is not your way wrong? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} I will judge you, O house of Israel, says the Lord, each one according to his way: be converted, and turn from all your ungodliness, and it shall not become to you the punishment of iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Cast away from yourselves all your ungodliness wherein you⌃ have sinned against me; and make to yourselves a new heart and a new spirit: for why should you⌃ die, O house of Israel? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} For I desire not the death of him that dies, says the Lord.\par

\subsection*{Ezekiel 19}
\markright{EZEKIEL 19}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Moreover do you take up a lamentation for the prince of Israel, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} and say, Why is your mother become a whelp in the midst of lions? in the midst of lions she has multiplied her whelps. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And one of her whelps sprang forth; he became a lion, and learned to take prey, he devoured men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And the nations heard a report of him; he was caught in their pit, and they brought him into the land of Egypt in chains. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And she saw that he was driven away from her, [and] her hope [of him] perished, and she took another of her whelps; she made him a lion. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And he went up and down in the midst of lions, he became a lion, and learned to take prey, he devoured men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And he prowled in his boldness and laid waste their cities, and made the land desolate, and the fullness of it, by the voice of his roaring. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Then the nations set upon him from the countries round about, and they spread their nets upon him: he was taken in their pit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And they put him in chains and in a cage, [and] he came to the king of Babylon; and he cast him into prison, that his voice should not be heard on the mountains of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Your mother was as a vine and as a blossom on a pomegranate tree, planted by water: her fruit and her shoot abounded by reason of much water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And she became a rod for a tribe of princes, and was elevated in her bulk in the midst of [other] trees, and she saw her bulk in the multitude of her branches. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} But she was broken down in wrath, she was cast upon the ground, and the east wind dried up her choice [branches]: vengeance came upon them, and the rod of her strength was withered; fire consumed it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And now they have planted her in the wilderness, in a dry land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And fire is gone out of a rod of her choice [boughs], and has devoured her; and there was no rod of strength in her. Her race is become a parable of lamentation, and it shall be for a lamentation.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} A lioness Judea, which possessed strength, courage, and sovereignty.; she lay Had confederacy with the neighbouring kings, and learned their manners. her whelps The sons of Josiah, who learned to be oppressive tyrants from the surrounding princes. young lions \textsuperscript{3} one Jehoahaz, made king of Israel instead of Josiah, who became cruel and oppressive. it became \textsuperscript{4} he was Taken prisoner by Pharaoh-necho, and brought into Egypt. \textsuperscript{5} another Jehoiakim.; a young lion King of Judah. \textsuperscript{6} he went Became a perfect heathen. He reigned eleven years, a monster of iniquity.;, he became \textsuperscript{7} desolate palaces or, widows and the land;, the fulness \textsuperscript{9} chains or, hooks and brought; that his \textsuperscript{10} mother; like; blood or, quietness, or, likeness she was; full Many princes \textsuperscript{11} she had Many powerful sovereigns, who rendered Judah very considerable among the nations., ; her stature \textsuperscript{12} she was The kingdom was entirely ruined, and her princes cut off.;, ; the east; strong;, ;, the fire \textsuperscript{13} she is; in the wilderness In Chaldea, whither they were carried captive. in a dry \textsuperscript{14} fire The treachery of Zedekiah hath caused her utter ruin.; she hath; This is\par}

\subsection*{Ezekiel 20}
\markright{EZEKIEL 20}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it came to pass in the seventh year, on the fifteenth day of the month, there came men of the elders of the house of Israel to enquire of the Lord, and they sat before me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Son of man, speak to the elders of the house of Israel, and you shall say to them, Thus says the Lord; Are you⌃ come to enquire of me? [As] I live, I will not be enquired of by you, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Shall I utterly take vengeance on them, son of man? testify to them of the iniquities of their fathers: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} and you shall say to them, Thus says the Lord; From the day that I chose the house of Israel, and became known to the seed of the house of Jacob, and was known to them in the land of Egypt, and helped them with my hand, saying, I am the Lord your God; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} in that day I helped them with my hand, to bring them out of the land of Egypt into the land which I prepared for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, it is abundant beyond every land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I said to them, Let every one cast away the abominations of his eyes, and defile not yourselves with the devices of Egypt: I am the Lord your God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} But they revolted from me, and would not listen to me: they cast not away the abominations of their eyes, and forsook not the devices of Egypt: then I said that I would pour out my wrath upon them, to accomplish my wrath upon them in the midst of Egypt. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} But I wrought [so] that my name should not be at all profaned in the sight of the Gentiles, in the midst of whom they are, among whom I was made known to them in their sight, to bring them out of the land of Egypt. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And I brought them into the wilderness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And I gave them my commandments, and made known to them my ordinances, all which [if] a man shall do, he shall even live in them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And I gave them my sabbaths, that they should be for a sign between me and them, that they should know that I am the Lord that sanctify them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And I said to the house of Israel in the wilderness, Walk you⌃ in my commandments: but they walked not [in them], and they rejected my ordinances, which [if] a man shall do, he shall even live in them; and they grievously profaned my sabbaths: and I said that I would pour out my wrath upon them in the wilderness, to consume them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} But I wrought [so] that my name should not be at all profaned before the Gentiles, before whose eyes I brought them out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} But I lifted up my hand against them in the wilderness once for all, that I would not bring them into the land which I gave them, a land flowing with milk and honey, it is sweeter than all lands: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} because they rejected my ordinances, and walked not in my commandments, but profaned my sabbaths, and went after the imaginations of their hearts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Yet my eyes spared them, so as [not] to destroy them utterly, and I did not make an end of them in the wilderness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And I said to their children in the wilderness, Walk not you⌃ in the customs of your fathers, and keep not their ordinances, and have no fellowship with their practices, nor defile yourselves [with them]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} I [am] the Lord your God; walk in my commandments, and keep my ordinances, and do them; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} and hallow my sabbaths, and let them be a sign between me and you, that you⌃ may know that I am the Lord your God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} But they provoked me, and their children walked not in my commandments, and they took no heed to my ordinances to do them, which [if] a man shall do, he shall even live in them, and they profaned my sabbaths: then I said that I would pour out my wrath upon them in the wilderness, to accomplish my anger upon them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} But I wrought so that my name might not be at all profaned before the Gentiles; and I brought them out in their sight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} I lifted up my hand against them in the wilderness, that I would scatter them among the Gentiles, [and] disperse them in the countries; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} because they kept not my ordinances, and rejected my commandments, and profaned my sabbaths, and their eyes went after the imaginations of their fathers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} So I gave them commandments [that were] not good, and ordinances in which they should not live. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And I will defile them by their [own] decrees, when I pass through upon every one that opens the womb, that I may destroy them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Therefore, son of man, speak to the house of Israel, and you shall say to them, Thus says the Lord: Hitherto have your fathers provoked me in their trespasses in which they transgressed against me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Whereas I brought them into the land concerning which I lifted up my hand to give it them; and they looked upon every high hill, and every shady tree, and they sacrificed there to their gods, and offered there sweet smelling savor, and there they poured out their drink-offerings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And I said to them, What is Abama, that you⌃ go in there? and they called its name Abama, until this day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord, Do you⌃ pollute yourselves with the iniquities of your fathers, and do you⌃ go a-whoring after their abominations, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} and [do you⌃ pollute yourselves] with the first fruits of your gifts, in the offerings wherewith you⌃ pollute yourselves in all your imaginations, until this day; and shall I answer you, O house of Israel? [As] I live, says the Lord, I will not answer you, neither shall this thing come upon your spirit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And it shall not be as you⌃ say, We will be as the nations, and as the tribes of the earth, to worship stocks and stones. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Therefore, [as] I live, says the Lord, I will reign over you with a strong hand, and with a high arm, and with outpoured wrath: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} I will bring you out from the nations, and will take you out of the lands wherein you⌃ were dispersed, with a strong hand, and with a high arm, and with outpoured wrath. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And I will bring you into the wilderness of the nations, and will plead with you there face to face. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} As I pleaded with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so will I judge you, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And I will cause you to pass under my rod, and I will bring you in by number. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And I will separate from among you the ungodly and the revolters; for I will lead them forth out of their place of sojourning, and they shall not enter into the land of Israel: and you⌃ shall know that I am the Lord, [even] the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And [as to] you, O house of Israel, thus says the Lord, [even] the Lord; Put away each one his [evil] practices, and hereafter if you⌃ listen to me, then shall you⌃ no more profane my holy name by your gifts and by devices. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} For upon my holy mountain, on the high mountain, says the Lord, [even] the Lord, there shall all the house of Israel serve me for ever: and there will I accept [you], and there will I have respect to your first fruits, and the first fruits of your offerings, in all your holy things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} I will accept you with a sweet smelling savor, when I bring you out from the nations, and take you out of the countries wherein you⌃ have been dispersed; and I will be sanctified among you in the sight of the nations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And you⌃ shall know that I am the Lord, when I have brought you into the land of Israel, into the land concerning which I lifted up my hand to give it to your fathers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And you⌃ shall there remember your ways, and your devices wherewith you⌃ defiled yourselves; and you⌃ shall bewail yourselves for all your wickedness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And you⌃ shall know that I am the Lord, when I have done thus to you, that my name may not be profaned in your evil ways, and in your corrupt devices, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} Son of man, set your face against Thaeman, and look toward Darom, and prophesy against the chief forest of Nageb, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} and you shall say to the forest of Nageb, Hear the word of the Lord; thus says the Lord, [even] the Lord; Behold, I [will] kindle a fire in you, and it shall devour in you every green tree, and every dry tree: the flame that is kindled shall not be quenched, and every face shall be scorched with it from the south to the north. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} And all flesh shall know that I the Lord have kindled it: it shall not be quenched. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} And I said, Not so, O Lord God! they say to me, Is not this that is spoken a parable?\par

by which they were ripened for the destruction which he intended to bring upon them, that they might learn to know God by his judgments, seeing they had despised his mercies. \subsection*{Ezekiel 21}
\markright{EZEKIEL 21}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Therefore prophesy, son of man, set your face steadfastly toward Jerusalem, and look toward their holy places, and you shall prophesy against the land of Israel, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and you shall say to the land of Israel, Thus says the Lord; Behold, I am against you, and I will draw forth my sword out of its sheath, and I will destroy out of you the transgressor and unrighteous. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Because I will destroy out of you the unrighteous and the transgressor, [therefore] so shall my sword come forth out of its sheath against all flesh from the south to the north: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} and all flesh shall know that I the Lord have drawn forth my sword out of its sheath: it shall not return any more. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And you, son of man, groan with the breaking of your loins; you shall even groan heavily in their sight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And it shall come to pass, if they shall say to you, Therefore do you groan? that you shall say, For the report; because it comes: and every heart shall break, and all hands shall become feeble, and all flesh and every spirit shall faint, and all thighs shall be defiled with moisture: behold, it comes, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Son of man, prophesy, and you shall say, Thus says the Lord; Say, Sword, sword, be sharpened and rage, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} that you may kill victims; be sharpened that you may be bright, ready for slaughter, kill, set at nothing, despise every tree. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And he made it ready for his hand to hold: the sword is sharpened, it is ready to put into the hand of the slayer. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Cry out and howl, son of man: for this [sword] is come upon my people, this [sword is come] upon all the princes of Israel: they shall be as strangers: [judgment] with the sword is come upon my people: therefore clap your hands, for sentence has been passed: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} and what if even the tribe be rejected? it shall not be, says the Lord God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And you, son of man, prophesy, and clap your hands, and take a second sword: the third sword is [the sword] of the slain, the great sword of the slain: and you shall strike them with amazement, lest the heart should faint {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} and the weak ones be multiplied at every gate—they are given up to the slaughter of the sword: it is well fitted for slaughter, it is well fitted for glittering. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And do you go on, sharpen yourself on the right and on the left wherever your face may set itself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And I also will clap my hands, and let loose my fury: I the Lord have spoken [it]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} and you, son of man, appoint you two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may enter in: the two shall go forth of one country; and [there shall be] a force at the top of the way of the city, you shall set [it] at the top of the way, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} that the sword may enter in upon Rabbath of the children of Ammon, and upon Judea, and upon Jerusalem in the midst thereof. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For the king of Babylon shall stand on the old way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination, to make bright the arrow, and to enquire of the graven images, and to examine [the victims]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} On his right was the divination against Jerusalem, to cast a mound, to open the mouth in shouting, to lift up the voice with crying, to cast a mound against her gates, to cast up a heap, and to build forts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And he was to them as one using divination before them, and he himself recounting his iniquities, that they might be borne in mind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Therefore thus says the Lord, Because you⌃ have caused your iniquities to be remembered, in the discovery of your wickedness, so that your sins should be seen, in all your wickedness and in your [evil] practices; because you⌃ have caused remembrance [of them], in these shall you⌃ be taken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And you profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day, [even] an end, is come in a sea of iniquity, thus says the Lord; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} You have taken off the mitre and put on the crown, it shall not have such [another] after it: you have abased that which was high, and exalted that which was low. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Injustice, injustice, injustice, will I make it: woe to it: such shall it be until he comes to whom it belongs; and I will deliver [it] to him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And you, son of man, prophesy, and you shall say, Thus says the Lord, concerning the children of Ammon, and concerning their reproach; and you shall say, O sword, sword, drawn for slaughter, and drawn for destruction, awake, that you may gleam. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} While you are seeing vain [visions], and while you are prophesying falsehoods, to bring yourself upon the necks of ungodly transgressors, the day is come, [even] an end, in a season of iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Turn, rest not in this place wherein you were born: in your own land will I judge you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And I will pour out my wrath upon you, I will blow upon you with the fire of my wrath, and I will deliver you into the hands of barbarians skilled in working destruction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} You shall be fuel for fire; your blood shall be in the midst of your land; there shall be no remembrance at all of you: for I the Lord have spoken [it].\par
