\subsection*{Ezekiel 22}
\markright{EZEKIEL 22}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And you, son of man, will you judge the bloody city? yes, declare you to her all her iniquities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And you shall say, Thus says the Lord God: O city that sheds blood in the midst of her, so that her time should come, and that forms devices against herself, to defile herself; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} in their blood which you have shed, you have transgressed; and in your devices which you have formed, you have polluted yourself; and you have brought near your days, and have brought on the time of your years: therefore have I made you a reproach to the Gentiles, and a mockery to all the countries, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} to those near you, and to those far distant from you; and they shall mock you, [you that are] notoriously unclean, and abundant in iniquities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Behold, the princes of the house of Israel have conspired in you each one with his kindred, that they might shed blood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} In you they have reviled father and mother; and in you they have behaved unjustly toward the stranger: they have oppressed the orphan and widow. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And they have set at nothing my holy things, and in you they have profaned my sabbaths. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} [There are] robbers in you, to shed blood in you; and in you they have eaten upon the mountains: they have wrought ungodliness in the midst of you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} In you they have uncovered the father's shame; and in you they have humbled her that was set apart for uncleanness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} They have dealt unlawfully each one with his neighbor's wife; and each one in ungodliness has defiled his daughter-in-law: and in you they have humbled each one his sister, the daughter of his father. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} In you they have received gifts to shed blood; they have received in you interest and usurious increase; and by oppression you have brought your wickedness to the full, and have forgotten me, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And if I shall strike my hand at [your iniquities] which you have accomplished, which you have wrought, and at your blood that has been shed in the midst of you, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} shall your heart endure? shall your hands be strong in the days which I bring upon you? I the Lord have spoken, and will do [it]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And I will scatter you among the nations, and disperse you in the countries, and your uncleanness shall be removed out of you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And I will give heritages in you in the sight of the nations, and you⌃ shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Son of man, behold, the house of Israel are all become to me [as it were] mixed with brass, and iron, and tin, and lead; they are mixed up in the midst of the silver. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Therefore say, Thus says the Lord God; Because you⌃ have become one mixture, therefore I will gather you into the midst of Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} As silver, and brass, and iron, and tin, and lead, are gathered into the midst of the furnace, to blow fire into it, that they may be melted: so will I take [you] in my wrath, and I will gather and melt you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And I will blow upon you in the fire of my wrath, and you⌃ shall be melted in the midst thereof. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} As silver is melted in the midst of a furnace, so shall you⌃ be melted in the midst thereof; and you⌃ shall know that I the Lord have poured out my wrath upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Son of man, say to her, You are the land that is not rained upon, neither has rain come upon you in the day of wrath; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} whose princes in the midst of her are as roaring lions seizing prey, devouring souls by oppression, and taking bribes; and your widows are multiplied in the midst of you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Her priests also have set at nothing my law, and profaned my holy things: they have not distinguished between the holy and profane, nor have they distinguished between the unclean and the clean, and have hid their eyes from my sabbaths, and I was profaned in the midst of them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Her princes in the midst of her are as wolves ravening to shed blood, that they may get dishonest gain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And her prophets that daub them shall fall, that see vanities, that prophesy falsehoods, saying, Thus says the Lord, when the Lord has not spoken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} That sorely oppress the people of the land with injustice, and commit robbery; oppressing the poor and needy, and not dealing justly with the stranger. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And I sought from among them a man behaving uprightly, and standing before me perfectly in the time of wrath, so that I should not utterly destroy her: but I found [him] not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} So I have poured out my wrath upon her in the fury of my anger, to accomplish [it]. I have recompensed their ways on their own heads, says the Lord God.\par

\subsection*{Ezekiel 23}
\markright{EZEKIEL 23}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and they went a-whoring in Egypt in their youth: there their breasts fell, there they lost their virginity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And their names were Oola the elder, and Ooliba her sister: and they were mine, and bore sons and daughters: and [as for] their names, Samaria was Oola, and Jerusalem was Ooliba. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And Oola went a-whoring from me, and doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians that were her neighbors, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} clothed with purple, princes and captains; [they were] young men and choice, all horseman riding on horses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And she bestowed her fornication upon them; all were choice sons of the Assyrians: and on whoever she doted herself, with them she defiled herself in all [their] devices. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And she forsook not her fornication with the Egyptians: for in her youth they committed fornication with her, and they deflowered her, and poured out their fornication upon her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Therefore I delivered her into the hands of her lovers, into the hands of the children of the Assyrians, on whom she doted. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} They uncovered her shame: they took her sons and daughters, and killed her with the sword: and she became a byword among women: and they wrought vengeance in her for the sake of the daughters. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And her sister Ooliba saw [it], and she indulged in her fondness more corruptly than she, and in her fornication more than the fornication of her sister. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} She doted upon the sons of the Assyrian, princes and captains, her neighbors, clothed with fine linen, horsemen riding on horses; [they were] all choice young men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And I saw that they were defiled, [that] the two [had] one way. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And she increased her fornication, and she saw men painted on the wall, likenesses of the Chaldeans painted with a pencil, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} having variegated girdles on their loins, having also richly dyed [attire] upon their heads; all had a princely appearance, the likeness of the children of the Chaldeans, of their native land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And she doted upon them as soon as she saw them, and sent forth messengers to them into the land of the Chaldeans. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And the sons of Babylon came to her, into the bed of rest, and they defiled her in her fornication, and she was defiled by them, and her soul was alienated from them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And she exposed her fornication, and exposed her shame: and my soul was alienated from her, even as my soul was alienated from her sister. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And you did multiply your fornication, so as to call to remembrance the days of your youth, wherein you did commit whoredom in Egypt, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} and you did dote upon the Chaldeans, whose flesh is as the flesh of the asses, and their members [as] the members of horses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And you did look upon the iniquity of your youth, [the things] which you wrought in Egypt in your lodgings, where were the breasts of your youth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Therefore, Ooliba, thus says the Lord; Behold, I [will] stir up your lovers against you, from whom your soul is alienated, and I will bring them upon you round about, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} the children of Babylon, and all the Chaldeans, Phacuc, and Sue, and Hychue, and all the sons of the Assyrians with them; choice young men, governors and captains, all princes and renowned, riding on horses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And they all shall come upon you from the north, chariots and wheels, with a multitude of nations, shields and targets; and [the enemy] shall set a watch against you round about: and I will set judgment before them, and they shall take vengeance on you with their judgments. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And I will bring upon you my jealousy, and they shall deal with you in great wrath: they shall take away your nose and your ears; and shall cast down your remnant with the sword: they shall take your sons and your daughters; and your remnant fire shall devour. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And they shall strip you of your raiment, and take [away] your ornaments. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} So I will turn back your ungodliness from you, and your fornication from the land of Egypt: and you shall not lift up your eyes upon them, and shall no more remember Egypt. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Therefore thus says the Lord God; Behold, I [will] deliver you into the hands of those whom you hate, from whom your soul is alienated. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And they shall deal with you in hatred, and shall take all [the fruits] of your labors and your toils, and you shall be naked and bare: and the shame of your fornication shall be exposed: and your ungodliness and your fornication {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} brought this upon you, in that you went a-whoring after the nations, and did defile yourself with their devices. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} You did walk in the way of your sister; and I will put her cup into your hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Thus says the Lord; Drink your sister's cup, deep and large, and full, to cause complete drunkenness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And you shall be thoroughly weakened; and the cup of destruction, the cup of your sister Samaria, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} drink you it, and I will take away her feasts and her new moons: for I have spoken [it], says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Therefore thus says the Lord; Because you have forgotten me, and cast me behind your back, therefore receive you [the reward] of your ungodliness and your fornication. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And the Lord said to me, Son of man, will you not judge Oola and Ooliba? and declare to them their iniquities? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} For they have committed adultery, and blood was in their hands, they committed adultery with their devices, and they passed through the fire to them their children which they bore to me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} So long too as they did these things to me, they defiled my sanctuary, and profaned my sabbaths. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And when they sacrificed their children to their idols, they also went into my sanctuary to profane it: and whereas they did thus in the midst of my house; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} and whereas they did thus to the men that came from afar, to whom they sent messengers, and as soon as they came, immediately you did wash yourself, and did paint your eyes and adorn yourself with ornaments, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} and sat on a prepared bed, and before it [there was] a table set out, and [as for] my incense and my oil, they rejoiced in them, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} and they raised a sound of music, and [that] with men coming from the wilderness out of a multitude of men, and they put bracelets on their hands, and a crown of glory on their heads; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} Therefore I said, Do they not commit adultery with these? and has she also gone a-whoring [after] the manner of a harlot? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And they went in to her, as [men] go in to a harlot; so they went in to Oola and to Ooliba to work iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} And they are just men, and shall take vengeance on them with the judgment of an adulteress and the judgment of blood: for they are adulteresses, and blood is in their hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} Thus says the Lord God, Bring up a multitude upon them, and send trouble and plunder into the midst of them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} And stone them with the stones of a multitude, and pierce them with their swords: they shall kill their sons and their daughters, and shall burn up their houses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} And I will remove ungodliness out of the land, and all the women shall be instructed, and shall not do according to their ungodliness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} And your ungodliness shall be recompensed upon you, and you⌃ shall bear the guilt of your devices: and you⌃ shall know that I am the Lord.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{4} the names The kingdom of Israel, of which Samaria was the capital, containing ten tribes, and occupying a larger extent of country than that of Judah, is therefore called "her elder sister; " and Aholah, the name given to her, implies that the whole religious establishment in Israel was a human invention, a temple and service of their own, and not of God's appointment. Aholibah, the name given to Judah, implies that the worship established there was from God, and that His temple was truly at Jerusalem. the elder; they were; Aholah that is, His tent, or tabernacle; Aholibah that is, My tabernacle in her \textsuperscript{5} Aholah The Israelites, in addition to their former gross idolatries, received the impure idolatrous worship of the Assyrians, who became their neighbours by the conquest of Syria., ; doted, ; on the \textsuperscript{7} committed her whoredoms with them Heb. bestowed her whoredoms upon them, the chosen men of Assyria Heb. the choice of the children of Asshur, with all their \textsuperscript{10} discovered; they took famous Heb. a name \textsuperscript{11} her sister; was more corrupt in her inordinate love than she Heb. she corrupted her inordinate love more than she. her sister in her whoredoms. Heb. the whoredoms of her sister. \textsuperscript{15} with girdles; all of; look to That is, "princes in appearance; " which seem to have been the deified men worshipped by the Chaldeans. The inhabitants of Judah, like the Israelites, connected themselves with the Assyrians, and were enamoured with their idols; and then with the Chaldeans, and followed their idols; still retaining their attachment to the Egyptians and their idolatrous rites. \textsuperscript{16} as soon as she saw them with her eyes Heb. at the sight of her eyes; and sent \textsuperscript{17} Babylonians Heb. children of Babel, and her, ; alienated Heb. loosed, or disjointed \textsuperscript{22} I will raise, ; from and I \textsuperscript{23} Babylonians; the Chaldeans; Pekod the Assyrians; desirable \textsuperscript{24} with chariots; I will set \textsuperscript{25} I will set, ; they shall take away This refers to the severe vengeance which enraged husbands took on their faithless wives, and implies that God would employ the Chaldeans to destroy the princes and priests of Judah, for violating their covenants and treaties. Such punishments were anciently common; and such is the present practice in one of the South Sea Islands. they shall take thy; thy residue \textsuperscript{26} strip, ; fair jewels Heb. instruments of thy decking \textsuperscript{27} will I; and thy, so that These severe judgments shall effectually deter you from idolatry, and make you abhor the least approaches to it. This often repeated prediction has received a most wonderful accomplishment. For neither the authority, frowns, examples, or favour of their conquerors or powerful neighbours, nor their own fears, hopes, interests, or predilection for the sensual worship of idols, could prevail with them to run into gross idolatry, either during the captivity, or ever afterwards, to the present day, a period of 2, 414 years. \textsuperscript{30} thou hast;, because thou art \textsuperscript{33} filled; with the cup of astonishment \textsuperscript{36} wilt; judge or, plead for, Aholah declare \textsuperscript{37} they have; and blood, ; have also \textsuperscript{40} ye have; to come Heb. coming, thou didst; paintedst Kachalt aineych rendered by the LXX εστιβιζου τους οφθαλμους σου; "thou didst paint thine eyes with stibium, " and Vulgate circumlinisti stibio oculos tuos "thou didst paint round thine eyes with stibium, " or lead ore; whence it is called in Arabic kochl and in Syriac kecholo and koochlȯ; and deckedst \textsuperscript{41} stately Heb. honourable; a table; whereupon \textsuperscript{42} a voice This seems to be an account of an idolatrous festival, perhaps that of Bacchus; in which a riotous and drunken multitude assembled, adorned with bracelets and chaplets, accompanied with music, songs, and dances.; common sort Heb. multitude of men were brought; Sabeans or, drunkards bracelets \textsuperscript{43} old; whoredoms with her Heb. her whoredoms \textsuperscript{45} the righteous The Chaldeans, so called, because appointed by God to execute his judgment on these criminals.; after the manner of adulteresses; because \textsuperscript{46} I will; to be removed and spoiled Heb. for a removing and spoil \textsuperscript{47} the company, ; dispatch them or, single them out, shall slay; and burn \textsuperscript{49} they shall, ; ye shall bear and ye shall know\par}

\subsection*{Ezekiel 24}
\markright{EZEKIEL 24}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to me, in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth [day] of the month, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Son of man, write for yourself daily from this day, on which the king of Babylon set himself against Jerusalem, [even] from this day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And speak a parable to the provoking house, and you shall say to them, Thus says the Lord; Set on the caldron, and pour water into it: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} and put the pieces into it, every prime piece, the leg and shoulder taken off from the bones, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} [which are] taken from choice cattle, and burn the bones under them: her bones are boiled and cooked in the midst of her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Therefore thus says the Lord; O bloody city, the caldron in which there is scum, and the scum has not gone out of, she has brought it forth piece by piece, no lot has fallen upon it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For her blood is in the midst of her; I have set it upon a smooth rock: I have not poured it out upon the earth, so that the earth should cover it; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} that my wrath should come up for complete vengeance to be taken: I set her blood upon a smooth rock, so as not to cover it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Therefore thus says the Lord, I will also make the firebrand great, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} and I will multiply the wood, and kindle the fire, that the flesh may be consumed, and the liquor boiled away; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} and that [it] may stand upon the coals, that her brass may be thoroughly heated, and be melted in the midst of her filthiness, and her scum may be consumed, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} and her abundant scum may not come forth of her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Her scum shall become shameful, because you did defile yourself: and what if you shall be purged no more until I have accomplished my wrath? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} I the Lord have spoken; and it shall come, and I will do [it]; I will not delay, neither will I have any mercy: I will judge you, says the Lord, according to your ways, and according to your devices: therefore will I judge you according to your bloodshed, and according to your devices will I judge you, you unclean, notorious, and abundantly provoking one. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Son of man, behold I take from you the desire of your eyes by violence: you shall not lament, neither shall you weep. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} You shall groan for blood, and have mourning upon your loins; your hair shall not be braided upon you, and your sandals [shall be] on your feet; you shall in no wise be comforted by their lips, and you shall not eat the bread of men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And I spoke to the people in the morning, as he commanded me in the evening, and I did in the morning as it was commanded me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And the people said to me, Will you not tell us what these things are that you do? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Then I said to them, The word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord; Behold, I [will] profane my sanctuary, the boast of your strength, the desire of your eyes, and for which your souls are concerned; and your sons and your daughters, whom you⌃ have left, shall fall by the sword. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And you⌃ shall do as I have done: you⌃ shall not be comforted at their mouth, and you⌃ shall not eat the bread of men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And your hair [shall be] upon your head, and your shoes on your feet: neither shall you⌃ at all lament or weep; but you⌃ shall pine away in your iniquities, and shall comfort every one his brother. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And Jezekiel shall be for a sign to you: according to all that I have done shall you⌃ do, when these things shall come; and you⌃ shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And you, son of man, [shall it] not [be] in the day when I take their strength from them, the pride of their boasting, the desires of their eyes, and the pride of their soul, their sons and their daughters, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} that in that day he that escapes shall come to you, to tell [it] you in your ears? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} In that day your mouth shall be opened to him that escapes; you shall speak, and shall be no longer dumb: and you shall be for a sign to them, and they shall know that I am the Lord.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} am 3414, bc 590 the ninth year This was the ninth year of Zedekiah, about Thursday, January 30, am 3414, the very day in which Nebuchadnezzar began the siege of Jerusalem. \textsuperscript{5} the choice, ; burn or, heap \textsuperscript{6} Woe, ; , to the pot; bring, ; let no \textsuperscript{8} it might, ; , I have set \textsuperscript{11} set it, that the filthiness, ; The pot was Jerusalem; the flesh, the inhabitants in general: every good piece, the thigh and the shoulder, Zedekiah, his family, and princes; the bones, the soldiers; the fire and water, the calamities they were to suffer; and the setting on of the pot, the commencement of the siege. \textsuperscript{12} wearied;, ; her great; her scum The pot being polluted with the scum, must be heated, melted, and even burned with fire till purified; that is, Jerusalem shall be entirely levelled with the ground, as nothing short of this will purify it from the relics of its idolatrous abominations. \textsuperscript{13} thy filthiness; because; till I \textsuperscript{14} the Lord; neither will I spare, ; according to thy ways \textsuperscript{16} the desire, ; with a yet; thy tears, ; run Heb. go \textsuperscript{17} Forbear to cry Heb. \noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Son of man, set your face steadfastly against the children of Ammon, and prophesy against them; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and you shall say to the children of Ammon, Hear you⌃ the word of the Lord; thus says the Lord; Forasmuch as you⌃ have rejoiced against my sanctuary, because it was profaned; and against the land of Israel, because it was laid waste; and against the house of Juda, because they went into captivity; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} therefore, behold, I [will] deliver you to the children of Kedem for an inheritance, and they shall lodge in you with their stuff, and they shall pitch their tents in you: they shall eat your fruits, and they shall drink your milk. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And I will give up the city of Ammon for camels' pastures, and the children of Ammon for a pasture of sheep: and you⌃ shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} For thus says the Lord; Because you have clapped your hands, and stamped with your foot, and heartily rejoiced against the land of Israel; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} therefore I will stretch out my hand against you, and I will make you a spoil to the nations; and I will utterly destroy you from among the peoples, and I will completely cut you off from out of the countries: and you shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Thus says the Lord; Because Moab has said, Behold, are not the house of Israel and Juda like all the [other] nations? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Therefore, behold, I will weaken the shoulder of Moab from his frontier cities, [even] the choice land, the house of Bethasimuth above the fountain of the city, by the sea-side. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} I have given him the children of Kedem in addition to the children of Ammon for an inheritance, that there may be no remembrance of the children of Ammon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And I will execute vengeance on Moab; and they shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Thus says the Lord; Because of what the Idumeans have done in taking vengeance on the house of Juda, and [because they] have remembered injuries, and have exacted full recompense; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} therefore thus says the Lord; I will also stretch out my hand upon Idumea, and will utterly destroy out of it man and beast; and will make it desolate; and they that are pursued out of Thaeman shall fall by the sword. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And I will execute my vengeance on Idumea by the hand of my people Israel: and they shall deal in Idumea according to my anger and according to my wrath, and they shall know my vengeance, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Therefore thus says the Lord, Because the Philistines have wrought revengefully, and raised up vengeance rejoicing from their heart to destroy [the Israelites] to a man; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} therefore thus says the Lord; Behold, I [will] stretch out my hand upon the Philistines, and will utterly destroy the Cretans, and will cut off the remnant that dwell by the sea-coast. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And I will execute great vengeance upon them; and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I have brought my vengeance upon them.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{4} men Heb. children, ; . Josephus expressly states, that five years after the destruction of Jerusalem, Nebuchadnezzar turned his arms against the Ammonites and Moabites, and entirely subjugated them; and it is probable, that the Arabs, and other nations east of Judah, then took possession of their cities, and enjoyed the fruits of their land. The country of Moab and Ammon is now inhabited by the Bedouin Arabs; where they pasture their flocks, and, no doubt, make the ruins of Rabbah, their one proud capital, "a stable for camels, " and other cattle. \subsection*{Ezekiel 26}
\markright{EZEKIEL 26}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it came to pass in the eleventh year, on the first [day] of the month, [that] the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Son of man, because Sor has said against Jerusalem, Aha, she is crushed: the nations are destroyed: she is turned to me: she that was full is made desolate: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} therefore thus says the Lord; Behold, I am against you, O Sor, and I will bring up many nations against you, as the sea comes up with its waves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And they shall cast down the walls of Sor, and shall cast down your towers: and I will scrape her dust from off her, and make her a bare rock. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} She shall be in the midst of the sea a place for repairing nets: for I have spoken [it], says the Lord: and it shall be a spoil for the nations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And her daughters [which are] in the field shall be slain with the sword, and they shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For thus says the Lord; Behold, I [will] bring up against you, O Sor, Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon from the north: he is a king of kings, with horses, and chariots, and horsemen, and a concourse of very many nations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} He shall kill your daughters that are in the field with the sword, and shall set a watch against you, and build forts around you, and carry a rampart round against you, and set up warlike works, and array his spears against you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} He shall cast down with his swords your walls and your towers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} By reason of your multitude of his horses their dust shall cover you, and by reason of the sound of his horsemen and the wheels of his chariots the walls shall be shaken, when he enters into your gates, as one entering into a city from the plain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} With the hoofs of his horses they shall trample all your streets: he shall kill your people with the sword, and shall bring down to the ground the support of your strength. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And he shall prey upon your power, and plunder your substance, and shall cast down your walls, and break down your pleasant houses: and he shall cast your stones and your timber and your dust into the midst of your sea. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And he shall destroy the multitude of your musicians, and the sound of your lutes shall be heard no more. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And I will make you a bare rock: you shall be a place to spread nets upon; you shall be built no more: for I the Lord have spoken [it], says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For thus says the Lord God to Sor; Shall not the isles shake at the sound of your fall, while the wounded are groaning, while they have drawn a sword in the midst of you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And all the princes of the nations of the sea shall come down from their thrones, and shall take off their crowns from their heads, and shall take off their embroidered raiment: they shall be utterly amazed; they shall sit upon the ground, and fear their [own] destruction, and shall groan over you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And they shall take up a lamentation for you, and shall say to you, How are you destroyed from out of the sea, the renowned city, that brought her terror upon all her inhabitants. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And the isles shall be alarmed at the day of your fall. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} For thus says the Lord God; When I shall make the city desolate, as the cities that shall not be inhabited, when I have brought the deep up upon you, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} and great waters shall cover you; and I shall bring you down to them that go down to the pit, to the people of old time, and shall cause you to dwell in the depths of the earth, as in everlasting desolation, with them that go down to the pit, that you may not be inhabited, nor stand upon the land of life; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} I will make you a destruction, and you shall be no more for ever, says the Lord God.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} Tyrus Ezek. 27:1-28:26; Aha, ;, the gates; she is \textsuperscript{3} Behold contain a summary prediction of what befell both the continental and insular Tyre, during a long succession of ages. The former was totally destroyed by Nebuchadnezzar, after a siege of thirteen years, bc 573; and the latter, which arose out of its ruins, after seventy years recovered its ancient wealth and splendour, as foretold by Isaiah ( ). After it was taken and burnt by Alexander, bc 332, it speedily recovered its strength and dignity, and nineteen years afterwards withstood both the fleets and armies of Antigonus. Agreeably to the prophetic declarations (; . . ), it was early converted to Christianity; and after being successively taken by the Saracens, Christians, Mamalukes, and Turks, in whose hands it still remains, it became "a place for the spreading of nets." \subsection*{Ezekiel 27}
\markright{EZEKIEL 27}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to me saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And you, son of man, take up a lamentation against Sor; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and you shall say to Sor that dwells at the entrance of the sea, to the mart of the nations coming from many islands, Thus says the Lord to Sor; You have said, I have clothed myself with my beauty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} In the heart of the sea your sons have put beauty upon you for Beelim. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Cedar in Senir was employed for you in building: boards of cypress timber were taken out of Libanus, and wood to make you masts of fir. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} They made your oars [of wood] out of the land of Basan; your sacred utensils they made of ivory, your shady houses of wood from the isles of Chetiim. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Fine linen with embroidery from Egypt supplied the couch, to put honor upon you, and to clothe you with blue and purple from the isles of Elisai; and they became your coverings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And your princes were the dwellers in Sidon, and the Aradians were your rowers: your wise men, O Sor, who were in you, these were your pilots. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The elders of the Biblians, and their wise men, who were in you, these helped your counsel: and all the ships of the sea and their rowers traded for you to the utmost west. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Persians and Lydians and Libyans were in your army: your warriors hung in you shields and helmets; these gave [you] your glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} The sons of the Aradians and your army were upon the walls; there were guards in your towers: they hung their quivers on your battlements round about; these completed your beauty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} The Carthaginians were your merchants because of the abundance of all your strength; they furnished your market with silver, and gold, and iron, and tin, and lead. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Greece, both the whole [world], and the adjacent coasts, these traded with you in the persons of men, and they gave [as] your merchandise vessels of brass. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Out of the house of Thogarma horses and horsemen furnished the market. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} The sons of the Rhodians were your merchants; from the islands they multiplied your merchandise, [even] elephants' teeth: and to them that came in you did return your prices, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} [even] men [as] your merchandise, from the multitude of your trading [population], myrrh and embroidered works from Tharsis: Ramoth also and Chorchor furnished your market. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Juda and the children of Israel, these were your merchants; in the sale of corn and ointments and cassia: and they gave the best honey, and oil, and resin, to your trading [population]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} [The people of] Damascus were your merchants by reason of the abundance of all your power; wine out of Chelbon, and wool from Miletus; and they brought wine into your market. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Out of Asel [came] wrought iron, and there is the sound of wheels among your trading [population]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} [The people of] Daedan were your merchants, with choice cattle for chariots. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Arabia and all the princes of Kedar, these were your traders with you, [bringing] camels, and lambs, and rams, in which they trade with you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} The merchants of Sabba and Ramma, these were your merchants, with choice spices, and precious stones: and they brought gold to your market. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Charra, and Chanaa, these were your merchants: Assur, and Charman, were your merchants: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} bringing [for] merchandise blue, and choice stores bound with cords, and cypress wood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Ships were your merchants, in abundance, with your trading [population]: and you were filled and very heavily loaded in the heart of the sea. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Your rowers have brought you into great waters: the south wind has broken you in the heart of the sea. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Your forces, and your gain, and that of your traders, and your rowers, and your pilots, and your counselors, and they that traffic with you, and all your warriors that are in you: and all your company in the midst of you shall perish in the heart of the sea, in the day of your fall. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} At the cry of your voice your pilots shall be greatly terrified. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And all the rowers and the mariners shall come down from the ships, and the pilots of the sea shall stand on the land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And they shall wail over you with their voice, and cry bitterly, and put earth on their heads, and spread ashes under them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And their sons shall take up a [lament] for you, even a lamentation for Sor, [saying], {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} How large a reward have you gained from the sea? you have filled nations out of your abundance; and out of your mixed merchandise you have enriched all the kings of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Now are you broken in the sea, your traders are in the deep water, and all your company in the midst of you: all your rowers have fallen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} All the dwellers in the islands have mourned over you, and their kings have been utterly amazed, and their countenance has wept. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Merchants from the nations have hissed at you; you are utterly destroyed, and shall not be any more for ever.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{3} O thou Tyre was situated in the Mediterranean, at the nearest entrance to it from the interior and eastern part of Asia., ; a merchant; I am, ; of perfect beauty Heb. perfect of beauty \textsuperscript{5} made Heb. built of Senir; Shenir cedars \textsuperscript{6} the oaks; the company etc. or, they have made thy hatches of ivory well trodden, Rather, "thy benches have they made of ivory inlaid with box, from the isles of Chittim." Vulgate, de insulis Italie "from the islands of Italy, " which were always famous for box-trees. company Heb. daughters the isles, Kittim \textsuperscript{7} linen; blue and purple or, purple and scarlet; Elishah Elis, part of the Peloponnesus, extending along the western coast of Arcadia, north of Messenia, and south of Achaia. \textsuperscript{9} Gebal; *marg. calkers or, stoppers of chinks, Heb. strengtheners \textsuperscript{10} Persia; of Lud; they hanged \textsuperscript{13} Javan; , Tubal, ; the persons; market or, merchandise \textsuperscript{16} Syria, Aram; the wares of thy making Heb. thy works agate or, chrysoprase. \textsuperscript{17} wheat; Minnith balm or, rosin \textsuperscript{18} Damascus; Helbon The Chalybon of the Greeks and Romans, now called by the natives Haleb, and by us Aleppo, said to have been so celebrated for its wine, that the Persian kings would drink no other. It was a celebrated city of Syria, situated about 90 miles from the Mediterranean by way of Antioch, and 100 from the Euphrates, in lat. 36 degrees 11 minutes 25 seconds north, long. 37 degrees 9 minutes east; and previous to its destruction by an earthquake in 1822, occupied, including its suburbs, eight small hills, with the intermediate valleys, comprehending a circuit of about seven miles; and its inhabitants were variously estimated at from 100, 000 to 258, 000 souls. \textsuperscript{19} Dan going to and fro or, Menzal cassia \textsuperscript{20} Dedan; precious clothes Heb. clothes of freedom \textsuperscript{21} Arabia; Kedar; occupied with thee Heb. were the merchants of thy hand in lambs \textsuperscript{23} Haran; Charran Canneh, Calneh, Calno, Calneh Eden; Sheba; Asshur \textsuperscript{24} all sorts of things or, excellent things clothes Heb. foldings. \textsuperscript{26} rowers great; the east; midst Heb. heart \textsuperscript{27} Thy riches In these beautiful and expressive figures, Tyre is represented as a ship at sea, wrecked through the mistakes of her pilots and rowers; that is, destroyed by Nebuchadnezzar, and afterwards by Alexander, in consequence of her rulers having pertinaciously resolved to withstand those haughty conquerors. This vast ship, laden with all kinds of valuable wares, being wrecked, all her valuables, sailors, officers, etc. went to the bottom., ; and in all or, even with all shall fall, midst Heb. heart \textsuperscript{29} all that handle shall come \textsuperscript{30} shall cause All that were on land, seeing this gallant ship perishing with all her men and goods, are here represented as setting up a dismal cry at the heart-rending sight.; cast; they shall wallow \textsuperscript{32} take up, What city; the destroyed \textsuperscript{36} hiss; thou shalt, a terror Heb. terrors never shalt be any more Heb. shalt not be forever\par}

\subsection*{Ezekiel 28}
\markright{EZEKIEL 28}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And you, son of man, say to the prince of Tyrus, Thus says the Lord; Because your heart has been exalted, and you have said, I am God, I have inhabited the dwelling of God in the heart of the sea; yet you are man and not God, though you have set your heart as the heart of God: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} are you wiser than Daniel? or have not the wise instructed you with their knowledge? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Have you gained power for yourself by your [own] knowledge or your [own] prudence, and [gotten] gold and silver in your treasures? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} By your abundant knowledge and your traffic you have multiplied your power; your heart has been lifted up by your power. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Therefore thus says the Lord; Since you have set your heart as the hart of God; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} because of this, behold, I [will] bring on you strange plagues from the nations; and they shall draw their swords against you, and against the beauty of your knowledge, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} and they shall bring down your beauty to destruction. And they shall bring you down; and you shall die the death of the slain in the heart of the sea. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Will you indeed say, I am God, before them that kill you? whereas you are man, and not God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} You shall perish by the hands of strangers among the multitude of the uncircumcised: for I have spoken it, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Son of man, take up a lamentation for the prince of Tyre, and say to him, Thus says the Lord God; You are a seal of resemblance, and crown of beauty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} You were in the delight of the paradise of God; you have bound upon you every precious stone, the sardius, and topaz, and emerald, and carbuncle, and sapphire, and jasper, and silver, and gold, and ligure, and agate, and amethyst, and chrysolite, and beryl, and onyx: and you have filled your treasures and your stores in you with gold. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} From the day that you were created you [was] with the cherub: I set you on the holy mount of God; you were in the midst of the stones of fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} You were faultless in your days, from the day that you were created, until iniquity was found in you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Of the abundance of your merchandise you have filled your storehouses with iniquity, and have sinned: therefore you have been cast down wounded from the mount of God, and the cherub has brought you out of the midst of the stones of fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Your heart has been lifted up because of your beauty; your knowledge has been corrupted with your beauty: because of the multitude of your sins I have cast you to the ground, I have caused you to be put to open shame before kings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Because of the multitude of your sins and the iniquities of your merchandise, I have profaned your sacred things; and I will bring fire out of the midst of you, this shall devour you; and I will make you [to be] ashes upon your land before all that see you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And all that know you among the nations shall groan over you: you are gone to destruction, and you shall not exist any more. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Son of man, set your face against Sidon, and prophesy against it, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} and say, Thus says the Lord; Behold, I am against you, O Sidon; and I will be glorified in you; and you shall know that I am the Lord, when I have wrought judgments in you, and I will be sanctified in you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Blood and death [shall be] in your streets; and [men] wounded with swords shall fall in you and on every side of you; and they shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And there shall no more be in the house of Israel a thorn of bitterness and a pricking briar proceeding from them that are round about them, who dishonored them; and they shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Thus says the Lord God; I will also gather Israel from the nations, among whom they have been scattered, and I will be sanctified among them, and before the peoples and nations: and they shall dwell upon their land, which I gave to my servant Jacob. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Yes, they shall dwell upon it safely, and they shall build houses, and plant vineyards, and dwell securely, when I shall execute judgment on all that have dishonored them, [even] on those [that are] round about them; and they shall know that I am the Lord their God, and the God of their fathers.\par

\subsection*{Ezekiel 29}
\markright{EZEKIEL 29}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} In the twelfth year, in the tenth month, on the first [day] of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Son of man, set your face against Pharao king of Egypt, and prophesy against him, and against the whole of Egypt: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and say, Thus says the Lord; Behold, I am against Pharao, the great dragon that lies in the midst of his rivers, that says, The rivers are mine, and I made them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And I will put hooks in your jaws, and I will cause the fish of your river to stick to your sides, and I will bring you up out of the midst of your river: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} and I will quickly cast down you and all the fish of your river: you shall fall on the face of the plain, and shall by no means be gathered, and shall not be brought together: I have given you for food to the wild beasts of the earth and to the fowls of the sky. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And all the dwellers in Egypt shall know that I am the Lord, because you have been a staff of reed to the house of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} When they took hold of you with their hand, you did break: and when every hand was clapped against them, and when they leaned on you, you were utterly broken, and did crush the loins of them all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Therefore thus says the Lord; Behold, I [will] bring a sword upon you, and will cut off from you man and beast; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} and the land of Egypt shall be ruined and desert; and they shall know that I am the Lord; because you say, The rivers are mine, and I made them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Therefore, behold, I am against you, and against all your rivers, and I will give up the land of Egypt to desolation, and the sword, and destruction, from Magdol and Syene even to the borders of the Ethiopians. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} No foot of man shall pass through it, and no foot of beast shall pass through it, and it shall not be inhabited for forty years. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And I will cause her land to be utterly destroyed in the midst of a land that is desolate, and her cities shall be [desolate] forty years in the midst of cities that are desolate: and I will disperse Egypt among the nations, and will utterly scatter them into the countries. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Thus says the Lord; After forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations among whom they have been scattered; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} and I will turn the captivity of the Egyptians, and will cause them to dwell in the land of Phathore, in the land whence they were taken; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} and it shall be a base kingdom beyond all [other] kingdoms; it shall not any more be exalted over the nations; and I will make them few in number, that they may not be [great] among the nations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And they shall no more be to the house of Israel a confidence bringing iniquity to remembrance, when they follow after them; and they shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And it came to pass in the twenty-seventh year, on the first [day] of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Son of man, Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon caused his army to serve a great service against Tyre; every head was bald, and every shoulder peeled; yet there was no reward to him or to his army [serving] against Tyre, nor for the service wherewith they served against it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Thus says the Lord God; Behold, I [will] give to Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon the land of Egypt, and he shall take the plunder thereof, and seize the spoils thereof; and [it] shall be a reward for his army. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} In return for his service wherewith he served against Tyre, I have given him the land of Egypt; thus says the Lord God: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} In that day shall a horn spring forth for all the house of Israel, and I will give you an open mouth in the midst of them; and they shall know that I am the Lord.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} set, Pharaoh This was Pharaoh-hophra, or Apries, who, Herodotus informs us, agreeably to the character given him by the prophet, "proudly and wickedly boasted of having established his kingdom so securely, that it was not in the power of any God to dispossess him of it." against all Ezek. 30:1-32:32; Isa. 18:1-19:17 \textsuperscript{3} I am; the great; , ; My river \textsuperscript{4} I will put; the fish \textsuperscript{5} I will leave, ;, open fields Heb. face of the field I have \textsuperscript{10} I will; utterly waste Heb. wastes of waste from the tower of from Migdol to.; Syene Heb. Seveneh, Now Essuan, situated at the southern extremity of Egypt (as Migdol was at the northern), on the confines of Ethiopia, near the tropic of Cancer, and about lat. 24 degrees n long 32 degrees e. \textsuperscript{12} desolate in; and I will scatter We learn from Berosus that Nebuchadnezzar sent several captive Egyptians to Babylon; and from Megasthenes, that he transplanted others to Pontus; and it is probable, that at the dissolution of the Babylonian empire, about forty years after, Cyrus permitted them to return to their native country. \textsuperscript{14} Pathros; Pathrusim; habitation or, birth base Heb. low \textsuperscript{18} Nebuchadrezzar; a great Nebuchadnezzar was thirteen years employed in the siege. During this long siege, the soldiers must have endured great hardships; their heads would become bald by constantly wearing their helmets; and their shoulders be peeled by carrying materials to and from the works. yet St. Jerome asserts, on the authority of the Assyrian histories, that when the Tyrians saw their city must fall, they put their most valuable effects on board their ships, and fled with them to the islands, and their colonies, "so that, the city being taken, Nebuchadnezzar found nothing worthy of his labour." \textsuperscript{19} I will; take her spoil, and take her prey Heb. spoil her spoil, and prey her prey \textsuperscript{21} I cause;, ; the opening, ; they shall know\par}

\subsection*{Ezekiel 30}
\markright{EZEKIEL 30}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus says the Lord; Woe, woe [worth] the day! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For the day of the Lord is near, a day of cloud; it shall be the end of the nations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And the sword shall come upon the Egyptians, and there shall be tumult in Ethiopia, and in Egypt [men] shall fall down slain together, and her foundations shall fall. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Persians, and Cretans, and Lydians, and Libyans, and all the mixed multitude, and they of the children of my covenant, shall fall by the sword therein. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And the supports of Egypt shall fall; and the pride of her strength shall come down from Magdol to Syene: they shall fall by the sword in it, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And it shall be made desolate in the midst of desolate countries, and their cities shall be [desolate] in the midst of desolate cities: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I shall send fire upon Egypt, and [when] all that help her shall be broken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} In that day shall messengers go forth hasting to destroy Ethiopia utterly, and there shall be tumult among them in the day of Egypt: for, behold it comes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Thus says the Lord God; I will also destroy the multitude of the Egyptians by the hand of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} his [hand] and his people's; [they are] plagues sent forth from the nations to destroy the land: and they all shall unsheath their swords against Egypt, and the land shall be filled with slain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And I will make their rivers desolate, and will destroy the land and the fulness of it by the hands of strangers: I the Lord have spoken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} For thus says the Lord God; I will also destroy the nobles from Memphis, and the princes of Memphis out of the land of Egypt; and they shall be no more. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And I will destroy the land of Phathore, and will send fire upon Tanis, and will execute vengeance on Diospolis. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And I will pour out my wrath upon Sais the strength of Egypt, and will destroy the multitude of Memphis. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And I will send fire upon Egypt; and Syene shall be sorely troubled; and there shall be a breaking in Diospolis, and waters shall be poured out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} The youths of Heliopolis and Bubastum shall fall by the sword, and the women shall go into captivity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And the day shall be darkened in Taphnae, when I have broken there the scepters of Egypt: and the pride of her strength shall perish there: and a cloud shall cover her, and her daughters shall be taken prisoners. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And I will execute judgment on Egypt; and they shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh [day] of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Son of man, I have broken the arms of Pharao, king of Egypt; and, behold, it has not been bound up to be healed, to have a plaster put upon it, [or] to be strengthened to lay hold of the sword. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Therefore thus says the Lord God; Behold, I am against Pharao king of Egypt, and I will break his strong and outstretched arms, and will strike down his sword out of his hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations, and will utterly scatter them among the countries. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and put my sword into his hand: and he shall bring it upon Egypt, and shall take her plunder and seize her spoils. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Yes, I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, and the arms of Pharao shall fail: and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I have put my sword into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he shall stretch it out over the land of Egypt. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And I will disperse the Egyptians among the nations, and utterly scatter them among the countries; and they all shall know that I am the Lord.\par

It was the key of Egypt on the side of Judea and Syria, and was therefore strongly fortified and garrisoned; but it is now quite in ruins. \textsuperscript{17} Aven or, Heliopolis, Pibeseth or Pubastum, Situated on the Pelusiac branch of the Nile, near the top of the Delta. \textsuperscript{18} Tehaphnehes, Tahapanes, Tahpanhes the day; darkened or, restrained I shall break;, the pomp; a cloud \textsuperscript{21} Son of man This prophecy was delivered soon after the Egyptians under Pharaoh-hophra had come to relieve Jerusalem, and some months before the city was taken, being the eleventh year of Jeremiah's captivity, and answering to April 26, am 3416. When the king of Babylon took from the king of Egypt, in the days of Pharaoh-necho, all his dominions in Asia, one of his arms was broken. God now declared that he should never recover these territories, or gain any ascendancy in that part of the world; nay, that his other arm, which was now strong, should soon be broken, and rendered utterly useless. This was fulfilled when Hophra was dethroned and driven into Upper Egypt by Amasis; and then Nebuchadnezzar, taking advantage of this civil discord, invaded and conquered that kingdom, and enslaved, dispersed, and carried captive the Egyptians. \subsection*{Ezekiel 31}
\markright{EZEKIEL 31}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it came to pass in the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first [day] of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Son of man, say to Pharao king of Egypt, and to his multitude; To whom have you compared yourself in your haughtiness? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Behold, the Assyrian was a cypress in Libanus, and was fair in shoots, and high in stature: his top reached to the midst of the clouds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} The water nourished him, the depth made him grow tall; she led her rivers round about his plants, and she sent forth her streams to all the trees of the field. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Therefore was his stature exalted above all the trees of the field, and his branches spread far by the help of much water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} All the birds of the sky made their nests in his boughs, and under his branches all the wild beasts of the field bred; the whole multitude of nations lived under his shadow. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And he was fair in his height by reason of the multitude of his branches: for his roots were amidst much water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And such cypresses [as this] were in the paradise of God; and there were no pines like his shoots, and there were no firs like his branches: no tree in the paradise of God was like him in his beauty, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} because of the multitude of his branches: and the trees of God's paradise of delight envied him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Therefore thus says the Lord; Because you are grown great, and have set your top in the midst of the clouds, and I saw when he was exalted; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} therefore I delivered him into the hands of the prince of the nations, and he wrought his destruction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And ravaging strangers from the nations have destroyed him, and have cast him down upon the mountains: his branches fell in all the valleys, and his boughs were broken in every field of the land; and all the people of the nations are gone down from their shelter, and have laid him low. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} All the birds of the sky have settled on his fallen trunk, and all the wild beasts of the field came upon his boughs: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} in order that none of the trees by the water should exalt themselves by reason of their size: whereas they set their top in the midst of the clouds, yet they continued not in their high state in their place, all that drank water, all were consigned to death, to the depth of the earth, in the midst of the children of men, with them that go down to the pit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Thus says the Lord God; In the day wherein he went down to Hades, the deep mourned for him: and I stayed her floods, and restrained her abundance of water: and Libanus saddened for him, all the trees of the field fainted for him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} At the sound of his fall the nations quaked, when I brought him down to Hades with them that go down to the pit: and all the trees of Delight comforted him in the heart, and the choice of [plants] of Libanus, all that drink water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For they went down to hell with him among the slain with the sword; and his seed, [even] they that lived under his shadow, perished in the midst of their life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} To whom are you compared? descend, and be you debased with the trees of paradise to the depth of the earth: you shall lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain by the sword. Thus shall Pharao be, and the multitude of his host, says the Lord God.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} in the eleventh On Sunday, June 19, am 3416, according to Usher; and about a month before the capture of Jerusalem. \textsuperscript{3} the Assyrian; a cedar; with fair branches Heb. fair of branches of an high \textsuperscript{4} waters; made him great or, nourished him set or, brought, little rivers. or, conduits. \textsuperscript{5} his height The Assyrian king, to whom Pharaoh is compared, from his great power, extensive dominion, and the protection he afforded, resembled the spreading branches, thick shade, and high stature of a flourishing cedar on mount Lebanon. The fruitful lands of Assyria; the immense revenues he drew from vast multitudes in his extensive territories; his lucrative commerce, by the river Tigris, with the countries on the Indian ocean; and all the various sources of his wealth and prosperity, resembled the rivers and streams which cause the trees planted by them to grow and flourish exceedingly; and hence the empire and its head were exalted above all the kingdoms of the earth.;, ; he shot forth or, it sent them forth \textsuperscript{9} made; , all the trees; envied \textsuperscript{10} Therefore The allegory and its interpretation are here combined; and the Assyrian monarch, though already destroyed, is poetically addressed. Because and his \textsuperscript{11} delivered, ; the mighty Nebuchadnezzar, the subverter of the Assyrian empire.; he shall surely deal with him Heb. in doing he shall do unto him; I have driven \textsuperscript{14} the end; stand up in their height or, stand upon themselves for their height delivered; the nether \textsuperscript{15} I caused a The deep and all the mighty rivers which cherished this fair tree are here described as mourning at his downfall. They stop their usual courses to bewail his fate, and Lebanon with all its stately trees (his confederates and allies), sympathise with him in his misfortunes.; mourn Heb. be black \textsuperscript{16} made, ; When I; and all; shall be comforted \textsuperscript{18} To whom Pharaoh is here called upon to look in his mirror, and see the termination of his glory and greatness. art thou, with the, thou shalt, ; This is That is, the judgment that befell the king of Assyria, is an exact representation of the destruction that remains for Pharaoh and all his people.\par}
