\subsection*{Ezekiel 32}
\markright{EZEKIEL 32}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the tenth month, on the first [day] of the month, [that] the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharao king of Egypt, and say to him, You are become like a lion of the nations, and as a serpent that is in the sea: and you did make assaults with your rivers, and did disturb the water with your feet, and did trample your rivers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Thus says the Lord; I will also cast over you the nets of many nations, and will bring you up with my hook: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} and I will stretch you upon the earth: the fields shall be covered [with you], and I will cause all the birds of the sky to settle upon you, and I will fill [with you] all the wild beasts of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And I will cast your flesh upon the mountains, and will saturate [them] with your blood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And the land shall be drenched with your dung, because of your multitude upon the mountains: I will fill the valleys with you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I will veil the heavens when you are extinguished, and will darken the stars thereof; I will cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon shall not give her light. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} All the [bodies] that give light in the sky, shall be darkened over you, and I will bring darkness upon the earth, says the Lord God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And I will provoke to anger the heart of many people, when I shall lead you captive among the nations, to a land which you have not known. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And many nations shall mourn over you, and their kings shall be utterly amazed, when my sword flies in their faces, as they wait for their [own] fall from the day of your fall. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For thus says the Lord God; The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon you, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} with the swords of mighty men; and I will cast down your strength: [they are] all destroying ones from the nations, and they shall destroy the pride of Egypt, and all her strength shall be crushed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And I will destroy all her cattle from [beside] the great water; and the foot of man shall not trouble it any more, and the step of cattle shall no more trample it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Thus shall their waters then be at rest, and their rivers shall flow like oil, says the Lord, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} when I shall give up Egypt to destruction, and the land shall be made desolate with the fullness thereof; when I shall scatter all that dwell in it, and they shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} There is a lamentation, and you shall utter it; and the daughters of the nations shall utter it, [even] for Egypt, and they shall mourn for it over all the strength thereof, says the Lord God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And it came to pass in the twelfth year, in the first month, on the fifteenth [day] of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Son of man, lament over the strength of Egypt, for the nations shall bring down her daughters dead to the depth of the earth, to them that go down to the pit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} They shall fall with him in the midst of them [that are] slain with the sword, and all his strength shall perish: the giants also shall say to you, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Be you in the depth of the pit: to whom are you superior? yes, go down, and lie with the uncircumcised, in the midst of them [that are] slain with the sword. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} There are Assur and all his company: all [his] slain have been laid there: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} and their burial is in the depth of the pit, and his company are set around about his tomb: all the slain that fell by the sword, who had caused the fear of them [to be] upon the land of the living. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} There is Aelam and all his host round about his tomb: all the slain that fell by the sword, and the uncircumcised that go down to the deep of the earth, who caused their fear to be upon the land of the living: and they have received their punishment with them that go down to the pit, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} in the midst of the slain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} There were laid Mosoch, and Thobel, and all his strength round about his tomb: all his slain men, all the uncircumcised, slain with the sword, who caused their fear to be in the land of the living. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And they are laid with the giants that fell of old, who went down to Hades with [their] weapons of war: and they laid their swords under their heads, but their iniquities were upon their bones, because they terrified all men during their life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And you shall lie in the midst of the uncircumcised, with them that have been slain by the sword. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} There are laid the princes of Assur, who yielded their strength to a wound of the sword: these are laid with the slain, with them that go down to the pit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} There are the princes of the north, [even] all the captains of Assur, who go down slain [to Hades]: they lie uncircumcised among the slain with the sword together with their terror and their strength, and they have received their punishment with them that go down to the pit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} King Pharao shall see them, and shall be comforted over all their force, says the Lord God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} For I have caused his fear to be upon the land of the living yet he shall lie in the midst of the uncircumcised with them that are slain with the sword, [even] Pharao, and all his multitude with him, says the Lord God.\par

\subsection*{Ezekiel 33}
\markright{EZEKIEL 33}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Son of man, speak to the children of your people, and you shall say to them, On whatever land I shall bring a sword, and the people of the land take one man of them, and set him for their watchman: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and he shall see the sword coming upon the land, and blow the trumpet, and sound an alarm to the people; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} and he that hears the sound of the trumpet shall hear [indeed], and [yet] not take heed, and the sword shall come upon him, and overtake him, his blood shall be upon his [own] head. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Because he heard the sound of the trumpet, and took no heed, his blood shall be upon him: but the other, because he took heed, has delivered his soul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} But if the watchman see the sword coming, and do not sound the trumpet, and the people do not watch; and the sword come, and take a soul from among them, that [soul] is taken because of its iniquity; but the blood [thereof] will I require at the watchman's hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And you, son of man, I have set you [as] a watchman to the house of Israel, and you shall hear a word from my mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} When I say to the sinner, You shall surely die; [if] you speak not to warn the wicked from his way, the wicked himself shall die in his iniquity; but his blood will I require at your hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} But if you forewarn the wicked of his way to turn from it, and he turn not from his way, he shall die in his ungodliness; but you have delivered your own soul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And you, son of man, say to the house of Israel; Thus have you⌃ spoken, saying, Our errors, and our iniquities weigh upon us, and we pine away in them, and how then shall we live? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Say to them, Thus says the Lord; [As] I live, I desire not the death of the ungodly, as that the ungodly should turn from his way and live: turn you⌃ heartily from your way; for why will you⌃ die, O house of Israel? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Say to the children of your people, The righteousness of the righteous shall not deliver him, in the day wherein he errs: and the iniquity of the ungodly shall not harm him, in the day wherein he turns from his iniquity, but the righteous [erring] shall not be able to deliver himself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} When I say to the righteous, [You shall live; and] he trusts in his righteousness, and shall commit iniquity, none of his righteousnesses shall be remembered; in his unrighteousness which he has wrought, in it shall he die. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And when I say to the ungodly, You shall surely die; and he shall turn from his sin, and do judgment and justice, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} and return the pledge, and repay that which he has robbed, [and] walk in the ordinances of life, so as to do no wrong; he shall surely live, and shall not die. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} None of his sins which he has committed shall be remembered: because he has wrought judgment and righteousness; by them shall he live. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Yet the children of your people will say, The way of the Lord is not straight: whereas this their way is not straight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} When the righteous turns away from his righteousness, and shall commit iniquities, then shall he die in them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And when the sinner turns from his iniquity, and shall do judgment and righteousness, he shall live by them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And this is that which you⌃ said, The way of the Lord is [not] straight. I will judge you, O house of Israel, every one for his ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And it came to pass in the tenth year of our captivity, in the twelfth month, on the fifth [day] of the month, [that] one that had escaped from Jerusalem came to me, saying, The city is taken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Now the hand of the Lord had come upon me in the evening, before he came; and he opened my mouth, when he came to me in the morning: and my mouth was open, it was no longer kept closed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Son of man, they that inhabit the desolate [places] on the land of Israel say, Abram was one, and he possessed the land: and we are more numerous; to us the land is given for a possession. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Therefore say to them, Thus says the Lord God, [As] I live, surely they that are in the desolate places shall fall by swords and they that are in the open plain shall be given for food to the wild beasts of the field, and them that are in the fortified [cities] and them that are in the caves I will kill with pestilence. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And I will make the land desert, and the pride of her strength shall perish; and the mountains of Israel shall be made desolate by reason of no man passing through. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And they shall know that I am the Lord; and I will make their land desert, and it shall be made desolate because of all their abominations which they have wrought. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And [as for] you, son of man, the children of your people are they that speak concerning you by the walls, and in the porches of the houses, and they talk one to another, saying, Let us come together, and let us hear the [words] that proceed from the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} They approach you as a people comes together, and sit before you, and hear your words, but they will not do them: for [there is] falsehood in their mouth, and their heart [goes] after their pollutions. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And you are to them as a sound of a sweet, well-tuned lute, and they will hear your words, but they will not do them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} But whenever it shall come [to pass], they will say, Behold, it is come: and they shall know that there was a prophet in the midst of them.\par

\subsection*{Ezekiel 34}
\markright{EZEKIEL 34}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel, prophesy, and say to the shepherds, Thus says the Lord God; O shepherds of Israel, do shepherds feed themselves? do not the shepherds feed the sheep? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Behold, you⌃ feed on the milk, and clothe yourselves with the wool, and kill the fat: but you⌃ feed not my sheep. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} The weak one you⌃ have not strengthened, and the sick you⌃ have not cherished, and the bruised you⌃ have not bound up, and the stray one you⌃ have not turned back, and the lost you⌃ have not sought; and the strong you⌃ have wearied with labor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And my sheep were scattered, because there were no shepherds: and they became meat to all the wild beasts of the field. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And my sheep were scattered on every mountain, and on every high hill: yes, they were scattered on the face of the earth, and there was none to seek them out, nor to bring them back. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Therefore, you⌃ shepherds, hear the word of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} [As] I live, says the Lord God, surely because my sheep became a prey, and my sheep became meat to all the wild beasts of the field, because there were no shepherds, and the shepherds sought not out my sheep, and the shepherds fed themselves, but fed not my sheep. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For this cause, O shepherds, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} thus says the Lord God, Behold, I am against the shepherds; and I will require my sheep at their hands, and will turn them back that they shall not feed my sheep, and the shepherds shall no longer feed them; and I will deliver my sheep out of their mouth, and they shall no longer be meat for them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For thus says the Lord God, Behold, I will seek out my sheep, and will visit them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} As the shepherd seeks his flock, in the day when there is darkness and cloud, in the midst of the sheep that are separated: so will I seek out my sheep, and will bring them back from every place where they were scattered in the day of cloud and darkness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And I will bring them out from the Gentiles, and will gather them from the countries, and will bring them into their own land, and will feed them upon the mountains of Israel, and in the valleys, and in every inhabited place of the land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} I will feed them in a good pasture, on a high mountain of Israel: and their folds shall be there, and they shall lie down, and there shall they rest in perfect prosperity, and they shall feed in a fat pasture on the mountains of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} I will feed my sheep, and I will cause them to rest; and they shall know that I am the Lord: thus says the Lord God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} I will seek that which is lost, and I will recover the stray one, and will bind up that which was broken, and will strengthen the fainting, and will guard the strong, and will feed them with judgment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And [as for] you, you⌃ sheep, thus says the Lord God, Behold, I will distinguish between sheep and sheep, [between] rams and he-goats. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And [is it] not enough for you that you⌃ fed on the good pasture, that you⌃ trampled with your feet the remnant of your pasture? and [that] you⌃ drank the standing water, [that] you⌃ disturbed the residue with your feet? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} So my sheep fed on that which you⌃ had trampled with your feet; and they drank the water that had been disturbed by your feet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Therefore thus says the Lord God; Behold, I will separate between the strong sheep and the weak sheep. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} You⌃ did thrust with your sides and shoulders, and pushed with your horns, and you⌃ cruelly treated all the sick. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Therefore I will save my sheep, and they shall not be any more for a prey; and will judge between ram and ram. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And I will raise up one shepherd over them, and he shall tend them, [even] my servant David, and he shall be their shepherd; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} and I the Lord will be to them a God, and David a prince in the midst of them; I the Lord have spoken it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And I will make with David a covenant of peace and I will utterly destroy evil beasts from off the land; and they shall dwell in the wilderness, and sleep in the forests. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And I will settle them round about my mountain; and I will give you the rain, the rain of blessing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And the trees that are in the field shall yield their fruit, and the earth shall yield her strength, and they shall dwell in the confidence of peace on their land, and they shall know that I am the Lord, when I have broken their yoke; and I will deliver them out of the hand of those that enslaved them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And they shall no more be a spoil to the nations, and the wild beasts of the land shall no more at all devour them; and they shall dwell safely, and there shall be none to make them afraid. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And I will raise up for them a plant of peace, and they shall no more perish with hunger upon the land, and they shall no more bear the reproach of the nations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, and they my people. O house of Israel, says the Lord God, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} you⌃ are my sheep, even the sheep of my flock, and I am the Lord your God, says the Lord God.\par

\subsection*{Ezekiel 35}
\markright{EZEKIEL 35}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Son of man, set your face against mount Seir, and prophesy against it, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and say to it, Thus says the Lord God; Behold, I am against you, O mount Seir, and I will stretch out my hand against you, and will make you a waste, and you shall be made desolate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And I will cause desolation in your cities, and you shall be desolate, and you shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Because you have been a perpetual enemy, and have laid wait craftily for the house of Israel, with the hand of enemies with a sword, in the time of injustice, at the last: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Therefore, as I live, says the Lord God, verily you have sinned even to blood, therefore blood shall pursue you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I will make mount Seir a waste, and desolate, and I will destroy from off it men and cattle: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} and I will fill your hills and your valleys with slain men, and in all your plains there shall fall in you men slain with the sword. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} I will make you a perpetual desolation, and your cities shall not be inhabited any more: and you shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Because you said, The two nations and the two countries shall be mine, and I shall inherit them; whereas the Lord is there: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} therefore, [as] I live, says the Lord, I will even deal with you according to your enmity, and I will be made known to you when I shall judge you: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} and you shall know that I am the Lord. I have heard the voice of your blasphemies, whereas you have said, The desert mountains of Israel are given to us for food; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} and you have spoken swelling words against me with your mouth: I have heard [them]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Thus says the Lord; When all the earth is rejoicing, I will make you desert. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} You shall be desert, O mount Seir, and all Idumea; and it shall be utterly consumed: and you shall know that I am the Lord their God.\par

\subsection*{Ezekiel 36}
\markright{EZEKIEL 36}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say to the mountains of Israel, Hear you⌃ the word of the Lord: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Thus says the Lord God; Because the enemy has said against you, Aha, the old waste places are become a possession for us: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} therefore prophesy, and say, Thus says the Lord God; Because you⌃ have been dishonored, and hated by those round about you, that you⌃ might be a possession to the remainder of the nations, and you⌃ became a byword, and a reproach to the nations: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} therefore, you⌃ mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord; Thus says the Lord to the mountains, and to the hills, and to the streams, and to the valleys, and to [the places] that have been made desolate and destroyed, and to the cities that have been deserted, and have become a spoil and a trampling to the nations that were left round about; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} therefore, thus says the Lord; Verily in the fire of my wrath have I spoken against the rest of the nations, and against all Idumea, because they have appropriated my land to themselves for a possession with joy, disregarding the lives [of the inhabitants], to destroy [it] by plunder: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and say to the mountains, and to the hills, and to the valleys, and to the forests, Thus says the Lord; Behold, I have spoken in my jealousy and in my wrath, because you⌃ have borne the reproaches of the heathen: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} therefore I will lift up my hand against the nations that are round about you; they shall bear their reproach. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} But your grapes and your fruits, O mountains of Israel, shall my people eat; for they are hoping to come. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For, behold, I am toward you, and I will have respect to you, and you⌃ shall be tilled and sown: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} and I will multiply men upon you, [even] all the house of Israel to the end: and the cities shall be inhabited, and the desolate land shall be built upon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And I will multiply men and cattle upon you; and I will cause you to dwell as at the beginning, and will treat you well, as in your former [times]: and you⌃ shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And I will increase men upon you, [even] my people Israel; and they shall inherit you, and you⌃ shall be to them for a possession; and you⌃ shall no more be bereaved of them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Thus says the Lord God: Because they said to you, You [land] devour men, and have been bereaved of your nation; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} therefore you shall no more devour men, and you shall no more bereave your nation, says the Lord God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And there shall no more be heard against you the reproach of the nations, and you⌃ shall no more bear the revilings of the peoples, says the Lord God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Son of man, the house of Israel lived upon their land, and defiled it by their way, and with their idols, and with their uncleannesses; and their way was before me like the uncleanness of a removed woman. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} So I poured out my wrath upon them: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} and I dispersed them among the nations, and utterly scattered them through the countries: I judged them according to their way and according to their sin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And they went in among the nations, among which they went, and they profaned my holy name, while it was said of them, These are the people of the Lord, and they came forth out of his land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} But I spared them for the sake of my holy name, which the house of Israel profaned among the nations, among whom they went. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Therefore say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord; I do not this, O house of Israel, for your sakes, but because of my holy name, which you⌃ have profaned among the nations, among whom you⌃ went. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And I will sanctify my great name, which was profaned among the nations, which you⌃ profaned in the midst of them; and the nations shall know that I am the Lord, when I am sanctified among you before their eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And I will take you out from the nations, and will gather you out of all the lands, and will bring you into your own land: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} and I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and you⌃ shall be purged from all your uncleannesses, and from all your idols, and I will cleanse you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And I will give you a new heart, and will put a new spirit in you: and I will take away the heart of stone out of your flesh, and will give you a heart of flesh. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And I will put my Spirit in you, and will cause you to walk in my ordinances, and to keep my judgments, and do [them]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And you⌃ shall dwell upon the land which I gave to your fathers; and you⌃ shall be to me a people, and I will be to you a God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And I will save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and multiply it, and will not bring famine upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And I will multiply the fruit of the trees, and the produce of the field, that you⌃ may not bear the reproach of famine among the nations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And you⌃ shall remember your evil ways and your practices that were not good, and you⌃ shall be hateful in your own sight for your transgressions and for your abominations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Not for your sakes do I [this], says the Lord God, [as] it is known to you: be you⌃ ashamed and confounded for your ways, O house of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Thus says the Lord God; In the day wherein I shall cleanse you from all your iniquities I will also cause the cities to be inhabited, and the waste [places] shall be built upon: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} and the desolate land shall be cultivated, whereas it was desolate in the eyes of every one that passed by. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And they shall say, That desolate land is become like a garden of delight; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities are inhabited. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And the nations, as many as shall have been left round about you, shall know that I the Lord have built the ruined [cities] and planted the waste [lands]: I the Lord have spoken, and will do [it]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Thus says the Lord God; Yet [for] this will I be sought by the house of Israel, to establish them; I will multiply them [even] men as sheep; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} as holy sheep, as the sheep of Jerusalem in her feasts; thus shall the desert cities be full of flocks of men: and they shall know that I [am] the Lord.\par

\subsection*{Ezekiel 37}
\markright{EZEKIEL 37}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the hand of the Lord came upon me, and the Lord brought me forth by the Spirit, and set me in the midst of the plain, and it was full of human bones. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And he led me round about them every way: and, behold, [there were] very many on the face of the plain, very dry. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And he said to me, Son of man, will these bones live? and I said, O Lord God, you know this. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And he said to me, Prophesy upon these bones, and you shall say to them, You⌃ dry bones, hear the word of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Thus says the Lord to these bones; Behold, I [will] bring upon you the breath of life: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} and I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and will spread skin upon you, and will put my Spirit into you, and you⌃ shall live; and you⌃ shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} So I prophesied as [the Lord] commanded me: and it came to pass while I was prophesying, that, behold, [there was] a shaking, and the bones approached each one to his joint. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And I looked, and behold, sinews and flesh grew upon them, and skin came upon them above: but there was not breath in them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And he said to me, Prophesy to the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus says the Lord; Come from the four winds, and breathe upon these dead [men], and let them live. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath entered into them, and they lived, and stood upon their feet, a very great congregation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And the Lord spoke to me, saying, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: and they say, Our bones are become dry, our hope has perished, we are quite spent. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Therefore prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord; Behold, I [will] open your tombs, and will bring you up out of your tombs, and will bring you into the land of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And you⌃ shall know that I am the Lord, when I have opened your graves, that I may bring up my people from [their] graves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And I will put my Spirit within you, and you⌃ shall live, and I will place you upon your own land: and you⌃ shall know that I [am] the Lord; I have spoken, and will do [it], says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Son of man, take for yourself a rod, and write upon it, Juda, and the children of Israel his adherents; and you shall take for yourself another rod, and you shall inscribe it for Joseph, the rod of Ephraim, and all the children of Israel that belong to him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And you shall joint them together for yourself, so as that they should bind themselves into one stick; and they shall be in your hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And it shall come to pass, when the children of your people shall say to you, Will you not tell us what you meanest by these things? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Then shall you say to them, Thus says the Lord; behold, I will take the tribe of Joseph, which is in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel that belong to him, and I will add them to the tribe of Juda, and they shall become one rod in the hand of Juda. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And the rods on which you did write shall be in your hand in their presence. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And you shall say to them, Thus says the Lord God; Behold, I [will] take the whole house of Israel out of the midst of the nations, among whom they have gone, and I will gather them from all that are round about them, and I will bring them into the land of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And I will make them a nation in my land, even on the mountains of Israel; and they shall have one prince: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided any more at all into two kingdoms: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} that they may no more defile themselves with their idols; and I will deliver them from all their transgressions whereby they have sinned, and will cleanse them; and they shall be to me a people, and I the Lord will be to them a God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And my servant David [shall be] a prince in the midst of them: there shall be one shepherd of [them] all; for they shall walk in my ordinances, and keep my judgments, and do them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And they shall dwell in their land, which I have given to my servant Jacob, where their fathers lived; and they shall dwell upon it: and David my servant [shall be their] prince forever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And I will make with them a covenant of peace; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them; and I will establish my sanctuary in the midst of them for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And my tabernacle shall be among them; and I will be to them a God, and they shall be my people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And the nations shall know that I am the Lord that sanctifies them, when my sanctuary is in the midst of them for ever.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} hand In this vision, the dry bones aptly represent the ruined and desperate state of both Israel and Judah; and the revivification of these bones signifies their restoration to their own land after their captivity, and also their recovery from their present long dispersion. Although this is the primary and genuine scope of the vision, yet the doctrine of a general resurrection of the dead may justly be inferred from it; for "a simile of the resurrection, " says Jerome, after Tertullian and others, "would never have been used to signify the restoration of the people of Israel, unless such a future resurrection had been believed and known; because no one attempts to confirm uncertain things by things which have no existence.", ; carried \textsuperscript{2} valley or, champaign, they were \textsuperscript{12} Therefore I will open This is a pointed allusion to the resurrection; under which figure Isaiah ( ) also describes the restoration of the house of Israel, when he says, "thy dead men shall live; " at which time their bones are said to flourish ( ), or to be restored to their former strength and vigour; and, in like manner, St. Paul ( ), expresses their conversion by "life from the dead." In the land of their captivity, they seemed as absolutely deprived of their country as persons committed to the grave are cut off from the land of the living; but when Cyrus issued his proclamation, Jehovah, as it were, opened their graves, and when he stirred up their spirits to embrace the proffered liberty, he put his Spirit within them, that they might live; and their re-establishment in their own land evinced the truth of God in the prediction, and his power in its accomplishment.; and bring, ; Ezra 1:1-2:70 \textsuperscript{14} shall put, ; I the Lord \textsuperscript{16} take thee For Judah, For Joseph \textsuperscript{22} I will make; and one It is evident that the grand union of Israel and Judah here predicted, and their government under one king, and that king to be David, must still be future; for, politically speaking, they never had a king from that day to this, far less a king or prince of that name. \subsection*{Ezekiel 38}
\markright{EZEKIEL 38}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Son of man, set your face against Gog, and the land of Magog, Rhos, prince of Mesoch and Thobel, and prophesy against him, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and say to him, Thus says the Lord God; Behold, I am against you, Rhos prince of Mesoch and Thobel: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} and I will gather you, and all your host, horses and horsemen, all wearing breastplates, with a great multitude, shields and helmets and swords: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Persians, and Ethiopians, and Libyans; all with helmets and shields. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Gomer, and all belonging to him; the house of Thorgama, from the end of the north, and all belonging to him; and many nations with you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Be you prepared, prepare yourself, you, and all your multitude that is assembled with you, and you shall be to me for a guard. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} He shall be prepared after many days, and he shall come at the end of years, and shall come to a land that is brought back from the sword, when [the people] are gathered from many nations against the land of Israel, which was entirely desolate: and he is come forth out of the nations, and they shall all dwell securely. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And you shall go up as rain, and shall arrive as a cloud to cover the land, and there shall be you, and all that are about you, and many nations with you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Thus says the Lord God; It shall also come to pass in that day, that thoughts shall come up into your heart, and you shall devise evil devices. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And you shall say, I will go up to the rejected land; I will come upon them that are at ease in tranquility, and dwelling in peace, all inhabiting a land in which there is no wall, nor bars, nor have they doors; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} to seize plunder, and to take their spoil; to turn my hands against the desolate land that is [now] inhabited, and against a nation that is gathered from many nations, that have acquired property, dwelling in the midst of the land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Sabba, and Daedan, and Carthaginian merchants, and all their villages shall say to you, You are come for plunder to take a prey, and to get spoils: you have gathered your multitude to take silver and gold, to carry off property, to take spoils. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Therefore prophesy, son of man, and say to Gog, Thus says the Lord; Will you not arise in that day, when my people Israel are dwelling securely, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} and come out of your place from the farthest north, and many nations with you? all of them mounted on horses, a great gathering, and a large force? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And you shall come up upon my people Israel as a cloud to cover the land; it shall come to pass in the last days, that I will bring you up upon my land, that all the nations may know me, when I am sanctified in you before them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Thus says the Lord God, to Gog; You are [he] concerning whom I spoke in former times, by the hand of my servants the prophets of Israel, in those days and years, that I would bring you up against them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And it shall come to pass in that day, in the day when Gog shall come against the land of Israel, says the Lord God, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} [that] my wrath and my jealousy shall arise, I have spoken in the fire of my anger, verily in that day there shall be a great shaking in the land of Israel; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} and the fish of the sea shall quake at the presence of the Lord, and the birds of the sky and the wild beasts of the field, and all the reptiles that creep upon the earth, and all the men that are on the face of the earth; and the mountains shall be torn, and the valleys shall fall, and every wall on the land shall fall. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And I will summon against it even every fear, says the Lord: the sword of [every] man shall be against his brother. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And I will judge him with pestilence, and blood, and sweeping rain, and hailstones; and I will rain upon him fire and brimstone, and upon all that are with him, and upon many nations with him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And I will be magnified, and sanctified, and glorified; and I will be known in the presence of many nations, and they shall know that I am the Lord.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} Son, set, Gog Rather, "Gog (the prince) of the land of Magog, the prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal." By Magog is most probably meant the Scythians or Tartars, called so by Arabian and Syrian writers, and especially the Turks, who were originally natives of Tartary; and by Rosh, the Russians, descendants of the ancient inhabitants on the river Araxes or Rosh. Magog; the chief prince of or, prince of the chief of Meshech \textsuperscript{4} I will turn; horses; all of them handling \textsuperscript{5} Persia Libya or, Phut; Put \textsuperscript{8} many days; thou shalt be; into the land, ; the mountains, it is and they shall \textsuperscript{9} shalt ascend; like; all thy \textsuperscript{10} that at; think an evil thought or, conceive a mischievous purpose \textsuperscript{11} go up; go to; safely or, confidently \textsuperscript{12} take a spoil, and to take a prey Heb. spoil the spoil, and to prey the prey, *marg.; turn; the desolate; and upon; midst Heb. navel, *marg. \textsuperscript{16} as a cloud it shall be Though it is not generally agreed what people or transactions are here predicted, yet it seems evident that the prophecy is not yet accomplished. Nothing occurred in the wars of Cambyses, or Antiochus Epiphanes with the Jews, that answers to it; and the expression here used, in the latter days, plainly implies that there should be a succession of many ages between the publication of the prediction and its accomplishment. It is therefore supposed, with much probability, that its fulfilment will be posterior to the conversion of the Jews and their restoration to their own land; and that the Turks, Tarters, or Scythians, from the northern parts of Asia, perhaps uniting with the inhabitants of some more southern regions, will make war upon the Jews and be cut off in a manner predicted here.; that the \textsuperscript{17} whom;, ; by Heb. the hands of \textsuperscript{20} the fishes; steep places or, towers, or stairs \textsuperscript{22} I will plead; with pestilence an overflowing\par}

\subsection*{Ezekiel 39}
\markright{EZEKIEL 39}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And you, son of man, prophesy against Gog, and say, Thus says the Lord; Behold, I am against you, O Gog, Rhos prince of Mesoch and Thobel: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} and I will assemble you, and guide you, and raise you up on the extremity of the north, and I will bring you up upon the mountains of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I will destroy the bow out of your left hand, and your arrows out of your right hand, and I will cast you down on the mountains of Israel; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} and you and all that belong to you shall fall, and the nations that are with you shall be given to multitudes of birds, [even] to every fowl, and I have given you to all the wild beasts of the field to be devoured. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} You shall fall on the face of the field: for I have spoken [it], says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And I will send a fire upon Gog, and the islands shall be securely inhabited: and they shall know that I am the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And my holy name shall be known in the midst of my people Israel; and my holy name shall no more be profaned: and the nations shall know that I am the Lord, the Holy [One] in Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Behold it is come, and you shall know that it shall be, says the Lord God; this is the day concerning which I have spoken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And they that inhabit the cities of Israel shall come forth, and make a fire with the arms, the shields and the spears, and bows and arrows, and hand-staves, and lances, and they shall keep fire burning with them for seven years: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} and they shall not take any wood out of the field, neither shall they cut any out of the forests, but they shall burn the weapons with fire: and they shall plunder those that plundered them, and spoil those that spoiled them, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And it shall come to pass [that] in that day I will give to Gog a place of renown, a tomb in Israel, the burial-place of them that approach the sea: and they shall build round about the outlet of the valley, and there they shall bury Gog and all his multitude: and [the place] shall then be called the burial-place of Gog. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And the house of Israel shall bury them, that the land may be cleansed in the space of seven months. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Yes, all the people of the land shall bury them; and it shall be to them a [place] of renown in the day wherein it was glorified, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And they shall appoint men continually to go over the land, to bury them that have been left on the face of the earth, to cleanse it after the space of seven months, and they shall seek [them] out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And every one that goes through the land, and sees a man's bone, shall set up a mark by it, until the buriers shall have buried it in the valley, the burial place of Gog. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} For the name of the city [shall be] Burial-place: so shall the land be cleansed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And you, son of man, say, Thus says the Lord; Say to every winged bird, and to all the wild beasts of the field, Gather yourselves, and come; gather yourselves from all [places] round about to my sacrifice, which I have made for you, [even] a great sacrifice on the mountains of Israel, and you⌃ shall eat flesh, and drink blood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} You⌃ shall eat the flesh of mighty men, and you⌃ shall drink the blood of princes of the earth, rams, and calves and goats, and they are all fatted calves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And you⌃ shall eat fat till you⌃ are full, and shall drink wine till you⌃ are drunken, of my sacrifice which I have prepared for you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And you⌃ shall be filled at my table, [eating] horse, and rider, and mighty man, and every warrior, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And I will set my glory among you, and all the nations shall see my judgment which I have wrought, and my hand which I have brought upon them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And the house of Israel shall know that I am the Lord their God, from this day and onwards. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And all the nations shall know that the house of Israel were led captive because of their sins, because they rebelled against me, and I turned away my face from them, and delivered them into the hands of their enemies, and they all fell by the sword. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} According to their uncleannesses and according to their transgressions did I deal with them, and I turned away my face from them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Therefore thus says the Lord God, Now will I turn back captivity in Jacob, and will have mercy on the house of Israel, and will be jealous for the sake of my holy name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And they shall bear their reproach, and the iniquity which they committed when they lived upon their land in peace. Yet there shall be none to terrify [them] {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} when I have brought them back from the nations, and gathered them out of the countries of the nations: and I will be sanctified among them in the presence of the nations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And they shall know that I am the Lord their God, when I have been manifested to them among the nations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And I will no more turn away my face from them, because I have poured out my wrath upon the house of Israel, says the Lord God.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} son Behold; the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal Or, "prince of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal." \textsuperscript{2} I will It is probable that none of the invaders will escape, but perhaps the inhabitants of Magog in general are meant. \subsection*{Ezekiel 40}
\markright{EZEKIEL 40}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it came to pass in the twenty-fifth year of our captivity, in the first month, on the tenth [day] of the month, in the fourteenth year after the taking of the city, in that day the hand of the Lord was upon me, and brought me {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} in a vision of God into the land of Israel, and set me on a very high mountain, and upon it [there was] as it were the frame of a city before [me]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And he brought me in there, and, behold, [there was] a man, and the appearance of him was as the appearance of shining brass, and in his hand was a builder's line, and a measuring reed; and he stood at the gate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And the man said to me, Look with your eyes at him whom you have seen, son of man, and hear with your ears, and lay up in your heart all things that I show you; for you have come in hither that [I] might show you, and you shall show all things that you see to the house of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And behold a wall round about the house without, and in the man's hand a reed, the measure [of it was] six cubits by the cubit, and a span: and he measured across the front wall; the breadth was equal to the reed, and the length of it equal to the reed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And he entered by seven steps into the gate that looks eastward, and he measured across the porch of the gate equal to the reed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the chamber was equal in length to the reed, and equal in breadth to the reed; and the porch between the chambers six cubits; and the second chamber equal in breadth to the reed, and equal in length to the reed, and the porch five cubits. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And the third chamber equal in length to the reed, and equal in breadth to the reed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And the porch of the gateway (near the porch of the gate) eight cubits; and the posts there of two cubits; and the porch of the gate was inward: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} and the chambers of the gate of the chamber in front [were] three on one side and three on the other, and [there was] one measure to the three: [there was] one measure to the porches on this side and on that. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And he measured the breadth of the door of the gateway, ten cubits; and the breadth of the gateway thirteen cubits. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And the space before the chambers was narrowed to a cubit in front of the chambers on this side and on that side: and the chamber was six cubits this way, and six cubits that way. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And he measured the gate from the wall of one chamber to the wall of the other chamber: the breadth was twenty-five cubits, the one gate over against the other gate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And the open space of the porch of the gate without, was twenty cubits to the chambers round about the gate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And the open space of the gate without to the open space of the porch of the gate within was fifty cubits. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And [there were] secret windows to the chambers, and to the porches within the gate of the court round about, and in the same manner windows to the porches round about within: and on the porch [there were] palm-trees on this side and on that side. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And he brought me into the inner court, and, behold, [there were] chambers, and peristyles round about the court; thirty chambers within the ranges of columns. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And the porticos were behind the gates; according to the length of the gates, was the lower peristyle. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And he measured the breadth of the court, from the open space of the outer gate inwards to the open space of the gate looking outwards: one hundred cubits [was the distance to the place] of the gate looking eastward: and he brought me to the north; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} and behold a gate looking northwards [belonging to] the outer court, and he measured it, both the length of it and the breadth; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} and the chambers, three on this side and three on that; and the posts, and the porches, and the palm-trees thereof: and they were according to the measures of the gate that looks eastward: the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof was twenty-five cubits. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And its windows, and its porches, and its palm-trees, were according to [the dimensions of] the gate looking eastward; and they went up to it by seven steps; and the porches were within. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And [there was] a gate to the inner court looking toward the north gate, after the manner of the gate looking toward the east; and he measured the court from gate to gate, one hundred cubits. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And he brought me to the south side, and behold a gate looking southwards: and he measured it, and its chambers, and its posts, and its porches, according to these dimensions. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And its windows and its porches round about were according to the windows of the porch: the length thereof was fifty cubits, and the breadth thereof was five and twenty cubits. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And it had seven steps, and porches within: and it [had] palm-trees on the posts, one on one side, and one on the other side. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And [there was] a gate opposite the gate of the inner court southward: and he measured the court from gate to gate, one hundred cubits in breadth southward. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And he brought me into the inner court of the south gate: and he measured the gate according to these measures; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} and the chambers, and the posts, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} and the porches, according to these measures: and [there were] windows to it and to the porches round about: its length was fifty cubits, and [its] breadth twenty-five cubits, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} from the porch to the outer court: and [there were] palm-trees to the post [thereof], and eight steps. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And he brought me in at the gate that looks eastward: and he measured it according to these measures: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} and the chambers, and the posts, and the porches according to these measures: and [there were] windows to it, and porches round about: the length of it was fifty cubits, and the breadth of it twenty-five cubits. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And [there were] porches [opening] into the inner court, and palm-trees on the posts on this side and on that side: and it [had] eight steps. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And he brought me in at the northern gate, and measured [it] according to these measures; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} and the chambers, and the posts, and the porches: and it [had] windows round about, and [it had] its porches: the length of it was fifty cubits, and the breadth twenty-five cubits. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And its porches were toward the inner court; and [there were] palm-trees to the posts on this side and on that side: and it [had] eight steps. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Its chambers and its door-ways, and its porches at the second gate [served as] a drain, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} that they might kill in it the sin-offerings, and the trespass-offerings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And behind the drain for the whole burnt offerings at the north [gate], two tables eastward behind the second gate; and [behind] the porch of the gate two tables eastward. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} Four on one side and four on the other side behind the gate; upon them they kill the victims, in front of the eight tables of sacrifices. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And [there were] four tables of hewn stone for whole burnt offerings, the breadth [of them was] a cubit and a half, and the length [of them] two cubits [and] a half, and [their] height was a cubit: on them they shall place the instruments with which they kill there the whole burnt offerings and the victims. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And they shall have within a border of hewn stone round about of a span broad, and over the tables above screens for covering [them] from the wet and from the heat. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And he brought me into the inner court, and behold [there were] two chambers in the inner court, one behind the gate looking to the north, turning southward, and one behind the southern gate, but which looks to the north. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} And he said to me, This chamber that looks to the south, is for the priests that keep the charge of the house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} And the chamber that looks to the north is for the priests that keep the charge of the altar: they are the sons of Sadduc, those of the tribe of Levi who draw near to the Lord to serve him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} And he measured the court, the length [whereof was] one hundred cubits, and the breadth one hundred cubits, on its four sides; and the altar in front of the house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} And he brought me into the porch of the house; and he measured the post of the porch, the breadth was five cubits on one side and five cubits on the other side; and the breadth of the door [was] fourteen cubits, and the side-pieces of the door of the porch [were] three cubits on one side, and three cubits on the other side. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} And the length of the porch was twenty cubits, and the breadth twelve cubits; and they went up to it by ten steps; and [there were] pillars to the porch, one on this side and one on that side.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} In the five On Tuesday, April 20., after; selfsame hand \textsuperscript{2} the visions There can be little doubt, that the grand outlines of the description of the temple, in the following extraordinary vision, were taken from that of Solomon's, with all the additions made to it in after ages; and we may suppose that Zerubbabel and the other Jews had respect to it, as far as circumstances would permit, in rebuilding the temple after the captivity. There are, however, many circumstances which conclusively shew, that something infinitely superior to either the first or second temple was intended; and that the external description must be considered as a figure and emblem of spiritual blessings. Probably the more immediate accomplishment of the prophecy will be subsequent to the conversion and restoration of the Jews, the destruction of Gog and Magog, and the pouring out of the Spirit, mentioned at the close of the last chapter; but whether there will be any external forms analogous to these cannot be determined, though in some respects it seems improbable.; a very; by or, upon as the; frame, on the south \textsuperscript{5} a wall; by so he \textsuperscript{6} unto, ; which looketh Heb. whose face was the way stairs; threshold, ; *marg. one reed \textsuperscript{10} the little they three The entrance into the outer court seems to have been through a porch with doors at both ends; and on each side of this porch were three small chambers, or rooms, for the use of the porters, a reed square in size, with a passage of five cubits between them. The common cubit, termed the "cubit of a man, " ( ), was about 18 inches; but the cubit used by the angel was, as we learn from, "a cubit and a hand breadth, " or about three inches more than the common cubit, that is 21 inches. Hence the measuring reed, which was "six cubits long, by the cubit and the hand breadth, " ( ), must have been about 10+ feet \textsuperscript{12} space Heb. limit, or bound \textsuperscript{13} the gate The whole arch of the east gate, measured from the southern extremity of one room to the northern extremity of the opposite room, was 25 cubits; including the dimensions of the two rooms, or twelve cubits ( ); the spaces before the rooms, or two cubits ( ); and the breadth of the entrance, ten cubits ( ); making all 24 cubits, leaving one cubit for the thickness of the walls. \textsuperscript{15} the face of the gate This was the whole length of the porch, from the outward front (, ), to the inner side which looks into the first court ( ), including the thickness of the walls ( ), chambers ( ), and spaces between them. \textsuperscript{16} narrow Heb. closed; the little, arches or, galleries, or porches, ; inward or, within palm trees \textsuperscript{17} the outward, ; there were; thirty \textsuperscript{19} unto the, without or, from without \textsuperscript{20} the gate that looked Heb. whose face was \textsuperscript{21} the little, arches or, galleries, or porches, after \textsuperscript{22} palm trees, ;, ; and they, ; before them Or, "suitable to them, " that is, to the arches of the east gate. See the parallel passages. \textsuperscript{37} the posts, the utter court That is, "the outer court, " as the word utter primarily denotes. \textsuperscript{38} the chambers; where This place, where the legs and entrails of the sacrifices, especially of the burnt offerings, were washed, was just within the portico of the north entrance to the inner court, or court of the priests. An allusion to this is most probably made by the inspired apostle when writing his Epistle to the Hebrews ( ). "Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and our bodies washed with pure water." \textsuperscript{39} tables on that; the burnt the sin; the trespass \textsuperscript{40} at the side Two tables were on each side, as you come into the porch of the gate; and two on each side of the inner part of the gate that looked towards the altar; in all eight tables, on which they slew and cut up the victims. One for the singers; one for the priests who in their courses took charge of the sacred vessels and treasures; and one for the priests who attended on the altar and sacrifices. whose the keepers;, ; charge or, ward, or, ordinance, and so \textsuperscript{46} the keepers; these, ; which come \textsuperscript{47} court This was the inner court, or court of the priests, which was of the same dimensions with each division of the outer court; and the altar stood directly before the porch of the temple. an hundred cubits long \textsuperscript{48} the porch The length of the porch was twenty cubits, the same as the breadth of the temple, and the breadth eleven cubits, that is, one cubit more than in Solomon's temple. Two bivalve, or folding doors, each leaf of them being three cubits wide, seem to have formed the entrance; which, with five cubits, perhaps of brick or stone work, one each side, called "the post of the porch, " amount to sixteen cubits; and the other four cubits may be supposed to have been the distance from these posts to the outside walls of the temple. \textsuperscript{49} The steps This was a flight of steps which led from the inner court into the temple., pillars\par}
