\subsection*{Daniel 3}
\markright{DANIEL 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} In [his] eighteenth year Nabuchodonosor the king made a golden image, its height was sixty cubits, its breadth six cubits: and he set it up in the plain of Deira, in the province of Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And he sent forth to gather the governors, and the captains, and the heads of provinces, chiefs, and princes, and those who were in authority, and all the rulers of districts, to come to the dedication of the image. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} So the heads of provinces, the governors, the captains, the chiefs, the great princes, those who were in authority, and all the rulers of districts, were gathered to the dedication of the image which king Nabuchodonosor had set up; and they stood before the image. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Then a herald cried aloud, To you it is commanded, you⌃ peoples, tribes, [and] languages, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} at what hour you⌃ shall hear the sound of the trumpet, and pipe, and harp, and sackbut, and lute, and every kind of music, you⌃ shall fall down and worship the golden image which king Nabuchodonosor has set up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And whoever shall not fall down and worship, in the same hour he shall be cast into the burning fiery furnace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And it came to pass when the nations heard the sound of the trumpet, and pipe, and harp, and sackbut, and lute, and all kinds of music, all the nations, tribes, [and] languages, fell down and worshipped the golden image which king Nabuchodonosor had set up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Then came near [certain] Chaldeans, and accused the Jews to the king, [saying], {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} O king, live for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} You, O king, have made a decree that every man who shall hear the sound of the trumpet, and pipe, and harp, sackbut, and lute, and all kinds of music, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} and shall not fall down and worship the golden image, shall be cast into the burning fiery furnace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} There are [certain] Jews whom you have appointed over the affairs of the province of Babylon, Sedrach, Misach, [and] Abdenago, who have not obeyed your decree, O king: they serve not your gods, and worship not the golden image which you have set up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Then Nabuchodonosor in wrath and anger commanded to bring Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago: and they were brought before the king. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And Nabuchodonosor answered and said to them, Is it true, Sedrach, Misach, [and] Abdenago, that you⌃ serve not my gods, and worship not the golden image which I have set up? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Now then if you⌃ be ready, whenever you⌃ shall hear the sound of the trumpet, and pipe, and harp, and sackbut, and lute, and harmony, and every kind of music, to fall down and worship the golden image which I have made; [well]: but if you⌃ worship not, in the same hour you⌃ shall be cast into the burning fiery furnace; and who is the God that shall deliver you out of my hand? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Then answered Sedrach, Misach [and] Abdenago and said to king Nabuchodonosor, We have no need to answer you concerning this matter. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For our God whom we serve is in the heavens, able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will rescue us from your hands, O king. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} But if not, be it known to you, O king, that we [will] not serve your gods, nor worship the image which you have set up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Then Nabuchodonosor was filled with wrath, and the form of his countenance was changed toward Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago: and he gave orders to heat the furnace seven times [more than usual], until it should burn to the uttermost. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And he commanded mighty men to bind Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago, and to cast [them] into the burning fiery furnace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Then those men were bound with their coats, and caps, and hose, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} forasmuch as the king's word prevailed; and the furnace was made exceeding hot. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Then these three men, Sedrach, Misach, and Abdenago, fell bound into the midst of the burning furnace, and walked in the midst of the flame, singing praise to God, and blessing the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And Nabuchodonosor heard them singing praises; and he wondered, and rose up in haste, and said to his nobles, Did we not cast three men bound into the midst of the fire? and they said to the king, Yes, O king. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And the king said, But I see four men loose, and walking in the midst of the fire, and there has no harm happened to them; and the appearance of the fourth is like the Son of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Then Nabuchodonosor drew near to the door of the burning fiery furnace, and said, Sedrach, Misach, [and] Abdenago, you⌃ servants of the most high God, proceed forth, and come here. So Sedrach, Misach, [and] Abdenago, came forth out of the midst of the fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Then were assembled the satraps, and captains, and heads of provinces, and the royal princes; and they saw the men, [and perceived] that the fire had not had power against their bodies, and the hair of their head was not burnt, and their coats were not scorched, nor was the smell of fire upon them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And king Nabuchodonosor answered and said, Blessed be the God of Sedrach, Misach, [and] Abdenago, who has sent his angel, and delivered his servants, because they trusted in him; and they have changed the king's word, and delivered their bodies to be burnt, that they might not serve nor worship any god, except their own God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Therefore I publish a decree: Every people, tribe, [or] language, that shall speak reproachfully against the God of Sedrach, Misach, [and] Abdenago shall be destroyed, and their houses shall be plundered: because there is no other God who shall be able to deliver thus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Then the king promoted Sedrach, Misach, [and] Abdenago, in the province of Babylon, and advanced them, and gave them authority to rule over all the Jews who were in his kingdom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} King Nabuchodonosor to all nations, tribes, and tongues, who dwell in all the earth; Peace be multiplied to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} It seemed good to me to declare to you the signs and wonders which the most high God has wrought with me, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} how great and mighty [they are]: his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and his power to all generations.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{6} Gk. vocab: hōra (ὥρα) = hour; time. Common English renderings: hour; time. Can denote an hour or a set time. \textsuperscript{27} Heb. vocab: guf (גּוּף) = body. Common English renderings: body. Rare biblical term, more common in later Hebrew.\par}

\subsection*{Daniel 4}
\markright{DANIEL 4}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} I Nabuchodonosor was thriving in my house, and prospering. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} I saw a vision, and it terrified me, and I was troubled on my bed, and the visions of my head troubled me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I made a decree to bring in before me all the wise men of Babylon, that they might make known to me the interpretation of the dream. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} So the enchanters, magicians, soothsayers, [and] Chaldeans came in: and I told the dream before them; but they did not make known to me the interpretation thereof; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} until Daniel came, whose name is Baltasar, according to the name of my God, who has within him the Holy Spirit of God; to whom I said, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} O Baltasar, chief of the enchanters, of whom I know that the Holy Spirit of God is in you, and no mystery is too hard for you, hear the vision of my dream which I had, and tell me the interpretation of it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} I had a vision upon my bed; and behold a tree in the midst of the earth, and its height was great. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} The tree grew large and strong, and its height reached to the sky, and its extent to the extremity of the whole earth: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} its leaves were fair, and its fruit abundant, and in it was meat for all; and under it the wild beasts of the field took shelter, and the birds of the sky lodged in the branches of it, and all flesh was fed of it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} I saw in the night vision upon my bed, and, behold, a watcher and an holy one came down from heaven and cried aloud, and thus he said, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Cut down the tree, and pluck off its branches, and shake off its leaves, and scatter its fruit: let the wild beasts be removed from under it, and the birds from its branches. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Only leave the stump of its roots in the earth, and [bind it] with an iron and brass band; and it shall lie in the grass that is without and in the dew of heaven, and its portion [shall be] with the wild beasts in the grass of the field. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} His heart shall be changed from that of man, and the heart of a wild beast shall be given to him; and seven times shall pass over him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} The matter is by the decree of the watcher, and the demand is a word of the holy ones; that the living may known that the Lord is most high [over] the kingdom of men, and he will give it to whoever he shall please, and will set up over it that which is set at nothing of men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} This is the vision which I king Nabuchodonosor saw: and do you, Baltasar, declare the interpretation, for none of the wise men of my kingdom are able to show me the interpretation of it: but you, Daniel, are able; for the Holy Spirit of God is in you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Then Daniel, whose name is Baltasar, was amazed about one hour, and his thoughts troubled him. And Baltasar answered and said, [My] lord, let the dream be to them that hate you, and the interpretation of it to your enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} The tree which you saw, that grew large and strong, whose height reached to the sky and its extent to all the earth; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} and whose leaves were flourishing, and its fruit abundant, (and it was meat for all; under it the wild beasts lodged, and the birds of the sky took shelter in its branches:) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} is yourself, O king; for you are grown great and powerful, and your greatness has increased and reached to heaven, and your dominion to the ends of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And whereas the king saw a watcher and a holy one coming down from heaven, and he said, Strip the tree, and destroy it; only leave the stump of its roots in the ground, and [bind it] with a band of iron and brass; and it shall lie in the grass that is without, and in the dew of heaven, and its portion shall be with wild beasts, until seven times have passed over it; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} this is the interpretation of it, O king, and it is a decree of the Most High, which has come upon my lord the king. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And they shall drive you forth from men, and your dwelling shall be with wild beasts, and they shall feed you with grass as an ox, and you shall have your lodging under the dew of heaven, and seven times shall pass over you, until you known that the Most High is Lord of the kingdom of men, and will give it to whom he shall please. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And whereas they said, Leave the stumps of the roots of the tree; your kingdom abides [sure] to you from the time that you shall know the power of the heavens. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Therefore, O king, let my counsel please you, and atone for your sins by alms, and [your] iniquities by compassion on the poor: it may be God will be longsuffering to your trespasses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} All these things came upon king Nabuchodonosor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} After a twelvemonth, as he walked in his palace in Babylon, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} the king answered and said, Is not this great Babylon, which I have built for a royal residence, by the might of my power, for the honor of my glory? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} While the word was yet in the king's mouth, there came a voice from heaven, [saying], To you, king Nabuchodonosor, they say, The kingdom has departed from you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And they [shall] drive you from men, and your dwelling shall be with the wild beasts of the field, and they shall feed you with grass as an ox: and seven times shall pass over you, until you know that the Most High is Lord of the kingdom of men, and he will give it to whoever he shall please. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} In the same hour the word was fulfilled upon Nabuchodonosor: and he was driven forth from men, and he ate grass as an ox, and his body was bathed with the dew of heaven, until his hairs were grown like lions' [hairs], and his nails as birds' [claws]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And at the end of the time I Nabuchodonosor lifted up my eyes to heaven, and my reason returned to me, and I blessed the Most High, and praised him that lives for ever, and gave [him] glory; for his dominion is an everlasting dominion, and his kingdom [lasts] to all generations: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} and all the inhabitants of the earth are reputed as nothing: and he does according to his will in the army of heaven, and among the inhabitants of the earth: and there is none who shall withstand his power, and say to him, What has you done? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} At the same time my reason returned to me, and I came to the honor of my kingdom; and my [natural] form returned to me, and my princes, and my nobles, sought me, and I was established in my kingdom, and more abundant majesty was added to me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Now therefore I Nabuchodonosor praise and greatly exalt and glorify the King of heaven; for all his works are true, and his paths are judgment: and all that walk in pride he is able to abase.\par

\subsection*{Daniel 5}
\markright{DANIEL 5}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Baltasar the king made a great supper for his thousand nobles, and [there was] wine before the thousand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And Baltasar drinking gave orders as he tasted the wine that they should bring the gold and silver vessels, which Nabuchodonosor his father had brought forth from the temple in Jerusalem; that the king, and his nobles, and his mistresses, and his concubines, should drink out of them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} So the gold and silver vessels were brought which [Nabuchodonosor] had taken out of the temple of God in Jerusalem; and the king, and his nobles, and his mistresses, and his concubines, drank out of them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} They drank wine, and praised the gods of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of iron, and of wood, and of stone. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} In the same hour came forth fingers of a man's hand, and wrote in front of the lamp on the plaster of the wall of the king's house: and the king saw the knuckles of the hand that wrote. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Then the king's countenance changed, and his thoughts troubled him, and the joints of his loins were loosed, and his knees struck one another. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the king cried aloud to bring in the magicians, Chaldeans, [and] soothsayers; and he said to the wise men of Babylon, Whosoever shall read this writing, and make known to me the interpretation, shall be clothed with scarlet, and [there shall be] a golden chain upon his neck, and he shall be the third ruler in my kingdom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Then came in all the king's wise men: but they could not read the writing, nor make known the interpretation to the king. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And king Baltasar was troubled, and his countenance changed upon him, and his nobles were troubled with him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Then the queen came into the banquet house, and said, O king, live for ever: let not your thoughts trouble you, and let not your countenance be changed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} There is a man in your kingdom, in whom is the Spirit of God; and in the days of your father watchfulness and understanding were found in him; and king Nabuchodonosor your father made him chief of the enchanters, magicians, Chaldeans, [and] soothsayers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For [there is] an excellent spirit in him, and sense and understanding in him, interpreting dreams [as he does], and answering hard [questions], and solving difficulties: [it is] Daniel, and the king gave him the name of Baltasar: now then let him be called, and he shall tell you the interpretation of the writing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Then Daniel was brought in before the king: and the king said to Daniel, Are you Daniel, of the children of the captivity of Judea, which the king my father brought? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} I have heard concerning you, that the Spirit of God is in you, and [that] watchfulness and understanding and excellent wisdom have been found in you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And now, the wise men, magicians, [and] soothsayers, have come in before me, to read the writing, and make known to me the interpretation: but they could not tell it me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And I have heard concerning you, that you are able to make interpretations: now then if you shall be able to read the writing, and to make known to me the interpretation of it, you shall be clothed with purple, and there shall be a golden chain upon your neck, and you shall be third ruler in my kingdom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And Daniel said, before the king, Let your gifts be to yourself, and give the present of your house to another; but I will read the writing, and will make known to you the interpretation of it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} O king, the most high God gave to your father Nabuchodonosor a kingdom, and majesty, and honor, and glory: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} and by reason of the majesty which he gave to him, all nations, tribes, [and] languages trembled and feared before him: whom he would he killed; and whom he would he struck; and whom he would he exalted; and whom he would he abased. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was emboldened to act proudly, he was deposed from his royal throne, and [his] honor was taken from him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And he was driven forth from men; and his heart was given him after the nature of wild beasts, and his dwelling was with the wild asses; and they fed him with grass as an ox, and his body was bathed with the dew of heaven; until he knew that the most high God is Lord of the kingdom of men, and will give it to whoever he shall please. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And you accordingly, his son, O Baltasar, has not humbled your heart before God: know you not all this? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And you have been exalted against the Lord God of heaven; and they have brought before you the vessels of his house, and you, and your nobles, and your mistresses, and your concubines, have drunk wine out of them; and you have praised the gods of gold, and silver, and brass, and iron, and wood, and stone, which see not, and which hear not, and know not: and the God in whose hand are your breath, and all your ways has you not glorified. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Therefore from his presence has been sent forth the knuckle of a hand; and he has ordered the writing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And this is the ordered writing, Mane, Thekel, Phares. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} This is the interpretation of the sentence: Mane; God has measured your kingdom, and finished it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Thekel; it has been weighed in the balance, and found lacking. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Phares; your kingdom is divided, and given to the Medes and Persians. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Then Baltasar commanded, and they clothed Daniel with scarlet, and put the golden chain about his neck, and proclaimed concerning him that he was the third ruler in the kingdom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} In the same night was Baltasar the Chaldean king slain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And Darius the Mede succeeded to the kingdom, being sixty-two years [old].\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} Belshazzar is said by Josephus to be the same as Naboandelus, the Nabonadius of Ptolemy, and the Labynetus of Herodotus. He reigned seven years, during which time he was engaged in unsuccessful wars with the Medes and Persians; and at this very time was besieged by Cyrus. the golden; father or, grandfather, ; taken out Chal, brought forth might \textsuperscript{6} the king's, ; countenance Chal, brightness, was changed Chal, changed it and his thoughts, so that; joints or, girdles, Chal, bindings, or knots and his knees \textsuperscript{7} aloud Chal, with might, *marg. to bring; be clothed, ; scarlet or, purple a chain; the third \textsuperscript{8} but Because, probably, it was written in the ancient Hebrew or Samaritan character. \textsuperscript{9} greatly; countenance Chal, brightness, changed \textsuperscript{10} the queen This was probably Nitocris, the queen-mother, widow of Evil-merodach, son of Nebuchadnezzar, and father of Belshazzar. O king, ; let not \textsuperscript{11} a man, ; father or, grandfather, light; Nebuchadnezzar was certainly the grandfather of Belshazzar; but the term father in Hebrew and Chaldee is frequently used to denote a progenitor, or ancestor, however remote. master \textsuperscript{12} an excellent; interpreting of or, of an interpreter of, etc dissolving or, of a dissolver doubts Chal. knots.; whom \textsuperscript{13} Art thou Though Daniel was one of the chief ministers of state, who did "the king's business" in the palace ( ), yet Belshazzar seems to have known nothing of him. This shews that he was a weak and vicious prince, who minded pleasure more than business, according to the character given him by historians. He appears to have left the care of public affairs to his mother, Nitocris, a lady celebrated for her wisdom, who evidently knew Daniel well, and probably constantly employed him in the government of the kingdom., the children;, father or, grandfather, Jewry, Judea \textsuperscript{16} make Chal, interpret, thou shalt \textsuperscript{17} Let Daniel, on this occasion, behaved in a very different manner to Belshazzar, than he had formerly done to Nebuchadnezzar. \subsection*{Daniel 6}
\markright{DANIEL 6}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it pleased Darius, and he set over the kingdom one hundred and twenty satraps, to be in all his kingdom; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} and over them three governors, of whom one was, Daniel; for the satraps to give account to them, that the king should not be troubled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And Daniel was over them, for [there was] an excellent spirit in him; and the king set him over all his kingdom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Then the governors and satraps sought to find occasion against Daniel; but they found against him no occasion, nor trespass, nor error, because he was faithful. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And the governors said, We shall not find occasion against Daniel, except in the ordinances of his God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Then the governors and satraps stood by the king, and said to him, King Darius, live for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} All who preside over your kingdom, captains and satraps, chiefs and local governors, have taken counsel together, to establish by a royal statue and to confirm a decree, that whoever shall ask a petition of any god or man for thirty days, save of you, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Now then, O king, establish the decree, and publish a writ, that the decree of the Persians and Medes be not changed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Then king Darius commanded the decree to be written. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And when Daniel knew that the decree was ordered, he went into his house; and his windows were opened in his chambers toward Jerusalem, and three times in the day he knelt upon his knees, and prayed and gave thanks before his God, as he used to do before. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Then these men watched, and found Daniel praying and supplicating to his God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And they came and said to the king, O king, has you not made a decree, that whatever man shall ask a petition of any god or man for thirty days, but of you, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions? And the king said, The word is true, and the decree of the Medes and Persians shall not pass. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Then they answered and said before the king, Daniel of the children of the captivity of Judea, has not submitted to your decree; and three times in the day he makes his requests of his God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Then the king, when he heard the saying, was much grieved for Daniel and he greatly exerted himself for Daniel to deliver him: and he exerted himself till evening to deliver him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Then those men said to the king, Know, O king, that the law of the Medes and Persians is that we must not change any decree of statue which the king shall make. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. But the king said to Daniel, Your God whom you serve continually, he will deliver you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And they brought a stone, and put it on the mouth of the den; and the king sealed [it] with his ring, and with the ring of his nobles; that the case might not be altered with regard to Daniel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And the king departed to his house, and lay down fasting, and they brought him no food; and his sleep departed from him. But God shut the mouths of the lions, and they not molest Daniel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Then the king arose very early in the morning, and came in have to the den of lions. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And when he drew near to the den, he cried with a loud voice, Daniel, servant of the living God, has your God, whom you serve continually, been able to deliver you from the lion's mouth? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And Daniel said to the king, O king, live for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} My God has sent his angel, and stopped the lions' mouths, and they have not hurt me: for uprightness was found in me before him; and moreover before you, O king, I have committed no trespass. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Then the king was very glad for him, and he commanded to bring Daniel out of the den. So Daniel was brought out of the den, and there was found no hurt upon him, because he believed in his God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And the king commanded, and they brought the men that had accused Daniel, and they were cast into the den of lions, they, and their children, and their wives: and they reached not the bottom of the den before the lions had the mastery of them, and utterly broke to pieces all their bones. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Then king Darius wrote to all nations, tribes, [and] languages, who dwell in all the earth, [saying], Peace be multiplied to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} This decree has been set forth by me in every dominion of my kingdom, that [men] tremble and fear before the God of Daniel: for he is the living and eternal God, and his kingdom shall not be destroyed, and his dominion is for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} He helps and delivers, and works signs and wonders in the heaven and on the earth, who has rescued Daniel from the power of the lions. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.\par

\subsection*{Daniel 7}
\markright{DANIEL 7}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} In the first year of Baltasar, king of the Chaldeans Daniel had a dream, and visions of his head upon his bed: and he wrote his dream. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} I Daniel looked, and, behold, the four winds of heaven blew violently upon the great sea. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And there came up four great beasts out of the sea, differing from one another. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} The first [was] as a lioness, and her wings as an eagle's; I saw until her wings were plucked, ands she was lifted off from the earth, and she stood on human feet, and a man's heart was given to her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And, behold, a second beast like a bear, and it supported itself on one side, and there were three ribs in its mouth, between its teeth: and thus they said to it, Arise, devour much flesh. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} After this one I looked, and behold another wild beast as a leopard, and it had four wings of a bird upon it: and the wild beast had four heads, and power was given to it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} After this one I looked, and behold a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and exceedingly strong, and its teeth were of iron; devouring and crushing to atoms, and it trampled the remainder with its feet: and it was altogether different from the beasts that were before it; and it [had] ten hours. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I noticed his horns, and behold, another little horn came up in the midst of them, and before it three of the former horns were rooted out: and, behold, [there were] eyes as the eyes of a man in this horn, and a mouth speaking great things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} I watched until the thrones were set, and the Ancient of days sat; and his raiment was white as snow, and the hair of his head, as pure wool: his throne was a flame of fire, [and] his wheels burning fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} A stream of fire rushed forth before him: thousand thousands ministered to him, and ten thousands of myriads, attended upon him: the judgment sat, and the books were opened. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} I watched then because of the voice of the great words which that horn spoke, until the wild beast was slain and destroyed, and his body given to be burnt with fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And the dominion of the rest of the wild beasts was taken away; but a prolonging of life was given them for certain times. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} I saw in the night vision, and, behold, [one] coming with the clouds of heaven as the Son of man, and he came on to the Ancient of days, and was brought near to him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And to him was given the dominion, and the honor, and the kingdom; and all nations, tribes, and languages, shall serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom shall not be destroyed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} [As for] me Daniel, my spirit in my body trembled, and the visions of my head troubled me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And I drew near to one of them that stood by, and I sought to learn of him the truth of all these things: and he told me the truth, and made known to me the interpretation of the things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} These four beasts are four kingdoms [that] shall rise up on the earth: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} which shall be taken away; and the saints of the Most High shall take the kingdom, and possess it for ever and ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Then I enquired carefully concerning the fourth beast; for it differed from every [other] beast, exceeding dreadful: its teeth were of iron, and its claws of brass, devouring, and utterly breaking to pieces, and it trampled the remainder with its feet: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} and concerning it ten horns that were in its head, and the other that came up, and rooted up [some] of the former, which had eyes, and a mouth speaking great things, and his look was bolder than the rest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} I saw, and that horn made war with the saints, and prevailed against them; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} until the Ancient of days came, and he gave judgment to the saints of the Most High; and the time came on, and the saints possessed the kingdom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom on the earth, which shall excel all [other] kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and trample and destroy it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And his ten horns are ten kings [that] shall arise: and after them shall arise another, who shall exceed all the former ones in wickedness and he shall subdue three kings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And he shall speak words against the Most High, and shall wear out the saints of the Most High, and shall think to change times and law: and [power] shall be given into his hand for a time and times and half a time. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And the judgment has sat, and they shall remove [his] dominion to abolish it, and to destroy it utterly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And the kingdom and the power and the greatness of the kings that are under the whole heaven were given to the saints of the Most High; and his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all powers shall serve and obey him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Hitherto is the end of the matter. As for me Daniel, my thoughts greatly troubled me, and my countenance was changed: but I kept the matter in my heart.\par

\subsection*{Daniel 8}
\markright{DANIEL 8}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} In the third year of the reign of king Baltasar a vision appeared to me, [even] to me Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And I was in Susa the palace, which is in the land of Aelam, and I was on the [bank of] Ubal. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and, behold, a ram standing in front of the Ubal; and he had high horns; and one was higher than the other, and the high one came up last. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And I saw the ram butting westward, and northward, and southward; and no beast could stand before him, and there was none that could deliver out of his hand; and he did according to his will, and became great. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And I was considering, and, behold, a he-goat came from the southwest on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the earth: and the goat [had] a horn between his eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And he came to the ram that had the horns, which I had seen standing in front of the Ubal, and he ran at him with the violence of his strength. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I saw him coming up close to the ram, and he was furiously enraged against him, and he struck the ram, and broke both his horns: and there was no strength in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him on the ground, and trampled on him; and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And the he-goat grew exceedingly great: and when he was strong, his great horn was broken; and four other [horns] rose up in its place toward the four winds of heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And out of one of them came forth one strong horn, and it grew very great toward the south, and toward the host: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} and it magnified itself to the host of heaven; and there fell to the earth [some] of the host of heaven and of the stars, and they trampled on them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And [this shall be] until the chief captain shall have delivered the captivity: and by reason of him the sacrifice was disturbed, and he prospered; and the holy place shall be made desolate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And a sin-offering was given for the sacrifice, and righteousness was cast down to the ground; and it practised, and prospered. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And I heard one saint speaking, and a saint said to a certain one speaking, How long shall the vision continue, [even] the removal of the sacrifice, and the bringing in of the sin of desolation; and [how long] shall the sanctuary and host be trampled? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And he said to him, Evening and morning [there shall be] two thousand and four hundred days; and [then] the sanctuary shall be cleansed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And it came to pass, as I, [even] I Daniel, saw the vision, and sought to understand it, that, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And I heard the voice of a man between [the banks of] the Ubal; and he called, and said, Gabriel, cause that man to understand the vision. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And he came and stood near where I stood: and when he came, I was struck with awe, and fell upon my face: but he said to me, Understand, son of man: for yet the vision is for an appointed time. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And while he spoke with me, I fell upon my face to the earth: and he touched me, and set me on my feet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And he said, Behold, I make you know the things that shall come to pass at the end of the wrath: for the vision [is] yet for an appointed time. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} The ram which you saw that had the horns is the king of the Medes and Persians. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} The he-goat is the King of the Greeks: and the great horn which was between his eyes, he is the first king. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And [as for] the one that was broken, in whose place there stood up four horns, four kings shall arise out of his nation, but not in their [own] strength. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And at the latter time of their kingdom, when their sins are coming to the full, there shall arise a king bold in countenance, and understanding riddles. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And his power [shall be] great, and he shall destroy wonderfully, and prosper, and practise, and shall destroy mighty men, and the holy people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And the yoke of his chain shall prosper: [there is] craft in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by craft shall destroy many, and he shall stand up for the destruction of many, and shall crush them as eggs in his hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And the vision of the evening and morning that was mentioned is true: and do you seal the vision; for [it is] for many days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And I Daniel fell asleep, and was sick: then I arose, and did the king's business; and I wondered at the vision, and there was none that understood [it].\par

\subsection*{Daniel 9}
\markright{DANIEL 9}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} In the first year of Darius the son of Assuerus, of the seed of the Medes, who reigned over the kingdom of the Chaldeans, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} I Daniel understood by books the number of the years which was the word of the Lord to the prophet Jeremias, [even] seventy years for the accomplishment of the desolation of Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I set my face toward the Lord God, to seek [him] diligently by prayer and supplications, with fastings and sackcloth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And I prayed to the Lord my God, and confessed, and said, O Lord, the great and wonderful God, keeping your covenant and your mercy to them that love you, and to them that keep your commandments; we have sinned, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} we have done iniquity, we have transgressed, and we have departed and turned aside from your commandments and from your judgments: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} and we have not listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, and our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} To you, O Lord, [belongs] righteousness, and to us confusion of face, as at this day; to the men of Juda, and to the dwellers in Jerusalem, and to all Israel, to them that are near, and to them that are far off in all the earth, wherever you have scattered them, for the sin which they committed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} In you, O Lord, is our righteousness, and to us [belongs] confusion of faced, and to our kings, and to our princes, and to our fathers, forasmuch as we have sinned. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} To you, the Lord our God, [belong] compassions and forgivenesses, whereas we have departed [from you]; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} neither have we listened to the voice of the Lord our God, to walk in his laws, which he set before us by the hands of his servants the prophets. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Moreover all Israel have transgressed your law, and have refused to listen to your voice; so the curse has come upon us, and the oath that is written in the law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And he has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us, and against our judges who judged us, [by] bringing upon us great evils, such as have not happened under the whole heaven, according to what has happened in Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} As it is written in the law of Moses, all these evils have come upon us: yet we have not implored the Lord our God, that we might turn away from our iniquities, and have understanding in all your truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} The Lord also has watched, and brought the evils upon us: for the Lord our God is righteous in all his work which he has executed, but we have not listened to his voice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And now, O Lord our God, who brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and made to yourself a name, as [at] this day; we have sinned, we have transgressed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} O Lord, your mercy is over all: let, I pray you, your wrath turn away, and your anger from your city Jerusalem, [even] your holy mountain: for we have sinned, and because of our iniquities, and those of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people are become a reproach among all that are round about us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And now, O lord our God, listen to the prayer of your servant, and his supplications, and cause your face to shine on your desolate sanctuary, for your [own] sake, O Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Incline your ear, O my God, and hear; open your eyes and behold our desolation, and that of your city on which your name is called: for we do not bring our pitiful case before you on [the ground of] our righteousness, but on [the ground of] your manifold compassions, O Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Listen, O Lord; be propitious, O Lord; attend, O Lord; delay not, O my God, for your own sake: for your name is called upon your city and upon your people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And while I was yet speaking, and praying, and confessing my sins and the sins of my people Israel, and bringing my pitiful case before the Lord my God concerning the holy mountain; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} yes, while I was yet speaking in prayer, behold the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, [came] flying, and he touched me about the hour of the evening sacrifice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And he instructed me, and spoke with me, and said, O Daniel, I am now come forth to impart to you understanding. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} At the beginning of your supplication the word came forth, and I am come to tell you; for you are a man much beloved: therefore consider the matter, understand the vision. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Seventy weeks have been determined upon your people, and upon the holy city, for sin to be ended, and to seal up transgressions, and to blot out the iniquities, and to make atonement for iniquities, and to bring in everlasting righteousness, and to seal the vision and the prophet, and to anoint the Most Holy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And you shall know and understand, that from the going forth of the command for the answer and for the building of Jerusalem until Christ the prince [there shall be] seven weeks, and sixty-two weeks; and then [the time] shall return, and the street shall be built, and the wall, and the times shall be exhausted. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And after the sixty-two weeks, the anointed one shall be destroyed, and there is no judgment in him: and he shall destroy the city and the sanctuary with the prince that is coming: they shall be cut off with a flood, and to the end of the war which is rapidly completed he shall appoint [the city] to desolations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And one week shall establish the covenant with many: and in the midst of the week my sacrifice and drink-offering shall be taken away: and on the temple [shall be] the abomination of desolations; and at the end of time an end shall be put to the desolation.\par

\subsection*{Daniel 10}
\markright{DANIEL 10}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} In the third year of Cyrus king of the Persians a thing was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Baltasar; and the thing was true, and great power and understanding in the vision was given to him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} In those days I Daniel was mourning three full weeks. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} I ate no pleasant bread, and no flesh or wine entered into my mouth, neither did I anoint myself with oil, until three whole weeks were accomplished. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was near the great river, which is Tigris Eddekel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And I lifted up my eyes, and looked, and behold a man clothed in linen, and his loins were girded with gold of Ophaz: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} and his body was as Tharsis, and his face was a the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as lamps of fire, and his arms and his legs as the appearance of shining brass, and the voice of his words as the voice of a multitude. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I Daniel only saw the vision: and the men that were with me saw not the vision; but a great amazement fell upon them, and they fled in fear. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} So I was left alone, and saw this great vision, and there was no strength left in me, and my glory was turned into corruption, and I retained no strength. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Yet I heard the voice of his words: and when I heard him I was pricked [in the heart], and [I fell with] my face to the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And, behold, a hand touched me, and it raised me on my knees. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And he said to me, O Daniel, man greatly beloved, understand the words which I speak to you, and stand upright: for I am now sent to you. And when he had spoken to me this word, I stood trembling. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And he said to me, Fear not, Daniel: for from the first day that you did set your heart to understand, and to afflict yourself before the Lord your God, they words were heard, and I am come because of your words. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} But the prince of the kingdom of the Persians withstood me twenty-one days: and behold, Michael, one of the princes, came to help me; and I left him there with the chief of the kingdom of the Persians: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} and I have come to inform you of all that shall befall your people in the last days: for the vision is yet for [many] days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And when he had spoken with me according to these words, I turned my face to the ground, and was pricked [in the heart]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And, behold, as it were the likeness of a son of man touched my lips; and I opened my mouth, and spoke, and said to him that stood before me, O [my] lord, at the sight of you my bowels were turned within me, and I had no strength. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And how shall your servant be able, O [my] lord, to speak with this my lord? and as for me, from henceforth strength will not remain in me, and there is no breath left in me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And there touched me again as it were the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} and said to me, Fear not, man greatly beloved: peace be to you, quit yourself like a man, and be strong. And when he had spoken with me, I received strength, and said, Let my lord speak; for you have strengthened me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And he said, Know you, therefore I am come to you? and now I will return to fight with the prince of the Persians: and I was going in, and the prince of the Greeks came. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} But I will tell you that which is ordained in the scripture of truth: and there is no one that holds with me in these matters but Michael your prince.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} am 3470, bc 534 Cyrus;, ; whose, and the; but, long Heb. great and he \textsuperscript{2} I Daniel; full weeks Heb. weeks of days \textsuperscript{3} I ate; pleasant bread Heb. bread of desires; *marg. neither did \textsuperscript{5} and behold; a certain man Heb. one man clothed; loins; Uphaz \textsuperscript{6} like the beryl; his face; his arms; like the voice \textsuperscript{8} I was; and there, ; comeliness or, vigour turned \textsuperscript{10} an hand, ; set Heb. moved \textsuperscript{11} a man; greatly beloved Heb. of desires; understand, upright Heb. upon thy standing, I stood \textsuperscript{12} Fear not; , ; from Daniel, as Bp. Newton observes, was now very far advanced in years; for the third year of Cyrus was the 73rd of his captivity; and being a youth when carried captive, he cannot be supposed to have been less than ninety. Old as he was, "he set his heart to understand, " the former revelations which had been made to him, and particularly the vision of the ram and he-goat, as may be collected from the sequel; and for this purpose he prayed and fasted three weeks. His fasting and prayers had the desired effect, for and angel was sent to unfold to him those mysteries; and whoever would excel in divine knowledge, must imitate Daniel, and habituate himself to study, temperance, and devotion., ; chasten; and I \textsuperscript{13} the prince; Michael; one or, the first \textsuperscript{16} like, ; touched; my Lord; my sorrows \textsuperscript{17} the servant of this my lord or, this servant of my lord; talk; straightway \textsuperscript{19} O man;, fear not; be strong; Let thou hast \textsuperscript{20} to fight; the prince of Grecia \textsuperscript{21} I will, 11:1-12:13; holdeth Heb. strengtheneth himself Michael\par}

\subsection*{Daniel 11}
\markright{DANIEL 11}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And I in the first year of Cyrus stood to strengthen and confirm [him]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And now I will tell you the truth. Behold, there shall yet rise up three kings in Persia: and the fourth shall be very far richer than all: and after that he is master of his wealth, he shall rise up against all the kingdoms of the Greeks. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} An there shall rise up a mighty king, and he shall be lord of a great empire, and shall do according to his will. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And when his kingdom shall stand up, it shall be broken, and shall be divided to the four winds of heaven; but not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled over: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, and [given] to others beside these. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And the king of the south shall be strong; and one of their princes shall prevail against him, and shall obtain a great dominion. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And after his years they shall associate; and the daughter of the king of the south shall come to the king of the north, to make agreements with him: but she shall not retain power of arm; neither shall his seed stand: and she shall be delivered up, and they that brought her, and the maiden, and he that strengthened her in these times. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} [But] out of the flower of her root there shall arise [one on] his place, and shall come against the host, and shall enter into the strongholds of the king of the north, and shall fight against them, and prevail. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Yes, he shall carry with a body of captives into Egypt their gods with their molten [images, and] all their precious vessels of silver and gold; and he shall last longer than the king of the north. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And he shall enter into the kingdom of the king of the south, and shall return to his own land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And his sons shall gather a multitude among many: and one shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through, and he shall rest, and collect his strength. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And the king of the south shall be greatly enraged, and shall come forth, and shall war with the king of the north: and he shall raise a great multitude; but the multitude shall be delivered into his hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And he shall take the multitude, and his heart shall be exalted; and he shall cast down many thousands; but he shall not prevail. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} For the king of the north shall return, and bring a multitude greater than the former, and at the end of the times of years an invading army shall come with a great force, and with much substance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And in those times many shall rise up against the king of the south; and the children of the spoilers of your people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; and they shall fail. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And the king of the north shall come in, and cast up a mound, and take strong cities: and the arms of the king of the south shall withstand, and his chosen ones shall rise up, but there shall be no strength to stand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And he that comes in against him shall do according to his will, and there is no one to stand before him: and he shall stand in the land of beauty, and it shall be consumed by his hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And he shall set his face to come in with the force of his whole kingdom, and shall cause everything to prosper with him: and he shall give him the daughter of women to corrupt her: but she shall not continue, neither be on his side. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And he shall turn his face to the islands, and shall take many, and cause princes to cease from their reproach: nevertheless his own reproach shall return to him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Then he shall turn back his face to the strength of his own land: but he shall become weak, and fall, and not be found. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And there shall arise out of his root one that shall cause a plant of the kingdom to pass over his place, earning kingly glory: and yet in those days shall he be broken, yet not openly, nor in war. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} [One] shall stand on his place, [who] has been set a nothing, and they have not put upon him the honor of the kingdom: but he shall come in prosperously, and obtain the kingdom by deceitful ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And the arms of him that overflows shall be washed away as with a flood from before him, and shall be broken, and [so shall be] the head of the covenant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And because of the leagues made with him he shall work deceit: and he shall come up, and overpower them with a small nation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And he shall enter with prosperity, and [that] into fertile districts; and he shall do what his fathers and his fathers' fathers have not done; he shall scatter among them plunder, and spoils, and wealth; and he shall devise plans against Egypt, even for a time. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And his strength and his heart shall be stirred up against the king of the south with a great force; and the king of the south shall engage in war with a great and very strong force; but [his forces] shall not stand, for they shall devise plans against him: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} and they shall eat his provisions, and shall crush him, and he shall carry away armies as with a flood, and many shall fall down slain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And [as for] both the kings, their hearts [are set] upon mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper; for yet the end is for a [fixed] time. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And he shall return to his land with much substance; and his heart [shall be] against the holy covenant; and he shall perform [great deeds], and return to his own land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} At the [set] time he shall return, and shall come into the south, but the last [expedition] shall [not] be as the first. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} For the Citians issuing forth shall come against him, and he shall be brought low, and shall return, and shall be incensed against the holy covenant: and he shall do [thus], and shall return, and have intelligence with them that have forsaken the holy covenant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And seeds shall spring up out of him, and they shall profane the sanctuary of strength, and they shall remove the perpetual [sacrifice], and make the abomination desolate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And the transgressors shall bring about a covenant by deceitful ways: but a people knowing their God shall prevail, and do [valiantly]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And the intelligent of the people shall understand much: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, and by captivity, and by spoil of [many] days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And when they are weak they shall be helped with a little help: but many shall attach themselves to them with treachery. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And [some] of them that understand shall fall, to try them as with fire, and to test [them], and that they may be manifested at the time of the end, for the matter [is] yet for a [set] time. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And he shall do according to his will, and the king shall exalt and magnify himself against every god, and shall speak great swelling words, and shall prosper until the indignation shall be accomplished: for it is coming to an end. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And he shall not regard any gods of his fathers, nor the desire of women, neither shall he regard any deity: for he shall magnify himself above all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And he shall honor the god of forces on his place: and a god whom his fathers knew not he shall honor with gold, and silver, and precious stones, and desirable things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And he shall do [thus] in the strong places of refuge with a strange god, and shall increase his glory: and he shall subject many to them, and shall distribute the land in gifts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And at the end of the time he shall conflict with the king of the south: and the king of the north shall come against him with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and they shall enter into the land: and he shall break in pieces, and pass on: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} and he shall enter into the land of beauty, and many shall fail: but these shall escape out of his hand, Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And he shall stretch forth [his] hand over the land; and the land of Egypt shall not escape. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And he shall have the mastery over the secret [treasures] of gold and silver, and over all the desirable [possessions] of Egypt, and of the Libyans and Ethiopians in their strongholds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} But rumors and anxieties out of the east and from the north shall trouble him; and he shall come with great wrath to destroy many. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} And he shall pitch the tabernacle of his palace between the seas in the holy mountain of beauty: [but] he shall come to his portion, and there is none to deliver him.\par

That no word of God can fall to the ground, but what he has declared shall infallibly come to pass. For the elucidation of the historical parts of Scripture, it is advantageous to notice the writings of heathen authors. Light is thus thrown on many passages of Holy Writ, by shewing the accomplishment of the prophecies therein contained, or customs elucidated, which, in the course of years, or in our more northern latitude, would be to us inexplicable. \subsection*{Daniel 12}
\markright{DANIEL 12}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And at that time Michael the great prince shall stand up, that stands over the children of your people: and there shall be a time of tribulation, such tribulation as has not been from the time that there was a nation on the earth until that time: at that time your people shall be delivered, [even] every one that is written in the book. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to reproach and everlasting shame. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And the wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament, and [some] of the many righteous as the stars for ever and ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And you, Daniel, close the words, and seal the book to the time of the end; until many are taught, and knowledge is increased. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And I Daniel saw, and, behold, two others stood, on one side of the bank of the river, and the other on the other side of the bank of the river. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And [one] said to the man clothed in linen, who was over the water of the river, When [will be] the end of the wonders which you have mentioned? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I heard the man clothed in linen, who was over the water of the river, and he lifted up his right hand and his left hand to heaven, and swore by him that lives for ever, that [it should be] for a time of times and half a time: when the dispersion is ended they shall know all these things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And I heard, but I understood not: and I said, O Lord, what [will be] the end of these things? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And he said, Go, Daniel: for the words are closed and sealed up to the time of the end. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Many must be tested, and thoroughly whitened, and tried with fire, and sanctified; but the transgressors shall transgress: and none of the transgressors shall understand; but the wise shall understand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And from the time of the removal of the perpetual sacrifice, when the abomination of desolation shall be set up, [there shall be] a thousand two hundred and ninety days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Blessed is he that waits, and comes to the thousand three hundred and thirty-five days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} But go you, and rest; for [there are] yet days and seasons to the fulfillment of the end; and you shall stand in your lot at the end of the days.\par

\section*{Hosea Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} Hosea\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} The book names Hosea and is received as his prophetic ministry to the northern kingdom.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} Romans 9:25-26 and Matthew 2:15 cite Hosea as prophetic Scripture.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} 8th century BC\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} MT chronology places Hosea in the late northern kingdom before Samaria's fall.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} The LXX preserves the same horizon, with normal versional differences.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Northern kingdom prophecy using Hosea's marriage and family as sign-acts.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To expose covenant unfaithfulness and proclaim the LORD's steadfast restoring love.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} covenant unfaithfulness; steadfast love; judgment; restoration; sonship\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Marriage sign and accusations 1-3; Covenant lawsuit and judgment 4-13; Restoration hope 14.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Qumran Hosea fragments survive Second Temple period | Subst. Early Hebrew witness survives in Qumran fragments Hasmonean-Herodian periods | Heb. Leningrad Codex AD 1008 | Gk. Codex Vaticanus and Alexandrinus preserve Greek Hosea 4th-5th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Cited in later Jewish and NT writings by Paul and Matthew (1st century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} Hosea is frequently quoted in the NT, making MT/LXX comparison especially important at citation points.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives Hosea as the named prophet and his sign-act marriage as real prophetic history under inspiration.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\subsection*{Osee 1}
\markright{OSEE 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The word of the Lord which came to Osee the son of Beeri, in the days of Ozias, and Joatham, and Achaz, and Ezekias, kings of Juda, and in the days of Jeroboam son of Joas, king of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The beginning of the word of the Lord by Osee. And the Lord said to Osee, Go, take to yourself a wife of fornication, and children of fornication: for the land will surely go a-whoring in departing from the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} So he went and took Gomer, daughter of Debelaim; and she conceived, and bore him a son. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And the Lord said to him, Call his name Jezrael; for yet a little [while], and I will avenge the blood of Jezrael on the house of Juda, and will make to cease the kingdom of the house of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And it shall be, in that day, [that] I will break the bow of Israel in the valley of Jezrael. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And she conceived again, and bore a daughter. And he said to him, Call her name, Unpitied: for I will no more have mercy on the house of Israel, but will surely set myself in array against them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} But I will have mercy on the house of Juda, and will save them by the Lord their God, and will not save them with bow, nor with sword, nor by war, nor by horses, nor by horsemen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And she weaned Unpitied; and she conceived again, and bore a son. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And he said, Call his name, Not my people: for you⌃ are not my people, and I am not your [God]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Yet the number of the children of Israel was as the sand of the sea, which shall not be measured nor numbered: and it shall come to pass, [that] in the place where it was said to them, You⌃ are not my people, even they shall be called the sons of the living God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And the children of Juda shall be gathered, and the children of Israel together, and shall appoint themselves one head, and shall come up out of the land: for great [shall be] the day of Jezrael.\par
