\subsection*{Osee 2}
\markright{OSEE 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Say to your brother, My people, and to your sister, Pitied. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Plead with your mother, plead: for she is not my wife, and I am not her husband: and I will remove her fornication out of my presence, and her adultery from between her breasts: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} that I may strip her naked, and make her again as she was at the day of her birth: and I will make her desolate, and make her as a dry land, and will kill her with thirst. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And I will not have mercy upon her children; for they are children of fornication. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And their mother went a-whoring: she that bore them disgraced [them]: for she said, I will go after my lovers, that give me my bread and my water, and my garments, and my linen clothes, my oil and my necessaries. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Therefore, behold, I hedge up her way with thorns, and I will stop the ways, and she shall not find her path. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And she shall follow after her lovers, and shall not overtake them; and she shall seek them, but shall not find them: and she shall say, I will go, and return to my former husband; for it was better with me than now. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And she knew not that I gave her her corn, and wine, and oil, and multiplied silver to her: but she made silver and gold [images] for Baal. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Therefore I will return, and take away my corn in its season, and my wine in its time; and I will take away my raiment and my linen clothes, so that she shall not cover her nakedness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And now I will expose her uncleanness before her lovers, and no one shall by any means deliver her out of my hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And I will take away all her gladness, her feasts, and her festivals at the new moon, and her sabbaths, and all her solemn assemblies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And I will utterly destroy her vines, and her fig-trees, all things of which she said, These are my hire which my lovers have given me: and I will make them a testimony, and the wild beasts of the field, and the birds of the sky, and the reptiles of the earth shall devour them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And I will recompense on her the days of Baalim, wherein she sacrificed to them, and put on her ear-rings, and her necklaces, and went after her lovers, and forgot me, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Therefore, behold, I [will] cause her to err, and will make her as desolate, and will speak comfortably to her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And I will giver her possessions from thence, and the valley of Achor to open her understanding: and she shall be afflicted there according to the days of her infancy, and according to the days of her coming up out of the land of Egypt. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And it shall come to pass in that day, says the Lord, [that] she shall call me, My husband, and shall no longer call me Baalim. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And I will take away the names of Baalim out of her mouth, and their names shall be remembered no more at all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And I will make for them in that day a covenant with the wild beasts of the field, and with the birds of the sky, and with the reptiles of the earth: and I will break the bow and the sword and the battle from off the earth, and will cause you to dwell safely. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And I will betroth you to myself for ever; yes, I will betroth you to myself in righteousness, and in judgment, and in mercy, and in tender compassions; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} and I will betroth you to myself in faithfulness: and you shall know the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And it shall come to pass in that day, says the Lord, I will listen to the heaven, and it shall listen to the earth; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} and the earth shall listen to the corn, and the wine, and the oil; and they shall listen to Jezrael. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And I will sow her to me on the earth; and will love her that was not loved, and will say to that which was not my people, You are my people; and they shall say, You are the Lord my God.\par

\subsection*{Osee 3}
\markright{OSEE 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the Lord said to me, Go yet, and love a woman that loves evil things, an adulteress, even as the Lord loves the children of Israel, and they have respect to strange gods, and love cakes of dried grapes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} So I hired [her] to myself for fifteen [pieces] of silver, and a homer of barley, and a flagon of wine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I said to her, You shall wait for me many days; and you shall not commit fornication, neither shall you be for [another] man; and I [will be] for you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For the children of Israel shall abide many days without a king, and without a prince, and without a sacrifice, and without an altar, and without a priesthood, and without manifestations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And afterward shall the children of Israel return, and shall seek the Lord their God, and David their king; and shall be amazed at the Lord and at his goodness in the latter days.\par

\subsection*{Osee 4}
\markright{OSEE 4}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Hear the word of the Lord, you⌃ children of Israel: for the Lord [has] a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Cursing, and lying, and murder, and theft, and adultery abound in the land, and they mingle blood with blood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Therefore shall the land mourn, and shall be diminished with all that dwell in it, with the wild beasts of the field, and the reptiles of the earth, and with the birds of the sky, and the fish of the sea shall fail: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} that neither any one may plead, nor any one reprove [another]; but my people are as a priest spoken against. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Therefore they shall fall by day, and the prophet with you shall fall: I have compared your mother to night. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} My people are like as if they had no knowledge: because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you shall not minister as priest to me: and [as] you have forgotten the law of your God, I also will forget your children. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} According to their multitude, so they sinned against me: I will turn their glory into shame. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} They will devour the sins of my people, and will set their hearts on their iniquities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And the priest shall be as the people: and I will avenge on them their ways, and I will recompense to them their counsels. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And they shall eat, and shall not be satisfied: they have gone a-whoring, and shall by no means prosper: because they have left off to take heed to the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} The heart of my people has gladly engaged in fornication and wine and strong drink. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} They asked counsel by [means of] signs, and they reported answer to them by their staves: they have gone astray in a spirit of whoredom, and gone grievously a-whoring from their God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} They have sacrificed on the tops of the mountains, and on the hills they have sacrificed under the oak and poplar, and under the shady tree, because the shade was good: therefore your daughters shall go a-whoring, and your daughters-in-law shall commit adultery. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And I will not visit upon your daughters when they shall commit fornication, nor your daughters-in-law when they shall commit adultery: for they themselves mingled themselves with harlots, and sacrificed with polluted ones, and the people that understood not entangled itself with a harlot. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} But you, O Israel, be not ignorant, and go you⌃ not, [men of] Juda, to Galgala; and go not up to the house of On, and swear not by the living Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} For Israel was maddened like a mad heifer: now the Lord will feed them as a lamb in a wide place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Ephraim, joined with idols, has laid stumbling blocks in his own way. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} He has chosen the Chananites: they have grievously gone a-whoring: they have loved dishonor through her insolence. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} You are a blast of wind in her wings, and they shall be ashamed because of their altars.\par

\subsection*{Osee 5}
\markright{OSEE 5}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Hear these things, you⌃ priests; and attend, O house of Israel; and listen, O house of the king; for the controversy is with you, because you⌃ have been a snare in Scopia, and as a net spread on Itabyrium, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} which they that hunt the prey have fixed: but I will correct you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} I know Ephraim, and Israel is not far from me: for now Ephraim has gone grievously a-whoring, Israel is defiled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} They have not framed their counsels to return to their God, for the spirit of fornication is in them, and they have not known the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And the pride of Israel shall be brought low before his face; and Israel and Ephraim shall fall in their iniquities; and Judas also shall fall with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} They shall go with sheep and calves diligently to seek the Lord; but they shall not find him, for he has withdrawn himself from them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For they have forsaken the Lord; for strange children have been born to them: now shall the cankerworm devour them and their heritages. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Blow you⌃ the trumpet on the hills, sound aloud on the heights: proclaim in the house of On, Benjamin is amazed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Ephraim has come to nothing in the days of reproof: in the tribes of Israel I have shown faithful [dealings]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} The princes of Juda became as they that removed the bounds: I will pour out upon them my fury as water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Ephraim altogether prevailed against his adversary, he trod judgment under foot, for he began to go after vanities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Therefore I [will be] as consternation to Ephraim, and as a goad to the house of Juda. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And Ephraim saw his disease, and Judas his pain; then Ephraim went to the Assyrians, and sent ambassadors to king Jarim: but he could not heal you, and your pain shall in nowise cease from you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Therefore I am as a panther to Ephraim, and as a lion to the house of Juda: and I will tear, and go away; and I will take, and there shall be none to deliver. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} I will go and return to my place, until they are brought to nothing, and [then] shall they seek my face.\par

\subsection*{Osee 6}
\markright{OSEE 6}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} In their affliction they will seek me early, saying, Let us go, and return to the Lord our God; for he has torn, and will heal us; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} he will strike, and bind us up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} After two days he will heal us: in the third day we shall arise, and live before him, and shall know [him]: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} let us follow on to know the Lord: we shall find him ready as the morning, and he will come to us as the early and latter rain to the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} What shall I do to you, Ephraim? What shall I do to you, Juda? whereas your mercy is as a morning cloud, and as the early dew that goes away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Therefore have I mown down your prophets; I have slain them with the word of my mouth: and my judgment shall go forth as the light. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For I will [have] mercy rather than sacrifice, and the knowledge of God rather than whole burnt offerings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} But they are as a man transgressing a covenant: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} there the city Galaad despised me, working vanity, troubling water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And your strength [is that] of a robber: the priests have hid the way, they have murdered [the people of] Sicima; for they have wrought iniquity in the house of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} I have seen horrible [things] there, [even] the fornication of Ephraim: Israel and Juda are defiled; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} begin together grapes for yourself, when I turn the captivity of my people.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} and let; he hath torn \textsuperscript{3} we know; if; his going; as the rain \textsuperscript{4} what;, ; for; goodness or, mercy, or, kindness as a \textsuperscript{5} have I; , ; I have; , and thy judgments are as or, that thy judgments might be as, etc. \textsuperscript{7} men or, Adam, ; transgressed; they dealt \textsuperscript{8} Gilead; polluted with blood or, cunning for blood \textsuperscript{9} as troops; so; by consent Heb. with one shoulder, or, to Shechem, lewdness or, enormity\par}

\subsection*{Osee 7}
\markright{OSEE 7}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} When I have healed Israel, then shall the iniquity of Ephraim be revealed, and the wickedness of Samaria; for they have wrought falsehood: and a thief shall come in to him, [even] a robber spoiling in his way; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} that they may concert together as [men] singing in their heart: I remember all their wickedness: now have their own counsels compassed them about; they came before my face. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} They gladdened kings with their wickedness, and princes with their lies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} They are all adulterers, as an oven glowing with flame for hot-baking, on account of the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} [In] the days of our kings, the princes began to be inflamed with wine: he stretched out his hand with pestilent fellows. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Therefore their hearts are inflamed as an oven, while they rage all the night: Ephraim is satisfied with sleep; the morning is come; he is burnt up as a flame of fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} They are all heated like an oven, and have devoured their judges: all their kings are fallen; there was not among them one that called on me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Ephraim is mixed among his people; Ephraim became a cake not turned. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Strangers devoured his strength, and he knew [it] not; and grey hairs came upon him, and he knew [it] not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And the pride of Israel shall be brought down before his face: yet they have not returned to the Lord their God, neither have they diligently sought him for all this. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And Ephraim was as a silly dove, not having a heart: he called to Egypt, and they went to the Assyrians. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Whenever they shall go, I will cast my net upon them; I will bring them down as the birds of the sky, I will chasten them with the rumor of their [coming] affliction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Woe to them! for they have started aside from me: they are cowards; for they have sinned against me: yet I redeemed them, but they spoke falsehoods against me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And their hearts did not cry to me, but they howled on their beds: they pined for oil and wine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} They were instructed by me, and I strengthened their arms; and they devised evils against me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} They turned aside to that which is not, they became as a bent bow: their princes shall fall by the sword, by reason of the unbridled state of their tongue: this is their setting at nothing in the land of Egypt.\par

\subsection*{Osee 8}
\markright{OSEE 8}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} [He shall come] into their midst as the land, as an eagle against the house of the Lord, because they have transgressed my covenant, and have sinned against my law. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} They shall soon cry out to me, [saying], O God, we know you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For Israel has turned away from good things; they have pursued an enemy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} They have made kings for themselves, but not by me: they have ruled, but they did not make it known to me: [of] their silver and their gold they have made images to themselves, that they might be destroyed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Cast off your calf, O Samaria; my anger is kindled against them: how long will they be unable to purge themselves in Israel? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Whereas the workman made it, and it is not God; therefore your calf, Samaria, was a deceiver: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} for they sowed blighted [seed], and their destruction shall await them, a sheaf of corn that avails not to make meal; and even if it should produce it, strangers shall devour it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Israel is swallowed up: now is he become among the nations as a worthless vessel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For they have gone up to the Assyrians: Ephraim has been strengthened against himself; they loved gifts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Therefore shall they be delivered to the nations: now I will receive them, and they shall cease a little to anoint a king and princes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Because Ephraim has multiplied altars, [his] beloved altars are become sins to him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} I will write down a multitude [of commands] for him; but his statutes are accounted strange things, [even] the beloved altars. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} For if they should offer a sacrifice, and eat flesh, the lord will not accept them: now will he remember their iniquities, and will take vengeance on their sins: they have returned to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things among the Assyrians. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And Israel has forgotten him that made him, and they have built fanes, and Juda has multiplied walled cities: but I will send fire on his cities, and it shall devour their foundations.\par

\subsection*{Osee 9}
\markright{OSEE 9}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Rejoice not, O Israel, neither make merry, as [other] nations: for you have gone a-whoring from your God; you have loved gifts upon every threshing floor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The threshing floor and wine-press knew them not, and the wine disappointed them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} They lived not in the Lord's land: Ephraim lived in Egypt, and they shall eat unclean things among the Assyrians. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} They have not offered wine to the Lord, neither have their sacrifices been sweet to him, [but] as the bread of mourning to them; all that eat them shall be defiled; for their bread for their soul shall not enter into the house of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} What will you⌃ do in the day of the general assembly, and in the day of the feast of the Lord? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Therefore, behold, they go forth from the trouble of Egypt, and Memphis shall receive them, and Machmas shall bury them: [as for] their silver, destruction shall inherit it; thorns [shall be] in their tents. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} The days of vengeance are come, the days of your recompense are come; and Israel shall be afflicted as the prophet that is mad, as a man deranged: by reason of the multitude of your iniquities your madness has abounded. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} The watchman of Ephraim [was] with God: the prophet is a crooked snare in all his ways: they have established madness in the house of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} They have corrupted themselves according to the days of the hill: he will remember their iniquities, he will take vengeance on their sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} I found Israel as grapes in the wilderness, and I saw their fathers as an early watchman in a fig tree: they went in to Beel-phegor, and were shamefully estranged, and the abominable became as the beloved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Ephraim has flown away as a bird; their glories from the birth, and the travail, and the conception. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For even if they should rear their children, yet shall they be utterly bereaved: therefore also there is woe to them, [though] my flesh is of them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Ephraim, [even] as I saw, gave their children for a prey; yes, Ephraim [was ready] to bring out his children to slaughter. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Give them, O Lord: what will you give them? a miscarrying womb, and dry breasts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} All their wickedness is in Galgal: for there I hated them: because of the wickedness of their practices, I will cast them out of my house, I will not love them any more: all their princes are disobedient. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Ephraim is sick, he is dried up at his roots, he shall in no wise any more bear fruit: therefore even if they should beget [children], I will kill the desired [fruit] of their womb. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} God shall reject them, because they have not listened to him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.\par

\subsection*{Osee 10}
\markright{OSEE 10}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Israel is a vine with goodly branches, her fruit is abundant: according to the multitude of her fruits she has multiplied [her] altars; according to the wealth of his land, he has set up pillars. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} They have divided their hearts; now shall they be utterly destroyed: he shall dig down their altars, their pillars shall mourn. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Because now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the Lord: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} and what should a king do for us, speaking false professions [as his] words? he will make a covenant: judgment shall spring up as a weed on the soil of the field. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} The inhabitants of Samaria shall dwell near the calf of the house of On; for the people of it mourned for it: and as they provoked him, they shall rejoice at his glory, because he has departed from them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And having bound it for the Assyrians, they carried it away as presents to king Jarim: Ephraim shall receive a gift, and Israel shall be ashamed of his counsel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Samaria has cast off her king as a twig on the surface of the water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And the altars of On, the sins of Israel, shall be taken away: thorns and thistles shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} From the time the hills [existed] Israel has sinned: there they stood: war [waged] against the children of iniquity {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} to chastise them shall not overtake them on the hill, the nations shall be gathered against them, when they are chastened for their two sins, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Ephraim is a heifer taught to love victory, but I will come upon the fair part of her neck: I will mount Ephraim; I will pass over Juda in silence; Jacob shall prevail against him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Sow to yourselves for righteousness, gather in for the fruit of life: light you⌃ for yourselves the light of knowledge; seek the Lord till the fruits of righteousness come upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Therefore have you⌃ passed over ungodliness in silence, and reaped the sins of it? you⌃ have eaten false fruit; for you have trusted in your sins, in the abundance of your power. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Therefore shall destruction rise up among your people, and all your strong places shall be ruined: as a prince Solomon [departed] out of the house of Jeroboam, in the days of battle they dashed the mother to the ground upon the children, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} thus will I do to you, O house of Israel, because of the unrighteousness of your sins.\par

\subsection*{Osee 11}
\markright{OSEE 11}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Early in the morning were they cast off, the king of Israel has been cast off: for Israel is a child, and I loved him, and out of Egypt have I called his children. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} As I called them, so they departed from my presence: they sacrificed to Baalim, and burnt incense to graven images. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Yet I bound the feet of Ephraim, I took him on my arm; but they knew not that I healed them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} When men were destroyed, I drew them with the bands of my love: and I will be to them as a man striking [another] on his cheek: and I will have respect to him, I will prevail with him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Ephraim lived in Egypt; and [as for] the Assyrian, he was his king, because he would not return. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And in his cities he prevailed not with the sword, and he ceased [to war] with his hands: and they shall eat [of the fruit] of their own devices: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} and his people [shall] cleave fondly to their habitation; but God shall be angry with his precious things, and shall not at all exalt him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} How shall I deal with you, Ephraim? [how] shall I protect you, Israel? what shall I do with you? I will make you as Adama, and as Seboim; my heart is turned at once, my repentance is powerfully excited. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} I will not act according to the fury of my wrath, I will not abandon Ephraim to be utterly destroyed: for I am God, and not man; the Holy One within you: and I will not enter into the city. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} I will go after the Lord: he shall utter [his voice] as a lion: for he shall roar, and the children of the waters shall be amazed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} They shall be amazed [and fly] as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of the Assyrians: and I will restore them to their houses, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Ephraim has compassed me with falsehood, and the house of Israel and Juda with ungodliness: [but] now God knows them, and they shall be called God's holy people.\par

\subsection*{Osee 12}
\markright{OSEE 12}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} But Ephraim is an evil spirit, he has chased the east wind all the day: he has multiplied empty and vain things, and made a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil has gone in the way of traffic into Egypt. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And the Lord [has] a controversy with Juda, in order to punish Jacob: according to his ways and according to his practices will he recompense him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and in his labors he had power with God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And he prevailed with the angel and was strong: they wept, and entreated me: they found me in the house of On, and there [a word] was spoken to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} But the Lord God Almighty shall be his memorial. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} You therefore shall return to your God: keep you mercy and judgment, and draw near to your God continually. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} [As for] Chanaan, in his hand is a balance of unrighteousness: he has loved to tyrannize. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And Ephraim said, Nevertheless I am rich, I have found refreshment to myself. None of his labors shall be found [available] to him, by reason of the sins which he has committed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} But I the Lord your God brought you up out of the land of Egypt: I will yet cause you to dwell in tabernacles, according to the days of the feast. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And I will speak to the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and by the means of the prophets I was represented. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} If Galaad exists not, then the chiefs in Galaad when they sacrificed were false, and their altars were as heaps on the ground of the field. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And Jacob retreated into the plain of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and waited for a wife. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And the Lord brought Israel out of the land of Egypt by a prophet, and by a prophet was he preserve. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Ephraim was angry and excited, therefore his blood shall be poured out upon him, and the Lord shall recompense to him his reproach.\par

\subsection*{Osee 13}
\markright{OSEE 13}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} According to the word of Ephraim he adopted ordinances for himself in Israel; and he established them for Baal, and died. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And now they have sinned increasingly, and have made for themselves a molten image of their silver, according to the fashion of idols, the work of artificers accomplished for them: they say, Sacrifice men, for the calves have come to an end. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Therefore shall they be as a morning cloud, and as the early dew that passes away, as chaff blown away from the threshing floor, and as a vapor from tears. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} But I am the Lord your God that establishes the heaven, and creates the earth, whose hands have framed the whole host of heaven: but I showed them not to you that you should go after them: and I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and you shall know no God but me; and there is no Saviour beside me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} I tended you as a shepherd in the wilderness, in an uninhabited land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} According to their pastures, so they were completely filled; and their hearts were exalted; therefore they forgot me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I will be to them as a panther, and as a leopard. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I will meet them by the way of the Assyrians, as a she-bear excited, and I will rend the caul of their heart, and the lions' whelps of the thicket shall devour them there; the wild beasts of the field shall rend them in pieces. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} O Israel, who will aid [you] in your destruction? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Where is this your king? let him even save you in all your cities: let him judge you, of whom you said, Give me a king and a prince. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And I gave you a king in my anger, and kept [him] back in my wrath. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Ephraim [has framed] a conspiracy of unrighteousness, his sin is hidden. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Pains as of a woman in travail shall come upon him: he is your wise son, because he shall not stay in the destruction of [your] children. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} I will deliver [them] out of the power of Hades, and will redeem them from death: where is your penalty, O death? O Hades, where is your sting? comfort is hidden from my eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Forasmuch as he will cause a division among [his] brethren, the Lord shall bring upon him an east wind from the desert, and shall dry up his veins [and] quite drain his fountains: he shall dry up his land, and [spoil] all his precious vessels.\par

\subsection*{Osee 14}
\markright{OSEE 14}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Samaria shall be utterly destroyed: for she has resisted her God; they shall fall by the sword, and their sucklings shall be dashed against the ground, and their women with child ripped up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Return, O Israel, to the Lord your God; for the people have fallen through your iniquities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Take with you words, and turn to the Lord your God: speak to him, that you⌃ may not receive [the reward of] unrighteousness, but that you⌃ may receive good things: and we will render in return the fruit of our lips. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Assur shall never save us; we will not mount on horseback; we will no longer say to the works of our hands, Our gods. He who is in you shall pity the orphan. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} I will restore their dwellings, I will love them truly: for he has turned away my wrath from him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} I will be as dew to Israel: he shall bloom as the lily, and cast forth his roots as Libanus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} His branches shall spread, and he shall be as a fruitful olive, and his smell shall be as [the smell] of Libanus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} They shall return, and dwell under his shadow: they shall live and be satisfied with corn, and he shall flower as a vine: his memorial shall be to Ephraim as the wine of Libanus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} What [has] he to do any more with idols? I have afflicted him, and I will strengthen him: I am as a leafy juniper tree. From me is your fruit found. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Who is wise, and will understand these things? or prudent, and will know them? for the ways of the Lord are straight, and the righteous shall walk in them: but the ungodly shall fall therein.\par

\section*{Joel Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} Joel\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} The book names Joel; conservative scholarship receives the prophecy as Joel's own.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} Acts 2 cites Joel 2 explicitly as Joel's prophecy.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} date debated; conservative options range from early monarchy to post-exilic\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} MT preserves Joel as a compact prophetic book centered on locust judgment and the day of the LORD.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} The LXX preserves the same message and is especially important because Acts quotes Joel through the Greek tradition.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Prophecy of judgment and restoration centered on the day of the LORD.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To call God's people to repentance and announce future outpouring, judgment, and restoration.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} day of the LORD; repentance; Spirit outpouring; restoration; nations\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Locust crisis and call to repent 1-2; Spirit outpouring and final judgment 2-3.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Qumran Joel fragments survive Second Temple period | Subst. Early Hebrew witness survives in fragmentary form Second Temple period | Heb. Leningrad Codex AD 1008 | Gk. Codex Vaticanus and Alexandrinus preserve Greek Joel 4th-5th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Explicitly cited in the NT by Peter (1st century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} Joel is especially important for LXX/NT quotation study because Acts 2 cites Joel in Greek form.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives Joel as the real prophet behind the book and the Pentecost citation as confirmation of its prophetic authority.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

Have such things happen in your days, or in the days of your fathers? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Tell your children concerning them, and [let] your children [tell] their children, and their children another generation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} The leavings of the caterpillar has the locust eaten, and the leavings of the locust has the palmerworm eaten, and the leavings of the palmerworm has the cankerworm eaten. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Awake, you⌃ drunkards, from your wine, and weep: mourn, all you⌃ that drink wine to drunkenness: for joy and gladness and removed are from your mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} For a strong and innumerable nation is come up against my land, their teeth are lion's teeth, and their back teeth those of a [lion's] whelp. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} He has ruined my vine, and utterly broken my fig-trees: he has utterly searched [my vine], and cast it down; for the harvest has perished from off the field. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} The vine is dried up, and the fig-trees are become few; the pomegranate, and palm tree, and apple, and all trees of the field are dried up: for the sons of men have have abolished joy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Gird yourselves [with sackcloth], and lament, you⌃ priests: mourn, you⌃ that serve at the altar: go in, sleep in sackcloths, you⌃ that minister to God: for the meat-offering and drink-offering are withheld from the house of your God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Sanctify a fast, proclaim a [solemn] service, gather the elders [and] all the inhabitants of the land into the house of your God, and cry earnestly to the Lord, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Alas, Alas, Alas for the day! for the day of the Lord is near, and it will come as trouble upon trouble. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} [Your] meat has been destroyed before your eyes, joy and gladness from out of the house of your God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} The heifers have started at their mangers, the treasures are abolished, the wine presses are broken down; \subsection*{Joel 2}
\markright{JOEL 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Sound the trumpet in Sion, make a proclamation in my holy mountain, and let all the inhabitants of the land be confounded: \subsection*{Joel 3}
\markright{JOEL 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} For, behold, in those days and at that time, when I shall have turned the captivity of Juda and Jerusalem, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} I will also gather all the Gentiles, and bring them down to the valley of Josaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and my heritage Israel, who have been dispersed among the Gentiles; and [these Gentiles] have divided my land, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and cast lots over my people, and have given [their] boys to harlots, and sold [their] girls for wine, and have drunk. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And what have you⌃ to do with me, O Tyre, and Sidon, and all Galilee of the Gentiles? do you⌃ render me a recompense? or do you⌃ bear malice against me? quickly and speedily will I return your recompense on your own heads: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} because you⌃ have taken my silver and my gold, and you⌃ have brought my choice ornaments into your temples; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} and you⌃ have sold the children of Juda and the children of Jerusalem to the children of the Greeks, that you⌃ might expel them from their coasts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Therefore, behold, I [will] raise them up out of the place whither you⌃ have sold them, and I will return your recompense on your own heads. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And I will sell your sons and your daughters into the hands of the children of Juda, and they shall sell them into captivity to a far distant nation: for the Lord has spoken [it]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Proclaim these things among the Gentiles; declare war, arouse the warriors, draw near and go up, all you⌃ men of war. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Beat your plowshares into swords, and your sickles into spears: let the weak say, I am strong. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Gather yourselves together, and go in, all you⌃ nations round about, and gather yourselves there; let the timid become a warrior. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Let them be aroused, let all the nations go up to the valley of Josaphat: for there will I sit to judge all the Gentiles round about. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Bring forth the sickles, for the vintage is come: go in, tread [the grapes], for the press is full: cause the vats to overflow; for their wickedness is multiplied. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Noises have resounded in the valley of judgment: for the day of the Lord is near in the valley of judgment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} The sun and the moon shall be darkened, and the stars shall withdraw their light. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And the Lord shall cry out of Sion, and shall utter his voice from Jerusalem; and the heaven and the earth shall be shaken, but the Lord shall spare his people, and shall strengthen the children of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And you⌃ shall know that I am the Lord your God, who dwell in Sion my holy mountain: and Jerusalem shall be holy, and strangers shall not pass through her anymore. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And it shall come to pass in that day [that] the mountains shall drop sweet wine, and the hills shall flow with milk, and all the fountains of Juda shall flow with water, and a fountain shall go forth of the house of the Lord, and water the valley of flags. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Egypt shall be a desolation, and Idumea shall be a desolate plain, because of the wrongs of the children of Juda, because they have shed righteous blood in their land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But Judea shall be inhabited for ever, and Jerusalem to all generations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And I will make inquisition for their blood, and will by no means leave it unavenged: and the Lord shall dwell in Sion.\par

\section*{Amos Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} Amos\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} The book names Amos the herdsman-prophet from Tekoa.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} Acts 7:42-43 and James 9:11-12 cite Amos as prophetic Scripture.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} 8th century BC\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} MT chronology places Amos in the prosperous but corrupt northern kingdom before Samaria's fall.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} The LXX preserves the same setting and is important for the wording used in Acts 15.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Northern kingdom prophecy from a Judean herdsman in a time of social injustice and false security.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To denounce covenant injustice and announce judgment while preserving hope for David's fallen booth.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} justice; judgment; nations; false worship; remnant; Davidic restoration\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Judgment on nations and Israel 1-6; visions and confrontation 7-9.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Qumran Amos fragments survive Second Temple period | Subst. Early Hebrew witness survives in fragmentary form Second Temple period | Heb. Leningrad Codex AD 1008 | Gk. Codex Vaticanus and Alexandrinus preserve Greek Amos 4th-5th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Explicit NT citation by Stephen and James (1st century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} Amos is a key book for LXX/NT comparison because Acts 15 quotes Amos 9 in a form closer to the Greek tradition.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives Amos as the named prophet and his social-justice oracles as covenantal, not merely political, preaching.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{Amos}
\markboth{AMOS}{}
\subsection*{Amos 1}
\markright{AMOS 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The words of Amos which came [to him] in Accarim out of Thecue, which he saw concerning Jerusalem, in the days of Ozias king of Juda, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joas king of Israel, two years before the earthquake. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And he said, The Lord has spoken out of Sion, and has uttered his voice out of Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds have mourned, and the top of Carmel is dried up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And the Lord said, For three sins of Damascus, and for four, I will not turn away from it; because they sawed with iron saws the women with child of the Galaadites. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And I will send a fire on the house of Azael, and it shall devour the foundations of the son of Ader. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And I will break to pieces the bars of Damascus, and will destroy the inhabitants out of the plain of On, and will cut in pieces a tribe out of the men of Charrhan: and the famous people of Syria shall be led captive, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Thus says the Lord; For three sins of Gaza, and for four, I will not turn away from them; because they took prisoners the captivity of Solomon, to shut [them] up into Idumea. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I will send forth a fire on the walls of Gaza, and it shall devour its foundations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And I will destroy the inhabitants out of Azotus, and a tribe shall be cut off from Ascalon, and I will stretch out my hand upon Accaron: and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Thus says the Lord; For three transgressions of Tyre, and for four, I will not turn away from it; because they shut up the prisoners of Solomon into Idumea, and remembered not the covenant of brethren. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And I will send forth a fire on the walls of Tyre, and it shall devour the foundations of it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Thus says the Lord; For three sins of Idumea, and for four, I will not turn away from them; because they pursued their brother with the sword, and destroyed the mother upon the earth, and summoned up his anger for a testimony, and kept up his fury to the end. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And I will send forth a fire upon Thaman, and it shall devour the foundations of her walls. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Thus says the Lord; For three sins of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not turn away from him; because they ripped up the women with child of the Galaadites, that they might widen their coasts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And I will kindle a fire on the walls of Rabbath, and it shall devour her foundations with shouting in the day of war, and she shall be shaken in the days of her destruction: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} and her kings shall go into captivity, their priests and their rulers together, says the Lord.\par

\subsection*{Amos 2}
\markright{AMOS 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Thus says the Lord; For three sins of Moab, and for four, I will not turn away from it; because they burnt the bones of the king of Idumea to lime. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} But I will send forth a fire on Moab, and it shall devour the foundations of its cities: and Moab shall perish in weakness, with a shout, and with the sound of a trumpet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I will destroy the judge out of her, and kill all her princes with him, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Thus says the Lord; For three sins of the children of Judah, and for four, I will not turn away from him; because they have rejected the law of the Lord, and have not kept his ordinances, and their vain [idols] which they made, which their fathers followed, caused them to err. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And I will send a fire on Juda, and it shall devour the foundations of Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Thus says the Lord; for three sins of Israel, and for four, I will not turn away from him; because they sold the righteous for silver, and the poor for sandals, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} wherewith to tread on the dust of the earth, and they have struck upon the heads of the poor, and have perverted the way of the lowly: and a son and his father have gone into the same maid, that they might profane the name of their God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And binding their clothes with cords they have made them curtains near the altar, and they have drunk wine gained by extortion in the house of their God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Nevertheless I cut off the Amorite from before them, whose height was as the height of a cedar, and he was strong as an oak; and I dried up his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And I brought you up out of the land of Egypt, and led you about in the desert forty years, that you⌃ should inherit the land of the Amorites. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And I took of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for consecration. Are not these things so, you⌃ sons of Israel? says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} But you⌃ gave the consecrated ones wine to drink; and you⌃ commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Therefore, behold, I roll under you, as a wagon full of straw is rolled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And flight shall perish from the runner, and the strong shall not hold fast his strength, and the warrior shall not save his life: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} and the archer shall not withstand, and he that is swift of foot shall in no wise escape; and the horseman shall not save his life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And the strong shall find no confidence in power: the naked shall flee away in that day, says the Lord.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} For three, ; Num. 22:1-25:18; of Moab, 15:1-16:14; because \textsuperscript{4} For, Judah; , because; , ; and their, ;, ; after \textsuperscript{6} Thus saith Amos, says Abp. Newcome, first prophesies against the Syrians, Philistines, Tyrians, Edomites, Ammonites, and Moabites, who dwelt in the neighbourhood of the twelve tribes, and had occasionally become their enemies and persecutors. Having thus taught his countrymen that the providence of God extended to other nations, he briefly mentions the idolatrous practices and consequent destruction of Judah, and then passes on to his proper subject, which was to exhort and reprove the kingdom of Israel, and to denounce against it the Divine judgments. \subsection*{Amos 3}
\markright{AMOS 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Hear you⌃ this word, O house of Israel, which the Lord has spoken concerning you, and against the whole family whom I brought up out of the land of Egypt, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} You especially have I known out of all the families of the earth: therefore will I take vengeance upon you for all your sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Shall two walk together at all, if they do not know one another? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Will a lion roar out of his thicket if he has no prey? will a [lion's] whelp utter his voice at all out of his lair, if he have taken nothing? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Will a bird fall on the earth without a fowler? will a snare be taken up from the earth without having taken anything? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Shall the trumpet sound in the city, and the people not be alarmed? shall there be evil in a city which the Lord has not wrought? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For the Lord God will do nothing, without revealing instruction to his servants the prophets. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} A lion shall roar, and who will not be alarmed? the Lord God has spoken, and who will not prophesy? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Proclaim it to the regions among the Assyrians, and to the regions of Egypt, and say, Gather yourselves to the mountain of Samaria, and behold many wonderful things in the midst of it, and the oppression that is in it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And she knew not what things would come against her, says the Lord, [even] those that store up wrong and misery in their countries. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Therefore thus says the Lord God; O Tyre, your land shall be made desolate round about [you]; and he shall bring down your strength out of you, and your countries shall be spoiled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Thus says the Lord; As when a shepherd rescues from the mouth of a lion two legs or a piece of an ear, so shall be drawn forth the children of Israel who dwell in Samaria in the presence of [a foreign] tribe, and in Damascus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Hear, O you⌃ priests, and testify to the house of Jacob, says the Lord God Almighty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For in the day wherein I shall take vengeance of the sins of Israel upon him, I will also take vengeance on the altars of Bethel: and the horns of the altar shall be broken down, and they shall fall upon the ground. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} I will crush and strike the turreted-house upon the summer-house; and the ivory-houses shall be destroyed, and many other houses also, says the Lord.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{3} Gk. vocab: symphōnia (συμφωνία) = agreement; harmony. Common English renderings: agreement. Literally a sounding together, hence harmony or agreement.\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} only;, ; all; therefore; punish Heb. visit upon, *marg. \textsuperscript{4} a lion; cry Heb. give forth his voice \textsuperscript{6} a trumpet; and the people; be afraid or, run together shall there That is, Shall there be any evil, or calamity (not moral evil), inflicted on a wicked city, which does not proceed from me, as the effect of my wrath? \subsection*{Amos 4}
\markright{AMOS 4}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Hear you⌃ this word, you⌃ heifers of the land of Basan that are in the mountain of Samaria, that oppress the poor, and trample on the needy, which say to their masters, Give us that we may drink. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The Lord swears by his holiness, that, behold, the days come upon you, when they shall take you with weapons, and fiery destroyers shall cast those with you into boiling caldrons. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And you⌃ shall be brought forth naked in the presence of each other; and you⌃ shall be cast forth on the mountain Romman, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} You⌃ went into Bethel, and sinned, and you⌃ multiplied sin at Galgala; and you⌃ brought your meat-offerings in the morning, [and] your tithes every third day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And they read the law without, and called for public professions: proclaim aloud that the children of Israel have loved these things, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And I will give you dullness of teeth in all your cities, and lack of bread in all your places: yet you⌃ returned not to me, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Also I withheld from you the rain three months before the harvest: and I will rain upon one city, and on another city I will not rain: one part shall be rained upon, and the part on which I shall not rain shall be dried up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And [the inhabitants of] two or three cities shall be gathered to one city to drink water, and they shall not be satisfied: yet you⌃ have not returned to me, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} I struck you with parching, and with blight: you⌃ multiplied your gardens, your vineyards, and your fig-grounds, and the cankerworm devoured your olive yards: yet not [even] thus did you⌃ return to me, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} I sent pestilence among you by the way of Egypt, and killed your young men with the sword, together with your horses that were taken captive; and in my wrath against you I set fire to your camps: yet not even thus did you⌃ return to me, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} I overthrew you, as God overthrew Sodoma and Gomorrha, and you⌃ became as a brand plucked out of the fire: yet not even thus did you⌃ return to me, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Therefore thus will I do to you, O Israel: nay because I will do thus to you, prepare to call on your God, O Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} For, behold, I am he that strengthens the thunder, and creates the wind, and proclaims to men his Christ, forming the morning and the darkness, and mounting on the high places of the earth, The Lord God Almighty is his name.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} ye kine By the "kine of Bashan, " some understand the proud, luxurious matrons of Israel; but it is probable the prophet speaks catachrestically, and means the wealthy, effeminate, and profligate rulers and nobles of Samaria.; the mountain; which oppress, ; , ; crush; *marg. Bring \textsuperscript{3} ye shall go; them into the palace or, away the things of the palace \textsuperscript{4} Come A bitter irony and sarcasm, addressed to the idolatrous Israelites.; at Gilgal;, and bring and your, three years Heb. three years of days \textsuperscript{5} offer a sacrifice Heb. offer by burning, proclaim; for; this liketh you Heb. so ye love \textsuperscript{6} cleanness From want of food, occasioned by severe famine. and want; yet \textsuperscript{7} I have, ; , ; when; and I, ; and the \textsuperscript{9} with; when etc. or, the multitude of your gardens, etc. did the palmer worm, etc the palmerworm; yet \textsuperscript{10} pestilence, ;, ; after the manner or, in the way your young;, and have taken away your horses Heb. with the captivity of your horses, the stink;, ; yet \textsuperscript{11} as God; as a; yet \textsuperscript{13} he that This is a most powerful description of the majesty of Jehovah, the God of hosts.; and createth; wind or, spirit, and declareth; that maketh; and treadeth; The Lord\par}

\subsection*{Amos 5}
\markright{AMOS 5}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Hear you⌃ this word of the Lord, even a lamentation, which I take up against you. The house of Israel is fallen; it shall no more rise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The virgin of Israel has fallen upon his land; there is none that shall raise her up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Therefore thus says the Lord God; The city out of which there went forth a thousand, [in it] there shall be left one hundred, and [in that] out of which there went forth one hundred, there shall be left ten to the house of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Therefore thus says the Lord to the house of Israel, Seek you⌃ me, and you⌃ shall live. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} But seek not Bethel, and go not into Galgala, and cross not over to the Well of the Oath: for Galgala shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall be as that which is not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Seek you⌃ the Lord, and you⌃ shall live; lest the house of Joseph blaze as fire, and it devour him, and there shall be none to quench it for the house of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} [It is he] that executes judgment in the height [above], and he has established justice on the earth: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} who makes all things, and changes [them], and turns darkness into the morning, and darkens the day into night: who calls for the water of the sea, and pours it out on the face of the earth: the Lord is his name: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} who dispenses ruin to strength, and brings distress upon the fortress. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} They hated him that reproved in the gates, and abhorred holy speech. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Therefore because they have struck the poor with their fists, and you⌃ have received of them choice gifts; you⌃ have built polished houses, but you⌃ shall not dwell in them; you⌃ have planted desirable vineyards, but you⌃ shall not drink the wine of them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For I know your many transgressions, and your sins are great, trampling on the just, taking bribes, and turning aside [the judgment of] the poor in the gates. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Therefore the prudent shall be silent at that time; for it is a time of evils. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Seek good, and not evil, that you⌃ may live: and so the Lord God Almighty shall be with you, as you⌃ have said, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} We have hated evil, and loved good: and restore you⌃ judgment in the gates; that the Lord God Almighty may have mercy on the remnant of Joseph. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Therefore thus says the Lord God Almighty; In all the streets [shall be] lamentations; and in all the ways shall it be said, Woe, woe! the husbandman shall be called to mourning and lamentation, and to them that are skilled in complaining. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And [there shall be] lamentation in all the ways; because I will pass through the midst of you, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Woe to you that desire the day of the Lord! what is this day of the Lord to you? whereas it is darkness, and not light. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} As if a man should flee from the face of a lion, and a bear should meet him; and he should spring into his house, and lean his hands upon the wall, and a serpent should bite him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Is not the day of the Lord darkness, and not light? and is not this [day] gloom without brightness? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} I hate, I reject your feasts, and I will not smell [your] meat-offerings in your general assemblies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Therefore if you⌃ should bring me your whole burnt sacrifices and meat-offerings, I will not accept [them]: neither will I have respect to your grand peace-offerings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Remove from me the sound of your songs, and I will not hear the music of your instruments. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} But let judgment roll down as water, and righteousness as an impassable torrent. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Have you⌃ offered to me victims and sacrifices, O house of Israel, forty years in the wilderness? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Yes, you⌃ took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Raephan, the images of them which you⌃ made for yourselves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And I will carry you away beyond Damascus, says the Lord, the Almighty God is his name.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} virgin; is fallen; she shall, ; she is none \textsuperscript{5} seek;, Beersheba; Gilgal There is a paronomasia here, both on the letters and words: hag gilgal galoh yigleh oovaith el yiheyeh leawen "Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Beth-el (the house of God) shall come to nought, " or Aven, i.e., Beth-aven, the house of iniquity. and Bethel; , come \textsuperscript{6} Seek; lest the house; there \textsuperscript{8} maketh, and turneth; maketh; that calleth; The Lord \textsuperscript{11} treading; ye have built; pleasant vineyards Heb. vineyards of desire \textsuperscript{12} I know; manifold; they afflict; take; bribe or, ransom and they; in the \textsuperscript{15} Hate, ; establish, ; it may; the remnant \textsuperscript{18} desire; the day of the Lord is \textsuperscript{19} As if They should go from one evil to another. \textsuperscript{21} hate, ; I will; smell in your solemn assemblies or, smell your holy days \textsuperscript{22} offer; peace offerings or, thank offerings \textsuperscript{26} the tabernacle of your Moloch or, Siccuth your king, ; Milcom\par}

\subsection*{Amos 6}
\markright{AMOS 6}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Woe to them that set at nothing Sion, and that trust in the mountain of Samaria: they have gathered [the harvest of] the heads of the nations, and they have gone in themselves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} O house of Israel, pass by all [of you], and see; and pass by thence to Ematrabba; and thence descend to Geth of the Philistines, the chief of all these kingdoms, [see] if their coasts are greater than your coasts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} You⌃ who are approaching the evil day, who are drawing near and adopting false sabbaths; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} who sleep upon beds of ivory, and live delicately on their couches, and eat kids out of the flocks, and sucking calves out of the midst of the stalls; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} who excel in the sound of musical instruments; they have regarded them as dwelling, not as fleeting [pleasures]; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} who drink strained wine, and anoint themselves with the best ointment; and have suffered nothing on occasion of the calamity of Joseph. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Therefore now shall they depart into captivity from the dominion of princes, and the neighing of horses shall be cut off from Ephraim. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For the Lord has sworn by himself, [saying], Because I abhor all the pride of Jacob, I do also hate his countries, and I will cut off [his] city with all who inhabit it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And it shall come to pass, if there be ten men left in one house, that they shall die. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} But a remnant shall be left behind, and their relations shall take them, and shall strenuously endeavor to carry forth their bones from the house: and one shall say to the heads of the house, Is there yet [any one] else with you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And he shall say, No [one] else.
