\subsection*{Habakkuk 2}
\markright{HABAKKUK 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} I will stand upon my watch, and mount upon the rock, and watch to see what he will say by me, and what I shall answer when I am reproved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And the Lord answered me and said, Write the vision, and [that] plainly on a tablet, that he that reads it may run. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For the vision [is] yet for a time, and it shall shoot forth at the end, and not in vain: though he should wait, wait for him; for he will surely come, and will not wait. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} If he should draw back, my soul has no pleasure in him: but the just shall live by my faith. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} But the arrogant man and the scorner, the boastful man, shall not finish anything; who has enlarged his desire as the grave, and like death he is never satisfied, and he will gather to himself all the nations, and will receive to himself all the peoples. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Shall not all these take up a parable against him? and a proverb to tell against him? and they shall say, Woe to him that multiplies to himself the possessions which are not his! how long? and who heavily loads his yoke. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For suddenly there shall arise up those that bite him, and they that plot against you shall awake, and you shall be a plunder to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Because you have spoiled many nations, all the nations that are left shall spoil [you], because of the blood of men, and the sins of the land and city, and of all that dwell in it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Woe to him that covets an evil covetousness to his house, that he may set his nest on high, that he may be delivered from the power of evils. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} You have devised shame to your house, you have utterly destroyed many nations, and your soul has sinned. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beetle out of the timber shall speak. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Woe to him that builds a city with blood, and establishes a city by unrighteousness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Are not these things of the Lord Almighty? surely many people have been exhausted in the fire, and many nations have fainted. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord; it shall cover them as water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Woe to him that gives his neighbor to drink the thick lees [of wine], and intoxicates [him], that he may look upon their secret parts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Drink you also [your] fill of disgrace instead of glory: shake, O heart, and quake, the cup of the right hand of the Lord has come round upon you, and dishonor has gathered upon your glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For the ungodliness of Libanus shall cover you, and distress because of wild beasts shall dismay you, because of the blood of men, and the sins of the land and city, and of all that dwell in it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} What profit it the graven image, that they have graven it? [one] has made it a molten work, a false image; for the maker has trusted in his work, to make dumb idols. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Woe to him that says to the wood, Awake, arise; and to the stone, Be you exalted! whereas it is an image, and this is a casting of gold and silver, and there is no breath in it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But the Lord is in his holy temple: let all the earth fear before him.\par

\subsection*{Habakkuk 3}
\markright{HABAKKUK 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} A PRAYER OF THE PROPHET AMBACUM, WITH A SONG. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} O Lord, I have heard your report, and was afraid: I considered your works, and was amazed: you shall be known between the two living creatures, you shall be acknowledged when the years draw near; you shall be manifested when the time is come; when my soul is troubled, you will in wrath remember mercy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} God shall come from Thaeman, and the Holy One from the dark shady mount Pharan. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} His excellence covered the heavens, and the earth was full of his praise. And his brightness shall be as light; [there were] horns in his hands, and he caused a mighty love of his strength. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Before his face shall go a report, and it shall go forth into the plains, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} the earth stood at his feet and trembled: he looked, and the nations melted away: the mountains were violently burst through, the everlasting hills melted at his everlasting going forth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Because of troubles I looked upon the tents of the Ethiopians: the tabernacles also of the land of Madiam shall be dismayed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Was you angry, O Lord, with the rivers? or [was] your wrath against the rivers, or your anger against the sea? for you will mount on your horses, and your chariots are salvation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Surely you did bend they bow at scepters, says the Lord. Pause. The land of rivers shall be torn asunder. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} The nations shall see you and be in pain, [as you do] divide the moving waters: the deep uttered her voice, and raised her form on high. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} The sun was exalted, and the moon stood still in her course: your darts shall go forth at the light, at the brightness of the gleaming of your arms. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} You will bring low the land with threatening, and in wrath you will break down the nations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} You went forth for the salvation of your people, to save your anointed: you shall bring death on the heads of transgressors; you have brought bands upon [their] neck. Pause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} You did cut asunder the heads of princes with amazement, they shall tremble in it; they shall burst their bridles, [they shall be] as a poor man devouring in secret. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And you do cause your horses to enter the sea, disturbing much water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} I watched, and my belly trembled at the sound of the prayer of my lips, and trembling entered into my bones, and my frame was troubled within me; I will rest in the day of affliction, from going up to the people of my sojourning. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For [though] the fig tree shall bear no fruit, and there shall be no produce on the vines; the labor of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall produce no food: the sheep have failed from the pasture, and there are no oxen at the cribs; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} yet I will exult in the Lord, I will joy in God my Saviour. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} The Lord God is my strength, and he will perfectly strengthen my feet; he mounts me upon high places, that I may conquer by his song.\par

\section*{Zephaniah Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} Zephaniah\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} The book names Zephaniah son of Cushi with royal lineage details and is received as his prophecy.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} No direct NT attribution names the writer, but Zephaniah belongs to the authenticated prophetic corpus.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} late 7th century BC in Josiah's days\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} MT chronology places Zephaniah in Josiah's reign before the reform fully took hold.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} The LXX preserves the same pre-exilic setting and message of the day of the LORD.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Judah-focused prophecy of the coming day of the LORD, judgment, and purified restoration.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To warn of the coming day of the LORD and promise a purified remnant and restored worship.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} day of the LORD; remnant; judgment; restoration; humility\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Judgment on Judah and nations 1-2; Woe and restoration 3.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Qumran Zephaniah fragments survive Second Temple period | Subst. Early Hebrew witness is fragmentary Second Temple period | Heb. Leningrad Codex AD 1008 | Gk. Codex Vaticanus and Alexandrinus preserve Greek Zephaniah 4th-5th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Use in later prophetic interpretation by Multiple (later biblical and post-biblical reception)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} Zephaniah's compact structure makes its day-of-the-LORD theology especially important for intertextual study.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives Zephaniah as the named prophet in Josiah's era and reads its warnings and promises as historically grounded prophecy.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{Sophonias}
\markboth{SOPHONIAS}{}
\subsection*{Sophonias 1}
\markright{SOPHONIAS 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The word of the Lord which came to Sophonias the son of Chusi, the son of Godolias, the son of Amorias, the son of Ezekias, in the days of Josias son of Amon, king of Juda. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Let there be an utter cutting off from the face of the land, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Let man and cattle be cut off; let the birds of the air and the fishes of the sea be cut off; and the ungodly shall fail, and I will take away the transgressors from the face of the land, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And I will stretch out my hand upon Juda, and upon all the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and I will remove the names of Baal out of this place, and the names of the priests; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} and them that worship the host of heaven upon the housetops; and them that worship and swear by the Lord, and them that swear by their king; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} and them that turn aside from the Lord, and them that seek not the Lord, and them that cleave not to the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Fear you⌃ before the Lord God; for the day of the Lord is near; for the Lord has prepared his sacrifice, and has sanctified his guests. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And it shall come to pass in the day of the Lord's sacrifice, that I will take vengeance on the princes, and on the king's house, and upon all that wear strange apparel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And I will openly take vengeance on the porches in that day, [on the men] that fill the house of the Lord their God with ungodliness and deceit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And there shall be in that day, says the Lord, the sound of a cry from the gate of men slaying, and a howling from the second [gate], and a great crashing from the hills. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Lament, you⌃ that inhabit the [city] that has been broken down, for all the people has become like Chanaan; and all that were exalted by silver have been utterly destroyed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And it shall come to pass in that day, [that] I will search Jerusalem with a candle, and will take vengeance on the men that despise the things committed to them; but they say in their hearts, The Lord will not do any good, neither will he do any evil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And their power shall be for a spoil, and their houses for utter desolation; and they shall build houses, but shall not dwell in them; and they shall plant vineyards, but shall not drink the wine of them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For the great day of the Lord [is] near, [it is] near, and very speedy; the sound of the day of the Lord is made bitter and harsh. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} A mighty day of wrath is that day, a day of affliction and distress, a day of desolation and destruction, a day of gloominess and darkness, a day of cloud and vapor, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} a day of the trumpet and cry against the strong cities, and against the high towers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And I will greatly afflict the men, and they shall walk as blind men, because they have sinned against the Lord; therefore he shall pour out their blood as dust, and their flesh as dung. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And their silver and their gold shall in nowise be able to rescue them in the day of the Lord's wrath; but the whole land shall be devoured by the fire of his jealously; for he will bring a speedy destruction on all them that inhabit the land.\par

\subsection*{Sophonias 2}
\markright{SOPHONIAS 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Be you⌃ gathered and closely joined together, O unchastened nation; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} before you⌃ become as the flower that passes away, before the anger of the Lord come upon you, before the day of the wrath of the Lord come upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Seek you⌃ the Lord, all you⌃ meek of the earth; do judgment, and seek justice, and answer accordingly; that you⌃ may be hid in the day of the wrath of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For Gaza shall be utterly spoiled, and Ascalon shall be destroyed; and Azotus shall be cast forth at noon-day, and Accaron shall be rooted up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Woe to them that dwell on the border of the sea, neighbors of the Cretans! the word of the Lord is against you, O Chanaan, land of the Philistines, and I will destroy you out of [your] dwelling-place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And Crete shall be a pasture of flocks, and a fold of sheep. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the sea cost shall be for the remnant of the house of Juda; they shall pasture upon them in the houses of Ascalon; they shall rest in the evening because of the children of Juda; for the Lord their God has visited them, and he will turn away their captivity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I have heard the revilings of Moab, and the insults of the children of Ammon, wherewith they have reviled my people, and magnified themselves against my coasts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Therefore, [as] I live, says the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, Moab shall be as Sodoma, and the children of Ammon as Gomorrha; and Damascus [shall be] left as a heap of the threshing floor, and desolate for ever: and the remnant of my people shall plunder them, and the remnant of my nations shall inherit them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} This is their punishment in return for their haughtiness, because they have reproached and magnified themselves against the Lord Almighty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} The Lord shall appear against them, and shall utterly destroy all the gods of the nations of the earth; and they shall worship him every one from his place, [even] all the islands of the nations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} You⌃ Ethiopians also are the slain of my sword. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And he shall stretch forth his hand against the north and destroy the Assyrian, and make Nineve a dry wilderness, [even] as a desert. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And flocks, and all the wild beasts of the land, and chameleons shall feed in the midst thereof: and hedgehogs shall lodge in the ceilings thereof; and wild beasts shall cry in the breaches thereof, and ravens in her porches, whereas her loftiness was [as] as cedar.\par

\subsection*{Sophonias 3}
\markright{SOPHONIAS 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} This is the scornful city that dwells securely, that says in her heart, I am, and there is no longer any [to be] after me: how is she become desolate, a habitation of wild beasts! every one that passes through her shall hiss, and shake his hands. Alas the glorious and ransomed city. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The dove listened not to the voice; she received not correction; she trusted not in the Lord, and she drew not near to her God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Her princes within her were as roaring lions, her judges as the wolves of Arabia; they remained not till the morrow. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Her prophets are light [and] scornful men: her priests profane the holy things, and sinfully transgress the law. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} But the just Lord is in the midst of her, and he will never do an unjust thing: morning by morning he will bring out his judgment to the light, and it is not hidden, and he knows not injustice by extortion, nor injustice in strife. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} I have brought down the proud with destruction; their corners are destroyed: I will make their ways completely waste, so that none shall go through: their cities are come to an end, by reason of no man living or dwelling [in them]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} I said, But do you⌃ fear me, and receive instruction, and you⌃ shall not be cut off from the face of the land [for] all the vengeance I have brought upon her: prepare you, rise early: all their produce is spoilt. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Therefore wait upon me, says the Lord, until the day when I rise up for a witness: because my judgment [shall be] on the gatherings of the nations, to draw to me kings, to pour out upon them all [my] fierce anger: for the whole earth shall be consumed with the fire of my jealousy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For then will I turn to the peoples a tongue for her generation, that all may call on the name of the Lord, to serve him under one yoke. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} From the boundaries of the rivers of Ethiopia will I receive my dispersed ones; they shall offer sacrifices to me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} In that day you shall not be ashamed of all your practices, wherein you have transgressed against me: for then will I take away from you your disdainful pride, and you shall no more magnify yourself upon my holy mountain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And I will leave in you a meek and lowly people; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} and the remnant of Israel shall fear the name of the Lord, and shall do no iniquity, neither shall they speak vanity; neither shall a deceitful tongue be found in their mouth: for they shall feed, and lie down, and there shall be none to terrify them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Rejoice, O daughter of Sion; cry aloud, O daughter of Jerusalem; rejoice and delight yourself with all your heart, O daughter of Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} The Lord has taken away your iniquities, he has ransomed you from the hand of your enemies: the Lord, the King of Israel, is in the midst of you: you shall not see evil any more. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} At that time the Lord shall say to Jerusalem, Be of good courage, Sion; let not your hands be slack. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} The Lord your God is in you; the Mighty One shall save you: he shall bring joy upon you, and shall refresh you with his love; and he shall rejoice over you with delight as in a day of feasting. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And I will gather your afflicted ones. Alas! who has taken up a reproach against her? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Behold, I [will] work in you for your sake at that time, says the Lord: and I will save her that was oppressed, and receive her that was rejected; and I will make them a praise, and honored in all the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And [their enemies] shall be ashamed at that time, when I shall deal well with you, and at the time when I shall receive you: for I will make you honored and a praise among all the nations of the earth, when I turn back your captivity before you, says the Lord.\par

\section*{Haggai Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} Haggai\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} The book names Haggai and dates its oracles precisely in the Persian period.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} Ezra 5-6 confirms Haggai's prophetic role in the rebuilding era.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} 520 BC\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} MT chronology places Haggai during the second year of Darius I amid temple rebuilding.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} The LXX preserves the same precisely dated post-exilic setting.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Short post-exilic prophecy urging temple rebuilding and covenant priority.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To call the restored community to rebuild the temple and expect future glory.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} temple; obedience; covenant priorities; latter glory; Zerubbabel\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Calls to rebuild 1; Promise of future glory and covenant blessing 2.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Qumran Haggai fragments survive Second Temple period | Subst. Early Hebrew witness is fragmentary Second Temple period | Heb. Leningrad Codex AD 1008 | Gk. Codex Vaticanus and Alexandrinus preserve Greek Haggai 4th-5th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Corroborated by Ezra's narrative by Ezra (Persian period narrative and later canon)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} Haggai is textually modest but historically valuable because of its precise dates and integration with Ezra.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives Haggai as precisely dated prophetic preaching in the restoration era.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{Aggaeus}
\markboth{AGGAEUS}{}
\subsection*{Aggaeus 1}
\markright{AGGAEUS 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, on the first [day] of the month, the word of the Lord came by the hand of the prophet Aggaeus, saying, Speak to Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, of the tribe of Juda, and to Jesus the son of Josedec, the high priest, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Thus says the Lord Almighty, saying, This people say, The time is not come to build the house of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And the word of the Lord came by the hand of the prophet Aggaeus, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Is it time for you to dwell in your ceiled houses, whereas our house is desolate? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And now thus says the Lord Almighty; Consider your ways, I pray you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} You⌃ have sown much, but brought in little; you⌃ have eaten, and are not satisfied; you⌃ have drunk, and are not satisfied with drink, you⌃ have clothed yourselves, and have not become warm thereby: and he that earns wages has gathered [them] into a bag full of holes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Thus says the Lord Almighty; Consider your ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Go up to the mountain, and cut timber; build the house, and I will take pleasure in it, and be glorified, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} You⌃ looked for much, and there came little; and it was brought into the house, and I blew it away. Therefore thus says the Lord Almighty, Because my house is desolate, and you⌃ run everyone into his own house; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} therefore shall the sky withhold dew, and the earth shall keep back her produce. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And I will bring a sword upon the land, and upon the mountains, and upon the corn, and upon the wine, and upon the oil, and all that the earth produces, and upon the men, and upon the cattle, and upon all the labors of their hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, of the tribe of Juda, and Jesus the son of Josedec, the high priest, and all the remnant of the people, listened to the voice of the Lord their God, and the words of the prophet Aggaeus, according as the Lord their God had sent him to them, and the people feared before the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And Aggaeus the Lord's messenger spoke among the messengers of the Lord to the people, [saying], I am with you, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And the Lord stirred up the spirit of Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, of the tribe of Juda, and the spirit of Jesus the son of Josedec, the high priest, and the spirit of the remnant of all the people; and they went in, and wrought in the house of the Lord Almighty their God, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} on the four and twentieth [day] of the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.\par

\subsection*{Aggaeus 2}
\markright{AGGAEUS 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} In the seventh month, on the twenty-first [day] of the month, the Lord spoke by Aggaeus the prophet, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Speak now to Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, of the tribe of Juda, and to Jesus the son of Josedec, the high priest, and to all the remnant of the people, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Who [is there] of you that saw this house in her former glory? and how do you⌃ now look upon it, as it were nothing before your eyes? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Yet now be strong, O Zorobabel, says the Lord; and strengthen yourself, O Jesus the high priest, the son of Josedec; and let all the people of the land strengthen themselves, says the Lord, and work, for I am with you, says the Lord Almighty; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} and my Spirit remains in the midst of you; be of good courage. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For thus says the Lord Almighty; Yet once I will shake the heaven, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry [land]; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} and I will shake all nations, and the choice [portions] of all the nations shall come: and I will fill this house with glory, says the Lord Almighty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Mine is the silver, and mine the gold, says the Lord Almighty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For the glory of this house shall be great, the latter more than the former, says the Lord Almighty: and in this place will I give peace, says the Lord Almighty, even peace of soul for a possession to every one that builds, to raise up this temple. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} On the four and twentieth [day] of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to Aggaeus the prophet, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Thus says the Lord Almighty; Inquire now of the priest [concerning] the law, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} If a man should take holy flesh in the skirt of his garment, and the skirt of his garment should touch bread, or pottage, or wine, or oil, or any meat, shall it be holy? And the priests answered and said, No. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And Aggaeus said, If a defiled person who is unclean by reason of a dead body, touch any of these, shall it be defiled? And the priests answered and said, It shall be defiled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And Aggaeus answered and said, So is this people, and so is this nation before me, says the Lord; and so are all the works of their hands: and whoever shall approach them, shall be defiled [because of their early burdens: they shall be pained because of their toils; and you⌃ have hated him that reproved in the gates]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And now consider, I pray you, from this day and beforetime, before they laid a stone on a stone in the temple of the Lord, what manner of men you⌃ were. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} When you⌃ cast into the corn-bin twenty measures of barley, and there were [only] ten measures of barley: and you⌃ went to the vat to draw out fifty measures, and there were [but] twenty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} I struck you with barrenness, and with blasting, and all the works of your hands with hail; yet you⌃ returned not to me, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Set your hearts now [to think] from this day and upward, from the four and twentieth [day] of the ninth month, even from the day when the foundation of the temple of the Lord was laid; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} consider in your hearts, whether [this] shall be known on the corn-floor, and whether yet the vine, and the fig tree, and the pomegranate, and the olive-trees that bear no fruit [are with you]: from this day will I bless [you]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And the word of the Lord came the second time to Aggaeus the prophet, on the four and twentieth [day] of the month, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Speak to Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, of the tribe of Juda, saying, I shake the heaven, and the earth, and the sea, and the dry [land]; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} and I will overthrow the thrones of kings, and I will destroy the power of the kings of the nations; and I will overthrow chariots and riders; and the horses and their riders shall come down, every one by the sword striving against his brother. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} In that day, says the Lord Almighty, I will take you, O Zorobabel, the son of Salathiel, my servant, says the Lord, and will make you as a seal: for I have chosen you, says the Lord Almighty.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{6} Yet; it is; and I \textsuperscript{7} I will shake; and the, ; I will fill \textsuperscript{9} glory; saith Whoever compares the description of the temple of Solomon, in the first book of Kings, with the most splendid accounts of the second temple, however adorned with costly stones and other magnificent decorations in after ages, must perceive that the former, being wholly overlaid with pure gold, was incomparably more glorious than the latter in its greatest magnificence; and the Jews themselves allow that the ark of the covenant, fire from heaven, the Urim and Thummim the anointing oil, the Shechinah or visible glory, and the spirit of prophecy, which distinguished the former temple, were wanting in this. In nothing, in fact, could the second temple excel the first in glory, except in the personal presence of "the Desire of all nations, " He who is "the glory of the Lord, " and the true temple, "in whom dwells all the fulness of the Godhead bodily, " and who was the true Shechinah of which that of Solomon's temple was merely a type. And if it be admitted that the presence of the promised Messiah was intended, then it will follow that "Jesus of Nazareth" was He; for the second temple, in which as the "Prince of peace" he preached peace and reconciliation with God, has been utterly destroyed for upwards of seventeen hundred years. give \textsuperscript{14} So is this people;, ; and that \textsuperscript{16} when one came to an \textsuperscript{17} with blasting; with hail; in all; yet \textsuperscript{22} overthrow;, ; and I will overthrow the chariots, ; every \textsuperscript{23} O Zerubbabel It seems evident that the Messiah is here described under the name of Zerubbabel, as elsewhere under that of David, whose kingdom, after these mighty convulsions, should supersede all others. and will; for\par}

\section*{Zechariah Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} Zechariah son of Berechiah son of Iddo\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} The book names Zechariah and dates much of its material in the Persian period; conservative scholarship typically receives the whole canonical book as Zechariah's prophecy.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} Jesus refers to Zechariah son of Berechiah in Matthew 23:35.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} 520-518 BC and after\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} MT chronology places Zechariah alongside Haggai in the restoration era, with later oracles extending beyond the initial temple work.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} The LXX preserves the same restoration-era framework, though the later chapters remain important for messianic quotation and textual study.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Post-exilic visions and oracles encouraging restoration and projecting messianic hope.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To encourage the restored community, call for repentance, and announce the coming king, shepherd, and future kingdom.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} visions; repentance; messianic king; shepherd; temple; future kingdom\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Night visions 1-6; Fasting and renewal 7-8; Messianic and eschatological oracles 9-14.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Qumran Zechariah fragments survive Second Temple period | Subst. Early Hebrew witness is fragmentary Second Temple period | Heb. Leningrad Codex AD 1008 | Gk. Codex Vaticanus and Alexandrinus preserve Greek Zechariah 4th-5th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Quoted/alluded to heavily in the NT by Multiple (1st century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} Zechariah is a major messianic quotation book, especially chapters 9-14, making MT/LXX comparison important in the passion narratives.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives Zechariah as the prophet named in the book and reads the later chapters as genuine predictive prophecy, not late anonymous additions.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{Zacharias}
\markboth{ZACHARIAS}{}
\subsection*{Zacharias 1}
\markright{ZACHARIAS 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} In the eighth month, in the second year of [the reign of] Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zacharias, the son of Barachias, the son of Addo, the prophet, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The Lord has been very angry with your fathers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And you shall say to them, Thus says the Lord Almighty: Turn to me, says the Lord of hosts, and I will turn to you, says the Lord of hosts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And be you⌃ not as your fathers, whom the prophets before charged, saying, Thus says the Lord Almighty: Turn you⌃ from your evil ways, and from your evil practices: but they listened not, and attended not to listen to me, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Where are your fathers, and the prophets? Will they live for ever? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} But do you⌃ receive my words and my ordinances, all that I command by my Spirit to my servants the prophets, who lived in the days of your fathers; and they answered and said, As the Lord Almighty determined to do to us, according to our ways, and according to our practices, so has he done to us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} On the twenty-fourth [day] in the eleventh month, this is the month Sabat, in the second year of [the reign of] Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zacharias, the son of Barachias, the son of Addo, the prophet, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I saw by night, and behold a man mounted on a red horse, and he stood between the shady mountains; and behind him were red horses, and grey, and piebald, and white. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And I said, What are these, [my] lord? And the angel spoke with me said to me, I will show you what these [things] are. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And the man that stood between the mountains answered, and said to me, These are [they] whom the Lord has sent forth to go round the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And they answered the angel of the Lord that stood between the mountains, and said, We have gone round all the earth, and, behold, all the earth is inhabited, and is at rest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Then the angel of the Lord answered and said, O Lord Almighty, how long will you have no mercy on Jerusalem, and the cities of Juda, which you have disregarded these seventy years? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And the Lord Almighty answered the angel that spoke with me good words and consolatory sayings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And the angel that spoke with me said to me, Cry out and say, Thus says the Lord Almighty; I have been jealous for Jerusalem and Sion with great jealousy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And I am very angry with the heathen that combine to attack [her]: forasmuch as I indeed was a little angry, but they combined to attack [her] for evil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Therefore thus says the Lord: I will return to Jerusalem with compassion; and my house shall be rebuilt in her, says the Lord Almighty, and a measuring line shall yet be stretched out over Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And the angel that spoke with me said to me, Cry yet, and say, Thus says the Lord Almighty; Yet shall cities be spread abroad through prosperity; and the Lord shall yet have mercy upon Sion, and shall choose Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold four horns. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And I said to the angel that spoke with me, What are these things, [my] lord? And he said to me, These are the horns that have scattered Juda, and Israel, and Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And the Lord showed me four artificers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And I said, What are these coming to do? And he said, These are the horns that scattered Juda, and they broke Israel in pieces, and none of them lifted up his head: and these are come forth to sharpen them for their hands, [even] the four horns, the nations that lifted up the horn against the land of the Lord to scatter it.\par

\subsection*{Zacharias 2}
\markright{ZACHARIAS 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And I lifted up my eyes, and looked, and behold a man, and in his hand a measuring line. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And I said to him, Whither go you? And he said to me, To measure Jerusalem, to see what is the breadth of it, and what is the length of it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And, behold, the angel that spoke with me stood [by], and another angel went forth to meet him, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} and spoke to him, saying, Run and speak to that young man, saying, Jerusalem shall be fully inhabited by reason of the abundance of men and cattle in the midst of her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And I will be to her, says the Lord, a wall of fire round about, and I will be for a glory in the midst of her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Ho, ho, flee from the land of the north, says the Lord: for I will gather you from the four winds of heaven, says the Lord, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} [even] to Sion: deliver yourselves, you⌃ that dwell [with] the daughter of Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For thus says the Lord Almighty; After the glory has he sent me to the nations that spoiled you: for he that touches you is as one that touches the apple of his eye. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For, behold, I bring my hand upon them, and they shall be a spoil to them that serve them: and you⌃ shall know that the Lord Almighty has sent me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Sion: for, behold, I come, and will dwell in the midst of you, says the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And many nations shall flee for refuge to the Lord in that day, and they shall be for a people to him, and they shall dwell in the midst of you: and you shall know that the Lord Almighty has sent me to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And the Lord shall inherit Juda his portion in the holy [land], and he will yet choose Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Let all flesh fear before the Lord: for he has risen up from his holy clouds.\par

\subsection*{Zacharias 3}
\markright{ZACHARIAS 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the Lord showed me Jesus the high priest standing before the angel of the Lord, and the Devil stood on his right hand to resist him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And the Lords said to the Devil, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} The Lord rebuke you, O Devil, even the Lord that has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you: behold! is not this as a brand plucked from the fire? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Now Jesus was clothed in filthy raiment, and stood before the angel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And [the Lord] answered and spoke to those who stood before him, saying, Take away the filthy raiment from him: and he said to him, Behold, I have taken away your iniquities: and clothe you⌃ him with a long robe, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} and place a pure mitre upon his head. So they placed a pure mitre upon his head, and clothed him with garments: and the angel of the Lord stood [by]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the angel of the Lord testified to Jesus, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Thus says the Lord Almighty; If you will walk in my ways, and take heed to my charges, then shall you judge my house: and if you will diligently keep my court, then will I give you men to walk in the midst of these that stand [here]. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Hear now, Jesus the high priest, you, and your neighbors that are sitting before [you]: for they are diviners, for, behold, I bring forth my servant The Branch. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For [as for] the stone which I have set before the face of Jesus, on the one stone are seven eyes: behold, I am digging a trench, says the Lord Almighty, and I will search out all the iniquity of that land in one day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} In that day, says the Lord Almighty, you⌃ shall call together every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.\par

\subsection*{Zacharias 4}
\markright{ZACHARIAS 4}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the angel that talked with me returned, and awakened me, as when a man is awakened out of his sleep. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And he said to me, What see you? And I said, I have seen, and behold a candlestick all of gold, and its bowl upon it, and seven lamps upon it, and seven oil funnels to the lamps upon it: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and two olive-trees above it, one on the right of the bowl, and one on the left. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And I inquired, and spoke to the angel that talked with me, saying, What are these things, [my] lord? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And the angel that talked with me answered, and spoke to me, saying, Know you not what these things are? And I said, No, [my] lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And he answered and spoke to me, saying, This is the word of the Lord to Zorobabel, saying, Not by mighty power, nor by strength, but by my Spirit, says the Lord Almighty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Who are you, the great mountain before Zorobabel, that you should prosper? whereas I will bring out the stone of the inheritance, the grace of it the equal of [my ] grace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The hands of Zorobabel have laid the foundation of this house, and his hands shall finish it: and you shall know that the Lord Almighty has sent me to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For who has despised the small days? surely they shall rejoice, and shall see the plummet of tin in the hand of Zorobabel: these are the seven eyes that look upon all the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And I answered, and said to him, What are these two olive-trees, which are on the right and left hand of the candlestick? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And I asked the second time, and said to him, What are the two branches of the olive-trees that are by the side of the two golden pipes that pour into and communicate with the golden oil funnels? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And he said to me, Know you not what these are? and I said, No, [my] lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And he said, These are the two anointed ones [that] stand by the Lord of the whole earth.\par

\subsection*{Zacharias 5}
\markright{ZACHARIAS 5}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And I turned, and lifted up my eyes, and looked and behold a flying sickle. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And he said to me, What see you? And I said, I see a flying sickle, of the length of twenty cubits, and of the breadth of ten cubits. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And he said to me, This is the curse that goes forth over the face of the whole earth: for every thief shall be punished with death on this side, and every false swearer shall be punished on that side. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And I will bring it forth, says the Lord Almighty, and it shall enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him that swears falsely by my name: and it shall rest in the midst of his house, and shall consume it, and the timber of it, and the stones of it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And the angel that talked with me went forth, and said to me, Lift up your eyes, and see this that goes forth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And I said, What is it? And he said, This is the measure that goes forth. And he said, This is their iniquity in all the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And behold a talent of lead lifted up: and behold a woman sat in the midst of the measure. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And he said, This is iniquity. And he cast it into the midst of the measure, and cast the weight of lead on the mouth of it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and, behold, two women coming forth, and the wind was in their wings; and they had stork's wings: and they lifted up the measure between the earth and the sky. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And I said to the angel that spoke with me, Whither do these carry away the measure? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And he said to me, To build it a house in the land of Babylon, and to prepare [a place for it]; and they shall set it there on its own base.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{3} the curse, ; the face every one etc. or, every one of this people that stealeth, holdeth himself guiltless, as it doth. stealeth.; sweareth \textsuperscript{6} This is an ephah "The meaning of this vision, " says Archbishop Newcome, "seems to be, that the Babylonish captivity had happened on account of the wickedness of the Jews, and that a like dispersion would befall them if they relapsed into like crimes." The woman who sat in the ephah was an emblem of the Jewish nation; the casting the weight of lead on the mouth of the ephah seems to mean the condemnation of the Jews, after they had filled up the measure of their iniquities by crucifying the Messiah; the "two women, with wings like a stork, and the wind in their wings, " seem emblematical of the Roman armies and the rapidity of their conquests; and their lifting up the ephah and carrying it through the air, to build it a house in Shinar or Babylon, where it was fixed on its own basis, represents the taking of Jerusalem, the dispersion of the Jews, and the long continuance of that calamity, as a just punishment of their unbelief. \textsuperscript{7} talent or, weighty piece, is; Hosea 1:1-3:5\par}

\subsection*{Zacharias 6}
\markright{ZACHARIAS 6}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And I turned, and lifted up my eyes, and looked, and, behold, four chariots coming out from between two mountains; and the mountains were brazen mountains. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} In the first chariot [were] red horses; and in the second chariot black horses; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} and in the third chariot white horses; and in the fourth chariot piebald [and] ash-colored horses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And I answered and said to the angel that talked with me, What are these, my Lord? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And the angel that talked with me answered and said, These are the four winds of heaven, [and] they are going forth to stand before the Lord of all the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} [As for the chariot] in which were the black horses, they went out to the land of the north; and the white went out after them; and the piebald went out to the land of the south. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the ash-colored went out, and looked to go and compass the earth: and he said, Go, and compass the earth. And they compassed the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And he cried out and spoke to me, saying, Behold, these go out to the land of the north, and they have quieted my anger in the land of the north. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And the word of the Lord came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Take the things of the captivity from the chief men, and from the useful men of it, and from them that have understood it; and you shall enter in that day into the house of Josias the son of Sophonias that came out of Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And you shall take silver and gold, and make crowns, and you shall put [them] upon the head of Jesus the son of Josedec the high priest; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} and you shall say to him, Thus says the Lord Almighty; Behold the man whose name is The Branch; and he shall spring up from his stem, and build the house of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And he shall receive power, and shall sit and rule upon his throne; and there shall be a priest on his right hand, and a peaceful counsel shall be between [them] both. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And the crown shall be to them that wait patiently, and to the useful men of the captivity, and to them that have known it, and for the favor of the son of Sophonias, and for a psalm in the house of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And they [that are] far from them shall come and build in the house of the Lord, and you⌃ shall know that the Lord Almighty has sent me to you: and [this] shall come to pass, if you⌃ will diligently listen to the voice of the Lord your God.\par

\subsection*{Zacharias 7}
\markright{ZACHARIAS 7}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it came to pass in the fourth year of Darius the king, [that] the word of the Lord came to Zacharias on the fourth [day] of the ninth month, which is Chaseleu. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And Sarasar and Arbeseer the king and his men sent to Bethel, and [that] to propitiate the Lord, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} speaking to the priests that were in the house of the Lord Almighty, and to the prophets, saying, The holy offering has come in hither in the fifth month, as it has done already many years. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And the word of the Lord of hosts came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Speak to the whole people of the land, and to the priests, saying, Though you⌃ fasted or lamented in the fifth or seventh [months] (yes, behold, these seventy years) have you⌃ at all fasted to me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And if you⌃ eat or drink, do you⌃ not eat and drink for yourselves? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Are not these the words which the Lord spoke by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and her cities round about her, and the hill country and the low country was inhabited? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And the word of the Lord came to Zacharias, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Thus says the Lord Almighty; Judge righteous judgment, and deal mercifully and compassionately every one with his brother: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} and oppress not the widow, or the fatherless, or the stranger, or the poor; and let not one of you remember in his heart the injury of his brother. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} But they refused to attend, and madly turned their back, and made their ears heavy, so that they should not hear. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And they made their heart disobedient, so as not to listen to my law, and the words which the Lord Almighty sent forth by his Spirit by the former prophets: so there was great wrath from the Lord Almighty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And it shall come to pass, [that] as he spoke, and they listened not, so they shall cry, and I will not listen, says the Lord Almighty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And I will cast them out among all the nations, whom they know not; and the land behind them shall be made utterly destitute of any going through or returning: yes they have made the choice land a desolation.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} the fourth; Chisleu Answering to part of November and part of December. \textsuperscript{2} they; pray before the Lord Heb. intreat the face of the Lord; *marg. \textsuperscript{3} speak; Should; fifth This was a fast for the burning of the temple, as that of the seventh month was for the death of Gedaliah; and seeing that the city and temple were in part rebuilt, they wished to know whether they should continue the observance of them.; separating \textsuperscript{5} When seventh; seventy From the eleventh year of Zedekiah to the fourth of Darius Hystapses are just seventy years.; did \textsuperscript{6} did not ye eat for or, be not ye they that did eat for, etc. \textsuperscript{7} Should ye not hear the words or, Are not these the words, etc., cried; former Heb. the hand of former the south \textsuperscript{9} saying; Execute true judgment Heb. Judge judgment of truth, *marg. \textsuperscript{11} they refused; , ; pulled away the shoulder Heb. gave a backsliding shoulder; stopped Heb. made heavy \textsuperscript{12} their hearts; , lest; sent; the former Heb. the hand of the former, therefore \textsuperscript{14} scattered; , ; whom; the land; the pleasant land Heb. the land of desire\par}

\subsection*{Zacharias 8}
\markright{ZACHARIAS 8}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the word of the Lord Almighty came, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Thus says the Lord Almighty; I have been jealous for Jerusalem and for Sion with great jealousy, and I have been jealous for her with great fury. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Thus says the Lord; I will return to Sion, and dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and Jerusalem shall be called a true city, and the mountain of the Lord Almighty a holy mountain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Thus says the Lord Almighty; There shall yet dwell old men and old women in the streets of Jerusalem, every one holding his staff in his hand for age. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And the broad places of the city shall be filled with boys and girls playing in the streets thereof. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Thus says the Lord Almighty; If it shall be impossible in the sight of the remnant of this people in those days, shall it also be impossible in my sight? says the Lord Almighty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Thus says the Lord Almighty; Behold, I [will] save my people from the east country, and the west country; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} and I will bring them in, and cause [them] to dwell in the midst of Jerusalem: and they shall be to me a people, and I will be to them a God, in truth and in righteousness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Thus says the Lord Almighty; Let your hands be strong, [you⌃ that] hear in these days these words out of the mouth of the prophets, from the day that the house of the Lord Almighty was founded, and from the time that the temple was built. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For before those days the wages of men could not be profitable, and there could be no hire of cattle, and there could be no peace by reason of the affliction to him that went out or to him that came in: for I would have let loose all men, every one against his neighbor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} But now I [will] not do to the remnant of this people according to the former days, says the Lord Almighty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} But I will show peace: the vine shall yield her fruit, and the land shall yield her produce, and the heaven shall give its dew: and I will give as an inheritance all these things to the remnant of my people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And it shall come to pass, as you⌃ were a curse among the nations, O house of Juda, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and you⌃ shall be a blessing: be of good courage, and strengthen your hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For thus says the Lord Almighty; As I took counsel to afflict you when your fathers provoked me, says the Lord Almighty, and I repented not: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} so have I prepared and taken counsel in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Juda: be you⌃ of good courage. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} These [are] the things which you⌃ shall do; speak truth every one with his neighbor; judge truth and peaceful judgment in your gates: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} and let none of you devise evil in his heart against his neighbor; and love not a false oath: for all these things I hate, says the Lord Almighty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And the word of the Lord Almighty came to me, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Thus says the Lord Almighty, The fourth fast, and the fifth fast, and the seventh fast, and the tenth fast, shall be to the house of Juda for joy and gladness, and for good feasts; and you⌃ shall rejoice; and love you⌃ the truth and peace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Thus says the Lord Almighty; Yet shall many peoples come, and the inhabitants of many cities; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} and the inhabitants of five cities shall come together to one city, saying, Let us go to make supplication to the Lord, and to seek the face of the Lord Almighty; I will go also. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And many peoples and many nations shall come to seek earnestly the face of the Lord Almighty in Jerusalem, and to obtain favor of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Thus says the Lord Almighty; In those days [my word shall be fulfilled] if ten men of all the languages of the nations should take hold—even take hold of the hem of a Jew, saying, We will go with you; for we have heard that God is with you.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{3} I am; dwell; a city; the mountain the holy \textsuperscript{4} There; very age Heb. multitude of days \textsuperscript{6} marvellous or, hard, or difficult should \textsuperscript{7} I;, ; west country Heb. country of the going down of the sun \textsuperscript{8} and they shall dwell, ; they shall be my;, ; in truth \textsuperscript{10} before, there was no hire for man or, the hire of man became nothing, etc neither; for \textsuperscript{12} the seed; prosperous Heb. of peace; the heavens; the remnant; to possess \textsuperscript{13} a curse; , ; O house, ; ye shall The consideration that all nations who now worship the true God, and receive the Sacred Scriptures as His word, have derived the whole of their divine knowledge, under God, from Jewish prophets, apostles, and teachers, and that the Saviour "in whom all nations shall be blessed, " sprang from that favoured race, emphatically explains what is meant by "ye shall be a blessing." The full accomplishment of this prediction, however, is probably reserved for the future restoration of the Jews.; fear not \textsuperscript{16} are; Speak; execute the judgment of truth and peace Heb. judge truth and the judgment of peace \textsuperscript{19} the fourth; the fifth; the seventh; the tenth joy; feasts Heb. solemn, or, set times therefore \textsuperscript{21} Let speedily or, continually, Heb. going, pray before the Lord Heb. intreat the face of the Lord, I will \textsuperscript{23} ten men; out; take; We will; we have\par}

\subsection*{Zacharias 9}
\markright{ZACHARIAS 9}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The burden of the word of the Lord, in the land of Sedrach, and his sacrifice [shall be] in Damascus; for the Lord looks upon men, and upon all the tribes of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And in Emath, [even] in her coasts, [are] Tyre and Sidon, because they were very wise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And Tyrus built strongholds for herself, and heaped up silver as dust, and gathered gold as the mire of the ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And therefore the Lord will take them for a possession, and will strike her power in the sea; and she shall be consumed with fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Ascalon shall see, and fear; Gaza also, and shall be greatly pained, and Accaron; for she is ashamed at her trespass; and the king shall perish from Gaza, and Ascalon shall not be inhabited. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And aliens shall dwell in Azotus, and I will bring down the pride of the Philistines. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I will take their blood out of their mouth, and their abominations from between their teeth; and these also shall be left to our God, and they shall be as a captain of a thousand in Juda, and Accaron as a Jebusite. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And I will set up a defence for my house, that they may not pass through, nor turn back, neither shall there any more come upon them one to drive them away: for now have I seen with my eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Rejoice greatly, O daughter of Sion; proclaim [it] aloud, O daughter of Jerusalem; behold, the King is coming to you, just, and a Saviour; he is meek and riding on an ass, and a young foal. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And he shall destroy the chariots out of Ephraim, and the horse out of Jerusalem, and the bow of war shall be utterly destroyed; and [there shall be] abundance and peace out of the nations; and he shall rule over the waters as far as the sea, and the rivers [to] the ends of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And you by the blood of your covenant has sent forth your prisoners out of the pit that has no water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} You⌃ shall dwell in strongholds, you⌃ prisoners of the congregation: and for one day of your captivity I will recompense you double. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} For I have bent you, O Juda, for myself [as] a bow, I have filled Ephraim; and I will raise up your children, O Sion, against the children of the Greeks, and I will handle you as the sword of a warrior. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And the Lord shall be over them, and [his] arrow shall go forth as lightning: and the Lord Almighty shall blow with the trumpet; and shall proceed with the tumult of his threatening. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} The Lord Almighty shall protect them, and they shall destroy them, and overwhelm them with sling-stones; and they shall swallow them down as wine, and fill the bowls as the altar. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And the Lord their God shall save them in that day, [even] his people as a flock; for holy stones are rolled upon his land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For if he has anything good, and if he has anything fair, the young [men shall have] corn, and [there shall be] fragrant wine to the virgins.\par

\subsection*{Zacharias 10}
\markright{ZACHARIAS 10}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Ask you⌃ of the Lord rain in season, the early and the latter: the Lord has given bright signs, and will give them abundant rain, to every one grass in the field. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} For the speakers have uttered grievous things, and the diviners [have ] [seen] false visions, and they have spoken false dreams, they have given vain comfort: therefore have they fallen away like sheep, and been afflicted, because there was no healing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} My anger was kindled against the shepherds, and I will visit the lambs; and the Lord God Almighty shall visit his flock, the house of Juda, and he shall make them as his goodly horse in war. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And from him he looked, and from him he set [the battle in order], and from him [came] the bow in anger, [and] from him shall come forth every oppressor together. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And they shall be as warriors treading clay in the ways in war; and they shall set the battle in array, because the Lord is with them, and the riders on horses shall be put to shame. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And I will strengthen the house of Juda, and save the house of Joseph, and I will settle them; because I have loved them: and they shall be as [if] I had not cast them off: for I am the Lord their God, and I will hear them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And they shall be as the warriors of Ephraim, and their heart shall rejoice as with wine: and their children also shall see [it], and be glad; and their heart shall rejoice in the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I will make a sign to them, and gather them in; for I will redeem them, and they shall be multiplied according to their number before. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And I will sow them among the people; and they that are afar off shall remember me: they shall nourish their children, and they shall return. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And I will bring them again from the land of Egypt, and I will gather them in from among the Assyrians; and I will bring them into the land of Galaad and to Libanus; and there shall not even one of them be left behind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And they shall pass through a narrow sea, they shall strike the waves in the sea, and all the deep places of the rivers shall be dried up: and all the pride of the Assyrians shall be taken away, and the sceptre of Egypt shall be removed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And I will strengthen them in the Lord their God; and they shall boast in his name, says the Lord.\par
