\subsection*{Matthew 23}
\markright{MATTHEW 23}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then spoke Jesus to the multitude, and to his disciples, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Saying The scribes and the Pharisees sit in Moses' seat: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} All therefore whatsoever they bid you observe, that observe and do; but do not all of you after their works: for they say, and do not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For they bind heavy burdens and grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not move them with one of their fingers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} But all their works they do in order to be seen of men: they make broad their phylacteries, and enlarge the borders of their garments, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And love the uppermost rooms at feasts, and the chief seats in the synagogues, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And greetings in the markets, and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} But be not all of you called Rabbi: for one is your Master, even Christ; and all you are brethren. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And call no man your father upon the earth: for one is your Father, which is in heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Neither be all of you called masters: for one is your Master, even Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} But he that is greatest among you shall be your servant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And whosoever shall exalt himself shall be brought low; and he that shall humble himself shall be exalted. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} But woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for all of you shut up the kingdom of heaven against men: for all of you neither go in yourselves, neither suffer all of you them that are entering to go in. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for all of you devour widows' houses, and for a pretence make long prayer: therefore all of you shall receive the greater damnation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for all of you compass sea and land to make one proselyte, and when he is made, all of you make him twofold more the child of hell than yourselves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Woe unto you, all of you blind guides, which say, Whosoever shall swear by the temple, it is nothing; but whosoever shall swear by the gold of the temple, he is a debtor! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} All of you fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gold, or the temple that santifies the gold? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And, Whosoever shall swear by the altar, it is nothing; but whosoever swears by the gift that is upon it, he is guilty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} All of you fools and blind: for whether is greater, the gift, or the altar that santifies the gift? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Whoso therefore shall swear by the altar, swears by it, and by all things thereon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And whoso shall swear by the temple, swears by it, and by him that dwells therein. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And he that shall swear by heaven, swears by the throne of God, and by him that sits thereon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for all of you pay tithe of mint and anise and cummin, and have omitted the weightier matters of the law, judgment, mercy, and faith: these ought all of you to have done, and not to leave the other undone. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} All of you blind guides, which strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for all of you make clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and excess. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} You blind Pharisee, cleanse first that which is within the cup and platter, that the outside of them may be clean also. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for all of you are like unto whitewashed sepulchers, which indeed appear beautiful outward, but are within full of dead men's bones, and of all uncleanness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Even so all of you also outwardly appear righteous unto men, but within all of you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! because all of you build the tombs of the prophets, and garnish the sepulchers of the righteous, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And say, If we had been in the days of our fathers, we would not have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Wherefore all of you be witnesses unto yourselves, that all of you are the children of them which killed the prophets. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Fill all of you up then the measure of your fathers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} All of you serpents, all of you generation of vipers, how can all of you escape the damnation of hell? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Wherefore, behold, I send unto you prophets, and wise men, and scribes: and some of them all of you shall kill and crucify; and some of them shall all of you scourge in your synagogues, and persecute them from city to city: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} That upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel unto the blood of Zacharias son of Barachias, whom all of you slew between the temple and the altar. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Verily I say unto you, All these things shall come upon this generation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you that kill the prophets, and stone them which are sent unto you, how often would I have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chickens under her wings, and all of you would not! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Behold, your house is left unto you desolate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} For I say unto you, All of you shall not see me henceforth, till all of you shall say, Blessed is he that comes in the name of the Lord.\par

Berachoth, where we are told that the very religious prayed nine hours a day. therefore \textsuperscript{16} ye blind, ; Whosoever shall swear by the temple; it is; he is \textsuperscript{18} guilty or, debtor, or bound \textsuperscript{23} for anise Gr. ανηθον, dill. Dill is a species of plant of the pentandria digynia class, growing native in Spain and Portugal. The root is fusiform and long; stems, erect-groved, jointed, branched, and about two feet in height; leaves, doubly pinnated, sweet and odorous; flowers, flat, terminal umbels; corolla, five ovate, concave, yellow petals, with apexes inflected; germen, like that of fennel; seeds, scarcely the length of a carraway seed, but broader and flatter, of a brown colour, aromatic, sweetish odour, and warmish, pungent taste. cummin Gr. κυμινομ Cummin is a plant of the same class as dill. It rises eight or ten inches on a slender round procumbent, branching stem; leaves, a dark green, narrow, linear, and pointed; flowers, purple, in numerous four rayed umbels; corolla, five unequal petals, inflected, and notched at the apex; seeds, oblong, striated, of a brown colour, strong, heavy odour, and warm, bitterish taste. the weightier, ; these \textsuperscript{34} I send; prophets, ; and wise; scribes ye \textsuperscript{35} upon; , ; the blood of righteous; unto \textsuperscript{37} Jerusalem; thou, ; how;, ; even;, and ye\par}

\subsection*{Matthew 24}
\markright{MATTHEW 24}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And Jesus went out, and departed from the temple: and his disciples came to him in order to show him the buildings of the temple. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And Jesus said unto them, See all of you not all these things? verily I say unto you, There shall not be left here one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And as he sat upon the mount of Olives, the disciples came unto him privately, saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of your coming, and of the end of the world? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And Jesus answered and said unto them, Take heed that no man deceive you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And all of you shall hear of wars and rumours of wars: see that all of you be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: and there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} All these are the beginning of sorrows. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Then shall they deliver you up to be afflicted, and shall kill you: and all of you shall be hated of all nations for my name's sake. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And many false prophets shall rise, and shall deceive many. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And because iniquity shall abound, the love (o. agape) of many shall wax cold. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} But he that shall endure unto the end, the same shall be saved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} When all of you therefore shall see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, stand in the holy place, (whoso reads, let him understand:) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Then let them which be in Judaea flee into the mountains: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Let him which is on the housetop not come down to take any thing out of his house: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Neither let him which is in the field return back to take his clothes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck in those days! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But pray all of you that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For then shall be great tribulation, such as was not since the beginning of the world to this time, no, nor ever shall be. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved: but for the elect's sake those days shall be shortened. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Then if any man shall say unto you, Lo, here is Christ, or there; believe it not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} For there shall arise false Christs, and false prophets, and shall show great signs and wonders; insomuch that, if it were possible, they shall deceive the very elect. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Behold, I have told you before. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Wherefore if they shall say unto you, Behold, he is in the desert; go not forth: behold, he is in the secret chambers; believe it not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} For as the lightning comes out of the east, and shines even unto the west; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} For where ever the carcass is, there will the eagles be gathered together. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Immediately after the tribulation of those days shall the sun be darkened, and the moon shall not give her light, and the stars shall fall from heaven, and the powers of the heavens shall be shaken: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And then shall appear the sign of the Son of man in heaven: and then shall all the tribes of the earth mourn, and they shall see the Son of man coming in the clouds of heaven with power and great glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Now learn a parable of the fig tree; When his branch is yet tender, and puts forth leaves, all of you know that summer is nigh: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} So likewise all of you, when all of you shall see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass, till all these things be fulfilled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Heaven and earth shall pass away, but my words (o. logos) shall not pass away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} But of that day and hour knows no man, no, not the angels of heaven, but my Father only. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of man be. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} For as in the days that were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of man be. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} Then shall two be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} Two women shall be grinding at the mill; the one shall be taken, and the other left. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} Watch therefore: for all of you know not what hour your Lord does come. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} But know this, that if the goodman of the house had known in what watch the thief would come, he would have watched, and would not have suffered his house to be broken up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} Therefore be all of you also ready: for in such an hour as all of you think not the Son of man comes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} Who then is a faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has made ruler over his household, to give them food in due season? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he comes shall find so doing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} Verily I say unto you, That he shall make him ruler over all his goods. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} But and if that evil servant shall say in his heart, My lord delays his coming; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} And shall begin to strike his fellow servants, and to eat and drink with the drunken; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} The lord of that servant shall come in a day when he looks not for him, and in an hour that he is not aware of, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} And shall cut him asunder, and appoint him his portion with the hypocrites: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{3} Gk. vocab: parousia (παρουσία) = presence; coming. Common English renderings: coming; presence. In eschatological contexts this term commonly denotes the coming of Christ.\par}

\subsection*{Matthew 25}
\markright{MATTHEW 25}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And five of them were wise, and five were foolish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom comes; go all of you out to meet him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go all of you rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Watch therefore, for all of you know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man comes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and immediately took his journey. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} But he that had received one went and dug in the earth, and hid his lord's money. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} After a long time the lord of those servants comes, and reckons (o. logos) with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, you delivered unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} His lord said unto him, Well done, you good and faithful servant: you have been faithful over a few things, I will make you ruler over many things: enter you into the joy of your lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, you delivered unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; you have been faithful over a few things, I will make you ruler over many things: enter you into the joy of your lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew you that you are an hard man, reaping where you have not sown, and gathering where you have not scattered: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And I was afraid, and went and hid your talent in the earth: lo, there you have that is yours. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} His lord answered and said unto him, You wicked and slothful servant, you knew that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not scattered: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} You ought therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with interest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which has ten talents. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} For unto every one that has shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that has not shall be taken away even that which he has. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And cast all of you the useless servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divides his sheep from the goats: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, all of you blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} For I was an hungered, and all of you gave me food: I was thirsty, and all of you gave me drink: I was a stranger, and all of you took me in: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Naked, and all of you clothed me: I was sick, and all of you visited me: I was in prison, and all of you came unto me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we you an hungered, and fed you? or thirsty, and gave you drink? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} When saw we you a stranger, and took you in? or naked, and clothed you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} Or when saw we you sick, or in prison, and came unto you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as all of you have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, all of you have done it unto me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, all of you cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} For I was an hungered, and all of you gave me no food: I was thirsty, and all of you gave me no drink: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} I was a stranger, and all of you took me not in: naked, and all of you clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and all of you visited me not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we you an hungered, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as all of you did it not to one of the least of these, all of you did it not to me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} Then; the kingdom, ; ten;, ; which; went; the bridegroom \textsuperscript{6} at; a cry; Behold; go \textsuperscript{8} Give; for; gone out or, going out \textsuperscript{10} the bridegroom;, they; and the \textsuperscript{15} talents "A talent is 187£. 10s." \textsuperscript{24} he which Our Lord placed the example of negligence in him to whom the least was committed, probably to "intimate" says Doddridge, "that we are accountable for the smallest advantage with which we are entrusted; but it cannot imply that they who have received much will ordinarily pass their account best; for it is too plain, in fact, that most of those whose dignity, wealth, and genius give them the greatest opportunities of service, seem to forget that they have any Master in heaven to serve, or any future reckoning to expect; and many render themselves much more criminal than this wicked and slothful servant who hid his talents in the earth." \subsection*{Matthew 26}
\markright{MATTHEW 26}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it came to pass, when Jesus had finished all these sayings, (o. logos) he said unto his disciples, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} All of you know that after two days is the feast of the passover, and the Son of man is betrayed to be crucified. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Then assembled together the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders of the people, unto the palace of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And consulted that they might take Jesus by subtlety, and kill him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} But they said, Not on the feast day, lest there be an uproar among the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} There came unto him a woman having an alabaster box of very precious ointment, and poured it on his head, as he sat at food. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} But when his disciples saw it, they had indignation, saying, To what purpose is this waste? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} When Jesus understood it, he said unto them, Why trouble all of you the woman? for she has wrought a good work upon me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For all of you have the poor always with you; but me all of you have not always. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For in that she has poured this ointment on my body, she did it for my burial. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Verily I say unto you, Where ever this gospel shall be preached in the whole world, there shall also this, that this woman has done, be told for a memorial of her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And said unto them, What will all of you give me, and I will deliver him unto you? And they covenanted with him for thirty pieces of silver. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And from that time he sought opportunity to betray him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Now the first day of the feast of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying unto him, Where will you that we prepare for you to eat the passover? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And he said, Go into the city to such a man, and say unto him, The Master says, My time is at hand; I will keep the passover at your house with my disciples. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And the disciples did as Jesus had appointed them; and they made ready the passover. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Now when the even was come, he sat down with the twelve. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And as they did eat, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began every one of them to say unto him, Lord, is it I? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And he answered and said, He that dips his hand with me in the dish, the same shall betray me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} The Son of man goes as it is written of him: but woe unto that man by whom the Son of man is betrayed! it had been good for that man if he had not been born. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Then Judas, which betrayed him, answered and said, Master, is it I? He said unto him, You have said. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And as they were eating, Jesus took bread, and blessed it, and brake it, and gave it to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and gave it to them, saying, Drink all of you all of it; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} For this is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} But I say unto you, I will not drink henceforth of this fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it new with you in my Father's kingdom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And when they had sung an hymn, they went out into the mount of Olives. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Then says Jesus unto them, All you shall be offended because of me this night: for it is written, I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock shall be scattered abroad. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} But after I am risen again, I will go before you into Galilee. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Peter answered and said unto him, Though all men shall be offended because of you, yet will I never be offended. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto you, That this night, before the cock crow, you shall deny me three times. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Peter said unto him, Though I should die with you, yet will I not deny you. Likewise also said all the disciples. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Then comes Jesus with them unto a place called Gethsemane, and says unto the disciples, Sit all of you here, while I go and pray yonder. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and very heavy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Then says he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry all of you here, and watch with me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And he went a little farther, and fell on his face, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if it be possible, let this cup pass from me: nevertheless not as I will, but as you will. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And he comes unto the disciples, and finds them asleep, and says unto Peter, What, could all of you not watch with me one hour? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} Watch and pray, that all of you enter not into temptation: the spirit (o. pneuma) indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} He went away again the second time, and prayed, saying, O my Father, if this cup may not pass away from me, except I drink it, your will be done. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And he came and found them asleep again: for their eyes were heavy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And he left them, and went away again, and prayed the third time, saying the same words. (o. logos) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} Then comes he to his disciples, and says unto them, Sleep on now, and take your rest: behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of man is betrayed into the hands of sinners. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} Rise, let us be going: behold, he is at hand that does betray me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} And while he yet spoke, lo, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and staves, from the chief priests and elders of the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} Now he that betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whomsoever I shall kiss, that same is he: hold him fast. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} And forthwith he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, master; and kissed him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} And Jesus said unto him, Friend, wherefore are you come? Then came they, and laid hands on Jesus and took him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} And, behold, one of them which were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck a servant of the high priest's, and stroke off his ear. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} Then said Jesus unto him, Put up again your sword into his place: for all they that take the sword shall perish with the sword. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} Think you that I cannot now pray to my Father, and he shall presently give me more than twelve legions of angels? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{54}} But how then shall the scriptures be fulfilled, that thus it must be? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{55}} In that same hour said Jesus to the multitudes, Are all of you come out as against a thief with swords and staves in order to take me? I sat daily with you teaching in the temple, and all of you laid no hold on me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{56}} But all this was done, that the scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples forsook him, and fled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{57}} And they that had laid hold on Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were assembled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{58}} But Peter followed him far off unto the high priest's palace, and went in, and sat with the servants, to see the end. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{59}} Now the chief priests, and elders, and all the council, sought false witness against Jesus, to put him to death; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{60}} But found none: yea, though many false witnesses came, yet found they none. At the last came two false witnesses, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{61}} And said, This fellow said, I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{62}} And the high priest arose, and said unto him, Answer you nothing? what is it which these witness against you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{63}} But Jesus held his peace, And the high priest answered and said unto him, I adjure you by the living God, that you tell us whether you be the Christ, the Son of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{64}} Jesus says unto him, You have said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall all of you see the Son of man sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{65}} Then the high priest rent his clothes, saying, He has spoken blasphemy; what further need have we of witnesses? behold, now all of you have heard his blasphemy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{66}} What think all of you? They answered and said, He is guilty of death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{67}} Then did they spit in his face, and buffeted him; and others stroke him with the palms of their hands, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{68}} Saying, Prophesy unto us, you Christ, Who is he that stroke you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{69}} Now Peter sat without in the palace: and a damsel came unto him, saying, You also were with Jesus of Galilee. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{70}} But he denied before them all, saying, I know not what you says. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{71}} And when he was gone out into the porch, another maid saw him, and said unto them that were there, This fellow was also with Jesus of Nazareth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{72}} And again he denied with an oath, I do not know the man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{73}} And after a while came unto him they that stood by, and said to Peter, Surely you also are one of them; for your speech betrayed you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{74}} Then began he to curse and to swear, saying, I know not the man. And immediately the cock crew. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{75}} And Peter remembered the word (o. rhema) of Jesus, which said unto him, Before the cock crow, you shall deny me three times. And he went out, and wept bitterly.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{3} assembled;, ; the palace; Caiaphas This was Joseph, surnamed Caiaphas, who succeeded Simon son of Camith, in the high-priesthood, about ad 25. About two years after our Lord's death, he was deposed by Vitellius governor of Syria; and unable to bear his disgrace, and perhaps the stings of conscience for the murder of Christ, he killed himself about ad 35. \textsuperscript{15} What; thirty Probably shekels or staters, as some read, which, reckoning the shekels at 3s., with Prideaux, would amount to about 4£ 10s., the price for the meanest slave! (See ) \textsuperscript{18} Go; The Master, ; My time \textsuperscript{24} Son of man goeth; , ; written; but \textsuperscript{26} as; Jesus; blessed it "Many Greek copies have gave thanks." and brake; Take; this \textsuperscript{30} when; hymn or, psalm they went \textsuperscript{31} All, ; I will; and the NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. Brenton LXX: “Zechariah 13:7 Awake, O sword, against my shepherds, and against the man who is my citizen, saith the Lord Almighty: smite the shepherds, and draw out the sheep: and I will bring mine hand upon the little ones.” Masoretic/Hebrew comparison: “Zechariah 13:7 Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man [that is] my fellow, saith the LORD of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.” \textsuperscript{36} a place; Gethsemane was a garden at the foot of the Mount of Olives, beyond the brook Cedron; an even plat of ground, says Maundrell, not above fifty-seven yards square, where are shown some old olive trees, supposed to identify the spot to which our Lord was wont to resort. while \textsuperscript{39} and fell; and prayed; O my Father; if; let; not \textsuperscript{45} Sleep on That is, as it is well paraphrased by Euthymius, "Since you have thus far failed to watch, sleep on the rest of the time, and take your rest, if you can."; the hour \textsuperscript{49} Hail; kissed him Κατεφιλησεν, he kissed him affectionately, eagerly, or repeatedly, from κατα, intensive, and φιλεω, to kiss, still pretending the most affectionate attachment to our Lord. \textsuperscript{50} Friend Rather, "Companion, εταιρε, against whom ( εφ ̓ω the reading of all the best MSS) art thou come?" \textsuperscript{53} and he; twelve legions (A legion, λεγεων, for the Latin legio, from lego, to collect or choose was a particular division or battalion of the Roman army, which at different times contained different numbers. In the time of our Saviour it probably consisted of 6, 200 foot and 300 horse, twelve of which would amount to 78, 000 men.) \textsuperscript{61} This; , I am The words of our Lord were widely different from this statement of them; so that the testimony of these witnesses was false, though it had the semblance of truth. \textsuperscript{63} Jesus; I adjure; that;, the Christ \textsuperscript{67} did; buffeted him Εκολαφισαν, "smote him with their fists, " as Theophylact interprets. and others; smote him Ερραπισαν, "smote him on the cheek with the open hand, " as Suidas renders. They offered him every indignity, in all its various and vexatious forms. the palms of their hands or, rods\par}

\subsection*{Matthew 27}
\markright{MATTHEW 27}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} When the morning was come, all the chief priests and elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And when they had bound him, they led him away, and delivered him to Pontius Pilate the governor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Then Judas, which had betrayed him, when he saw that he was condemned, repented himself, and brought again the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Saying, I have sinned in that I have betrayed the innocent blood. And they said, What is that to us? see you to that. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And he cast down the pieces of silver in the temple, and departed, and went and hanged himself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And the chief priests took the silver pieces, and said, It is not lawful in order to put them into the treasury, because it is the price of blood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter's field, to bury strangers in. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Wherefore that field was called, The field of blood, unto this day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Then was fulfilled that which was spoken by Jeremy the prophet, saying, And they took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him that was valued, whom they of the children of Israel did value; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord appointed me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Are you the King of the Jews? And Jesus said unto him, You says. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And when he was accused of the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Then said Pilate unto him, Hear you not how many things they witness against you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And he answered him to not a word; (o. rhema) insomuch that the governor marvelled greatly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Now at that feast the governor was known to release unto the people a prisoner, whom they would. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And they had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Therefore when they were gathered together, Pilate said unto them, Whom will all of you that I release unto you? Barabbas, or Jesus which is called Christ? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} For he knew that for envy they had delivered him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} When he was set down on the judgment seat, his wife sent unto him, saying, Have you nothing to do with that just man: for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But the chief priests and elders persuaded the multitude that they should ask Barabbas, and destroy Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} The governor answered and said unto them, Whether of the two will all of you that I release unto you? They said, Barabbas. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Pilate says unto them, What shall I do then with Jesus which is called Christ? They all say unto him, Let him be crucified. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And the governor said, Why, what evil has he done? But they cried out the more, saying, Let him be crucified. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} When Pilate saw that he could prevail nothing, but that rather a tumult was made, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this just person: see all of you to it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Then answered all the people, and said, His blood be on us, and on our children. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Then released he Barabbas unto them: and when he had scourged Jesus, he delivered him to be crucified. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Then the soldiers of the governor took Jesus into the common hall, and gathered unto him the whole band of soldiers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And they stripped him, and put on him a scarlet robe. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And when they had intertwined a crown of thorns, they put it upon his head, and a reed in his right hand: and they bowed the knee before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And they spit upon him, and took the reed, and stroke him on the head. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And after that they had mocked him, they took the robe off from him, and put his own raiment on him, and led him away to crucify him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And as they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name: him they compelled to bear his cross. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And when they were come unto a place called Golgotha, that is to say, a place of a skull, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} They gave him vinegar to drink mingled with gall: and when he had tasted thereof, he would not drink. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And they crucified him, and parted his garments, casting lots: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, They parted my garments among them, and upon my vesture did they cast lots. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And sitting down they watched him there; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And set up over his head his accusation written, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Then were there two thieves crucified with him, one on the right hand, and another on the left. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And they that passed by reviled him, wagging their heads, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And saying, You that destroys the temple, and build it in three days, save yourself. If you be the Son of God, come down from the cross. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} Likewise also the chief priests mocking him, with the scribes and elders, said, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} He saved others; himself he cannot save. If he be the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will believe him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} He trusted in God; let him deliver him now, if he will have him: for he said, I am the Son of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} The thieves also, which were crucified with him, cast the same in his teeth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land unto the ninth hour. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} And about the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is to say, My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} Some of them that stood there, when they heard that, said, This man calls for Elijah. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} And immediately one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him to drink. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} The rest said, Let be, let us see whether Elijah will come to save him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} Jesus, when he had cried again with a loud voice, yielded up the spirit. (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} And, behold, the veil of the temple was rent in two from the top to the bottom; and the earth did quake, and the rocks rent; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the saints which slept arose, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} And came out of the graves after his resurrection, and went into the holy city, and appeared unto many. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{54}} Now when the centurion, and they that were with him, watching Jesus, saw the earthquake, and those things that were done, they feared greatly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{55}} And many women were there beholding far off, which followed Jesus from Galilee, ministering unto him: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{56}} Among which was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of Zebedees children. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{57}} When the even was come, there came a rich man of Arimathaea, named Joseph, who also himself was Jesus' disciple: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{58}} He went to Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. Then Pilate commanded the body to be delivered. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{59}} And when Joseph had taken the body, he wrapped it in a clean linen cloth, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{60}} And laid it in his own new tomb, which he had hewn out in the rock: and he rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb, and departed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{61}} And there was Mary Magdalene, and the other Mary, sitting opposite to the tomb. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{62}} Now the next day, that followed the day of the preparation, the chief priests and Pharisees came together unto Pilate, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{63}} Saying, Sir, we remember that that deceiver said, while he was yet alive, After three days I will rise again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{64}} Command therefore that the tomb be made sure until the third day, lest his disciples come by night, and steal him away, and say unto the people, He has risen from the dead: so the last error shall be worse than the first. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{65}} Pilate said unto them, All of you have a watch: go your way, make it as sure as all of you can. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{66}} So they went, and made the tomb sure, sealing the stone, and setting a watch.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{2} Name meaning: Pilate (Pilatus) — Armed with a spear Roman judge who washed his hands of Jesus. \textsuperscript{16} Name meaning: Barabbas (Bar-Abba) — Son of the father Released in place of the true Son of the Father. \textsuperscript{18} Gk. vocab: phthonos (φθόνος) = envy. Common English renderings: envy. This lemma is not attested in the canonical Greek Old Testament. \textsuperscript{56} Name meaning: Mary Magdalene (Miryam) — Of Magdala First witness to the resurrection.\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} bound;, ; delivered; Pontius Pilate Pontius Pilate governed Judea ten years under the emperor Tiberius, from his 13th to his 23rd year ad 26 to 36; but, having exercised great cruelties against the Samaritans, they complained to Vitellius, governor of Syria, who sent Marcellus, one of his friends, to superintend Judea, and ordered Pilate to Rome, to give an account of his conduct to Tiberius. The emperor was dead before he arrived; but it is an ancient tradition, that he was banished to Vienne in Dauphiny, where he was reduced to such extremity that he killed himself with his own sword two years after. \textsuperscript{4} I have sinned; the innocent, ; What; see \textsuperscript{6} It is not; to put; because The Jews considered it was strictly forbidden by the Divine law to bring any filthy or iniquitous gain into the temple. For this reason they now refused to allow this money to be placed in the chest in the temple, amongst the former contributions for its repairs. In this, they were right enough, but by the very act of refusing this money, they proved themselves to be gross perverters of the spirit of God's requirements. They saw not that it was much less lawful for them, who had hired Judas to this sordid action, to be employed in the service of the temple. Those that "bear the vessels of the Lord, " ought to be holy. Thus our Lord's words, "Ye blind guides! ye strain at a gnat and swallow a camel." \textsuperscript{9} Jeremy The words here quoted are not found in Jeremiah, but in Zechariah; and a variety of conjectures have been formed, in order to reconcile this discrepancy. The most probable opinion seems to be, that the name of the prophet was originally omitted by the Evangelist, and that the name of Jeremiah was added by some subsequent copyist. It is omitted in two manuscripts of the twelfth century, in the Syriac, later Persic, two of the Itala, and in some other Latin copies; and what renders it highly probable that the original reading was δια, του, προφητον, by the prophet, is, that Matthew frequently omits the name of the prophet in his quotations. See note on; . This omission is approved of by Bengel, Dr. A. Clarke, and Horne. And they thirty; of the children of Israel did value or, bought of the children of Israel NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. Brenton LXX: “Zechariah 11:12 And I will say to them, If it be good in your eyes, give me my price, or refuse it. And they weighed for my price thirty pieces of silver. And the Lord said to me, Drop them into the furnace, and I will see if it is good metal, as I was proved for their sakes. And I took the thirty pieces of silver, and cast them into the furnace in the house of the Lord.” Masoretic/Hebrew comparison: “Zechariah 11:12 And I said unto them, If ye think good, give [me] my price; and if not, forbear. So they weighed for my price thirty [pieces] of silver. And the LORD said unto me, Cast it unto the potter: a goodly price that I was prised at of them. And I took the thirty [pieces] of silver, and cast them to the potter in the house of the LORD.” \textsuperscript{18} he; envy Or, malice φθονος, probably from φθινω, to decay, wither, pine away, according to that of Solomon. \textsuperscript{26} released; scourged This of itself was a severe punishment, the flesh being generally cut by the whips used for this purpose. \textsuperscript{27} common hall or, governor's house; Gr band \textsuperscript{28} stripped; a scarlet robe Mark calls it a purple robe; but by πορφυρα is denoted whatever is of a dazzling red; and the words κοκκινον, scarlet, and πορφυρα, purple, are not infrequently interchanged. \textsuperscript{34} gave; vinegar Mark says wine mingled with myrrh; but as the sour wine used by the Roman soldiers and common people was termed οινος wine, and οξος vinegar, vin aigre (French), is sour wine; and as chole gall, is applied to bitters of any kind, it is not difficult to reconcile the two accounts. \textsuperscript{35} they crucified; parted; that it NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. Brenton LXX: “Psalms 21:18 They parted my garments among themselves, and cast lots upon my raiment.” Masoretic/Hebrew comparison: “Psalms 22:18 They part my garments among them, and cast lots upon my vesture.” \textsuperscript{40} saying; that destroyest; If, come \textsuperscript{45} from; darkness That this general darkness was wholly preternatural is evident from this, that it happened at the passover, which was celebrated only at the full moon, a time in which it was impossible for the sun to be eclipsed, natural eclipses happening only at the time of the new moon. (See Introduction to the Comprehensive Bible, p. 59.) \textsuperscript{46} NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. Brenton LXX: “Psalms 21:1 O God, my God, attend to me: why hast thou forsaken me? the account of my transgressions is far from my salvation.” Masoretic/Hebrew comparison: “Psalms 22:1 My God, my God, why hast thou forsaken me? [why art thou so] far from helping me, [and from] the words of my roaring?” \textsuperscript{54} the centurion;, saw; feared; Truly \textsuperscript{56} Mary Magdalene; Mary the; James; the mother \textsuperscript{62} the day; the chief priests \textsuperscript{66} and made Every thing was here done which human policy and prudence could, to prevent a resurrection, which these very precautions had the most direct tendency to authenticate and establish. sealing\par}

\subsection*{Matthew 28}
\markright{MATTHEW 28}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} In the end of the sabbath, as it began to dawn toward the first day of the week, came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the tomb. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And, behold, there was a great earthquake: for the angel of the Lord descended from heaven, and came and rolled back the stone from the door, and sat upon it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} His countenance was like lightning, and his raiment white as snow: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And for fear of him the keepers did shake, and became as dead men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And the angel answered and said unto the women, Fear not all of you: for I know that all of you seek Jesus, which was crucified. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} He is not here: for he has risen, as he said. Come, see the place where the Lord lay. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And go quickly, and tell his disciples that he has risen from the dead; and, behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there shall all of you see him: lo, I have told you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And they departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy; and did run to bring his disciples word. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And as they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, All hail. And they came and held him by the feet, and worshipped him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Then said Jesus unto them, Be not afraid: go tell my brethren that they go into Galilee, and there shall they see me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Now when they were going, behold, some of the watch came into the city, and showed unto the chief priests all the things that were done. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And when they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave large money unto the soldiers, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Saying, Say all of you, His disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And if this come to the governor's ears, we will persuade him, and secure you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} So they took the money, and did as they were taught: and this saying (o. logos) is commonly reported among the Jews until this day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Then the eleven disciples went away into Galilee, into a mountain where Jesus had appointed them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And when they saw him, they worshipped him: but some doubted. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And Jesus came and spoke unto them, saying, All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Go all of you therefore, and teach all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit: (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you: and, lo, I am with you always, even unto the end of the world. Amen.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} the end The Hebrew word Schabbath from which our English word is derived, signifies rest, and is applied to all solemn festivals, equally with that one day of every week devoted to the worship of God; "they polluted my sabbaths." Three evangelists say, the transaction recorded in this verse, occurred upon the first day of the week, early in the morning, about sunrising, and John says, while it was yet dark. Οψε, σαββατων, does not signify "in the evening of sabbath, " but "sabbaths." Hence, the great feast having been concluded, the term "end of the sabbaths" denotes the time very clearly. Again, it may be observed that the Jews, speaking of their passover, sometimes speak according to their civil computation, wherein they measured their days from sun-rising to sun-rising. Sometimes according to their sacred computation, which was from sun-set to sun-set. This reconciles, which seems to make the fourteenth day of the first month, the first day of unleavened bread.; Mary Magdalene \textsuperscript{2} there; was or, had been for \textsuperscript{9} as; All hail; *Gr. and held; worshipped \textsuperscript{19} ye therefore;, ; teach all nations or, make disciples, or Christians, of all nations baptizing, ; the name \textsuperscript{20} them; I am; unto, Amen\par}

\section*{Mark Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} John Mark under Petrine apostolic oversight\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} Early church testimony consistently links Mark with Peter's preaching, especially in Papias and Irenaeus.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} Mark's close Petrine perspective and unanimous patristic witness support traditional authorship.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} before AD 70 in common conservative dating\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} Not applicable as a textual tradition label; historically the Gospel narrates Christ's ministry in Roman-facing concise form.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} Not applicable; Mark's OT citations still bear on Hebrew and Greek quotation study.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Fast-paced Gospel emphasizing Christ's authority, suffering, and servant ministry.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To present Jesus as the mighty Son of God and suffering servant and to call readers to discipleship under the cross.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} authority; Son of God; suffering servant; discipleship; immediacy\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Introduction and Galilean ministry 1-8; journey and passion teaching 8-13; passion and resurrection 14-16.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. No very early tiny fragment is universally agreed; Papyrus 137 is one candidate 2nd-3rd century AD | Subst. Papyrus 45 is the earliest substantial Mark witness 3rd century AD | Heb. No complete Hebrew original survives n/a | Gk. Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Vaticanus preserve complete Greek Mark 4th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Tradition on Mark as Peter's interpreter by Papias (early 2nd century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} Mark's ending and several shorter textual problems make it one of the key NT books for text-critical discussion.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives Mark as the authentic Gospel of John Mark rooted in apostolic Petrine preaching.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\subsection*{Mark 1}
\markright{MARK 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ, the Son of God; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before your face, which shall prepare your way before you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare all of you the way of the Lord, make his paths straight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} John did baptize in the wilderness, and preach the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And there went out unto him all the land of Judaea, and they of Jerusalem, and were all baptized of him in the river of Jordan, confessing their sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And John was clothed with camel's hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and wild honey; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And preached, saying, There comes one mightier than I after me, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to stoop down and unloose. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the Holy Spirit. (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And it came to pass in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized of John in Jordan. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And immediately coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens opened, and the Spirit (o. pneuma) like a dove descending upon him: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And there came a voice from heaven, saying, You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And immediately the spirit (o. pneuma) drives him into the wilderness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And he was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted of Satan; and was with the wild beasts; and the angels ministered unto him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Now after that John was put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the gospel of the kingdom of God, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And saying, The time is fulfilled, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent all of you, and believe the gospel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Now as he walked by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew his brother casting a net into the sea: for they were fishers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And Jesus said unto them, Come all of you after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And immediately they forsook their nets, and followed him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And when he had gone a little farther thence, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who also were in the ship mending their nets. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And immediately he called them: and they left their father Zebedee in the ship with the hired servants, and went after him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And they went into Capernaum; and immediately on the sabbath day he entered into the synagogue, and taught. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And they were astonished at his doctrine: for he taught them as one that had authority, and not as the scribes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; (o. pneuma) and he cried out, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with you, you Jesus of Nazareth? are you come to destroy us? I know you who you are, the Holy One of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold your peace, and come out of him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And when the unclean spirit (o. pneuma) had torn him, and cried with a loud voice, he came out of him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And they were all amazed, insomuch that they questioned among themselves, saying, What thing is this? what new doctrine is this? for with authority commands he even the unclean spirits, (o. pneuma) and they do obey him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And immediately his fame spread abroad throughout all the region round about Galilee. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And forthwith, when they were come out of the synagogue, they entered into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} But Simon's wife's mother lay sick of a fever, and soon they tell him of her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And he came and took her by the hand, and lifted her up; and immediately the fever left her, and she ministered unto them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And at even, when the sun did set, they brought unto him all that were diseased, and them that were possessed with devils. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And all the city was gathered together at the door. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And he healed many that were sick of divers diseases, and cast out many devils; and suffered not the devils to speak, because they knew him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And in the morning, rising up a great while before day, he went out, and departed into a solitary place, and there prayed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And Simon and they that were with him followed after him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And when they had found him, they said unto him, All men seek for you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And he said unto them, Let us go into the next towns, that I may preach there also: for therefore came I forth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And he preached in their synagogues throughout all Galilee, and cast out devils. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And there came a leper to him, beseeching him, and kneeling down to him, and saying unto him, If you will, you can make me clean. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And Jesus, moved with compassion, put forth his hand, and touched him, and says unto him, I will; be you clean. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And as soon as he had spoken, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was cleansed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And he strictly charged him, and forthwith sent him away; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And says unto him, See you say nothing to any man: but go your way, show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing those things which Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} But he went out, and began to publish it much, and to blaze abroad the matter, (o. logos) insomuch that Jesus could no more openly enter into the city, but was without in desert places: and they came to him from every quarter.\par
