\section*{Luke Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} Luke the beloved physician and companion of Paul\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} The prologue, Acts' we-sections, and unanimous early church testimony support Lucan authorship.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} Colossians 4:14, 2 Timothy 4:11, and Philemon 24 identify Luke as Paul's coworker, fitting the Gospel-Acts corpus.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} AD 60-62 in common conservative dating\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Orderly Gospel narrative addressed to Theophilus, rooted in eyewitness testimony and careful investigation.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To give certainty about the things fulfilled in Christ and to present the Savior for Jew and Gentile alike.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} certainty; salvation; compassion; Holy Spirit; prayer; Gentiles\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Infancy and preparation 1-4; Galilean ministry 4-9; travel narrative 9-19; Jerusalem, passion, resurrection 19-24.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Papyrus 4 and Papyrus 75 preserve early Luke material late 2nd to early 3rd century AD | Subst. Papyrus 75 is the earliest substantial Luke witness late 2nd to early 3rd century AD | Heb. No complete Hebrew original survives n/a | Gk. Codex Vaticanus and Codex Sinaiticus preserve complete Greek Luke 4th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Likely early use in apostolic fathers; clear attestation in Irenaeus by Irenaeus (late 2nd century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} Luke's wording matters for several OT quotations and for the relation of Luke and Acts to early text families.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives Luke as the physician-companion of Paul and the faithful historian-theologian of the Gospel and Acts.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{Luke}
\markboth{LUKE}{}
\subsection*{Luke 1}
\markright{LUKE 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Forasmuch as many have taken in hand to set forth in order a declaration of those things which are most surely believed among us, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Even as they delivered them unto us, which from the beginning were eyewitnesses, and ministers of the word; (o. logos) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} It seemed good to me also, having had perfect understanding of all things from the very first, to write unto you in order, most excellent Theophilus, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} That you might know the certainty of those things, (o. logos) wherein you have been instructed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} THERE was in the days of Herod, the king of Judaea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the course of Abia: and his wife was of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And they were both righteous before God, walking in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord blameless. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And they had no child, because that Elisabeth was barren, and they both were now well stricken in years. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And it came to pass, that while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his course, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} According to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to burn incense when he went into the temple of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And the whole multitude of the people were praying without at the time of incense. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And there appeared unto him an angel of the Lord standing on the right side of the altar of incense. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And when Zacharias saw him, he was troubled, and fear fell upon him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} But the angel said unto him, Fear not, Zacharias: for your prayer is heard; and your wife Elisabeth shall bear you a son, and you shall call his name John. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And you shall have joy and gladness; and many shall rejoice at his birth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For he shall be great in the sight of the Lord, and shall drink neither wine nor strong drink; and he shall be filled with the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) even from his mother's womb. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And many of the children of Israel shall he turn to the Lord their God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And he shall go before him in the spirit (o. pneuma) and power of Elijah, to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children, and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to make ready a people prepared for the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And Zacharias said unto the angel, Whereby shall I know this? for I am an old man, and my wife well stricken in years. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And the angel answering said unto him, I am Gabriel, that stand in the presence of God; and am sent to speak unto you, and to show you these glad tidings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And, behold, you shall be dumb, and not able to speak, until the day that these things shall be performed, because you believe not my words, (o. logos) which shall be fulfilled in their season. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And the people waited for Zacharias, and marvelled that he tarried so long in the temple. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And when he came out, he could not speak unto them: and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple: for he beckoned unto them, and remained speechless. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And it came to pass, that, as soon as the days of his ministration were accomplished, he departed to his own house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And after those days his wife Elisabeth conceived, and hid herself five months, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Thus has the Lord dealt with me in the days wherein he looked on me, to take away my reproach among men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God unto a city of Galilee, named Nazareth, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} To a virgin espoused to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David; and the virgin's name was Mary. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And the angel came in unto her, and said, Hail, you that are highly favoured, the Lord is with you: blessed are you among women. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And when she saw him, she was troubled at his saying, (o. logos) and cast in her mind what manner of salutation this should be. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And the angel said unto her, Fear not, Mary: for you have found favour with God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And, behold, you shall conceive in your womb, and bring forth a son, and shall call his name JESUS. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} He shall be great, and shall be called the Son of the Highest: and the Lord God shall give unto him the throne of his father David: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And he shall reign over the house of Jacob for ever; and of his kingdom there shall be no end. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Then said Mary unto the angel, How shall this be, seeing I know not a man? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And the angel answered and said unto her, The Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) shall come upon you, and the power of the Highest shall overshadow you: therefore also that holy thing which shall be born of you shall be called the Son of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And, behold, your cousin Elisabeth, she has also conceived a son in her old age: and this is the sixth month with her, who was called barren. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} For with God nothing (o. rhema) shall be impossible. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And Mary said, Behold the handmaid of the Lord; be it unto me according to your word. (o. rhema) And the angel departed from her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And Mary arose in those days, and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Juda; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And entered into the house of Zacharias, and saluted Elisabeth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And it came to pass, that, when Elisabeth heard the salutation of Mary, the babe leaped in her womb; and Elisabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit: (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And she spoke out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And whence is this to me, that the mother of my Lord should come to me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} For, lo, as soon as the voice of your salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} And blessed is she that believed: for there shall be a performance of those things which were told her from the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} And Mary said, My soul does magnify the Lord, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} And my spirit (o. pneuma) has rejoiced in God my Saviour. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} For he has regarded the low estate of his handmaiden: for, behold, from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} For he that is mighty has done to me great things; and holy is his name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} And his mercy is on them that fear him from generation to generation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} He has showed strength with his arm; he has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} He has put down the mighty from their seats, and exalted them of low degree. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} He has filled the hungry with good things; and the rich he has sent empty away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{54}} He has helped his servant Israel, in remembrance of his mercy; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{55}} As he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham, and to his seed for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{56}} And Mary abode with her about three months, and returned to her own house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{57}} Now Elisabeth's full time came that she should be delivered; and she brought forth a son. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{58}} And her neighbours and her cousins heard how the Lord had showed great mercy upon her; and they rejoiced with her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{59}} And it came to pass, that on the eighth day they came to circumcise the child; and they called him Zacharias, after the name of his father. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{60}} And his mother answered and said, Not so; but he shall be called John. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{61}} And they said unto her, There is none of your kindred that is called by this name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{62}} And they made signs to his father, how he would have him called. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{63}} And he asked for a writing table, and wrote, saying, His name is John. And they marvelled all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{64}} And his mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue loosed, and he spoke, and praised God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{65}} And fear came on all that dwelt round about them: and all these sayings (o. rhema) were noised abroad throughout all the hill country of Judaea. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{66}} And all they that heard them laid them up in their hearts, saying, What manner of child shall this be! And the hand of the Lord was with him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{67}} And his father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) and prophesied, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{68}} Blessed be the Lord God of Israel; for he has visited and redeemed his people, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{69}} And has raised up an horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{70}} As he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets, which have been since the world began: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{71}} That we should be saved from our enemies, and from the hand of all that hate us; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{72}} To perform the mercy promised to our fathers, and to remember his holy covenant; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{73}} The oath which he swore to our father Abraham, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{74}} That he would grant unto us, that we being delivered out of the hand of our enemies might serve him without fear, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{75}} In holiness and righteousness before him, all the days of our life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{76}} And you, child, shall be called the prophet of the Highest: for you shall go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{77}} To give knowledge of salvation unto his people by the remission of their sins, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{78}} Through the tender mercy of our God; whereby the dayspring from on high has visited us, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{79}} To give light to them that sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, to guide our feet into the way of peace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{80}} And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, (o. pneuma) and was in the deserts till the day of his showing unto Israel.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{3} Name meaning: Theophilus (Theophilos) — Lover of God The one Luke wrote to. \textsuperscript{5} Name meaning: Elizabeth (Elisheva) — God is my oath Mother of John; God kept His oath. Name meaning: Zacharias (Zekharyah) — Yahweh remembers Father of John; God remembered him. \textsuperscript{47} Name of God: Soter (σωτήρ) — Savior Common English renderings: Saviour. Declares God as the deliverer of His people; in the New Testament this title is also applied to Christ.\par}

\subsection*{Luke 2}
\markright{LUKE 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be taxed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} (And this taxing was first made when Cyrenius was governor of Syria.) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And all went to be taxed, every one into his own city. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judaea, unto the city of David, which is called Bethlehem; (because he was of the house and lineage of David:) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} To be taxed with Mary his espoused wife, being great with child. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And so it was, that, while they were there, the days were accomplished that she should be delivered. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And she brought forth her firstborn son, and wrapped him in swaddling clothes, and laid him in a crib; because there was no room for them in the inn. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the field, keeping watch over their flock by night. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And, lo, the angel of the Lord came upon them, and the glory of the Lord shone round about them: and they were sore afraid. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And the angel said unto them, Fear not: for, behold, I bring you good tidings of great joy, which shall be to all people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And this shall be a sign unto you; All of you shall find the babe wrapped in swaddling clothes, lying in a crib. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And suddenly there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly host praising God, and saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Glory to God in the highest, and on earth peace, good will toward men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And it came to pass, as the angels were gone away from them into heaven, the shepherds said one to another, Let us now go even unto Bethlehem, and see this thing (o. rhema) which has come to pass, which the Lord has made known unto us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And they came with haste, and found Mary, and Joseph, and the babe lying in a crib. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And when they had seen it, they made known abroad the saying (o. rhema) which was told them concerning this child. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And all they that heard it wondered at those things which were told them by the shepherds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} But Mary kept all these things, (o. rhema) and pondered them in her heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And the shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, as it was told unto them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And when eight days were accomplished for the circumcising of the child, his name was called JESUS, which was so named of the angel before he was conceived in the womb. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And when the days of her purification according to the law of Moses were accomplished, they brought him to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} (As it is written in the law of the LORD, Every male that opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord;) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And, behold, there was a man in Jerusalem, whose name was Simeon; and the same man was just and devout, waiting for the consolation of Israel: and the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) was upon him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And it was revealed unto him by the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) that he should not see death, before he had seen the Lord's Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And he came by the Spirit (o. pneuma) into the temple: and when the parents brought in the child Jesus, to do for him after the custom of the law, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Then took he him up in his arms, and blessed God, and said, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Lord, now let you your servant depart in peace, according to your word: (o. rhema) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} For mine eyes have seen your salvation, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Which you have prepared before the face of all people; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} A light to lighten the Gentiles, and the glory of your people Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And Joseph and his mother marvelled at those things which were spoken of him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And Simeon blessed them, and said unto Mary his mother, Behold, this child is set for the fall and rising again of many in Israel; and for a sign which shall be spoken against; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} (Yea, a sword shall pierce through your own soul also,) that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And there was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Aser: she was of a great age, and had lived with an husband seven years from her virginity; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And she was a widow of about fourscore and four years, which departed not from the temple, but served God with fastings and prayers night and day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And she coming in that instant gave thanks likewise unto the Lord, and spoke of him to all them that looked for redemption in Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And when they had performed all things according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city Nazareth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And the child grew, and waxed strong in spirit, (o. pneuma) filled with wisdom: and the grace of God was upon him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} Now his parents went to Jerusalem every year at the feast of the passover. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And when he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem after the custom of the feast. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And when they had fulfilled the days, as they returned, the child Jesus tarried behind in Jerusalem; and Joseph and his mother knew not of it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} But they, supposing him to have been in the company, went a day's journey; and they sought him among their kinsfolk and acquaintance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} And when they found him not, they turned back again to Jerusalem, seeking him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} And it came to pass, that after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the doctors, both hearing them, and asking them questions. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} And all that heard him were astonished at his understanding and answers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} And when they saw him, they were amazed: and his mother said unto him, Son, why have you thus dealt with us? behold, your father and I have sought you sorrowing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} And he said unto them, How is it that all of you sought me? know all of you not that I must be about my Father's business? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} And they understood not the saying (o. rhema) which he spoke unto them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth, and was subject unto them: but his mother kept all these sayings (o. rhema) in her heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favour with God and man.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{25} Name meaning: Simeon (NT) (Simeon) — Heard Held baby Jesus and declared he had seen salvation. \textsuperscript{29} Name of God: Despotes (δεσπότης) — Master; Sovereign Lord Common English renderings: Lord. A title emphasizing God’s absolute ownership and sovereign authority. \textsuperscript{32} Gk. vocab: apokalypsis (ἀποκάλυψις) = revelation; unveiling. Common English renderings: revelation. This lemma is not attested in the canonical Greek Old Testament. \textsuperscript{36} Name meaning: Anna (Channah) — Grace; favor Prophetess who recognized the Messiah.\par}

\subsection*{Luke 3}
\markright{LUKE 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judaea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of Abilene, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Annas and Caiaphas being the high priests, the word (o. rhema) of God came unto John the son of Zacharias in the wilderness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And he came into all the country about Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for the remission of sins; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} As it is written in the book of the words (o. logos) of Isaiah the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, Prepare all of you the way of the Lord, make his paths straight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Every valley shall be filled, and every mountain and hill shall be brought low; and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough ways shall be made smooth; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And all flesh shall see the salvation of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Then said he to the multitude that came forth to be baptized of him, O generation of vipers, who has warned you to flee from the wrath to come? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and begin not to say within yourselves, We have Abraham to our father: for I say unto you, That God is able of these stones to raise up children unto Abraham. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And now also the axe is laid unto the root of the trees: every tree therefore which brings not forth good fruit is hewn down, and cast into the fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And the people asked him, saying, What shall we do then? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} He answers and says unto them, He that has two coats, let him impart to him that has none; and he that has food, let him do likewise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Then came also publicans to be baptized, and said unto him, Master, what shall we do? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And he said unto them, Exact no more than that which is appointed you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And as the people were in expectation, and all men mused in their hearts of John, whether he were the Christ, or not; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} John answered, saying unto them all, I indeed baptize you with water; but one mightier than I comes, the latchet of whose shoes I am not worthy to unloose: he shall baptize you with the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) and with fire: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly purge his floor, and will gather the wheat into his garner; but the chaff he will burn with fire unquenchable. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And many other things in his exhortation preached he unto the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} But Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias his brother Philip's wife, and for all the evils which Herod had done, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Added yet this above all, that he shut up John in prison. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Now when all the people were baptized, it came to pass, that Jesus also being baptized, and praying, the heaven was opened, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) descended in a bodily shape like a dove upon him, and a voice came from heaven, which said, You are my beloved Son; in you I am well pleased. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And Jesus himself began to be about thirty years of age, being (as was supposed) the son of Joseph, which was the son of Heli, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Janna, which was the son of Joseph, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Amos, which was the son of Naum, which was the son of Esli, which was the son of Nagge, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Which was the son of Maath, which was the son of Mattathias, which was the son of Semei, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Juda, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Which was the son of Joanna, which was the son of Rhesa, which was the son of Zorobabel, which was the son of Salathiel, which was the son of Neri, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of Addi, which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Which was the son of Jose, which was the son of Eliezer, which was the son of Jorim, which was the son of Matthat, which was the son of Levi, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Which was the son of Simeon, which was the son of Juda, which was the son of Joseph, which was the son of Jonan, which was the son of Eliakim, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Which was the son of Melea, which was the son of Menan, which was the son of Mattatha, which was the son of Nathan, which was the son of David, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Which was the son of Jesse, which was the son of Obed, which was the son of Booz, which was the son of Salmon, which was the son of Naasson, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Which was the son of Aminadab, which was the son of Aram, which was the son of Esrom, which was the son of Phares, which was the son of Juda, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Which was the son of Jacob, which was the son of Isaac, which was the son of Abraham, which was the son of Thara, which was the son of Nachor, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Which was the son of Saruch, which was the son of Ragau, which was the son of Phalec, which was the son of Heber, which was the son of Sala, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Which was the son of Cainan, which was the son of Arphaxad, which was the son of Sem, which was the son of Noe, which was the son of Lamech, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Which was the son of Mathusala, which was the son of Enoch, which was the son of Jared, which was the son of Maleleel, which was the son of Cainan, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Which was the son of Enos, which was the son of Seth, which was the son of Adam, which was the son of God.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} am 4030, ad 26 Tiberius Caesar Pontius Pilate;, Herod, his; Ituraea was a province of Syria east of Jordan, now called Djedour, according to Burckhardt, and comprising all the flat country south of Djebel Kessoue as far as Nowa, east of Djebel el Sheikh, or mount Hermon, and west of the Hadj road. Trachonitis, according to Strabo and Ptolemy, comprehended all the uneven country on the east of Auranitis, now Haouran, from near Damascus to Bozra, now called El Ledja and Djebel Haouran. Abilene was a district in the valley of Lebanon, so called from Abila its chief town, eighteen miles n of Damascus, according to Antoninus. \textsuperscript{8} fruits; worthy of or, meet for We; of these \textsuperscript{14} the soldiers; Do violence to no man or, Put no man in fear; accuse; and be; wages or, allowance \textsuperscript{15} expectation or, suspense, mused or, reasoned, or debated \textsuperscript{16} I indeed; , he shall; and with \textsuperscript{21} that; and praying; the heaven \textsuperscript{23} thirty;, being; which The real father of Joseph was Jacob ( ); but having married the daughter of Heli, and being perhaps adopted by him, he was called his son, and as such was entered in the public registers; Mary not being mentioned, because the Hebrews never permitted the name of a woman to enter the genealogical tables, but inserted her husband as the son of him who was, in reality, but his father-in-law. Hence it appears that Matthew, who wrote principally for the Jews, traces the pedigree of Jesus Christ from Abraham, through whom the promises were given to the Jews, to David, and from David, through the line of Solomon, to Jacob the father of Joseph, the reputed or legal father of Christ; and that Luke, who wrote for the Gentiles, extends his genealogy upwards from Heli, the father of Mary, through the line of Nathan, to David, and from David to Abraham, and from Abraham to Adam, who was the immediate "son of God" by creation, and to whom the promise of the Saviour was given in behalf of himself and all his posterity. The two branches of descent from David, by Solomon and Nathan, being thus united in the persons of Mary and Joseph, Jesus the son of Mary re-united in himself all the blood, privileges, and rights, of the whole family of David; in consequence of which he is emphatically called "the Son of David." \textsuperscript{32} was the son of Jesse; which was the son of Obed, ; Nahshon, Salma, Boaz \textsuperscript{33} Aminadab; Aminadab Ram, Hezron, Esrom; Hezron Phares;, Pharez of Juda, Judah, Judas \textsuperscript{34} which was the son of Isaac; Thara; Terah, Nahor, Reu, Serug, Peleg, Eber, Shelah \textsuperscript{35} Saruch, Serug, Reu Phalec, Peleg Heber, Eber Sala, Salah \textsuperscript{36} Cainan This Cainan is not found in the Hebrew Text of any of the genealogies, but only in the Septuagint; from which, probably, the evangelist transcribed the register, as sufficiently exact for his purpose, and as more generally suited to command attention. (See note on .) It may here be remarked, that though some of the same names occur here, from Nathan downwards, as in Joseph's genealogy, yet there appears no sufficient evidence that the same persons were intended, different persons often bearing the same name. \subsection*{Luke 4}
\markright{LUKE 4}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And Jesus being full of the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) returned from Jordan, and was led by the Spirit (o. pneuma) into the wilderness, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Being forty days tempted of the devil. And in those days he did eat nothing: and when they were ended, he afterward hungered. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And the devil said unto him, If you be the Son of God, command this stone that it be made bread. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, That man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word (o. rhema) of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And the devil, taking him up into an high mountain, showed unto him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And the devil said unto him, All this power will I give you, and the glory of them: for that is delivered unto me; and to whomsoever I will I give it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} If you therefore will worship me, all shall be yours. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And Jesus answered and said unto him, Get you behind me, Satan: for it is written, You shall worship the Lord your God, and him only shall you serve. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And he brought him to Jerusalem, and set him on a pinnacle of the temple, and said unto him, If you be the Son of God, cast yourself down from behind: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For it is written, He shall give his angels charge over you, to keep you: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And in their hands they shall bear you up, lest at any time you dash your foot against a stone. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And Jesus answering said unto him, It is said, You shall not tempt the Lord your God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And when the devil had ended all the temptation, he departed from him for a season. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit (o. pneuma) into Galilee: and there went out a fame of him through all the region round about. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And he taught in their synagogues, being glorified of all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And he came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up: and, as his custom was, he went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and stood up in order to read. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And there was delivered unto him the book of the prophet Isaiah. And when he had opened the book, he found the place where it was written, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} The Spirit (o. pneuma) of the Lord is upon me, because he has anointed me to preach the gospel to the poor; he has sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to preach deliverance to the captives, and recovering of sight to the blind, to set at liberty them that are bruised, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} To preach the acceptable year of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And he closed the book, and he gave it again to the minister, and sat down. And the eyes of all them that were in the synagogue were fastened on him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And he began to say unto them, This day is this scripture fulfilled in your ears. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And all bare him witness, and wondered at the gracious words (o. logos) which proceeded out of his mouth. And they said, Is not this Joseph's son? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And he said unto them, All of you will surely say unto me this proverb, Physician, heal yourself: whatsoever we have heard done in Capernaum, do also here in your country. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And he said, Verily I say unto you, No prophet is accepted in his own country. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} But I tell you truthfully, many widows were in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the heaven was shut up three years and six months, when great famine was throughout all the land; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} But unto none of them was Elijah sent, save unto Sarepta, a city of Sidon, unto a woman that was a widow. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And many lepers were in Israel in the time of Eliseus the prophet; and none of them was cleansed, saving Naaman the Syrian. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And all they in the synagogue, when they heard these things, were filled with wrath, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And rose up, and thrust him out of the city, and led him unto the brow of the hill whereon their city was built, that they might cast him down headlong. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} But he passing through the midst of them went his way, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee, and taught them on the sabbath days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And they were astonished at his doctrine: for his word (o. logos) was with power. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And in the synagogue there was a man, which had a spirit (o. pneuma) of an unclean devil, and cried out with a loud voice, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Saying, Let us alone; what have we to do with you, you Jesus of Nazareth? are you come to destroy us? I know you who you are; the Holy One of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And Jesus rebuked him, saying, Hold your peace, and come out of him. And when the devil had thrown him in the midst, he came out of him, and hurt him not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And they were all amazed, and spoke among themselves, saying, What a word (o. logos) is this! for with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, (o. pneuma) and they come out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And the fame of him went out into every place of the country round about. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And he arose out of the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. And Simon's wife's mother was taken with a great fever; and they besought him for her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And he stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her: and immediately she arose and ministered unto them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} Now when the sun was setting, all they that had any sick with divers diseases brought them unto him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And devils also came out of many, crying out, and saying, You are Christ the Son of God. And he rebuking them suffered them not to speak: for they knew that he was Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And when it was day, he departed and went into a desert place: and the people sought him, and came unto him, and stayed him, that he should not depart from them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And he said unto them, I must preach the kingdom of God to other cities also: for therefore am I sent. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And he preached in the synagogues of Galilee.\par

\subsection*{Luke 5}
\markright{LUKE 5}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it came to pass, that, as the people pressed upon him to hear the word (o. logos) of God, he stood by the lake of Gennesaret, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And he entered into one of the ships, which was Simon's, and prayed him that he would thrust out a little from the land. And he sat down, and taught the people out of the ship. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And Simon answering said unto him, Master, we have toiled all the night, and have taken nothing: nevertheless at your word (o. rhema) I will let down the net. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And when they had this done, they enclosed a great multitude of fishes: and their net brake. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And they beckoned unto their partners, which were in the other ship, that they should come and help them. And they came, and filled both the ships, so that they began to sink. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} When Simon Peter saw it, he fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me; for I am a sinful man, O Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the draught of the fishes which they had taken: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And so was also James, and John, the sons of Zebedee, which were partners with Simon. And Jesus said unto Simon, Fear not; from henceforth you shall catch men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And when they had brought their ships to land, they forsook all, and followed him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And it came to pass, when he was in a certain city, behold a man full of leprosy: who seeing Jesus fell on his face, and besought him, saying, Lord, if you will, you can make me clean. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And he put forth his hand, and touched him, saying, I will: be you clean. And immediately the leprosy departed from him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And he charged him to tell no man: but go, and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing, according as Moses commanded, for a testimony unto them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} But so much the more went there a fame (o. logos) abroad of him: and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And he withdrew himself into the wilderness, and prayed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And it came to pass on a certain day, as he was teaching, that there were Pharisees and doctors of the law sitting by, which were come out of every town of Galilee, and Judaea, and Jerusalem: and the power of the Lord was present to heal them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And when he saw their faith, he said unto him, Man, your sins are forgiven you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And the scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this which speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} But when Jesus perceived their thoughts, he answering said unto them, What reason all of you in your hearts? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Whether is easier, to say, Your sins be forgiven you; or to say, Rise up and walk? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} But that all of you may know that the Son of man has power upon earth to forgive sins, (he said unto the sick of the palsy,) I say unto you, Arise, and take up your couch, and go into yours house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And immediately he rose up before them, and took up that whereon he lay, and departed to his own house, glorifying God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And they were all amazed, and they glorified God, and were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things to day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And after these things he went forth, and saw a publican, named Levi, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he said unto him, Follow me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And he left all, rose up, and followed him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And Levi made him a great feast in his own house: and there was a great company of publicans and of others that sat down with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} But their scribes and Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do all of you eat and drink with publicans and sinners? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And they said unto him, Why do the disciples of John fast often, and make prayers, and likewise the disciples of the Pharisees; but yours eat and drink? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And he said unto them, Can all of you make the children of the bride-chamber fast, while the bridegroom is with them? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} But the days will come, when the bridegroom shall be taken away from them, and then shall they fast in those days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And he spoke also a parable unto them; No man puts a piece of a new garment upon an old; if otherwise, then both the new makes a rent, and the piece that was taken out of the new agrees not with the old. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And no man puts new wine into old bottles; else the new wine will burst the bottles, and be spilled, and the bottles shall perish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} But new wine must be put into new bottles; and both are preserved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} No man also having drunk old wine immediately desires new: for he says, The old is better.\par

\subsection*{Luke 6}
\markright{LUKE 6}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do all of you that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And Jesus answering them said, Have all of you not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungered, and they which were with him; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the showbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth your hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: (o. pneuma) and they were healed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be all of you poor: for yours is the kingdom of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Blessed are all of you that hunger now: for all of you shall be filled. Blessed are all of you that weep now: for all of you shall laugh. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Blessed are all of you, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Rejoice all of you in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} But woe unto you that are rich! for all of you have received your consolation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Woe unto you that are full! for all of you shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for all of you shall mourn and weep. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And unto him that strikes you on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that takes away your cloak forbid not to take your coat also. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Give to every man that asks of you; and of him that takes away your goods ask them not again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And as all of you would that men should do to you, do all of you also to them likewise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} For if all of you love them which love you, what thank have all of you? for sinners also love those that love them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And if all of you do good to them which do good to you, what thank have all of you? for sinners also do even the same. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And if all of you lend to them of whom all of you hope to receive, what thank have all of you? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} But love all of you your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and all of you shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Be all of you therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Judge not, and all of you shall not be judged: condemn not, and all of you shall not be condemned: forgive, and all of you shall be forgiven: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that all of you mete likewise it shall be measured to you again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And he spoke a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And why behold you the splinter that is in your brother's eye, but perceive not the beam that is in yours own eye? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} Either how can you say to your brother, Brother, let me pull out the splinter that is in yours eye, when you yourself behold not the beam that is in yours own eye? You hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of yours own eye, and then shall you see clearly to pull out the splinter that is in your brother's eye. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} For a good tree brings not forth corrupt fruit; neither does a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} A good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaks. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} And why call all of you me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} Whosoever comes to me, and hears my sayings, (o. logos) and does them, I will show you to whom he is like: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} He is like a man which built an house, and dug deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} But he that hears, and does not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{15} Name meaning: Simon the Zealot (Shimon) — He has heard Zealous revolutionary transformed into apostle. \textsuperscript{16} Name meaning: Judas (not Iscariot) (Yehudah) — Praise Praised God; associated with the epistle of Jude.\par}

\subsection*{Luke 7}
\markright{LUKE 7}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Now when he had ended all his sayings (o. rhema) in the audience of the people, he entered into Capernaum. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And a certain centurion's servant, who was dear unto him, was sick, and ready to die. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And when he heard of Jesus, he sent unto him the elders of the Jews, beseeching him that he would come and heal his servant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And when they came to Jesus, they besought him instantly, saying, That he was worthy for whom he should do this: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For he loves our nation, and he has built us a synagogue. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Then Jesus went with them. And when he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying unto him, Lord, trouble not yourself: for I am not worthy that you should enter under my roof: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Wherefore neither thought I myself worthy to come unto you: but say in a word, (o. logos) and my servant shall be healed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For I also am a man set under authority, having under me soldiers, and I say unto one, Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my servant, Do this, and he does it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} When Jesus heard these things, he marvelled at him, and turned him about, and said unto the people that followed him, I say unto you, I have not found so great faith, no, not in Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And they that were sent, returning to the house, found the servant whole that had been sick. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And it came to pass the day after, that he went into a city called Nain; and many of his disciples went with him, and much people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Now when he came nigh to the gate of the city, behold, there was a dead man carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow: and much people of the city was with her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And when the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said unto her, Weep not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And he came and touched the bier: and they that bare him stood still. And he said, Young man, I say unto you, Arise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And he that was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he delivered him to his mother. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And there came a fear on all: and they glorified God, saying, That a great prophet has risen up among us; and, That God has visited his people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And this rumour (o. logos) of him went forth throughout all Judaea, and throughout all the region round about. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And the disciples of John showed him of all these things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And John calling unto him two of his disciples sent them to Jesus, saying, Are you he that should come? or look we for another? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} When the men were come unto him, they said, John Baptist has sent us unto you, saying, Are you he that should come? or look we for another? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And in that same hour he cured many of their infirmities and plagues, and of evil spirits; (o. pneuma) and unto many that were blind he gave sight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Then Jesus answering said unto them, Go your way, and tell John what things all of you have seen and heard; how that the blind see, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, to the poor the gospel is preached. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And blessed is he, whosoever shall not be offended in me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And when the messengers of John were departed, he began to speak unto the people concerning John, What went all of you out into the wilderness in order to see? A reed shaken with the wind? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} But what went all of you out in order to see? A man clothed in soft raiment? Behold, they which are gorgeously apparelled, and live delicately, are in kings' courts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} But what went all of you out in order to see? A prophet? Yea, I say unto you, and much more than a prophet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} This is he, of whom it is written, Behold, I send my messenger before your face, which shall prepare your way before you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} For I say unto you, Among those that are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptist: but he that is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And all the people that heard him, and the publicans, justified God, being baptized with the baptism of John. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} But the Pharisees and lawyers rejected the counsel of God against themselves, being not baptized of him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And the Lord said, Unto which then shall I liken the men of this generation? and to what are they like? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} They are like unto children sitting in the marketplace, and calling one to another, and saying, We have piped unto you, and all of you have not danced; we have mourned to you, and all of you have not wept. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} For John the Baptist came neither eating bread nor drinking wine; and all of you say, He has a devil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} The Son of man has come eating and drinking; and all of you say, Behold a gluttonous man, and a wine indulger, a friend of publicans and sinners! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} But wisdom is justified of all her children. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And one of the Pharisees desired him that he would eat with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house, and sat down to food. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And, behold, a woman in the city, which was a sinner, when she knew that Jesus sat at food in the Pharisee's house, brought an alabaster box of ointment, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And stood at his feet behind him weeping, and began to wash his feet with tears, and did wipe them with the hairs of her head, and kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} Now when the Pharisee which had bidden him saw it, he spoke within himself, saying, This man, if he were a prophet, would have known who and what manner of woman this is that touches him: for she is a sinner. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And Jesus answering said unto him, Simon, I have somewhat to say unto you. And he says, Master, say on. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} There was a certain creditor which had two debtors: the one owed five hundred pence, and the other fifty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And when they had nothing to pay, he frankly forgave them both. Tell me therefore, which of them will love him most? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} Simon answered and said, I suppose that he, to whom he forgave most. And he said unto him, You have rightly judged. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And he turned to the woman, and said unto Simon, See you this woman? I entered into yours house, you gave me no water for my feet: but she has washed my feet with tears, and wiped them with the hairs of her head. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} You gave me no kiss: but this woman since the time I came in has not ceased to kiss my feet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} My head with oil you did not anoint: but this woman has anointed my feet with ointment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} Wherefore I say unto you, Her sins, which are many, are forgiven; for she loved much: but to whom little is forgiven, the same loves little. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} And he said unto her, Your sins are forgiven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} And they that sat at food with him began to say within themselves, Who is this that forgives sins also? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} And he said to the woman, Your faith has saved you; go in peace.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{12} Gk. vocab: monogenēs (μονογενής) = only begotten; one of a kind. Common English renderings: only begotten. In Johannine theology this term is especially important in relation to the Son.\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{8} under, one Gr. this man and he goeth \textsuperscript{12} the only; , ; a widow; and much \textsuperscript{16} a fear, ; they; a great, ;, ; God \textsuperscript{19} John When we remember the Baptist's solemn testimony to Christ, the sign from heaven, and the miraculous impulse which made him acknowledge Jesus the Messiah, we shall be constrained to think that he sent to Christ, not for his own satisfaction, but for that of his disciples. two; Art \textsuperscript{21} plagues; evil spirits Πνευματα, πονηρα, are here clearly distinguished from bodily disorders. \textsuperscript{22} Go how; the lame;, the lepers, the deaf; the dead, to \textsuperscript{30} rejected or, frustrated; the counsel; against or, within \textsuperscript{39} he spake, ; This man;, would \textsuperscript{41} a certain, *marg.; the one; pence *marg. the other \textsuperscript{45} gavest; this Many have supposed that this person was Mary Magdalene, and Mary the sister of Lazarus. But there is no indication in the gospel history, that Mary Magdalene was the sister of Lazarus; but on the contrary, it would appear that they were perfectly distinct persons, the sister of Lazarus residing at Bethany, while Mary Magdalene appears to have resided at Magdala, east of Jordan, a distance of nearly ninety miles. Add to this, that our Saviour seems to have been now in or near Nain, not at Bethany; and the woman appears from the recital to have been previously unknown to him.\par}
