\subsection*{Luke 8}
\markright{LUKE 8}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and showing the glad tidings of the kingdom of God: and the twelve were with him, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits (o. pneuma) and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod's steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spoke by a parable: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that has ears to hear, let him hear. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And he said, Unto you it is given to know the mysteries of the kingdom of God: but to others in parables; that seeing they might not see, and hearing they might not understand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Now the parable is this: The seed is the word (o. logos) of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Those by the way side are they that hear; then comes the devil, and takes away the word (o. logos) out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word (o. logos) with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, (o. logos) keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} No man, when he has lighted a candle, covers it with a vessel, or puts it under a bed; but sets it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Take heed therefore how all of you hear: for whosoever has, to him shall be given; and whosoever has not, from him shall be taken even that which he seems to have. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And it was told him by certain which said, Your mother and your brethren stand without, desiring to see you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word (o. logos) of God, and do it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commands even the winds and water, and they obey him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite to Galilee. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of God most high? I plead to you, torment me not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} (For he had commanded the unclean spirit (o. pneuma) to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And Jesus asked him, saying, What is your name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Jesus, and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Jesus, clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Jesus sent him away, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} Return to yours own house, and show how great things God has done unto you. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Jesus had done unto him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And it came to pass, that, when Jesus was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Jesus' feet, and besought him that he would come into his house: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stopped. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} And Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude crowd upon you and press you, and says you, Who touched me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} And Jesus said, Somebody has touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: your faith has made you whole; go in peace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} While he yet spoke, there comes one from the ruler of the synagogue's house, saying to him, Your daughter is dead; trouble not the Master. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} But when Jesus heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleeps. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{54}} And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{55}} And her spirit (o. pneuma) came again, and she arose immediately: and he commanded to give her food. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{56}} And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.\par

But who, by simply saying Peace, be still ( ), could do this but God? One word of our Lord can change the face of nature, and calm the troubled ocean, as well as restore peace to the disconsolate soul. \textsuperscript{28} he cried; What I beseech \textsuperscript{31} they; the deep "The abyss, " says Dr. Doddridge, "the prison in which many of these fallen spirits are detained; and to which some, who may, like these, have been permitted for a while to range at large, are sometimes by Divine justice and power remanded." \textsuperscript{32} there an; besought; he suffered \textsuperscript{33} Then By this was fully evinced the sovereign power of our Lord, and the reality of diabolical agency; "for, " says Dr. Doddridge, "it was self-evident that a herd of swine could not be confederates in any fraud; their death, therefore, in this instructive circumstance, was ten thousand times a greater blessing to mankind than if they had been slain for food, as was intended." the herd \textsuperscript{35} and found; sitting; clothed, in his \textsuperscript{41} there; a ruler;, and he fell; and besought \textsuperscript{45} Who "Not that he was ignorant who had touched him, " says Epiphanius, "but that he might not be himself the divulger of the miracle, and that the woman, hearing the question, and drawing near, might testify the singular benefit she had received, and that, in consequence of her declaration, she might presently hear from his lips, that her faith had saved her; and by this means, others might be excited to come and be healed of their disorders." the multitude \textsuperscript{47} when; she came; she declared \textsuperscript{55} her spirit This expression, thus used of one who had been dead, strongly implies, that at death the soul not only exists separately, but returns and is re-united to the body, when it is raised from the dead.; and he\par}

\subsection*{Luke 9}
\markright{LUKE 9}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then he called his twelve disciples together, and gave them power and authority over all devils, and to cure diseases. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And he sent them to preach the kingdom of God, and to heal the sick. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And he said unto them, Take nothing for your journey, neither staves, nor pouch, neither bread, neither money; neither have two coats apiece. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And whatsoever house all of you enter into, there abide, and thence depart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And whosoever will not receive you, when all of you go out of that city, shake off the very dust from your feet for a testimony against them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And they departed, and went through the towns, preaching the gospel, and healing every where. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him: and he was perplexed, because that it was said of some, that John was risen from the dead; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And of some, that Elijah had appeared; and of others, that one of the old prophets was risen again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And Herod said, John have I beheaded: but who is this, of whom I hear such things? And he desired to see him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And the apostles, when they were returned, told him all that they had done. And he took them, and went aside privately into a desert place belonging to the city called Bethsaida. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And the people, when they knew it, followed him: and he received them, and spoke unto them of the kingdom of God, and healed them that had need of healing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And when the day began to wear away, then came the twelve, and said unto him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the towns and country round about, and lodge, and get victuals: for we are here in a desert place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} But he said unto them, Give all of you them to eat. And they said, We have no more but five loaves and two fishes; except we should go and buy food for all this people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For they were about five thousand men. And he said to his disciples, Make them sit down by fifties in a company. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And they did so, and made them all sit down. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Then he took the five loaves and the two fishes, and looking up to heaven, he blessed them, and brake, and gave to the disciples to set before the multitude. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And they did eat, and were all filled: and there was taken up of fragments that remained to them twelve baskets. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And it came to pass, as he was alone praying, his disciples were with him: and he asked them, saying, Whom say the people that I am? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} They answering said, John the Baptist; but some say, Elijah; and others say, that one of the old prophets has risen again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} He said unto them, But whom say all of you that I am? Peter answering said, The Christ of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And he strictly charged them, and commanded them to tell no man that thing; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Saying, The Son of man must suffer many things, and be rejected of the elders and chief priests and scribes, and be slain, and be raised the third day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And he said to them all, If any man will come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross daily, and follow me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} For whosoever will save his life shall lose it: but whosoever will lose his life for my sake, the same shall save it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} For what is a man advantaged, if he gain the whole world, and lose himself, or be cast away? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, (o. logos) of him shall the Son of man be ashamed, when he shall come in his own glory, and in his Father's, and of the holy angels. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} But I tell you truthfully, there be some standing here, which shall not taste of death, till they see the kingdom of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And it came to pass about an eight days after these sayings, (o. logos) he took Peter and John and James, and went up into a mountain to pray. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And as he prayed, the fashion of his countenance was altered, and his raiment was white and flashing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And, behold, there talked with him two men, which were Moses and Elijah: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Who appeared in glory, and spoke of his decease which he should accomplish at Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} But Peter and they that were with him were heavy with sleep: and when they were awake, they saw his glory, and the two men that stood with him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And it came to pass, as they departed from him, Peter said unto Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tabernacles; one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah: not knowing what he said. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} While he thus spoke, there came a cloud, and overshadowed them: and they feared as they entered into the cloud. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And there came a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son: hear him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And when the voice was past, Jesus was found alone. And they kept it close, and told no man in those days any of those things which they had seen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And it came to pass, that on the next day, when they were come down from the hill, much people met him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And, behold, a man of the company cried out, saying, Master, I plead to you, look upon my son: for he is mine only child. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And, lo, a spirit (o. pneuma) takes him, and he suddenly cries out; and it tears him that he foams again, and bruising him hardly departs from him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And I besought your disciples to cast him out; and they could not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And Jesus answering said, O faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you, and suffer you? Bring your son here. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And as he was yet a coming, the devil threw him down, and tare him. And Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, (o. pneuma) and healed the child, and delivered him again to his father. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And they were all amazed at the mighty power of God. But while they wondered every one at all things which Jesus did, he said unto his disciples, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} Let these sayings (o. logos) sink down into your ears: for the Son of man shall be delivered into the hands of men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} But they understood not this saying, (o. rhema) and it was hid from them, that they perceived it not: and they feared to ask him of that saying. (o. rhema) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} Then there arose a reasoning among them, which of them should be greatest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} And Jesus, perceiving the thought of their heart, took a child, and set him by him, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} And said unto them, Whosoever shall receive this child in my name receives me: and whosoever shall receive me receives him that sent me: for he that is least among you all, the same shall be great. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} And John answered and said, Master, we saw one casting out devils in your name; and we forbad him, because he follows not with us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} And Jesus said unto him, Forbid him not: for he that is not against us is for us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} And it came to pass, when the time was come that he should be received up, he steadfastly set his face to go to Jerusalem, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} And sent messengers before his face: and they went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, to make ready for him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} And they did not receive him, because his face was as though he would go to Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{54}} And when his disciples James and John saw this, they said, Lord, will you that we command fire to come down from heaven, and consume them, even as Elijah did? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{55}} But he turned, and rebuked them, and said, All of you know not what manner of spirit (o. pneuma) all of you are of. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{56}} For the Son of man is not come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. And they went to another village. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{57}} And it came to pass, that, as they went in the way, a certain man said unto him, Lord, I will follow you anywhere you go. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{58}} And Jesus said unto him, Foxes have holes, and birds of the air have nests; but the Son of man has not where to lay his head. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{59}} And he said unto another, Follow me. But he said, Lord, suffer me first to go and bury my father. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{60}} Jesus said unto him, Let the dead bury their dead: but go you and preach the kingdom of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{61}} And another also said, Lord, I will follow you; but let me first go bid them farewell, which are at home at my house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{62}} And Jesus said unto him, No man, having put his hand to the plough, and looking back, is fit for the kingdom of God.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{7} am 4036, ad 32 Herod; Tetrarch A tetrarch, τετραρχης, from τετρας, four, and αρχη, government, properly signifies a prince, or ruler over a quarter of any region; and had its origin from Galatia, which was governed by four princes. In the New Testament, however, it denotes a prince, or king, who reigns over the fourth part of a former kingdom. By Herod's will his kingdom was thus divided among his sons: Archelaus had one-half, consisting of Idumea, Judea, and Samaria; Herod Antipas, one-fourth, consisting of Galilee and Perea; and Philip the remaining fourth, consisting of Batanea, Trachonitis, and Auranitis. he \textsuperscript{10} the apostles; he took; Bethsaida \textsuperscript{11} when; and he; the kingdom; healed \textsuperscript{25} what, ; himself Or, as in the parallel passage, την ψυχην ( πσψχην ), αυτου, "his soul, " or life. be \textsuperscript{27} I tell; some taste; see \textsuperscript{28} about; sayings or, things he; into \textsuperscript{33} it is, ; and let; not \textsuperscript{41} O faithless; , perverse;, ; how; and suffer; Bring \textsuperscript{48} Whosoever shall receive this;, ; he that \textsuperscript{52} sent; and they the Samaritans\par}

\subsection*{Luke 10}
\markright{LUKE 10}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} After these things the LORD appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, where he himself would come. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Therefore said he unto them, The harvest truly is great, but the labourers are few: pray all of you therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he would send forth labourers into his harvest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Go your ways: behold, I send you forth as lambs among wolves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Carry neither purse, nor pouch, nor shoes: and salute no man by the way. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And into whatsoever house all of you enter, first say, Peace be to this house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And if the son of peace be there, your peace shall rest upon it: if not, it shall turn to you again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And in the same house remain, eating and drinking such things as they give: for the labourer is worthy of his hire. Go not from house to house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And into whatsoever city all of you enter, and they receive you, eat such things as are set before you: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of God has come nigh unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} But into whatsoever city all of you enter, and they receive you not, go your ways out into the streets of the same, and say, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Even the very dust of your city, which cleaves on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be all of you sure of this, that the kingdom of God has come nigh unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} But I say unto you, that it shall be more tolerable in that day for Sodom, than for that city. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Woe unto you, Chorazin! woe unto you, Bethsaida! for if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon, which have been done in you, they had a great while ago repented, sitting in sackcloth and ashes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} But it shall be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon at the judgment, than for you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And you, Capernaum, which are exalted to heaven, shall be thrust down to hell. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} He that hears you hears me; and he that despises you despises me; and he that despises me despises him that sent me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Lord, even the devils are subject unto us through your name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits (o. pneuma) are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} In that hour Jesus rejoiced in spirit, (o. pneuma) and said, I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hid these things from the wise and prudent, and have revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in your sight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knows who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And he turned him unto his disciples, and said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that all of you see: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} For I tell you, that many prophets and kings have desired to see those things which all of you see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which all of you hear, and have not heard them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And, behold, a certain lawyer stood up, and tempted him, saying, Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} He said unto him, What is written in the law? how read you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And he answering said, You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbour as yourself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And he said unto him, You have answered right: this do, and you shall live. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} But he, willing to justify himself, said unto Jesus, And who is my neighbour? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And Jesus answering said, A certain man went down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and fell among thieves, which stripped him of his raiment, and wounded him, and departed, leaving him half dead. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And by chance there came down a certain priest that way: and when he saw him, he passed by on the other side. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And likewise a Levite, when he was at the place, came and looked on him, and passed by on the other side. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} But a certain Samaritan, as he journeyed, came where he was: and when he saw him, he had compassion on him, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And went to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring in oil and wine, and set him on his own beast, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And on the next day when he departed, he took out two pence, and gave them to the host, and said unto him, Take care of him; and whatsoever you spend more, when I come again, I will repay you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Which now of these three, think you, was neighbour unto him that fell among the thieves? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And he said, He that showed mercy on him. Then said Jesus unto him, Go, and do you likewise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Now it came to pass, as they went, that he entered into a certain village: and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And she had a sister called Mary, which also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word. (o. logos) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} But Martha was cumbered about much serving, and came to him, and said, Lord, do you not care that my sister has left me to serve alone? bid her therefore that she help me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And Jesus answered and said unto her, Martha, Martha, you are careful and troubled about many things: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} But one thing is necessary: and Mary has chosen that good part, which shall not be taken away from her.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{38} Name meaning: Martha (Martha) — Lady; mistress Busy homemaker who learned to sit at Jesus’ feet.\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} these; other seventy Rather, seventy others, as Dr. Campbell renders; for the expression other seventy implies that there were seventy sent before, which was not the case. It seems to refer to the twelve apostles whom our Lord had previously chosen., two and; whither \textsuperscript{2} The harvest; the labourers; are; pray the Lord \textsuperscript{6} the Son; *Gr: it shall \textsuperscript{13} unto for; Tyre; Ezek. 26:1-28:26 which; repented \textsuperscript{16} heareth you; despiseth you; despiseth him \textsuperscript{21} Jesus; I thank; Lord; thou hast; revealed; even \textsuperscript{22} All things "Many ancient copies add, And turning to his disciples he said.";, ; and no \textsuperscript{31} by *marg.; priest; he passed \textsuperscript{35} two pence the host whatsoever\par}

\subsection*{Luke 11}
\markright{LUKE 11}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it came to pass, that, as he was praying in a certain place, when he ceased, one of his disciples said unto him, Lord, teach us to pray, as John also taught his disciples. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And he said unto them, When all of you pray, say, Our Father which are in heaven, Hallowed be your name. Your kingdom come. Your will be done, as in heaven, so in earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Give us day by day our daily bread. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And forgive us our sins; for we also forgive every one that is indebted to us. And lead us not into temptation; but deliver us from evil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And he said unto them, Which of you shall have a friend, and shall go unto him at midnight, and say unto him, Friend, lend me three loaves; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} For a friend of mine in his journey has come to me, and I have nothing to set before him? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And he from within shall answer and say, Trouble me not: the door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed; I cannot rise and give you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I say unto you, Though he will not rise and give him, because he is his friend, yet because of his importunity he will rise and give him as many as he needs. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And I say unto you, Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and all of you shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For every one that asks receives; and he that seeks finds; and to him that knocks it shall be opened. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} If a son shall ask bread of any of you that is a father, will he give him a stone? or if he ask a fish, will he for a fish give him a serpent? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Or if he shall ask an egg, will he offer him a scorpion? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} If all of you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children: how much more shall your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) to them that ask him? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And he was casting out a devil, and it was dumb. And it came to pass, when the devil was gone out, the dumb spoke; and the people wondered. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} But some of them said, He casts out devils through Beelzebub the chief of the devils. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And others, tempting him, sought of him a sign from heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falls. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand? because all of you say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And if I by Beelzebub cast out devils, by whom do your sons cast them out? therefore shall they be your judges. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But if I with the finger of God cast out devils, no doubt the kingdom of God has come upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} When a strong man armed keeps his palace, his goods are in peace: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} But when a stronger than he shall come upon him, and overcome him, he takes from him all his armour wherein he trusted, and divides his spoils. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} He that is not with me is against me: and he that gathers not with me scatters. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} When the unclean spirit (o. pneuma) is gone out of a man, he walks through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, I will return unto my house whence I came out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And when he comes, he finds it swept and garnished. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Then goes he, and takes to him seven other spirits (o. pneuma) more wicked than himself; and they enter in, and dwell there: and the last state of that man is worse than the first. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And it came to pass, as he spoke these things, a certain woman of the company lifted up her voice, and said unto him, Blessed is the womb that bare you, and the breast which you have sucked. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} But he said, Yea rather, blessed are they that hear the word (o. logos) of God, and keep it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And when the people were gathered thick together, he began to say, This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} The queen of the south shall rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and condemn them: for she came from the utmost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and, behold, a greater than Solomon is here. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} The men of Nineveh shall rise up in the judgment with this generation, and shall condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonas; and, behold, a greater than Jonas is here. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} No man, when he has lighted a candle, puts it in a secret place, neither under a bushel, but on a candlestick, that they which come in may see the light. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} The light of the body is the eye: therefore when yours eye is single, your whole body also is full of light; but when yours eye is evil, your body also is full of darkness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Take heed therefore that the light which is in you be not darkness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} If your whole body therefore be full of light, having no part dark, the whole shall be full of light, as when the bright shining of a candle does give you light. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And as he spoke, a certain Pharisee besought him to dine with him: and he went in, and sat down to food. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And when the Pharisee saw it, he marvelled that he had not first washed before dinner. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And the Lord said unto him, Now do all of you Pharisees make clean the outside of the cup and the platter; but your inward part is full of ravening and wickedness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} All of you fools, did not he that made that which is without make that which is within also? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} But rather give alms of such things as all of you have; and, behold, all things are clean unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} But woe unto you, Pharisees! for all of you tithe mint and rue and all manner of herbs, and pass over judgment and the love (o. agape) of God: these ought all of you to have done, and not to leave the other undone. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} Woe unto you, Pharisees! for all of you love the uppermost seats in the synagogues, and greetings in the markets. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for all of you are as graves which appear not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} Then answered one of the lawyers, and said unto him, Master, thus saying you reproach us also. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} And he said, Woe unto you also, all of you lawyers! for all of you load men with burdens grievous to be borne, and all of you yourselves touch not the burdens with one of your fingers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} Woe unto you! for all of you build the sepulchers of the prophets, and your fathers killed them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} Truly all of you bear witness that all of you allow the deeds of your fathers: for they indeed killed them, and all of you build their sepulchers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} That the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} From the blood of Abel unto the blood of Zacharias which perished between the altar and the temple: verily I say unto you, It shall be required of this generation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} Woe unto you, lawyers! for all of you have taken away the key of knowledge: all of you entered not in yourselves, and them that were entering in all of you hindered. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} And as he said these things unto them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{54}} Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.\par

Beelzebul, and so \textsuperscript{20} the finger; the kingdom For the destruction of the kingdom of Satan plainly implies the setting up of the kingdom of God. The reasoning of the Pharisees (, and ), was not expressed, and Jesus knowing their thoughts, gave ample proof of his omniscience. This, with our Lord's masterly confutation of their reasonings, by a conclusion drawn from their own premises, one would have supposed might have humbled and convinced those men; but the most conclusive reasoning, and the most astonishing miracles, were lost upon a people who were obstinately determined to disbelieve every thing that was good relative to Jesus of Nazareth. \textsuperscript{24} the unclean he walketh; dry;, ; seeking; I will \textsuperscript{33} when; a bushel may see \textsuperscript{36} the whole;, ; the bright shining of a candle Gr. a candle by its bright shining \textsuperscript{41} rather, ; , ; of such things as ye have or, as you are able all \textsuperscript{42} woe, for and pass; and not \textsuperscript{49} the wisdom Probably by the Wisdom of God we are to understand the λογος, or Word of God, that is, our Lord himself; this being a dignified and oriental mode of expression for I say, as it is in the parallel passage., ; I will; and some \textsuperscript{51} the blood of Abel; Zacharias; It shall\par}

\subsection*{Luke 12}
\markright{LUKE 12}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware all of you of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Therefore whatsoever all of you have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which all of you have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} But I will forewarn you whom all of you shall fear: Fear him, which after he has killed has power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: all of you are of more value than many sparrows. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} But he that denies me before men shall be denied before the angels of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And whosoever shall speak a word (o. logos) against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemes against the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) it shall not be forgiven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take all of you no thought how or what thing all of you shall answer, or what all of you shall say: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) shall teach you in the same hour what all of you ought to say. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consists not in the abundance of the things which he possesses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And he spoke a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And I will say to my soul, Soul, you have much goods laid up for many years; take yours ease, eat, drink, and be merry. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But God said unto him, You fool, this night your soul shall be required of you: then whose shall those things be, which you have provided? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} So is he that lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what all of you shall eat; neither for the body, what all of you shall put on. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} The life is more than food, and the body is more than raiment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feeds them: how much more are all of you better than the fowls? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} If all of you then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take all of you thought for the rest? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and tomorrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O all of you of little faith? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And seek not all of you what all of you shall eat, or what all of you shall drink, neither be all of you of doubtful mind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knows that all of you have need of these things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} But rather seek all of you the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Sell that all of you have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that fails not, where no thief approaches, neither moth corrupts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And all of you yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he comes and knocks, they may open unto him immediately. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he comes shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to food, and will come forth and serve them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} Be all of you therefore ready also: for the Son of man comes at an hour when all of you think not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speak you this parable unto us, or even to all? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of food in due season? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he comes shall find so doing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} Truthfully I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he has. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delays his coming; and shall begin to beat the male servants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looks not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in two, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} Suppose all of you that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{54}} And he said also to the people, When all of you see a cloud rise out of the west, immediately all of you say, There comes a shower; and so it is. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{55}} And when all of you see the south wind blow, all of you say, There will be heat; and it comes to pass. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{56}} All of you hypocrites, all of you can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that all of you do not discern this time? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{57}} Yea, and why even of yourselves judge all of you not what is right? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{58}} When you go with yours adversary to the magistrate, as you are in the way, give diligence that you may be delivered from him; lest he hale you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer cast you into prison. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{59}} I tell you, you shall not depart thence, till you have paid the very last mite.\par

So among the Turks, a crier announces the hours of public worship from the minaret or tower of the mosque. housetops \textsuperscript{20} God; Thou fool; thy soul shall be required of thee or, do they require thy soul then \textsuperscript{24} the ravens The raven is a species of the corvus, or crow tribe, of the order Picζ, known by its large size, its plumage being of a bluish black, and tail roundish at the end. \subsection*{Luke 13}
\markright{LUKE 13}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} There were present at that season some that told him of the Galilaeans, whose blood Pilate had mingled with their sacrifices. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And Jesus answering said unto them, Suppose all of you that these Galilaeans were sinners above all the Galilaeans, because they suffered such things? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} I tell you, Nay: but, except all of you repent, all of you shall all likewise perish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Or those eighteen, upon whom the tower in Siloam fell, and slew them, think all of you that they were sinners above all men that dwelt in Jerusalem? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} I tell you, Nay: but, except all of you repent, all of you shall all likewise perish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} He spoke also this parable; A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard; and he came and sought fruit thereon, and found none. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Then said he unto the dresser of his vineyard, Behold, these three years I come seeking fruit on this fig tree, and find none: cut it down; why cumbers it the ground? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And he answering said unto him, Lord, let it alone this year also, till I shall dig about it, and dung it: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And if it bear fruit, well: and if not, then after that you shall cut it down. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And he was teaching in one of the synagogues on the sabbath. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And, behold, there was a woman which had a spirit (o. pneuma) of infirmity eighteen years, and was bowed together, and could in no wise lift up herself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And when Jesus saw her, he called her to him, and said unto her, Woman, you are loosed from yours infirmity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And he laid his hands on her: and immediately she was made straight, and glorified God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And the ruler of the synagogue answered with indignation, because that Jesus had healed on the sabbath day, and said unto the people, There are six days in which men ought to work: in them therefore come and be healed, and not on the sabbath day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} The Lord then answered him, and said, You hypocrite, does not each one of you on the sabbath loose his ox or his ass from the stall, and lead him away to watering? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan has bound, lo, these eighteen years, be loosed from this bond on the sabbath day? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And when he had said these things, all his adversaries were ashamed: and all the people rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Then said he, Unto what is the kingdom of God like? and unto which shall I resemble it? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and cast into his garden; and it grew, and waxed a great tree; and the fowls of the air lodged in the branches of it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And again he said, Unto which shall I liken the kingdom of God? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} It is like leaven, which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And he went through the cities and villages, teaching, and journeying toward Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Then said one unto him, Lord, are there few that be saved? And he said unto them, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Strive to enter in at the strait gate: for many, I say unto you, will seek to enter in, and shall not be able. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} When once the master of the house has risen up, and has shut to the door, and all of you begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Lord, Lord, open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence all of you are: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Then shall all of you begin to say, We have eaten and drunk in your presence, and you have taught in our streets. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} But he shall say, I tell you, I know you not whence all of you are; depart from me, all you workers of iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} There shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth, when all of you shall see Abraham, and Isaac, and Jacob, and all the prophets, in the kingdom of God, and you yourselves thrust out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And they shall come from the east, and from the west, and from the north, and from the south, and shall sit down in the kingdom of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And, behold, there are last which shall be first, and there are first which shall be last. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} The same day there came certain of the Pharisees, saying unto him, Get you out, and depart behind: for Herod will kill you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And he said unto them, Go all of you, and tell that fox, Behold, I cast out devils, and I do cures to day and tomorrow, and the third day I shall be perfected. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Nevertheless I must walk to day, and tomorrow, and the day following: for it cannot be that a prophet perish out of Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} O Jerusalem, Jerusalem, which kill the prophets, and stone them that are sent unto you; how often would I have gathered your children together, as a hen does gather her brood under her wings, and all of you would not! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Behold, your house is left unto you desolate: and verily I say unto you, All of you shall not see me, until the time come when all of you shall say, Blessed is he that comes in the name of the Lord.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} the Galilaeans The Galilaeans are frequently mentioned by Josephus as the most turbulent and seditious people, being upon all occasions ready to disturb the Roman authority. It is uncertain to what event our Lord refers; but is probable that they were the followers of Judas Gaulonitis, who opposed paying tribute to Caesar and submitting to the Roman government. A party of them coming to Jerusalem during one of the great festivals, and presenting their oblations in the court of the temple, Pilate treacherously sent a company of soldiers, who slew them, and "mingled their blood with their sacrifices." mingled \textsuperscript{4} in Siloam; fell; sinners or, debtors \textsuperscript{6} fig tree; and he came \textsuperscript{11} a spirit; eighteen; , bowed, *marg. \textsuperscript{14} the ruler;, with; There; and not \textsuperscript{19} like; cast, ; and it;, ; , *Gr:; and the \textsuperscript{25} once; shut; Lord; I know \textsuperscript{28} weeping;, when; the kingdom; you \textsuperscript{32} that fox This was probably Herod Antipas, tetrarch of Galilee, who is described by Josephus as a crafty and incestuous prince, with which the character given him by our Lord, and the narratives of the evangelists, exactly coincide., ; I cast; I shall, *Gr: \textsuperscript{34} Jerusalem; killest; how; thy; as;, and ye \textsuperscript{35} your; Ye shall not;, Blessed\par}

\subsection*{Luke 14}
\markright{LUKE 14}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it came to pass, as he went into the house of one of the chief Pharisees to eat bread on the sabbath day, that they watched him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And, behold, there was a certain man before him which had the dropsy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And Jesus answering spoke unto the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the sabbath day? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And they held their peace. And he took him, and healed him, and let him go; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And answered them, saying, Which of you shall have an ass or an ox fallen into a pit, and will not immediately pull him out on the sabbath day? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And they could not answer him again to these things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And he put forth a parable to those which were bidden, when he marked how they chose out the chief rooms; saying unto them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} When you are bidden of any man to a wedding, sit not down in the highest room; lest a more honourable man than you be bidden of him; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And he that bade you and him come and say to you, Give this man place; and you begin with shame to take the low room. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} But when you are bidden, go and sit down in the low room; that when he that bade you comes, he may say unto you, Friend, go up higher: then shall you have worship in the presence of them that sit to eat with you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For whosoever exalts himself shall be brought low; and he that humbles himself shall be exalted. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Then said he also to him that bade him, When you make a dinner or a supper, call not your friends, nor your brethren, neither your kinsmen, nor your rich neighbours; lest they also bid you again, and a recompence be made you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} But when you make a feast, call the poor, the physically disabled, the lame, the blind: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And you shall be blessed; for they cannot recompense you: for you shall be recompensed at the resurrection of the just. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And when one of them that sat at food with him heard these things, he said unto him, Blessed is he that shall eat bread in the kingdom of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Then said he unto him, A certain man made a great supper, and bade many: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And sent his servant at supper time to say to them that were bidden, Come; for all things are now ready. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And they all with one consent began to make excuse. The first said unto him, I have bought a piece of ground, and I must essentially go and see it: I pray you have me excused. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And another said, I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I go to prove them: I pray you have me excused. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And another said, I have married a wife, and therefore I cannot come. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} So that servant came, and showed his lord these things. Then the master of the house being angry said to his servant, Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in here the poor, and the physically disabled, and the halt, and the blind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And the servant said, Lord, it is done as you have commanded, and yet there is room. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And the lord said unto the servant, Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} For I say unto you, That none of those men which were bidden shall taste of my supper. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And there went great multitudes with him: and he turned, and said unto them, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} If any man come to me, and hate not his father, and mother, and wife, and children, and brethren, and sisters, yea, and his own life also, he cannot be my disciple. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And whosoever does not bear his cross, and come after me, cannot be my disciple. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} For which of you, intending to build a tower, sits not down first, and counts the cost, whether he have sufficient to finish it? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Lest lest by any means, after he has laid the foundation, and is not able to finish it, all that behold it begin to mock him, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Saying, This man began to build, and was not able to finish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Or what king, going to make war against another king, sits not down first, and consults whether he be able with ten thousand to meet him that comes against him with twenty thousand? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an embassy, and desires conditions of peace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} So likewise, whosoever he be of you that forsakes not all that he has, he cannot be my disciple. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Salt is good: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be seasoned? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} It is neither fit for the land, nor yet for the dunghill; but men cast it out. He that has ears to hear, let him hear.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{8} When That there were among the Jews of these times many disputes about seats at banquets, we learn both from Josephus and the Rabbis; nor were these matters unattended to by the Greeks and Romans. Similar admonitions to this of our Lord, also occur in the Rabbinical writers. Rabbi Akiba said, Go two or three seats lower than the place that belongs to thee, and sit there till they say unto to thee, Go up higher; but do not take the uppermost seat, lest they say unto thee, Come down: for it is better they should say unto thee, Go up, go up than they should say, Go down, go down. \textsuperscript{21} and showed; being; Go; the poor; the halt \textsuperscript{22} it is Acts 1:1-9:43 and yet \textsuperscript{34} Salt Common salt, or muriate of soda, consists of soda in combination with muriatic acid, and is for the most part an artificial preparation from sea water, though found in some countries in a solid and massive state. See particularly . but\par}
