\subsection*{Luke 15}
\markright{LUKE 15}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then drew near unto him all the publicans and sinners in order to hear him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And the Pharisees and scribes murmured, saying, This man receives sinners, and eats with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And he spoke this parable unto them, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} What man of you, having an hundred sheep, if he lose one of them, does not leave the ninety and nine in the wilderness, and go after that which is lost, until he find it? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And when he has found it, he lays it on his shoulders, rejoicing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And when he comes home, he calls together his friends and neighbours, saying unto them, Rejoice with me; for I have found my sheep which was lost. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} I say unto you, that likewise joy shall be in heaven over one sinner that repents, more than over ninety and nine just persons, which need no repentance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Either what woman having ten pieces of silver, if she lose one piece, does not light a candle, and sweep the house, and seek diligently till she find it? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And when she has found it, she calls her friends and her neighbours together, saying, Rejoice with me; for I have found the piece which I had lost. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Likewise, I say unto you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner that repents. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And he said, A certain man had two sons: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And the younger of them said to his father, Father, give me the portion of goods that falls to me. And he divided unto them his living. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And not many days after the younger son gathered all together, and took his journey into a far country, and there wasted his substance with riotous living. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And when he had spent all, there arose a mighty famine in that land; and he began to be in lack. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And he went and joined himself to a citizen of that country; and he sent him into his fields to feed swine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And he would fain have filled his belly with the husks that the swine did eat: and no man gave unto him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And when he came to himself, he said, How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough and to spare, and I perish with hunger! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} I will arise and go to my father, and will say unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and before you, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And am no more worthy to be called your son: make me as one of your hired servants. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And he arose, and came to his father. But when he was yet a great way off, his father saw him, and had compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight, and am no more worthy to be called your son. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} But the father said to his servants, Bring forth the best robe, and put it on him; and put a ring on his hand, and shoes on his feet: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And bring here the fatted calf, and kill it; and let us eat, and be merry: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} For this my son was dead, and is alive again; he was lost, and is found. And they began to be merry. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Now his elder son was in the field: and as he came and drew nigh to the house, he heard music and dancing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And he called one of the servants, and asked what these things meant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And he said unto him, Your brother has come; and your father has killed the fatted calf, because he has received him safe and sound. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And he was angry, and would not go in: therefore came his father out, and implored him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And he answering said to his father, Lo, these many years do I serve you, neither transgressed I at any time your commandment: and yet you never gave me a kid, that I might make merry with my friends: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} But as soon as this your son was come, which has devoured your living with harlots, you have killed for him the fatted calf. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And he said unto him, Son, you are ever with me, and all that I have is yours. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} It was meet that we should make merry, and be glad: for this your brother was dead, and is alive again; and was lost, and is found.\par

\subsection*{Luke 16}
\markright{LUKE 16}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And he said also unto his disciples, There was a certain rich man, which had a steward; and the same was accused unto him that he had wasted his goods. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And he called him, and said unto him, How is it that I hear this of you? give an account (o. logos) of your stewardship; for you may be no longer steward. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Then the steward said within himself, What shall I do? for my lord takes away from me the stewardship: I cannot dig; to beg I am ashamed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I am resolved what to do, that, when I am put out of the stewardship, they may receive me into their houses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} So he called every one of his lord's debtors unto him, and said unto the first, How much owe you unto my lord? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And he said, An hundred measures of oil. And he said unto him, Take your bill, and sit down quickly, and write fifty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Then said he to another, And how much owe you? And he said, An hundred measures of wheat. And he said unto him, Take your bill, and write fourscore. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And the lord commended the unjust steward, because he had done wisely: for the children of this world are in their generation wiser than the children of light. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And I say unto you, Make to yourselves friends of the mammon of unrighteousness; that, when all of you fail, they may receive you into everlasting habitations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} He that is faithful in that which is least is faithful also in much: and he that is unjust in the least is unjust also in much. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} If therefore all of you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And if all of you have not been faithful in that which is another man's, who shall give you that which is your own? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} No servant can serve two masters: for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to the one, and despise the other. All of you cannot serve God and mammon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And the Pharisees also, who were covetous, heard all these things: and they derided him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And he said unto them, All of you are they which justify yourselves before men; but God knows your hearts: for that which is highly esteemed among men is abomination in the sight of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} The law and the prophets were until John: since that time the kingdom of God is preached, and every man presses into it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And it is easier for heaven and earth to pass, than one tittle of the law to fail. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Whosoever puts away his wife, and marries another, commits adultery: and whosoever marries her that is put away from her husband commits adultery. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} There was a certain rich man, which was clothed in purple and fine linen, and fared sumptuously every day: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And there was a certain beggar named Lazarus, which was laid at his gate, full of sores, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And desiring to be fed with the crumbs which fell from the rich man's table: moreover the dogs came and licked his sores. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and sees Abraham far off, and Lazarus in his bosom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} But Abraham said, Son, remember that you in your lifetime received your good things, and likewise Lazarus evil things: but now he is comforted, and you are tormented. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And beside all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed: so that they which would pass from behind to you cannot; neither can they pass to us, that would come from thence. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Then he said, I pray you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father's house: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} For I have five brethren; that he may testify unto them, lest they also come into this place of torment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Abraham says unto him, They have Moses and the prophets; let them hear them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And he said, Nay, father Abraham: but if one went unto them from the dead, they will repent. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And he said unto him, If they hear not Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded, though one rose from the dead.\par

\subsection*{Luke 17}
\markright{LUKE 17}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then said he unto the disciples, It is impossible but that offences will come: but woe unto him, through whom they come! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck, and he cast into the sea, than that he should offend one of these little ones. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Take heed to yourselves: If your brother trespass against you, rebuke him; and if he repent, forgive him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And if he trespass against you seven times in a day, and seven times in a day return to you, saying, I repent; you shall forgive him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And the apostles said unto the Lord, Increase our faith. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And the Lord said, If all of you had faith as a grain of mustard seed, all of you might say unto this sycamine tree, Be you plucked up by the root, and be you planted in the sea; and it should obey you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} But which of you, having a servant plowing or feeding cattle, will say unto him by and by, when he has come from the field, Go and sit down to food? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And will not rather say unto him, Make ready wherewith I may sup, and gird yourself, and serve me, till I have eaten and drunken; and afterward you shall eat and drink? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded him? I I think not not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} So likewise all of you, when all of you shall have done all those things which are commanded you, say, We are useless servants: we have done that which was our duty to do. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And it came to pass, as he went to Jerusalem, that he passed through the midst of Samaria and Galilee. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And as he entered into a certain village, there met him ten men that were lepers, which stood far off: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And they lifted up their voices, and said, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go show yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, and with a loud voice glorified God, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And fell down on his face at his feet, giving him thanks: and he was a Samaritan. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And Jesus answering said, Were there not ten cleansed? but where are the nine? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} There are not found that returned to give glory to God, save this stranger. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And he said unto him, Arise, go your way: your faith has made you whole. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God comes not with observation: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there! for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And he said unto the disciples, The days will come, when all of you shall desire to see one of the days of the Son of man, and all of you shall not see it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And they shall say to you, See here; or, see there: go not after them, nor follow them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} For as the lightning, that lightens out of the one part under heaven, shines unto the other part under heaven; so shall also the Son of man be in his day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} But first must he suffer many things, and be rejected of this generation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And as it was in the days of Noe, so shall it be also in the days of the Son of man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} They did eat, they drank, they married wives, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noe entered into the ark, and the flood came, and destroyed them all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Likewise also as it was in the days of Lot; they did eat, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} But the same day that Lot went out of Sodom it rained fire and brimstone from heaven, and destroyed them all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Even thus shall it be in the day when the Son of man is revealed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} In that day, he which shall be upon the housetop, and his stuff in the house, let him not come down to take it away: and he that is in the field, let him likewise not return back. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Remember Lot's wife. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Whosoever shall seek to save his life shall lose it; and whosoever shall lose his life shall preserve it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} I tell you, in that night there shall be two men in one bed; the one shall be taken, and the other shall be left. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Two women shall be grinding together; the one shall be taken, and the other left. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Two men shall be in the field; the one shall be taken, and the other left. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And they answered and said unto him, Where, Lord? And he said unto them, Where ever the body is, thither will the eagles be gathered together.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{20} when the, ; observation or, outward show \textsuperscript{21} Lo here; the kingdom; within you or, among you \textsuperscript{26} as, Noah; the days of the Son \textsuperscript{31} he which The flat-roofed eastern houses have stairs on the outside, by which a person may ascend and descend without coming into the house; and in walled cities they usually form continued terraces, from one end of the city to the other, terminating at the gates; so that one may pass along the tops of the houses and escape out of the city without coming down into the street. \textsuperscript{36} "This verse is wanting in most of the Greek copies."\par}

\subsection*{Luke 18}
\markright{LUKE 18}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And he spoke a parable unto them to this end, that men ought always to pray, and not to faint; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Saying, There was in a city a judge, which feared not God, neither regarded man: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And there was a widow in that city; and she came unto him, saying, Avenge me of mine adversary. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And he would not for a while: but afterward he said within himself, Though I fear not God, nor regard man; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Yet because this widow troubles me, I will avenge her, lest by her continual coming she weary me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And the Lord said, Hear what the unjust judge says. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And shall not God avenge his own elect, which cry day and night unto him, though he bear long with them? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I tell you that he will avenge them speedily. Nevertheless when the Son of man comes, shall he find faith on the earth? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And he spoke this parable unto certain which trusted in themselves that they were righteous, and despised others: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Two men went up into the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, and the other a publican. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} The Pharisee stood and prayed thus with himself, God, I thank you, that I am not as other men are, extortionists, unjust, adulterers, or even as this publican. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} I fast twice in the week, I give tithes of all that I possess. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And the publican, standing far off, would not lift up so much as his eyes unto heaven, but stroke upon his breast, saying, God be merciful to me a sinner. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other: for every one that exalts himself shall be brought low; and he that humbles himself shall be exalted. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And they brought unto him also infants, that he would touch them: but when his disciples saw it, they rebuked them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} But Jesus called them unto him, and said, Suffer little children to come unto me, and forbid them not: for of such is the kingdom of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Verily I say unto you, Whosoever shall not receive the kingdom of God as a little child shall in no wise enter therein. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And a certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Master, what shall I do to inherit eternal life? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And Jesus said unto him, Why call you me good? none is good, save one, that is, God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} You know the commandments, Do not commit adultery, Do not kill, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honour your father and your mother. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And he said, All these have I kept from my youth up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Now when Jesus heard these things, he said unto him, Yet lack you one thing: sell all that you have, and distribute unto the poor, and you shall have treasure in heaven: and come, follow me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And when he heard this, he was very sorrowful: for he was very rich. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} For it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And they that heard it said, Who then can be saved? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Then Peter said, Lo, we have left all, and followed you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And he said unto them, Verily I say unto you, There is no man that has left house, or parents, or brethren, or wife, or children, for the kingdom of God's sake, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Who shall not receive manifold more in this present time, and in the world to come life everlasting. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Then he took unto him the twelve, and said unto them, Behold, we go up to Jerusalem, and all things that are written by the prophets concerning the Son of man shall be accomplished. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} For he shall be delivered unto the Gentiles, and shall be mocked, and spitefully pleaded, and spitted on: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And they shall scourge him, and put him to death: and the third day he shall rise again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And they understood none of these things: and this saying (o. rhema) was hid from them, neither knew they the things which were spoken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And it came to pass, that as he was come nigh unto Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the way side begging: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And hearing the multitude pass by, he asked what it meant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And they told him, that Jesus of Nazareth passes by. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And he cried, saying, Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And they which went before rebuked him, that he should hold his peace: but he cried so much the more, You son of David, have mercy on me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And Jesus stood, and commanded him to be brought unto him: and when he was come near, he asked him, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} Saying, What will you that I shall do unto you? And he said, Lord, that I may receive my sight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And Jesus said unto him, Receive your sight: your faith has saved you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God: and all the people, when they saw it, gave praise unto God.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} city Gr. certain city which; regarded \textsuperscript{9} which, ; that they were righteous or, as being righteous and despised \textsuperscript{13} standing, ; but; God, ; a sinner \textsuperscript{25} a camel Some render a cable; but it may justly be doubted whether καμηλος ever was so translated before, for the word for a cable, as the scholiast on Aristophanes expressly affirms, is written καμιλος, not with an "e" η, but with an "i" ι . Some few manuscripts, it is true, have got the word καμιλος into the text, but it is evidently an attempted improvement.\par}

\subsection*{Luke 19}
\markright{LUKE 19}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And Jesus entered and passed through Jericho. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And, behold, there was a man named Zacchaeus, which was the chief among the publicans, and he was rich. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And he sought to see Jesus who he was; and could not for the press, because he was little of stature. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And he ran before, and climbed up into a sycomore tree to see him: for he was to pass that way. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And when Jesus came to the place, he looked up, and saw him, and said unto him, Zacchaeus, make haste, and come down; in order to day I must abide at your house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And he made haste, and came down, and received him joyfully. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And when they saw it, they all murmured, saying, That he was gone to be guest with a man that is a sinner. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And Zacchaeus stood, and said unto the Lord: Behold, Lord, the half of my goods I give to the poor; and if I have taken any thing from any man by false accusation, I restore him fourfold. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And Jesus said unto him, This day is salvation come to this house, forasmuch as he also is a son of Abraham. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For the Son of man has come to seek and to save that which was lost. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And as they heard these things, he added and spoke a parable, because he was nigh to Jerusalem, and because they thought that the kingdom of God should immediately appear. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And he called his ten servants, and delivered them ten pounds, and said unto them, Occupy till I come. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} But his citizens hated him, and sent a message after him, saying, We will not have this man to reign over us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And it came to pass, that when he was returned, having received the kingdom, then he commanded these servants to be called unto him, to whom he had given the money, that he might know how much every man had gained by trading. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Then came the first, saying, Lord, your pound has gained ten pounds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And he said unto him, Well, you good servant: because you have been faithful in a very little, have you authority over ten cities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And the second came, saying, Lord, your pound has gained five pounds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And he said likewise to him, Be you also over five cities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And another came, saying, Lord, behold, here is your pound, which I have kept laid up in a cloth: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For I feared you, because you are an austere man: you take up that you layed not down, and reap that you did not sow. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And he says unto him, Out of yours own mouth will I judge you, you wicked servant. You knew that I was an austere man, taking up that I laid not down, and reaping that I did not sow: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Wherefore then gave not you my money into the bank, that at my coming I might have required mine own with interest? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And he said unto them that stood by, Take from him the pound, and give it to him that has ten pounds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} (And they said unto him, Lord, he has ten pounds.) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} For I say unto you, That unto every one which has shall be given; and from him that has not, even that he has shall be taken away from him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} But those mine enemies, which would not that I should reign over them, bring here, and slay them before me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And when he had thus spoken, he went before, ascending up to Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And it came to pass, when he was come nigh to Bethphage and Bethany, at the mount called the mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Saying, Go all of you into the village opposite to you; in the which at your entering all of you shall find a colt tied, whereon yet never man sat: loose him, and bring him here. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And if any man ask you, Why do all of you loose him? thus shall all of you say unto him, Because the Lord has need of him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And they that were sent went their way, and found even as he had said unto them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And as they were loosing the colt, the owners thereof said unto them, Why loose all of you the colt? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And they said, The Lord has need of him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And they brought him to Jesus: and they cast their garments upon the colt, and they set Jesus thereon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And as he went, they spread their clothes in the way. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And when he was come nigh, even now at the descent of the mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works that they had seen; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Saying, Blessed be the King that comes in the name of the Lord: peace in heaven, and glory in the highest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And some of the Pharisees from among the multitude said unto him, Master, rebuke your disciples. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And he answered and said unto them, I tell you that, if these should hold their peace, the stones would immediately cry out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And when he was come near, he beheld the city, and wept over it, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} Saying, If you had known, even you, at least in this your day, the things which belong unto your peace! but now they are hid from yours eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} For the days shall come upon you, that yours enemies shall cast a trench about you, and compass you round, and keep you in on every side, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And shall lay you even with the ground, and your children within you; and they shall not leave in you one stone upon another; because you knew not the time of your visitation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} And he went into the temple, and began to cast out them that sold therein, and them that bought; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} Saying unto them, It is written, My house is the house of prayer: but all of you have made it a den of thieves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} And he taught daily in the temple. But the chief priests and the scribes and the chief of the people sought to destroy him, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} And could not find what they might do: for all the people were very attentive to hear him.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{2} Name meaning: Zacchaeus (Zakkay) — Pure; innocent Tax collector made pure by Jesus.\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} the chief Αρχιτελωνης, rather, "a chief publican, " or tax gatherer. Probably Zacchaeus, who appears from his name to have been a Jew, farmed the revenue of the district around Jericho, having others under him, who either rented of him smaller portions, or were employed as servants to collect the taxes. and he \textsuperscript{8} Behold, ; by false; I restore \textsuperscript{9} unto him Rather, as Elsner renders προς, αυτον, concerning him; for our Lord speaks of him in the third person. This day; forsomuch \textsuperscript{12} A certain; a far; to; and \textsuperscript{13} his; delivered; pounds "Mina, here translated a pound, is 12, 1/2 oz., which, according to 5s. the ounce, is 3£. 2s. 6d." \textsuperscript{15} having money Gr. silver, and so, that he \textsuperscript{26} That unto; and from That is, the poor man, who possesses but little. \textsuperscript{42} If; in this; the things, ;, ; but \textsuperscript{43} the days; cast Or, "cast a bank" or rampart χαραξ . This was literally fulfilled when Jerusalem was besieged by Titus; who surrounded it with a wall of circumvallation in three days, though not less than 39 furlongs in circumference; and when this was effected, the Jews were so enclosed on every side, that no person could escape from the city, and no provision could be brought in. \textsuperscript{44} lay; thy children; leave; because \textsuperscript{48} could; were very attentive to hear him or, hanged on him, Εξεκρεματο, αυτου, ακουων, literally, "they hung upon him hearing; " which is beautifully expressive of their earnest attention, and high gratification.\par}

\subsection*{Luke 20}
\markright{LUKE 20}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it came to pass, that on one of those days, as he taught the people in the temple, and preached the gospel, the chief priests and the scribes came upon him with the elders, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And spoke unto him, saying, Tell us, by what authority do you these things? or who is he that gave you this authority? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And he answered and said unto them, I will also ask you one thing; (o. logos) and answer me: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} The baptism of John, was it from heaven, or of men? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And they reasoned with themselves, saying, If we shall say, From heaven; he will say, Why then believed all of you him not? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} But and if we say, Of men; all the people will stone us: for they be persuaded that John was a prophet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And they answered, that they could not tell whence it was. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And Jesus said unto them, Neither tell I you by what authority I do these things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Then began he to speak to the people this parable; A certain man planted a vineyard, and let it forth to husbandmen, and went into a far country for a long time. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And at the season he sent a servant to the husbandmen, that they should give him of the fruit of the vineyard: but the husbandmen beat him, and sent him away empty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And again he sent another servant: and they beat him also, and pleaded him shamefully, and sent him away empty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And again he sent a third: and they wounded him also, and cast him out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Then said the lord of the vineyard, What shall I do? I will send my beloved son: it may be they will reverence him when they see him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} But when the husbandmen saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, This is the heir: come, let us kill him, that the inheritance may be ours. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} So they cast him out of the vineyard, and killed him. What therefore shall the lord of the vineyard do unto them? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} He shall come and destroy these husbandmen, and shall give the vineyard to others. And when they heard it, they said, God forbid. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And he beheld them, and said, What is this then that is written, The stone which the builders rejected, the same is become the head of the corner? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Whosoever shall fall upon that stone shall be broken; but on whomsoever it shall fall, it will grind him to powder. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And the chief priests and the scribes the same hour sought to lay hands on him; and they feared the people: for they perceived that he had spoken this parable against them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And they watched him, and sent forth spies, which should feign themselves just men, that they might take hold of his words, (o. logos) that so they might deliver him unto the power and authority of the governor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And they asked him, saying, Master, we know that you says and teach rightly, neither accept you the person of any, but teach the way of God truly: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Is it lawful for us to give tribute unto Caesar, or no? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} But he perceived their craftiness, and said unto them, Why tempt all of you me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Show me a penny. Whose image and superscription has it? They answered and said, Caesar's. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And he said unto them, Render therefore unto Caesar the things which be Caesar's, and unto God the things which be God's. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And they could not take hold of his words (o. rhema) before the people: and they marvelled at his answer, and held their peace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Then came to him certain of the Sadducees, which deny that there is any resurrection; and they asked him, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Saying, Master, Moses wrote unto us, If any man's brother die, having a wife, and he die without children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up seed unto his brother. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} There were therefore seven brethren: and the first took a wife, and died without children. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And the second took her to wife, and he died childless. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And the third took her; and in like manner the seven also: and they left no children, and died. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Last of all the woman died also. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them is she? for seven had her to wife. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And Jesus answering said unto them, The children of this world marry, and are given in marriage: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} But they which shall be accounted worthy to obtain that world, and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Neither can they die any more: for they are equal unto the angels; and are the children of God, being the children of the resurrection. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Now that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he calls the Lord the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} For he is not a God of the dead, but of the living: for all live unto him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} Then certain of the scribes answering said, Master, you have well said. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And after that they durst not ask him any question at all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And he said unto them, How say they that Christ is David's son? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And David himself says in the book of Psalms, The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit you on my right hand, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} Till I make yours enemies your footstool. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} David therefore calls him Lord, how is he then his son? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} Then in the audience of all the people he said unto his disciples, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} Beware of the scribes, which desire to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the markets, and the highest seats in the synagogues, and the chief rooms at feasts; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} Which devour widows' houses, and for a show make long prayers: the same shall receive greater damnation.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{9} this; planted; and let husbandmen, went \textsuperscript{13} What; I will; it may \textsuperscript{18} shall fall This is an allusion to the Jewish mode of stoning. "The place of stoning was twice as high as a man. From the top of this one of the witnesses struck the culprit on the loins, and felled him to the ground. If he died of this, well; if not, the other witness threw a stone upon his heart, " etc. Our Lord seems to refer not only to the dreadful crushing of the Jews by the Romans, but also to their general dispersion to the present day. \textsuperscript{20} they watched; feign; *marg. they might deliver \textsuperscript{21} Master; sayest; acceptest; truly or, of a truth \textsuperscript{24} a penny, image This was the head of the emperor; the superscription his titles. Julius Cesar was the first who caused his image to be struck on the Roman coin; and Tiberius was emperor at this time. This therefore was a denarius of Cesar, γιπψΰ χιρψ ΰπδ, as it is termed in the Talmud; and consequently this was respecting the tribute required by the Roman government. Caesar's \textsuperscript{26} they could; and they marvelled \textsuperscript{36} can; , they are; , the children of God \textsuperscript{37} even; when There is a remarkable passage in Josephus, which proves that the best informed among the Jews believed in the immateriality and immortality of the soul, and that the souls of righteous men were in the presence of God in a state of happiness. "They who lose their lives for the sake of God, live unto God, as do Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and the rest of the patriarchs." Not less remarkable is a passage in Shemoth Rabba, "Why doth Moses say ( ) Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob? R. Abin saith, The Lord said unto Moses, I look for ten men from thee, as I looked for that number in Sodom. Find me out ten righteous persons among the people, and I will not destroy thy people. Then saith Moses, Behold, here am I, and Aaron, Eleazar, and Ithamar, Phinehas, and Caleb, and Joshua; but, saith God, there are but seven. Where are the other three? When Moses knew not what to do, he saith, O Eternal God, ηιιν δν δξϊιν, do those live who are dead? Yes, saith God. Then saith Moses, If those that are dead do live, remember Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob."\par}

\subsection*{Luke 21}
\markright{LUKE 21}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And he looked up, and saw the rich men casting their gifts into the treasury. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And he saw also a certain poor widow casting in thither two mites. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And he said, Truthfully I say unto you, that this poor widow has cast in more than they all: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For all these have of their abundance cast in unto the offerings of God: but she of her destitution has cast in all the living that she had. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And as some spoke of the temple, how it was adorned with goodly stones and gifts, he said, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} As for these things which all of you behold, the days will come, in the which there shall not be left one stone upon another, that shall not be thrown down. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And they asked him, saying, Master, but when shall these things be? and what sign will there be when these things shall come to pass? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And he said, Take heed that all of you be not deceived: for many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and the time draws near: go all of you not therefore after them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} But when all of you shall hear of wars and commotions, be not terrified: for these things must first come to pass; but the end is not by and by. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Then said he unto them, Nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And great earthquakes shall be in divers places, and famines, and pestilences; and fearful sights and great signs shall there be from heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} But before all these, they shall lay their hands on you, and persecute you, delivering you up to the synagogues, and into prisons, being brought before kings and rulers for my name's sake. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And it shall turn to you for a testimony. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Settle it therefore in your hearts, not to meditate before what all of you shall answer: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For I will give you a mouth and wisdom, which all your adversaries shall not be able to gainsay nor resist. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And all of you shall be betrayed both by parents, and brethren, and kinsfolks, and friends; and some of you shall they cause to be put to death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And all of you shall be hated of all men for my name's sake. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} But there shall not an hair of your head perish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} In your patience possess all of you your souls. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And when all of you shall see Jerusalem compassed with armies, then know that the desolation thereof is nigh. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Then let them which are in Judaea flee to the mountains; and let them which are in the midst of it depart out; and let not them that are in the countries enter therein. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} But woe unto them that are with child, and to them that give suck, in those days! for there shall be great distress in the land, and wrath upon this people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations: and Jerusalem shall be trodden down of the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles be fulfilled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And there shall be signs in the sun, and in the moon, and in the stars; and upon the earth distress of nations, with perplexity; the sea and the waves roaring; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Men's hearts failing them for fear, and for looking after those things which are coming on the earth: for the powers of heaven shall be shaken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And then shall they see the Son of man coming in a cloud with power and great glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And when these things begin to come to pass, then look up, and lift up your heads; for your redemption draws nigh. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And he spoke to them a parable; Behold the fig tree, and all the trees; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} When they now shoot forth, all of you see and know of your own selves that summer is now nigh at hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} So likewise all of you, when all of you see these things come to pass, know all of you that the kingdom of God is nigh at hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Verily I say unto you, This generation shall not pass away, till all be fulfilled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Heaven and earth shall pass away: but my words (o. logos) shall not pass away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And take heed to yourselves, lest at any time your hearts be overcharged with worldly excess, and drunkenness, and cares of this life, and so that day come upon you unexpectedly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} For as a snare shall it come on all them that dwell on the face of the whole earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Watch all of you therefore, and pray always, that all of you may be accounted worthy to escape all these things that shall come to pass, and to stand before the Son of man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And in the day time he was teaching in the temple; and at night he went out, and abode in the mount that is called the mount of Olives. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And all the people came early in the morning to him in the temple, in order to hear him.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{8} Take; for; and the time or, and, The time \textsuperscript{10} Nation shall This portended the dissensions, insurrections, and mutual slaughter of the Jews, the open wars of different tetrarchies, and the civil wars in Italy between Otho and Vitellius. \textsuperscript{21} flee Accordingly, when Cestius Gallus came against Jerusalem, and unexpectedly raised the siege, Josephus states, that many of the noble Jews departed out of the city, as out of a sinking ship; and when Vespasian afterwards drew towards it, a great multitude fled to the mountains. And we learn from Eusebius, and Epiphanius, that at this juncture, all who believed in Christ left Jerusalem, and removed to Pella, and other places beyond Jordan; and so escaped the general shipwreck of their country, that we do not read of one who perished in Jerusalem.; and let them \textsuperscript{25} signs, ; upon with; the sea \textsuperscript{34} take; your hearts; surfeiting; cares; that day \textsuperscript{35} as; dwell; of the whole earth Or, "of this whole land; the land of Judea, on which these heavy judgments were to fall."\par}

\subsection*{Luke 22}
\markright{LUKE 22}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Now the feast of unleavened bread drew nigh, which is called the Passover. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill him; for they feared the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And he went his way, and communed with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray him unto them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And they were glad, and covenanted to give him money. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And he promised, and sought opportunity to betray him unto them in the absence of the multitude. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Then came the day of unleavened bread, when the passover must be killed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And he sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare us the passover, that we may eat. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And they said unto him, Where will you that we prepare? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And he said unto them, Behold, when all of you are entered into the city, there shall a man meet you, bearing a pitcher of water; follow him into the house where he enters in. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And all of you shall say unto the goodman of the house, The Master says unto you, Where is the guest room, where I shall eat the passover with my disciples? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And he shall show you a large upper room furnished: there make ready. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And they went, and found as he had said unto them: and they made ready the passover. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And when the hour was come, he sat down, and the twelve apostles with him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And he said unto them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} For I say unto you, I will not any more eat thereof, until it be fulfilled in the kingdom of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And he took the cup, and gave thanks, and said, Take this, and divide it among yourselves: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} For I say unto you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine, until the kingdom of God shall come. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And he took bread, and gave thanks, and brake it, and gave unto them, saying, This is my body which is given for you: this do in remembrance of me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Likewise also the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood, which is shed for you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} But, behold, the hand of him that betrays me is with me on the table. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And truly the Son of man goes, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And they began to enquire among themselves, which of them it was that should do this thing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And there was also a strife among them, which of them should be accounted the greatest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And he said unto them, The kings of the Gentiles exercise lordship over them; and they that exercise authority upon them are called benefactors. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} But all of you shall not be so: but he that is greatest among you, let him be as the younger; and he that is chief, as he that does serve. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} For whether is greater, he that sits at food, or he that serves? is not he that sits at food? but I am among you as he that serves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} All of you are they which have continued with me in my temptations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father has appointed unto me; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} That all of you may eat and drink at my table in my kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan has desired to have you, that he may sift you as wheat: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} But I have prayed for you, that your faith fail not: and when you are converted, strengthen your brethren. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And he said unto him, Lord, I am ready to go with you, both into prison, and to death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And he said, I tell you, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day, before that you shall three times deny that you know me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And he said unto them, When I sent you without purse, and pouch, and shoes, lacked all of you any thing? And they said, Nothing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Then said he unto them, But now, he that has a purse, let him take it, and likewise his pouch: and he that has no sword, let him sell his garment, and buy one. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} For I say unto you, that this that is written must yet be accomplished in me, And he was reckoned among the transgressors: for the things concerning me have an end. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And they said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. And he said unto them, It is enough. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And he came out, and went, as he was known, to the mount of Olives; and his disciples also followed him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And when he was at the place, he said unto them, Pray that all of you enter not into temptation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And he was withdrawn from them about a stone's cast, and kneeled down, and prayed, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} Saying, Father, if you be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but yours, be done. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And there appeared an angel unto him from heaven, strengthening him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} And when he rose up from prayer, and was come to his disciples, he found them sleeping for sorrow, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} And said unto them, Why sleep all of you? rise and pray, lest all of you enter into temptation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} And while he yet spoke, behold a multitude, and he that was called Judas, one of the twelve, went before them, and drew near unto Jesus to kiss him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} But Jesus said unto him, Judas, betray you the Son of man with a kiss? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} When they which were about him saw what would follow, they said unto him, Lord, shall we strike with the sword? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} And one of them stroke the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} And Jesus answered and said, Suffer all of you thus far. And he touched his ear, and healed him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} Then Jesus said unto the chief priests, and captains of the temple, and the elders, which were come to him, Be all of you come out, as against a thief, with swords and staves? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} When I was daily with you in the temple, all of you stretched forth no hands against me: but this is your hour, and the power of darkness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{54}} Then took they him, and led him, and brought him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed far off. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{55}} And when they had kindled a fire in the midst of the hall, and were set down together, Peter sat down among them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{56}} But a certain maid beheld him as he sat by the fire, and earnestly looked upon him, and said, This man was also with him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{57}} And he denied him, saying, Woman, I know him not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{58}} And after a little while another saw him, and said, You are also of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{59}} And about the space of one hour after another confidently affirmed, saying, Truthfully this fellow also was with him: for he is a Galilaean. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{60}} And Peter said, Man, I know not what you says. And immediately, while he yet spoke, the cock crew. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{61}} And the Lord turned, and looked upon Peter. And Peter remembered the word (o. logos) of the Lord, how he had said unto him, Before the cock crow, you shall deny me three times. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{62}} And Peter went out, and wept bitterly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{63}} And the men that held Jesus mocked him, and stroke him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{64}} And when they had blindfolded him, they struck him on the face, and asked him, saying, Prophesy, who is it that stroke you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{65}} And many other things blasphemously spoke they against him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{66}} And as soon as it was day, the elders of the people and the chief priests and the scribes came together, and led him into their council, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{67}} Are you the Christ? tell us. And he said unto them, If I tell you, all of you will not believe: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{68}} And if I also ask you, all of you will not answer me, nor let me go. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{69}} Hereafter shall the Son of man sit on the right hand of the power of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{70}} Then said they all, Are you then the Son of God? And he said unto them, All of you say that I am. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{71}} And they said, What need we any further witness? for we ourselves have heard of his own mouth.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{6} in the absence of the multitude or, without tumult \textsuperscript{15} With desire I have desired or, I have heartily desired \textsuperscript{18} I will not; the fruit; until \textsuperscript{19} he took; gave thanks; is my; given; this do \textsuperscript{32} I have; thy faith; and when; strengthen \textsuperscript{42} Father; willing, remove Gr. willing to remove cup; not \textsuperscript{53} I was;, but; the power \textsuperscript{54} took Our blessed Lord before his death passed another examination. One was before the Jewish Sanhedrim, whose proper province it was to try such as were accused as false prophets or blasphemers. This was a kind of ecclesiastical court. The other, with which the next chapter opens, was before Pilate, the Roman governor of Judea at that time; he principally took cognizance of criminal things, such especially as concerned the peace of the country, considered as part of the Roman empire.; And Peter \textsuperscript{58} another A maid challenged Peter in the second instance, according to Matthew and Mark; yet here it is said ετερος, another (man) and he also answers to a man. But ετερος, as Wetstein shows, may be, and is in innumerable instances applied to a female; and Matthew says, "she said to them that were there, " and Mark, "she began to say to them that stood by." So that the maid gave the information to those around her, and some man charged Peter with it. Probably several joined in the accusation, though he answered to an individual, for John says, "They said unto him, " etc. \textsuperscript{61} turned; looked; And Peter; Before\par}
