\subsection*{Luke 23}
\markright{LUKE 23}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the whole multitude of them arose, and led him unto Pilate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And they began to accuse him, saying, We found this fellow perverting the nation, and forbidding to give tribute to Caesar, saying that he himself is Christ a King. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And Pilate asked him, saying, Are you the King of the Jews? And he answered him and said, You says it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Then said Pilate to the chief priests and to the people, I find no fault in this man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And they were the more fierce, saying, He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Jewry, beginning from Galilee to this place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} When Pilate heard of Galilee, he asked whether the man were a Galilaean. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And as soon as he knew that he belonged unto Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who himself also was at Jerusalem at that time. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceeding glad: for he was desirous to see him of a long season, because he had heard many things of him; and he hoped to have seen some miracle done by him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Then he questioned with him in many words; (o. logos) but he answered him nothing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And the chief priests and scribes stood and vehemently accused him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And Herod with his men of war set him at nothing, and mocked him, and arrayed him in a gorgeous robe, and sent him again to Pilate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And Pilate, when he had called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Said unto them, All of you have brought this man unto me, as one that perverts the people: and, behold, I, having examined him before you, have found no fault in this man concerning those things whereof all of you accuse him: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} No, nor yet Herod: for I sent you to him; and, lo, nothing worthy of death is done unto him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} I will therefore chastise him, and release him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} (For of necessity he must release one unto them at the feast.) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And they cried out all at once, saying, Away with this man, and release unto us Barabbas: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} (Who for a certain sedition made in the city, and for murder, was cast into prison.) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Pilate therefore, willing to release Jesus, spoke again to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} But they cried, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And he said unto them the third time, Why, what evil has he done? I have found no cause of death in him: I will therefore chastise him, and let him go. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And they were instant with loud voices, requiring that he might be crucified. And the voices of them and of the chief priests prevailed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And Pilate gave sentence that it should be as they required. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And he released unto them him that for sedition and murder was cast into prison, whom they had desired; but he delivered Jesus to their will. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And as they led him away, they laid hold upon one Simon, a Cyrenian, coming out of the country, and on him they laid the cross, that he might bear it after Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And there followed him a great company of people, and of women, which also bewailed and lamented him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} But Jesus turning unto them said, Daughters of Jerusalem, weep not for me, but weep for yourselves, and for your children. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} For, behold, the days are coming, in the which they shall say, Blessed are the barren, and the wombs that never bare, and the breast which never gave suck. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Then shall they begin to say to the mountains, Fall on us; and to the hills, Cover us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} For if they do these things in a green tree, what shall be done in the dry? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And there were also two other, malefactors, led with him to be put to death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And when they were come to the place, which is called Calvary, there they crucified him, and the malefactors, one on the right hand, and the other on the left. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Then said Jesus, Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do. And they parted his raiment, and cast lots. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And the people stood beholding. And the rulers also with them derided him, saying, He saved others; let him save himself, if he be Christ, the chosen of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And the soldiers also mocked him, coming to him, and offering him vinegar, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And saying, If you be the king of the Jews, save yourself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And a superscription also was written over him in letters of Greek, and Latin, and Hebrew, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And one of the malefactors which were hanged railed on him, saying, If you be Christ, save yourself and us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} But the other answering rebuked him, saying, Do not you fear God, seeing you are in the same condemnation? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And we indeed justly; for we receive the due reward of our deeds: but this man has done nothing amiss. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when you come into your kingdom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto you, To day shall you be with me in paradise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And it was about the sixth hour, and there was a darkness over all the earth until the ninth hour. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} And the sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was rent in the midst. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} And when Jesus had cried with a loud voice, he said, Father, into your hands I commend my spirit: (o. pneuma) and having said thus, he gave up the spirit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} Now when the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} And all the people that came together to that sight, beholding the things which were done, stroke their breasts, and returned. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} And all his acquaintance, and the women that followed him from Galilee, stood far off, beholding these things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} And, behold, there was a man named Joseph, a counsellor; and he was a good man, and a just: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} (The same had not consented to the counsel and deed of them;) he was of Arimathaea, a city of the Jews: who also himself waited for the kingdom of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} This man went unto Pilate, and begged the body of Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} And he took it down, and wrapped it in linen, and laid it in a tomb that was hewn in stone, wherein never man before was laid. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{54}} And that day was the preparation, and the sabbath drew on. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{55}} And the women also, which came with him from Galilee, followed after, and beheld the tomb, and how his body was laid. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{56}} And they returned, and prepared spices and ointments; and rested the sabbath day according to the commandment.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{3} Pilate; the King, ;, he answered Thou sayest it This was the most solemn mode of affirmation used by the Jews. When the inhabitants of Zippor, inquired whether Rabbi Judah were dead, the son of Kaphra answered, ΰϊεο ΰξψιϊεο, Ye say. \textsuperscript{15} nothing Rather, "nothing worthy of death is committed my him; " ̓πεπραγμενον, αυτω, being put for ̓πεπραγμενον υπ ̓, αυτου, or πεπραχεν, αυτος, "he hath done nothing." \textsuperscript{24} Pilate; gave sentence or, assented; it \textsuperscript{26} they laid; a Cyrenian, that \textsuperscript{29} the days Our Lord here refers to the destruction of Jerusalem, and the final desolation of the Jewish state; an evil associated with so many miseries, that sterility, which had otherwise been considered an opprobrium, was accounted a circumstance most felicitous. No history can furnish us with a parallel to the calamities and miseries of the Jews; rapine and murder, famine and pestilence, within; fire and sword, and all the terrors of war, without. Our Saviour himself wept at the foresight of these calamities; and it is almost impossible for persons of any humanity to read the relation of them in Josephus without weeping also. He might justly affirm, "if the misfortunes of all, from the beginning of the world, were compared with those of the Jews, they would appear much inferior in the comparison."; Blessed \textsuperscript{30} NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. Brenton LXX: “Hosea 10:8 And the altars of On, the sins of Israel, shall be taken away: thorns and thistles shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.” Masoretic/Hebrew comparison: “Hosea 10:8 The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.” \textsuperscript{33} when; Calvary or, the place of a skull they crucified \textsuperscript{34} Father; they know not; And they \textsuperscript{44} it; there; earth or, land \textsuperscript{46} NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. Brenton LXX: “Psalms 30:5 Into thine hands I will commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O Lord God of truth.” Masoretic/Hebrew comparison: “Psalms 31:5 Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O LORD God of truth.”\par}

\subsection*{Luke 24}
\markright{LUKE 24}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Now upon the first day of the week, very early in the morning, they came unto the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And they found the stone rolled away from the tomb. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And they entered in, and found not the body of the Lord Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And it came to pass, as they were much perplexed thereabout, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And as they were afraid, and bowed down their faces to the earth, they said unto them, Why seek all of you the living among the dead? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} He is not here, but has risen: remember how he spoke unto you when he was yet in Galilee, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Saying, The Son of man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And they remembered his words, (o. rhema) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And returned from the tomb, and told all these things unto the eleven, and to all the rest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} It was Mary Magdalene and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James, and other women that were with them, which told these things unto the apostles. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And their words (o. rhema) seemed to them as idle tales, and they believed them not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Then arose Peter, and ran unto the tomb; and stooping down, he beheld the linen clothes laid by themselves, and departed, wondering in himself at that which was come to pass. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And, behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was from Jerusalem about threescore furlongs. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And they talked together of all these things which had happened. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And it came to pass, that, while they communed together and reasoned, Jesus himself drew near, and went with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} But their eyes were held that they should not know him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And he said unto them, What manner of communications (o. logos) are these that all of you have one to another, as all of you walk, and are sad? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And the one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answering said unto him, Are you only a stranger in Jerusalem, and have not known the things which are come to pass there in these days? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And he said unto them, What things? And they said unto him, Concerning Jesus of Nazareth, which was a prophet mighty in deed and word (o. logos) before God and all the people: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him to be condemned to death, and have crucified him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} But we trusted that it had been he which should have redeemed Israel: and beside all this, to day is the third day since these things were done. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Yea, and certain women also of our company made us astonished, which were early at the tomb; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And when they found not his body, they came, saying, that they had also seen a vision of angels, which said that he was alive. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And certain of them which were with us went to the tomb, and found it even so as the women had said: but him they saw not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Then he said unto them, O fools, and slow of heart to believe all that the prophets have spoken: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Ought not Christ to have suffered these things, and to enter into his glory? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, he expounded unto them in all the scriptures the things concerning himself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And they drew nigh unto the village, where they went: and he made as though he would have gone further. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} But they constrained him, saying, Abide with us: for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent. And he went in to tarry with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And it came to pass, as he sat at food with them, he took bread, and blessed it, and brake, and gave to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And their eyes were opened, and they knew him; and he vanished out of their sight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And they said one to another, Did not our heart burn within us, while he talked with us by the way, and while he opened to us the scriptures? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And they rose up the same hour, and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and them that were with them, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Saying, The Lord has risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And they told what things were done in the way, and how he was known of them in breaking of bread. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And as they thus spoke, Jesus himself stood in the midst of them, and says unto them, Peace be unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} But they were terrified and affrighted, and supposed that they had seen a spirit. (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And he said unto them, Why are all of you troubled? and why do thoughts arise in your hearts? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} Behold my hands and my feet, that it is I myself: handle me, and see; for a spirit (o. pneuma) has not flesh and bones, as all of you see me have. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And when he had thus spoken, he showed them his hands and his feet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And while they yet believed not for joy, and wondered, he said unto them, Have all of you here any food? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And they gave him a piece of a broiled fish, and of an honeycomb. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And he took it, and did eat before them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And he said unto them, These are the words (o. logos) which I spoke unto you, while I was yet with you, that all things must be fulfilled, which were written in the law of Moses, and in the prophets, and in the psalms, concerning me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} Then opened he their understanding, that they might understand the scriptures, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} And said unto them, Thus it is written, and thus it was essential for Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} And all of you are witnesses of these things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} And, behold, I send the promise of my Father upon you: but tarry all of you in the city of Jerusalem, until all of you be imbued with power from on high. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} And he led them out as far as to Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} And it came to pass, while he blessed them, he was parted from them, and carried up into heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} And they worshipped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} And were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{18} Name meaning: Cleopas (Kleopas) — Glory of the father Disciple on the Emmaus road.\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{4} two men; (see note on .) \textsuperscript{5} they;, ; the living or, him that liveth \textsuperscript{13} two; Emmaus was situated, according to the testimony both of Luke and Josephus, sixty furlongs from Jerusalem, that is, about seven miles and a half. It has generally been confounded with Emmaus, a city of Judah, afterwards called Nicopolis; but Reland has satisfactorily shown that they were distinct places; the latter, according to the old Itinerary of Palestine, being situated 10 miles from Lydda, and 22 miles from Jerusalem. D'Arvieux states, that going from Jerusalem to Rama, he took the right from the high road to Rama, at some little distance from Jerusalem, and "travelled a good league over rocks and flint stones, to the end of the valley of terebinthine trees, " until he reached Emmaus; which "seems, by the ruins which surround it, to have been formerly larger that it was in our Saviour's time. The Christians, while masters of the Holy Land, re-established it a little, and built several churches. Emmaus was not worth the trouble of having come out of the way to see it." \textsuperscript{25} O fools Rather, inconsiderate men, ανοητοι, justly termed such, because they had not attended to the description of the Messiah by the prophets, nor to His teaching and miracles, as proofs that He alone was the person described. \textsuperscript{28} he made That is, he was directing his steps as if to go onwards; and so he doubtless would, had he not been withheld by their friendly importunities. There is not the smallest ground for founding a charge of dissimulation against our Saviour, or affording any encouragement to dissimulation in others. \textsuperscript{31} their eyes; vanished out of their sight or, ceased to be seen of them \textsuperscript{34} Saying From, we learn that the apostles did not believe the testimony even of the two disciples from Emmaus, while it is here asserted they were saying, when they entered the room, "The Lord is risen" etc. This difficulty is removed by rendering interrogatively, "Has the Lord risen, " etc? hath \textsuperscript{44} These, ; while, that all, ; in the law, ; , in the prophets;, ; , ; in the psalms\par}

\section*{John Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} John the apostle\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} Early church testimony strongly attributes the Gospel to John the son of Zebedee, and the internal beloved-disciple claim fits apostolic authorship.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} John 21:24 identifies the disciple behind the testimony; early church witness connects this with the apostle John.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} AD 80-90 in common conservative dating\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Reflective Gospel centered on Jesus' signs, identity, and saving purpose.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To lead readers to believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and to have life in His name.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} signs; deity of Christ; belief; life; witness; love\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Prologue 1; book of signs 2-12; book of glory 13-20; epilogue 21.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Papyrus 52 early 2nd century AD | Subst. Papyrus 66 is the earliest substantial John witness ca. AD 200 | Heb. No complete Hebrew original survives n/a | Gk. Codex Vaticanus and Codex Sinaiticus preserve complete Greek John 4th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Likely early allusion in Ignatius; clear attestation in Irenaeus by Irenaeus (late 2nd century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} John is text-critically important at several famous loci, but its early papyrus attestation is exceptionally strong.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives John's high Christology as apostolic eyewitness testimony, not as a late theological invention.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{John}
\markboth{JOHN}{}
\subsection*{John 1}
\markright{JOHN 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} In the beginning was the Word, (o. logos) and the Word (o. logos) was with God, and the Word (o. logos) was God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The same was in the beginning with God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} All things were made by him; and without him was not any thing made that was made. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} In him was life; and the life was the light of men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And the light shines in darkness; and the darkness comprehended it not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} There was a man sent from God, whose name was John. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light, that all men through him might believe. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} That was the true Light, which lights every man that comes into the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} He was in the world, and the world was made by him, and the world knew him not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} He came unto his own, and his own received him not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Which were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And the Word (o. logos) was made flesh, and dwelt among us, (and we beheld his glory, the glory as of the only begotten of the Father,) full of grace and truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} John bare witness of him, and cried, saying, This was he of whom I spoke, He that comes after me is preferred before me: for he was before me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And of his fullness have all we received, and grace for grace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For the law was given by Moses, but grace and truth came by Jesus Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} No man has seen God at any time, the only begotten Son, which is in the bosom of the Father, he has declared him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And this is the record of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who are you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And he confessed, and denied not; but confessed, I am not the Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And they asked him, What then? Are you Elijah? And he says, I am not. Are you that prophet? And he answered, No. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Then said they unto him, Who are you? that we may give an answer to them that sent us. What says you of yourself? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said the prophet Isaiah. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And they which were sent were of the Pharisees. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And they asked him, and said unto him, Why baptize you then, if you be not that Christ, nor Elijah, neither that prophet? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} John answered them, saying, I baptize with water: but there stands one among you, whom all of you know not; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} He it is, who coming after me is preferred before me, whose shoe's latchet I am not worthy to unloose. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} These things were done in Bethabara beyond Jordan, where John was baptizing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} The next day John sees Jesus coming unto him, and says, Behold the Lamb of God, which takes away the sin of the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} This is he of whom I said, After me comes a man which is preferred before me: for he was before me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And I knew him not: but that he should be made manifest to Israel, therefore am I come baptizing with water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And John bare record, saying, I saw the Spirit (o. pneuma) descending from heaven like a dove, and it abode upon him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And I knew him not: but he that sent me to baptize with water, the same said unto me, Upon whom you shall see the Spirit (o. pneuma) descending, and remaining on him, the same is he which baptizes with the Holy Spirit. (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And I saw, and bare record that this is the Son of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Again the next day after John stood, and two of his disciples; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And looking upon Jesus as he walked, he says, Behold the Lamb of God! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And the two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Then Jesus turned, and saw them following, and says unto them, What seek all of you? They said unto him, Rabbi, (which is to say, being interpreted, Master,) where dwell you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} He says unto them, Come and see. They came and saw where he dwelt, and abode with him that day: for it was about the tenth hour. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} One of the two which heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} He first finds his own brother Simon, and says unto him, We have found the Messiah, which is, being interpreted, the Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And he brought him to Jesus. And when Jesus beheld him, he said, You are Simon the son of Jona: you shall be called Cephas, which is by interpretation, A stone. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} The day following Jesus would go forth into Galilee, and finds Philip, and says unto him, Follow me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} Now Philip was of Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} Philip finds Nathanael, and says unto him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, did write, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} And Nathanael said unto him, Can there any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip says unto him, Come and see. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and says of him, Behold an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} Nathanael says unto him, Whence know you me? Jesus answered and said unto him, Before that Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} Nathanael answered and says unto him, Rabbi, you are the Son of God; you are the King of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} Jesus answered and said unto him, Because I said unto you, I saw you under the fig tree, believe you? you shall see greater things than these. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} And he says unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Hereafter all of you shall see heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{1} Name of God: Logos (λόγος) — Word Common English renderings: Word. A uniquely Johannine title for the Son, presenting Him as the eternal self-expression of God. \textsuperscript{18} Name of God: Monogenes Huios (μονογενὴς υἱός) — Only begotten Son; unique Son Common English renderings: only begotten Son. Declares the unique divine Sonship of Christ and His perfect revelation of the Father.\par}

\subsection*{John 2}
\markright{JOHN 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the third day there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee; and the mother of Jesus was there: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And both Jesus was called, and his disciples, to the marriage. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And when they wanted wine, the mother of Jesus says unto him, They have no wine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Jesus says unto her, Woman, what have I to do with you? mine hour is not yet come. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} His mother says unto the servants, Whatsoever he says unto you, do it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And there were set there six water pots of stone, after the manner of the purifying of the Jews, containing two or three firkins apiece. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Jesus says unto them, Fill the water pots with water. And they filled them up to the brim. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And he says unto them, Draw out now, and bear unto the governor of the feast. And they bare it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} When the ruler of the feast had tasted the water that was made wine, and knew not whence it was: (but the servants which drew the water knew;) the governor of the feast called the bridegroom, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And says unto him, Every man at the beginning does set forth good wine; and when men have well drunk, then that which is worse: but you have kept the good wine until now. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} This beginning of miracles did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} After this he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, and his brethren, and his disciples: and they continued there not many days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And the Jews' passover was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And found in the temple those that sold oxen and sheep and doves, and the changers of money sitting: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And when he had made a scourge of small cords, he drove them all out of the temple, and the sheep, and the oxen; and poured out the changers' money, and overthrew the tables; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And said unto them that sold doves, Take these things behind; make not my Father's house an house of merchandise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And his disciples remembered that it was written, The zeal of yours house has eaten me up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Then answered the Jews and said unto him, What sign show you unto us, seeing that you do these things? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Jesus answered and said unto them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Then said the Jews, Forty and six years was this temple in building, and will you rear it up in three days? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} But he spoke of the temple of his body. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} When therefore he was risen from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this unto them; and they believed the scripture, and the word (o. logos) which Jesus had said. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Now when he was in Jerusalem at the passover, in the feast day, many believed in his name, when they saw the miracles which he did. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} But Jesus did not commit himself unto them, because he knew all men, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And needed not that any should testify of man: for he knew what was in man.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} am 4034, ad 30 the third a marriage; Cana; Kanah \textsuperscript{11} beginning; did, manifested, ; and his \textsuperscript{17} NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. \subsection*{John 3}
\markright{JOHN 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that you do, except God be with him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Nicodemus says unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, (o. pneuma) he cannot enter into the kingdom of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit (o. pneuma) is spirit. (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Marvel not that I said unto you, All of you must be born again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} The wind (o. pneuma) blows where it decides, and you hear the sound thereof, but can not tell whence it comes, and where it goes: so is every one that is born of the Spirit. (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Jesus answered and said unto him, Are you a master of Israel, and know not these things? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Verily, verily, I say unto you, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and all of you receive not our witness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} If I have told you earthly things, and all of you believe not, how shall all of you believe, if I tell you of heavenly things? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And no man has ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} That whosoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believes in him should not perish, but have everlasting life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} He that believes on him is not condemned: but he that believes not is condemned already, because he has not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And this is the condemnation, that light has come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} For every one that does evil hates the light, neither comes to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} But he that does truth comes to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} For John was not yet cast into prison. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with you beyond Jordan, to whom you bare witness, behold, the same baptizes, and all men come to him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} All of you yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} He that has the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} He must increase, but I must decrease. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} He that comes from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaks of the earth: he that comes from heaven is above all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And what he has seen and heard, that he testifies; and no man receives his testimony. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} He that has received his testimony has set to his seal that God is true. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} For he whom God has sent speaks the words (o. rhema) of God: for God gives not the Spirit (o. pneuma) by measure unto him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} He that believes on the Son has everlasting life: and he that believes not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abides on him.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{1} Name meaning: Nicodemus (Nikodemos) — Victory of the people Came to Jesus by night seeking truth.\par}

\subsection*{John 4}
\markright{JOHN 4}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} When therefore the LORD knew how the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made and baptized more disciples than John, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} He left Judaea, and departed again into Galilee. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And he must essentially go through Samaria. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Then comes he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Now Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} There comes a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus says unto her, Give me to drink. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy food.) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Then says the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that you, being a Jew, ask drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Jesus answered and said unto her, If you knew the gift of God, and who it is that says to you, Give me to drink; you would have asked of him, and he would have given you living water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} The woman says unto him, Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then have you that living water? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Are you greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinks of this water shall thirst again: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} But whosoever drinks of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} The woman says unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come here to draw. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Jesus says unto her, Go, call your husband, and come here. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, You have well said, I have no husband: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} For you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband: in that said you truly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} The woman says unto him, Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and all of you say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Jesus says unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when all of you shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} All of you worship all of you know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit (o. pneuma) and in truth: for the Father seeks such to worship him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} God is a Spirit: (o. pneuma) and they that worship him must worship him in spirit (o. pneuma) and in truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} The woman says unto him, I know that Messiah comes, which is called Christ: when he has come, he will tell us all things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Jesus says unto her, I that speak unto you am he. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seek you? or, Why talk you with her? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} The woman then left her water pot, and went her way into the city, and says to the men, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Come, see a man, which told me all things that ever I did: is not this the Christ? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Then they went out of the city, and came unto him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} In the mean while his disciples prayed him, saying, Master, eat. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} But he said unto them, I have food to eat that all of you know not of. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Therefore said the disciples one to another, Has any man brought him ought to eat? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Jesus says unto them, My food is to do the will of him that sent me, and to finish his work. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Say not all of you, There are yet four months, and then comes harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And he that reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit unto life eternal: that both he that sows and he that reaps may rejoice together. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And herein is that saying (o. logos) true, One sows, and another reaps. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} I sent you to reap that whereon all of you bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and all of you are entered into their labours. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying (o. logos) of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} So when the Samaritans were come unto him, they besought him that he would tarry with them: and he abode there two days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And many more believed because of his own word; (o. logos) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And said unto the woman, Now we believe, not because of your saying: for we have heard him ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Saviour of the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} Now after two days he departed thence, and went into Galilee. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} For Jesus himself testified, that a prophet has no honour in his own country. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} Then when he was come into Galilee, the Galilaeans received him, having seen all the things that he did at Jerusalem at the feast: for they also went unto the feast. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} When he heard that Jesus was come out of Judaea into Galilee, he went unto him, and besought him that he would come down, and heal his son: for he was at the point of death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} Then said Jesus unto him, Except all of you see signs and wonders, all of you will not believe. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} The nobleman says unto him, Sir, come down before my child die. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} Jesus says unto him, Go your way; your son lives. And the man believed the word (o. logos) that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Your son lives. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} Then enquired he of them the hour when he began to amend. And they said unto him, Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Your son lives: and himself believed, and his whole house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{54}} This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{6} Jacob's well Over Jacob's well the empress Helena is said to have built a church, in the form of a cross, of which "nothing but a few foundations" remained in the time of Maundrell. He states that is situated about one-third of an hour, or, about a mile, east of Naplosa, the ancient Sychar; and Mr. Buckingham says it is called Beer Samareea, or the well of Samaria, and "stands at the commencement of the round vale which is thought to be the parcel of ground bought by Jacob, and which, like the narrow valley east of Nablous, is rich and fertile. The mouth of the well itself had an arched or vaulted building over it; and the only passage down to it at this moment is by a small hole in the roof." "It is, " says Maundrell, "dug in the firm rock, and contains about three yards in diameter, and thirty-five in depth; five of which we found full of water." being; sat; the sixth \textsuperscript{10} If; and who, ; thou wouldest; living \textsuperscript{22} ye know; we worship; for \textsuperscript{23} the hour, true, ; in spirit, ; in truth; the Father seeketh \textsuperscript{36} he that reapeth receiveth; both he that \textsuperscript{46} Cana "It is worthy of remark, " says Dr. E. D. Clarke, who visited Cana a few years ago, "that, walking among the ruins of a church, we saw large massy pots, answering the description given of the ancient vessels of the country; not preserved, but lying about, disregarded by the present inhabitants, as antiquities with whose original use they were unacquainted. From their appearance, and the number of them, it was quite evident that a practice of keeping water in large pots, each holding from eighteen to twenty-seven gallons, was once common in the country." (Compare the account of the water pots, .); nobleman or, courtier, or, ruler whose\par}

\subsection*{John 5}
\markright{JOHN 5}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} After this there was a feast of the Jews; and Jesus went up to Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Now there is at Jerusalem by the sheep market a pool, which is called in the Hebrew tongue Bethesda, having five porches. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} In these lay a great multitude of impotent folk, of blind, halt, withered, waiting for the moving of the water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For an angel went down at a certain season into the pool, and troubled the water: whosoever then first after the troubling of the water stepped in was made whole of whatsoever disease he had. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And a certain man was there, which had an infirmity thirty and eight years. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} When Jesus saw him lie, and knew that he had been now a long time in that case, he says unto him, Will you be made whole? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} The impotent man answered him, Sir, I have no man, when the water is troubled, to put me into the pool: but while I am coming, another steps down before me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Jesus says unto him, Rise, take up your bed, and walk. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And immediately the man was made whole, and took up his bed, and walked: and on the same day was the sabbath. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} The Jews therefore said unto him that was cured, It is the sabbath day: it is not lawful for you to carry your bed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} He answered them, He that made me whole, the same said unto me, Take up your bed, and walk. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Then asked they him, What man is that which said unto you, Take up your bed, and walk? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And he that was healed know not who it was: for Jesus had conveyed himself away, a multitude being in that place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Afterward Jesus finds him in the temple, and said unto him, Behold, you are made whole: sin no more, lest a worse thing come unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} The man departed, and told the Jews that it was Jesus, which had made him whole. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And therefore did the Jews persecute Jesus, and sought to slay him, because he had done these things on the sabbath day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} But Jesus answered them, My Father works until now, and I work. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Therefore the Jews sought the more to kill him, because he not only had broken the sabbath, but said also that God was his Father, making himself equal with God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Then answered Jesus and said unto them, Verily, verily, I say unto you, The Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father do: for what things whatsoever he does, these also does the Son likewise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} For the Father loves the Son, and shows him all things that himself does: and he will show him greater works than these, that all of you may marvel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For as the Father raises up the dead, and replenishes life to them; even so the Son gives life to whom he will. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} For the Father judges no man, but has committed all judgment unto the Son: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} That all men should honour the Son, even as they honour the Father. He that honors not the Son honors not the Father which has sent him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that hears my word, (o. logos) and believes on him that sent me, has everlasting life, and shall not come into condemnation; but is passed from death unto life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Verily, verily, I say unto you, The hour is coming, and now is, when the dead shall hear the voice of the Son of God: and they that hear shall live. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} For as the Father has life in himself; so has he given to the Son to have life in himself; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And has given him authority to execute judgment also, because he is the Son of man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Marvel not at this: for the hour is coming, in the which all that are in the graves shall hear his voice, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And shall come forth; they that have done good, unto the resurrection of life; and they that have done evil, unto the resurrection of damnation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} I can of mine own self do nothing: as I hear, I judge: and my judgment is just; because I seek not mine own will, but the will of the Father which has sent me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} If I bear witness of myself, my witness is not true. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} There is another that bears witness of me; and I know that the witness which he witnesses of me is true. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} All of you sent unto John, and he bare witness unto the truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} But I receive not testimony from man: but these things I say, that all of you might be saved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} He was a burning and a shining light: and all of you were willing for a season to rejoice in his light. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} But I have greater witness than that of John: for the works which the Father has given me to finish, the same works that I do, bear witness of me, that the Father has sent me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And the Father himself, which has sent me, has borne witness of me. All of you have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his shape. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And all of you have not his word (o. logos) abiding in you: for whom he has sent, him all of you believe not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} Search the scriptures; for in them all of you think all of you have eternal life: and they are they which testify of me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And all of you will not come to me, that all of you might have life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} I receive not honour from men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} But I know you, that all of you have not the love (o. agape) of God in you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} I am come in my Father's name, and all of you receive me not: if another shall come in his own name, him all of you will receive. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} How can all of you believe, which receive honour one of another, and seek not the honour that comes from God only? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} Do not think that I will accuse you to the Father: there is one that accuses you, even Moses, in whom all of you trust. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} For had all of you believed Moses, all of you would have believed me; for he wrote of me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} But if all of you believe not his writings, how shall all of you believe my words? (o. rhema)\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} market or, gate, pool, Bethesda The supposed remains of the pool of Bethesda are situated on the east of Jerusalem, contiguous on one side to St. Stephen's gate, and on the other to the area of the temple. Maundrell states that, "it is 120 paces long, and forty broad, and at least eight deep, but void of water. At its west end it discovers some old arches, now damned up. These some will have to be porches, in which sat that multitude of lame, halt, and blind. But it is not likely, for instead of five, there are but three." \textsuperscript{4} whosoever The sanative property of this pool has been supposed by some to have been communicated by the blood of the sacrifices, and others have referred it to the mineral properties of the waters. But: 1. The beasts for sacrifice were not washed here, but in a laver in the temple. 2. No natural property could cure all manner of diseases. 3. The cure only extended to the first who entered. 4. It took place only at one particular time. 5. As the healing was effected by immersion, it must have been instantaneous; and it was never failing in it effects. All which, not being observed in medicinal waters, determine the cures to have been miraculous, as expressly stated in the text. first; was made \textsuperscript{13} he that had; a multitude being or, from the multitude that was \textsuperscript{18} the Jews broken; God was \textsuperscript{19} and, with, and, with; with; with; with, Verily, The Son, for; Compare, with;, with \textsuperscript{20} the Father; and showeth, ; greater \textsuperscript{23} all men; *marg.; He that \textsuperscript{24} He that, ; and shall not;, ; but \textsuperscript{27} hath; because; the Son This appears to be a direct reference to, which the Jews interpret of the Messiah. \textsuperscript{39} Search; ye think;, ; they which\par}
