\subsection*{John 13}
\markright{JOHN 13}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Now before the feast of the passover, when Jesus knew that his hour was come that he should depart out of this world unto the Father, having loved his own which were in the world, he loved them unto the end. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And supper being ended, the devil having now put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Jesus knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he was come from God, and went to God; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} He rises from supper, and laid aside his garments; and took a towel, and girded himself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} After that he pours water into a basin, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel wherewith he was girded. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Then comes he to Simon Peter: and Peter says unto him, Lord, do you wash my feet? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Jesus answered and said unto him, What I do you know not now; but you shall know hereafter. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Peter says unto him, You shall never wash my feet. Jesus answered him, If I wash you not, you have no part with me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Simon Peter says unto him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Jesus says to him, He that is washed needs not save to wash his feet, but is clean everything: and all of you are clean, but not all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For he knew who should betray him; therefore said he, All of you are not all clean. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} So after he had washed their feet, and had taken his garments, and was set down again, he said unto them, Know all of you what I have done to you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} All of you call me Master and Lord: and all of you say well; for so I am. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; all of you also ought to wash one another's feet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For I have given you an example, that all of you should do as I have done to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Verily, verily, I say unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord; neither he that is sent greater than he that sent him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} If all of you know these things, happy are all of you if all of you do them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} I speak not of you all: I know whom I have chosen: but that the scripture may be fulfilled, He that eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Now I tell you before it come, that, when it has come to pass, all of you may believe that I am he. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that receives whomsoever I send receives me; and he that receives me receives him that sent me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} When Jesus had thus said, he was troubled in spirit, (o. pneuma) and testified, and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Then the disciples looked one on another, doubting of whom he spoke. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Now there was leaning on Jesus' bosom one of his disciples, whom Jesus loved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, that he should ask who it should be of whom he spoke. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} He then lying on Jesus' breast says unto him, Lord, who is it? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Jesus answered, He it is, to whom I shall give a morsel, when I have dipped it. And when he had dipped the morsel, he gave it to Judas Iscariot, the son of Simon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And after the morsel Satan entered into him. Then said Jesus unto him, That you do, do quickly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Now no man at the table knew for what intent he spoke this unto him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} For some of them thought, because Judas had the bag, that Jesus had said unto him, Buy those things that we have need of against the feast; or, that he should give something to the poor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} He then having received the morsel went immediately out: and it was night. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Therefore, when he was gone out, Jesus said, Now is the Son of man glorified, and God is glorified in him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} If God be glorified in him, God shall also glorify him in himself, and shall immediately glorify him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Little children, yet a little while I am with you. All of you shall seek me: and as I said unto the Jews, Where I go, all of you cannot come; so now I say to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} A new commandment I give unto you, That all of you love one another; as I have loved you, that all of you also love one another. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} By this shall all men know that all of you are my disciples, if all of you have love (o. agape) one to another. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Simon Peter said unto him, Lord, where go you? Jesus answered him, Where I go, you can not follow me now; but you shall follow me afterwards. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Peter said unto him, Lord, why cannot I follow you now? I will lay down my life for your sake. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Jesus answered him, Will you lay down your life for my sake? Verily, verily, I say unto you, The cock shall not crow, till you have denied me three times.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} the feast; knew, ; depart, having, ; unto \textsuperscript{4} laid aside That is, his gown, or upper coat, ιματια, with the girdle by which it was girdled close to his tunic, or inner coat; and instead of his girdle, he tied a towel about him, that he might have it in readiness to dry their feet, and that he might appear as a servant. Indeed the whole action was a servile one; and never performed by a superior to an inferior. \textsuperscript{10} He, ; *Gr. needeth; but; ye \textsuperscript{18} NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. \subsection*{John 14}
\markright{JOHN 14}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Let not your heart be troubled: all of you believe in God, believe also in me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there all of you may be also. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And where I go all of you know, and the way all of you know. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Thomas says unto him, Lord, we know not where you go; and how can we know the way? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Jesus says unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man comes unto the Father, but by me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} If all of you had known me, all of you should have known my Father also: and from henceforth all of you know him, and have seen him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Philip says unto him, Lord, show us the Father, and it satisfies us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Jesus says unto him, Have I been so long time with you, and yet have you not known me, Philip? he that has seen me has seen the Father; and how says you then, Show us the Father? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Believe you not that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? the (o. rhema) words that I speak unto you I speak not of myself: but the Father that dwells in me, he does the works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me: or else believe me for the very works' sake. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Verily, verily, I say unto you, He that believes on me, the works that I do shall he do also; and greater works than these shall he do; because I go unto my Father. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And whatsoever all of you shall ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} If all of you shall ask any thing in my name, I will do it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} If all of you love me, keep my commandments. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter, that he may abide with you for ever; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Even the Spirit (o. pneuma) of truth; whom the world cannot receive, because it sees him not, neither knows him: but all of you know him; for he dwells with you, and shall be in you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} I will not leave you comfortless: I will come to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Yet a little while, and the world sees me no more; but all of you see me: because I live, all of you shall live also. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} At that day all of you shall know that I am in my Father, and all of you in me, and I in you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} He that has my commandments, and keeps them, he it is that loves me: and he that loves me shall be loved of my Father, and I will love him, and will manifest myself to him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Judas says unto him, not Iscariot, Lord, how is it that you will manifest yourself unto us, and not unto the world? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Jesus answered and said unto him, If a man love me, he will keep my words: (o. logos) and my Father will love him, and we will come unto him, and make our abode with him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} He that loves me not keeps not my sayings: (o. logos) and the word (o. logos) which all of you hear is not mine, but the Father's which sent me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} These things have I spoken unto you, being yet present with you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} But the Comforter, which is the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) whom the Father will send in my name, he shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance, whatsoever I have said unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world gives, give I unto you. Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} All of you have heard how I said unto you, I go away, and come again unto you. If all of you loved me, all of you would rejoice, because I said, I go unto the Father: for my Father is greater than I. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And now I have told you before it come to pass, that, when it has come to pass, all of you might believe. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Hereafter I will not talk much with you: for the prince of this world comes, and has nothing in me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} But that the world may know that I love the Father; and as the Father gave me commandment, even so I do. Arise, let us go behind.\par

\subsection*{John 15}
\markright{JOHN 15}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Every branch in me that bears not fruit he takes away: and every branch that bears fruit, he purges it, that it may bring forth more fruit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Now all of you are clean through the word (o. logos) which I have spoken unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself, except it abide in the vine; no more can all of you, except all of you abide in me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} I am the vine, all of you are the branches: He that abides in me, and I in him, the same brings forth much fruit: for without me all of you can do nothing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} If a man abide not in me, he is cast forth as a branch, and is withered; and men gather them, and cast them into the fire, and they are burned. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} If all of you abide in me, and my words (o. rhema) abide in you, all of you shall ask what all of you will, and it shall be done unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Herein is my Father glorified, that all of you bear much fruit; so shall all of you be my disciples. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you: continue all of you in my love. (o. agape) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} If all of you keep my commandments, all of you shall abide in my love; (o. agape) even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and abide in his love. (o. agape) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} This is my commandment, That all of you love one another, as I have loved you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Greater love (o. agape) has no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} All of you are my friends, if all of you do whatsoever I command you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Henceforth I call you not servants; for the servant knows not what his lord does: but I have called you friends; for all things that I have heard of my Father I have made known unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} All of you have not chosen me, but I have chosen you, and ordained you, that all of you should go and bring forth fruit, and that your fruit should remain: that whatsoever all of you shall ask of the Father in my name, he may give it you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} These things I command you, that all of you love one another. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} If the world hate you, all of you know that it hated me before it hated you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} If all of you were of the world, the world would love his own: but because all of you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world, therefore the world hates you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Remember the word (o. logos) that I said unto you, The servant is not greater than his lord. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they have kept my saying, (o. logos) they will keep yours also. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} But all these things will they do unto you for my name's sake, because they know not him that sent me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} If I had not come and spoken unto them, they had not had sin: but now they have no cloak for their sin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} He that hates me hates my Father also. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} If I had not done among them the works which no other man did, they had not had sin: but now have they both seen and hated both me and my Father. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} But this comes to pass, that the word (o. logos) might be fulfilled that is written in their law, They hated me without a cause. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} But when the Comforter has come, whom I will send unto you from the Father, even the Spirit (o. pneuma) of truth, which proceeds from the Father, he shall testify of me: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And all of you also shall bear witness, because all of you have been with me from the beginning.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{5} vine; same; without or, severed from, can \textsuperscript{16} have not, ;, ; ordained; bring; that your; , that whatsoever \textsuperscript{19} were of the world; because \textsuperscript{20} word, ; if they have kept \textsuperscript{25} the; They, without; , All in Gr NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. Brenton LXX: “Psalms 68:4 They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head: my enemies that persecute me unrighteously are strengthened: then I restored that which I took not away.” Masoretic/Hebrew comparison: “Psalms 69:4 They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, [being] mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored [that] which I took not away.”\par}

\subsection*{John 16}
\markright{JOHN 16}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} These things have I spoken unto you, that all of you should not be offended. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} They shall put you out of the synagogues: yea, the time comes, that whosoever kills you will think that he does God service. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And these things will they do unto you, because they have not known the Father, nor me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} But these things have I told you, that when the time shall come, all of you may remember that I told you of them. And these things I said not unto you at the beginning, because I was with you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} But now I go my way to him that sent me; and none of you asks me, Where go you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} But because I have said these things unto you, sorrow has filled your heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Nevertheless I tell you the truth; It is expedient for you that I go away: for if I go not away, the Comforter will not come unto you; but if I depart, I will send him unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And when he has come, he will reprove the world of sin, and of righteousness, and of judgment: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Of sin, because they believe not on me; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Of righteousness, because I go to my Father, and all of you see me no more; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Of judgment, because the prince of this world is judged. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} I have yet many things to say unto you, but all of you cannot bear them now. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Nevertheless when he, the Spirit (o. pneuma) of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth: for he shall not speak of himself; but whatsoever he shall hear, that shall he speak: and he will show you things to come. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} He shall glorify me: for he shall receive of mine, and shall show it unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} All things that the Father has are mine: therefore said I, that he shall take of mine, and shall show it unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} A little while, and all of you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and all of you shall see me, because I go to the Father. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Then said some of his disciples among themselves, What is this that he says unto us, A little while, and all of you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and all of you shall see me: and, Because I go to the Father? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} They said therefore, What is this that he says, A little while? we cannot tell what he says. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Now Jesus knew that they were desirous to ask him, and said unto them, Do all of you enquire among yourselves of that I said, A little while, and all of you shall not see me: and again, a little while, and all of you shall see me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Verily, verily, I say unto you, That all of you shall weep and lament, but the world shall rejoice: and all of you shall be sorrowful, but your sorrow shall be turned into joy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} A woman when she is in travail has sorrow, because her hour has come: but as soon as she is delivered of the child, she remembers no more the anguish, for joy that a man is born into the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And all of you now therefore have sorrow: but I will see you again, and your heart shall rejoice, and your joy no man takes from you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And in that day all of you shall ask me nothing. Verily, verily, I say unto you, Whatsoever all of you shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Until now have all of you asked nothing in my name: ask, and all of you shall receive, that your joy may be full. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} These things have I spoken unto you in proverbs: but the time comes, when I shall no more speak unto you in proverbs, but I shall show you plainly of the Father. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} At that day all of you shall ask in my name: and I say not unto you, that I will pray the Father for you: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} For the Father himself loves you, because all of you have loved me, and have believed that I came out from God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} I came forth from the Father, and am come into the world: again, I leave the world, and go to the Father. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} His disciples said unto him, Lo, now speak you plainly, and speak no proverb. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Now are we sure that you know all things, and need not that any man should ask you: by this we believe that you came forth from God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Jesus answered them, Do all of you now believe? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Behold, the hour comes, yea, is now come, that all of you shall be scattered, every man to his own, and shall leave me alone: and yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} These things I have spoken unto you, that in me all of you might have peace. In the world all of you shall have tribulation: but be of good cheer; I have overcome the world.\par

\subsection*{John 17}
\markright{JOHN 17}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} These words spoke Jesus, and lifted up his eyes to heaven, and said, Father, the hour has come; glorify your Son, that your Son also may glorify you: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} As you have given him power over all flesh, that he should give eternal life to as many as you have given him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And this is life eternal, that they might know you the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you have sent. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I have glorified you on the earth: I have finished the work which you gave me to do. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And now, O Father, glorify you me with yours own self with the glory which I had with you before the world was. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} I have manifested your name unto the men which you gave me out of the world: yours they were, and you gave them me; and they have kept your word. (o. logos) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Now they have known that all things whatsoever you have given me are of you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For I have given unto them the words (o. rhema) which you gave me; and they have received them, and have known surely that I came out from you, and they have believed that you did send me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} I pray for them: I pray not for the world, but for them which you have given me; for they are yours. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And all mine are yours, and yours are mine; and I am glorified in them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And now I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I come to you. Holy Father, keep through yours own name those whom you have given me, that they may be one, as we are. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name: those that you gave me I have kept, and none of them is lost, but the son of perdition; that the scripture might be fulfilled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And now come I to you; and these things I speak in the world, that they might have my joy fulfilled in themselves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} I have given them your word; (o. logos) and the world has hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} I pray not that you should take them out of the world, but that you should keep them from the evil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Sanctify them through your truth: your word (o. logos) is truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} As you have sent me into the world, even so have I also sent them into the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And for their sakes I sanctify myself, that they also might be sanctified through the truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Neither pray I for these alone, but for them also which shall believe on me through their word; (o. logos) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} That they all may be one; as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us: that the world may believe that you have sent me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And the glory which you gave me I have given them; that they may be one, even as we are one: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} I in them, and you in me, that they may be made perfect in one; and that the world may know that you have sent me, and have loved them, as you have loved me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Father, I will that they also, whom you have given me, be with me where I am; that they may behold my glory, which you have given me: for you loved me before the foundation of the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} O righteous Father, the world has not known you: but I have known you, and these have known that you have sent me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And I have declared unto them your name, and will declare it: that the love (o. agape) wherewith you have loved me may be in them, and I in them.\par

\subsection*{John 18}
\markright{JOHN 18}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples over the brook Cedron, where was a garden, into the which he entered, and his disciples. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place: for Jesus frequently resorted thither with his disciples. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Judas then, having received a band of men and officers from the chief priests and Pharisees, comes thither with lanterns and torches and weapons. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Jesus therefore, knowing all things that should come upon him, went forth, and said unto them, Whom seek all of you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus says unto them, I am he. And Judas also, which betrayed him, stood with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Then asked he them again, Whom seek all of you? And they said, Jesus of Nazareth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Jesus answered, I have told you that I am he: if therefore all of you seek me, let these go their way: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} That the saying (o. logos) might be fulfilled, which he spoke, Of them which you gave me have I lost none. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and stroke the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Then said Jesus unto Peter, Put up your sword into the sheath: the cup which my Father has given me, shall I not drink it? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Then the band and the captain and officers of the Jews took Jesus, and bound him, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And led him away to Annas first; for he was father in law to Caiaphas, which was the high priest that same year. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Now Caiaphas was he, which gave counsel to the Jews, that it was expedient that one man should die for the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple: that disciple was known unto the high priest, and went in with Jesus into the palace of the high priest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} But Peter stood at the door without. Then went out that other disciple, which was known unto the high priest, and spoke unto her that kept the door, and brought in Peter. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Then says the damsel that kept the door unto Peter, Are not you also one of this man's disciples? He says, I am not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And the servants and officers stood there, who had made a fire of coals; for it was cold: and they warmed themselves: and Peter stood with them, and warmed himself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} The high priest then asked Jesus of his disciples, and of his doctrine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Jesus answered him, I spoke openly to the world; I ever taught in the synagogue, and in the temple, where the Jews always resort; and in secret have I said nothing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Why ask you me? ask them which heard me, what I have said unto them: behold, they know what I said. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And when he had thus spoken, one of the officers which stood by struck Jesus with the palm of his hand, saying, Answer you the high priest so? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, bear witness of the evil: but if well, why smite you me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Now Annas had sent him bound unto Caiaphas the high priest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And Simon Peter stood and warmed himself. They said therefore unto him, Are not you also one of his disciples? He denied it, and said, I am not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} One of the servants of the high priest, being his kinsman whose ear Peter cut off, says, Did not I see you in the garden with him? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Peter then denied again: and immediately the cock crew. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Then led they Jesus from Caiaphas unto the hall of judgment: and it was early; and they themselves went not into the judgment hall, lest they should be defiled; but that they might eat the passover. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Pilate then went out unto them, and said, What accusation bring all of you against this man? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} They answered and said unto him, If he were not a villain, we would not have delivered him up unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Then said Pilate unto them, Take all of you him, and judge him according to your law. The Jews therefore said unto him, It is not lawful for us to put any man to death: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} That the saying (o. logos) of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying what death he should die. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Then Pilate entered into the judgment hall again, and called Jesus, and said unto him, Are you the King of the Jews? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Jesus answered him, Says you this thing of yourself, or did others tell it you of me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Pilate answered, Am I a Jew? Yours own nation and the chief priests have delivered you unto me: what have you done? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Jesus answered, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom were of this world, then would my servants fight, that I should not be delivered to the Jews: but now is my kingdom not from behind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Pilate therefore said unto him, Are you a king then? Jesus answered, You says that I am a king. To this end was I born, and for this cause came I into the world, that I should bear witness unto the truth. Every one that is of the truth hears my voice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Pilate says unto him, What is truth? And when he had said this, he went out again unto the Jews, and says unto them, I find in him no fault at all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} But all of you have a custom, that I should release unto you one at the passover: will all of you therefore that I release unto you the King of the Jews? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} Then cried they all again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was a robber.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} spoken, 14:1-17:26 he; the brook; Kidron a garden \textsuperscript{6} they went Doubtless by the interposition of Divine power; and it was thus shown that Jesus voluntarily resigned himself into their hands. \textsuperscript{12} the band; the captain, bound \textsuperscript{13} led Annas; that "And Annas sent Christ bound unto Caiaphas the high priest, ." \textsuperscript{17} the damsel; I am not \textsuperscript{22} struck; the palm of his hand or, a rod Answerest \textsuperscript{24} Annas was dismissed from being high priest, ad 23, after filling that office for fifteen years; but, being a person of distinguished character, and having had no fewer than five sons who had successively enjoyed the dignity of the high-priesthood, and the present high priest Caiaphas being his son-in-law, he must have possessed much authority in the nation. It was at the palace of Caiaphas where the chief priests, elders, and scribes were assembled the whole of the night to see the issue of their stratagem.; bound \textsuperscript{28} led; unto; *Gr. hall of judgment or, Pilate's house early; and they; eat \textsuperscript{36} Jesus My kingdom is; then \textsuperscript{37} Thou; that I should; Every\par}

\subsection*{John 19}
\markright{JOHN 19}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then Pilate therefore took Jesus, and scourged him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And the soldiers intertwined a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and they put on him a purple robe, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And said, Hail, King of the Jews! and they stroke him with their hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Pilate therefore went forth again, and says unto them, Behold, I bring him forth to you, that all of you may know that I find no fault in him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Then came Jesus forth, wearing the crown of thorns, and the purple robe. And Pilate says unto them, Behold the man! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} When the chief priests therefore and officers saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him. Pilate says unto them, Take all of you him, and crucify him: for I find no fault in him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} When Pilate therefore heard that saying, (o. logos) he was the more afraid; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And went again into the judgment hall, and says unto Jesus, Whence are you? But Jesus gave him no answer. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Then says Pilate unto him, Speak you not unto me? know you not that I have power to crucify you, and have power to release you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Jesus answered, You could have no power at all against me, except it were given you from above: therefore he that delivered me unto you has the greater sin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And from thenceforth Pilate sought to release him: but the Jews cried out, saying, If you let this man go, you are not Caesar's friend: whosoever makes himself a king speaks against Caesar. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} When Pilate therefore heard that saying, (o. logos) he brought Jesus forth, and sat down in the judgment seat in a place that is called the Pavement, but in the Hebrew, Gabbatha. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And it was the preparation of the passover, and about the sixth hour: and he says unto the Jews, Behold your King! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} But they cried out, Away with him, away with him, crucify him. Pilate says unto them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Then delivered he him therefore unto them to be crucified. And they took Jesus, and led him away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And he bearing his cross went forth into a place called the place of a skull, which is called in the Hebrew Golgotha: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Where they crucified him, and two other with him, on either side one, and Jesus in the midst. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And Pilate wrote a title, and put it on the cross. And the writing was JESUS OF NAZARETH THE KING OF THE JEWS. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} This title then read many of the Jews: for the place where Jesus was crucified was nigh to the city: and it was written in Hebrew, and Greek, and Latin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Then said the chief priests of the Jews to Pilate, Write not, The King of the Jews; but that he said, I am King of the Jews. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Pilate answered, What I have written I have written. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments, and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also his coat: now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} They said therefore among themselves, Let us not rend it, but cast lots for it, whose it shall be: that the scripture might be fulfilled, which says, They parted my raiment among them, and for my vesture they did cast lots. These things therefore the soldiers did. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Now there stood by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} When Jesus therefore saw his mother, and the disciple standing by, whom he loved, he says unto his mother, Woman, behold your son! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Then says he to the disciple, Behold your mother! And from that hour that disciple took her unto his own home. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} After this, Jesus knowing that all things were now accomplished, that the scripture might be fulfilled, says, I thirst. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Now there was set a vessel full of vinegar: and they filled a sponge with vinegar, and put it upon hyssop, and put it to his mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished: and he bowed his head, and gave up the spirit. (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} The Jews therefore, because it was the preparation, that the bodies should not remain upon the cross on the sabbath day, (for that sabbath day was an high day,) besought Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Then came the soldiers, and brake the legs of the first, and of the other which was crucified with him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} But when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was dead already, they brake not his legs: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} But one of the soldiers with a spear pierced his side, and forthwith came there out blood and water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And he that saw it bare record, and his record is true: and he knows that he says true, that all of you might believe. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} For these things were done, that the scripture should be fulfilled, A bone of him shall not be broken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And again another scripture says, They shall look on him whom they pierced. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And after this Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate gave him leave. He came therefore, and took the body of Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And there came also Nicodemus, which at the first came to Jesus by night, and brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about an hundred pound weight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} Then took they the body of Jesus, and wound it in linen clothes with the spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden; and in the garden a new tomb, wherein was never man yet laid. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} There laid they Jesus therefore because of the Jews' preparation day; for the tomb was nigh at hand.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{6} the chief priests; Take Pilate neither did nor could say this seriously; for crucifixion was not a Jewish but a Roman mode of punishment. The cross was made of two beams, either crossing at the top, at right angles, like a T, or in the middle of their length like an X; with a piece on the centre of the transverse beam for the accusation, and another piece projecting from the middle, on which the person sat. The cross on which our Lord suffered was of the former kind, being thus represented on all old monuments, coins, and crosses. The body was usually fastened to the upright beam by nailing the feet to it, and on the transverse piece by nailing the hands; and the person was frequently permitted to hang in this situation till he perished through agony and lack of food. This horrible punishment was usually inflicted only on slaves for the worst of crimes. \textsuperscript{14} the preparation; the sixth Instead of εκτη, sixth, several manuscripts and fathers have τριτη, third, as in the parallel place., Behold \textsuperscript{17} he, ; went; Golgotha, of which Κρανιον and Calvaria are merely translations, is supposed to have been a hill, or a rising on a greater hill, on the north-west of Jerusalem. \textsuperscript{19} wrote; And the The apparent discrepancy between the accounts of this title given by the Evangelists, which has been urged as an objection against their inspiration and veracity, has been most satisfactorily accounted for by Dr. Townson; who supposes that, as it was written in Hebrew, Greek, and Latin, it might have slightly varied in each language; and that, as Luke and John wrote for the Gentiles, they would prefer the Greek inscription, that Matthew, addressing the Jews, would use the Hebrew, and that Mark, writing to the Romans, would naturally give the Latin. Jesus \textsuperscript{23} the soldiers; now Such was the χιτων, or coat, of the Jewish high-priest, as described by Josephus. woven or, wrought \textsuperscript{25} his mother and his; Cleophas or, Cleopas, and Mary \textsuperscript{29} was set; hyssop This hyssop is termed a reed by Matthew and Mark; and it appears that a species of hyssop, with a reedy stalk, about two feet long, grew about Jerusalem. \textsuperscript{30} It is *Gr:; and he \textsuperscript{31} because; that the that sabbath their Lactantius says that it was a custom to break the legs of criminals upon the cross; which was done, we are told, at the instep with an iron mallet; and appears to have been a kind of coup de grace, the sooner to put them out of pain. \textsuperscript{36} NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. Brenton LXX: “Psalms 33:20 He keeps all their bones: not one of them shall be broken. Exodus 12:46 In one house shall it be eaten, and ye shall not carry of the flesh out from the house; and a bone of it ye shall not break.” Masoretic/Hebrew comparison: “Psalms 34:20 He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken. Exodus 12:46 In one house shall it be eaten; thou shalt not carry forth ought of the flesh abroad out of the house; neither shall ye break a bone thereof.” \textsuperscript{37} NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. Brenton LXX: “Zechariah 12:10 And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and compassion: and they shall look upon me, because they have mocked me, and they shall make lamentation for him, as for a beloved friend, and they shall grieve intensely, as for a first-born son.” Masoretic/Hebrew comparison: “Zechariah 12:10 And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications: and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for [his] only [son], and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for [his] firstborn.”\par}

\subsection*{John 20}
\markright{JOHN 20}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The first day of the week comes Mary Magdalene early, when it was yet dark, unto the tomb, and sees the stone taken away from the tomb. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Then she runs, and comes to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple, whom Jesus loved, and says unto them, They have taken away the LORD out of the tomb, and we know not where they have laid him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Peter therefore went forth, and that other disciple, and came to the tomb. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the tomb. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And he stooping down, and looking in, saw the linen clothes lying; yet went he not in. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Then comes Simon Peter following him, and went into the tomb, and sees the linen clothes lie, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the cloth, that was about his head, not lying with the linen clothes, but wrapped together in a place by itself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Then went in also that other disciple, which came first to the tomb, and he saw, and believed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For as yet they knew not the scripture, that he must rise again from the dead. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Then the disciples went away again unto their own home. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} But Mary stood without at the tomb weeping: and as she wept, she stooped down, and looked into the tomb, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And sees two angels in white sitting, the one at the head, and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And they say unto her, Woman, why weep you? She says unto them, Because they have taken away my LORD, and I know not where they have laid him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And when she had thus said, she turned herself back, and saw Jesus standing, and knew not that it was Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Jesus says unto her, Woman, why weep you? whom seek you? She, supposing him to be the gardener, says unto him, Sir, if you have borne him behind, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Jesus says unto her, Mary. She turned herself, and says unto him, Rabboni; which is to say, Master. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Jesus says unto her, Touch me not; for I am not yet ascended to my Father: but go to my brethren, and say unto them, I ascend unto my Father, and your Father; and to my God, and your God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the LORD, and that he had spoken these things unto her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Then the same day at evening, being the first day of the week, when the doors were shut where the disciples were assembled for fear of the Jews, came Jesus and stood in the midst, and says unto them, Peace be unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And when he had so said, he showed unto them his hands and his side. Then were the disciples glad, when they saw the LORD. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Then said Jesus to them again, Peace be unto you: as my Father has sent me, even so send I you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and says unto them, Receive all of you the Holy Spirit: (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Whomsoever sins all of you remit, they are remitted unto them; and whomsoever sins all of you retain, they are retained. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} The other disciples therefore said unto him, We have seen the LORD. But he said unto them, Except I shall see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my finger into the print of the nails, and thrust my hand into his side, I will not believe. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And after eight days again his disciples were within, and Thomas with them: then came Jesus, the doors being shut, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Then says he to Thomas, Reach here your finger, and behold my hands; and reach here your hand, and thrust it into my side: and be not faithless, but believing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And Thomas answered and said unto him, My LORD and my God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Jesus says unto him, Thomas, because you have seen me, you have believed: blessed are they that have not seen, and yet have believed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} But these are written, that all of you might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing all of you might have life through his name.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} first; cometh Mary Magdalene, as well as Peter, was evidently at the sepulchre twice on that morning of the resurrection. The first time of her going was some short time before her companions, the other Mary and Salome ( ); and observing that the stone had been removed, she returned to inform Peter and John. In the meantime, the other Mary and Salome came to the sepulchre, and saw the angel, as recorded by Matthew and Mark. While these women returned to the city, Peter and John went to the sepulchre, passing them at some distance, or going another way, followed by Mary Magdalene, who stayed after their return. This was her second journey; when she saw two angels, and then Jesus himself, as here related; and immediately after Jesus appeared to the other women, as they returned to the city ( ). In the meantime Joanna and her company arrived at the sepulchre, when two angels appeared to them, and addressed them as the one angel had done the other women ( ). They immediately returned to the city, and by some means found the apostles before the others arrived, and informed them of what they had seen; upon which Peter went a second time to the sepulchre, but saw only the linen clothes lying ( ).; the stone \textsuperscript{2} to the, They have taken \textsuperscript{17} Touch Or rather, "embrace me not, " or, "cling not to me, " ( μη, μου, απτον ), "Spend no more time with me now in joyful gratulations. For I am not yet immediately going to ascend to my Father; you will have several opportunities of seeing me again; but go and tell my disciples that I shall depart to my Father and your Father."; my brethren; I ascend, ; your Father; your God \textsuperscript{19} the same; when; came; Peace \textsuperscript{27} Reach hither thy finger; reach hither thy hand and be \textsuperscript{28} My Lord The disbelief of the apostle is the means of furnishing us with a full and satisfactory demonstration of the resurrection of our Lord. Throughout the divine dispensations every doctrine and ever important truth is gradually revealed; and here we have a conspicuous instance of the progressive system. An angel first declares the glorious event; the empty sepulchre confirms the women's report. Christ's appearance to Mary Magdalene shewed that he was alive; that to the disciples at Emmaus proved that it was at the least the spirit of Christ; that to the eleven shewed the reality of his body; and the conviction given to Thomas proved it the self-same body that had been crucified. Incredulity itself is satisfied; and the convinced apostle exclaims, in the joy of his heart, "My Lord and my God!"\par}

\subsection*{John 21}
\markright{JOHN 21}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} After these things Jesus showed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and likewise showed he himself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} There were together Simon Peter, and Thomas called Didymus, and Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two other of his disciples. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Simon Peter says unto them, I go a fishing. They say unto him, We also go with you. They went forth, and entered into a ship immediately; and that night they caught nothing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} But when the morning was now come, Jesus stood on the shore: but the disciples knew not that it was Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Then Jesus says unto them, Children, have all of you any food? They answered him, No. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And he said unto them, Cast the net on the right side of the ship, and all of you shall find. They cast therefore, and now they were not able to draw it for the multitude of fishes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Therefore that disciple whom Jesus loved says unto Peter, It is the Lord. Now when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he girt his fisher's coat unto him, (for he was naked,) and did cast himself into the sea. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And the other disciples came in a little ship; (for they were not far from land, but as it were two hundred cubits,) dragging the net with fishes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Jesus says unto them, Bring of the fish which all of you have now caught. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land full of great fishes, an hundred and fifty and three: and for all there were so many, yet was not the net broken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Jesus says unto them, Come and dine. And none of the disciples durst ask him, Who are you? knowing that it was the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Jesus then comes, and takes bread, and gives them, and fish likewise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} This is now the third time that Jesus showed himself to his disciples, after that he was risen from the dead. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} So when they had dined, Jesus says to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonas, love you me more than these? He says unto him, Yea, Lord; you know that I love you. He says unto him, Feed my lambs. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} He says to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonas, love you me? He says unto him, Yea, Lord; you know that I love you. He says unto him, Feed my sheep. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} He says unto him the third time, Simon, son of Jonas, love you me? Peter was grieved because he said unto him the third time, Love you me? And he said unto him, Lord, you know all things; you know that I love you. Jesus says unto him, Feed my sheep. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Verily, verily, I say unto you, When you were young, you gird yourself, and walked where you would: but when you shall be old, you shall stretch forth your hands, and another shall gird you, and carry you where you would not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} This spoke he, signifying by what death he should glorify God. And when he had spoken this, he says unto him, Follow me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Then Peter, turning about, sees the disciple whom Jesus loved following; which also leaned on his breast at supper, and said, Lord, which is he that betrays you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Peter seeing him says to Jesus, Lord, and what shall this man do? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Jesus says unto him, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to you? follow you me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Then went this saying (o. logos) abroad among the brethren, that that disciple should not die: yet Jesus said not unto him, He shall not die; but, If I will that he tarry till I come, what is that to you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} This is the disciple which testifies of these things, and wrote these things: and we know that his testimony is true. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written. Amen.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{15} Gk. vocab: arnion (ἀρνίον) = lamb. Common English renderings: lamb. This lemma is not attested in the canonical Greek Old Testament.\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} Thomas Nathanael Cana, ; Kanah the sons \textsuperscript{5} Children or, Sirs, *Gr. have \textsuperscript{6} Cast; They cast; the multitude \textsuperscript{7} that disciple, It is; when; fisher's coat Or, upper coat, great coat, or, surtout, επενδυτην, from επι, upon, and ενδυω, I clothe. naked That is, he was only in his vest, or under garment; for γυμνος, naked, like the Hebrew arom is frequently applied to one who has merely laid aside his outer garment. See note on, and see note on . To which may be added what we read in the LXX, "Thou has taken away the covering of the naked, " αμφιαιν γυμνων, the plaid, or blanket, in which they wrapped themselves, and besides they had no other. In this sense Virgil says, Nudus ara, sere nudus "plough naked, and sow naked, " i.e., strip off your upper garments. \textsuperscript{12} Come dine The word αρισταν, like prandere was used for any meat taken before the coena or supper. durst \textsuperscript{14} the third time Or, as some read, the third day. On the day the Saviour rose he appeared five times; the second day was that day se'nnight; and this was the third day - or this was his third appearance to any considerable number of his disciples together. Though he had appeared to Mary, to the women, to the two disciples, to Cephas - yet he had but twice appeared to a company of them together. \textsuperscript{15} son, Jona, Bar-jona lovest, ; more; thou knowest; Feed; lambs \textsuperscript{17} the third; grieved; Lord, ; thou knowest that; Feed \textsuperscript{18} but; another thou wouldest not \textsuperscript{25} there; that even This is a very strong eastern expression to represent the number of miracles which Jesus wrought. But however strong and strange it may appear to us of the western world, we find sacred and other authors using hyperboles of the like kind and signification. See; . Basnage gives a very similar hyperbole taken from the Jewish writers, in which Jochanan is said to have "composed such a great number of precepts and lessons, that if the heavens were paper, and all the trees of the forest so many pens, and all the children of men so many scribes, they would not suffice to write all his lessons."\par}

\section*{Acts Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} Luke\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} Acts continues Luke's account to the same addressee and shares style, vocabulary, and perspective with the Gospel.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} The we-sections and early church tradition support Luke as the author of Acts.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} AD 62 or shortly after in common conservative dating\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Historical account of the risen Christ's work by the Spirit through the apostles from Jerusalem to Rome.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To narrate the spread of the gospel, the formation of the church, and the mission to the nations under the Spirit's power.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} Holy Spirit; mission; church; apostolic witness; Jew and Gentile; providence\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Jerusalem witness 1-7; Judea and Samaria 8-12; Gentile mission to Rome 13-28.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Papyrus 29 and Papyrus 38 are early small witnesses; Papyrus 45 is substantial 3rd century AD | Subst. Papyrus 45 is the earliest substantial Acts witness 3rd century AD | Heb. No complete Hebrew original survives n/a | Gk. Codex Vaticanus and Codex Sinaiticus preserve complete Greek Acts 4th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Clear early attestation in Irenaeus and Muratorian tradition by Irenaeus (late 2nd century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} Acts is central for text criticism because the Alexandrian and Western forms differ at many points.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives Acts as accurate sacred history written by Luke under inspiration.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{Acts}
\markboth{ACTS}{}
\subsection*{Acts 1}
\markright{ACTS 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The former treatise (o. logos) have I made, O Theophilus, of all that Jesus began both to do and teach, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Until the day in which he was taken up, after that he through the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) had given commandments unto the apostles whom he had chosen: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} To whom also he showed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And, being assembled together with them, commanded them that they should not depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which, says he, all of you have heard of me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For John truly baptized with water; but all of you shall be baptized with the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) not many days behind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, will you at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And he said unto them, It is not for you to know the times or the seasons, which the Father has put in his own power. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} But all of you shall receive power, after that the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) has come upon you: and all of you shall be witnesses unto me both in Jerusalem, and in all Judaea, and in Samaria, and unto the uttermost part of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And when he had spoken these things, while they beheld, he was taken up; and a cloud received him out of their sight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And while they looked steadfastly toward heaven as he went up, behold, two men stood by them in white apparel; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Which also said, All of you men of Galilee, why stand all of you gazing up into heaven? this same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner as all of you have seen him go into heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Then returned they unto Jerusalem from the mount called Olivet, which is from Jerusalem a sabbath day's journey. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And when they were come in, they went up into an upper room, where abode both Peter, and James, and John, and Andrew, Philip, and Thomas, Bartholomew, and Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon Zelotes, and Judas the brother of James. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} These all continued with one accord in prayer and supplication, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brethren. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And in those days Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples, and said, (the number of names together were about an hundred and twenty,) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Men and brethren, this scripture must essentially have been fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) by the mouth of David spoke before concerning Judas, which was guide to them that took Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For he was numbered with us, and had obtained part of this ministry. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Now this man purchased a field with the reward of iniquity; and falling headlong, he burst asunder in the midst, and all his bowels gushed out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And it was known unto all the dwellers at Jerusalem; insomuch as that field is called in their proper tongue, Aceldama, that is to say, The field of blood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} For it is written in the book of Psalms, Let his habitation be desolate, and let no man dwell therein: and his bishoprick let another take. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Wherefore of these men which have companied with us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Beginning from the baptism of John, unto that same day that he was taken up from us, must one be ordained to be a witness with us of his resurrection. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And they appointed two, Joseph called Barsabas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And they prayed, and said, You, Lord, which know the hearts of all men, show whether of these two you have chosen, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} That he may take part of this ministry and apostleship, from which Judas by transgression fell, that he might go to his own place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And they gave forth their lots; and the lot fell upon Matthias; and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{23} Name meaning: Matthias (Mattityahu) — Gift of Yahweh Chosen to replace Judas. \textsuperscript{25} Gk. vocab: apostolē (ἀποστολή) = sending; mission; apostleship. Common English renderings: apostleship. This lemma is not attested in the canonical Greek Old Testament.\par}
