\subsection*{Acts 2}
\markright{ACTS 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And when the day of Pentecost was fully come, they were all with one accord in one place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And suddenly there came a sound from heaven as of a rushing mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And there appeared unto them cloven tongues like of fire, and it sat upon each of them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) and began to speak with other tongues, as the Spirit (o. pneuma) gave them utterance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And there were dwelling at Jerusalem Jews, devout men, out of every nation under heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Now when this was noised abroad, the multitude came together, and were confounded, because that every man heard them speak in his own language. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And they were all amazed and marvelled, saying one to another, Behold, are not all these which speak Galilaeans? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And how hear we every man in our own tongue, wherein we were born? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Parthians, and Medes, and Elamites, and the dwellers in Mesopotamia, and in Judaea, and Cappadocia, in Pontus, and Asia, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Phrygia, and Pamphylia, in Egypt, and in the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and strangers of Rome, Jews and proselytes, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Cretes and Arabians, we do hear them speak in our tongues the wonderful works of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And they were all amazed, and were in doubt, saying one to another, What means this? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Others mocking said, These men are full of new wine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and said unto them, All of you men of Judaea, and all you that dwell at Jerusalem, be this known unto you, and hearken to my words: (o. rhema) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For these are not drunken, as all of you suppose, seeing it is but the third hour of the day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} But this is that which was spoken by the prophet Joel; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And it shall come to pass in the last days, says God, I will pour out of my Spirit (o. pneuma) upon all flesh: and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And on my servants and on my handmaidens I will pour out in those days of my Spirit; (o. pneuma) and they shall prophesy: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And I will show wonders in heaven above, and signs in the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and vapour of smoke: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and notable day of the Lord come: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And it shall come to pass, that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} All of you men of Israel, hear these words; (o. logos) Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved of God among you by miracles and wonders and signs, which God did by him in the midst of you, as all of you yourselves also know: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Him, being delivered by the determinate counsel and foreknowledge of God, all of you have taken, and by wicked hands have crucified and slain: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Whom God has raised up, having loosed the pains of death: because it was not possible that he should be held of it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} For David speaks concerning him, I foresaw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Therefore did my heart rejoice, and my tongue was glad; moreover also my flesh shall rest in hope: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Because you will not leave my soul in hell, neither will you suffer yours Holy One to see corruption. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} You have made known to me the ways of life; you shall make me full of joy with your countenance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Men and brethren, let me freely speak unto you of the patriarch David, that he is both dead and buried, and his tomb is with us unto this day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Therefore being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him, that of the fruit of his loins, according to the flesh, he would raise up Christ to sit on his throne; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} He seeing this before spoke of the resurrection of Christ, that his soul was not left in hell, neither his flesh did see corruption. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} This Jesus has God raised up, whereof we all are witnesses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Therefore being by the right hand of God exalted, and having received of the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) he has shed forth this, which all of you now see and hear. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} For David is not ascended into the heavens: but he says himself, The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit you on my right hand, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Until I make your foes your footstool. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Therefore let all the house of Israel know assuredly, that God has made the same Jesus, whom all of you have crucified, both Lord and Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Now when they heard this, they were pricked in their heart, and said unto Peter and to the rest of the apostles, Men and brethren, what shall we do? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Then Peter said unto them, Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins, and all of you shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit. (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} For the promise is unto you, and to your children, and to all that are far off, even as many as the LORD our God shall call. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And with many other words (o. logos) did he testify and exhort, saying, Save yourselves from this untoward generation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} Then they that gladly received his word (o. logos) were baptized: and the same day there were added unto them about three thousand souls. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And they continued steadfastly in the apostles' doctrine and fellowship, and in breaking of bread, and in prayers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And fear came upon every soul: and many wonders and signs were done by the apostles. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And all that believed were together, and had all things common; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} And sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} And they, continuing daily with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread from house to house, did eat their food with gladness and singleness of heart, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} Praising God, and having favour with all the people. And the Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{23} Gk. vocab: prognōsis (πρόγνωσις) = foreknowledge. Common English renderings: foreknowledge. This lemma is not attested in the canonical Greek Old Testament.\par}

The sun shall be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord come. And it shall come to pass that whosoever shall call on the name of the Lord shall be saved: for in mount Sion and in Jerusalem shall the saved one be as the Lord has said, and they that have glad tidings preached to them, whom the Lord has called.” Masoretic/Hebrew comparison: “Joel 2:28-32 And it shall come to pass afterward, [that] I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh; and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, your young men shall see visions: And also upon the servants and upon the handmaids in those days will I pour out my spirit. \subsection*{Acts 3}
\markright{ACTS 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Now Peter and John went up together into the temple at the hour of prayer, being the ninth hour. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And a certain man lame from his mother's womb was carried, whom they laid daily at the gate of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask alms of them that entered into the temple; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Who seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple asked an alms. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And Peter, fastening his eyes upon him with John, said, Look on us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And he gave heed unto them, expecting to receive something of them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Then Peter said, Silver and gold have I none; but such as I have give I you: In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth rise up and walk. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And he took him by the right hand, and lifted him up: and immediately his feet and ankle bones received strength. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And he leaping up stood, and walked, and entered with them into the temple, walking, and leaping, and praising God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And all the people saw him walking and praising God: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And they knew that it was he which sat for alms at the Beautiful gate of the temple: and they were filled with wonder and amazement at that which had happened unto him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And as the lame man which was healed held Peter and John, all the people ran together unto them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And when Peter saw it, he answered unto the people, All of you men of Israel, why marvel all of you at this? or why look all of you so earnestly on us, as though by our own power or holiness we had made this man to walk? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} The God of Abraham, and of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Son Jesus; whom all of you delivered up, and denied him in the presence of Pilate, when he was determined to let him go. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} But all of you denied the Holy One and the Just, and desired a murderer to be granted unto you; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And killed the Prince of life, whom God has raised from the dead; whereof we are witnesses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And his name through faith in his name has made this man strong, whom all of you see and know: yea, the faith which is by him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And now, brethren, I know that through ignorance all of you did it, as did also your rulers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} But those things, which God before had showed by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he has so fulfilled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Repent all of you therefore, and be converted, that your sins may be blotted out, when the times of refreshing shall come from the presence of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And he shall send Jesus Christ, which before was preached unto you: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Whom the heaven must receive until the times of restitution of all things, which God has spoken by the mouth of all his holy prophets since the world began. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} For Moses truly said unto the fathers, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall all of you hear in all things whatsoever he shall say unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And it shall come to pass, that every soul, which will not hear that prophet, shall be destroyed from among the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Yea, and all the prophets from Samuel and those that follow after, as many as have spoken, have likewise foretold of these days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} All of you are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying unto Abraham, And in your seed shall all the families of the earth be blessed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Unto you first God, having raised up his Son Jesus, sent him to bless you, in turning away every one of you from his iniquities.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} lame; whom which to ask \textsuperscript{13} God of Abraham; hath; , ; whom \textsuperscript{15} Prince or, Author, ; whom; whereof \textsuperscript{21} the heaven the times; holy \textsuperscript{22} Moses; A prophet; of your; like him NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. And whatever man shall not hearken to whatsoever words that prophet shall speak in my name, I will take vengeance on him.” Masoretic/Hebrew comparison: “Deuteronomy 18:15 The LORD thy God will raise up unto thee a Prophet from the midst of thee, of thy brethren, like unto me; unto him ye shall hearken; Deuteronomy 18:18-19 I will raise them up a Prophet from among their brethren, like unto thee, and will put my words in his mouth; and he shall speak unto them all that I shall command him. Genesis 28:14 And thy seed shall be as the sand of the earth; and it shall spread abroad to the sea, and the south, and the north, and to the east; and in thee and in thy seed shall all the tribes of the earth be blessed.” Masoretic/Hebrew comparison: “Genesis 22:18 And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice. \subsection*{Acts 4}
\markright{ACTS 4}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And as they spoke unto the people, the priests, and the captain of the temple, and the Sadducees, came upon them, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Being grieved that they taught the people, and preached through Jesus the resurrection from the dead. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And they laid hands on them, and put them in hold unto the next day: for it was now evening. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Nevertheless many of them which heard the word (o. logos) believed; and the number of the men was about five thousand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And it came to pass on the next day, that their rulers, and elders, and scribes, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And Annas the high priest, and Caiaphas, and John, and Alexander, and as many as were of the kindred of the high priest, were gathered together at Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And when they had set them in the midst, they asked, By what power, or by what name, have all of you done this? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) said unto them, All of you rulers of the people, and elders of Israel, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} If we this day be examined of the good deed done to the impotent man, by what means he is made whole; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Be it known unto you all, and to all the people of Israel, that by the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom all of you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, even by him does this man stand here before you whole. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} This is the stone which was set at nothing of you builders, which is become the head of the corner. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Neither is there salvation in any other: for there is no other name under heaven given among men, whereby we must be saved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And beholding the man which was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Saying, What shall we do to these men? for that indeed a notable miracle has been done by them is manifest to all them that dwell in Jerusalem; and we cannot deny it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} But that it spread no further among the people, let us strictly threaten them, that they speak henceforth to no man in this name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And they called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} But Peter and John answered and said unto them, Whether it be right in the sight of God to hearken unto you more than unto God, judge all of you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} For we cannot but speak the things which we have seen and heard. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} So when they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding nothing how they might punish them, because of the people: for all men glorified God for that which was done. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} For the man was above forty years old, on whom this miracle of healing was showed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And being let go, they went to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And when they heard that, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, Lord, you are God, which have made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all that in them is: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Who by the mouth of your servant David have said, Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} For truthfully against your holy child Jesus, whom you have anointed, both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} In order to do whatsoever your hand and your counsel determined before to be done. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto your servants, that with all boldness they may speak your word, (o. logos) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} By stretching forth yours hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done by the name of your holy child Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) and they spoke the word (o. logos) of God with boldness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And the multitude of them that believed were of one heart and of one soul: neither said any of them that ought of the things which he possessed was his own; but they had all things common. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And with great power gave the apostles witness of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus: and great grace was upon them all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Neither was there any among them that lacked: for as many as were possessors of lands or houses sold them, and brought the prices of the things that were sold, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And laid them down at the apostles' feet: and distribution was made unto every man according as he had need. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas, (which is, being interpreted, The son of consolation,) a Levite, and of the country of Cyprus, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Having land, sold it, and brought the money, and laid it at the apostles' feet.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{36} Name meaning: Barnabas (Bar-Nabas) — Son of encouragement Encouraged the early Church and Paul.\par}

\subsection*{Acts 5}
\markright{ACTS 5}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And kept back part of the price, his wife also being privy to it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} But Peter said, Ananias, why has Satan filled yours heart to lie to the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) and to keep back part of the price of the land? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} While it remained, was it not yours own? and after it was sold, was it not in yours own power? why have you conceived this thing in yours heart? you have not lied unto men, but unto God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And Ananias hearing these words (o. logos) fell down, and gave up the spirit: and great fear came on all them that heard these things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And the young men arose, wound him up, and carried him out, and buried him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And it was about the space of three hours after, when his wife, not knowing what was done, came in. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And Peter answered unto her, Tell me whether all of you sold the land for so much? And she said, Yea, for so much. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Then Peter said unto her, How is it that all of you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit (o. pneuma) of the Lord? behold, the feet of them which have buried your husband are at the door, and shall carry you out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Then fell she down immediately at his feet, and yielded up the spirit: and the young men came in, and found her dead, and, carrying her forth, buried her by her husband. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And great fear came upon all the church, and upon as many as heard these things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And by the hands of the apostles were many signs and wonders wrought among the people; (and they were all with one accord in Solomon's porch. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And of the rest durst no man join himself to them: but the people magnified them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And believers were the more added to the Lord, multitudes both of men and women.) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Insomuch that they brought forth the sick into the streets, and laid them on beds and couches, that at the least the shadow of Peter passing by might overshadow some of them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} There came also a multitude out of the cities round about unto Jerusalem, bringing sick folks, and them which were vexed with unclean spirits: (o. pneuma) and they were healed every one. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Then the high priest rose up, and all they that were with him, (which is the sect of the Sadducees,) and were filled with indignation, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And laid their hands on the apostles, and put them in the common prison. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} But the angel of the Lord by night opened the prison doors, and brought them forth, and said, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Go, stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words (o. rhema) of this life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And when they heard that, they entered into the temple early in the morning, and taught. But the high priest came, and they that were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} But when the officers came, and found them not in the prison, they returned and told, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Saying, The prison truly found we shut with all safety, and the keepers standing without before the doors: but when we had opened, we found no man within. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Now when the high priest and the captain of the temple and the chief priests heard these things, (o. logos) they doubted of them unto which this would grow. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Then came one and told them, saying, Behold, the men whom all of you put in prison are standing in the temple, and teaching the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Then went the captain with the officers, and brought them without violence: for they feared the people, lest they should have been stoned. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And when they had brought them, they set them before the council: and the high priest asked them, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Saying, Did not we strictly command you that all of you should not teach in this name? and, behold, all of you have filled Jerusalem with your doctrine, and intend to bring this man's blood upon us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Then Peter and the other apostles answered and said, We ought to obey God rather than men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom all of you slew and hanged on a tree. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Him has God exalted with his right hand to be a Prince and a Saviour, in order to give repentance to Israel, and forgiveness of sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And we are his witnesses of these things; (o. rhema) and so is also the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) whom God has given to them that obey him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} When they heard that, they were cut to the heart, and took counsel to slay them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Then stood there up one in the council, a Pharisee, named Gamaliel, a doctor of the law, had in reputation among all the people, and commanded to put the apostles forth a little space; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And said unto them, All of you men of Israel, take heed to yourselves what all of you intend to do as concerning these men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} For before these days rose up Theudas, boasting himself to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered, and brought to nothing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} After this man rose up Judas of Galilee in the days of the taxing, and drew away much people after him: he also perished; and all, even as many as obeyed him, were dispersed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And now I say unto you, Refrain from these men, and let them alone: for if this counsel or this work be of men, it will come to nothing: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} But if it be of God, all of you cannot overthrow it; lest lest by any means all of you be found even to fight against God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And to him they agreed: and when they had called the apostles, and beaten them, they commanded that they should not speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And they departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer shame for his name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And daily in the temple, and in every house, they ceased not to teach and preach Jesus Christ.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{1} Name meaning: Ananias (Chananyah) — Yahweh has been gracious Name borne by multiple figures in the New Testament. Name meaning: Sapphira (Sapphira) — Sapphire Beautiful exterior but deceptive heart. \textsuperscript{34} Name meaning: Gamaliel (Gamaliel) — God is my reward Wise teacher who advised the Sanhedrin.\par}

\subsection*{Acts 6}
\markright{ACTS 6}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word (o. logos) of God, and serve tables. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Wherefore, brethren, look all of you out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word. (o. logos) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And the saying (o. logos) pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the word (o. logos) of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit (o. pneuma) by which he spoke. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words (o. rhema) against Moses, and against God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceases not to speak blasphemous words (o. rhema) against this holy place, and the law: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And all that sat in the council, looking steadfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.\par

\subsection*{Acts 7}
\markright{ACTS 7}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then said the high priest, Are these things so? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And he said, Men, brethren, and fathers, hearken; The God of glory appeared unto our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he dwelt in Charran, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And said unto him, Get you out of your country, and from your kindred, and come into the land which I shall show you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Then came he out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and dwelt in Charran: and from thence, when his father was dead, he removed him into this land, wherein all of you now dwell. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And he gave him none inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on: yet he promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when as yet he had no child. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And God spoke likewise, That his seed should sojourn in a strange land; and that they should bring them into bondage, and plead them evil four hundred years. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the nation to whom they shall be in bondage will I judge, said God: and after that shall they come forth, and serve me in this place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And he gave him the covenant of circumcision: and so Abraham brings forth Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day; and Isaac brings forth Jacob; and Jacob brings forth the twelve patriarchs. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And the patriarchs, moved with envy, sold Joseph into Egypt: but God was with him, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favour and wisdom in the sight of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and he made him governor over Egypt and all his house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Now there came a dearth over all the land of Egypt and Chanaan, and great affliction: and our fathers found no sustenance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} But when Jacob heard that there was corn in Egypt, he sent out our fathers first. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And at the second time Joseph was made known to his brethren; and Joseph's kindred was made known unto Pharaoh. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Then sent Joseph, and called his father Jacob to him, and all his kindred, threescore and fifteen souls. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} So Jacob went down into Egypt, and died, he, and our fathers, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And were carried over into Sychem, and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a sum of money of the sons of Emmor the father of Sychem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} But when the time of the promise drew nigh, which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Till another king arose, which knew not Joseph. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} The same dealt subtlely with our kindred, and evil pleaded our fathers, so that they cast out their young children, to the end they might not live. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} In which time Moses was born, and was exceeding fair, and nourished up in his father's house three months: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And when he was cast out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and nourished him for her own son. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And Moses was learned in all the wisdom of the Egyptians, and was mighty in words (o. logos) and in deeds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And when he was full forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brethren the children of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and stroke the Egyptian: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} For he supposed his brethren would have understood how that God by his hand would deliver them: but they understood not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And the next day he showed himself unto them as they strove, and would have set them to reconcile again, saying, Sirs, all of you are brethren; why do all of you wrong one to another? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} But he that did his neighbour wrong thrust him away, saying, Who made you a ruler and a judge over us? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Will you kill me, as you did the Egyptian yesterday? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Then fled Moses at this saying, (o. logos) and was a stranger in the land of Madian, where he brings forth two sons. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And when forty years were expired, there appeared to him in the wilderness of mount Sina an angel of the Lord in a flame of fire in a bush. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight: and as he drew near to behold it, the voice of the LORD came unto him, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Saying, I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. Then Moses trembled, and durst not behold. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Then said the Lord to him, Put off your shoes from your feet: for the place where you stand is holy ground. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} I have seen, I have seen the affliction of my people which is in Egypt, and I have heard their groaning, and am come down to deliver them. And now come, I will send you into Egypt. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} This Moses whom they refused, saying, Who made you a ruler and a judge? the same did God send to be a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel which appeared to him in the bush. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} He brought them out, after that he had showed wonders and signs in the land of Egypt, and in the Red sea, and in the wilderness forty years. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} This is that Moses, which said unto the children of Israel, A prophet shall the Lord your God raise up unto you of your brethren, like unto me; him shall all of you hear. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} This is he, that was in the church in the wilderness with the angel which spoke to him in the mount Sina, and with our fathers: who received the lively oracles to give unto us: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} To whom our fathers would not obey, but thrust him from them, and in their hearts turned back again into Egypt, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} Saying unto Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: for as for this Moses, which brought us out of the land of Egypt, we know not what is become of him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And they made a calf in those days, and offered sacrifice unto the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their own hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} Then God turned, and gave them up to worship the host of heaven; as it is written in the book of the prophets, O all of you house of Israel, have all of you offered to me slain beasts and sacrifices by the space of forty years in the wilderness? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} Yea, all of you took up the tabernacle of Moloch, and the star of your god Remphan, figures which all of you made to worship them: and I will carry you away beyond Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} Our fathers had the tabernacle of witness in the wilderness, as he had appointed, speaking unto Moses, that he should make it according to the fashion that he had seen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} Which also our fathers that came after brought in with Jesus into the possession of the Gentiles, whom God drove out before the face of our fathers, unto the days of David; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} Who found favour before God, and desired to find a tabernacle for the God of Jacob. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} But Solomon built him an house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} Nevertheless the most High dwells not in temples made with hands; as says the prophet, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} Heaven is my throne, and earth is my footstool: what house will all of you build me? says the Lord: or what is the place of my rest? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} Has not my hand made all these things? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} All of you stubborn and uncircumcised in heart and ears, all of you do always resist the Holy Spirit: (o. pneuma) as your fathers did, so do all of you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} Which of the prophets have not your fathers persecuted? and they have slain them which showed before of the coming of the Just One; of whom all of you have been now the betrayers and murderers: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} Who have received the law by the disposition of angels, and have not kept it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{54}} When they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed on him with their teeth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{55}} But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) looked up steadfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{56}} And said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of man standing on the right hand of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{57}} Then they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and ran upon him with one accord, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{58}} And cast him out of the city, and stoned him: and the witnesses laid down their clothes at a young man's feet, whose name was Saul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{59}} And they stoned Stephen, calling upon God, and saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit. (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{60}} And he kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, lay not this sin to their charge. And when he had said this, he fell asleep.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} Men, The God, ; *Gr:; appeared; when Charran, Haran \textsuperscript{3} NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. Brenton LXX: “Genesis 12:1 And the Lord said to Abram, Go forth out of thy land and out of thy kindred, and out of the house of thy father, and come into the land which I shall shew thee.” Masoretic/Hebrew comparison: “Genesis 12:1 Now the LORD had said unto Abram, Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee:” \textsuperscript{5} he gave; not yet, ; , 34:4; when \textsuperscript{7} the nation; Exod. 7:1-14:31; and serve NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. Exodus 3:12 And God spoke to Moses, saying, I will be with thee, and this shall be the sign to thee that I shall send thee forth,--when thou bringest out my people out of Egypt, then ye shall serve God in this mountain.” Masoretic/Hebrew comparison: “Genesis 15:14 And also that nation, whom they shall serve, will I judge: and afterward shall they come out with great substance. Exodus 3:12 And he said, Certainly I will be with thee; and this [shall be] a token unto thee, that I have sent thee: When thou hast brought forth the people out of Egypt, ye shall serve God upon this mountain.” \textsuperscript{8} the covenant; and so Or, "and thus, " και, ουτως, in this covenant., and Isaac; and Jacob, ; patriarchs \textsuperscript{16} were Of the two burying-places of the patriarchs, one was at Hebron, the cave and field which Abraham purchased of Ephron the Hittite (, etc.); the other in Sychem, which Jacob (not Abraham) bought of the sons of Emmor ( ). To remove this glaring discrepancy, Markland interprets παρα, from, as it frequently signifies with a genitive, and renders, "And were carried over to Sychem; and afterwards from among the descendants of Emmor, the father, or son, of Sychem, they were laid in the sepulchre which Abraham bought for a sum of money." This agrees with the account which Josephus gives of the patriarchs; that they were carried out of Egypt, first to Sychem, and then to Hebron, where they were buried.; the sepulchre, Emmor, Hamor, Shechem \textsuperscript{20} Moses and was; exceeding fair or, fair to God \textsuperscript{25} For or, Now God, ; but \textsuperscript{27} NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. \subsection*{Acts 8}
\markright{ACTS 8}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And Saul was consenting unto his death. And at that time there was a great persecution against the church which was at Jerusalem; and they were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judaea and Samaria, except the apostles. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And devout men carried Stephen to his burial, and made great lamentation over him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} As for Saul, he made havoc of the church, entering into every house, and haling men and women committed them to prison. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Therefore they that were scattered abroad went every where preaching the word. (o. logos) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Then Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and preached Christ unto them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spoke, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For unclean spirits, (o. pneuma) crying with loud voice, came out of many that were possessed with them: and many taken with palsies, and that were lame, were healed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And there was great joy in that city. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} But there was a certain man, called Simon, which in time past in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} To whom they all gave heed, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is the great power of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And to him they had regard, because that of long time he had bewitched them with sorceries. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} But when they believed Philip preaching the things concerning the kingdom of God, and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Then Simon himself believed also: and when he was baptized, he continued with Philip, and wondered, beholding the miracles and signs which were done. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Now when the apostles which were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word (o. logos) of God, they sent unto them Peter and John: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Who, when they were come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit: (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} (For as yet he was fallen upon none of them: only they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Then laid they their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit. (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And when Simon saw that through laying on of the apostles' hands the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) was given, he offered them money, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Saying, Give me also this power, that on whomsoever I lay hands, he may receive the Holy Spirit. (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But Peter said unto him, Your money perish with you, because you have thought that the gift of God may be purchased with money. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} You have neither part nor lot in this matter: (o. logos) for your heart is not right in the sight of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Repent therefore of this your wickedness, and pray God, if perhaps the thought of yours heart may be forgiven you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} For I perceive that you are in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Then answered Simon, and said, Pray all of you to the LORD for me, that none of these things which all of you have spoken come upon me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And they, when they had testified and preached the word (o. logos) of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the gospel in many villages of the Samaritans. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And the angel of the Lord spoke unto Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south unto the way that goes down from Jerusalem unto Gaza, which is desert. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And he arose and went: and, behold, a man of Ethiopia, an eunuch of great authority under Candace queen of the Ethiopians, who had the charge of all her treasure, and had come to Jerusalem in order to worship, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Was returning, and sitting in his chariot read Isaiah the prophet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Then the Spirit (o. pneuma) said unto Philip, Go near, and join yourself to this chariot. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And Philip ran thither to him, and heard him read the prophet Isaiah, and said, Understand you what you read? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And he said, How can I, except some man should guide me? And he desired Philip that he would come up and sit with him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} The place of the scripture which he read was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter; and like a lamb dumb before his shearer, so opened he not his mouth: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: and who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken from the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And the eunuch answered Philip, and said, I pray you, of whom speaks the prophet this? of himself, or of some other man? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Then Philip opened his mouth, and began at the same scripture, and preached unto him Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And as they went on their way, they came unto a certain water: and the eunuch said, See, here is water; what does hinder me to be baptized? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And Philip said, If you believe with all yours heart, you may. And he answered and said, I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And he commanded the chariot to stand still: and they went down both into the water, both Philip and the eunuch; and he baptized him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And when they were come up out of the water, the Spirit (o. pneuma) of the Lord caught away Philip, that the eunuch saw him no more: and he went on his way rejoicing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} But Philip was found at Azotus: and passing through he preached in all the cities, till he came to Caesarea.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{9} Name meaning: Simon the Sorcerer (Shimon) — He has heard Heard the gospel but sought power.\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} And Saul This clause evidently belongs to the conclusion of the previous chapter; there is scarcely a worse division of chapters than this., there, ; the church, and they; Samaria; except \textsuperscript{5} Philip, the city Rather, "to a city of Samaria, " εις, πολις της Σαμαρειας, for the city of Samaria had been utterly destroyed by Hyrcanus, and the city built by Herod on its site was called Σεβαστη, that is, Augusta, in honour of Augustus. Samaria comprised the tract of country formerly occupied by the tribes of Ephraim and Manasseh, west of Jordan, lying between Judea and Galilee, beginning, says Josephus, at Ginea in the great plain, and ending at the toparchy of Acrabateni.; preached \textsuperscript{10} they; from, ; the great power \textsuperscript{13} Simon This Simon was probably, as several learned men suppose, the same who is mentioned by Josephus, as persuading Drusilla to leave her husband, and live with Felix. believed; and wondered; miracles and signs Gr. signs and great miracles \textsuperscript{22} Repent, ; pray; if; the thought \textsuperscript{26} The angel, ; Arise; Gaza; desert It is probable, that we should refer ερημος, desert, not to Gaza, but to οδος, the way; though Gaza was situated at the entrance of the desert, and the ancient city was in ruins, being destroyed by Alexander. \textsuperscript{27} he arose; a man;, ; queen; and had \textsuperscript{32} He was as a; and like; opened NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. Brenton LXX: “Isaiah 53:7,8 And he, because of his affliction, opens not his mouth: he was led as a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before the shearer is dumb, so he opens not his mouth. In his humiliation his judgment was taken away: who shall declare his generation? for his life is taken away from the earth: because of the iniquities of my people he was led to death.” Masoretic/Hebrew comparison: “Isaiah 53:7,8 He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth. He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.” \textsuperscript{33} his humiliation judgment; and who; for \textsuperscript{37} If, ; he answered I believe \textsuperscript{39} were; *Gr. the Spirit; and he \textsuperscript{40} at; Ashdod he preached; Caesarea\par}

\subsection*{Acts 9}
\markright{ACTS 9}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And Saul, yet breathing out threatenings and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went unto the high priest, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And desired of him letters to Damascus to the synagogues, that if he found any of this way, whether they were men or women, he might bring them bound unto Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And as he journeyed, he came near Damascus: and suddenly there shined round about him a light from heaven: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And he fell to the earth, and heard a voice saying unto him, Saul, Saul, why persecute you me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And he said, Who are you, Lord? And the Lord said, I am Jesus whom you persecute: it is hard for you to kick against the pricks. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And he trembling and astonished said, Lord, what will you have me to do? And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the city, and it shall be told you what you must do. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the men which journeyed with him stood speechless, hearing a voice, but seeing no man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And Saul arose from the earth; and when his eyes were opened, he saw no man: but they led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And he was three days without sight, and neither did eat nor drink. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and to him said the Lord in a vision, Ananias. And he said, Behold, I am here, Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prays, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And has seen in a vision a man named Ananias coming in, and putting his hand on him, that he might receive his sight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Then Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard by many of this man, how much evil he has done to your saints at Jerusalem: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all that call on your name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} But the Lord said unto him, Go your way: for he is a chosen vessel unto me, to bear my name before the Gentiles, and kings, and the children of Israel: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} For I will show him how great things he must suffer for my name's sake. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And Ananias went his way, and entered into the house; and putting his hands on him said, Brother Saul, the Lord, even Jesus, that appeared unto you in the way as you came, has sent me, that you might receive your sight, and be filled with the Holy Spirit. (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And immediately there fell from his eyes as it had been scales: and he received sight forthwith, and arose, and was baptized. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And when he had received food, he was strengthened. Then was Saul certain days with the disciples which were at Damascus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And immediately he preached Christ in the synagogues, that he is the Son of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} But all that heard him were amazed, and said; Is not this he that destroyed them which called on this name in Jerusalem, and came here for that intent, that he might bring them bound unto the chief priests? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} But Saul increased the more in strength, and confounded the Jews which dwelt at Damascus, proving that this is very Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And after that many days were fulfilled, the Jews took counsel to kill him: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} But their laying await was known of Saul. And they watched the gates day and night to kill him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Then the disciples took him by night, and let him down by the wall in a basket. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And when Saul was come to Jerusalem, he assayed to join himself to the disciples: but they were all afraid of him, and believed not that he was a disciple. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared unto them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how he had preached boldly at Damascus in the name of Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And he was with them coming in and going out at Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And he spoke boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus, and disputed against the Grecians: but they went about to slay him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Which when the brethren knew, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him forth to Tarsus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Then had the churches rest throughout all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria, and were edified; and walking in the fear of the Lord, and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) were multiplied. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And it came to pass, as Peter passed throughout all quarters, he came down also to the saints which dwelt at Lydda. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And there he found a certain man named Aeneas, which had kept his bed eight years, and was sick of the palsy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And Peter said unto him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ makes you whole: arise, and make your bed. And he arose immediately. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And all that dwelt at Lydda and Saron saw him, and turned to the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which by interpretation is called Dorcas: this woman was full of good works and kind acts which she did. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And it came to pass in those days, that she was sick, and died: whom when they had washed, they laid her in an upper chamber. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And forasmuch as Lydda was nigh to Joppa, and the disciples had heard that Peter was there, they sent unto him two men, desiring him that he would not delay to come to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} Then Peter arose and went with them. When he was come, they brought him into the upper chamber: and all the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the coats and garments which Dorcas made, while she was with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} But Peter put them all forth, and kneeled down, and prayed; and turning him to the body said, Tabitha, arise. And she opened her eyes: and when she saw Peter, she sat up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And he gave her his hand, and lifted her up, and when he had called the saints and widows, presented her alive. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And it was known throughout all Joppa; and many believed in the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And it came to pass, that he tarried many days in Joppa with one Simon a tanner.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{36} Name meaning: Dorcas (Tabitha) — Gazelle Full of good works and raised to life.\par}
