\subsection*{Acts 10}
\markright{ACTS 10}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} There was a certain man in Caesarea called Cornelius, a centurion of the band called the Italian band, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God always. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} He saw in a vision evidently about the ninth hour of the day an angel of God coming in to him, and saying unto him, Cornelius. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And when he looked on him, he was afraid, and said, What is it, Lord? And he said unto him, Your prayers and yours alms are come up for a memorial before God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And now send men to Joppa, and call for one Simon, whose surname is Peter: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} He lodges with one Simon a tanner, whose house is by the sea side: he shall tell you what you ought to do. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And when the angel which spoke unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And when he had declared all these things unto them, he sent them to Joppa. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} On the next day, as they went on their journey, and drew nigh unto the city, Peter went up upon the housetop to pray about the sixth hour: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And he became very hungry, and would have eaten: but while they made ready, he fell into a trance, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And saw heaven opened, and a certain vessel descending upon him, as it had been a great sheet knit at the four corners, and let down to the earth: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Wherein were all manner of four-footed beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And there came a voice to him, Rise, Peter; kill, and eat. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten any thing that is common or unclean. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And the voice spoke unto him again the second time, What God has cleansed, that call not you common. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} This was done three times: and the vessel was received up again into heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Now while Peter doubted in himself what this vision which he had seen should mean, behold, the men which were sent from Cornelius had made enquiry for Simon's house, and stood before the gate, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And called, and asked whether Simon, which was surnamed Peter, were lodged there. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} While Peter thought on the vision, the Spirit (o. pneuma) said unto him, Behold, three men seek you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Arise therefore, and get you down, and go with them, doubting nothing: for I have sent them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Then Peter went down to the men which were sent unto him from Cornelius; and said, Behold, I am he whom all of you seek: what is the cause wherefore all of you are come? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And they said, Cornelius the centurion, a just man, and one that fears God, and of good report among all the nation of the Jews, was warned from God by an holy angel to send for you into his house, and to hear words (o. rhema) of you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Then called he them in, and lodged them. And on the next day Peter went away with them, and certain brethren from Joppa accompanied him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And the next day after they entered into Caesarea. And Cornelius waited for them, and he had called together his kinsmen and near friends. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And as Peter was coming in, Cornelius met him, and fell down at his feet, and worshipped him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} But Peter took him up, saying, Stand up; I myself also am a man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And as he talked with him, he went in, and found many that were come together. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And he said unto them, All of you know how that it is an unlawful thing for a man that is a Jew to keep company, or come unto one of another nation; but God has showed me that I should not call any man common or unclean. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Therefore came I unto you without gainsaying, as soon as I was sent for: I ask therefore for what intent (o. logos) all of you have sent for me? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And Cornelius said, Four days ago I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour I prayed in my house, and, behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And said, Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and yours alms are had in remembrance in the sight of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Send therefore to Joppa, and call here Simon, whose surname is Peter; he is lodged in the house of one Simon a tanner by the sea side: who, when he comes, shall speak unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Immediately therefore I sent to you; and you have well done that you are come. Now therefore are we all here present before God, to hear all things that are commanded you of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Then Peter opened his mouth, and said, Truthfully I perceive that God is no respecter of persons: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} But in every nation he that fears him, and works righteousness, is accepted with him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} The word (o. logos) which God sent unto the children of Israel, preaching peace by Jesus Christ: (he is Lord of all:) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} That word, (o. rhema) I say, all of you know, which was published throughout all Judaea, and began from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) and with power: who went about doing good, and healing all that were oppressed of the devil; for God was with him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And we are witnesses of all things which he did both in the land of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they slew and hanged on a tree: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} Him God raised up the third day, and showed him openly; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} Not to all the people, but unto witnesses chosen before God, even to us, who did eat and drink with him after he rose from the dead. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} To him give all the prophets witness, that through his name whosoever believes in him shall receive remission of sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} While Peter yet spoke these words, (o. rhema) the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) fell on all them which heard the word. (o. logos) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} And they of the circumcision which believed were astonished, as many as came with Peter, because that on the Gentiles also was poured out the gift of the Holy Spirit. (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} For they heard them speak with tongues, and magnify God. Then answered Peter, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} Can any man forbid water, that these should not be baptized, which have received the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) as well as we? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} And he commanded them to be baptized in the name of the Lord. Then prayed they him to tarry certain days.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{1} Name meaning: Cornelius (Cornelius) — Horn Roman centurion turned to God.\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} Cir, am 4045, ad 41 in, a centurion, ; Italian The Italian band, or rather cohort, σπειρα, (a regiment sometimes consisting of from 555 to 1, 105 infantry), is not unknown to the Roman writers (see Tacitus); and Gruter gives an inscription in which it is mentioned, which was found in the Forum Sempronii, on a fine marble table. \textsuperscript{2} devout, ; one, ; with, ; which, ; and prayed;, *marg. \textsuperscript{4} he was;, What; thy; thine \textsuperscript{11} saw; , and a;, ; , ; vessel The word σκευος, which corresponds to the Hebrew kelee, denotes every kind of vessel or utensil, anything which may be considered as a receptacle; and is therefore applicable to a sheet οθονη, or anything woven from flax, tied up at the four corners, which our word vessel is not. \textsuperscript{13} Rise; kill Or, sacrifice and eat, θυσον, και, φαγε . The spirit of the heavenly direction seems to be this, say Dr. A. Clarke, "The middle wall of the partition is now pulled down; the Jews and Gentiles are called to become one flock, under one shepherd and bishop of souls. Thou, Peter, shalt open the door of faith to the Gentiles, and be also the minister of the circumcision. Rise up; already a blessed sacrifice is prepared. Go and offer it to God; and let thy soul feed on the fruits of his mercy, " etc. \textsuperscript{22} Cornelius a just; of good; and to \textsuperscript{23} and lodged; on; and certain \textsuperscript{24} the morrow Caesarea This city, once an obscure fortress called Strato's Tower, was built and superbly decorated by Herod the Great and called Cesarea, in honour of Augustus Cesar, to whom he dedicated it in the 28th year of his reign. It was situated on the shore of the Mediterranean, between Joppa and Dora, with a haven, rendered by Herod the most convenient on the coast. According to Ibn Idris and Abulfeda, 30 miles from Jaffa or Joppa, 32 from Ramlay, and 36 from Acco or Ptolemais; and, according to Josephus, 600 stadia, or 75 miles from Jerusalem, though the real distance is probably not more than 62 miles. Nothing now remains of the former splendour of Cesarea. The supposed sites of the ancient edifices are mere mounds of indefinable form; the waves wash the ruins of the mole, the tower, and the port; the whole of the surrounding country is a sandy desert; and not a creature except beasts of prey, resides within many miles of this silent desolation. and had \textsuperscript{38} God; *marg.; who;, ; healing; for\par}

\subsection*{Acts 11}
\markright{ACTS 11}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And the apostles and brethren that were in Judaea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word (o. logos) of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And when Peter was come up to Jerusalem, they that were of the circumcision contended with him, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Saying, You went in to men uncircumcised, and did eat with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} But Peter rehearsed the matter from the beginning, and expounded it by order unto them, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} I was in the city of Joppa praying: and in a trance I saw a vision, A certain vessel descend, as it had been a great sheet, let down from heaven by four corners; and it came even to me: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Upon the which when I had fastened mine eyes, I considered, and saw four-footed beasts of the earth, and wild beasts, and creeping things, and fowls of the air. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I heard a voice saying unto me, Arise, Peter; slay and eat. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} But I said, Not so, Lord: for nothing common or unclean has at any time entered into my mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} But the voice answered me again from heaven, What God has cleansed, that call not you common. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And this was done three times: and all were drawn up again into heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And, behold, immediately there were three men already come unto the house where I was, sent from Caesarea unto me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And the Spirit (o. pneuma) bade me go with them, nothing doubting. Moreover these six brethren accompanied me, and we entered into the man's house: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And he showed us how he had seen an angel in his house, which stood and said unto him, Send men to Joppa, and call for Simon, whose surname is Peter; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Who shall tell you words, (o. rhema) whereby you and all your house shall be saved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And as I began to speak, the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) fell on them, as on us at the beginning. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Then remembered I the word (o. rhema) of the Lord, how that he said, John indeed baptized with water; but all of you shall be baptized with the Holy Spirit. (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Forasmuch then as God gave them the like gift as he did unto us, who believed on the Lord Jesus Christ; what was I, that I could withstand God? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then has God also to the Gentiles granted repentance unto life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Now they which were scattered abroad upon the persecution that arose about Stephen travelled as far as Phenice, and Cyprus, and Antioch, preaching the word (o. logos) to none but unto the Jews only. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And some of them were men of Cyprus and Cyrene, which, when they were come to Antioch, spoke unto the Grecians, preaching the LORD Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And the hand of the Lord was with them: and a great number believed, and turned unto the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Then tidings (o. logos) of these things came unto the ears of the church which was in Jerusalem: and they sent forth Barnabas, that he should go as far as Antioch. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Who, when he came, and had seen the grace of God, was glad, and exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they would cleave unto the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) and of faith: and much people was added unto the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Then departed Barnabas to Tarsus, in order to seek Saul: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And when he had found him, he brought him unto Antioch. And it came to pass, that a whole year they assembled themselves with the church, and taught much people. And the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And in these days came prophets from Jerusalem unto Antioch. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And there stood up one of them named Agabus, and signified by the Spirit (o. pneuma) that there should be great dearth throughout all the world: which came to pass in the days of Claudius Caesar. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Then the disciples, every man according to his ability, determined to send relief unto the brethren which dwelt in Judaea: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Which also they did, and sent it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{5} was in a; and it \textsuperscript{15} as I the Holy Ghost, as on \textsuperscript{18} they held; and glorified; hath, ;, ; granted \textsuperscript{19} they Phenice, Cyprus, Antioch, to none \textsuperscript{21} the hand; and a, ; turned \textsuperscript{22} am 4047, ad 43 tidings, ; and they \textsuperscript{23} seen; and exhorted; purpose; cleave \textsuperscript{24} he was; full, ; and much \textsuperscript{26} that with the church;, taught were \textsuperscript{28} Agabus great This was probably the famine which took place in the fourth year of Claudius, which continued for several years, and in which, says Josephus, "many died for want of food."; Claudius Caesar succeeded C. Caligula, ad 41; and after a reign of upwards of 13 years, he was poisoned by his wife Agrippina, and succeeded by Nero.\par}

\subsection*{Acts 12}
\markright{ACTS 12}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Now about that time Herod the king stretched forth his hands to vex certain of the church. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And he killed James the brother of John with the sword. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And because he saw it pleased the Jews, he proceeded further to take Peter also. (Then were the days of unleavened bread.) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And when he had apprehended him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four quaternions of soldiers to keep him; intending after Easter to bring him forth to the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Peter therefore was kept in prison: but prayer was made without ceasing of the church unto God for him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And when Herod would have brought him forth, the same night Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains: and the keepers before the door kept the prison. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And, behold, the angel of the Lord came upon him, and a light shined in the prison: and he stroke Peter on the side, and raised him up, saying, Arise up quickly. And his chains fell off from his hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And the angel said unto him, Gird yourself, and bind on your sandals. And so he did. And he says unto him, Cast your garment about you, and follow me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And he went out, and followed him; and know not that it was true which was done by the angel; but thought he saw a vision. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} When they were past the first and the second ward, they came unto the iron gate that leads unto the city; which opened to them of his own accord: and they went out, and passed on through one street; and forthwith the angel departed from him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And when Peter was come to himself, he said, Now I know certainly, that the LORD has sent his angel, and has delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from all the expectation of the people of the Jews. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And when he had considered the thing, he came to the house of Mary the mother of John, whose surname was Mark; where many were gathered together praying. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And as Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a damsel came to hearken, named Rhoda. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And when she knew Peter's voice, she opened not the gate for gladness, but ran in, and told how Peter stood before the gate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And they said unto her, You are mad. But she constantly affirmed that it was even so. Then said they, It is his angel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} But Peter continued knocking: and when they had opened the door, and saw him, they were astonished. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} But he, beckoning unto them with the hand to hold their peace, declared unto them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. And he said, Go show these things unto James, and to the brethren. And he departed, and went into another place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers, what was become of Peter. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And when Herod had sought for him, and found him not, he examined the keepers, and commanded that they should be put to death. And he went down from Judaea to Caesarea, and there abode. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And Herod was highly displeased with them of Tyre and Sidon: but they came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus the king's chamberlain their friend, desired peace; because their country was nourished by the king's country. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And upon a set day Herod, arrayed in royal apparel, sat upon his throne, and made an oration unto them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And the people gave a shout, saying, It is the voice of a god, and not of a man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And immediately the angel of the Lord stroke him, because he gave not God the glory: and he was eaten of worms, and gave up the spirit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} But the word (o. logos) of God grew and multiplied. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And Barnabas and Saul returned from Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their ministry, and took with them John, whose surname was Mark.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{12} Name meaning: Mark (Marcus) — Hammer; polite Initially faltered but later became useful to Paul.\par}

\subsection*{Acts 13}
\markright{ACTS 13}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, which had been brought up with Herod the tetrarch, and Saul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} As they ministered to the Lord, and fasted, the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) said, Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work unto which I have called them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And when they had fasted and prayed, and laid their hands on them, they sent them away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} So they, being sent forth by the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) departed unto Seleucia; and from thence they sailed to Cyprus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And when they were at Salamis, they preached the word (o. logos) of God in the synagogues of the Jews: and they had also John to their minister. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And when they had gone through the isle unto Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Barjesus: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Which was with the deputy of the country, Sergius Paulus, a prudent man; who called for Barnabas and Saul, and desired to hear the word (o. logos) of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn away the deputy from the faith. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Then Saul, (who also is called Paul,) filled with the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) set his eyes on him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And said, O full of all subtlety and all mischief, you child of the devil, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And now, behold, the hand of the Lord is upon you, and you shall be blind, not seeing the sun for a season. And immediately there fell on him a mist and a darkness; and he went about seeking some to lead him by the hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Then the deputy, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the doctrine of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Now when Paul and his company loosed from Paphos, they came to Perga in Pamphylia: and John departing from them returned to Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} But when they departed from Perga, they came to Antioch in Pisidia, and went into the synagogue on the sabbath day, and sat down. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And after the reading of the law and the prophets the rulers of the synagogue sent unto them, saying, All of you men and brethren, if all of you have any word (o. logos) of exhortation for the people, say on. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Then Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and all of you that fear God, give audience. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} The God of this people of Israel chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they dwelt as strangers in the land of Egypt, and with an high arm brought he them out of it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And about the time of forty years suffered he their manners in the wilderness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And when he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Chanaan, he divided their land to them by lot. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And after that he gave unto them judges about the space of four hundred and fifty years, until Samuel the prophet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And afterward they desired a king: and God gave unto them Saul the son of Cis, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, by the space of forty years. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And when he had removed him, he raised up unto them David to be their king; to whom also he gave their testimony, and said, I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after mine own heart, which shall fulfill all my will. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Of this man's seed has God according to his promise raised unto Israel a Saviour, Jesus: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} When John had first preached before his coming the baptism of repentance to all the people of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And as John fulfilled his course, he said, Whom think all of you that I am? I am not he. But, behold, there comes one after me, whose shoes of his feet I am not worthy to loose. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Men and brethren, children of the stock of Abraham, and whosoever among you fears God, to you is the word (o. logos) of this salvation sent. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} For they that dwell at Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they knew him not, nor yet the voices of the prophets which are read every sabbath day, they have fulfilled them in condemning him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And though they found no cause of death in him, yet desired they Pilate that he should be slain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And when they had fulfilled all that was written of him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a tomb. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} But God raised him from the dead: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And he was seen many days of them which came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses unto the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And we declare unto you glad tidings, how that the promise which was made unto the fathers, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} God has fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that he has raised up Jesus again; as it is also written in the second psalm, You are my Son, this day have I begotten you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And as concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he said likewise, I will give you the sure mercies of David. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Wherefore he says also in another psalm, You shall not suffer yours Holy One to see corruption. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} For David, after he had served his own generation by the will of God, fell asleep, and was laid unto his fathers, and saw corruption: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} But he, whom God raised again, saw no corruption. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Be it known unto you therefore, men and brethren, that through this man is preached unto you the forgiveness of sins: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And by him all that believe are justified from all things, from which all of you could not be justified by the law of Moses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} Beware therefore, lest that come upon you, which is spoken of in the prophets; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} Behold, all of you despisers, and wonder, and perish: for I work a work in your days, a work which all of you shall in no wise believe, though a man declare it unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} And when the Jews were gone out of the synagogue, the Gentiles besought that these words (o. rhema) might be preached to them the next sabbath. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} Now when the congregation was broken up, many of the Jews and religious proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas: who, speaking to them, persuaded them to continue in the grace of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And the next sabbath day came almost the whole city together to hear the word (o. logos) of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with envy, and spoke against those things which were spoken by Paul, contradicting and blaspheming. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} Then Paul and Barnabas waxed bold, and said, It was necessary that the word (o. logos) of God should first have been spoken to you: but seeing all of you put it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of everlasting life, lo, we turn to the Gentiles. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, I have set you to be a light of the Gentiles, that you should be for salvation unto the ends of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} And when the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word (o. logos) of the Lord: and as many as were ordained to eternal life believed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} And the word (o. logos) of the Lord was published throughout all the region. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} But the Jews stirred up the devout and honourable women, and the chief men of the city, and raised persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and expelled them out of their coasts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came unto Iconium. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} And the disciples were filled with joy, and with the Holy Spirit. (o. pneuma)\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{7} Name meaning: Sergius Paulus (Paulus) — Small; humble Proconsul who believed after seeing God’s power. \textsuperscript{8} Name meaning: Elymas (Bar-Jesus) — Wise man Sorcerer who opposed the gospel. \textsuperscript{9} Name meaning: Paul (Paulus) — Small; humble Changed from Saul to Paul, the humble apostle to the Gentiles.\par}

\subsection*{Acts 14}
\markright{ACTS 14}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it came to pass in Iconium, that they went both together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke, that a great multitude both of the Jews and also of the Greeks believed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} But the unbelieving Jews stirred up the Gentiles, and made their minds evil affected against the brethren. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Long time therefore abode they speaking boldly in the Lord, which gave testimony unto the word (o. logos) of his grace, and granted signs and wonders to be done by their hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} But the multitude of the city was divided: and part held with the Jews, and part with the apostles. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And when there was an assault made both of the Gentiles, and also of the Jews with their rulers, to use them despitefully, and to stone them, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} They were ware of it, and fled unto Lystra and Derbe, cities of Lycaonia, and unto the region that lies round about: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And there they preached the gospel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And there sat a certain man at Lystra, impotent in his feet, being a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The same heard Paul speak: who steadfastly beholding him, and perceiving that he had faith to be healed, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Said with a loud voice, Stand upright on your feet. And he leaped and walked. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And when the people saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voices, saying in the speech of Lycaonia, The gods are come down to us in the likeness of men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And they called Barnabas, Jupiter; and Paul, Mercurius, because he was the chief speaker. (o. logos) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Then the priest of Jupiter, which was before their city, brought oxen and garlands unto the gates, and would have done sacrifice with the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Which when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of, they rent their clothes, and ran in among the people, crying out, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And saying, Sirs, why do all of you these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and preach unto you that all of you should turn from these vanities unto the living God, which made heaven, and earth, and the sea, and all things that are therein: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Who in times past suffered all nations to walk in their own ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Nevertheless he left not himself without witness, in that he did good, and gave us rain from heaven, and fruitful seasons, filling our hearts with food and gladness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And with these sayings scarce restrained they the people, that they had not done sacrifice unto them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And there came thither certain Jews from Antioch and Iconium, who persuaded the people, and having stoned Paul, drew him out of the city, supposing he had been dead. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Nevertheless, as the disciples stood round about him, he rose up, and came into the city: and the next day he departed with Barnabas to Derbe. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And when they had preached the gospel to that city, and had taught many, they returned again to Lystra, and to Iconium, and Antioch, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Confirming the souls of the disciples, and exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that we must through much tribulation enter into the kingdom of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And when they had ordained them elders in every church, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they believed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And after they had passed throughout Pisidia, they came to Pamphylia. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And when they had preached the word (o. logos) in Perga, they went down into Attalia: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And thence sailed to Antioch, from whence they had been recommended to the grace of God for the work which they fulfilled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And when they were come, and had gathered the church together, they rehearsed all that God had done with them, and how he had opened the door of faith unto the Gentiles. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And there they abode long time with the disciples.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} in went, that a, Greeks, ; *marg. \textsuperscript{3} therefore; speaking; which; the word; granted \textsuperscript{6} were, ; and fled Lystra; Lycaonia \textsuperscript{15} Sirs, why; We also; of like; and preach, from; , ; the living; which \textsuperscript{17} he left; in that, ; and gave; filling \textsuperscript{19} Cir, am 4051, ad 47 there, persuaded; having, ; drew; supposing \textsuperscript{21} taught many Gr. made many disciples, *Gr. Lystra \textsuperscript{23} they had; elders, ; and had they commended \textsuperscript{24} Cir, am 4052, ad 48 Pisidia was a province of Asia Minor, situated between Phrygia on the north and west, Lycaonia on the east, and Pamphylia on the south. \textsuperscript{25} Perga was a considerable city of Pamphylia, towards the sea coast, and near the Caystrus, famous for the temple of Diana. Attalia, now Antalia, or Satalie, was a maritime city of Pamphylia, the chief residence of the prefect. \textsuperscript{26} to Antioch, ; recommended, ; the work \textsuperscript{27} and had;, they rehearsed, ; opened\par}

\subsection*{Acts 15}
\markright{ACTS 15}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And certain men which came down from Judaea taught the brethren, and said, Except all of you be circumcised after the manner of Moses, all of you cannot be saved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} When therefore Paul and Barnabas had no small dissension and disputation with them, they determined that Paul and Barnabas, and certain other of them, should go up to Jerusalem unto the apostles and elders about this question. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And being brought on their way by the church, they passed through Phenice and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles: and they caused great joy unto all the brethren. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And when they were come to Jerusalem, they were received of the church, and of the apostles and elders, and they declared all things that God had done with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} But there rose up certain of the sect of the Pharisees which believed, saying, That it was necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And the apostles and elders came together in order to consider of this matter. (o. logos) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And when there had been much disputing, Peter rose up, and said unto them, Men and brethren, all of you know how that a good while ago God made choice among us, that the Gentiles by my mouth should hear the word (o. logos) of the gospel, and believe. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And God, which knows the hearts, bare them witness, giving them the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) even as he did unto us; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And put no difference between us and them, purifying their hearts by faith. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Now therefore why tempt all of you God, to put a yoke upon the neck of the disciples, which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} But we believe that through the grace of the LORD Jesus Christ we shall be saved, even as they. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Then all the multitude kept silence, and gave audience to Barnabas and Paul, declaring what miracles and wonders God had wrought among the Gentiles by them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And after they had held their peace, James answered, saying, Men and brethren, hearken unto me: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Simeon has declared how God at the first did visit the Gentiles, to take out of them a people for his name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And to this agree the words (o. logos) of the prophets; as it is written, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} After this I will return, and will build again the tabernacle of David, which is fallen down; and I will build again the ruins thereof, and I will set it up: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} That the residue of men might seek after the Lord, and all the Gentiles, upon whom my name is called, says the Lord, who does all these things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Wherefore my sentence is, that we trouble not them, which from among the Gentiles are turned to God: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But that we write unto them, that they abstain from pollutions of idols, and from fornication, and from things strangled, and from blood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For Moses of old time has in every city them that preach him, being read in the synagogues every sabbath day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Then pleased it the apostles and elders with the whole church, to send chosen men of their own company to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; namely, Judas surnamed Barsabas and Silas, chief men among the brethren: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And they wrote letters by them after this manner; The apostles and elders and brethren send greeting unto the brethren which are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Forasmuch as we have heard, that certain which went out from us have troubled you with words, (o. logos) subverting your souls, saying, All of you must be circumcised, and keep the law: to whom we gave no such commandment: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} It seemed good unto us, being assembled with one accord, to send chosen men unto you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Men that have hazarded their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who shall also tell you the same things by mouth. (o. logos) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) and to us, to lay upon you no greater burden than these necessary things; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} That all of you abstain from meats offered to idols, and from blood, and from things strangled, and from fornication: from which if all of you keep yourselves, all of you shall do well. Fare all of you well. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} So when they were dismissed, they came to Antioch: and when they had gathered the multitude together, they delivered the epistle: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Which when they had read, they rejoiced for the consolation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And Judas and Silas, being prophets also themselves, exhorted the brethren with many words, (o. logos) and confirmed them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And after they had tarried there a space, they were let go in peace from the brethren unto the apostles. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Notwithstanding it pleased Silas to abide there still. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Paul also and Barnabas continued in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word (o. logos) of the Lord, with many others also. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And some days after Paul said unto Barnabas, Let us go again and visit our brethren in every city where we have preached the word (o. logos) of the LORD, and see how they do. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} And Barnabas determined to take with them John, whose surname was Mark. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} But Paul thought not good to take him with them, who departed from them from Pamphylia, and went not with them to the work. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And the contention was so sharp between them, that they departed asunder one from the other: and so Barnabas took Mark, and sailed unto Cyprus; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And Paul chose Silas, and departed, being recommended by the brethren unto the grace of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And he went through Syria and Cilicia, confirming the churches.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{22} Name meaning: Silas (Silvanus) — Forest; wood Steady companion who endured prison with Paul.\par}

\subsection*{Acts 16}
\markright{ACTS 16}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then came he to Derbe and Lystra: and, behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timotheus, the son of a certain woman, which was a Jewess, and believed; but his father was a Greek: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Which was well reported of by the brethren that were at Lystra and Iconium. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Him would Paul have to go forth with him; and took and circumcised him because of the Jews which were in those quarters: for they knew all that his father was a Greek. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And as they went through the cities, they delivered them the decrees in order to keep, that were ordained of the apostles and elders which were at Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And so were the churches established in the faith, and increased in number daily. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Now when they had gone throughout Phrygia and the region of Galatia, and were forbidden of the Holy Spirit (o. pneuma) to preach the word (o. logos) in Asia, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} After they were come to Mysia, they assayed to go into Bithynia: but the Spirit (o. pneuma) suffered them not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And they passing by Mysia came down to Troas. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And a vision appeared to Paul in the night; There stood a man of Macedonia, and prayed him, saying, Come over into Macedonia, and help us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And after he had seen the vision, immediately we endeavoured to go into Macedonia, assuredly gathering that the Lord had called us in order to preach the gospel unto them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Therefore loosing from Troas, we came with a straight course to Samothracia, and the next day to Neapolis; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And from thence to Philippi, which is the chief city of that part of Macedonia, and a colony: and we were in that city abiding certain days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And on the sabbath we went out of the city by a river side, where prayer was known to be made; and we sat down, and spoke unto the women which resorted thither. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, which worshipped God, heard us: whose heart the Lord opened, that she attended unto the things which were spoken of Paul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And when she was baptized, and her household, she besought us, saying, If all of you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and abide there. And she constrained us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And it came to pass, as we went to prayer, a certain damsel possessed with a spirit (o. pneuma) of divination met us, which brought her masters much gain by soothsaying: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} The same followed Paul and us, and cried, saying, These men are the servants of the most high God, which show unto us the way of salvation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And this did she many days. But Paul, being grieved, turned and said to the spirit, (o. pneuma) I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her. And he came out the same hour. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And when her masters saw that the hope of their gains was gone, they caught Paul and Silas, and drew them into the marketplace unto the rulers, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And brought them to the magistrates, saying, These men, being Jews, do exceedingly trouble our city, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And teach customs, which are not lawful for us to receive, neither to observe, being Romans. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And the multitude rose up together against them: and the magistrates rent off their clothes, and commanded to beat them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And when they had laid many stripes upon them, they cast them into prison, charging the jailor to keep them safely: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Who, having received such a charge, thrust them into the inner prison, and made their feet fast in the stocks. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken: and immediately all the doors were opened, and every one's bands were loosed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And the keeper of the prison awaking out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, he drew out his sword, and would have killed himself, supposing that the prisoners had been fled. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Do yourself no harm: for we are all here. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Then he called for a light, and sprang in, and came trembling, and fell down before Paul and Silas, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And brought them out, and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And they said, Believe on the Lord Jesus Christ, and you shall be saved, and your house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And they spoke unto him the word (o. logos) of the Lord, and to all that were in his house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} And he took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes; and was baptized, he and all his, immediately. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And when he had brought them into his house, he set food before them, and rejoiced, believing in God with all his house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, Let those men go. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And the keeper of the prison told this saying (o. logos) to Paul, The magistrates have sent to let you go: now therefore depart, and go in peace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} But Paul said unto them, They have beaten us openly uncondemned, being Romans, and have cast us into prison; and now do they thrust us out privately? nay verily; but let them come themselves and fetch us out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And the sergeants told these words (o. rhema) unto the magistrates: and they feared, when they heard that they were Romans. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And they came and besought them, and brought them out, and desired them to depart out of the city. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} And they went out of the prison, and entered into the house of Lydia: and when they had seen the brethren, they comforted them, and departed.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{1} Name meaning: Timothy (Timotheos) — Honoring God Paul’s faithful son in the faith. \textsuperscript{14} Name meaning: Lydia (Lydia) — From Lydia Dealer in purple; first European convert.\par}

\subsection*{Acts 17}
\markright{ACTS 17}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Opening and alleging, that Christ must essentially have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come here also; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Whom Jason has received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word (o. logos) with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word (o. logos) of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus in order to come to him with all speed, they departed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit (o. pneuma) was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seems to be a proclaimer of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof you speak, is? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} For you bring certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars' hill, and said, All of you men of Athens, I perceive that in all things all of you are too superstitious. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore all of you ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwells not in temples made with hands; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Neither is worshipped with men's hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he gives to all life, and breath, and all things; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And has made of one blood all nations of men in order to dwell on all the face of the earth, and has determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} That they should seek the Lord, if lest by any means they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by are and man's device. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commands all men every where to repent: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Because he has appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he has ordained; whereof he has given assurance unto all men, in that he has raised him from the dead. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear you again of this matter. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} So Paul departed from among them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Nevertheless certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{5} Name meaning: Jason (Iason) — Healer Hosted Paul and faced riot. \textsuperscript{34} Name meaning: Dionysius (Dionysios) — Of Dionysus Areopagite who believed Paul’s message. Name meaning: Damaris (Damaris) — Calf; gentle Athenian woman who joined the believers.\par}

\subsection*{Acts 18}
\markright{ACTS 18}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And found a certain Jew named Aquila, born in Pontus, lately come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla; (because that Claudius had commanded all Jews to depart from Rome:) and came unto them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And because he was of the same craft, he abode with them, and wrought: for by their occupation they were tentmakers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And he reasoned in the synagogue every sabbath, and persuaded the Jews and the Greeks. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And when Silas and Timotheus were come from Macedonia, Paul was pressed in the spirit, (o. pneuma) and testified to the Jews that Jesus was Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And when they opposed themselves, and blasphemed, he shook his raiment, and said unto them, Your blood be upon your own heads; I am clean; from henceforth I will go unto the Gentiles. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And he departed thence, and entered into a certain man's house, named Justus, one that worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And Crispus, the chief ruler of the synagogue, believed on the Lord with all his house; and many of the Corinthians hearing believed, and were baptized. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Then spoke the Lord to Paul in the night by a vision, Be not afraid, but speak, and hold not your peace: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For I am with you, and no man shall set on you to hurt you: for I have much people in this city. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And he continued there a year and six months, teaching the word (o. logos) of God among them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And when Gallio was the deputy of Achaia, the Jews made insurrection with one accord against Paul, and brought him to the judgment seat, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Saying, This fellow persuades men to worship God contrary to the law. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And when Paul was now about to open his mouth, Gallio said unto the Jews, If it were a matter of wrong or wicked lewdness, O all of you Jews, reason (o. logos) would that I should bear with you: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} But if it be a question of words (o. logos) and names, and of your law, look all of you to it; for I will be no judge of such matters. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And he drove them from the judgment seat. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Then all the Greeks took Sosthenes, the chief ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. And Gallio cared for none of those things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And Paul after this tarried there yet a good while, and then took his leave of the brethren, and sailed thence into Syria, and with him Priscilla and Aquila; having shorn his head in Cenchrea: for he had a vow. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And he came to Ephesus, and left them there: but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} When they desired him to tarry longer time with them, he consented not; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} But bade them farewell, saying, I must by all means keep this feast that comes in Jerusalem: but I will return again unto you, if God will. And he sailed from Ephesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And when he had landed at Caesarea, and gone up, and saluted the church, he went down to Antioch. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And after he had spent some time there, he departed, and went over all the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, strengthening all the disciples. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And a certain Jew named Apollos, born at Alexandria, an eloquent man, and mighty in the scriptures, came to Ephesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} This man was instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in the spirit, (o. pneuma) he spoke and taught diligently the things of the Lord, knowing only the baptism of John. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And he began to speak boldly in the synagogue: whom when Aquila and Priscilla had heard, they took him unto them, and expounded unto him the way of God more perfectly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And when he was disposed to pass into Achaia, the brethren wrote, exhorting the disciples to receive him: who, when he was come, helped them much which had believed through grace: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} For he mightily convinced the Jews, and that publicly, showing by the scriptures that Jesus was Christ.\par
