\subsection*{Galatians 6}
\markright{GALATIANS 6}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, all of you which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit (o. pneuma) of meekness; considering yourself, lest you also be tempted. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Bear all of you one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For if a man think himself to be something, when he is nothing, he deceives himself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} But let every man prove his own work, and then shall he have rejoicing in himself alone, and not in another. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For every man shall bear his own burden. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Let him that is taught in the word (o. logos) communicate unto him that teaches in all good things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man sows, that shall he also reap. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For he that sows to his flesh shall of the flesh reap corruption; but he that sows to the Spirit (o. pneuma) shall of the Spirit (o. pneuma) reap life everlasting. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} As we have therefore opportunity, let us do good unto all men, especially unto them who are of the household of faith. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} All of you see how large a letter I have written unto you with mine own hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} As many as desire to make a fair show in the flesh, they constrain you to be circumcised; only lest they should suffer persecution for the cross of Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} For neither they themselves who are circumcised keep the law; but desire to have you circumcised, that they may glory in your flesh. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} But God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom the world is crucified unto me, and I unto the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision avails any thing, nor uncircumcision, but a new creature. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And as many as walk according to this rule, peace be on them, and mercy, and upon the Israel of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} From henceforth let no man trouble me: for I bear in my body the marks of the Lord Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Brethren, the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. (o. pneuma) Amen.\par

\section*{Ephesians Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} Paul the apostle\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} The opening identifies Paul, and conservative scholarship receives the letter as Pauline, whether or not intended as a circular letter.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} Traditional church reception strongly supports Pauline authorship.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} AD 60-62 during Roman imprisonment\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Prison epistle celebrating Christ's cosmic headship and the church's unity.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To unfold the believer's blessings in Christ and call the church to unity, holiness, and spiritual warfare.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} union with Christ; church; grace; unity; holiness; armor of God\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Blessings and prayer 1-3; worthy walk 4-6.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Papyrus 46 ca. AD 200 | Subst. Papyrus 46 is the earliest substantial Ephesians witness ca. AD 200 | Heb. No complete Hebrew original survives n/a | Gk. Codex Vaticanus and Codex Sinaiticus preserve complete Greek Ephesians 4th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Likely echoed in Ignatius by Ignatius (early 2nd century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} Ephesians has some textual discussion around the address line and a few wording issues, but is strongly attested.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives Ephesians as Pauline and fully apostolic in doctrine and exhortation.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{Ephesians}
\markboth{EPHESIANS}{}
\subsection*{Ephesians 1}
\markright{EPHESIANS 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, to the saints which are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} According as he has chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love: (o. agape) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Having predestinated us unto the adoption of children by Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his will, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he has made us accepted in the beloved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of his grace; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Wherein he has abounded toward us in all wisdom and prudence; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Having made known unto us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he has purposed in himself: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} That in the dispensation of the fullness of times he might gather together in one all things in Christ, both which are in heaven, and which are on earth; even in him: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} In whom also we have obtained an inheritance, being predestinated according to the purpose of him who works all things after the counsel of his own will: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} That we should be to the praise of his glory, who first trusted in Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} In whom all of you also trusted, after that all of you heard the word (o. logos) of truth, the gospel of your salvation: in whom also after that all of you believed, all of you were sealed with that holy Spirit (o. pneuma) of promise, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Which is the earn of our inheritance until the redemption of the purchased possession, unto the praise of his glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Wherefore I also, after I heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus, and love (o. agape) unto all the saints, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Cease not to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give unto you the spirit (o. pneuma) of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} The eyes of your understanding being enlightened; that all of you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to the working of his mighty power, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Which he wrought in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and set him at his own right hand in the heavenly places, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Far above all principality, and power, and might, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this world, but also in that which is to come: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And has put all things under his feet, and gave him to be the head over all things to the church, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Which is his body, the fullness of him that fills all in all.\par

\subsection*{Ephesians 2}
\markright{EPHESIANS 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And you has he quickened, who were dead in trespasses and sins; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Wherein in time past all of you walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit (o. pneuma) that now works in the children of disobedience: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Among whom also we all had our conversation in times past in the lusts of our flesh, fulfilling the desires of the flesh and of the mind; and were by nature the children of wrath, even as others. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} But God, who is rich in mercy, for his great love (o. agape) wherewith he loved us, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Even when we were dead in sins, has quickened us together with Christ, (by grace all of you are saved;) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And has raised us up together, and made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} That in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in his kindness toward us through Christ Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For by grace are all of you saved through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is the gift of God: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Not of works, lest any man should boast. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God has before ordained that we should walk in them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Wherefore remember, that all of you being in time past Gentiles in the flesh, who are called Uncircumcision by that which is called the Circumcision in the flesh made by hands; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} That at that time all of you were without Christ, being aliens from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of promise, having no hope, and without God in the world: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} But now in Christ Jesus all of you who sometimes were far off are made nigh by the blood of Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For he is our peace, who has made both one, and has broken down the middle wall of partition between us; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Having abolished in his flesh the enmity, even the law of commandments contained in ordinances; in order to make in himself of two one new man, so making peace; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And that he might reconcile both unto God in one body by the cross, having slain the enmity thereby: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And came and preached peace to you which were far off, and to them that were nigh. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} For through him we both have access by one Spirit (o. pneuma) unto the Father. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Now therefore all of you are no more strangers and foreigners, but fellow citizens with the saints, and of the household of God; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And are built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Jesus Christ himself being the chief corner stone; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} In whom all the building fitly framed together grows unto an holy temple in the Lord: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} In whom all of you also are built together for an habitation of God through the Spirit. (o. pneuma)\par

\subsection*{Ephesians 3}
\markright{EPHESIANS 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} If all of you have heard of the dispensation of the grace of God which is given me toward you: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} How that by revelation he made known unto me the mystery; (as I wrote before in few words, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Whereby, when all of you read, all of you may understand my knowledge in the mystery of Christ) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Which in other ages was not made known unto the sons of men, as it is now revealed unto his holy apostles and prophets by the Spirit; (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} That the Gentiles should be join heirs, and of the same body, and partakers of his promise in Christ by the gospel: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Whereof I was made a minister, according to the gift of the grace of God given unto me by the effectual working of his power. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Unto me, who am less than the least of all saints, is this grace given, that I should preach among the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And to make all men see what is the fellowship of the mystery, which from the beginning of the world has been hid in God, who created all things by Jesus Christ: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} To the intent that now unto the principalities and powers in heavenly places might be known by the church the manifold wisdom of God, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} According to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} In whom we have boldness and access with confidence by the faith of him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Wherefore I desire that all of you faint not at my tribulations for you, which is your glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For this cause I bow my knees unto the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Of whom the whole family in heaven and earth is named, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} That he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, to be strengthened with might by his Spirit (o. pneuma) in the inner man; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} That Christ may dwell in your hearts by faith; that all of you, being rooted and grounded in love, (o. agape) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} May be able to comprehend with all saints what is the breadth, and length, and depth, and height; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And to know the love (o. agape) of Christ, which passes knowledge, that all of you might be filled with all the fullness of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Now unto him that is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Unto him be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.\par

\subsection*{Ephesians 4}
\markright{EPHESIANS 4}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, plead to you that all of you walk worthy of the vocation wherewith all of you are called, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} With all lowliness and meekness, with longsuffering, forbearing one another in love; (o. agape) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit (o. pneuma) in the bond of peace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} There is one body, and one Spirit, (o. pneuma) even as all of you are called in one hope of your calling; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} One Lord, one faith, one baptism, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} One God and Father of all, who is above all, and through all, and in you all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} But unto every one of us is given grace according to the measure of the gift of Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Wherefore he says, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} (Now that he ascended, what is it but that he also descended first into the lower parts of the earth? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} He that descended is the same also that ascended up far above all heavens, that he might fill all things.) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And he gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Till we all come in the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, unto a perfect man, unto the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} That we henceforth be no more children, tossed back and forth, and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the sleight of men, and cunning craftiness, whereby they lie in wait to deceive; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} But speaking the truth in love, (o. agape) may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} From whom the whole body fitly joined together and compacted by that which every joint supplies, according to the effectual working in the measure of every part, makes increase of the body unto the edifying of itself in love. (o. agape) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that all of you henceforth walk not as other Gentiles walk, in the vanity of their mind, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Having the understanding darkened, being alienated from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them, because of the blindness of their heart: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Who being past feeling have given themselves over unto lasciviousness, to work all uncleanness with greediness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But all of you have not so learned Christ; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} If so be that all of you have heard him, and have been taught by him, as the truth is in Jesus: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} That all of you put off concerning the former conversation the old man, which is corrupt according to the deceitful lusts; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And be renewed in the spirit (o. pneuma) of your mind; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And that all of you put on the new man, which after God is created in righteousness and true holiness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Wherefore putting away lying, speak every man truth with his neighbour: for we are members one of another. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Be all of you angry, and sin not: let not the sun go down upon your wrath: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Neither give place to the devil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Let him that stole steal no more: but rather let him labour, working with his hands the thing which is good, that he may have to give to him that needs. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Let no corrupt communication (o. logos) proceed out of your mouth, but that which is good to the use of edifying, that it may minister grace unto the hearers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And grieve not the holy Spirit (o. pneuma) of God, whereby all of you are sealed unto the day of redemption. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And be all of you kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake has forgiven you.\par

\subsection*{Ephesians 5}
\markright{EPHESIANS 5}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Be all of you therefore followers of God, as dear children; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And walk in love, (o. agape) as Christ also has loved us, and has given himself for us an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet smelling savour. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} But fornication, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not be once named among you, as becomes saints; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Neither filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not convenient: but rather giving of thanks. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For this all of you know, that no whoremonger, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Let no man deceive you with vain words: (o. logos) for because of these things comes the wrath of God upon the children of disobedience. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Be not all of you therefore partakers with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For all of you were sometimes darkness, but now are all of you light in the Lord: walk as children of light: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} (For the fruit of the Spirit (o. pneuma) is in all goodness and righteousness and truth;) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Proving what is acceptable unto the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather reprove them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For it is a shame even to speak of those things which are done of them in secret. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} But all things that are reproved are made manifest by the light: for whatsoever does make manifest is light. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Wherefore he says, Awake you that sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give you light. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} See then that all of you walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Redeeming the time, because the days are evil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Wherefore be all of you not unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And be not drunk with wine, wherein is excess; but be filled with the Spirit; (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Speaking to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Giving thanks always for all things unto God and the Father in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Submitting yourselves one to another in the fear of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Therefore as the church is subject unto Christ, so let the wives be to their own husbands in every thing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word, (o. rhema) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} That he might present it to himself a glorious church, not having spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} So ought men to love their wives as their own bodies. He that loves his wife loves himself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} For no man ever yet hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord the church: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} For we are members of his body, of his flesh, and of his bones. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} For this cause shall a man leave his father and mother, and shall be joined unto his wife, and they two shall be one flesh. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} This is a great mystery: but I speak concerning Christ and the church. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{2} walk, ; , as; , ; a sacrifice *marg.; for a \textsuperscript{5} this; that no; who is \textsuperscript{6} no; vain; cometh; children disobedience or, unbelief; *Gr. \textsuperscript{9} the fruit goodness; righteousness; truth \textsuperscript{14} he or, it Awake, ; *marg. arise; Christ NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. Brenton LXX: “Isaiah 60:1 Be enlightened, be enlightened, O Jerusalem, for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.” Masoretic/Hebrew comparison: “Isaiah 60:1 Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.” \textsuperscript{19} to yourselves; psalms Psalms, ψαλμοι, from ψαλλω, to touch or play on a musical instrument, properly denotes such sacred songs or poems as are sung to stringed instruments, and may here refer to those of David; hymns, υμνοι, from υδω, to sing, celebrate, praise, signifies songs in honour of God; and songs ωδαι, from αειδω, to sing, denotes any regular poetic composition adapted to singing, and is here restricted to those which are spiritual.; making\par}

\subsection*{Ephesians 6}
\markright{EPHESIANS 6}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Children, obey your parents in the Lord: for this is right. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Honour your father and mother; which is the first commandment with promise; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} That it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And, all of you fathers, provoke not your children to wrath: but bring them up in the nurture and admonition of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Servants, be obedient to them that are your masters according to the flesh, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as unto Christ; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Not with eye-service, as men-pleasers; but as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} With good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Knowing that whatsoever good thing any man does, the same shall he receive of the Lord, whether he be bond or free. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And, all of you masters, do the same things unto them, forbearing threatening: knowing that your Master also is in heaven; neither is there respect of persons with him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Put on the whole armour of God, that all of you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For we wrestle not against flesh and blood, but against principalities, against powers, against the rulers of the darkness of this world, against spiritual wickedness in high places. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that all of you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Stand therefore, having your loins girt about with truth, and having on the breastplate of righteousness; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And your feet shod with the preparation of the gospel of peace; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Above all, taking the shield of faith, wherewith all of you shall be able to quench all the fiery darts of the wicked. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, (o. pneuma) which is the word (o. rhema) of God: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Praying always with all prayer and supplication in the Spirit, (o. pneuma) and watching thereunto with all perseverance and supplication for all saints; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And for me, that utterance (o. logos) may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery of the gospel, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} For which I am an ambassador in bonds: that therein I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} But that all of you also may know my affairs, and how I do, Tychicus, a beloved brother and faithful minister in the Lord, shall make known to you all things: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Whom I have sent unto you for the same purpose, that all of you might know our affairs, and that he might comfort your hearts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Peace be to the brethren, and love (o. agape) with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Grace be with all them that love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity. Amen.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{5} be; according with; in; as \textsuperscript{9} ye; the same; forbearing or, moderating;, knowing;, ; your Master Some read, both your and their Master.; neither \textsuperscript{11} Put; the whole; able; the wiles *Gr: \textsuperscript{12} wrestle; flesh and blood Gr. blood and flesh; principalities; against the; spiritual wickedness or, wicked spirits high or, heavenly \textsuperscript{13} take; the whole Πανοπλια, a complete suit of armour, both offensive and defensive, from παν, all, and οπλον, armour. in the; done all or, overcome all to stand \textsuperscript{14} having; the breastplate The θωραξ, or breastplate, consisted of two parts; one of which covered the whole region of the thorax or breast, and the other the back, as far down as the front part extended. \textsuperscript{16} the shield The θυρεος was a large oblong shield, or scuta, like a door, θυρα, made of wood and covered with hides.; to quench \textsuperscript{17} the helmet; the sword;, which \textsuperscript{18} Praying; , ; supplication, ; in the; watching; all perseverance; supplication \textsuperscript{19} for; utterance; that I, ; *marg.; the mystery \textsuperscript{20} I am; bonds or, a chain, ; therein or, thereof boldly \textsuperscript{24} Grace; love; in sincerity or, with incorruption; Amen\par}

\section*{Philippians Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} Paul the apostle\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} The opening identifies Paul, and the church has always received Philippians as Pauline.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} Its prison setting, coworkers, and warm personal tone fit Paul well.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} AD 60-62 during Roman imprisonment\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Warm prison letter to a faithful supporting church.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To thank the Philippians, encourage joy and unity, and exalt Christ's humiliation and exaltation.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} joy; humility; Christ hymn; perseverance; partnership\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Thanksgiving and prayer 1; Christlike humility 2; warning and goal 3; peace and gratitude 4.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Papyrus 16 and Papyrus 46 witness Philippians ca. AD 200 | Subst. Papyrus 46 is the earliest substantial Philippians witness ca. AD 200 | Heb. No complete Hebrew original survives n/a | Gk. Codex Vaticanus and Codex Sinaiticus preserve complete Greek Philippians 4th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Likely echoed in Polycarp by Polycarp (early 2nd century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} Philippians is early and well attested, with no major textual instability compared with some other books.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives Philippians as authentic Pauline prison correspondence.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{Philippians}
\markboth{PHILIPPIANS}{}
\subsection*{Philippians 1}
\markright{PHILIPPIANS 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} I thank my God upon every remembrance of you, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Being confident of this very thing, that he which has begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Even as it is meet for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, all of you all are partakers of my grace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For God is my record, how greatly I long after you all in the bowels of Jesus Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And this I pray, that your love (o. agape) may abound yet more and more in knowledge and in all judgment; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} That all of you may approve things that are excellent; that all of you may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are by Jesus Christ, unto the glory and praise of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} But I would all of you should understand, brethren, that the things which happened unto me have fallen out rather unto the furtherance of the gospel; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And many of the brethren in the Lord, waxing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word (o. logos) without fear. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} But the other of love, (o. agape) knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit (o. pneuma) of Jesus Christ, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} According to my earn expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} In order to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labour: yet what I shall choose I know not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} For I am in a strait between two, having a desire to depart, and to be with Christ; which is far better: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more necessary for you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Only let your conversation be as it becomes the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that all of you stand fast in one spirit, (o. pneuma) with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And in nothing terrified by your adversaries: which is to them an evident token of perdition, but to you of salvation, and that of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} For unto you it is given in the behalf of Christ, not only to believe on him, but also to suffer for his sake; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Having the same conflict which all of you saw in me, and now hear to be in me.\par

\subsection*{Philippians 2}
\markright{PHILIPPIANS 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, (o. agape) if any fellowship of the Spirit, (o. pneuma) if any bowels and mercies, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Fulfill all of you my joy, that all of you be likeminded, having the same love, (o. agape) being of one accord, of one mind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Wherefore God also has highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Wherefore, my beloved, as all of you have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} For it is God which works in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Do all things without murmurings and disputings: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} That all of you may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom all of you shine as lights in the world; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Holding forth the word (o. logos) of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} For the same cause also do all of you joy, and rejoice with me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ's. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} But all of you know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he has served with me in the gospel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellow soldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that all of you had heard that he had been sick. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when all of you see him again, all of you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{25} Name meaning: Epaphroditus (Epaphroditus) — Lovely; charming Risked his life to serve Paul.\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} any consolation;, ; if any comfort; , if any fellowship, ; if any bowels \textsuperscript{2} Fulfil, ; that, like minded, ; one accord \textsuperscript{7} made;, ; , the form, ; in the; likeness or, habit \textsuperscript{8} in; he; and became; the death \textsuperscript{10} NT quotation aligns more closely with the Hebrew here; cf. Brenton LXX: “Isaiah 45:23 By myself I swear, righteousness shall surely proceed out of my mouth; my words shall not be frustrated; that to me every knee shall bend, and every tongue shall swear by God,” Masoretic/Hebrew comparison: “Isaiah 45:23 I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.” \textsuperscript{11} every *marg.; is Lord; , to the \textsuperscript{12} my beloved; as ye, work; own; with \textsuperscript{15} blameless; and; harmless or, sincere, sons; rebuke; a crooked; ye shine or, shine ye \textsuperscript{16} Holding; the word; that I may; that I have \textsuperscript{17} and if; offered Gr. poured forth the sacrifice; I joy \textsuperscript{19} But or, Moreover; *marg.; to send, ; that I \textsuperscript{20} I have; likeminded or, so dear unto me \textsuperscript{25} Epaphroditus my brother; companion; fellowsoldier; but; *Gr. and he \textsuperscript{26} he longed, ; full; ye had \textsuperscript{27} nigh; but God;, ; but on \textsuperscript{29} Receive; with; and; hold such in reputation or, honour such\par}

\subsection*{Philippians 3}
\markright{PHILIPPIANS 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Finally, my brethren, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the concision. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, (o. pneuma) and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Though I might also have confidence in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has whereof he might trust in the flesh, I more: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, an Hebrew of the Hebrews; as concerning the law, a Pharisee; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Concerning zeal, persecuting the church; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, blameless. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} But what things were gain to me, those I counted loss for Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Yea doubtless, and I count all things but loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord: for whom I have suffered the loss of all things, and do count them but dung, that I may win Christ, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And be found in him, not having mine own righteousness, which is of the law, but that which is through the faith of Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} That I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, being made conformable unto his death; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} If by any means I might attain unto the resurrection of the dead. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may apprehend that for which also I am apprehended of Christ Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Brethren, I count not myself to have apprehended: but this one thing I do, forgetting those things which are behind, and reaching forth unto those things which are before, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} I press toward the mark for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Let us therefore, as many as be perfect, be thus minded: and if in any thing all of you be otherwise minded, God shall reveal even this unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Nevertheless, whereto we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule, let us mind the same thing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Brethren, be followers together of me, and mark them which walk so as all of you have us for an example. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} (For many walk, of whom I have told you often, and now tell you even weeping, that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Whose end is destruction, whose God is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who mind earthly things.) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Who shall change our vile body, that it may be fashioned like unto his glorious body, according to the working whereby he is able even to subdue all things unto himself.\par

\subsection*{Philippians 4}
\markright{PHILIPPIANS 4}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Therefore, my brethren dearly beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand fast in the Lord, my dearly beloved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} I plead to Euodias, and plead to Syntyche, that they be of the same mind in the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I implore you also, true yokefellow, help those women which laboured with me in the gospel, with Clement also, and with other my fellow labourers, whose names are in the book of life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Rejoice in the Lord always: and again I say, Rejoice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Let your moderation be known unto all men. The Lord is at hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the peace of God, which passes all understanding, shall keep your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Finally, brethren, whatsoever things are true, whatsoever things are honest, whatsoever things are just, whatsoever things are pure, whatsoever things are lovely, whatsoever things are of good report; if there be any virtue, and if there be any praise, think on these things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Those things, which all of you have both learned, and received, and heard, and seen in me, do: and the God of peace shall be with you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} But I rejoiced in the Lord greatly, that now at the last your care of me has flourished again; wherein all of you were also careful, but all of you lacked opportunity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Not that I speak in respect of lack: for I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} I know both how to be brought low, and I know how to abound: every where and in all things I am instructed both to be full and to be hungry, both to abound and to suffer need. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} I can do all things through Christ which strengthens me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Notwithstanding all of you have well done, that all of you did communicate with my affliction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Now all of you Philippians know also, that in the beginning of the gospel, when I departed from Macedonia, no church communicated with me as concerning (o. logos) giving and receiving, but all of you only. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} For even in Thessalonica all of you sent once and again unto my necessity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account. (o. logos) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} But I have all, and abound: I am full, having received of Epaphroditus the things which were sent from you, an odour of a sweet smell, a sacrifice acceptable, well-pleasing to God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} But my God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Now unto God and our Father be glory for ever and ever. Amen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Salute every saint in Christ Jesus. The brethren which are with me greet you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} All the saints salute you, chiefly they that are of Caesar's household. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{2} Name meaning: Euodia (Euodia) — Prosperous journey; success Worked hard in the gospel but needed unity. Name meaning: Syntyche (Syntyche) — Fortunate together Called to agree in the Lord. \textsuperscript{3} Name meaning: Clement (Clemens) — Mild; merciful Fellow worker whose name is in the Book of Life.\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} Therefore; and, my joy; so \textsuperscript{7} the peace; , ; , ; passeth; shall;, through \textsuperscript{8} Finally whatsoever; are true; honest or, venerable; , ; *Gr: *marg.; are just; are pure; are lovely; are of, ; virtue; praise; think \textsuperscript{9} which;, ; do; the God; with \textsuperscript{10} I; your; hath flourished or, is revived; ye lacked \textsuperscript{12} how to be;, I am \textsuperscript{18} I have all or, I have received all abound; Epaphroditus an; acceptable \textsuperscript{22} the; they Caesar's The cruel, worthless, and diabolical Nero was at this time emperor of Rome; but it is not improbable that the empress Poppaea was favourably inclined to Christianity, as Josephus relates that Θεοσεβης, γαρ, ην, "she was a worshipper of the true God." Jerome states (in Philemon) that St. Paul had converted many in Caesar's family; for "being by the emperor cast into prison, he became more known to his family, and turned the house of Christ's persecutor into a church."\par}

\section*{Colossians Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} Paul the apostle\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} The opening identifies Paul, and conservative scholarship receives Colossians as Pauline.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} Its links to Philemon and the prison setting support traditional authorship.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} AD 60-62 during Roman imprisonment\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Prison epistle magnifying Christ's supremacy over all powers and urging holy living.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To combat false teaching by exalting the all-sufficient Christ and calling believers to walk in Him.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} supremacy of Christ; new creation; holiness; fullness; church\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Supremacy and reconciliation 1-2; new life and household order 3-4.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Papyrus 46 ca. AD 200 | Subst. Papyrus 46 is the earliest substantial Colossians witness ca. AD 200 | Heb. No complete Hebrew original survives n/a | Gk. Codex Vaticanus and Codex Sinaiticus preserve complete Greek Colossians 4th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Likely echoed in Ignatius and Polycarp by Ignatius and Polycarp (early 2nd century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} Colossians is textually stable overall and closely linked to Philemon for historical setting.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives Colossians as authentic Pauline prison teaching centered on Christ's supremacy.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{Colossians}
\markboth{COLOSSIANS}{}
\subsection*{Colossians 1}
\markright{COLOSSIANS 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the (o. agape) love which all of you have to all the saints, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof all of you heard before in the (o. logos) word of the truth of the gospel; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Which has come unto you, as it is in all the world; and brings forth fruit, as it does also in you, since the day all of you heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} As all of you also learned of Epaphras our dear fellow servant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Who also declared unto us your (o. agape) love in the (o. pneuma) Spirit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that all of you might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} That all of you might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Giving thanks unto the Father, which has made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Who has delivered us from the power of darkness, and has translated us into the kingdom of his (o. agape) dear Son: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And he is before all things, and by him all things consist. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} For it pleased the Father that in him should all fullness dwell; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now has he reconciled {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and irreproachable in his sight: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} If all of you continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which all of you have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the church: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfill the (o. logos) word of God; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Even the mystery which has been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Unto which I also labour, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{7} Name meaning: Epaphras (Epaphras) — Lovely; charming Fervent intercessor for Colossae.\par}

\subsection*{Colossians 2}
\markright{COLOSSIANS 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} For I would that all of you knew what great conflict I have for you, and for them at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} That their hearts might be comforted, being knit together in (o. agape) love, and unto all riches of the full assurance of understanding, to the acknowledgement of the mystery of God, and of the Father, and of Christ; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} In whom are hid all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And this I say, lest any man should beguile you with enticing words. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For though I be absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the (o. pneuma) spirit, rejoicing and beholding your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} As all of you have therefore received Christ Jesus the Lord, so walk all of you in him: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, as all of you have been taught, abounding therein with thanksgiving. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Beware lest any man spoil you through philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the rudiments of the world, and not after Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For in him dwells all the fullness of the Godhead bodily. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And all of you are complete in him, which is the head of all principality and power: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} In whom also all of you are circumcised with the circumcision made without hands, in putting off the body of the sins of the flesh by the circumcision of Christ: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Buried with him in baptism, wherein also all of you are risen with him through the faith of the operation of God, who has raised him from the dead. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And you, being dead in your sins and the uncircumcision of your flesh, has he quickened together with him, having forgiven you all trespasses; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Blotting out the handwriting of ordinances that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Let no man therefore judge you in food, or in drink, or in respect of an holyday, or of the new moon, or of the sabbath days: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Which are a shadow of things to come; but the body is of Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Let no man beguile you of your reward in a voluntary humility and worshipping of angels, intruding into those things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And not holding the Head, from which all the body by joints and bands having nourishment ministered, and knit together, increases with the increase of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Wherefore if all of you be dead with Christ from the rudiments of the world, why, as though living in the world, are all of you subject to ordinances, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} (Touch not; taste not; handle not; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Which all are to perish with the using;) after the commandments and doctrines of men? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Which things have indeed a (o. logos) show of wisdom religious outlook, and humility, and neglecting of the body: not in any honour to the satisfying of the flesh.\par

\subsection*{Colossians 3}
\markright{COLOSSIANS 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} If all of you then be risen with Christ, seek those things which are above, where Christ sits on the right hand of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Set your affection on things above, not on things on the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For all of you are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} When Christ, who is our life, shall appear, then shall all of you also appear with him in glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Mortify therefore your members which are upon the earth; fornication, uncleanness, inordinate affection, evil concupiscence, and covetousness, which is idolatry: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} For which things' sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} In the which all of you also walked some time, when all of you lived in them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} But now all of you also put off all these; anger, wrath, malice, blasphemy, filthy communication out of your mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Lie not one to another, seeing that all of you have put off the old man with his deeds; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And have put on the new man, which is renewed in knowledge after the image of him that created him: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Where there is neither Greek nor Jew, circumcision nor uncircumcision, Barbarian, Savages, bond nor free: but Christ is all, and in all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Put on therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, bowels of mercies, kindness, humbleness of mind, meekness, longsuffering; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do all of you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And above all these things put on (o. agape) love, which is the bond of perfection. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to the which also all of you are called in one body; and be all of you thankful. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Let the (o. logos) word of Christ dwell in you richly in all wisdom; teaching and admonishing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your hearts to the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And whatsoever all of you do in (o. logos) word or deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God and the Father by him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as it is fit in the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Husbands, love your wives, and be not bitter against them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Children, obey your parents in all things: for this is well pleasing unto the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Fathers, provoke not your children to anger, lest they be discouraged. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Servants, obey in all things your masters according to the flesh; not with eye-service, as men-pleasers; but in singleness of heart, fearing God; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And whatsoever all of you do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Knowing that of the Lord all of you shall receive the reward of the inheritance: for all of you serve the Lord Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} But he that does wrong shall receive for the wrong which he has done: and there is no respect of persons.\par
