\section*{2 Peter Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} Peter the apostle\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} The opening identifies Simon Peter; conservative scholarship receives the letter as genuinely Petrine despite its later and sparser attestation.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} 2 Peter 1 and 3 present apostolic self-consciousness, eyewitness claim, and relation to Paul.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} mid-60s AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Final apostolic warning against false teachers and unbelief concerning Christ's return.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To call believers to growth, guard against corruption, and affirm the certainty of the Lord's coming.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} knowledge; holiness; false teachers; second coming; Scripture\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Growth and calling 1; false teachers 2; day of the Lord 3.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Papyrus 72 contains 2 Peter 3rd-4th century AD | Subst. Papyrus 72 is the earliest substantial 2 Peter witness 3rd-4th century AD | Heb. No complete Hebrew original survives n/a | Gk. Codex Sinaiticus and Vaticanus preserve complete Greek 2 Peter 4th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Earliest clear attestation in Origen by Origen (3rd century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} 2 Peter has the sparsest early external attestation among NT books, but its textual preservation in the received tradition is secure.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives 2 Peter as genuinely Petrine and does not accept late pseudonymity as compatible with the book's self-witness.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{2 Peter}
\markboth{2 PETER}{}
\subsection*{2 Peter 1}
\markright{2 PETER 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Simon Peter, a servant and an apostle of Jesus Christ, to them that have obtained like precious faith with us through the righteousness of God and our Saviour Jesus Christ: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Grace and peace be multiplied unto you through the knowledge of God, and of Jesus our Lord, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} According as his divine power has given unto us all things that pertain unto life and godliness, through the knowledge of him that has called us to glory and virtue: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Whereby are given unto us exceeding great and precious promises: that by these all of you might be partakers of the divine nature, having escaped the corruption that is in the world through lust. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And beside this, giving all diligence, add to your faith virtue; and to virtue knowledge; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And to knowledge wilful restrain; and to wilful restrain patience; and to patience godliness; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And to godliness brotherly kindness; and to brotherly kindness love. (o. agape) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For if these things be in you, and abound, they make you that all of you shall neither be barren nor unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} But he that lacks these things is blind, and cannot see far off, and has forgotten that he was purged from his old sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Wherefore the rather, brethren, give diligence to make your calling and election sure: for if all of you do these things, all of you shall never fall: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For so an entrance shall be ministered unto you abundantly into the everlasting kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Wherefore I will not be negligent to put you always in remembrance of these things, though all of you know them, and be established in the present truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Yea, I think it meet, as long as I am in this tabernacle, to stir you up by putting you in remembrance; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Knowing that shortly I must put off this my tabernacle, even as our Lord Jesus Christ has showed me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Moreover I will endeavour that all of you may be able after my decease to have these things always in remembrance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} For we have not followed cunningly devised fables, when we made known unto you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but were eyewitnesses of his majesty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For he received from God the Father honour and glory, when there came such a voice to him from the excellent glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And this voice which came from heaven we heard, when we were with him in the holy mount. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} We have also a more sure word (o. logos) of prophecy; unto which all of you do well that all of you take heed, as unto a light that shines in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke as they were moved by the Holy Spirit. (o. pneuma)\par

\subsection*{2 Peter 2}
\markright{2 PETER 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} But there were false prophets also among the people, even as there shall be false teachers among you, who privately shall bring in damnable heresies, even denying the Lord that bought them, and bring upon themselves swift destruction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And many shall follow their pernicious ways; by reason of whom the way of truth shall be evil spoken of. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And through covetousness shall they with feigned words (o. logos) make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingers not, and their damnation slumbers not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For if God spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrha into ashes condemned them with an overthrow, making them an example unto those that after should live ungodly; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} (For that righteous man dwelling among them, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds;) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} But chiefly them that walk after the flesh in the lust of uncleanness, and despise government. Arrogant are they, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Whereas angels, which are greater in power and might, bring not railing accusation against them before the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} But these, as natural brute beasts, made to be taken and destroyed, speak evil of the things that they understand not; and shall utterly perish in their own corruption; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And shall receive the reward of unrighteousness, as they that count it pleasure to riot in the day time. Spots they are and blemishes, sporting themselves with their own deceits while they feast with you; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Having eyes full of adultery, and that cannot cease from sin; beguiling unstable souls: an heart they have exercised with covetous practices; cursed children: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} But was rebuked for his iniquity: the dumb ass speaking with man's voice forbad the madness of the prophet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} These are wells without water, clouds that are carried with a tempest; to whom the mist of darkness is reserved for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} For when they speak great swelling words of vanity, they allure through the lusts of the flesh, through much wantonness, those that were clean escaped from them who live in error. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} While they promise them liberty, they themselves are the servants of corruption: for of whom a man is overcome, of the same is he brought in bondage. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} For if after they have escaped the pollutions of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again entangled therein, and overcome, the latter end is worse with them than the beginning. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For it had been better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after they have known it, to turn from the holy commandment delivered unto them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.\par

\subsection*{2 Peter 3}
\markright{2 PETER 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} This second epistle, beloved, I now write unto you; in both which I stir up your pure minds by way of remembrance: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} That all of you may be mindful of the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and of the commandment of us the apostles of the Lord and Saviour: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Knowing this first, that there shall come in the last days scoffers, walking after their own lusts, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And saying, Where is the promise of his coming? for since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word (o. logos) of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Whereby the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} But the heavens and the earth, which are now, by the same word (o. logos) are kept in store, reserved unto fire against the day of judgment and perdition of ungodly men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} But, beloved, be not ignorant of this one thing, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The Lord is not slack concerning his promise, as some men count slackness; but is longsuffering toward us, not willing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in the which the heavens shall pass away with a great noise, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat, the earth also and the works that are therein shall be burned up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought all of you to be in all holy conversation and godliness, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Looking for and hasting unto the coming of the day of God, wherein the heavens being on fire shall be dissolved, and the elements shall melt with fervent heat? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwells righteousness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Wherefore, beloved, seeing that all of you look for such things, be diligent that all of you may be found of him in peace, without spot, and blameless. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And account that the longsuffering of our Lord is salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also according to the wisdom given unto him has written unto you; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} As also in all his epistles, speaking in them of these things; in which are some things hard to be understood, which they that are unlearned and unstable shift, as they do also the other scriptures, unto their own destruction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} All of you therefore, beloved, seeing all of you know these things before, beware lest all of you also, being led away with the error of the wicked, fall from your own steadfastness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and for ever. Amen.\par

\section*{1 John Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} John the apostle\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} Early church testimony and the close relation to the Fourth Gospel support Johannine apostolic authorship.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} The language, theology, and pastoral voice align with the apostle John and the Johannine circle under his oversight.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} late 1st century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Pastoral doctrinal tract combating false claims while assuring believers of eternal life.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To strengthen assurance, define true fellowship, and expose antichrist error.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} assurance; fellowship; love; truth; incarnation; obedience\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Tests of life and fellowship 1-5.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Papyrus 9 and Papyrus 74 preserve early 1 John material 3rd-7th century AD | Subst. Papyrus 74 and major uncials preserve substantial text 3rd-4th century AD | Heb. No complete Hebrew original survives n/a | Gk. Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Vaticanus preserve complete Greek 1 John 4th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Likely echoed by Polycarp by Polycarp (early 2nd century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} 1 John is central in Christological and assurance passages; textually it is well preserved overall.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives 1 John as apostolic Johannine testimony against early christological error.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{1 John}
\markboth{1 JOHN}{}
\subsection*{1 John 1}
\markright{1 JOHN 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} That which was from the beginning, which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word (o. logos) of life; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} (For the life was manifested, and we have seen it, and bear witness, and show unto you that eternal life, which was with the Father, and was manifested unto us;) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} That which we have seen and heard declare we unto you, that all of you also may have fellowship with us: and truly our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son Jesus Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And these things write we unto you, that your joy may be full. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} This then is the message which we have heard of him, and declare unto you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} If we say that we have fellowship with him, and walk in darkness, we lie, and do not the truth: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship one with another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} If we say that we have not sinned, we make him a liar, and his word (o. logos) is not in us.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} That which; , which we have heard; and our; the Word \textsuperscript{2} the life;, was manifested; and bear;, ; show that eternal which was \textsuperscript{3} which; declare; ye also; *Gr. our fellowship;, ; with his \textsuperscript{6} If, ; fellowship; walk; , we lie; do not \textsuperscript{7} If we; as; we have; and the \textsuperscript{8} say, ; , ; we deceive; the truth \textsuperscript{9} we confess; he is; just; and to \textsuperscript{10} we say; we make; his word\par}

\subsection*{1 John 2}
\markright{1 JOHN 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} My little children, these things write I unto you, that all of you sin not. And if any man sin, we have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And he is the propitiation for our sins: and not for our's only, but also for the sins of the whole world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And hereby we do know that we know him, if we keep his commandments. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} He that says, I know him, and keeps not his commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} But whoso keeps his word, (o. logos) in him verily is the love (o. agape) of God perfected: hereby know we that we are in him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} He that says he abides in him ought himself also so to walk, even as he walked. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Brethren, I write no new commandment unto you, but an old commandment which all of you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word (o. logos) which all of you have heard from the beginning. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Again, a new commandment I write unto you, which thing is true in him and in you: because the darkness is past, and the true light now shines. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} He that says he is in the light, and hates his brother, is in darkness even until now. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} He that loves his brother abides in the light, and there is none occasion of stumbling in him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} But he that hates his brother is in darkness, and walks in darkness, and knows not where he goes, because that darkness has blinded his eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} I write unto you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} I write unto you, fathers, because all of you have known him that is from the beginning. I write unto you, young men, because all of you have overcome the wicked one. I write unto you, little children, because all of you have known the Father. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} I have written unto you, fathers, because all of you have known him that is from the beginning. I have written unto you, young men, because all of you are strong, and the word (o. logos) of God abides in you, and all of you have overcome the wicked one. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. If any man love the world, the love (o. agape) of the Father is not in him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, and the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father, but is of the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And the world passes away, and the lust thereof: but he that does the will of God abides for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Little children, it is the last time: and as all of you have heard that antichrist shall come, even now are there many antichrists; whereby we know that it is the last time. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us: but they went out, that they might be made manifest that they were not all of us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But all of you have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know all things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} I have not written unto you because all of you know not the truth, but because all of you know it, and that no lie is of the truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Who is a liar but he that denies that Jesus is the Christ? He is antichrist, that denies the Father and the Son. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Whosoever denies the Son, the same has not the Father: he that acknowledges the Son has the Father also. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Let that therefore abide in you, which all of you have heard from the beginning. If that which all of you have heard from the beginning shall remain in you, all of you also shall continue in the Son, and in the Father. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And this is the promise that he has promised us, even eternal life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} These things have I written unto you concerning them that seduce you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} But the anointing which all of you have received of him abides in you, and all of you need not that any man teach you: but as the same anointing teaches you of all things, and is truth, and is no lie, and even as it has taught you, all of you shall abide in him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And now, little children, abide in him; that, when he shall appear, we may have confidence, and not be ashamed before him at his coming. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} If all of you know that he is righteous, all of you know that every one that does righteousness is born of him.\par

\subsection*{1 John 3}
\markright{1 JOHN 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Behold, what manner of love (o. agape) the Father has bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God: therefore the world knows us not, because it knew him not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Beloved, now are we the sons of God, and it does not yet appear what we shall be: but we know that, when he shall appear, we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And every man that has this hope in him purifies himself, even as he is pure. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Whosoever commits sin trangresses also the law: for sin is the transgression of the law. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And all of you know that he was manifested to take away our sins; and in him is no sin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Whosoever abides in him sins not: whosoever sins has not seen him, neither known him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Little children, let no man deceive you: he that does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} He that commits sin is of the devil; for the devil sins from the beginning. For this purpose the Son of God was manifested, that he might destroy the works of the devil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Whosoever is born of God does not commit sin; for his seed remains in him: and he cannot sin, because he is born of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} In this the children of God are manifest, and the children of the devil: whosoever does not righteousness is not of God, neither he that loves not his brother. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For this is the message that all of you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Not as Cain, who was of that wicked one, and slew his brother. And wherefore slew he him? Because his own works were evil, and his brother's righteous. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Marvel not, my brethren, if the world hate you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} We know that we have passed from death unto life, because we love the brethren. He that loves not his brother abides in death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Whosoever hates his brother is a murderer: and all of you know that no murderer has eternal life abiding in him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Hereby perceive we the love (o. agape) of God, because he laid down his life for us: and we ought to lay down our lives for the brethren. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} But whoso has this world's good, and sees his brother have need, and shuts up his bowels of compassion from him, how dwells the love (o. agape) of God in him? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} My little children, let us not love in word, (o. logos) neither in tongue; but in deed and in truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And hereby we know that we are of the truth, and shall assure our hearts before him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} For if our heart condemn us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Beloved, if our heart condemn us not, then have we confidence toward God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments, and do those things that are pleasing in his sight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And this is his commandment, That we should believe on the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love one another, as he gave us commandment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And he that keeps his commandments dwells in him, and he in him. And hereby we know that he abides in us, by the Spirit (o. pneuma) which he has given us.\par

\subsection*{1 John 4}
\markright{1 JOHN 4}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Beloved, believe not every spirit, (o. pneuma) but try the spirits (o. pneuma) whether they are of God: because many false prophets are gone out into the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Hereby know all of you the Spirit (o. pneuma) of God: Every spirit (o. pneuma) that confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And every spirit (o. pneuma) that confesses not that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist, whereof all of you have heard that it should come; and even now already is it in the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} All of you are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} They are of the world: therefore speak they of the world, and the world hears them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} We are of God: he that knows God hears us; he that is not of God hears not us. Hereby know we the spirit (o. pneuma) of truth, and the spirit (o. pneuma) of error. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Beloved, let us love one another: for love (o. agape) is of God; and every one that loves is born of God, and knows God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} He that loves not knows not God; for God is love. (o. agape) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} In this was manifested the love (o. agape) of God toward us, because that God sent his only begotten Son into the world, that we might live through him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Herein is love, (o. agape) not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son to be the propitiation for our sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Beloved, if God so loved us, we ought also to love one another. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} No man has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God dwells in us, and his love (o. agape) is perfected in us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Hereby know we that we dwell in him, and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit. (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And we have seen and do testify that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Whosoever shall confess that Jesus is the Son of God, God dwells in him, and he in God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And we have known and believed the love (o. agape) that God has to us. God is love; (o. agape) and he that dwells in love (o. agape) dwells in God, and God in him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Herein is our love (o. agape) made perfect, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment: because as he is, so are we in this world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} There is no fear in love; (o. agape) but perfect love (o. agape) casts out fear: because fear has torment. He that fears is not made perfect in love. (o. agape) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} We love him, because he first loved us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} If a man say, I love God, and hates his brother, he is a liar: for he that loves not his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And this commandment have we from him, That he who loves God love his brother also.\par

\subsection*{1 John 5}
\markright{1 JOHN 5}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Whosoever believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God: and every one that loves him that brings forth loves him also that is begotten of him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God, and keep his commandments. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For this is the love (o. agape) of God, that we keep his commandments: and his commandments are not grievous. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For whatsoever is born of God overcomes the world: and this is the victory that overcomes the world, even our faith. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Who is he that overcomes the world, but he that believes that Jesus is the Son of God? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} This is he that came by water and blood, even Jesus Christ; not by water only, but by water and blood. And it is the Spirit (o. pneuma) that bears witness, because the Spirit (o. pneuma) is truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For there are three that bear record in heaven, the Father, the Word, (o. logos) and the Holy Spirit: (o. pneuma) and these three are one. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And there are three that bear witness in earth, the Spirit, (o. pneuma) and the water, and the blood: and these three agree in one. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater: for this is the witness of God which he has testified of his Son. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} He that believes on the Son of God has the witness in himself: he that believes not God has made him a liar; because he believes not the record that God gave of his Son. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And this is the record, that God has given to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} He that has the Son has life; and he that has not the Son of God has not life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} These things have I written unto you that believe on the name of the Son of God; that all of you may know that all of you have eternal life, and that all of you may believe on the name of the Son of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will, he hears us: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And if we know that he hear us, whatsoever we ask, we know that we have the petitions that we desired of him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} If any man see his brother sin a sin which is not unto death, he shall ask, and he shall give him life for them that sin not unto death. There is a sin unto death: I do not say that he shall pray for it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} All unrighteousness is sin: and there is a sin not unto death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} We know that whosoever is born of God sins not; but he that is begotten of God keeps himself, and that wicked one touches him not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And we know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in wickedness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And we know that the Son of God has come, and has given us an understanding, that we may know him that is true, and we are in him that is true, even in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Little children, keep yourselves from idols. Amen.\par

\section*{2 John Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} John the apostle\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} Early church testimony attributes 2 John to the apostle or the elder John identified with him in conservative reading.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} Its style and content closely cohere with 1 John and the Fourth Gospel.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} late 1st century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Short letter warning against deceivers and urging fidelity to truth and love.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To guard the church from false teachers while maintaining Christian love.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} truth; love; doctrine; deception\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Greeting 1-3; walking in truth and love 4-6; warning against deceivers 7-11; closing 12-13.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Papyrus 74 preserves 2 John 7th century AD | Subst. Major uncials preserve the earliest substantial 2 John text 4th century AD | Heb. No complete Hebrew original survives n/a | Gk. Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Vaticanus preserve complete Greek 2 John 4th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Likely attested by Irenaeus by Irenaeus (late 2nd century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} 2 John is short and less heavily witnessed in papyri, but secure in the main Greek tradition.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives 2 John as genuinely Johannine and apostolic.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{2 John}
\markboth{2 JOHN}{}
\subsection*{2 John 1}
\markright{2 JOHN 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The elder unto the elect lady and her children, whom I love in the truth; and not I only, but also all they that have known the truth; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} For the truth's sake, which dwells in us, and shall be with us for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Grace be with you, mercy, and peace, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love. (o. agape) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I rejoiced greatly that I found of your children walking in truth, as we have received a commandment from the Father. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And now I plead to you, lady, not as though I wrote a new commandment unto you, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And this is love, (o. agape) that we walk after his commandments. This is the commandment, That, as all of you have heard from the beginning, all of you should walk in it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For many deceivers are entered into the world, who confess not that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh. This is a deceiver and an antichrist. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Look to yourselves, that we lose not those things which we have wrought, but that we receive a full reward. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Whosoever trangresses, and abides not in the doctrine of Christ, has not God. He that abides in the doctrine of Christ, he has both the Father and the Son. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} If there come any unto you, and bring not this doctrine, receive him not into your house, neither bid him God speed: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For he that bids him God speed is partaker of his evil deeds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Having many things to write unto you, I would not write with paper and ink: but I trust to come unto you, and speak face to face, that our joy may be full. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} The children of your elect sister greet you. Amen.\par

\section*{3 John Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} John the apostle\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} Early church testimony attributes 3 John to the apostle or the elder John identified with him in conservative reading.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} Its language and themes closely cohere with 1 and 2 John.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} late 1st century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Brief personal letter concerning hospitality, truth, and Diotrephes's arrogance.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To commend faithfulness, rebuke pride, and support gospel workers.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} truth; hospitality; authority; faithfulness\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Greeting and praise 1-8; Diotrephes and Demetrius 9-12; closing 13-15.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Papyrus 74 preserves 3 John 7th century AD | Subst. Major uncials preserve the earliest substantial 3 John text 4th century AD | Heb. No complete Hebrew original survives n/a | Gk. Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Vaticanus preserve complete Greek 3 John 4th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Likely attested by later 2nd-century fathers by Irenaeus or later witnesses (late 2nd century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} 3 John is short and relatively thinly attested in early papyri, but stable in the main textual stream.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives 3 John as authentic Johannine apostolic correspondence.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{3 John}
\markboth{3 JOHN}{}
\subsection*{3 John 1}
\markright{3 JOHN 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The elder unto the beloved Gaius, whom I love in the truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Beloved, I wish above all things that you may prosper and be in health, even as your soul prospers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in you, even as you walk in the truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I have no greater joy than to hear that my children walk in truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Beloved, you do faithfully whatsoever you do to the brethren, and to strangers; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Which have borne witness of your love (o. agape) before the church: whom if you bring forward on their journey after a godly sort, you shall do well: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Because that for his name's sake they went forth, taking nothing of the Gentiles. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} We therefore ought to receive such, that we might be fellow-helpers to the truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} I wrote unto the church: but Diotrephes, who loves to have the preeminence among them, receives us not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Wherefore, if I come, I will remember his deeds which he does, babbling against us with malicious words: (o. logos) and not content therewith, neither does he himself receive the brethren, and forbids them that would, and casts them out of the church. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Beloved, follow not that which is evil, but that which is good. He that does good is of God: but he that does evil has not seen God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Demetrius has good report of all men, and of the truth itself: yea, and we also bear record; and all of you know that our record is true. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} I had many things to write, but I will not with ink and pen write unto you: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} But I trust I shall shortly see you, and we shall speak face to face. Peace be to you. Our friends salute you. Greet the friends by name.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{9} Name meaning: Diotrephes (Diotrephes) — Nurtured by Zeus Loved preeminence and opposed apostolic authority.\par}
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{N: }}\textsuperscript{1} ad 90, am 4094 elder the wellbeloved; whom; in the truth or, truly \textsuperscript{2} wish or, pray above; that; even \textsuperscript{6} have borne witness of thy charity; whom; after a godly sort or, worthy of God, This is a literal and proper rendering of the original αξιως, του, Θεου, by which the antecedent to the possessive pronoun his, in the next verse, becomes immediately apparent. \section*{Jude Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} Jude the brother of James and servant of Jesus Christ\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} The opening identifies Jude, and conservative scholarship receives him as Jude the brother of James and half-brother of the Lord.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} The self-designation fits the known family of Jesus without claiming apostolic office directly.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} mid to late 1st century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Short urgent letter warning against ungodly infiltrators and calling believers to contend for the faith.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To defend the once-for-all delivered faith and expose libertine false teachers.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} false teachers; judgment; perseverance; contend for the faith\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Greeting and purpose 1-4; examples of judgment 5-16; exhortation and doxology 17-25.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Papyrus 72 contains Jude 3rd-4th century AD | Subst. Papyrus 72 is the earliest substantial Jude witness 3rd-4th century AD | Heb. No complete Hebrew original survives n/a | Gk. Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Vaticanus preserve complete Greek Jude 4th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Likely known in later 2nd-century fathers by Clement of Alexandria or Tertullian (late 2nd century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} Jude is important for its use of Jewish traditional material and its close relation to 2 Peter.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives Jude as authentic by the brother of James and reads his use of traditional material under inspiration.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{Jude}
\markboth{JUDE}{}
\subsection*{Jude 1}
\markright{JUDE 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Jude, the servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to them that are sanctified by God the Father, and preserved in Jesus Christ, and called: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Mercy unto you, and peace, and love, (o. agape) be multiplied. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Beloved, when I gave all diligence to write unto you of the common salvation, it was necessary for me to write unto you, and exhort you that all of you should earnestly contend for the faith which was once delivered unto the saints. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For there are certain men crept in unexpectedly, who were before of old ordained to this condemnation, ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into lasciviousness, and denying the only Lord God, and our Lord Jesus Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} I will therefore put you in remembrance, though all of you once knew this, how that the Lord, having saved the people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed them that believed not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Even as Sodom and Gomorrha, and the cities about them in like manner, giving themselves over to fornication, and going after strange flesh, are set forth for an example, suffering the vengeance of eternal fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Likewise also these filthy dreamers defile the flesh, despise dominion, and speak evil of dignities. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses, durst not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, The Lord rebuke you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} But these speak evil of those things which they know not: but what they know naturally, as brute beasts, in those things they corrupt themselves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Woe unto them! for they have gone in the way of Cain, and ran greedily after the error of Balaam for reward, and perished in the gainsaying of Core. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} These are spots in your feasts of love, (o. agape) when they feast with you, feeding themselves without fear: clouds they are without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withers, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, the Lord comes with ten thousands of his saints, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} To execute judgment upon all, and to convince all that are ungodly among them of all their ungodly deeds which they have ungodly committed, and of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} These are murmurers, complainers, walking after their own lusts; and their mouth speaks great swelling words, having men's persons in admiration because of advantage. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} But, beloved, remember all of you the words (o. rhema) which were spoken before of the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} How that they told you there should be mockers in the last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} These be they who separate themselves, sensual, having not the Spirit. (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But all of you, beloved, building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit, (o. pneuma) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Keep yourselves in the love (o. agape) of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ unto eternal life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And of some have compassion, making a difference: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And others save with fear, pulling them out of the fire; hating even the garment spotted by the flesh. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.\par

\section*{Revelation Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} John the apostle\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} The book names John, and conservative scholarship commonly receives this as the apostle John writing from Patmos.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} Revelation 1:1-4 and 22:8 self-present a prophetic eyewitness named John; early church testimony often supports apostolic authorship.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} AD 95-96 in common conservative dating\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Apocalyptic prophecy to seven churches in Asia under Roman pressure.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To unveil Jesus Christ in His present reign, covenant judgments, final victory, and the consummation of all things.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} apocalypse; sovereignty; judgment; perseverance; kingdom; new creation\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Vision of Christ and churches 1-3; heavenly throne and judgments 4-19; millennial and final victory 20; new creation 21-22.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Papyrus 98 and Papyrus 47 preserve early Revelation material 2nd-3rd century AD | Subst. Papyrus 47 is the earliest substantial Revelation witness 3rd century AD | Heb. No complete Hebrew original survives n/a | Gk. Codex Sinaiticus and Codex Alexandrinus preserve complete Greek Revelation 4th-5th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Early attestation by Justin Martyr and Irenaeus by Justin Martyr (mid 2nd century AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} Revelation is text-critically important because of its distinctive manuscript profile and dense reuse of OT language.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} This edition receives Revelation as genuine apostolic prophecy by John and rejects approaches that reduce it to merely coded political literature devoid of predictive revelation.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{Revelation}
\markboth{REVELATION}{}
\subsection*{Revelation 1}
\markright{REVELATION 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave unto him, to show unto his servants things which must shortly come to pass; and he sent and signified it by his angel unto his servant John: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Who bare record of the word (o. logos) of God, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, and of all things that he saw. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Blessed is he that reads, and they that hear the words (o. logos) of this prophecy, and keep those things which are written therein: for the time is at hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be unto you, and peace, from him which is, and which was, and which is to come; and from the seven Spirits (o. pneuma) which are before his throne; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the First-Born of the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. Unto him that loved us, and washed us from our sins in his own blood, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And has made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Behold, he comes with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all families of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the ending, says the Lord, which is, and which was, and which is to come, the Almighty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} I John, who also am your brother, and companion in tribulation, and in the kingdom and patience of Jesus Christ, was in the isle that is called Patmos, for the word (o. logos) of God, and for the testimony of Jesus Christ. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} I was in the Spirit (o. pneuma) on the Lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Saying, I am Alpha and Omega, the first and the last: and, What you see, write in a book, and send it unto the seven churches which are in Asia; unto Ephesus, and unto Smyrna, and unto Pergamos, and unto Thyatira, and unto Sardis, and unto Philadelphia, and unto Laodicea. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the breast with a golden girdle. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp two-edged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shines in his strength. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying unto me, Fear not; I am the first and the last: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} I am he that lives, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Write the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which shall be hereafter; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which you saw are the seven churches.\par
{\notefont\fontsize{6.8}{7.5}\selectfont\noindent{\color{tnaccent}\textit{T: }}\textsuperscript{8} Name of God: Alpha kai to O (ἄλφα καὶ τὸ ὦ) — Alpha and Omega; the beginning and the ending Common English renderings: Alpha and Omega; beginning and the ending. A divine title expressing God’s absolute sovereignty over all history.\par}

\subsection*{Revelation 2}
\markright{REVELATION 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write; These things says he that holds the seven stars in his right hand, who walks in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} I know your works, and your labour, and your patience, and how you can not bear them which are evil: and you have tried them which say they are apostles, and are not, and have found them liars: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And have borne, and have patience, and for my name's sake have laboured, and have not fainted. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Nevertheless I have somewhat against you, because you have left your first love. (o. agape) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Remember therefore from whence you are fallen, and repent, and do the first works; or else I will come unto you quickly, and will remove your candlestick out of his place, except you repent. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} But this you have, that you hate the deeds of the Nicolaitanes, which I also hate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit (o. pneuma) says unto the churches; To him that overcomes will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And unto the angel of the church in Smyrna write; These things says the first and the last, which was dead, and is alive; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} I know your works, and tribulation, and poverty, (but you are rich) and I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Fear none of those things which you shall suffer: behold, the devil shall cast some of you into prison, that all of you may be tried; and all of you shall have tribulation ten days: be you faithful unto death, and I will give you a crown of life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit (o. pneuma) says unto the churches; He that overcomes shall not be hurt of the second death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write; These things says he which has the sharp sword with two edges; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} I know your works, and where you dwell, even where Satan's seat is: and you hold fast my name, and have not denied my faith, even in those days wherein Antipas was my faithful martyr, who was slain among you, where Satan dwells. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} But I have a few things against you, because you have there them that hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to cast a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed unto idols, and to commit fornication. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} So have you also them that hold the doctrine of the Nicolaitanes, which thing I hate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Repent; or else I will come unto you quickly, and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit (o. pneuma) says unto the churches; To him that overcomes will I give to eat of the hidden manna, and will give him a white stone, and in the stone a new name written, which no man knows saving he that receives it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And unto the angel of the church in Thyatira write; These things says the Son of God, who has his eyes like unto a flame of fire, and his feet are like fine brass; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} I know your works, and love, (o. agape) and service, and faith, and your patience, and your works; and the last to be more than the first. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Notwithstanding I have a few things against you, because you suffer that woman Jezebel, which calls herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication, and to eat things sacrificed unto idols. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And I gave her space to repent of her fornication; and she repented not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And I will kill her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he which searches the reins and hearts: and I will give unto every one of you according to your works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} But unto you I say, and unto the rest in Thyatira, as many as have not this doctrine, and which have not known the depths of Satan, as they speak; I will put upon you no other burden. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} But that which all of you have already hold fast till I come. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And he that overcomes, and keeps my works unto the end, to him will I give power over the nations: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And he shall rule them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers: even as I received of my Father. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And I will give him the morning star. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit (o. pneuma) says unto the churches.\par

\subsection*{Revelation 3}
\markright{REVELATION 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And unto the angel of the church in Sardis write; These things says he that has the seven Spirits (o. pneuma) of God, and the seven stars; I know your works, that you have a name that you live, and are dead. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Be watchful, and strengthen the things which remain, that are ready to die: for I have not found your works perfect before God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Remember therefore how you have received and heard, and hold fast, and repent. If therefore you shall not watch, I will come on you as a thief, and you shall not know what hour I will come upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} You have a few names even in Sardis which have not defiled their garments; and they shall walk with me in white: for they are worthy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} He that overcomes, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit (o. pneuma) says unto the churches. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write; These things says he that is holy, he that is true, he that has the key of David, he that opens, and no man shuts; and shuts, and no man opens; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I know your works: behold, I have set before you an open door, and no man can shut it: for you have a little strength, and have kept my word, (o. logos) and have not denied my name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Behold, I will make them of the synagogue of Satan, which say they are Jews, and are not, but do lie; behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Because you have kept the word (o. logos) of my patience, I also will keep you from the hour of temptation, which shall come upon all the world, to try them that dwell upon the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Behold, I come quickly: hold that fast which you have, that no man take your crown. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Him that overcomes will I make a pillar in the temple of my God, and he shall go no more out: and I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit (o. pneuma) says unto the churches. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And unto the angel of the church of the Laodiceans write; These things says the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the beginning of the creation of God; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot: I would you were cold or hot. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} So then because you are lukewarm, and neither cold nor hot, I will spew you out of my mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Because you says, I am rich, and increased with goods, and have need of nothing; and know not that you are wretched, and miserable, and poor, and blind, and naked: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} I counsel you to buy of me gold tried in the fire, that you may be rich; and white raiment, that you may be clothed, and that the shame of your nakedness do not appear; and anoint yours eyes with eye salve, that you may see. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} As many as I love, I rebuke and chasten: be zealous therefore, and repent. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him, and will sup with him, and he with me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} To him that overcomes will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} He that has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit (o. pneuma) says unto the churches.\par

\subsection*{Revelation 4}
\markright{REVELATION 4}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} After this I looked, and, behold, a door was opened in heaven: and the first voice which I heard was as it were of a trumpet talking with me; which said, Come up here, and I will show you things which must be hereafter. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And immediately I was in the spirit: (o. pneuma) and, behold, a throne was set in heaven, and one sat on the throne. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And he that sat was to look upon like a jasper and a sardine stone: and there was a rainbow round about the throne, in sight like unto an emerald. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And round about the throne were four and twenty seats: and upon the seats I saw four and twenty elders sitting, clothed in white raiment; and they had on their heads crowns of gold. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And out of the throne proceeded lightnings and thunderings and voices: and there were seven lamps of fire burning before the throne, which are the seven Spirits (o. pneuma) of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And before the throne there was a sea of glass like unto crystal: and in the midst of the throne, and round about the throne, were four beasts full of eyes before and behind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the first beast was like a lion, and the second beast like a calf, and the third beast had a face as a man, and the fourth beast was like a flying eagle. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, LORD God Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And when those beasts give glory and honour and thanks to him that sat on the throne, who lives for ever and ever, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} The four and twenty elders fall down before him that sat on the throne, and worship him that lives for ever and ever, and cast their crowns before the throne, saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} You are worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for you have created all things, and for your pleasure they are and were created.\par
