{\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} He will send his power, and will destroy them from the face of the earth, and their God shall not deliver them: but we his servants will destroy them as one man; for they are not able to sustain the power of our horses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For with them we will tread them under foot, and their mountains shall be drunken with their blood, and their fields shall be filled with their dead bodies, and their footsteps shall not be able to stand before us, for they shall utterly perish, says king Nabuchodonosor, lord of all the earth: for he said, None of my words shall be in vain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And you, Achior, an hireling of Ammon, which have spoken these words in the day of your iniquity, shall see my face no more from this day, until I take vengeance of this nation that came out of Egypt. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And then shall the sword of my army, and the multitude of them that serve me, pass through your sides, and you shall fall among their slain, when I return. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Now therefore my servants shall bring you back into the hill country, and shall set you in one of the cities of the passages: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And you shall not perish, till you be destroyed with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And if you persuade yourself in your mind that they shall be taken, let not your countenance fall: I have spoken it, and none of my words shall be in vain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Then Holofernes commanded his servants, that waited in his tent, to take Achior, and bring him to Bethulia, and deliver him into the hands of the children of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} So his servants took him, and brought him out of the camp into the plain, and they went from the midst of the plain into the hill country, and came to the fountains that were under Bethulia. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And when the men of the city saw them, they took up their weapons, and went out of the city to the top of the hill: and every man that used a sling kept them from coming up by casting of stones against them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Nevertheless having gotten privily under the hill, they bound Achior, and cast him down, and left him at the foot of the hill, and returned to their lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} But the Israelites descended from their city, and came to him, and loosed him, and brought him to Bethulia, and presented him to the governors of the city: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Which were in those days Ozias the son of Micha, of the tribe of Simeon, and Chabris the son of Gothoniel, and Charmis the son of Melchiel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And they called together all the ancients of the city, and all their youth ran together, and their women, to the assembly, and they set Achior in the midst of all their people. Then Ozias asked him of that which was done. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And he answered and declared to them the words of the council of Holofernes, and all the words that he had spoken in the midst of the princes of Assur, and whatever Holofernes had spoken proudly against the house of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Then the people fell down and worshipped God, and cried to God. saying, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} O Lord God of heaven, behold their pride, and pity the low estate of our nation, and look upon the face of those that are sanctified to you this day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Then they comforted Achior, and praised him greatly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And Ozias took him out of the assembly to his house, and made a feast to the elders; and they called on the God of Israel all that night for help.\par
\subsection*{Judith 7}
\markright{JUDITH 7}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The next day Holofernes commanded all his army, and all his people which were come to take his part, that they should remove their camp against Bethulia, to take beforehand the ascents of the hill country, and to make war against the children of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Then their strong men removed their camps in that day, and the army of the men of war was one hundred and seventy thousand footmen, and twelve thousand horsemen, beside the baggage, and other men that were afoot among them, a very great multitude. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And they camped in the valley near to Bethulia, by the fountain, and they spread themselves in breadth over Dothaim even to Belmaim, and in length from Bethulia to Cynamon, which is over against Esdraelon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Now the children of Israel, when they saw the multitude of them, were greatly troubled, and said every one to his neighbor, Now will these men lick up the face of the earth; for neither the high mountains, nor the valleys, nor the hills, are able to bear their weight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Then every man took up his weapons of war, and when they had kindled fires upon their towers, they remained and watched all that night. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} But in the second day Holofernes brought forth all his horsemen in the sight of the children of Israel which were in Bethulia, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And viewed the passages up to the city, and came to the fountains of their waters, and took them, and set garrisons of men of war over them, and he himself removed toward his people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Then came to him all the chief of the children of Esau, and all the governors of the people of Moab, and the captains of the sea coast, and said, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Let our lord now hear a word, that there be not an overthrow in your army. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For this people of the children of Israel do not trust in their spears, but in the height of the mountains wherein they dwell, because it is not easy to come up to the tops of their mountains. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Now therefore, my lord, fight not against them in battle array, and there shall not so much as one man of your people perish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Remain in your camp, and keep all the men of your army, and let your servants get into their hands the fountain of water, which issues forth of the foot of the mountain: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} For all the inhabitants of Bethulia have their water thence; so shall thirst kill them, and they shall give up their city, and we and our people shall go up to the tops of the mountains that are near, and will camp upon them, to watch that none go out of the city. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} So they and their wives and their children shall be consumed with fire, and before the sword come against them, they shall be overthrown in the streets where they dwell. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Thus shall you render them an evil reward; because they rebelled, and met not your person peaceably. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And these words pleased Holofernes and all his servants, and he appointed to do as they had spoken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} So the camp of the children of Ammon departed, and with them five thousand of the Assyrians, and they pitched in the valley, and took the waters, and the fountains of the waters of the children of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Then the children of Esau went up with the children of Ammon, and camped in the hill country over against Dothaim: and they sent some of them toward the south, and toward the east over against Ekrebel, which is near to Chusi, that is upon the brook Mochmur; and the rest of the army of the Assyrians camped in the plain, and covered the face of the whole land; and their tents and carriages were pitched to a very great multitude. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Then the children of Israel cried to the Lord their God, because their heart failed, for all their enemies had compassed them round about, and there was no way to escape out from among them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Thus all the company of Assur remained about them, both their footmen, chariots, and horsemen, four and thirty days, so that all their vessels of water failed all the inhibitants of Bethulia. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And the cisterns were emptied, and they had not water to drink their fill for one day; for they gave them drink by measure. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Therefore their young children were out of heart, and their women and young men fainted for thirst, and fell down in the streets of the city, and by the passages of the gates, and there was no longer any strength in them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Then all the people assembled to Ozias, and to the chief of the city, both young men, and women, and children, and cried with a loud voice, and said before all the elders, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} God be judge between us and you: for you⌃ have done us great injury, in that you⌃ have not required peace of the children of Assur. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} For now we have no helper: but God has sold us into their hands, that we should be thrown down before them with thirst and great destruction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Now therefore call them to you, and deliver the whole city for a spoil to the people of Holofernes, and to all his army. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} For it is better for us to be made a spoil to them, than to die for thirst: for we will be his servants, that our souls may live, and not see the death of our infants before our eyes, nor our wives nor our children to die. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} We take to witness against you the heaven and the earth, and our God and Lord of our fathers, which punishes us according to our sins and the sins of our fathers, that he do not according as we have said this day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Then there was great weeping with one consent in the midst of the assembly; and they cried to the Lord God with a loud voice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Then said Ozias to them, Brethren, be of good courage, let us yet endure five days, in the which space the Lord our God may turn his mercy toward us; for he will not forsake us utterly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And if these days pass, and there come no help to us, I will do according to your word. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And he dispersed the people, every one to their own charge; and they went to the walls and towers of their city, and sent the women and children into their houses: and they were very low brought in the city.\par
\subsection*{Judith 8}
\markright{JUDITH 8}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Now at that time Judith heard thereof, which was the daughter of Merari, the son of Ox, the son of Joseph, the son of Ozel, the son of Elcia, the son of Ananias, the son of Gedeon, the son of Raphaim, the son of Acitho, the son of Eliu, the son of Eliab, the son of Nathanael, the son of Samael, the son of Salasadal, the son of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And Manasses was her husband, of her tribe and kindred, who died in the barley harvest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For as he stood overseeing them that bound sheaves in the field, the heat came upon his head, and he fell on his bed, and died in the city of Bethulia: and they buried him with his fathers in the field between Dothaim and Balamo. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} So Judith was a widow in her house three years and four months. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And she made her a tent upon the top of her house, and put on sackcloth upon her loins and ware her widow's apparel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And she fasted all the days of her widowhood, save the eves of the sabbaths, and the sabbaths, and the eves of the new moons, and the new moons and the feasts and solemn days of the house of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} She was also of a goodly countenance, and very beautiful to behold: and her husband Manasses had left her gold, and silver, and menservants and maidservants, and cattle, and lands; and she remained upon them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And there was none that gave her an ill word; for she feared God greatly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Now when she heard the evil words of the people against the governor, that they fainted for lack of water; for Judith had heard all the words that Ozias had spoken to them, and that he had sworn to deliver the city to the Assyrians after five days; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Then she sent her waitingwoman, that had the government of all things that she had, to call Ozias and Chabris and Charmis, the ancients of the city. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And they came to her, and she said to them, Hear me now, O you⌃ governors of the inhabitants of Bethulia: for your words that you⌃ have spoken before the people this day are not right, touching this oath which you⌃ made and pronounced between God and you, and have promised to deliver the city to our enemies, unless within these days the Lord turn to help you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And now who are you⌃ that have tempted God this day, and stand instead of God among the children of men? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And now try the Lord Almighty, but you⌃ shall never know any thing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For you⌃ can’t find the depth of the heart of man, neither can you⌃ perceive the things that he thinks: then how can you⌃ search out God, that has made all these things, and know his mind, or comprehend his purpose? Nay, my brethren, provoke not the Lord our God to anger. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For if he will not help us within these five days, he has power to defend us when he will, even every day, or to destroy us before our enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Do not bind the counsels of the Lord our God: for God is not as man, that he may be threatened; neither is he as the son of man, that he should be wavering. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Therefore let us wait for salvation of him, and call upon him to help us, and he will hear our voice, if it please him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} For there arose none in our age, neither is there any now in these days neither tribe, nor family, nor people, nor city among us, which worship gods made with hands, as has been aforetime. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} For the which cause our fathers were given to the sword, and for a spoil, and had a great fall before our enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But we know none other god, therefore we trust that he will not dispise us, nor any of our nation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For if we be taken so, all Judea shall lie waste, and our sanctuary shall be spoiled; and he will require the profanation thereof at our mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And the slaughter of our brethren, and the captivity of the country, and the desolation of our inheritance, will he turn upon our heads among the Gentiles, wherever we shall be in bondage; and we shall be an offense and a reproach to all them that possess us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} For our servitude shall not be directed to favor: but the Lord our God shall turn it to dishonor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Now therefore, O brethren, let us show an example to our brethren, because their hearts depend upon us, and the sanctuary, and the house, and the altar, rest upon us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Moreover let us give thanks to the Lord our God, which tries us, even as he did our fathers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Remember what things he did to Abraham, and how he tried Isaac, and what happened to Jacob in Mesopotamia of Syria, when he kept the sheep of Laban his mother's brother. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} For he has not tried us in the fire, as he did them, for the examination of their hearts, neither has he taken vengeance on us: but the Lord does scourge them that come near to him, to admonish them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Then said Ozias to her, All that you have spoken have you spoken with a good heart, and there is none that may gainsay your words. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} For this is not the first day wherein your wisdom is manifested; but from the beginning of your days all the people have known your understanding, because the disposition of your heart is good. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} But the people were very thirsty, and compelled us to do to them as we have spoken, and to bring an oath upon ourselves, which we will not break. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Therefore now pray you for us, because you are a godly woman, and the Lord will send us rain to fill our cisterns, and we shall faint no more. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Then said Judith to them, Hear me, and I will do a thing, which shall go throughout all generations to the children of our nation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} You⌃ shall stand this night in the gate, and I will go forth with my waitingwoman: and within the days that you⌃ have promised to deliver the city to our enemies the Lord will visit Israel by my hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} But enquire not you⌃ of my act: for I will not declare it to you, till the things be finished that I do. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Then said Ozias and the princes to her, Go in peace, and the Lord God be before you, to take vengeance on our enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} So they returned from the tent, and went to their wards.\par
\subsection*{Judith 9}
\markright{JUDITH 9}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Judith fell upon her face, and put ashes upon her head, and uncovered the sackcloth wherewith she was clothed; and about the time that the incense of that evening was offered in Jerusalem in the house of the Lord Judith cried with a loud voice, and said, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} O Lord God of my father Simeon, to whom you gave a sword to take vengeance of the strangers, who loosened the girdle of a maid to defile her, and revealed the thigh to her shame, and polluted her virginity to her reproach; for you said, It shall not be so; and yet they did so: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Therefore you gave their rulers to be slain, so that they dyed their bed in blood, being deceived, and struck the servants with their lords, and the lords upon their thrones; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And have given their wives for a prey, and their daughters to be captives, and all their spoils to be divided among your dear children; which were moved with your zeal, and abhorred the pollution of their blood, and called upon you for aid: O God, O my God, hear me also a widow. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For you have wrought not only those things, but also the things which fell out before, and which ensued after; you have thought upon the things which are now, and which are to come. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Yes, what things you did determine were ready at hand, and said, Behold, we are here: for all your ways are prepared, and your judgments are in your foreknowledge. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For, behold, the Assyrians are multiplied in their power; they are exalted with horse and man; they glory in the strength of their footmen; they trust in shield, and spear, and bow, and sling; and know not that you are the Lord that break the battles: the Lord is your name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Throw down their strength in your power, and bring down their force in your wrath: for they have purposed to defile your sanctuary, and to pollute the tabernacle where your glorious name rests and to cast down with sword the horn of your altar. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Behold their pride, and send your wrath upon their heads: give into my hand, which am a widow, the power that I have conceived. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Strike by the deceit of my lips the servant with the prince, and the prince with the servant: break down their stateliness by the hand of a woman. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For your power stands not in multitude nor your might in strong men: for you are a God of the afflicted, an helper of the oppressed, an upholder of the weak, a protector of the forlorn, a savior of them that are without hope. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} I pray you, I pray you, O God of my father, and God of the inheritance of Israel, Lord of the heavens and earth, Creator of the waters, king of every creature, hear you my prayer: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And make my speech and deceit to be their wound and stripe, who have purposed cruel things against your covenant, and your hallowed house, and against the top of Sion, and against the house of the possession of your children. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And make every nation and tribe to acknowledge that you are the God of all power and might, and that there is none other that protects the people of Israel but you.\par
\subsection*{Judith 10}
\markright{JUDITH 10}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Now after that she had ceased to cry to the God of Israel, and bad made an end of all these words. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} She rose where she had fallen down, and called her maid, and went down into the house in the which she abode in the sabbath days, and in her feast days, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And pulled off the sackcloth which she had on, and put off the garments of her widowhood, and washed her body all over with water, and anointed herself with precious ointment, and braided the hair of her head, and put on a tire upon it, and put on her garments of gladness, wherewith she was clad during the life of Manasses her husband. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And she took sandals upon her feet, and put about her her bracelets, and her chains, and her rings, and her earrings, and all her ornaments, and decked herself bravely, to allure the eyes of all men that should see her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Then she gave her maid a bottle of wine, and a cruse of oil, and filled a bag with parched corn, and lumps of figs, and with fine bread; so she folded all these things together, and laid them upon her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Thus they went forth to the gate of the city of Bethulia, and found standing there Ozias and the ancients of the city, Chabris and Charmis. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And when they saw her, that her countenance was altered, and her apparel was changed, they wondered at her beauty very greatly, and said to her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} The God, the God of our fathers give you favor, and accomplish your enterprizes to the glory of the children of Israel, and to the exaltation of Jerusalem. Then they worshipped God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And she said to them, Command the gates of the city to be opened to me, that I may go forth to accomplish the things whereof you⌃ have spoken with me. So they commanded the young men to open to her, as she had spoken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And when they had done so, Judith went out, she, and her maid with her; and the men of the city looked after her, until she was gone down the mountain, and till she had passed the valley, and could see her no more. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Thus they went straight forth in the valley: and the first watch of the Assyrians met her, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And took her, and asked her, Of what people are you? and whence come you? and whither go you? And she said, I am a woman of the Hebrews, and am fled from them: for they shall be given you to be consumed: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And I am coming before Holofernes the chief captain of your army, to declare words of truth; and I will show him a way, whereby he shall go, and win all the hill country, without losing the body or life of any one of his men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Now when the men heard her words, and saw her countenance, they wondered greatly at her beauty, and said to her, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} You have saved your life, in that you have hasted to come down to the presence of our lord: now therefore come to his tent, and some of us shall conduct you, until they have delivered you to his hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And when you stand before him, be not afraid in your heart, but show to him according to your word; and he will entreat you well. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Then they chose out of them one hundred men to accompany her and her maid; and they brought her to the tent of Holofernes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Then was there a concourse throughout all the camp: for her coming was noised among the tents, and they came about her, as she stood without the tent of Holofernes, till they told him of her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And they wondered at her beauty, and admired the children of Israel because of her, and every one said to his neighbor, Who would despise this people, that have among them such women? surely it is not good that one man of them be left who being let go might deceive the whole earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And they that lay near Holofernes went out, and all his servants and they brought her into the tent. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Now Holofernes rested upon his bed under a canopy, which was woven with purple, and gold, and emeralds, and precious stones. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} So they showed him of her; and he came out before his tent with silver lamps going before him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And when Judith was come before him and his servants they all marveled at the beauty of her countenance; and she fell down upon her face, and did reverence to him: and his servants took her up.\par
\subsection*{Judith 11}
\markright{JUDITH 11}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then said Holofernes to her, Woman, be of good comfort, fear not in your heart: for I never hurt any that was willing to serve Nabuchodonosor, the king of all the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Now therefore, if your people that dwells in the mountains had not set light by me, I would not have lifted up my spear against them: but they have done these things to themselves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} But now tell me therefore you are fled from them, and are come to us: for you are come for safeguard; be of good comfort, you shall live this night, and hereafter: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For none shall hurt you, but entreat you well, as they do the servants of king Nabuchodonosor my lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Then Judith said to him, Receive the words of your servant, and suffer your handmaid to speak in your presence, and I will declare no lie to my lord this night. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And if you will follow the words of your handmaid, God will bring the thing perfectly to pass by you; and my lord shall not fail of his purposes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} As Nabuchodonosor king of all the earth lives, and as his power lives, who has sent you for the upholding of every living thing: for not only men shall serve him by you, but also the beasts of the field, and the cattle, and the fowls of the air, shall live by your power under Nabuchodonosor and all his house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For we have heard of your wisdom and your policies, and it is reported in all the earth, that you only are excellent in all the kingdom, and mighty in knowledge, and wonderful in feats of war. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Now as concerning the matter, which Achior did speak in your council, we have heard his words; for the men of Bethulia saved him, and he declared to them all that he had spoken to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Therefore, O lord and governor, reject not his word; but lay it up in your heart, for it is true: for our nation shall not be punished, neither can sword prevail against them, except they sin against their God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And now, that my lord be not defeated and frustrate of his purpose, even death is now fallen upon them, and their sin has overtaken them, wherewith they will provoke their God to anger whenever they shall do that which is not fit to be done: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For their food fail them, and all their water is scant, and they have determined to lay hands upon their cattle, and purposed to consume all those things, that God has forbidden them to eat by his laws: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And are resolved to spend the first fruits of the the tenths of wine and oil, which they had sanctified, and reserved for the priests that serve in Jerusalem before the face of our God; the which things it is not lawful for any of the people so much as to touch with their hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For they have sent some to Jerusalem, because they also that dwell there have done the like, to bring them a licence from the senate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Now when they shall bring them word, they will forthwith do it, and they shall be given to you to be destroyed the same day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Therefore I your handmaid, knowing all this, am fled from their presence; and God has sent me to work things with you, whereat all the earth shall be astonished, and whoever shall hear it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For your servant is religious, and serves the God of heaven day and night: now therefore, my lord, I will remain with you, and your servant will go out by night into the valley, and I will pray to God, and he will tell me when they have committed their sins: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And I will come and show it to you: then you shall go forth with all your army, and there shall be none of them that shall resist you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And I will lead you through the midst of Judea, until you come before Jerusalem; and I will set your throne in the midst thereof; and you shall drive them as sheep that have no shepherd, and a dog shall not so much as open his mouth at you: for these things were told me according to my foreknowledge, and they were declared to me, and I am sent to tell you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Then her words pleased Holofernes and all his servants; and they marveled at her wisdom, and said, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} There is not such a woman from one end of the earth to the other, both for beauty of face, and wisdom of words. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Likewise Holofernes said to her. God has done well to send you before the people, that strength might be in our hands and destruction upon them that lightly regard my lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And now you are both beautiful in your countenance, and witty in your words: surely if you do as you have spoken your God shall be my God, and you shall dwell in the house of king Nabuchodonosor, and shall be renowned through the whole earth.\par
\subsection*{Judith 12}
\markright{JUDITH 12}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then he commanded to bring her in where his plate was set; and bade that they should prepare for her of his own meats, and that she should drink of his own wine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And Judith said, I will not eat thereof, lest there be an offense: but provision shall be made for me of the things that I have brought. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Then Holofernes said to her, If your provision should fail, how should we give you the like? for there be none with us of your nation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Then said Judith to him As your soul lives, my lord, your handmaid shall not spend those things that I have, before the Lord work by my hand the things that he has determined. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Then the servants of Holofernes brought her into the tent, and she slept till midnight, and she arose when it was toward the morning watch, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And sent to Holofernes, saving, Let my lord now command that your handmaid may go forth to prayer. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Then Holofernes commanded his guard that they should not stay her: thus she abode in the camp three days, and went out in the night into the valley of Bethulia, and washed herself in a fountain of water by the camp. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And when she came out, she implored the Lord God of Israel to direct her way to the raising up of the children of her people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} So she came in clean, and remained in the tent, until she did eat her meat at evening. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And in the fourth day Holofernes made a feast to his own servants only, and called none of the officers to the banquet. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Then said he to Bagoas the eunuch, who had charge over all that he had, Go now, and persuade this Hebrew woman which is with you, that she come to us, and eat and drink with us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For, behold, it will be a shame for our person, if we shall let such a woman go, not having had her company; for if we draw her not to us, she will laugh us to scorn. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Then went Bagoas from the presence of Holofernes, and came to her, and he said, Let not this fair damsel fear to come to my lord, and to be honored in his presence, and drink wine, and be merry with us and be made this day as one of the daughters of the Assyrians, which serve in the house of Nabuchodonosor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Then said Judith to him, Who am I now, that I should gainsay my lord? surely whatever pleases him I will do speedily, and it shall be my joy to the day of my death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} So she arose, and decked herself with her apparel and all her woman's attire, and her maid went and laid soft skins on the ground for her over against Holofernes, which she had received of Bagoas for her daily use, that she might sit and eat upon them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Now when Judith came in and sat down, Holofernes his heart was ravished with her, and his mind was moved, and he desired greatly her company; for he waited a time to deceive her, from the day that he had seen her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Then said Holofernes to her, Drink now, and be merry with us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} So Judith said, I will drink now, my lord, because my life is magnified in me this day more than all the days since I was born. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Then she took and ate and drank before him what her maid had prepared. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And Holofernes took great delight in her, and drank more wine than he had drunk at any time in one day since he was born.\par
\subsection*{Judith 13}
\markright{JUDITH 13}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Now when the evening was come, his servants made haste to depart, and Bagoas shut his tent without, and dismissed the waiters from the presence of his lord; and they went to their beds: for they were all weary, because the feast had been long. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And Judith was left along in the tent, and Holofernes lying along upon his bed: for he was filled with wine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Now Judith had commanded her maid to stand without her bedchamber, and to wait for her. coming forth, as she did daily: for she said she would go forth to her prayers, and she spoke to Bagoas according to the same purpose. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} So all went forth and none was left in the bedchamber, neither little nor great. Then Judith, standing by his bed, said in her heart, O Lord God of all power, look at this present upon the works of my hands for the exaltation of Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For now is the time to help your inheritance, and to execute your enterprizes to the destruction of the enemies which are risen against us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Then she came to the pillar of the bed, which was at Holofernes' head, and took down his fauchion from thence, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And approached to his bed, and took hold of the hair of his head, and said, Strengthen me, O Lord God of Israel, this day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And she struck twice upon his neck with all her might, and she took away his head from him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And tumbled his body down from the bed, and pulled down the canopy from the pillars; and anon after she went forth, and gave Holofernes his head to her maid; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And she put it in her bag of meat: so they twain went together according to their custom to prayer: and when they passed the camp, they compassed the valley, and went up the mountain of Bethulia, and came to the gates thereof. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Then said Judith afar off, to the watchmen at the gate, Open, open now the gate: God, even our God, is with us, to show his power yet in Jerusalem, and his forces against the enemy, as he has even done this day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Now when the men of her city heard her voice, they made haste to go down to the gate of their city, and they called the elders of the city. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And then they ran all together, both small and great, for it was strange to them that she was come: so they opened the gate, and received them, and made a fire for a light, and stood round about them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Then she said to them with a loud voice, Praise, praise God, praise God, I say, for he has not taken away his mercy from the house of Israel, but has destroyed our enemies by my hands this night. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} So she took the head out of the bag, and showed it, and said to them, behold the head of Holofernes, the chief captain of the army of Assur, and behold the canopy, wherein he did lie in his drunkenness; and the Lord has struck him by the hand of a woman. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} As the Lord lives, who has kept me in my way that I went, my countenance has deceived him to his destruction, and yet has he not committed sin with me, to defile and shame me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Then all the people were wonderfully astonished, and bowed themselves and worshipped God, and said with one accord, Blessed be you, O our God, which have this day brought to nothing the enemies of your people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Then said Ozias to her, O daughter, blessed are you of the most high God above all the women upon the earth; and blessed be the Lord God, which has created the heavens and the earth, which has directed you to the cutting off of the head of the chief of our enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} For this your confidence shall not depart from the heart of men, which remember the power of God for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And God turn these things to you for a perpetual praise, to visit you in good things because you have not spared your life for the affliction of our nation, but have revenged our ruin, walking a straight way before our God. And all the people said; So be it, so be it.\par
\subsection*{Judith 14}
\markright{JUDITH 14}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then said Judith to them, Hear me now, my brethren, and take this head, and hang it upon the highest place of your walls. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And so soon as the morning shall appear, and the sun shall come forth upon the earth, take you⌃ every one his weapons, and go forth every valiant man out of the city, and set you⌃ a captain over them, as though you⌃ would go down into the field toward the watch of the Assyrians; but go not down. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Then they shall take their armor, and shall go into their camp, and raise up the captains of the army of Assur, and shall run to the tent of Holofernes, but shall not find him: then fear shall fall upon them, and they shall flee before your face. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} So you⌃, and all that inhabit the coast of Israel, shall pursue them, and overthrow them as they go. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} But before you⌃ do these things, call me Achior the Ammonite, that he may see and know him that despised the house of Israel, and that sent him to us as it were to his death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Then they called Achior out of the house of Ozias; and when he was come, and saw the head of Holofernes in a man's hand in the assembly of the people, he fell down on his face, and his spirit failed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} But when they had recovered him, he fell at Judith's feet, and reverenced her, and said, Blessed are you in all the tabernacles of Juda, and in all nations, which hearing your name shall be astonished. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Now therefore tell me all the things that you have done in these days. Then Judith declared to him in the midst of the people all that she had done, from the day that she went forth until that hour she spoke to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And when she had left off speaking, the people shouted with a loud voice, and made a joyful noise in their city. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And when Achior had seen all that the God of Israel had done, he believed in God greatly, and circumcised the flesh of his foreskin, and was joined to the house of Israel to this day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And as soon as the morning arose, they hanged the head of Holofernes upon the wall, and every man took his weapons, and they went forth by bands to the straits of the mountain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} But when the Assyrians saw them, they sent to their leaders, which came to their captains and tribunes, and to every one of their rulers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} So they came to Holofernes' tent, and said to him that had the charge of all his things, Waken now our lord: for the slaves have been bold to come down against us to battle, that they may be utterly destroyed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Then went in Bagoas, and knocked at the door of the tent; for he thought that he had slept with Judith. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} But because none answered, he opened it, and went into the bedchamber, and found him cast upon the floor dead, and his head was taken from him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Therefore he cried with a loud voice, with weeping, and sighing, and a mighty cry, and tore his garments. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} After he went into the tent where Judith lodged: and when he found her not, he leaped out to the people, and cried, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} These slaves have dealt treacherously; one woman of the Hebrews has brought shame upon the house of king Nabuchodonosor: for, behold, Holofernes lies upon the ground without a head. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} When the captains of the Assyrians' army heard these words, they tore their coats and their minds were wonderfully troubled, and there was a cry and a very great noise throughout the camp.\par
\subsection*{Judith 15}
\markright{JUDITH 15}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And when they that were in the tents heard, they were astonished at the thing that was done. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And fear and trembling fell upon them, so that there was no man that dared abide in the sight of his neighbor, but rushing out all together, they fled into every way of the plain, and of the hill country. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} They also that had camped in the mountains round about Bethulia fled away. Then the children of Israel, every one that was a warrior among them, rushed out upon them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Then sent Ozias to Betomasthem, and to Bebai, and Chobai, and Cola and to all the coasts of Israel, such as should tell the things that were done, and that all should rush forth upon their enemies to destroy them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Now when the children of Israel heard it, they all fell upon them with one consent, and killed them to Chobai: likewise also they that came from Jerusalem, and from all the hill country, (for men had told them what things were done in the camp of their enemies) and they that were in Galaad, and in Galilee, chased them with a great slaughter, until they were past Damascus and the borders thereof. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And the residue that lived at Bethulia, fell upon the camp of Assur, and spoiled them, and were greatly enriched. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the children of Israel that returned from the slaughter had that which remained; and the villages and the cities, that were in the mountains and in the plain, got many spoils: for the multitude was very great. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Then Joacim the high priest, and the ancients of the children of Israel that lived in Jerusalem, came to behold the good things that God had showed to Israel, and to see Judith, and to salute her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And when they came to her, they blessed her with one accord, and said to her, You are the exaltation of Jerusalem, you are the great glory of Israel, you are the great rejoicing of our nation: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} You have done all these things by your hand: you have done much good to Israel, and God is pleased therewith: blessed be you of the Almighty Lord for evermore. And all the people said, So be it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And the people spoiled the camp the space of thirty days: and they gave to Judith Holofernes his tent, and all his plate, and beds, and vessels, and all his stuff: and she took it and laid it on her mule; and made ready her carts, and laid them thereon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Then all the women of Israel ran together to see her, and blessed her, and made a dance among them for her: and she took branches in her hand, and gave also to the women that were with her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And they put a garland of olive upon her and her maid that was with her, and she went before all the people in the dance, leading all the women: and all the men of Israel followed in their armor with garlands, and with songs in their mouths.\par
\subsection*{Judith 16}
\markright{JUDITH 16}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then Judith began to sing this thanksgiving in all Israel, and all the people sang after her this song of praise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And Judith said, Begin to my God with timbrels, sing to my Lord with cymbals: tune to him a new psalm: exalt him, and call upon his name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For God breaks the battles: for among the camps in the midst of the people he has delivered me out of the hands of them that persecuted me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Assur came out of the mountains from the north, he came with ten thousands of his army, the multitude whereof stopped the torrents, and their horsemen have covered the hills. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} He bragged that he would burn up my borders, and kill my young men with the sword, and dash the sucking children against the ground, and make my infants as a prey, and my virgins as a spoil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} But the Almighty Lord has disappointed them by the hand of a woman. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For the mighty one did not fall by the young men, neither did the sons of the Titans strike him, nor high giants set upon him: but Judith the daughter of Merari weakened him with the beauty of her countenance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For she put off the garment of her widowhood for the exaltation of those that were oppressed in Israel, and anointed her face with ointment, and bound her hair in a tire, and took a linen garment to deceive him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Her sandals ravished his eyes, her beauty took his mind prisoner, and the fauchion passed through his neck. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} The Persians quaked at her boldness, and the Medes were daunted at her hardiness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Then my afflicted shouted for joy, and my weak ones cried aloud; but they were astonished: these lifted up their voices, but they were overthrown. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} The sons of the damsels have pierced them through, and wounded them as fugatives' children: they perished by the battle of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} I will sing to the Lord a new song: O Lord, you are great and glorious, wonderful in strength, and invincible. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Let all creatures serve you: for you spoke, and they were made, you did send forth your spirit, and it created them, and there is none that can resist your voice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For the mountains shall be moved from their foundations with the waters, the rocks shall melt as wax at your presence: yet you are merciful to them that fear you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} For all sacrifice is too little for a sweet savor to you, and all the fat is not sufficient for your burnt offering: but he that fears the Lord is great at all times. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Woe to the nations that rise up against my kindred! the Lord Almighty will take vengeance of them in the day of judgment, in putting fire and worms in their flesh; and they shall feel them, and weep for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Now as soon as they entered into Jerusalem, they worshipped the Lord; and as soon as the people were purified, they offered their burnt offerings, and their free offerings, and their gifts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Judith also dedicated all the stuff of Holofernes, which the people had given her, and gave the canopy, which she had taken out of his bedchamber, for a gift to the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} So the people continued feasting in Jerusalem before the sanctuary for the space of three months and Judith remained with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} After this time every one returned to his own inheritance, and Judith went to Bethulia, and remained in her own possession, and was in her time honorable in all the country. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And many desired her, but none knew her all the days of her life, after that Manasses her husband was dead, and was gathered to his people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} But she increased more and more in honor, and waxed old in her husband's house, being one hundred and five years old, and made her maid free; so she died in Bethulia: and they buried her in the cave of her husband Manasses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And the house of Israel lamented her seven days: and before she died, she did distribute her goods to all them that were nearest of kindred to Manasses her husband, and to them that were the nearest of her kindred. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And there was none that made the children of Israel any more afraid in the days of Judith, nor a long time after her death.\par

\section*{Wisdom Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} Traditionally Solomon in literary voice; actually anonymous Jewish wisdom author\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} The book speaks in Solomonic voice, but most scholarship sees an anonymous Jewish author writing in Greek.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} No NT attribution identifies the human writer; the book is included here as part of the Brenton/Apocrypha corpus.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} late 1st century BC\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} Not applicable\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} Greek is the original language and the primary textual form.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Hellenistic Jewish wisdom work, likely from Alexandria, exalting righteousness, wisdom, and God's rule in history.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To commend divine wisdom, righteousness, and hope beyond death in a Hellenistic setting.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} wisdom; righteousness; immortality; exodus typology; idolatry critique\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Wisdom and righteous hope 1-5; praise of wisdom 6-9; wisdom in history 10-19.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. No Hebrew original is known n/a | Subst. Greek text is primary and original Hellenistic period | Heb. n/a n/a | Gk. Codex Vaticanus and Alexandrinus preserve Greek Wisdom 4th-5th century AD\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Used by early Christian writers by Church fathers (2nd-4th centuries AD)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} Because Greek is original, textual work centers on the Greek tradition rather than MT/LXX comparison.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} Included as Greek Jewish wisdom literature within the Brenton corpus, with its non-Hebrew-canonical status made explicit.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{Wisdom of Solomon}
\markboth{WISDOM OF SOLOMON}{}
\subsection*{Wisdom of Solomon 1}
\markright{WISDOM OF SOLOMON 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Love righteousness, you⌃ that be judges of the earth: think of the Lord with a good (heart,) and in simplicity of heart seek him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} For he will be found of them that tempt him not; and shows himself to such as do not distrust him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} For froward thoughts separate from God: and his power, when it is tried, reproves the unwise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For into a malicious soul wisdom shall not enter; nor dwell in the body that is subject to sin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For the holy spirit of discipline will flee deceit, and remove from thoughts that are without understanding, and will not abide when unrighteousness comes in. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} For wisdom is a loving spirit; and will not acquit a blasphemer of his words: for God is witness of his reins, and a true beholder of his heart, and a hearer of his tongue. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For the Spirit of the Lord fills the world: and that which contains all things has knowledge of the voice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Therefore he that speaks unrighteous things can’t be hid: neither shall vengeance, when it punishes, pass by him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For inquisition shall be made into the counsels of the ungodly: and the sound of his words shall come to the Lord for the manifestation of his wicked deeds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For the ear of jealousy hears all things: and the noise of murmurings is not hid. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Therefore beware of murmuring, which is unprofitable; and refrain your tongue from backbiting: for there is no word so secret, that shall go for nothing: and the mouth that belies slays the soul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Seek not death in the error of your life: and pull not upon yourselves destruction with the works of your hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} For God made not death: neither has he pleasure in the destruction of the living. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For he created all things, that they might have their being: and the generations of the world were healthful; and there is no poison of destruction in them, nor the kingdom of death upon the earth: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} (For righteousness is immortal:) {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} But ungodly men with their works and words called it to them: for when they thought to have it their friend, they consumed to nothing, and made a covenant with it, because they are worthy to take part with it.\par
\subsection*{Wisdom of Solomon 2}
\markright{WISDOM OF SOLOMON 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} For the ungodly said, reasoning with themselves, but not aright, Our life is short and tedious, and in the death of a man there is no remedy: neither was there any man known to have returned from the grave. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} For we are born at all adventure: and we shall be hereafter as though we had never been: for the breath in our nostrils is as smoke, and a little spark in the moving of our heart: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Which being extinguished, our body shall be turned into ashes, and our spirit shall vanish as the soft air, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And our name shall be forgotten in time, and no man shall have our works in remembrance, and our life shall pass away as the trace of a cloud, and shall be dispersed as a mist, that is driven away with the beams of the sun, and overcome with the heat thereof. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For our time is a very shadow that passes away; and after our end there is no returning: for it is fast sealed, so that no man comes again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Come on therefore, let us enjoy the good things that are present: and let us speedily use the creatures like as in youth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Let us fill ourselves with costly wine and ointments: and let no flower of the spring pass by us: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Let us crown ourselves with rosebuds, before they be withered: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Let none of us go without his part of our voluptuousness: let us leave tokens of our joyfulness in every place: for this is our portion, and our lot is this. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Let us oppress the poor righteous man, let us not spare the widow, nor reverence the ancient gray hairs of the aged. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Let our strength be the law of justice: for that which is feeble is found to be nothing worth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Therefore let us lie in wait for the righteous; because he is not for our turn, and he is clean contrary to our doings: he upbraids us with our offending the law, and objects to our infamy the transgressings of our education. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} He professes to have the knowledge of God: and he calls himself the child of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} He was made to reprove our thoughts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} He is grievous to us even to behold: for his life is not like other men's, his ways are of another fashion. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} We are esteemed of him as counterfeits: he abstains from our ways as from filthiness: he pronounces the end of the just to be blessed, and makes his boast that God is his father. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Let us see if his words be true: and let us prove what shall happen in the end of him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} For if the just man be the son of God, he will help him, and deliver him from the hand of his enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Let us examine him with despitefulness and torture, that we may know his meekness, and prove his patience. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Let us condemn him with a shameful death: for by his own saying he shall be respected. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Such things they did imagine, and were deceived: for their own wickedness has blinded them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} As for the mysteries of God, they knew them not: neither hoped they for the wages of righteousness, nor discerned a reward for blameless souls. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} For God created man to be immortal, and made him to be an image of his own eternity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Nevertheless through envy of the devil came death into the world: and they that do hold of his side do find it.\par
\subsection*{Wisdom of Solomon 3}
\markright{WISDOM OF SOLOMON 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of God, and there shall no torment touch them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} In the sight of the unwise they seemed to die: and their departure is taken for misery, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And their going from us to be utter destruction: but they are in peace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For though they be punished in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And having been a little chastised, they shall be greatly rewarded: for God proved them, and found them worthy for himself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} As gold in the furnace has he tried them, and received them as a burnt offering. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} They shall judge the nations, and have dominion over the people, and their Lord shall reign for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} They that put their trust in him shall understand the truth: and such as be faithful in love shall abide with him: for grace and mercy is to his saints, and he has care for his elect. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} But the ungodly shall be punished according to their own imaginations, which have neglected the righteous, and forsaken the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For whoso despises wisdom and nurture, he is miserable, and their hope is vain, their labors unfruitful, and their works unprofitable: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Their wives are foolish, and their children wicked: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Their offspring is cursed. Therefore blessed is the barren that is undefiled, which has not known the sinful bed: she shall have fruit in the visitation of souls. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And blessed is the eunuch, which with his hands has wrought no iniquity, nor imagined wicked things against God: for to him shall be given the special gift of faith, and an inheritance in the temple of the Lord more acceptable to his mind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For glorious is the fruit of good labors: and the root of wisdom shall never fall away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} As for the children of adulterers, they shall not come to their perfection, and the seed of an unrighteous bed shall be rooted out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For though they live long, yet shall they be nothing regarded: and their last age shall be without honor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Or, if they die quickly, they have no hope, neither comfort in the day of trial. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} For horrible is the end of the unrighteous generation.\par
\subsection*{Wisdom of Solomon 4}
\markright{WISDOM OF SOLOMON 4}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Better it is to have no children, and to have virtue: for the memorial thereof is immortal: because it is known with God, and with men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} When it is present, men take example at it; and when it is gone, they desire it: it wears a crown, and triumphs for ever, having gotten the victory, striving for undefiled rewards. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} But the multiplying brood of the ungodly shall not thrive, nor take deep rooting from bastard slips, nor lay any fast foundation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For though they flourish in branches for a time; yet standing not last, they shall be shaken with the wind, and through the force of winds they shall be rooted out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} The imperfect branches shall be broken off, their fruit unprofitable, not ripe to eat, yes, meet for nothing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} For children begotten of unlawful beds are witnesses of wickedness against their parents in their trial. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} But though the righteous be prevented with death, yet shall he be in rest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For honorable age is not that which stands in length of time, nor that is measured by number of years. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} But wisdom is the gray hair to men, and an unspotted life is old age. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} He pleased God, and was beloved of him: so that living among sinners he was translated. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Yes speedily was he taken away, lest that wickedness should alter his understanding, or deceit decieve his soul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} For the bewitching of naughtiness does obscure things that are honest; and the wandering of concupiscence does undermine the simple mind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} He, being made perfect in a short time, fulfilled a long time: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For his soul pleased the Lord: therefore hasted he to take him away from among the wicked. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} This the people saw, and understood it not, neither laid they up this in their minds, That his grace and mercy is with his saints, and that he has respect to his chosen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Thus the righteous that is dead shall condemn the ungodly which are living; and youth that is soon perfected the many years and old age of the unrighteous. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For they shall see the end of the wise, and shall not understand what God in his counsel has decreed of him, and to what end the Lord has set him in safety. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} They shall see him, and despise him; but God shall laugh them to scorn: and they shall hereafter be a vile carcass, and a reproach among the dead for evermore. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} For he shall rend them, and cast them down headlong, that they shall be speechless; and he shall shake them from the foundation; and they shall be utterly laid waste, and be in sorrow; and their memorial shall perish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And when they cast up the accounts of their sins, they shall come with fear: and their own iniquities shall convince them to their face.\par
\subsection*{Wisdom of Solomon 5}
\markright{WISDOM OF SOLOMON 5}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then shall the righteous man stand in great boldness before the face of such as have afflicted him, and made no account of his labors. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} When they see it, they shall be troubled with terrible fear, and shall be amazed at the strangeness of his salvation, so far beyond all that they looked for. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And they repenting and groaning for anguish of spirit shall say within themselves, This was he, whom we had sometimes in derision, and a proverb of reproach: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} We fools accounted his life madness, and his end to be without honor: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} How is he numbered among the children of God, and his lot is among the saints! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Therefore have we erred from the way of truth, and the light of righteousness has not shined to us, and the sun of righteousness rose not upon us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} We wearied ourselves in the way of wickedness and destruction: yes, we have gone through deserts, where there lay no way: but as for the way of the Lord, we have not known it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} What has pride profited us? or what good has riches with our vaunting brought us? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} All those things are passed away like a shadow, and as a post that hasted by; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And as a ship that passes over the waves of the water, which when it is gone by, the trace thereof can’t be found, neither the pathway of the keel in the waves; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Or as when a bird has flown through the air, there is no token of her way to be found, but the light air being beaten with the stroke of her wings and parted with the violent noise and motion of them, is passed through, and therein afterwards no sign where she went is to be found;
