\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} My son, if you come to serve the Lord, prepare your soul for temptation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Set your heart aright, and constantly endure, and make not haste in time of trouble. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Cleave to him, and depart not away, that you may be increased at your last end. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Whatsoever is brought upon you take cheerfully, and be patient when you are changed to a low estate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For gold is tried in the fire, and acceptable men in the furnace of adversity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Believe in him, and he will help you; order your way aright, and trust in him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} You⌃ that fear the Lord, wait for his mercy; and go not aside, lest you⌃ fall. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} You⌃ that fear the Lord, believe him; and your reward shall not fail. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} You⌃ that fear the Lord, hope for good, and for everlasting joy and mercy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Look at the generations of old, and see; did ever any trust in the Lord, and was confounded? or did any abide in his fear, and was forsaken? or whom did he ever despise, that called upon him? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For the Lord is full of compassion and mercy, longsuffering, and very pitiful, and forgives sins, and saves in time of affliction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Woe be to fearful hearts, and faint hands, and the sinner that goes two ways! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Woe to him that is faint-hearted! for he believes not; therefore shall he not be defended. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Woe to you that have lost patience! and what will you⌃ do when the Lord shall visit you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} They that fear the Lord will not disobey his Word; and they that love him will keep his ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} They that fear the Lord will seek that which is well, pleasing to him; and they that love him shall be filled with the law. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} They that fear the Lord will prepare their hearts, and humble their souls in his sight, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Saying, We will fall into the hands of the Lord, and not into the hands of men: for as his majesty is, so is his mercy.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 3}
\markright{SIRACH 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Hear me your father, O children, and do thereafter, that you⌃ may be safe. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} For the Lord has given the father honor over the children, and has confirmed the authority of the mother over the sons. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Whoso honors his father makes an atonement for his sins: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And he that honors his mother is as one that lays up treasure. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Whoso honors his father shall have joy of his own children; and when he makes his prayer, he shall be heard. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} He that honors his father shall have a long life; and he that is obedient to the Lord shall be a comfort to his mother. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} He that fears the Lord will honor his father, and will do service to his parents, as to his masters. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Honor your father and mother both in word and deed, that a blessing may come upon you from them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For the blessing of the father establishes the houses of children; but the curse of the mother roots out foundations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Glory not in the dishonor of your father; for your father's dishonor is no glory to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For the glory of a man is from the honor of his father; and a mother in dishonor is a reproach to the children. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} My son, help your father in his age, and grieve him not as long as he lives. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And if his understanding fail, have patience with him; and despise him not when you are in your full strength. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For the relieving of your father shall not be forgotten: and instead of sins it shall be added to build you up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} In the day of your affliction it shall be remembered; your sins also shall melt away, as the ice in the fair warm weather. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} He that forsakes his father is as a blasphemer; and he that angers his mother is cursed: of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} My son, go on with your business in meekness; so shall you be beloved of him that is approved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} The greater you are, the more humble yourself, and you shall find favor before the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Many are in high place, and of renown: but mysteries are revealed to the meek. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} For the power of the Lord is great, and he is honored of the lowly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Seek not out things that are too hard for you, neither search the things that are above your strength. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} But what is commanded you, think thereupon with reverence, for it is not needful for you to see with your eyes the things that are in secret. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Be not curious in unnecessary matters: for more things are showed to you than men understand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} For many are deceived by their own vain opinion; and an evil suspicion has overthrown their judgment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Without eyes you shall lack light: profess not the knowledge therefore that you have not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} A stubborn heart shall fare evil at the last; and he that loves danger shall perish therein. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} An obstinate heart shall be laden with sorrows; and the wicked man shall heap sin upon sin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} In the punishment of the proud there is no remedy; for the plant of wickedness has taken root in him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} The heart of the prudent will understand a parable; and an attentive ear is the desire of a wise man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Water will quench a flaming fire; and alms makes an atonement for sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And he that requites good turns is mindful of that which may come hereafter; and when he falls, he shall find a stay.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 4}
\markright{SIRACH 4}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} My son, defraud not the poor of his living, and make not the needy eyes to wait long. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Make not an hungry soul sorrowful; neither provoke a man in his distress. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Add not more trouble to an heart that is vexed; and defer not to give to him that is in need. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Reject not the supplication of the afflicted; neither turn away your face from a poor man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Turn not away your eye from the needy, and give him none occasion to curse you: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} For if he curse you in the bitterness of his soul, his prayer shall be heard of him that made him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Get yourself the love of the congregation, and bow your head to a great man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Let it not grieve you to bow down your ear to the poor, and give him a friendly answer with meekness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Deliver him that suffers wrong from the hand of the oppressor; and be not faint-hearted when you sit in judgment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Be as a father to the fatherless, and instead of an husband to their mother: so shall you be as the son of the most High, and he shall love you more than your mother does. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Wisdom exalts her children, and lays hold of them that seek her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} He that loves her loves life; and they that seek to her early shall be filled with joy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} He that holds her fast shall inherit glory; and wherever she enters, the Lord will bless. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} They that serve her shall minister to the Holy One: and them that love her the Lord does love. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Whoso gives ear to her shall judge the nations: and he that attends to her shall dwell securely. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} If a man commit himself to her, he shall inherit her; and his generation shall hold her in possession. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For at the first she will walk with him by crooked ways, and bring fear and dread upon him, and torment him with her discipline, until she may trust his soul, and try him by her laws. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Then will she return the straight way to him, and comfort him, and show him her secrets. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} But if he go wrong, she will forsake him, and give him over to his own ruin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Observe the opportunity, and beware of evil; and be not ashamed when it concerns your soul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For there is a shame that brings sin; and there is a shame which is glory and grace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Accept no person against your soul, and let not the reverence of any man cause you to fall. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And refrain not to speak, when there is occasion to do good, and hide not your wisdom in her beauty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} For by speech wisdom shall be known: and learning by the word of the tongue. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} In no wise speak against the truth; but be abashed of the error of your ignorance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Be not ashamed to confess your sins; and force not the course of the river. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Make not yourself an underling to a foolish man; neither accept the person of the mighty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Strive for the truth to death, and the Lord shall fight for you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Be not hasty in your tongue, and in your deeds slack and remiss. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Be not as a lion in your house, nor frantick among your servants. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Let not your hand be stretched out to receive, and shut when you should repay.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 5}
\markright{SIRACH 5}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Set your heart upon your goods; and say not, I have enough for my life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Follow not your own mind and your strength, to walk in the ways of your heart: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And say not, Who shall control me for my works? for the Lord will surely revenge your pride. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Say not, I have sinned, and what harm has happened to me? for the Lord is longsuffering, he will in no wise let you go. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Concerning propitiation, be not without fear to add sin to sin: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And say not His mercy is great; he will be pacified for the multitude of my sins: for mercy and wrath come from him, and his indignation rests upon sinners. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Make no tarrying to turn to the Lord, and put not off from day to day: for suddenly shall the wrath of the Lord come forth, and in your security you shall be destroyed, and perish in the day of vengeance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Set not your heart upon goods unjustly gotten, for they shall not profit you in the day of calamity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Winnow not with every wind, and go not into every way: for so does the sinner that has a double tongue. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Be stedfast in your understanding; and let your word be the same. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Be swift to hear; and let your life be sincere; and with patience give answer. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} If you have understanding, answer your neighbor; if not, lay your hand upon your mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Honor and shame is in talk: and the tongue of man is his fall. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Be not called a whisperer, and lie not in wait with your tongue: for a foul shame is upon the thief, and an evil condemnation upon the double tongue. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Be not ignorant of any thing in a great matter or a small.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 6}
\markright{SIRACH 6}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Instead of a friend become not an enemy; for [thereby] you shall inherit an ill name, shame, and reproach: even so shall a sinner that has a double tongue. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Extol not yourself in the counsel of your own heart; that your soul be not torn in pieces as a bull [straying alone.] {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} You shall eat up your leaves, and lose your fruit, and leave yourself as a dry tree. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} A wicked soul shall destroy him that has it, and shall make him to be laughed to scorn of his enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Sweet language will multiply friends: and a fairspeaking tongue will increase kind greetings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Be in peace with many: nevertheless have but one counsellor of a thousand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} If you would get a friend, prove him first and be not hasty to credit him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For some man is a friend for his own occasion, and will not abide in the day of your trouble. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And there is a friend, who being turned to enmity, and strife will discover your reproach. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Again, some friend is a companion at the table, and will not continue in the day of your affliction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} But in your prosperity he will be as yourself, and will be bold over your servants. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} If you be brought low, he will be against you, and will hide himself from your face. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Separate yourself from your enemies, and take heed of your friends. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} A faithful friend is a strong defence: and he that has found such an one has found a treasure. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Nothing does countervail a faithful friend, and his excellency is invaluable. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} A faithful friend is the medicine of life; and they that fear the Lord shall find him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Whoso fears the Lord shall direct his friendship aright: for as he is, so shall his neighbor be also. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} My son, gather instruction from your youth up: so shall you find wisdom till your old age. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Come to her as one that plows and sows, and wait for her good fruits: for you shall not toil much in laboring about her, but you shall eat of her fruits right soon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} She is very unpleasant to the unlearned: he that is without understanding will not remain with her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} She will lie upon him as a mighty stone of trial; and he will cast her from him ere it be long. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} For wisdom is according to her name, and she is not manifest to many. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Give ear, my son, receive my advice, and refuse not my counsel, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And put your feet into her fetters, and your neck into her chain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Bow down your shoulder, and bear her, and be not grieved with her bonds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Come to her with your whole heart, and keep her ways with all your power. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Search, and seek, and she shall be made known to you: and when you have got hold of her, let her not go. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} For at the last you shall find her rest, and that shall be turned to your joy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Then shall her fetters be a strong defence for you, and her chains a robe of glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} For there is a golden ornament upon her, and her bands are purple lace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} You shall put her on as a robe of honor, and shall put her about you as a crown of joy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} My son, if you will, you shall be taught: and if you will apply your mind, you shall be prudent. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} If you love to hear, you shall receive understanding: and if you bow your ear, you shall be wise, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Stand in the multitude of the elders; and cleave to him that is wise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Be willing to hear every godly discourse; and let not the parables of understanding escape you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And if you see a man of understanding, get you betimes to him, and let your foot wear the steps of his door. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Let your mind be upon the ordinances of the Lord and meditate continually in his commandments: he shall establish your heart, and give you wisdom at your owns desire.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 7}
\markright{SIRACH 7}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Do no evil, so shall no harm come to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Depart from the unjust, and iniquity shall turn away from you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} My son, sow not upon the furrows of unrighteousness, and you shall not reap them sevenfold. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Seek not of the Lord preeminence, neither of the king the seat of honor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} justify not yourself before the Lord; and boast not of your wisdom before the king. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Seek not to be judge, being not able to take away iniquity; lest at any time you fear the person of the mighty, an stumbling block in the way of your uprightness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Offend not against the multitude of a city, and then you shall not cast yourself down among the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Bind not one sin upon another; for in one you shall not be unpunished. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Say not, God will look upon the multitude of my oblations, and when I offer to the most high God, he will accept it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Be not faint-hearted when you make your prayer, and neglect not to give alms. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Laugh no man to scorn in the bitterness of his soul: for there is one which humbles and exalts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Devise not a lie against your brother; neither do the like to your friend. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Use not to make any manner of lie: for the custom thereof is not good. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Use not many words in a multitude of elders, and make not much babbling when you pray. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Hate not laborious work, neither husbandry, which the most High has ordained. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Number not yourself among the multitude of sinners, but remember that wrath will not wait long. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Humble yourself greatly: for the vengeance of the ungodly is fire and worms. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Change not a friend for any good by no means; neither a faithful brother for the gold of Ophir. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Forego not a wise and good woman: for her grace is above gold. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Whereas your servant works truly, entreat him not evil. nor the hireling that gives himself wholly for you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Let your soul love a good servant, and defraud him not of liberty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Have you cattle? have an eye to them: and if they be for your profit, keep them with you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Have you children? instruct them, and bow down their neck from their youth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Have you daughters? have a care of their body, and show not yourself cheerful toward them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Marry your daughter, and so shall you have performed a weighty matter: but give her to a man of understanding. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Have you a wife after your mind? forsake her not: but give not yourself over to a light woman. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Honor your father with your whole heart, and forget not the sorrows of your mother. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Remember that you were begotten of them; and how can you recompense them the things that they have done for you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Fear the Lord with all your soul, and reverence his priests. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Love him that made you with all your strength, and forsake not his ministers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Fear the Lord, and honor the priest; and give him his portion, as it is commanded you; the first fruits, and the trespass offering, and the gift of the shoulders, and the sacrifice of sanctification, and the first fruits of the holy things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And stretch your hand to the poor, that your blessing may be perfected. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} A gift has grace in the sight of every man living; and for the dead detain it not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Fail not to be with them that weep, and mourn with them that mourn. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Be not slow to visit the sick: fir that shall make you to be beloved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Whatsoever you take in hand, remember the end, and you shall never do amiss.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 8}
\markright{SIRACH 8}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Strive not with a mighty man' lest you fall into his hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Be not at variance with a rich man, lest he overweigh you: for gold has destroyed many, and perverted the hearts of kings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Strive not with a man that is full of tongue, and heap not wood upon his fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Jest not with a rude man, lest your ancestors be disgraced. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Reproach not a man that turns from sin, but remember that we are all worthy of punishment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Dishonour not a man in his old age: for even some of us wax old. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Rejoice not over your greatest enemy being dead, but remember that we die all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Despise not the discourse of the wise, but acquaint yourself with their proverbs: for of them you shall learn instruction, and how to serve great men with ease. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Miss not the discourse of the elders: for they also learned of their fathers, and of them you shall learn understanding, and to give answer as need requires. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Kindle not the coals of a sinner, lest you be burnt with the flame of his fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Rise not up [in anger] at the presence of an injurious person, lest he lie in wait to entrap you in your words {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Lend not to him that is mightier than yourself; for if you lend him, count it but lost. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Be not surety above your power: for if you be surety, take care to pay it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Go not to law with a judge; for they will judge for him according to his honor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Travel not by the way with a bold fellow, lest he become grievous to you: for he will do according to his own will, and you shall perish with him through his folly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Strive not with an angry man, and go not with him into a solitary place: for blood is as nothing in his sight, and where there is no help, he will overthrow you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Consult not with a fool; for he can’t keep counsel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Do no secret thing before a stranger; for you know not what he will bring forth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Open not your heart to every man, lest he requite you with a shrewd turn.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 9}
\markright{SIRACH 9}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Be not jealous over the wife of your bosom, and teach her not an evil lesson against yourself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Give not your soul to a woman to set her foot upon your substance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Meet not with an harlot, lest you fall into her snares. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Use not much the company of a woman that is a singer, lest you be taken with her attempts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Gaze not on a maid, that you fall not by those things that are precious in her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Give not your soul to harlots, that you lose not your inheritance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Look not round about you in the streets of the city, neither wander you in the solitary place thereof. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Turn away your eye from a beautiful woman, and look not upon another's beauty; for many have been deceived by the beauty of a woman; for herewith love is kindled as a fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Sit not at all with another man's wife, nor sit down with her in your arms, and spend not your money with her at the wine; lest your heart incline to her, and so through your desire you fall into destruction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Forsake not an old friend; for the new is not comparable to him: a new friend is as new wine; when it is old, you shall drink it with pleasure. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Envy not the glory of a sinner: for you know not what shall be his end. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Delight not in the thing that the ungodly have pleasure in; but remember they shall not go unpunished to their grave. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Keep you far from the man that has power to kill; so shall you not doubt the fear of death: and if you come to him, make no fault, lest he take away your life presently: remember that you go in the midst of snares, and that you walk upon the battlements of the city. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} As near as you can, guess at your neighbor, and consult with the wise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Let your talk be with the wise, and all your communication in the law of the most High. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And let just men eat and drink with you; and let your glorying be in the fear of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For the hand of the artificer the work shall be commended: and the wise ruler of the people for his speech. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} A man of an ill tongue is dangerous in his city; and he that is rash in his talk shall be hated.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 10}
\markright{SIRACH 10}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} A wise judge will instruct his people; and the government of a prudent man is well ordered. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} As the judge of the people is himself, so are his officers; and what manner of man the ruler of the city is, such are all they that dwell therein. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} An unwise king destroys his people; but through the prudence of them which are in authority the city shall be inhabited. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} The power of the earth is in the hand of the Lord, and in due time he will set over it one that is profitable. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} In the hand of God is the prosperity of man: and upon the person of the scribe shall he lay his honor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Bear not hatred to your neighbor for every wrong; and do nothing at all by injurious practices. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Pride is hateful before God and man: and by both does one commit iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Because of unrighteous dealings, injuries, and riches got by deceit, the kingdom is translated from one people to another. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Why is earth and ashes proud? There is not a more wicked thing than a covetous man: for such an one sets his own soul to sale; because while he lives he casts away his bowels. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} The physician cuts off a long disease; and he that is to day a king to morrow shall die. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} For when a man is dead, he shall inherit creeping things, beasts, and worms. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} The beginning of pride is when one departs from God, and his heart is turned away from his Maker. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} For pride is the beginning of sin, and he that has it shall pour out abomination: and therefore the Lord brought upon them strange calamities, and overthrew them utterly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} The Lord has cast down the thrones of proud princes, and set up the meek in their stead. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} The Lord has plucked up the roots of the proud nations, and planted the lowly in their place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} The Lord overthrew countries of the heathen, and destroyed them to the foundations of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} He took some of them away, and destroyed them, and has made their memorial to cease from the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Pride was not made for men, nor furious anger for them that are born of a woman. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} They that fear the Lord are a sure seed, and they that love him an honorable plant: they that regard not the law are a dishonourable seed; they that transgress the commandments are a deceivable seed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Among brethren he that is chief is honorably; so are they that fear the Lord in his eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} The fear of the Lord goes before the obtaining of authority: but roughness and pride is the losing thereof. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Whether he be rich, noble, or poor, their glory is the fear of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} It is not meet to despise the poor man that has understanding; neither is it convenient to magnify a sinful man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Great men, and judges, and potentates, shall be honored; yet is there none of them greater than he that fears the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} To the servant that is wise shall they that are free do service: and he that has knowledge will not grudge when he is reformed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Be not overwise in doing your business; and boast not yourself in the time of your distress. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Better is he that labores, and abounds in all things, than he that boasts himself, and lacks bread. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} My son, glorify your soul in meekness, and give it honor according to the dignity thereof. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Who will justify him that sins against his own soul? and who will honor him that dishonors his own life? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} The poor man is honored for his skill, and the rich man is honored for his riches. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} He that is honored in poverty, how much more in riches? and he that is dishonourable in riches, how much more in poverty?\par
\subsection*{Sirach 11}
\markright{SIRACH 11}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Wisdom lifts up the head of him that is of low degree, and makes him to sit among great men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Commend not a man for his beauty; neither abhor a man for his outward appearance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} The bee is little among such as fly; but her fruit is the chief of sweet things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Boast not of your clothing and raiment, and exalt not yourself in the day of honor: for the works of the Lord are wonderful, and his works among men are hidden. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Many kings have sat down upon the ground; and one that was never thought of has worn the crown. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Many mighty men have been greatly disgraced; and the honorable delivered into other men's hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Blame not before you have examined the truth: understand first, and then rebuke. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Answer not before you have heard the cause: neither interrupt men in the midst of their talk. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Strive not in a matter that concerns you not; and sit not in judgment with sinners. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} My son, meddle not with many matters: for if you meddle much, you shall not be innocent; and if you follow after, you shall not obtain, neither shall you escape by fleeing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} There is one that labores, and takes pains, and makes haste, and is so much the more behind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Again, there is another that is slow, and has need of help, lacking ability, and full of poverty; yet the eye of the Lord looked upon him for good, and set him up from his low estate, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And lifted up his head from misery; so that many that saw from him is peace over all the {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Prosperity and adversity, life and death, poverty and riches, come of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Wisdom, knowledge, and understanding of the law, are of the Lord: love, and the way of good works, are from him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Error and darkness had their beginning together with sinners: and evil shall wax old with them that glory therein. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} The gift of the Lord remains with the ungodly, and his favor brings prosperity for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} There is that waxes rich by his wariness and pinching, and this his the portion of his reward: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Whereas he says, I have found rest, and now will eat continually of my goods; and yet he knows not what time shall come upon him, and that he must leave those things to others, and die. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Be stedfast in your covenant, and be conversant therein, and wax old in your work. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Marvel not at the works of sinners; but trust in the Lord, and abide in your labor: for it is an easy thing in the sight of the Lord on the sudden to make a poor man rich. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} The blessing of the Lord is in the reward of the godly, and suddenly he makes his blessing flourish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Say not, What profit is there of my service? and what good things shall I have hereafter? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Again, say not, I have enough, and possess many things, and what evil shall I have hereafter? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} In the day of prosperity there is a forgetfulness of affliction: and in the day of affliction there is no more remembrance of prosperity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} For it is an easy thing to the Lord in the day of death to reward a man according to his ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} The affliction of an hour makes a man forget pleasure: and in his end his deeds shall be revealed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Judge none blessed before his death: for a man shall be known in his children. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Bring not every man into your house: for the deceitful man has many trains. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Like as a partridge taken [and kept] in a cage, so is the heart of the proud; and like as a spy, watches he for your fall: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} For he lies in wait, and turns good into evil, and in things worthy praise will lay blame upon you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Of a spark of fire a heap of coals is kindled: and a sinful man lays wait for blood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Take heed of a mischievous man, for he works wickedness; lest he bring upon you a perpetual blot. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Receive a stranger into your house, and he will disturb you, and turn you out of your own.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 12}
\markright{SIRACH 12}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} When you will do good know to whom you do it; so shall you be thanked for your benefits. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Do good to the godly man, and you shall find a recompence; and if not from him, yet from the most High. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} There can no good come to him that is always occupied in evil, nor to him that gives no alms. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Give to the godly man, and help not a sinner. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Do well to him that is lowly, but give not to the ungodly: hold back your bread, and give it not to him, lest he overmaster you thereby: for [else] you shall receive twice as much evil for all the good you shall have done to him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} For the most High hates sinners, and will repay vengeance to the ungodly, and keeps them against the mighty day of their punishment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Give to the good, and help not the sinner. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} A friend can’t be known in prosperity: and an enemy can’t be hidden in adversity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} In the prosperity of a man enemies will be grieved: but in his adversity even a friend will depart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Never trust your enemy: for like as iron rusts, so is his wickedness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Though he humble himself, and go crouching, yet take good heed and beware of him, and you shall be to him as if you had wiped a lookingglass, and you shall know that his rust has not been altogether wiped away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Set him not by you, lest, when he has overthrown you, he stand up in your place; neither let him sit at your right hand, lest he seek to take your seat, and you at the last remember my words, and be pricked therewith. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Who will pity a charmer that is bitten with a serpent, or any such as come near wild beasts? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} So one that goes to a sinner, and is defiled with him in his sins, who will pity? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For a while he will abide with you, but if you begin to fall, he will not wait. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} An enemy speaks sweetly with his lips, but in his heart he imagines how to throw you into a pit: he will weep with his eyes, but if he find opportunity, he will not be satisfied with blood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} If adversity come upon you, you shall find him there first; and though he pretend to help you, yet shall he undermine you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} He will shake his head, and clap his hands, and whisper much, and change his countenance.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 13}
\markright{SIRACH 13}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} He that touches pitch shall be defiled therewith; and he that has fellowship with a proud man shall be like to him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Burden not yourself above your power while you live; and have no fellowship with one that is mightier and richer than yourself: for how agree the kettle and the earthen pot together? for if the one be struck against the other, it shall be broken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} The rich man has done wrong, and yet he threatens withal: the poor is wronged, and he must entreat also. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} If you be for his profit, he will use you: but if you have nothing, he will forsake you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} If you have any thing, he will live with you: yes, he will make you bare, and will not be sorry for it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} If he have need of you, he will deceive you, and smile upon you, and put you in hope; he will speak you fair, and say, What want you? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And he will shame you by his meats, until he have drawn you dry twice or thrice, and at the last he will laugh you to scorn afterward, when he sees you, he will forsake you, and shake his head at you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Beware that you be not deceived and brought down in your jollity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} If you be invited of a mighty man, withdraw yourself, and so much the more will he invite you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Press you not upon him, lest you be put back; stand not far off, lest you be forgotten. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Affect not to be made equal to him in talk, and believe not his many words: for with much communication will he tempt you, and smiling upon you will get out your secrets: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} But cruelly he will lay up your words, and will not spare to do you hurt, and to put you in prison. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Observe, and take good heed, for you walk in peril of your overthrowing: when you hear these things, awake in your sleep. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Love the Lord all your life, and call upon him for your salvation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Every beast loves his like, and every man loves his neighbor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} All flesh consorts according to kind, and a man will cleave to his like. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} What fellowship has the wolf with the lamb? so the sinner with the godly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} What agreement is there between the hyena and a dog? and what peace between the rich and the poor? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} As the wild ass is the lion's prey in the wilderness: so the rich eat up the poor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} As the proud hate humility: so does the rich abhor the poor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} A rich man beginning to fall is held up of his friends: but a poor man being down is thrust away by his friends. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} When a rich man is fallen, he has many helpers: he speaks things not to be spoken, and yet men justify him: the poor man slipped, and yet they rebuked him too; he spoke wisely, and could have no place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} When a rich man speaks, every man holds his tongue, and, look, what he says, they extol it to the clouds: but if the poor man speak, they say, What fellow is this? and if he stumble, they will help to overthrow him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Riches are good to him that has no sin, and poverty is evil in the mouth of the ungodly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} The heart of a man changes his countenance, whether it be for good or evil: and a merry heart makes a cheerful countenance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} A cheerful countenance is a token of a heart that is in prosperity; and the finding out of parables is a wearisome labor of the mind.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 14}
\markright{SIRACH 14}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Blessed is the man that has not slipped with his mouth, and is not pricked with the multitude of sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Blessed is he whose conscience has not condemned him, and who is not fallen from his hope in the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Riches are not comely for a niggard: and what should an envious man do with money? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} He that gathers by defrauding his own soul gathers for others, that shall spend his goods riotously. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} He that is evil to himself, to whom will he be good? he shall not take pleasure in his goods. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} There is none worse than he that envies himself; and this is a recompence of his wickedness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And if he does good, he does it unwillingly; and at the last he will declare his wickedness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} The envious man has a wicked eye; he turns away his face, and despises men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} A covetous man's eye is not satisfied with his portion; and the iniquity of the wicked dries up his soul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} A wicked eye envies [his] bread, and he is a niggard at his table. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} My son, according to your ability do good to yourself, and give the Lord his due offering. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Remember that death will not be long in coming, and that the covenant of the grave is not showed to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Do good to your friend before you die, and according to your ability stretch out your hand and give to him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Defraud not yourself of the good day, and let not the part of a good desire overpass you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Shall you not leave your travails to another? and your labors to be divided by lot? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Give, and take, and sanctify your soul; for there is no seeking of dainties in the grave. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} All flesh waxes old as a garment: for the covenant from the beginning is, You shall die the death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} As of the green leaves on a thick tree, some fall, and some grow; so is the generation of flesh and blood, one comes to an end, and another is born. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Every work rots and consumes away, and the worker thereof shall go withal. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Blessed is the man that does meditate good things in wisdom, and that reasons of holy things by his understanding. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} He that considers her ways in his heart shall also have understanding in her secrets. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Go after her as one that traces, and lie in wait in her ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} He that pries in at her windows shall also listen at her doors. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} He that does lodge near her house shall also fasten a pin in her walls. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} He shall pitch his tent near to her, and shall lodge in a lodging where good things are. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} He shall set his children under her shelter, and shall lodge under her branches. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} By her he shall be covered from heat, and in her glory shall he dwell.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 15}
\markright{SIRACH 15}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} He that fears the Lord will do good, and he that has the knowledge of the law shall obtain her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And as a mother shall she meet him, and receive him as a wife married of a virgin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} With the bread of understanding shall she feed him, and give him the water of wisdom to drink. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} He shall be stayed upon her, and shall not be moved; and shall rely upon her, and shall not be confounded. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} She shall exalt him above his neighbors, and in the midst of the congregation shall she open his mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} He shall find joy and a crown of gladness, and she shall cause him to inherit an everlasting name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} But foolish men shall not attain to her, and sinners shall not see her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} For she is far from pride, and men that are liars can’t remember her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Praise is not seemly in the mouth of a sinner, for it was not sent him of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} For praise shall be uttered in wisdom, and the Lord will prosper it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Say not you, It is through the Lord that I fell away: for you ought not to do the things that he hates. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Say not you, He has caused me to err: for he has no need of the sinful man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} The Lord hates all abomination; and they that fear God love it not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} He himself made man from the beginning, and left him in the hand of his counsel; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} If you will, to keep the commandments, and to perform acceptable faithfulness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} He has set fire and water before you: stretch forth your hand to whether you will. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Before man is life and death; and whether him likes shall be given him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} For the wisdom of the Lord is great, and he is mighty in power, and sees all things: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And his eyes are upon them that fear him, and he knows every work of man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} He has commanded no man to do wickedly, neither has he given any man licence to sin.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 16}
\markright{SIRACH 16}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Desire not a multitude of unprofitable children, neither delight in ungodly sons. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Though they multiply, rejoice not in them, except the fear of the Lord be with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Trust not you in their life, neither respect their multitude: for one that is just is better than a thousand; and better it is to die without children, than to have them that are ungodly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} For by one that has understanding shall the city be replenished: but the kindred of the wicked shall speedily become desolate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Many such things have I seen with my eyes, and my ear has heard greater things than these. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} In the congregation of the ungodly shall a fire be kindled; and in a rebellious nation wrath is set on fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} He was not pacified toward the old giants, who fell away in the strength of their foolishness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Neither spared he the place where Lot sojourned, but abhorred them for their pride. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} He pitied not the people of perdition, who were taken away in their sins: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Nor the six hundred thousand footmen, who were gathered together in the hardness of their hearts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And if there be one stiff-necked among the people, it is marvel if he escape unpunished: for mercy and wrath are with him; he is mighty to forgive, and to pour out displeasure. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} As his mercy is great, so is his correction also: he judges a man according to his works {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} The sinner shall not escape with his spoils: and the patience of the godly shall not be frustrate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Make way for every work of mercy: for every man shall find according to his works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} The Lord hardened Pharaoh, that he should not know him, that his powerful works might be known to the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} His mercy is manifest to every creature; and he has separated his light from the darkness with an adamant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Say not you, I will hide myself from the Lord: shall any remember me from above? I shall not be remembered among so many people: for what is my soul among such an infinite number of creatures? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Behold, the heaven, and the heaven of heavens, the deep, and the earth, and all that therein is, shall be moved when he shall visit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} The mountains also and foundations of the earth be shaken with trembling, when the Lord looks upon them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} No heart can think upon these things worthily: and who is able to conceive his ways? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} It is a tempest which no man can see: for the most part of his works are hid. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Who can declare the works of his justice? or who can endure them? for his covenant is afar off, and the trial of all things is in the end. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} He that lacks understanding will think upon vain things: and a foolish man erring imagines follies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} My son, listen to me, and learn knowledge, and mark my words with your heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} I will show forth doctrine in weight, and declare his knowledge exactly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} The works of the Lord are done in judgment from the beginning: and from the time he made them he disposed the parts thereof. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} He garnished his works for ever, and in his hand are the chief of them to all generations: they neither labor, nor are weary, nor cease from their works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} None of them hinders another, and they shall never disobey his word. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} After this the Lord looked upon the earth, and filled it with his blessings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} With all manner of living things has he covered the face thereof; and they shall return into it again.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 17}
\markright{SIRACH 17}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The Lord created man of the earth, and turned him into it again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} He gave them few days, and a short time, and power also over the things therein. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} He endued them with strength by themselves, and made them according to his image, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And put the fear of man upon all flesh, and gave him dominion over beasts and fowls. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} [They received the use of the five operations of the Lord, and in the sixth place he imparted them understanding, and in the seventh speech, an interpreter of the cogitations thereof.] {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Counsel, and a tongue, and eyes, ears, and a heart, gave he them to understand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Withal he filled them with the knowledge of understanding, and showed them good and evil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} He set his eye upon their hearts, that he might show them the greatness of his works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} He gave them to glory in his marvelous acts for ever, that they might declare his works with understanding. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And the elect shall praise his holy name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Beside this he gave them knowledge, and the law of life for an heritage. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} He made an everlasting covenant with them, and showed them his judgments. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Their eyes saw the majesty of his glory, and their ears heard his glorious voice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And he said to them, Beware of all unrighteousness; and he gave every man commandment concerning his neighbor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Their ways are ever before him, and shall not be hid from his eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Every man from his youth is given to evil; neither could they make to themselves fleshy hearts for stony. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} For in the division of the nations of the whole earth he set a ruler over every people; but Israel is the Lord's portion: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Whom, being his firstborn, he nourishes with discipline, and giving him the light of his love does not forsake him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Therefore all their works are as the sun before him, and his eyes are continually upon their ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} None of their unrighteous deeds are hid from him, but all their sins are before the Lord {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} But the Lord being gracious and knowing his workmanship, neither left nor forsook them, but spared them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} The alms of a man is as a signet with him, and he will keep the good deeds of man as the apple of the eye, and give repentance to his sons and daughters. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Afterwards he will rise up and reward them, and render their recompence upon their heads. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} But to them that repent, he granted them return, and comforted those that failed in patience. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Return to the Lord, and forsake your sins, make your prayer before his face, and offend less. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Turn again to the most High, and turn away from iniquity: for he will lead you out of darkness into the light of health, and hate you abomination vehemently. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Who shall praise the most High in the grave, instead of them which live and give thanks? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Thanksgiving perishes from the dead, as from one that is not: the living and sound in heart shall praise the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} How great is the lovingkindness of the Lord our God, and his compassion to such as turn to him in holiness! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} For all things can’t be in men, because the son of man is not immortal. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} What is brighter than the sun? yet the light thereof fails; and flesh and blood will imagine evil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} He views the power of the height of heaven; and all men are but earth and ashes.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 18}
\markright{SIRACH 18}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} He that lives for ever Hath created all things in general. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The Lord only is righteous, and there is none other but he, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Who governs the world with the palm of his hand, and all things obey his will: for he is the King of all, by his power dividing holy things among them from profane. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} To whom has he given power to declare his works? and who shall find out his noble acts? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Who shall number the strength of his majesty? and who shall also tell out his mercies? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} As for the wondrous works of the Lord, there may nothing be taken from them, neither may any thing be put to them, neither can the ground of them be found out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} When a man has done, then he begins; and when he leaves off, then he shall be doubtful. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} What is man, and whereto serves he? what is his good, and what is his evil? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The number of a man's days at the most are one hundred years. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} As a drop of water to the sea, and a gravelstone in comparison of the sand; so are a thousand years to the days of eternity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Therefore is God patient with them, and pours forth his mercy upon them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} He saw and perceived their end to be evil; therefore he multiplied his compassion. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} The mercy of man is toward his neighbor; but the mercy of the Lord is upon all flesh: he reproves, and nurtures, and teaches and brings again, as a shepherd his flock. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} He has mercy on them that receive discipline, and that diligently seek after his judgments. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} My son, blemish not your good deeds, neither use uncomfortable words when you give any thing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Shall not the dew asswage the heat? so is a word better than a gift. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Behold, is not a word better than a gift? but both are with a gracious man. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} A fool will upbraid churlishly, and a gift of the envious consumes the eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Learn before you speak, and use physick or ever you be sick. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Before judgment examine yourself, and in the day of visitation you shall find mercy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Humble yourself before you be sick, and in the time of sins show repentance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Let nothing hinder you to pay your vow in due time, and defer not until death to be justified. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Before you pray, prepare yourself; and be not as one that tempts the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Think upon the wrath that shall be at the end, and the time of vengeance, when he shall turn away his face. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} When you have enough, remember the time of hunger: and when you are rich, think upon poverty and need. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} From the morning until the evening the time is changed, and all things are soon done before the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} A wise man will fear in every thing, and in the day of sinning he will beware of offense: but a fool will not observe time. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Every man of understanding knows wisdom, and will give praise to him that found her. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} They that were of understanding in sayings became also wise themselves, and poured forth exquisite parables. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Go not after your lusts, but refrain yourself from your appetites. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} If you give your soul the desires that please her, she will make you a laughing stock to your enemies that malign you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Take not pleasure in much good cheer, neither be tied to the expense thereof. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Be not made a beggar by banqueting upon borrowing, when you have nothing in your purse: for you shall lie in wait for your own life, and be talked on.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 19}
\markright{SIRACH 19}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} A laboring man that A is given to drunkenness shall not be rich: and he that contemns small things shall fall by little and little. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Wine and women will make men of understanding to fall away: and he that cleaves to harlots will become impudent. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Moths and worms shall have him to heritage, and a bold man shall be taken away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} He that is hasty to give credit is lightminded; and he that sins shall offend against his own soul. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Whoso takes pleasure in wickedness shall be condemned: but he that resists pleasures crowns his life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} He that can rule his tongue shall live without strife; and he that hates babbling shall have less evil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Rehearse not to another that which is told to you, and you shall fare never the worse. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Whether it be to friend or foe, talk not of other men's lives; and if you can without offense, reveal them not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For he heard and observed you, and when time comes he will hate you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} If you have heard a word, let it die with you;
