for such he will not receive: and trust not to unrighteous sacrifices; for the Lord is judge, and with him is no respect of persons. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} He will not accept any person against a poor man, but will hear the prayer of the oppressed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} He will not despise the supplication of the fatherless; nor the widow, when she pours out her complaint. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Do not the tears run down the widow's cheeks? and is not her cry against him that causes them to fall? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} He that serves the Lord shall be accepted with favor, and his prayer shall reach to the clouds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds: and till it come near, he will not be comforted; and will not depart, till the most High shall behold to judge righteously, and execute judgment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} For the Lord will not be slack, neither will the Mighty be patient toward them, till he have struck in sunder the loins of the unmerciful, and repayed vengeance to the heathen; till he have taken away the multitude of the proud, and broken the sceptre of the unrighteous; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Till he have rendered to every man according to his deeds, and to the works of men according to their devices; till he have judged the cause of his people, and made them to rejoice in his mercy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Mercy is seasonable in the time of affliction, as clouds of rain in the time of drought.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 36}
\markright{SIRACH 36}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Have mercy upon us, O Lord God of all, and behold us: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And send your fear upon all the nations that seek not after you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Lift up your hand against the strange nations, and let them see your power. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} As you were sanctified in us before them: so be you magnified among them before us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And let them know you, as we have known you, that there is no God but only you, O God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Show new signs, and make other strange wonders: glorify your hand and your right arm, that they may set forth your wondrous works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Raise up indignation, and pour out wrath: take away the adversary, and destroy the enemy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Sake the time short, remember the covenant, and let them declare your wonderful works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Let him that escapes be consumed by the rage of the fire; and let them perish that oppress the people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Strike in sunder the heads of the rulers of the heathen, that say, There is none other but we. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Gather all the tribes of Jacob together, and inherit you them, as from the beginning. Though I was the last to wake up, yet I received their inheritance as from the beginning. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} O Lord, have mercy upon the people that is called by your name, and upon Israel, whom you have named your firstborn. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} O be merciful to Jerusalem, your holy city, the place of your rest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Fill Sion with your unspeakable oracles, and your people with your glory: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Give testimony to those that you have possessed from the beginning, and raise up prophets that have been in your name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Reward them that wait for you, and let your prophets be found faithful. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} O Lord, hear the prayer of your servants, according to the blessing of Aaron over your people, that all they which dwell upon the earth may know that you are the Lord, the eternal God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} The belly devours all meats, yet is one meat better than another. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} As the palate tastes various kinds of venison: so does an heart of understanding false speeches. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} A froward heart causes heaviness: but a man of experience will recompense him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} A woman will receive every man, yet is one daughter better than another. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} The beauty of a woman cheers the countenance, and a man loves nothing better. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} If there be kindness, meekness, and comfort, in her tongue, then is not her husband like other men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} He that gets a wife begins a possession, a help like to himself, and a pillar of rest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Where no hedge is, there the possession is spoiled: and he that has no wife will wander up and down mourning. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Who will trust a thief well appointed, that skips from city to city? so [who will believe] a man that has no house, and lodges wherever the night takes him?\par
\subsection*{Sirach 37}
\markright{SIRACH 37}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Every friend says, I am his friend also: but there is a friend, which is only a friend in name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Is it not a grief to death, when a companion and friend is turned to an enemy? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} O wicked imagination, whence came you in to cover the earth with deceit? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} There is a companion, which rejoices in the prosperity of a friend, but in the time of trouble will be against him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} There is a companion, which helps his friend for the belly, and takes up the buckler against the enemy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Forget not your friend in your mind, and be not unmindful of him in your riches. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Every counsellor extols counsel; but there is some that counsels for himself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Beware of a counsellor, and know before what need he has; for he will counsel for himself; lest he cast the lot upon you, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And say to you, Your way is good: and afterward he stand on the other side, to see what shall befall you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Consult not with one that suspects you: and hide your counsel from such as envy you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Neither consult with a woman touching her of whom she is jealous; neither with a coward in matters of war; nor with a merchant concerning exchange; nor with a buyer of selling; nor with an envious man of thankfulness; nor with an unmerciful man touching kindness; nor with the slothful for any work; nor with an hireling for a year of finishing work; nor with an idle servant of much business: listen not to these in any matter of counsel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} But be continually with a godly man, whom you know to keep the commandments of the Lord, whose, mind is according to your mind, and will sorrow with you, if you shall miscarry. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And let the counsel of your own heart stand: for there is no man more faithful to you than it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For a man's mind is sometime wont to tell him more than seven watchmen, that sit above in an high tower. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And above all this pray to the most High, that he will direct your way in truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Let reason go before every enterprise, and counsel before every action. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} The countenance is a sign of changing of the heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Four manner of things appear: good and evil, life and death: but the tongue rules over them continually. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} There is one that is wise and teaches many, and yet is unprofitable to himself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} There is one that shows wisdom in words, and is hated: he shall be destitute of all food. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For grace is not given, him from the Lord, because he is deprived of all wisdom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Another is wise to himself; and the fruits of understanding are commendable in his mouth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} A wise man instructs his people; and the fruits of his understanding fail not. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} A wise man shall be filled with blessing; and all they that see him shall count him happy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} The days of the life of man may be numbered: but the days of Israel are innumerable. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} A wise man shall inherit glory among his people, and his name shall be perpetual. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} My son, prove your soul in your life, and see what is evil for it, and give not that to it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} For all things are not profitable for all men, neither has every soul pleasure in every thing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Be not unsatiable in any dainty thing, nor too greedy upon meats: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} For excess of meats brings sickness, and surfeiting will turn into choler. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} By surfeiting have many perished; but he that takes heed prolongs his life.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 38}
\markright{SIRACH 38}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Honor a physician with the honor due to him for the uses which you⌃ may have of him: for the Lord has created him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} For of the most High comes healing, and he shall receive honor of the king. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} The skill of the physician shall lift up his head: and in the sight of great men he shall be in admiration. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} The Lord has created medicines out of the earth; and he that is wise will not abhor them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Was not the water made sweet with wood, that the virtue thereof might be known? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And he has given men skill, that he might be honored in his marvelous works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} With such does he heal [men,] and takes away their pains. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Of such does the apothecary make a confection; and of his works there is no end; and from him is peace over all the earth, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} My son, in your sickness be not negligent: but pray to the Lord, and he will make you whole. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Leave off from sin, and order your hands aright, and cleanse your heart from all wickedness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Give a sweet savor, and a memorial of fine flour; and make a fat offering, as not being. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Then give place to the physician, for the Lord has created him: let him not go from you, for you have need of him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} There is a time when in their hands there is good success. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For they shall also pray to the Lord, that he would prosper that, which they give for ease and remedy to prolong life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} He that sins before his Maker, let him fall into the hand of the physician. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} My son, let tears fall down over the dead, and begin to lament, as if you had suffered great harm yourself; and then cover his body according to the custom, and neglect not his burial. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Weep bitterly, and make great moan, and use lamentation, as he is worthy, and that a day or two, lest you be evil spoken of: and then comfort yourself for your heaviness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} For of heaviness comes death, and the heaviness of the heart breaks strength. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} In affliction also sorrow remains: and the life of the poor is the curse of the heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Take no heaviness to heart: drive it away, and member the last end. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Forget it not, for there is no turning again: you shall not do him good, but hurt yourself. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Remember my judgment: for your also shall be so; yesterday for me, and to day for you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} When the dead is at rest, let his remembrance rest; and be comforted for him, when his Spirit is departed from him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} The wisdom of a learned man comes by opportunity of leisure: and he that has little business shall become wise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} How can he get wisdom that holds the plow, and that glories in the goad, that drives oxen, and is occupied in their labors, and whose talk is of bullocks? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} He gives his mind to make furrows; and is diligent to give the kine fodder. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} So every carpenter and workmaster, that labores night and day: and they that cut and grave seals, and are diligent to make great variety, and give themselves to counterfeit imagery, and watch to finish a work: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} The smith also sitting by the anvil, and considering the iron work, the vapor of the fire wastes his flesh, and he fights with the heat of the furnace: the noise of the hammer and the anvil is ever in his ears, and his eyes look still upon the pattern of the thing that he makes; he sets his mind to finish his work, and watches to polish it perfectly: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} So does the potter sitting at his work, and turning the wheel about with his feet, who is always carefully set at his work, and makes all his work by number; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} He fashions the clay with his arm, and bows down his strength before his feet; he applies himself to lead it over; and he is diligent to make clean the furnace: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} All these trust to their hands: and every one is wise in his work. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Without these can’t a city be inhabited: and they shall not dwell where they will, nor go up and down: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} They shall not be sought for in publick counsel, nor sit high in the congregation: they shall not sit on the judges' seat, nor understand the sentence of judgment: they can’t declare justice and judgment; and they shall not be found where parables are spoken. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} But they will maintain the state of the world, and [all] their desire is in the work of their craft.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 39}
\markright{SIRACH 39}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} But he that gives his mind to the law of the most High, and is occupied in the meditation thereof, will seek out the wisdom of all the ancient, and be occupied in prophecies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} He will keep the sayings of the renowned men: and where subtle parables are, he will be there also. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} He will seek out the secrets of grave sentences, and be conversant in dark parables. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} He shall serve among great men, and appear before princes: he will travel through strange countries; for he has tried the good and the evil among men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} He will give his heart to resort early to the Lord that made him, and will pray before the most High, and will open his mouth in prayer, and make supplication for his sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} When the great Lord will, he shall be filled with the spirit of understanding: he shall pour out wise sentences, and give thanks to the Lord in his prayer. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} He shall direct his counsel and knowledge, and in his secrets shall he meditate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} He shall show forth that which he has learned, and shall glory in the law of the covenant of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Many shall commend his understanding; and so long as the world endures, it shall not be blotted out; his memorial shall not depart away, and his name shall live from generation to generation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Nations shall show forth his wisdom, and the congregation shall declare his praise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} If he die, he shall leave a greater name than a thousand: and if he live, he shall increase it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Yet have I more to say, which I have thought upon; for I am filled as the moon at the full. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Listen to me, you⌃ holy children, and bud forth as a rose growing by the brook of the field: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And give you⌃ a sweet savor as frankincense, and flourish as a lily, send forth a smell, and sing a song of praise, bless the Lord in all his works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Magnify his name, and show forth his praise with the songs of your lips, and with harps, and in praising him you⌃ shall say after this manner: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} All the works of the Lord are exceeding good, and whatever he commands shall be accomplished in due season. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And none may say, What is this? therefore is that? for at time convenient they shall all be sought out: at his commandment the waters stood as an heap, and at the words of his mouth the receptacles of waters. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} At his commandment is done whatever pleases him; and none can hinder, when he will save. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} The works of all flesh are before him, and nothing can be hid from his eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} He sees from everlasting to everlasting; and there is nothing wonderful before him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} A man need not to say, What is this? therefore is that? for he has made all things for their uses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} His blessing covered the dry land as a river, and watered it as a flood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} As he has turned the waters into saltness: so shall the heathen inherit his wrath. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} As his ways are plain to the holy; so are they stumbling blocks to the wicked. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} For the good are good things created from the beginning: so evil things for sinners. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} The principal things for the whole use of man's life are water, fire, iron, and salt, flour of wheat, honey, milk, and the blood of the grape, and oil, and clothing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} All these things are for good to the godly: so to the sinners they are turned into evil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} There be spirits that are created for vengeance, which in their fury lay on sore strokes; in the time of destruction they pour out their force, and appease the wrath of him that made them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Fire, and hail, and famine, and death, all these were created for vengeance; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Teeth of wild beasts, and scorpions, serpents, and the sword punishing the wicked to destruction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} They shall rejoice in his commandment, and they shall be ready upon earth, when need is; and when their time is come, they shall not transgress his word. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Therefore from the beginning I was resolved, and thought upon these things, and have left them in writing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} All the works of the Lord are good: and he will give every needful thing in due season. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} So that a man can’t say, This is worse than that: for in time they shall all be well approved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And therefore praise you⌃ the Lord with the whole heart and mouth, and bless the name of the Lord.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 40}
\markright{SIRACH 40}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Great travail is created for every man, and an heavy yoke is upon the sons of Adam, from the day that they go out of their mother's womb, till the day that they return to the mother of all things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Their imagination of things to come, and the day of death, [trouble] their thoughts, and [cause] fear of heart; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} From him that sits on a throne of glory, to him that is humbled in earth and ashes; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} From him that wears purple and a crown, to him that is clothed with a linen frock. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Wrath, and envy, trouble, and unquietness, fear of death, and anger, and strife, and in the time of rest upon his bed his night sleep, do change his knowledge. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} A little or nothing is his rest, and afterward he is in his sleep, as in a day of keeping watch, troubled in the vision of his heart, as if he were escaped out of a battle. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} When all is safe, he awakens, and marvels that the fear was nothing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} [Such things happen] to all flesh, both man and beast, and that is sevenfold more upon sinners. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Death, and bloodshed, strife, and sword, calamities, famine, tribulation, and the scourge; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} These things are created for the wicked, and for their sakes came the flood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} All things that are of the earth shall turn to the earth again: and that which is of the waters does return into the sea. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} All bribery and injustice shall be blotted out: but true dealing shall endure for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} The goods of the unjust shall be dried up like a river, and shall vanish with noise, like a great thunder in rain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} While he opens his hand he shall rejoice: so shall transgressors come to nothing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} The children of the ungodly shall not bring forth many branches: but are as unclean roots upon a hard rock. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} The weed growing upon every water and bank of a river shall be pulled up before all grass. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Bountifulness is as a most fruitful garden, and mercifulness endures for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} To labor, and to be content with that a man has, is a sweet life: but he that finds a treasure is above them both. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Children and the building of a city continue a man's name: but a blameless wife is counted above them both. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Wine and musick rejoice the heart: but the love of wisdom is above them both. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} The pipe and the lute make sweet melody: but a pleasant tongue is above them both. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Your eye desires favor and beauty: but more than both corn while it is green. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} A friend and companion never meet amiss: but above both is a wife with her husband. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Brethren and help are against time of trouble: but alms shall deliver more than them both. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Gold and silver make the foot stand sure: but counsel is esteemed above them both. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Riches and strength lift up the heart: but the fear of the Lord is above them both: there is no lack in the fear of the Lord, and it needs not to seek help. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} The fear of the Lord is a fruitful garden, and covers him above all glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} My son, lead not a beggar's life; for better it is to die than to beg. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} The life of him that depends on another man's table is not to be counted for a life; for he pollutes himself with other men's meat: but a wise man well nurtured will beware thereof. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Begging is sweet in the mouth of the shameless: but in his belly there shall burn a fire.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 41}
\markright{SIRACH 41}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} O death, how bitter is the remembrance of you to a man that lives at rest in his possessions, to the man that has nothing to vex him, and that has prosperity in all things: yes, to him that is yet able to receive meat! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} O death, acceptable is your sentence to the needy, and to him whose strength fails, that is now in the last age, and is vexed with all things, and to him that despairs, and has lost patience! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Fear not the sentence of death, remember them that have been before you, and that come after; for this is the sentence of the Lord over all flesh. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And why are you against the pleasure of the most High? there is no inquisition in the grave, whether you have lived ten, or one hundred, or a thousand years. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} The children of sinners are abominable children, and they that are conversant in the dwelling of the ungodly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} The inheritance of sinners' children shall perish, and their posterity shall have a perpetual reproach. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} The children will complain of an ungodly father, because they shall be reproached for his sake. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Woe be to you, ungodly men, which have forsaken the law of the most high God! for if you⌃ increase, it shall be to your destruction: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And if you⌃ be born, you⌃ shall be born to a curse: and if you⌃ die, a curse shall be your portion. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} All that are of the earth shall turn to earth again: so the ungodly shall go from a curse to destruction. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} The mourning of men is about their bodies: but an ill name of sinners shall be blotted out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Have regard to your name; for that shall continue with you above a thousand great treasures of gold. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} A good life has but few days: but a good name endures for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} My children, keep discipline in peace: for wisdom that is hid, and a treasure that is not seen, what profit is in them both? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} A man that hides his foolishness is better than a man that hides his wisdom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Therefore be shamefaced according to my word: for it is not good to retain all shamefacedness; neither is it altogether approved in every thing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Be ashamed of whoredom before father and mother: and of a lie before a prince and a mighty man; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Of an offense before a judge and ruler; of iniquity before a congregation and people; of unjust dealing before your partner and friend; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And of theft in regard of the place where you sojourn, and in regard of the truth of God and his covenant; and to lean with your elbow upon the meat; and of scorning to give and take; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And of silence before them that salute you; and to look upon an harlot; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And to turn away your face from your kinsman; or to take away a portion or a gift; or to gaze upon another man's wife. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Or to be overbusy with his maid, and come not near her bed; or of upbraiding speeches before friends; and after you have given, upbraid not;\par
\subsection*{Sirach 42}
\markright{SIRACH 42}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Or of iterating and speaking again that which you have heard; and of revealing of secrets. So shall you be truly shamefaced and find favor before all men. Of these things be not you ashamed, and accept no person to sin thereby: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Of the law of the most High, and his covenant; and of judgment to justify the ungodly; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Of reckoning with your partners and travellers; or of the gift of the heritage of friends; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Of exactness of balance and weights; or of getting much or little; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And of merchants' indifferent selling; of much correction of children; and to make the side of an evil servant to bleed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Sure keeping is good, where an evil wife is; and shut up, where many hands are. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Deliver all things in number and weight; and put all in writing that you give out, or receive in. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Be not ashamed to inform the unwise and foolish, and the extreme aged that contends with those that are young: thus shall you be truly learned, and approved of all men living. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} A daughter is a wakeful care to a father; and the care for her takes away sleep: when she is young, lest she pass away the flower of her age; and being married, lest she should be hated: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} In her virginity, lest she should be defiled and gotten with child in her father's house; and having an husband, lest she should misbehave herself; and when she is married, lest she should be barren. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Keep a sure watch over a shameless daughter, lest she make you a laughing stock to your enemies, and a byword in the city, and a reproach among the people, and make you ashamed before the multitude. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Behold not every body's beauty, and sit not in the midst of women. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} For from garments comes a moth, and from women wickedness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Better is the churlishness of a man than a courteous woman, a woman, I say, which brings shame and reproach. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} I will now remember the works of the Lord, and declare the things that I have seen: In the words of the Lord are his works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} The sun that gives light looks upon all things, and the work thereof is full of the glory of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} The Lord has not given power to the saints to declare all his marvelous works, which the Almighty Lord firmly settled, that whatever is might be established for his glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} He seeks out the deep, and the heart, and considers their crafty devices: for the Lord knows all that may be known, and he sees the signs of the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} He declares the things that are past, and for to come, and reveals the steps of hidden things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} No thought escapes him, neither any word is hidden from him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} He has garnished the excellent works of his wisdom, and he is from everlasting to everlasting: to him may nothing be added, neither can he be diminished, and he has no need of any counsellor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Oh how desirable are all his works! and that a man may see even to a spark. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} All these things live and remain for ever for all uses, and they are all obedient. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} All things are double one against another: and he has made nothing imperfect. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} One thing establishes the good or another: and who shall be filled with beholding his glory?\par
\subsection*{Sirach 43}
\markright{SIRACH 43}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The pride of the height, the clear firmament, the beauty of heaven, with his glorious show; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The sun when it appears, declaring at his rising a marvelous instrument, the work of the most High: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} At noon it parches the country, and who can abide the burning heat thereof? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} A man blowing a furnace is in works of heat, but the sun burns the mountains three times more; breathing out fiery vapours, and sending forth bright beams, it dims the eyes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Great is the Lord that made it; and at his commandment runs hastily. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} He made the moon also to serve in her season for a declaration of times, and a sign of the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} From the moon is the sign of feasts, a light that decreases in her perfection. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} The month is called after her name, increasing wonderfully in her changing, being an instrument of the armies above, shining in the firmament of heaven; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The beauty of heaven, the glory of the stars, an ornament giving light in the highest places of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} At the commandment of the Holy One they will stand in their order, and never faint in their watches. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Look upon the rainbow, and praise him that made it; very beautiful it is in the brightness thereof. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} It encircles the heaven about with a glorious circle, and the hands of the most High have bended it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} By his commandment he makes the snow to fall apace, and sends swiftly the lightnings of his judgment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Through this the treasures are opened: and clouds fly forth as fowls. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} By his great power he makes the clouds firm, and the hailstones are broken small. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} At his sight the mountains are shaken, and at his will the south wind blows. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} The noise of the thunder makes the earth to tremble: so does the northern storm and the whirlwind: as birds flying he scatters the snow, and the falling down thereof is as the lighting of grasshoppers: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} The eye marvels at the beauty of the whiteness thereof, and the heart is astonished at the raining of it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} The hoarfrost also as salt he pours on the earth, and being congealed, it lies on the top of sharp stakes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} When the cold north wind blows, and the water is congealed into ice, it remains upon every gathering together of water, and clothes the water as with a breastplate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} It devours the mountains, and burns the wilderness, and consumes the grass as fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} A present remedy of all is a mist coming speedily, a dew coming after heat refreshes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} By his counsel he appeases the deep, and plants islands therein. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} They that sail on the sea tell of the danger thereof; and when we hear it with our ears, we marvel thereat. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} For therein be strange and wondrous works, variety of all kinds of beasts and whales created. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} By him the end of them has prosperous success, and by his word all things consist. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} We may speak much, and yet come short: therefore in sum, he is all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} How shall we be able to magnify him? for he is great above all his works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} The Lord is terrible and very great, and marvelous is his power. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} When you⌃ glorify the Lord, exalt him as much as you⌃ can; for even yet will he far exceed: and when you⌃ exalt him, put forth all your strength, and be not weary; for you⌃ can never go far enough. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Who has seen him, that he might tell us? and who can magnify him as he is? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} There are yet hid greater things than these be, for we have seen but a few of his works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} For the Lord has made all things; and to the godly has he given wisdom.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 44}
\markright{SIRACH 44}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Let us now praise famous men, and our fathers that became the father of us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The Lord has wrought great glory by them through his great power from the beginning. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Such as did bear rule in their kingdoms, men renowned for their power, giving counsel by their understanding, and declaring prophecies: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Leaders of the people by their counsels, and by their knowledge of learning meet for the people, wise and eloquent are their instructions: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Such as found out musical tunes, and recited verses in writing: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Rich men furnished with ability, living peaceably in their habitations: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} All these were honored in their generations, and were the glory of their times. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} There be of them, that have left a name behind them, that their praises might be reported. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And some there be, which have no memorial; who are perished, as though they had never been; and are become as though they had never been born; and their children after them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} But these were merciful men, whose righteousness has not been forgotten. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} With their seed shall continually remain a good inheritance, and their children are within the covenant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Their seed stands fast, and their children for their sakes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Their seed shall remain for ever, and their glory shall not be blotted out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Their bodies are buried in peace; but their name lives for evermore. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} The people will tell of their wisdom, and the congregation will show forth their praise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Enoch pleased the Lord, and was translated, being an example of repentance to all generations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Noah was found perfect and righteous; in the time of wrath he was taken in exchange [for the world;] therefore was he left as a remnant to the earth, when the flood came. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} An everlasting covenant was made with him, that all flesh should perish no more by the flood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Abraham was a great father of many people: in glory was there none like to him; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Who kept the law of the most High, and was in covenant with him: he established the covenant in his flesh; and when he was proved, he was found faithful. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Therefore he assured him by an oath, that he would bless the nations in his seed, and that he would multiply him as the dust of the earth, and exalt his seed as the stars, and cause them to inherit from sea to sea, and from the river to the utmost part of the land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} With Isaac did he establish likewise [for Abraham his father's sake] the blessing of all men, and the covenant, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And made it rest upon the head of Jacob. He acknowledged him in his blessing, and gave him an heritage, and divided his portions; among the twelve tribes did he part them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And he brought out of him a merciful man, which found favor in the sight of all flesh, even Moses, beloved of God and men, whose memorial is blessed.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 45}
\markright{SIRACH 45}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} He made him like to the glorious saints, and magnified him, so that his enemies stood in fear of him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} By his words he caused the wonders to cease, and he made him glorious in the sight of kings, and gave him a commandment for his people, and showed him part of his glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} He sanctified him in his faithfulness and meekness, and chose him out of all men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} He made him to hear his voice, and brought him into the dark cloud, and gave him commandments before his face, even the law of life and knowledge, that he might teach Jacob his covenants, and Israel his judgments. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} He exalted Aaron, an holy man like to him, even his brother, of the tribe of Levi. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} An everlasting covenant he made with him and gave him the priesthood among the people; he beautified him with comely ornaments, and clothed him with a robe of glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} He put upon him perfect glory; and strengthened him with rich garments, with breeches, with a long robe, and the ephod. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And he compassed him with pomegranates, and with many golden bells round about, that as he went there might be a sound, and a noise made that might be heard in the temple, for a memorial to the children of his people; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} With an holy garment, with gold, and blue silk, and purple, the work of the embroiderer, with a breastplate of judgment, and with Urim and Thummim; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} With twisted scarlet, the work of the cunning workman, with precious stones graven like seals, and set in gold, the work of the jeweller, with a writing engraved for a memorial, after the number of the tribes of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} He set a crown of gold upon the mitre, wherein was engraved Holiness, an ornament of honor, a costly work, the desires of the eyes, goodly and beautiful. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Before him there were none such, neither did ever any stranger put them on, but only his children and his children's children perpetually. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Their sacrifices shall be wholly consumed every day twice continually. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Moses consecrated him, and anointed him with holy oil: this was appointed to him by an everlasting covenant, and to his seed, so long as the heavens should remain, that they should minister to him, and execute the office of the priesthood, and bless the people in his name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} He chose him out of all men living to offer sacrifices to the Lord, incense, and a sweet savor, for a memorial, to make reconciliation for his people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} He gave to him his commandments, and authority in the statutes of judgments, that he should teach Jacob the testimonies, and inform Israel in his laws. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Strangers conspired together against him, and maligned him in the wilderness, even the men that were of Dathan's and Abiron's side, and the congregation of Core, with fury and wrath. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} This the Lord saw, and it displeased him, and in his wrathful indignation were they consumed: he did wonders upon them, to consume them with the fiery flame. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But he made Aaron more honorable, and gave him an heritage, and divided to him the first fruits of the increase; especially he prepared bread in abundance: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} For they eat of the sacrifices of the Lord, which he gave to him and his seed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Howbeit in the land of the people he had no inheritance, neither had he any portion among the people: for the Lord himself is his portion and inheritance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} The third in glory is Phinees the son of Eleazar, because he had zeal in the fear of the Lord, and stood up with good courage of heart: when the people were turned back, and made reconciliation for Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Therefore was there a covenant of peace made with him, that he should be the chief of the sanctuary and of his people, and that he and his posterity should have the dignity of the priesthood for ever: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} According to the covenant made with David son of Jesse, of the tribe of Juda, that the inheritance of the king should be to his posterity alone: so the inheritance of Aaron should also be to his seed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} God give you wisdom in your heart to judge his people in righteousness, that their good things be not abolished, and that their glory may endure for ever.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 46}
\markright{SIRACH 46}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Jesus the son a Nave was valiant in the wars, and was the successor of Moses in prophecies, who according to his name was made great for the saving of the elect of God, and taking vengeance of the enemies that rose up against them, that he might set Israel in their inheritance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} How great glory got he, when he did lift up his hands, and stretched out his sword against the cities! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Who before him so stood to it? for the Lord himself brought his enemies to him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Did not the sun go back by his means? and was not one day as long as two? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} He called upon the most high Lord, when the enemies pressed upon him on every side; and the great Lord heard him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And with hailstones of mighty power he made the battle to fall violently upon the nations, and in the descent [of Beth-horon] he destroyed them that resisted, that the nations might know all their strength, because he fought in the sight of the Lord, and he followed the Mighty One. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} In the time of Moses also he did a work of mercy, he and Caleb the son of Jephunne, in that they withstood the congregation, and withheld the people from sin, and appeased the wicked murmuring. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And of six hundred thousand people on foot, they two were preserved to bring them in to the heritage, even to the land that flows with milk and honey. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The Lord gave strength also to Caleb, which remained with him to his old age: so that he entered upon the high places of the land, and his seed obtained it for an heritage: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} That all the children of Israel might see that it is good to follow the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And concerning the judges, every one by name, whose heart went not a whoring, nor departed from the Lord, let their memory be blessed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Let their bones flourish out of their place, and let the name of them that were honored be continued upon their children. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Samuel, the prophet of the Lord, beloved of his Lord, established a kingdom, and anointed princes over his people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} By the law of the Lord he judged the congregation, and the Lord had respect to Jacob. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} By his faithfulness he was found a true prophet, and by his word he was known to be faithful in vision. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} He called upon the mighty Lord, when his enemies pressed upon him on every side, when he offered the sucking lamb. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And the Lord thundered from heaven, and with a great noise made his voice to be heard. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And he destroyed the rulers of the Tyrians, and all the princes of the Philistines. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And before his long sleep he made protestations in the sight of the Lord and his anointed, I have not taken any man's goods, so much as a shoe: and no man did accuse him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And after his death he prophesied, and showed the king his end, and lifted up his voice from the earth in prophecy, to blot out the wickedness of the people.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 47}
\markright{SIRACH 47}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And after him rose up Nathan to prophesy in the time of David. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} As is the fat taken away from the peace offering, so was David chosen out of the children of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} He played with lions as with kids, and with bears as with lambs. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Slew he not a giant, when he was yet but young? and did he not take away reproach from the people, when he lifted up his hand with the stone in the sling, and beat down the boasting of Goliath? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For he called upon the most high Lord; and he gave him strength in his right hand to kill that mighty warrior, and set up the horn of his people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} So the people honored him with ten thousands, and praised him in the blessings of the Lord, in that he gave him a crown of glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For he destroyed the enemies on every side, and brought to nothing the Philistines his adversaries, and brake their horn in sunder to this day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} In all his works he praised the Holy One most high with words of glory; with his whole heart he sung songs, and loved him that made him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} He set singers also before the altar, that by their voices they might make sweet melody, and daily sing praises in their songs. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} He beautified their feasts, and set in order the solemn times until the end, that they might praise his holy name, and that the temple might sound from morning. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} The Lord took away his sins, and exalted his horn for ever: he gave him a covenant of kings, and a throne of glory in Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} After him rose up a wise son, and for his sake he lived at large. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Solomon reigned in a peaceful time, and was honored; for God made all quiet round about him, that he might build an house in his name, and prepare his sanctuary for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} How wise was you in your youth and, as a flood, filled with understanding! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Your soul covered the whole earth, and you filled it with dark parables. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Your name went far to the islands; and for your peace you were beloved. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} The countries marveled at you for your songs, and proverbs, and parables, and interpretations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} By the name of the Lord God, which is called the Lord God of Israel, you did gather gold as tin and did multiply silver as lead. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} You did bow your loins to women, and by your body you were brought into subjection. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} You did stain your honor, and pollute your seed: so that you brought wrath upon your children, and was grieved for your folly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} So the kingdom was divided, and out of Ephraim ruled a rebellious kingdom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} But the Lord will never leave off his mercy, neither shall any of his works perish, neither will he abolish the posterity of his elect, and the seed of him that loves him he will not take away: therefore he gave a remnant to Jacob, and out of him a root to David. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Thus rested Solomon with his fathers, and of his seed he left behind him Roboam, even the foolishness of the people, and one that had no understanding, who turned away the people through his counsel. There was also Jeroboam the son of Nebat, who caused Israel to sin, and showed Ephraim the way of sin: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And their sins were multiplied exceedingly, that they were driven out of the land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} For they sought out all wickedness, till the vengeance came upon them.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 48}
\markright{SIRACH 48}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then stood up Elias the prophet as fire, and his word burned like a lamp. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} He brought a sore famine upon them, and by his zeal he diminished their number. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} By the word of the Lord he shut up the heaven, and also three times brought down fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} O Elias, how was you honored in your wondrous deeds! and who may glory like to you! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Who did raise up a dead man from death, and his soul from the place of the dead, by the word of the most High: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Who brought kings to destruction, and honorably men from their bed: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Who heard the rebuke of the Lord in Sinai, and in Horeb the judgment of vengeance: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Who anointed kings to take revenge, and prophets to succeed after him: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Who was taken up in a whirlwind of fire, and in a chariot of fiery horses: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Who was ordained for reproofs in their times, to pacify the wrath of the Lord's judgment, before it brake forth into fury, and to turn the heart of the father to the son, and to restore the tribes of Jacob. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Blessed are they that saw you, and slept in love; for we shall surely live. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Elias it was, who was covered with a whirlwind: and Eliseus was filled with his spirit: while he lived, he was not moved with the presence of any prince, neither could any bring him into subjection. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} No word could overcome him; and after his death his body prophesied. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} He did wonders in his life, and at his death were his works marvelous. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For all this the people repented not, neither departed they from their sins, till they were spoiled and carried out of their land, and were scattered through all the earth: yet there remained a small people, and a ruler in the house of David: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Of whom some did that which was pleasing to God, and some multiplied sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Ezekias fortified his city, and brought in water into the midst thereof: he digged the hard rock with iron, and made wells for waters. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} In his time Sennacherib came up, and sent Rabsaces, and lifted up his hand against Sion, and boasted proudly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Then trembled their hearts and hands, and they were in pain, as women in travail. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} But they called upon the Lord which is merciful, and stretched out their hands toward him: and immediately the Holy One heard them out of heaven, and delivered them by the ministry of Esay. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} He struck the host of the Assyrians, and his angel destroyed them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} For Ezekias had done the thing that pleased the Lord, and was strong in the ways of David his father, as Esay the prophet, who was great and faithful in his vision, had commanded him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} In his time the sun went backward, and he lengthened the king's life. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} He saw by an excellent spirit what should come to pass at the last, and he comforted them that mourned in Sion. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} He showed what should come to pass for ever, and secret things or ever they came.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 49}
\markright{SIRACH 49}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The remembrance of Josias is like the composition of the perfume that is made by the art of the apothecary: it is sweet as honey in all mouths, and as musick at a banquet of wine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} He behaved himself uprightly in the conversion of the people, and took away the abominations of iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} He directed his heart to the Lord, and in the time of the ungodly he established the worship of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} All, except David and Ezekias and Josias, were defective: for they forsook the law of the most High, even the kings of Juda failed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Therefore he gave their power to others, and their glory to a strange nation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} They burnt the chosen city of the sanctuary, and made the streets desolate, according to the prophecy of Jeremias. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For they entreated him evil, who nevertheless was a prophet, sanctified in his mother's womb, that he might root out, and afflict, and destroy; and that he might build up also, and plant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} It was Ezekiel who saw the glorious vision, which was showed him upon the chariot of the cherubims. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For he made mention of the enemies under the figure of the rain, and directed them that went right. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And of the twelve prophets let the memorial be blessed, and let their bones flourish again out of their place: for they comforted Jacob, and delivered them by assured hope. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} How shall we magnify Zorobabel? even he was as a signet on the right hand: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} So was Jesus the son of Josedec: who in their time builded the house, and set up an holy temple to the Lord, which was prepared for everlasting glory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And among the elect was Neemias, whose renown is great, who raised up for us the walls that were fallen, and set up the gates and the bars, and raised up our ruins again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} But upon the earth was no man created like Enoch; for he was taken from the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Neither was there a young man born like Joseph, a governor of his brethren, a stay of the people, whose bones were regarded of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Sem and Seth were in great honor among men, and so was Adam above every living thing in creation.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 50}
\markright{SIRACH 50}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Simon the high priest, the son of Onias, who in his life repaired the house again, and in his days fortified the temple: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And by him was built from the foundation the double height, the high fortress of the wall about the temple: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} In his days the cistern to receive water, being in compass as the sea, was covered with plates of brass: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} He took care of the temple that it should not fall, and fortified the city against besieging: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} How was he honored in the midst of the people in his coming out of the sanctuary! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} He was as the morning star in the midst of a cloud, and as the moon at the full: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} As the sun shining upon the temple of the most High, and as the rainbow giving light in the bright clouds: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And as the flower of roses in the spring of the year, as lilies by the rivers of waters, and as the branches of the frankincense tree in the time of summer: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} As fire and incense in the censer, and as a vessel of beaten gold set with all manner of precious stones: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And as a fair olive tree budding forth fruit, and as a cypress tree which grows up to the clouds. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} When he put on the robe of honor, and was clothed with the perfection of glory, when he went up to the holy altar, he made the garment of holiness honorable. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} When he took the portions out of the priests' hands, he himself stood by the hearth of the altar, compassed about, as a young cedar in Libanus; and as palm trees compassed they him round about. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} So were all the sons of Aaron in their glory, and the oblations of the Lord in their hands, before all the congregation of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And finishing the service at the altar, that he might adorn the offering of the most high Almighty, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} He stretched out his hand to the cup, and poured of the blood of the grape, he poured out at the foot of the altar a sweet smelling savor to the most high King of all. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Then shouted the sons of Aaron, and sounded the silver trumpets, and made a great noise to be heard, for a remembrance before the most High. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Then all the people together hasted, and fell down to the earth upon their faces to worship their Lord God Almighty, the most High. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} The singers also sang praises with their voices, with great variety of sounds was there made sweet melody. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And the people implored the Lord, the most High, by prayer before him that is merciful, till the solemnity of the Lord was ended, and they had finished his service. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Then he went down, and lifted up his hands over the whole congregation of the children of Israel, to give the blessing of the Lord with his lips, and to rejoice in his name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And they bowed themselves down to worship the second time, that they might receive a blessing from the most High. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Now therefore bless you⌃ the God of all, which only does wondrous things every where, which exalts our days from the womb, and deals with us according to his mercy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} He grant us joyfulness of heart, and that peace may be in our days in Israel for ever: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} That he would confirm his mercy with us, and deliver us at his time! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} There be two manner of nations which my heart abhorrs, and the third is no nation: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} They that sit upon the mountain of Samaria, and they that dwell among the Philistines, and that foolish people that dwell in Sichem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Jesus the son of Sirach of Jerusalem has written in this book the instruction of understanding and knowledge, who out of his heart poured forth wisdom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Blessed is he that shall be exercised in these things; and he that lays them up in his heart shall become wise. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} For if he do them, he shall be strong to all things: for the light of the Lord leads him, who gives wisdom to the godly. Blessed be the name of the Lord for ever. Amen, Amen.\par
\subsection*{Sirach 51}
\markright{SIRACH 51}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} I will thank you, O Lord and King, and praise you, O God my Saviour: I do give praise to your name: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} For you are my defender and helper, and has preserved my body from destruction, and from the snare of the slanderous tongue, and from the lips that forge lies, and has been my helper against my adversaries: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And have delivered me, according to the multitude of your mercies and greatness of your name, from the teeth of them that were ready to devour me, and out of the hands of such as sought after my life, and from the manifold afflictions which I had; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} From the choking of fire on every side, and from the midst of the fire which I kindled not; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} From the depth of the belly of hell, from an unclean tongue, and from lying words. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} By an accusation to the king from an unrighteous tongue my soul drew near even to death, my life was near to the hell beneath. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} They compassed me on every side, and there was no man to help me: I looked for the succour of men, but there was none. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Then thought I upon your mercy, O Lord, and upon your acts of old, how you deliver such as wait for you, and save them out of the hands of the enemies. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Then lifted I up my supplications from the earth, and prayed for deliverance from death. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} I called upon the Lord, the Father of my Lord, that he would not leave me in the days of my trouble, and in the time of the proud, when there was no help. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} I will praise your name continually, and will sing praises with thanksgiving;
