found there Josias gave thirty thousand lambs and kids, and three thousand calves: these things were given of the king's allowance, according as he promised, to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And Helkias, Zacharias, and Syelus, the governors of the temple, gave to the priests for the passover two thousand and six hundred sheep, and three hundred calves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And Jeconias, and Samaias, and Nathanael his brother, and Assabias, and Ochiel, and Joram, captains over thousands, gave to the Levites for the passover five thousand sheep, and seven hundred calves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And when these things were done, the priests and Levites, having the unleavened bread, stood in very comely order according to the kindred, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And according to the several dignities of the fathers, before the people, to offer to the Lord, as it is written in the book of Moses: and thus did they in the morning. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And they roasted the passover with fire, as appertains: as for the sacrifices, they sod them in brass pots and pans with a good savor, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And set them before all the people: and afterward they prepared for themselves, and for the priests their brethren, the sons of Aaron. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} For the priests offered the fat until night: and the Levites prepared for themselves, and the priests their brethren, the sons of Aaron. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} The holy singers also, the sons of Asaph, were in their order, according to the appointment of David, to wit, Asaph, Zacharias, and Jeduthun, who was of the king's retinue. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Moreover the porters were at every gate; it was not lawful for any to go from his ordinary service: for their brethren the Levites prepared for them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Thus were the things that belonged to the sacrifices of the Lord accomplished in that day, that they might hold the passover, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And offer sacrifices upon the altar of the Lord, according to the commandment of king Josias. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} So the children of Israel which were present held the passover at that time, and the feast of sweet bread seven days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And such a passover was not kept in Israel since the time of the prophet Samuel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Yes, all the kings of Israel held not such a passover as Josias, and the priests, and the Levites, and the Jews, held with all Israel that were found dwelling at Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} In the eighteenth year of the reign of Josias was this passover kept. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And the works or Josias were upright before his Lord with an heart full of godliness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} As for the things that came to pass in his time, they were written in former times, concerning those that sinned, and did wickedly against the Lord above all people and kingdoms, and how they grieved him exceedingly, so that the words of the Lord rose up against Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Now after all these acts of Josias it came to pass, that Pharaoh the king of Egypt came to raise war at Carchamis upon Euphrates: and Josias went out against him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} But the king of Egypt sent to him, saying, What have I to do with you, O king of Judea? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} I am not sent out from the Lord God against you; for my war is upon Euphrates: and now the Lord is with me, yes, the Lord is with me hasting me forward: depart from me, and be not against the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Howbeit Josias did not turn back his chariot from him, but undertook to fight with him, not regarding the words of the prophet Jeremy spoken by the mouth of the Lord: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} But joined battle with him in the plain of Magiddo, and the princes came against king Josias. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Then said the king to his servants, Carry me away out of the battle; for I am very weak. And immediately his servants took him away out of the battle. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Then got he up upon his second chariot; and being brought back to Jerusalem died, and was buried in his father's sepulchre. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And in all Jewry they mourned for Josias, yes, Jeremy the prophet lamented for Josias, and the chief men with the women made lamentation for him to this day: and this was given out for an ordinance to be done continually in all the nation of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} These things are written in the book of the stories of the kings of Judah, and every one of the acts that Josias did, and his glory, and his understanding in the law of the Lord, and the things that he had done before, and the things now recited, are reported in the book of the kings of Israel and Judea. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} And the people took Joachaz the son of Josias, and made him king instead of Josias his father, when he was twenty and three years old. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} And he reigned in Judea and in Jerusalem three months: and then the king of Egypt deposed him from reigning in Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} And he set a tax upon the land of one hundred talents of silver and one talent of gold. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} The king of Egypt also made king Joacim his brother king of Judea and Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And he bound Joacim and the nobles: but Zaraces his brother he apprehended, and brought him out of Egypt. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} Five and twenty years old was Joacim when he was made king in the land of Judea and Jerusalem; and he did evil before the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} Therefore against him Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon came up, and bound him with a chain of brass, and carried him into Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} Nabuchodonosor also took of the holy vessels of the Lord, and carried them away, and set them in his own temple at Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} But those things that are recorded of him, and of his uncleanness and impiety, are written in the chronicles of the kings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} And Joacim his son reigned in his stead: he was made king being eighteen years old; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And reigned but three months and ten days in Jerusalem; and did evil before the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} So after a year Nabuchodonosor sent and caused him to be brought into Babylon with the holy vessels of the Lord; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} And made Zedechias king of Judea and Jerusalem, when he was one and twenty years old; and he reigned eleven years: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} And he did evil also in the sight of the Lord, and cared not for the words that were spoken to him by the prophet Jeremy from the mouth of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} And after that king Nabuchodonosor had made him to swear by the name of the Lord, he forswore himself, and rebelled; and hardening his neck, his heart, he transgressed the laws of the Lord God of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} The governors also of the people and of the priests did many things against the laws, and passed all the pollutions of all nations, and defiled the temple of the Lord, which was sanctified in Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} Nevertheless the God of their fathers sent by his messenger to call them back, because he spared them and his tabernacle also. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} But they had his messengers in derision; and, look, when the Lord spoke to them, they made a sport of his prophets: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} So far forth, that he, being angry with his people for their great ungodliness, commanded the kings of the Chaldees to come up against them; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} Who killed their young men with the sword, yes, even within the compass of their holy temple, and spared neither young man nor maid, old man nor child, among them; for he delivered all into their hands. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{54}} And they took all the holy vessels of the Lord, both great and small, with the vessels of the ark of God, and the king's treasures, and carried them away into Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{55}} As for the house of the Lord, they burnt it, and brake down the walls of Jerusalem, and set fire upon her towers: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{56}} And as for her glorious things, they never ceased till they had consumed and brought them all to nothing: and the people that were not slain with the sword he carried to Babylon: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{57}} Who became servants to him and his children, till the Persians reigned, to fulfil the word of the Lord spoken by the mouth of Jeremy: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{58}} Until the land had enjoyed her sabbaths, the whole time of her desolation shall she rest, until the full term of seventy years.\par
\subsection*{1 Esdras 2}
\markright{1 ESDRAS 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} In the first year of Cyrus king of the Persians, that the word of the Lord might be accomplished, that he had promised by the mouth of Jeremy; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The Lord raised up the spirit of Cyrus the king of the Persians, and he made proclamation through all his kingdom, and also by writing, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Saying, Thus says Cyrus king of the Persians; The Lord of Israel, the most high Lord, has made me king of the whole world, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And commanded me to build him an house at Jerusalem in Jewry. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} If therefore there be any of you that are of his people, let the Lord, even his Lord, be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem that is in Judea, and build the house of the Lord of Israel: for he is the Lord that dwells in Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Whosoever then dwell in the places about, let them help him, those, I say, that are his neighbors, with gold, and with silver, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} With gifts, with horses, and with cattle, and other things, which have been set forth by vow, for the temple of the Lord at Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Then the chief of the families of Judea and of the tribe of Benjamin stood up; the priests also, and the Levites, and all they whose mind the Lord had moved to go up, and to build an house for the Lord at Jerusalem, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And they that lived round about them, and helped them in all things with silver and gold, with horses and cattle, and with very many free gifts of a great number whose minds were stirred up thereto. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} King Cyrus also brought forth the holy vessels, which Nabuchodonosor had carried away from Jerusalem, and had set up in his temple of idols. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Now when Cyrus king of the Persians had brought them forth, he delivered them to Mithridates his treasurer: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And by him they were delivered to Sanabassar the governor of Judea. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And this was the number of them; A thousand golden cups, and a thousand of silver, censers of silver twenty nine, vials of gold thirty, and of silver two thousand four hundred and ten, and a thousand other vessels. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} So all the vessels of gold and of silver, which were carried away, were five thousand four hundred threescore and nine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} These were brought back by Sanabassar, together with them of the captivity, from Babylon to Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} But in the time of Artaxerxes king of the Persians Belemus, and Mithridates, and Tabellius, and Rathumus, and Beeltethmus, and Semellius the secretary, with others that were in commission with them, dwelling in Samaria and other places, wrote to him against them that lived in Judea and Jerusalem these letters following; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} To king Artaxerxes our lord, Your servants, Rathumus the storywriter, and Semellius the scribe, and the rest of their council, and the judges that are in Celosyria and Phenice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Be it now known to the lord king, that the Jews that are up from you to us, being come into Jerusalem, that rebellious and wicked city, do build the marketplaces, and repair the walls of it and do lay the foundation of the temple. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} Now if this city and the walls thereof be made up again, they will not only refuse to give tribute, but also rebel against kings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And forasmuch as the things pertaining to the temple are now in hand, we think it meet not to neglect such a matter, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} But to speak to our lord the king, to the intent that, if it be your pleasure it may be sought out in the books of your fathers: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And you shall find in the chronicles what is written concerning these things, and shall understand that that city was rebellious, troubling both kings and cities: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And that the Jews were rebellious, and raised always wars therein; for the which cause even this city was made desolate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} Therefore now we do declare to you, O lord the king, that if this city be built again, and the walls thereof set up anew, you shall from henceforth have no passage into Celosyria and Phenice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Then the king wrote back again to Rathumus the storywriter, to Beeltethmus, to Semellius the scribe, and to the rest that were in commission, and dwellers in Samaria and Syria and Phenice, after this manner; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} I have read the epistle which you⌃ have sent to me: therefore I commanded to make diligent search, and it has been found that that city was from the beginning practising against kings; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And the men therein were given to rebellion and war: and that mighty kings and fierce were in Jerusalem, who reigned and exacted tributes in Celosyria and Phenice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} Now therefore I have commanded to hinder those men from building the city, and heed to be taken that there be no more done in it; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And that those wicked workers proceed no further to the annoyance of kings, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Then king Artaxerxes his letters being read, Rathumus, and Semellius the scribe, and the rest that were in commission with them, removing in haste toward Jerusalem with a troop of horsemen and a multitude of people in battle array, began to hinder the builders; and the building of the temple in Jerusalem ceased until the second year of the reign of Darius king of the Persians.\par
\subsection*{1 Esdras 3}
\markright{1 ESDRAS 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Now when Darius reigned, he made a great feast to all his subjects, and to all his household, and to all the princes of Media and Persia, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And to all the governors and captains and lieutenants that were under him, from India to Ethiopia, of one hundred twenty and seven provinces. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And when they had eaten and drunken, and being satisfied were gone home, then Darius the king went into his bedchamber, and slept, and soon after awaked. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Then three young men, that were of the guard that kept the king's body, spoke one to another; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Let every one of us speak a sentence: he that shall overcome, and whose sentence shall seem wiser than the others, to him shall the king Darius give great gifts, and great things in token of victory: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} As, to be clothed in purple, to drink in gold, and to sleep upon gold, and a chariot with bridles of gold, and an headtire of fine linen, and a chain about his neck: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And he shall sit next to Darius because of his wisdom, and shall be called Darius his cousin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And then every one wrote his sentence, sealed it, and laid it under king Darius his pillow; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And said that, when the king is risen, some will give him the writings; and of whose side the king and the three princes of Persia shall judge that his sentence is the wisest, to him shall the victory be given, as was appointed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} The first wrote, Wine is the strongest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} The second wrote, The king is strongest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} The third wrote, Women are strongest: but above all things Truth bears away the victory. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Now when the king was risen up, they took their writings, and delivered them to him, and so he read them: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And sending forth he called all the princes of Persia and Media, and the governors, and the captains, and the lieutenants, and the chief officers; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And sat him down in the royal seat of judgment; and the writings were read before them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And he said, Call the young men, and they shall declare their own sentences. So they were called, and came in. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And he said to them, Declare to us your mind concerning the writings. Then began the first, who had spoken of the strength of wine; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And he said thus, O you⌃ men, how exceeding strong is wine! it causes all men to err that drink it: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} It makes the mind of the king and of the fatherless child to be all one; of the bondman and of the freeman, of the poor man and of the rich: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} It turns also every thought into jollity and mirth, so that a man remembers neither sorrow nor debt: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And it makes every heart rich, so that a man remembers neither king nor governor; and it makes to speak all things by talents: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And when they are in their cups, they forget their love both to friends and brethren, and a little after draw out swords: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} But when they are from the wine, they remember not what they have done. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} O you⌃ men, is not wine the strongest, that enforces to do thus? And when he had so spoken, he held his peace.\par
\subsection*{1 Esdras 4}
\markright{1 ESDRAS 4}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then the second, that had spoken of the strength of the king, began to say, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} O you⌃ men, do not men excel in strength that bear rule over sea and land and all things in them? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} But yet the king is more mighty: for he is lord of all these things, and has dominion over them; and whatever he commands them they do. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} If he bid them make war the one against the other, they do it: if he send them out against the enemies, they go, and break down mountains walls and towers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} They kill and are slain, and transgress not the king's commandment: if they get the victory, they bring all to the king, as well the spoil, as all things else. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Likewise for those that are no soldiers, and have not to do with wars, but use husbandry, when they have reaped again that which they had sown, they bring it to the king, and compel one another to pay tribute to the king. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And yet he is but one man: if he command to kill, they kill; if he command to spare, they spare; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} If he command to strike, they strike; if he command to make desolate, they make desolate; if he command to build, they build; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} If he command to cut down, they cut down; if he command to plant, they plant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} So all his people and his armies obey him: furthermore he lies down, he eats and drinks, and takes his rest: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And these keep watch round about him, neither may any one depart, and do his own business, neither disobey they him in any thing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} O you⌃ men, how should not the king be mightiest, when in such sort he is obeyed? And he held his tongue. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Then the third, who had spoken of women, and of the truth, (this was Zorobabel) began to speak. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} O you⌃ men, it is not the great king, nor the multitude of men, neither is it wine, that excels; who is it then that rules them, or has the lordship over them? are they not women? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} Women have borne the king and all the people that bear rule by sea and land. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Even of them came they: and they nourished them up that planted the vineyards, from whence the wine comes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} These also make garments for men; these bring glory to men; and without women can’t men be. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} Yes, and if men have gathered together gold and silver, or any other goodly thing, do they not love a woman which is comely in favor and beauty? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And letting all those things go, do they not gape, and even with open mouth fix their eyes fast on her; and have not all men more desire to her than to silver or gold, or any goodly thing whatever? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} A man leaves his own father that brought him up, and his own country, and cleaves to his wife. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} He sticks not to spend his life with his wife. and remembers neither father, nor mother, nor country. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} By this also you⌃ must know that women have dominion over you: do you⌃ not labor and toil, and give and bring all to the woman? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Yes, a man takes his sword, and goes his way to rob and to steal, to sail upon the sea and upon rivers; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And looks upon a lion, and goes in the darkness; and when he has stolen, spoiled, and robbed, he brings it to his love. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Therefore a man loves his wife better than father or mother. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} Yes, many there be that have run out of their wits for women, and become servants for their sakes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Many also have perished, have erred, and sinned, for women. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And now do you⌃ not believe me? is not the king great in his power? do not all regions fear to touch him? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Yet did I see him and Apame the king's concubine, the daughter of the admirable Bartacus, sitting at the right hand of the king, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And taking the crown from the king's head, and setting it upon her own head; she also struck the king with her left hand. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} And yet for all this the king gaped and gazed upon her with open mouth: if she laughed upon him, he laughed also: but if she took any displeasure at him, the king was fain to flatter, that she might be reconciled to him again. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} O you⌃ men, how can it be but women should be strong, seeing they do thus? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Then the king and the princes looked one upon another: so he began to speak of the truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} O you⌃ men, are not women strong? great is the earth, high is the heaven, swift is the sun in his course, for he encircles the heavens round about, and fetches his course again to his own place in one day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Is he not great that makes these things? therefore great is the truth, and stronger than all things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} All the earth cries upon the truth, and the heaven blesses it: all works shake and tremble at it, and with it is no unrighteous thing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Wine is wicked, the king is wicked, women are wicked, all the children of men are wicked, and such are all their wicked works; and there is no truth in them; in their unrighteousness also they shall perish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} As for the truth, it endures, and is Always strong; it lives and conquers for evermore. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} With her there is no accepting of persons or rewards; but she does the things that are just, and refrains from all unjust and wicked things; and all men do well like of her works. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} Neither in her judgment is any unrighteousness; and she is the strength, kingdom, power, and majesty, of all ages. Blessed be the God of truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And with that he held his peace. And all the people then shouted, and said, Great is Truth, and mighty above all things. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} Then said the king to him, Ask what you will more than is appointed in the writing, and we will give it you, because you are found wisest; and you shall sit next me, and shall be called my cousin. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} Then said he to the king, Remember your vow, which you have vowed to build Jerusalem, in the day when you came to your kingdom, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And to send away all the vessels that were taken away out of Jerusalem, which Cyrus set apart, when he vowed to destroy Babylon, and to send them again there. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} You also have vowed to build up the temple, which the Edomites burned when Judea was made desolate by the Chaldees. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} And now, O lord the king, this is that which I require, and which I desire of you, and this is the princely liberality proceeding from yourself: I desire therefore that you make good the vow, the performance whereof with your own mouth you have vowed to the King of heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} Then Darius the king stood up, and kissed him, and wrote letters for him to all the treasurers and lieutenants and captains and governors, that they should safely convey on their way both him, and all those that go up with him to build Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} He wrote letters also to the lieutenants that were in Celosyria and Phenice, and to them in Libanus, that they should bring cedar wood from Libanus to Jerusalem, and that they should build the city with him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} Moreover he wrote for all the Jews that went out of his realm up into Jewry, concerning their freedom, that no officer, no ruler, no lieutenant, nor treasurer, should forcibly enter into their doors; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} And that all the country which they hold should be free without tribute; and that the Edomites should give over the villages of the Jews which then they held: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} Yes, that there should be yearly given twenty talents to the building of the temple, until the time that it were built; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} And other ten talents yearly, to maintain the burnt offerings upon the altar every day, as they had a commandment to offer seventeen: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} And that all they that went from Babylon to build the city should have free liberty, as well they as their posterity, and all the priests that went away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{54}} He wrote also concerning. the charges, and the priests' vestments wherein they minister; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{55}} And likewise for the charges of the Levites, to be given them until the day that the house were finished, and Jerusalem builded up. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{56}} And he commanded to give to all that kept the city pensions and wages. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{57}} He sent away also all the vessels from Babylon, that Cyrus had set apart; and all that Cyrus had given in commandment, the same charged he also to be done, and sent to Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{58}} Now when this young man was gone forth, he lifted up his face to heaven toward Jerusalem, and praised the King of heaven, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{59}} And said, From you comes victory, from you comes wisdom, and your is the glory, and I am your servant. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{60}} Blessed are you, who have given me wisdom: for to you I give thanks, O Lord of our fathers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{61}} And so he took the letters, and went out, and came to Babylon, and told it all his brethren. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{62}} And they praised the God of their fathers, because he had given them freedom and liberty {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{63}} To go up, and to build Jerusalem, and the temple which is called by his name: and they feasted with instruments of musick and gladness seven days.\par
\subsection*{1 Esdras 5}
\markright{1 ESDRAS 5}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} After this were the principal men of the families chosen according to their tribes, to go up with their wives and sons and daughters, with their menservants and maidservants, and their cattle. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And Darius sent with them a thousand horsemen, till they had brought them back to Jerusalem safely, and with musical [instruments] tabrets and flutes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And all their brethren played, and he made them go up together with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And these are the names of the men which went up, according to their families among their tribes, after their several heads. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} The priests, the sons of Phinees the son of Aaron: Jesus the son of Josedec, the son of Saraias, and Joacim the son of Zorobabel, the son of Salathiel, of the house of David, out of the kindred of Phares, of the tribe of Judah; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Who spoke wise sentences before Darius the king of Persia in the second year of his reign, in the month Nisan, which is the first month. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And these are they of Jewry that came up from the captivity, where they lived as strangers, whom Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon had carried away to Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And they returned to Jerusalem, and to the other parts of Jewry, every man to his own city, who came with Zorobabel, with Jesus, Nehemias, and Zacharias, and Reesaias, Enenius, Mardocheus, Beelsarus, Aspharasus, Reelius, Roimus, and Baana, their guides. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The number of them of the nation, and their governors, sons of Phoros, two thousand one hundred seventy and two; the sons of Saphat, four hundred seventy and two: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} The sons of Ares, seven hundred fifty and six: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} The sons of Phaath Moab, two thousand eight hundred and twelve: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} The sons of Elam, a thousand two hundred fifty and four: the sons of Zathui, nine hundred forty and five: the sons of Corbe, seven hundred and five: the sons of Bani, six hundred forty and eight: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} The sons of Bebai, six hundred twenty and three: the sons of Sadas, three thousand two hundred twenty and two: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} The sons of Adonikam, six hundred sixty and seven: the sons of Bagoi, two thousand sixty and six: the sons of Adin, four hundred fifty and four: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} The sons of Aterezias, ninety and two: the sons of Ceilan and Azetas threescore and seven: the sons of Azuran, four hundred thirty and two: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} The sons of Ananias, one hundred and one: the sons of Arom, thirty two: and the sons of Bassa, three hundred twenty and three: the sons of Azephurith, one hundred and two: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} The sons of Meterus, three thousand and five: the sons of Bethlomon, one hundred twenty and three: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} They of Netophah, fifty and five: they of Anathoth, one hundred fifty and eight: they of Bethsamos, forty and two: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} They of Kiriathiarius, twenty and five: they of Caphira and Beroth, seven hundred forty and three: they of Pira, seven hundred: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} They of Chadias and Ammidoi, four hundred twenty and two: they of Cirama and Gabdes, six hundred twenty and one: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} They of Macalon, one hundred twenty and two: they of Betolius, fifty and two: the sons of Nephis, one hundred fifty and six: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} The sons of Calamolalus and Onus, seven hundred twenty and five: the sons of Jerechus, two hundred forty and five: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} The sons of Annas, three thousand three hundred and thirty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} The priests: the sons of Jeddu, the son of Jesus among the sons of Sanasib, nine hundred seventy and two: the sons of Meruth, a thousand fifty and two: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} The sons of Phassaron, a thousand forty and seven: the sons of Carme, a thousand and seventeen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} The Levites: the sons of Jessue, and Cadmiel, and Banuas, and Sudias, seventy and four. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} The holy singers: the sons of Asaph, one hundred twenty and eight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} The porters: the sons of Salum, the sons of Jatal, the sons of Talmon, the sons of Dacobi, the sons of Teta, the sons of Sami, in all one hundred thirty and nine. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} The servants of the temple: the sons of Esau, the sons of Asipha, the sons of Tabaoth, the sons of Ceras, the sons of Sud, the sons of Phaleas, the sons of Labana, the sons of Graba, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} The sons of Acua, the sons of Uta, the sons of Cetab, the sons of Agaba, the sons of Subai, the sons of Anan, the sons of Cathua, the sons of Geddur, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} The sons of Airus, the sons of Daisan, the sons of Noeba, the sons of Chaseba, the sons of Gazera, the sons of Azia, the sons of Phinees, the sons of Azara, the sons of Bastai, the sons of Asana, the sons of Meani, the sons of Naphisi, the sons of Acub, the sons of Acipha, the sons of Assur, the sons of Pharacim, the sons of Basaloth, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} The sons of Meeda, the sons of Coutha, the sons of Charea, the sons of Charcus, the sons of Aserer, the sons of Thomoi, the sons of Nasith, the sons of Atipha. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} The sons of the servants of Solomon: the sons of Azaphion, the sons of Pharira, the sons of Jeeli, the sons of Lozon, the sons of Israel, the sons of Sapheth, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} The sons of Hagia, the sons of Pharacareth, the sons of Sabi, the sons of Sarothie, the sons of Masias, the sons of Gar, the sons of Addus, the sons of Suba, the sons of Apherra, the sons of Barodis, the sons of Sabat, the sons of Allom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} All the ministers of the temple, and the sons of the servants of Solomon, were three hundred seventy and two. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} These came up from Thermeleth and Thelersas, Charaathalar leading them, and Aalar; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Neither could they show their families, nor their stock, how they were of Israel: the sons of Ladan, the son of Ban, the sons of Necodan, six hundred fifty and two. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} And of the priests that usurped the office of the priesthood, and were not found: the sons of Obdia, the sons of Accoz, the sons of Addus, who married Augia one of the daughters of Barzelus, and was named after his name. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} And when the description of the kindred of these men was sought in the register, and was not found, they were removed from executing the office of the priesthood: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} For to them said Nehemias and Atharias, that they should not be partakers of the holy things, till there arose up an high priest clothed with doctrine and truth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} So of Israel, from them of twelve years old and upward, they were all in number forty thousand, beside menservants and women servants two thousand three hundred and sixty. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} Their menservants and handmaids were seven thousand three hundred forty and seven: the singing men and singing women, two hundred forty and five: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} Four hundred thirty and five camels, seven thousand thirty and six horses, two hundred forty and five mules, five thousand five hundred twenty and five beasts used to the yoke. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And certain of the chief of their families, when they came to the temple of God that is in Jerusalem, vowed to set up the house again in his own place according to their ability, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} And to give into the holy treasury of the works a thousand pounds of gold, five thousand of silver, and one hundred priestly vestments. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} And so lived the priests and the Levites and the people in Jerusalem, and in the country, the singers also and the porters; and all Israel in their villages. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} But when the seventh month was at hand, and when the children of Israel were every man in his own place, they came all together with one consent into the open place of the first gate which is toward the east. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} Then stood up Jesus the son of Josedec, and his brethren the priests and Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and his brethren, and made ready the altar of the God of Israel, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} To offer burnt sacrifices upon it, according as it is expressly commanded in the book of Moses the man of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} And there were gathered to them out of the other nations of the land, and they erected the altar upon his own place, because all the nations of the land were at enmity with them, and oppressed them; and they offered sacrifices according to the time, and burnt offerings to the Lord both morning and evening. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} Also they held the feast of tabernacles, as it is commanded in the law, and offered sacrifices daily, as was meet: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} And after that, the continual oblations, and the sacrifice of the sabbaths, and of the new moons, and of all holy feasts. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} And all they that had made any vow to God began to offer sacrifices to God from the first day of the seventh month, although the temple of the Lord was not yet built. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{54}} And they gave to the masons and carpenters money, meat, and drink, with cheerfulness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{55}} To them of Zidon also and Tyre they gave carrs, that they should bring cedar trees from Libanus, which should be brought by floats to the haven of Joppa, according as it was commanded them by Cyrus king of the Persians. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{56}} And in the second year and second month after his coming to the temple of God at Jerusalem began Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and Jesus the son of Josedec, and their brethren, and the priests, and the Levites, and all they that were come to Jerusalem out of the captivity: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{57}} And they laid the foundation of the house of God in the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come to Jewry and Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{58}} And they appointed the Levites from twenty years old over the works of the Lord. Then stood up Jesus, and his sons and brethren, and Cadmiel his brother, and the sons of Madiabun, with the sons of Joda the son of Eliadun, with their sons and brethren, all Levites, with one accord setters forward of the business, laboring to advance the works in the house of God. So the workmen built the temple of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{59}} And the priests stood arrayed in their vestments with musical instruments and trumpets; and the Levites the sons of Asaph had cymbals, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{60}} Singing songs of thanksgiving, and praising the Lord, according as David the king of Israel had ordained. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{61}} And they sung with loud voices songs to the praise of the Lord, because his mercy and glory is for ever in all Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{62}} And all the people sounded trumpets, and shouted with a loud voice, singing songs of thanksgiving to the Lord for the rearing up of the house of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{63}} Also of the priests and Levites, and of the chief of their families, the ancients who had seen the former house came to the building of this with weeping and great crying. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{64}} But many with trumpets and joy shouted with loud voice, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{65}} Insomuch that the trumpets might not be heard for the weeping of the people: yet the multitude sounded marvelously, so that it was heard afar off. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{66}} Therefore when the enemies of the tribe of Judah and Benjamin heard it, they came to know what that noise of trumpets should mean. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{67}} And they perceived that they that were of the captivity did build the temple to the Lord God of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{68}} So they went to Zorobabel and Jesus, and to the chief of the families, and said to them, We will build together with you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{69}} For we likewise, as you⌃, do obey your Lord, and do sacrifice to him from the days of Azbazareth the king of the Assyrians, who brought us hither. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{70}} Then Zorobabel and Jesus and the chief of the families of Israel said to them, It is not for us and you to build together an house to the Lord our God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{71}} We ourselves alone will build to the Lord of Israel, according as Cyrus the king of the Persians has commanded us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{72}} But the heathen of the land lying heavy upon the inhabitants of Judea, and holding them strait, hindered their building; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{73}} And by their secret plots, and popular persuasions and commotions, they hindered the finishing of the building all the time that king Cyrus lived: so they were hindered from building for the space of two years, until the reign of Darius.\par
\subsection*{1 Esdras 6}
\markright{1 ESDRAS 6}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Now in the second year of the reign of Darius Aggeus and Zacharias the son of Addo, the prophets, prophesied to the Jews in Jewry and Jerusalem in the name of the Lord God of Israel, which was upon them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Then stood up Zorobabel the son of Salatiel, and Jesus the son of Josedec, and began to build the house of the Lord at Jerusalem, the prophets of the Lord being with them, and helping them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} At the same time came to them Sisinnes the governor of Syria and Phenice, with Sathrabuzanes and his companions, and said to them, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} By whose appointment do you⌃ build this house and this roof, and perform all the other things? and who are the workmen that perform these things? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Nevertheless the elders of the Jews obtained favor, because the Lord had visited the captivity; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And they were not hindered from building, until such time as signification was given to Darius concerning them, and an answer received. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} The copy of the letters which Sisinnes, governor of Syria and Phenice, and Sathrabuzanes, with their companions, rulers in Syria and Phenice, wrote and sent to Darius; To king Darius, greeting: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Let all things be known to our lord the king, that being come into the country of Judea, and entered into the city of Jerusalem we found in the city of Jerusalem the ancients of the Jews that were of the captivity {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Building an house to the Lord, great and new, of hewn and costly stones, and the timber already laid upon the walls. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And those works are done with great speed, and the work goes on prosperously in their hands, and with all glory and diligence is it made. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Then asked we these elders, saying, By whose commandment build you⌃ this house, and lay the foundations of these works? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} Therefore to the intent that we might give knowledge to you by writing, we demanded of them who were the chief doers, and we required of them the names in writing of their principal men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} So they gave us this answer, We are the servants of the Lord which made heaven and earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And as for this house, it was builded many years ago by a king of Israel great and strong, and was finished. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} But when our fathers provoked God to wrath, and sinned against the Lord of Israel which is in heaven, he gave them over into the power of Nabuchodonosor king of Babylon, of the Chaldees; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Who pulled down the house, and burned it, and carried away the people captives to Babylon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} But in the first year that king Cyrus reigned over the country of Babylon Cyrus the king wrote to build up this house. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And the holy vessels of gold and of silver, that Nabuchodonosor had carried away out of the house at Jerusalem, and had set them in his own temple those Cyrus the king brought forth again out of the temple at Babylon, and they were delivered to Zorobabel and to Sanabassarus the ruler, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} With commandment that he should carry away the same vessels, and put them in the temple at Jerusalem; and that the temple of the Lord should be built in his place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} Then the same Sanabassarus, being come here, laid the foundations of the house of the Lord at Jerusalem; and from that time to this being still a building, it is not yet fully ended. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Now therefore, if it seem good to the king, let search be made among the records of king Cyrus: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And if it be found that the building of the house of the Lord at Jerusalem has been done with the consent of king Cyrus, and if our lord the king be so minded, let him signify to us thereof. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Then commanded king Darius to seek among the records at Babylon: and so at Ecbatana the palace, which is in the country of Media, there was found a roll wherein these things were recorded. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} In the first year of the reign of Cyrus king Cyrus commanded that the house of the Lord at Jerusalem should be built again, where they do sacrifice with continual fire: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Whose height shall be sixty cubits and the breadth sixty cubits, with three rows of hewn stones, and one row of new wood of that country; and the expenses thereof to be given out of the house of king Cyrus: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And that the holy vessels of the house of the Lord, both of gold and silver, that Nabuchodonosor took out of the house at Jerusalem, and brought to Babylon, should be restored to the house at Jerusalem, and be set in the place where they were before. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} And also he commanded that Sisinnes the governor of Syria and Phenice, and Sathrabuzanes, and their companions, and those which were appointed rulers in Syria and Phenice, should be careful not to meddle with the place, but suffer Zorobabel, the servant of the Lord, and governor of Judea, and the elders of the Jews, to build the house of the Lord in that place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} I have commanded also to have it built up whole again; and that they look diligently to help those that be of the captivity of the Jews, till the house of the Lord be finished: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} And out of the tribute of Celosyria and Phenice a portion carefully to be given these men for the sacrifices of the Lord, that is, to Zorobabel the governor, for bullocks, and rams, and lambs; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} And also corn, salt, wine, and oil, and that continually every year without further question, according as the priests that be in Jerusalem shall signify to be daily spent: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} That offerings may be made to the most high God for the king and for his children, and that they may pray for their lives. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} And he commanded that whoever should transgress, yes, or make light of any thing before spoken or written, out of his own house should a tree be taken, and he thereon be hanged, and all his goods seized for the king. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} The Lord therefore, whose name is there called upon, utterly destroy every king and nation, that stretches out his hand to hinder or endamage that house of the Lord in Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} I Darius the king have ordained that according to these things it be done with diligence.\par
\subsection*{1 Esdras 7}
\markright{1 ESDRAS 7}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then Sisinnes the governor of Celosyria and Phenice, and Sathrabuzanes, with their companions following the commandments of king Darius, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Did very carefully oversee the holy works, assisting the ancients of the Jews and governors of the temple. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And so the holy works prospered, when Aggeus and Zacharias the prophets prophesied. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And they finished these things by the commandment of the Lord God of Israel, and with the consent of Cyrus, Darius, and Artaxerxes, kings of Persia. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And thus was the holy house finished in the three and twentieth day of the month Adar, in the sixth year of Darius king of the Persians {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And the children of Israel, the priests, and the Levites, and others that were of the captivity, that were added to them, did according to the things written in the book of Moses. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And to the dedication of the temple of the Lord they offered one hundred bullocks two hundred rams, four hundred lambs; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And twelve goats for the sin of all Israel, according to the number of the chief of the tribes of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} The priests also and the Levites stood arrayed in their vestments, according to their kindred, in the service of the Lord God of Israel, according to the book of Moses: and the porters at every gate. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And the children of Israel that were of the captivity held the passover the fourteenth day of the first month, after that the priests and the Levites were sanctified. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} They that were of the captivity were not all sanctified together: but the Levites were all sanctified together. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And so they offered the passover for all them of the captivity, and for their brethren the priests, and for themselves. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And the children of Israel that came out of the captivity did eat, even all they that had separated themselves from the abominations of the people of the land, and sought the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And they kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days, making merry before the Lord, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} For that he had turned the counsel of the king of Assyria toward them, to strengthen their hands in the works of the Lord God of Israel.\par
\subsection*{1 Esdras 8}
\markright{1 ESDRAS 8}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And after these things, when Artaxerxes the king of the Persians reigned came Esdras the son of Saraias, the son of Ezerias, the son of Helchiah, the son of Salum, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} The son of Sadduc, the son of Achitob, the son of Amarias, the son of Ezias, the son of Meremoth, the son of Zaraias, the son of Savias, the son of Boccas, the son of Abisum, the son of Phinees, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} This Esdras went up from Babylon, as a scribe, being very ready in the law of Moses, that was given by the God of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And the king did him honor: for he found grace in his sight in all his requests. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} There went up with him also certain of the children of Israel, of the priest of the Levites, of the holy singers, porters, and ministers of the temple, to Jerusalem, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} In the seventh year of the reign of Artaxerxes, in the fifth month, this was the king's seventh year; for they went from Babylon in the first day of the first month, and came to Jerusalem, according to the prosperous journey which the Lord gave them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} For Esdras had very great skill, so that he omitted nothing of the law and commandments of the Lord, but taught all Israel the ordinances and judgments. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Now the copy of the commission, which was written from Artaxerxes the king, and came to Esdras the priest and reader of the law of the Lord, is this that follows; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} King Artaxerxes to Esdras the priest and reader of the law of the Lord sends greeting: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} Having determined to deal graciously, I have given order, that such of the nation of the Jews, and of the priests and Levites being within our realm, as are willing and desirous should go with you to Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} As many therefore as have a mind thereto, let them depart with you, as it has seemed good both to me and my seven friends the counselors; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} That they may look to the affairs of Judea and Jerusalem, agreeably to that which is in the law of the Lord; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And carry the gifts to the Lord of Israel to Jerusalem, which I and my friends have vowed, and all the gold and silver that in the country of Babylon can be found, to the Lord in Jerusalem, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} With that also which is given of the people for the temple of the Lord their God at Jerusalem: and that silver and gold may be collected for bullocks, rams, and lambs, and things thereto appertaining; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} To the end that they may offer sacrifices to the Lord upon the altar of the Lord their God, which is in Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And whatever you and your brethren will do with the silver and gold, that do, according to the will of your God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And the holy vessels of the Lord, which are given you for the use of the temple of your God, which is in Jerusalem, you shall set before your God in Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And whatever thing else you shall remember for the use of the temple of your God, you shall give it out of the king's treasury. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And I king Artaxerxes have also commanded the keepers of the treasures in Syria and Phenice, that whatever Esdras the priest and the reader of the law of the most high God shall send for, they should give it him with speed, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} To the sum of one hundred talents of silver, likewise also of wheat even to one hundred cors, and one hundred pieces of wine, and other things in abundance. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} Let all things be performed after the law of God diligently to the most high God, that wrath come not upon the kingdom of the king and his sons. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} I command you also, that you⌃ require no tax, nor any other imposition, of any of the priests, or Levites, or holy singers, or porters, or ministers of the temple, or of any that have doings in this temple, and that no man have authority to impose any thing upon them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And you, Esdras, according to the wisdom of God ordain judges and justices, that they may judge in all Syria and Phenice all those that know the law of your God; and those that know it not you shall teach. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And whoever shall transgress the law of your God, and of the king, shall be punished diligently, whether it be by death, or other punishment, by penalty of money, or by imprisonment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} Then said Esdras the scribe, Blessed be the only Lord God of my fathers, who has put these things into the heart of the king, to glorify his house that is in Jerusalem: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{26}} And has honored me in the sight of the king, and his counselors, and all his friends and nobles. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{27}} Therefore was I encouraged by the help of the Lord my God, and gathered together men of Israel to go up with me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{28}} And these are the chief according to their families and several dignities, that went up with me from Babylon in the reign of king Artaxerxes: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{29}} Of the sons of Phinees, Gerson: of the sons of Ithamar, Gamael: of the sons of David, Lettus the son of Sechenias: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{30}} Of the sons of Pharez, Zacharias; and with him were counted one hundred and fifty men: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{31}} Of the sons of Pahath Moab, Eliaonias, the son of Zaraias, and with him two hundred men: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{32}} Of the sons of Zathoe, Sechenias the son of Jezelus, and with him three hundred men: of the sons of Adin, Obeth the son of Jonathan, and with him two hundred and fifty men: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} Of the sons of Elam, Josias son of Gotholias, and with him seventy men: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Of the sons of Saphatias, Zaraias son of Michael, and with him threescore and ten men: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} Of the sons of Joab, Abadias son of Jezelus, and with him two hundred and twelve men: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} Of the sons of Banid, Assalimoth son of Josaphias, and with him one hundred and threescore men: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} Of the sons of Babi, Zacharias son of Bebai, and with him twenty and eight men: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} Of the sons of Astath, Johannes son of Acatan, and with him one hundred and ten men: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} Of the sons of Adonikam the last, and these are the names of them, Eliphalet, Jewel, and Samaias, and with them seventy men: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} Of the sons of Bago, Uthi the son of Istalcurus, and with him seventy men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} And these I gathered together to the river called Theras, where we pitched our tents three days: and then I surveyed them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{42}} But when I had found there none of the priests and Levites, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{43}} Then sent I to Eleazar, and Iduel, and Masman, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{44}} And Alnathan, and Mamaias, and Joribas, and Nathan, Eunatan, Zacharias, and Mosollamon, principal men and learned. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{45}} And I bade them that they should go to Saddeus the captain, who was in the place of the treasury: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{46}} And commanded them that they should speak to Daddeus, and to his brethren, and to the treasurers in that place, to send us such men as might execute the priests' office in the house of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{47}} And by the mighty hand of our Lord they brought to us skillful men of the sons of Moli the son of Levi, the son of Israel, Asebebia, and his sons, and his brethren, who were eighteen. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{48}} And Asebia, and Annuus, and Osaias his brother, of the sons of Channuneus, and their sons, were twenty men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{49}} And of the servants of the temple whom David had ordained, and the principal men for the service of the Levites to wit, the servants of the temple two hundred and twenty, the catalogue of whose names were showed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{50}} And there I vowed a fast to the young men before our Lord, to desire of him a prosperous journey both for us and them that were with us, for our children, and for the cattle: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{51}} For I was ashamed to ask the king footmen, and horsemen, and conduct for safeguard against our adversaries. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{52}} For we had said to the king, that the power of the Lord our God should be with them that seek him, to support them in all ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{53}} And again we implored our Lord as touching these things, and found him favourable to us. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{54}} Then I separated twelve of the chief of the priests, Esebrias, and Assanias, and ten men of their brethren with them: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{55}} And I weighed them the gold, and the silver, and the holy vessels of the house of our Lord, which the king, and his council, and the princes, and all Israel, had given. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{56}} And when I had weighed it, I delivered to them six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels of one hundred talents, and one hundred talents of gold, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{57}} And twenty golden vessels, and twelve vessels of brass, even of fine brass, glittering like gold. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{58}} And I said to them, Both you⌃ are holy to the Lord, and the vessels are holy, and the gold and the silver is a vow to the Lord, the Lord of our fathers. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{59}} Watch you⌃, and keep them till you⌃ deliver them to the chief of the priests and Levites, and to the principal men of the families of Israel, in Jerusalem, into the chambers of the house of our God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{60}} So the priests and the Levites, who had received the silver and the gold and the vessels, brought them to Jerusalem, into the temple of the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{61}} And from the river Theras we departed the twelfth day of the first month, and came to Jerusalem by the mighty hand of our Lord, which was with us: and from the beginning of our journey the Lord delivered us from every enemy, and so we came to Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{62}} And when we had been there three days, the gold and silver that was weighed was delivered in the house of our Lord on the fourth day to Marmoth the priest the son of Iri. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{63}} And with him was Eleazar the son of Phinees, and with them were Josabad the son of Jesu and Moeth the son of Sabban, Levites: all was delivered them by number and weight. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{64}} And all the weight of them was written up the same hour. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{65}} Moreover they that were come out of the captivity offered sacrifice to the Lord God of Israel, even twelve bullocks for all Israel, fourscore and sixteen rams, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{66}} Threescore and twelve lambs, goats for a peace offering, twelve; all of them a sacrifice to the Lord. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{67}} And they delivered the king's commandments to the king's stewards' and to the governors of Celosyria and Phenice; and they honored the people and the temple of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{68}} Now when these things were done, the rulers came to me, and said, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{69}} The nation of Israel, the princes, the priests and Levites, have not put away from them the strange people of the land, nor the pollutions of the Gentiles to wit, of the Canaanites, Hittites, Pheresites, Jebusites, and the Moabites, Egyptians, and Edomites. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{70}} For both they and their sons have married with their daughters, and the holy seed is mixed with the strange people of the land; and from the beginning of this matter the rulers and the great men have been partakers of this iniquity. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{71}} And as soon as I had heard these things, I tore my clothes, and the holy garment, and pulled off the hair from off my head and beard, and sat me down sad and very heavy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{72}} So all they that were then moved at the word of the Lord God of Israel assembled to me, while I mourned for the iniquity: but I sat still full of heaviness until the evening sacrifice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{73}} Then rising up from the fast with my clothes and the holy garment torn, and bowing my knees, and stretching forth my hands to the Lord, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{74}} I said, O Lord, I am confounded and ashamed before your face; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{75}} For our sins are multiplied above our heads, and our ignorances have reached up to heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{76}} For ever since the time of our fathers we have been and are in great sin, even to this day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{77}} And for our sins and our fathers' we with our brethren and our kings and our priests were given up to the kings of the earth, to the sword, and to captivity, and for a prey with shame, to this day. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{78}} And now in some measure has mercy been showed to us from you, O Lord, that there should be left us a root and a name in the place of your sanctuary; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{79}} And to discover to us a light in the house of the Lord our God, and to give us food in the time of our servitude. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{80}} Yes, when we were in bondage, we were not forsaken of our Lord; but he made us gracious before the kings of Persia, so that they gave us food; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{81}} Yes, and honored the temple of our Lord, and raised up the desolate Sion, that they have given us a sure dwelling in Jewry and Jerusalem. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{82}} And now, O Lord, what shall we say, having these things? for we have transgressed your commandments, which you
