All groans, all wailing, were laid aside: they formed dances in token of serene joy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{33}} So, also, the king collected a number of guests for the occasion, and returned unceasing thanks with much magnificence for the unexpected deliverance afforded him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{34}} Those who had marked them out as for death and for carrion, and had registered them with joy, howled aloud, and were clothed with shame, and had the fire of their rage ingloriously put out. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{35}} But the Jews, as we just said, instituted a dance, and then gave themselves up to feasting, glad thanksgivings, and psalms. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{36}} They made a public ordinance to commemorate these things for generations to come, as long as they should be sojourners. They thus established these days as days of mirth, not for the purpose of drinking or luxury, but because God had saved them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{37}} They requested the king to send them back to their homes. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{38}} They were being enrolled from the twenty-fifth of Pachon to the fourth of Epiphi, a period of forty days: the measures taken for their destruction lasted from the fifth of Epiphi till the seventh, that is, three days. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{39}} The Ruler over all did during this time manifest forth his mercy gloriously, and did deliver them all together unharmed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{40}} They feasted upon the king's provision up to the fourteenth day, and then asked to be sent away. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{41}} The king commended them, and wrote the subjoined letter, of magnanimous import for them, to the commanders of every city.\par
\subsection*{3 Maccabees 7}
\markright{3 MACCABEES 7}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} King Ptolemy Philopator to the commanders throughout Egypt, and to all who are set over affairs, joy and strength. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} We, too, and our children are well; and God has directed our affairs as we wish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Certain of our friends did of malice vehemently urge us to punish the Jews of our realm in a body, with the infliction of a monstrous punishment. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} They pretended that our affairs would never be in a good state till this took place. Such, they said, was the hatred borne by the Jews to all other people. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} They brought them fettered in grievous chains as slaves, nay, as traitors. Without enquiry or examination they endeavoured to annihilate them. They buckled themselves with a savage cruelty, worse than Scythian custom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} For this cause we severely threatened them; yet, with the clemency which we are wont to extend to all men, we at length permitted them to live. Finding that the God of heaven cast a shield of protection over the Jews so as to preserve them, and that he fought for them as a father always fights for his sons; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} and taking into consideration their constancy and fidelity towards us and towards our ancestors, we have, as we ought, acquitted them of every sort of charge. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And we have dismissed them to their several homes; bidding all men everywhere to do them no wrong, or unrighteously revile them about the past. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} For know you⌃, that should we conceive any evil design, or in any way aggrieve them, we shall ever have as our opposite, not man, but the highest God, the ruler of all might. From Him there will be no escape, as the avenger of such deeds. Fare you⌃ well. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} When they had received this letter, they were not forward to depart immediately. They petitioned the king to be allowed to inflict fitting punishment upon those of their race who had willingly transgressed the holy god, and the law of God. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} They alleged that men who had for their bellies' sake transgressed the ordinances of God, would never be faithful to the interests of the king. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} The king admitted the truth of this reasoning, and commended them. Full power was given them, without warrant or special commission, to destroy those who had transgressed the law of God boldly in every part of the king's dominions. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Their priests, then, as it was meet, saluted him with good wishes, and all the people echoed with the Hallelujah. They then joyfully departed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Then they punished and destroyed with ignominy every polluted Jew that fell in their way; {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} slaying thus, in that day, above three hundred men, and esteeming this destruction of the wicked a season of joy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} They themselves having held fast their God to death, and having enjoyed a full deliverance, departed from the city garlanded with sweet-flowered wreaths of every kind. Uttering exclamations of joy, with songs of praise, and melodious hymns they thanked the God of their fathers, the eternal Saviour of Israel. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} Having arrived at Ptolemais, called from the specialty of that district Rose-bearing, where the fleet, in accordance with the general wish, waited for them seven days, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} they partook of a banquet of deliverance, for the king generously granted them severally the means of securing a return home. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} They were accordingly brought back in peace, while they gave utterance to becoming thanks; and they determined to keep these days during their sojourn as days of joyfulness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} These they registered as sacred upon a pillar, when they had dedicated the place of their festivity to be one of prayer. They departed unharmed, free, abundant in joy, preserved by the king's command, by land, by sea, and by river, each to his own home. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} They had more weight than before among their enemies; and were honored and feared, and no one in any way robbed them of their goods. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} Every man received back his own, according to inventory; those who had obtained their goods, giving them up with the greatest terror. For the greatest God wrought with perfectness wonders for their salvation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} Blessed be the Redeemer of Israel to everlasting. Amen.\par
\newpage
\section*{1 Enoch (chs. 1-36) Introduction}
{\notefont\fontsize{8.7}{10.2}\selectfont
\noindent\textbf{Author and Attribution.} Enoch in narrative voice; translated by R. H. Charles in this appendix\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Authorship Basis.} This appendix prints the opening thirty-six chapters of 1 Enoch in Charles's 1917 public-domain English translation; conservative readers may treat the work as ancient witness literature rather than canonical Scripture.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Jesus / NT Attribution.} Jude 14-15 explicitly cites Enoch's prophecy, but the NT does not identify 1 Enoch 1-36 as canonical Scripture.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Composition Date.} Ancient Jewish work; Charles translation first published 1917\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{MT Timeline.} Not part of MT canon chronology\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{LXX Timeline.} Not part of LXX canon chronology in this edition\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Historical Setting.} Early Jewish apocalyptic material centered on judgment, the Watchers, cosmic order, and Enoch's journeys.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Purpose.} To preserve an important ancient witness often discussed in relation to Jude, Second Temple Judaism, and early interpretation.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Key Themes.} judgment; Watchers; heavenly journeys; cosmic order; ancient witness\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Outline.} Blessing and judgment 1-5; Watchers 6-16; journeys and visions 17-36.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest Witnesses.} Frag. Aramaic fragments of 1 Enoch survive at Qumran 2nd century BC and later | Subst. Multiple Qumran fragments witness portions of 1 Enoch 2nd century BC and later | Heb. n/a n/a | Gk. Complete Ethiopic tradition preserves the full work; Charles translated from Ethiopic with other witnesses consulted medieval Ethiopic manuscripts\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Earliest External Attestation.} Cited in Jude 14-15 and known to early Christian writers by Jude and early church writers (1st century AD onward)\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Textual Notes.} This appendix includes only chapters 1-36 and is not presented as part of the Brenton Septuagint proper.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
\noindent\textbf{Conservative Notes.} Included as public-domain appendix material because of its historical importance and relation to Jude 14-15.\par
\vspace{0.18em}
}

\section*{1 Enoch}
\markboth{1 ENOCH}{}
\subsection*{1 Enoch 1}
\markright{1 ENOCH 1}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The words of the blessing of Enoch, wherewith he blessed the elect and righteous, who will be living in the day of tribulation, when all the wicked and godless are to be removed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And he took up his parable and said—Enoch a righteous man, whose eyes were opened by God, saw the vision of the Holy One in the heavens, which the angels showed me, and from them I heard everything, and from them I understood as I saw, but not for this generation, but for a remote one which is for to come. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Concerning the elect I said, and took up my parable concerning them: The Holy Great One will come forth from His dwelling, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And the eternal God will tread upon the earth, (even) on Mount Sinai, And appear in the strength of His might from the heaven of heavens. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And all shall be smitten with fear, And the Watchers shall quake, And great fear and trembling shall seize them unto the ends of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And the high mountains shall be shaken, And the high hills shall be made low, And shall melt like wax before the flame {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And the earth shall be wholly rent in sunder, And all that is upon the earth shall perish, And there shall be a judgement upon all (men). {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} But with the righteous He will make peace, And will protect the elect, And mercy shall be upon them. And they shall all belong to God, And they shall be prospered, And they shall all be blessed. And He will help them all, And light shall appear unto them, And He will make peace with them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 2}
\markright{1 ENOCH 2}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Observe ye every thing that takes place in the heaven, how they do not change their orbits, and the luminaries which are in the heaven, how they all rise and set in order each in its season, and transgress not against their appointed order. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Behold ye the earth, and give heed to the things which take place upon it from first to last, how steadfast they are, how none of the things upon earth change, but all the works of God appear to you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Behold the summer and the winter, how the whole earth is filled with water, and clouds and dew and rain lie upon it.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 3}
\markright{1 ENOCH 3}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Observe and see how (in the winter) all the trees seem as though they had withered and shed all their leaves, except fourteen trees, which do not lose their foliage but retain the old foliage from two to three years till the new comes.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 4}
\markright{1 ENOCH 4}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And again, observe ye the days of summer how the sun is above the earth over against it. And you seek shade and shelter by reason of the heat of the sun, and the earth also burns with glowing heat, and so you cannot tread on the earth, or on a rock by reason of its heat.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 5}
\markright{1 ENOCH 5}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Observe ye how the trees cover themselves with green leaves and bear fruit: wherefore give ye heed and know with regard to all His works, and recognize how He that liveth for ever hath made them so. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And all His works go on thus from year to year for ever, and all the tasks which they accomplish for Him, and their tasks change not, but according as God hath ordained so is it done. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And behold how the sea and the rivers in like manner accomplish and change not their tasks from His commandments. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} But ye—ye have not been steadfast, nor done the commandments of the Lord, But ye have turned away and spoken proud and hard words With your impure mouths against His greatness. Oh, ye hard-hearted, ye shall find no peace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Therefore shall ye execrate your days, And the years of your life shall perish, And the years of your destruction shall be multiplied in eternal execration, And ye shall find no mercy. 6a. In those days ye shall make your names an eternal execration unto all the righteous, b. And by you shall all who curse, curse. c. And all the sinners and godless shall imprecate by you, 7c. And for you, the godless, there shall be a curse. 6d. And all the ... shall rejoice, e. And there shall be forgiveness of sins, f. And every mercy and peace and forbearance: g. There shall be salvation unto them, a goodly light. i. And for all of you sinners there shall be no salvation, j. But on you all shall abide a curse. 7a. But for the elect there shall be light and grace and peace, b. And they shall inherit the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And then there shall be bestowed upon the elect wisdom, And they shall all live and never again sin, Either through ungodliness or through pride; But they who are wise shall be humble. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And they shall not again transgress, Nor shall they sin all the days of their life, Nor shall they die of (the divine) anger or wrath, But they shall complete the number of the days of their life. And their lives shall be increased in peace, And the years of their joy shall be multiplied, In eternal gladness and peace, All the days of their life. VI-XI. The Fall of the Angels: the Demoralisation of Mankind: the Intercession of the Angels on behalf of Mankind. The Dooms pronounced by God on the Angels: the Messianic Kingdom (a Noah fragment).\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 6}
\markright{1 ENOCH 6}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And it came to pass when the children of men had multiplied that in those days were born unto them beautiful and comely daughters. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And the angels, the children of the heaven, saw and lusted after them, and said to one another: ‘Come, let us choose us wives from among the children of men and beget us children.’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And Semjâzâ, who was their leader, said unto them: ‘I fear ye will not indeed agree to do this deed, and I alone shall have to pay the penalty of a great sin.’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And they all answered him and said: ‘Let us all swear an oath, and all bind ourselves by mutual imprecations not to abandon this plan but to do this thing.’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Then sware they all together and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And they were in all two hundred; who descended in the days of Jared on the summit of Mount Hermon, and they called it Mount Hermon, because they had sworn and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And these are the names of their leaders: Sêmîazâz, their leader, Arâkîba, Râmêêl, Kôkabîêl, Tâmîêl, Râmîêl, Dânêl, Êzêqêêl, Barâqîjâl, Asâêl, Armârôs, Batârêl, Anânêl, Zaqîêl, Samsâpêêl, Satarêl, Tûrêl, Jômjâêl, Sariêl. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} These are their chiefs of tens.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 7}
\markright{1 ENOCH 7}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And all the others together with them took unto themselves wives, and each chose for himself one, and they began to go in unto them and to defile themselves with them, and they taught them charms and enchantments, and the cutting of roots, and made them acquainted with plants. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And they became pregnant, and they bare great giants, whose height was three thousand ells: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Who consumed all the acquisitions of men. And when men could no longer sustain them, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} The giants turned against them and devoured mankind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And they began to sin against birds, and beasts, and reptiles, and fish, and to devour one another’s flesh, and drink the blood. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Then the earth laid accusation against the lawless ones.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 8}
\markright{1 ENOCH 8}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals ‹of the earth› and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication, and they were led astray, and became corrupt in all their ways. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Semjâzâ taught enchantments, and root-cuttings, Armârôs the resolving of enchantments, Barâqîjâl, (taught) astrology, Kôkabêl the constellations, Ezêqêêl the knowledge of the clouds, ‹Araqiêl the signs of the earth, Shamsiêl the signs of the sun›, and Sariêl the course of the moon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And as men perished, they cried, and their cry went up to heaven....\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 9}
\markright{1 ENOCH 9}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And then Michael, Uriel, Raphael, and Gabriel looked down from heaven and saw much blood being shed upon the earth, and all lawlessness being wrought upon the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And they said one to another: ‘The earth, made without inhabitant, cries the voice of their crying up to the gates of heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And now to you, the holy ones of heaven, the souls of men make their suit, saying, “Bring our cause before the Most High”.’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And they said to the Lord of the ages: ‘Lord of lords, God of gods, King of kings ‹and God of the ages›, the throne of Thy glory (standeth) unto all the generations of the ages, and Thy name holy and glorious and blessed unto all the ages! {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Thou hast made all things, and power over all things hast Thou: and all things are naked and open in Thy sight, and all things Thou seest, and nothing can hide itself from Thee. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Thou seest what Azâzêl hath done, who hath taught all unrighteousness on earth and revealed the eternal secrets which were (preserved) in heaven, which men were striving to learn: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And Semjâzâ, to whom Thou hast given authority to bear rule over his associates. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And they have gone to the daughters of men upon the earth, and have slept with the women, and have defiled themselves, and revealed to them all kinds of sins. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And the women have borne giants, and the whole earth has thereby been filled with blood and unrighteousness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And now, behold, the souls of those who have died are crying and making their suit to the gates of heaven, and their lamentations have ascended: and cannot cease because of the lawless deeds which are wrought on the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And Thou knowest all things before they come to pass, and Thou seest these things and Thou dost suffer them, and Thou dost not say to us what we are to do to them in regard to these.’\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 10}
\markright{1 ENOCH 10}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then said the Most High, the Holy and Great One spake, and sent Uriel to the son of Lamech, and said to him: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} ‘‹Go to Noah and› tell him in my name “Hide thyself!”, and reveal to him the end that is approaching: that the whole earth will be destroyed, and a deluge is about to come upon the whole earth, and will destroy all that is on it. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And now instruct him that he may escape and his seed may be preserved for all the generations of the world.’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And again the Lord said to Raphael: ‘Bind Azâzêl hand and foot, and cast him into the darkness: and make an opening in the desert, which is in Dûdâêl, and cast him therein. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And place upon him rough and jagged rocks, and cover him with darkness, and let him abide there for ever, and cover his face that he may not see light. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And on the day of the great judgement he shall be cast into the fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And heal the earth which the angels have corrupted, and proclaim the healing of the earth, that they may heal the plague, and that all the children of men may not perish through all the secret things that the Watchers have disclosed and have taught their sons. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And the whole earth has been corrupted through the works that were taught by Azâzêl: to him ascribe all sin.’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And to Gabriel said the Lord: ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy the children of the Watchers from amongst men: : send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And no request that they (i. e. their fathers) make of thee shall be granted unto their fathers on their behalf; for they hope to live an eternal life, and that each one of them will live five hundred years.’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And the Lord said unto Michael: ‘Go, bind Semjâzâ and his associates who have united themselves with women so as to have defiled themselves with them in all their uncleanness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And, when their sons have slain one another, and they have seen the destruction of their beloved ones, bind them fast for seventy generations in the valleys of the earth, till the day of their judgement and of their consummation, till the judgement that is for ever and ever is consummated. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: ‹and› to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And whosoever shall be condemned and destroyed will from thenceforth be bound together with them to the end of all generations. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And destroy all the spirits of the reprobate, and the children of the Watchers, because they have wronged mankind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} Destroy all wrong from the face of the earth, and let every evil work come to an end: and let the plant of righteousness and truth appear: and it shall prove a blessing: the works of righteousness and truth shall be planted in truth and joy for evermore. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And then shall all the righteous escape, And shall live till they beget thousands of children, And all the days of their youth and their old age shall they complete in peace. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And then shall the whole earth be tilled in righteousness, and shall all be planted with trees and be full of blessing. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And all desirable trees shall be planted on it, and they shall plant vines on it: and the vine which they plant thereon shall yield wine in abundance, and as for all the seed which is sown thereon each measure (of it) shall bear a thousand, and each measure of olives shall yield ten presses of oil. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And cleanse thou the earth from all oppression, and from all unrighteousness, and from all sin, and from all godlessness: and all the uncleanness that is wrought upon the earth destroy from off the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} And all the children of men shall become righteous, and all nations shall offer adoration and shall praise Me, and all shall worship Me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} And the earth shall be cleansed from all defilement, and from all sin, and from all punishment, and from all torment, and I will never again send (them) upon it from generation to generation and for ever.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 11}
\markright{1 ENOCH 11}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And in those days I will open the store chambers of blessing which are in the heaven, so as to send them down upon the earth over the work and labour of the children of men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And truth and peace shall be associated together throughout all the days of the world and throughout all the generations of men.’ XII-XVI. Dream Vision of Enoch: his intercession for Azâzêl and the fallen Angels: and his announcement to them of their first and final doom.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 12}
\markright{1 ENOCH 12}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Before these things Enoch was hidden, and no one of the children of men knew where he was hidden, and where he abode, and what had become of him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And his activities had to do with the Watchers, and his days were with the holy ones. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I, Enoch, was blessing the Lord of majesty and the King of the ages, and lo! the Watchers called me—Enoch the scribe—and said to me: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} ‘Enoch, thou scribe of righteousness, go, declare to the Watchers of the heaven who have left the high heaven, the holy eternal place, and have defiled themselves with women, and have done as the children of earth do, and have taken unto themselves wives: “Ye have wrought great destruction on the earth: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And ye shall have no peace nor forgiveness of sin: and inasmuch as they delight themselves in their children, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} The murder of their beloved ones shall they see, and over the destruction of their children shall they lament, and shall make supplication unto eternity, but mercy and peace shall ye not attain.”’\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 13}
\markright{1 ENOCH 13}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And Enoch went and said: ‘Azâzêl, thou shalt have no peace: a severe sentence has gone forth against thee to put thee in bonds: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And thou shalt not have toleration nor request granted to thee, because of the unrighteousness which thou hast taught, and because of all the works of godlessness and unrighteousness and sin which thou hast shown to men.’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Then I went and spoke to them all together, and they were all afraid, and fear and trembling seized them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And they besought me to draw up a petition for them that they might find forgiveness, and to read their petition in the presence of the Lord of heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} For from thenceforward they could not speak (with Him) nor lift up their eyes to heaven for shame of their sins for which they had been condemned. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Then I wrote out their petition, and the prayer in regard to their spirits and their deeds individually and in regard to their requests that they should have forgiveness and length ‹of days›. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And I went off and sat down at the waters of Dan, in the land of Dan, to the south of the west of Hermon: I read their petition till I fell asleep. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And behold a dream came to me, and visions fell down upon me, and I saw visions of chastisement, and a voice came bidding (me) to tell it to the sons of heaven, and reprimand them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And when I awaked, I came unto them, and they were all sitting gathered together, weeping in ’Abelsjâîl, which is between Lebanon and Sênêsêr, with their faces covered. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And I recounted before them all the visions which I had seen in sleep, and I began to speak the words of righteousness, and to reprimand the heavenly Watchers.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 14}
\markright{1 ENOCH 14}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} The book of the words of righteousness, and of the reprimand of the eternal Watchers in accordance with the command of the Holy Great One in that vision. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} I saw in my sleep what I will now say with a tongue of flesh and with the breath of my mouth: which the Great One has given to men to converse therewith and understand with the heart. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} As He hath created and given to man the power of understanding the word of wisdom, so hath He created me also and given me the power of reprimanding the Watchers, the children of heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I wrote out your petition, and in my vision it appeared thus, that your petition will not be granted unto you throughout all the days of eternity, and that judgement has been finally passed upon you: yea (your petition) will not be granted unto you. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And from henceforth you shall not ascend into heaven unto all eternity, and in bonds of the earth the decree has gone forth to bind you for all the days of the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And (that) previously you shall have seen the destruction of your beloved sons and you shall have no pleasure in them, but they shall fall before you by the sword. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And your petition on their behalf shall not be granted, nor yet on your own: even though you weep and pray and speak all the words contained in the writing which I have written. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And the vision was shown to me thus: Behold, in the vision clouds invited me and a mist summoned me, and the course of the stars and the lightnings sped and hastened me, and the winds in the vision caused me to fly and lifted me upward, and bore me into heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And I went in till I drew nigh to a wall which is built of crystals and surrounded by tongues of fire: and it began to affright me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And I went into the tongues of fire and drew nigh to a large house which was built of crystals: and the walls of the house were like a tesselated floor (made) of crystals, and its groundwork was of crystal. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Its ceiling was like the path of the stars and the lightnings, and between them were fiery cherubim, and their heaven was (clear as) water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} A flaming fire surrounded the walls, and its portals blazed with fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} And I entered into that house, and it was hot as fire and cold as ice: there were no delights of life therein: fear covered me, and trembling gat hold upon me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} And as I quaked and trembled, I fell upon my face. And I beheld a vision, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And lo! there was a second house, greater than the former, and the entire portal stood open before me, and it was built of flames of fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And in every respect it so excelled in splendour and magnificence and extent that I cannot describe to you its splendour and its extent. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{17}} And its floor was of fire, and above it were lightnings and the path of the stars, and its ceiling also was flaming fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{18}} And I looked and saw therein a lofty throne: its appearance was as crystal, and the wheels thereof as the shining sun, and there was the vision of cherubim. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{19}} And from underneath the throne came streams of flaming fire so that I could not look thereon. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{20}} And the Great Glory sat thereon, and His raiment shone more brightly than the sun and was whiter than any snow. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{21}} None of the angels could enter and could behold His face by reason of the magnificence and glory, and no flesh could behold Him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{22}} The flaming fire was round about Him, and a great fire stood before Him, and none around could draw nigh Him: ten thousand times ten thousand (stood) before Him, yet He needed no counsellor. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{23}} And the most holy ones who were nigh to Him did not leave by night nor depart from Him. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{24}} And until then I had been prostrate on my face, trembling: and the Lord called me with His own mouth, and said to me: ‘Come hither, Enoch, and hear my word.’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{25}} And one of the holy ones came to me and waked me, and He made me rise up and approach the door: and I bowed my face downwards.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 15}
\markright{1 ENOCH 15}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And He answered and said to me, and I heard His voice: ‘Fear not, Enoch, thou righteous man and scribe of righteousness: approach hither and hear my voice. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And go, say to the Watchers of heaven, who have sent thee to intercede for them: “You should intercede for men, and not men for you: {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Wherefore have ye left the high, holy, and eternal heaven, and lain with women, and defiled yourselves with the daughters of men and taken to yourselves wives, and done like the children of earth, and begotten giants (as your) sons. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And though ye were holy, spiritual, living the eternal life, you have defiled yourselves with the blood of women, and have begotten (children) with the blood of flesh, and, as the children of men, have lusted after flesh and blood as those also do who die and perish. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Therefore have I given them wives also that they might impregnate them, and beget children by them, that thus nothing might be wanting to them on earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} But you were formerly spiritual, living the eternal life, and immortal for all generations of the world. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And therefore I have not appointed wives for you; for as for the spiritual ones of the heaven, in heaven is their dwelling. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from men, and from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin; they shall be evil spirits on earth, and evil spirits shall they be called. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And the spirits of the giants afflict, oppress, destroy, attack, do battle, and work destruction on the earth, and cause trouble: they take no food, but nevertheless hunger and thirst, and cause offences. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And these spirits shall rise up against the children of men and against the women, because they have proceeded from them.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 16}
\markright{1 ENOCH 16}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated.” {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And now as to the Watchers who have sent thee to intercede for them, who had been aforetime in heaven, (say to them): {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} “You have been in heaven, but all the mysteries had not yet been revealed to you, and you knew worthless ones, and these in the hardness of your hearts you have made known to the women, and through these mysteries women and men work much evil on earth.” {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Say to them therefore: “You have no peace.”’ XVII-XXXVII. Enoch’s Journeys through the Earth and Sheol. XVII-XIX. The First Journey.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 17}
\markright{1 ENOCH 17}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And they took and brought me to a place in which those who were there were like flaming fire, and when they wished, they appeared as men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And they brought me to the place of darkness, and to a mountain the point of whose summit reached to heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I saw the places of the luminaries and the treasuries of the stars and of the thunder, and in the uttermost depths, where were a fiery bow and arrows and their quiver, and a fiery sword and all the lightnings. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And they took me to the living waters, and to the fire of the west, which receives every setting of the sun. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And I came to a river of fire in which the fire flows like water and discharges itself into the great sea towards the west. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} I saw the great rivers and came to the great river and to the great darkness, and went to the place where no flesh walks. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} I saw the mountains of the darkness of winter and the place whence all the waters of the deep flow. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} I saw the mouths of all the rivers of the earth and the mouth of the deep.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 18}
\markright{1 ENOCH 18}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} I saw the treasuries of all the winds; I saw how He had furnished with them the whole creation and the firm foundations of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And I saw the corner-stone of the earth: I saw the four winds which bear the firmament of the heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I saw how the winds stretch out the vaults of heaven, and have their station between heaven and earth: these are the pillars of the heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} I saw the winds of heaven which turn and bring the circumference of the sun and all the stars to their setting. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} I saw the winds on the earth carrying the clouds: I saw the paths of the angels: I saw at the end of the earth the firmament of the heaven above. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And I proceeded and saw a place which burns day and night, where there are seven mountains of magnificent stones, three towards the east, and three towards the south. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And as for those towards the east ‹one› was of coloured stone, and one of pearl, and one of jacinth, and those towards the south of red stone. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} But the middle one reached to heaven like the throne of God, of alabaster, and the summit of the throne was of sapphire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And I saw a flaming fire. And beyond these mountains {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} is a region, the end of the great earth: there the heavens were completed. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} And I saw a deep abyss, with columns of heavenly fire, and among them I saw columns of fire fall, which were beyond measure alike towards the height and towards the depth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And beyond that abyss I saw a place which had no firmament of the heaven above, and no firmly founded earth beneath it: there was no water upon it, and no birds, but it was a waste and horrible place. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} I saw there seven stars like great burning mountains, and to me, when I inquired regarding them, {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} The angel said: ‘This place is the end of heaven and earth: this has become a prison for the stars and the host of heaven. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{15}} And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of the Lord in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{16}} And He was wroth with them, and bound them till the time when their guilt should be consummated (even) for ten thousand years.’\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 19}
\markright{1 ENOCH 19}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And Uriel said to me: ‘Here shall stand the angels who have connected themselves with women, and their spirits, assuming many different forms, are defiling mankind, and shall lead them astray into sacrificing to demons as gods, (here shall they stand), till the day of the great judgement in which they shall be judged till they are made an end of. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And the women also of the angels who went astray shall become sirens.’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I, Enoch, alone saw the vision, the ends of all things: and no man shall see as I have seen. XX. Names and Functions of the Seven Archangels.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 20}
\markright{1 ENOCH 20}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And these are the names of the holy angels who watch. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Uriel, one of the holy angels, who is over the world and over Tartarus. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Raphael, one of the holy angels, who is over the spirits of men. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Raguel, one of the holy angels who takes vengeance on the world of the luminaries. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Michael, one of the holy angels, to wit, he that is set over the best part of mankind and over chaos. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Saraqâêl, one of the holy angels, who is set over the spirits, who sin in the spirit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Gabriel, one of the holy angels, who is over Paradise and the serpents and the Cherubim. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Remiel, one of the holy angels, whom God set over those who rise. XXI-XXXVI. The Second Journey of Enoch. XXI. Preliminary and final place of punishment of the fallen angels (stars).\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 21}
\markright{1 ENOCH 21}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And I proceeded to where things were chaotic. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And I saw there something horrible: I saw neither a heaven above nor a firmly founded earth, but a place chaotic and horrible. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And there I saw seven stars of the heaven bound together in it, like great mountains and burning with fire. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Then I said: ‘For what sin are they bound, and on what account have they been cast in hither?’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Then said Uriel, one of the holy angels, who was with me, and was chief over them, and said: ‘Enoch, why dost thou ask, and why art thou eager for the truth? {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} These are of the number of the stars of heaven which have transgressed the commandment of the Lord, and are bound here till ten thousand years, the time entailed by their sins, are consummated.’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And from thence I went to another place, which was still more horrible than the former, and I saw a horrible thing: a great fire there which burnt and blazed, and the place was cleft as far as the abyss, being full of great descending columns of fire: neither its extent or magnitude could I see, nor could I conjecture. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Then I said: ‘How fearful is the place and how terrible to look upon!’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} Then Uriel answered me, one of the holy angels who was with me, and said unto me: ‘Enoch, why hast thou such fear and affright?’ And I answered: ‘Because of this fearful place, and because of the spectacle of the pain.’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And he said unto me: ‘This place is the prison of the angels, and here they will be imprisoned for ever.’ XXII. Sheol, or the Underworld.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 22}
\markright{1 ENOCH 22}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And thence I went to another place, and he showed me in the west another great and high mountain of hard rock. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And there was in it four hollow places, deep and wide and very smooth. How smooth are the hollow places and deep and dark to look at. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Then Raphael answered, one of the holy angels who was with me, and said unto me: ‘These hollow places have been created for this very purpose, that the spirits of the souls of the dead should assemble therein, yea that all the souls of the children of men should assemble here. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And these places have been made to receive them till the day of their judgement and till their appointed period , till the great judgement (comes) upon them.’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} I saw the spirits of the children of men who were dead, and their voice went forth to heaven and made suit. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Then I asked Raphael the angel who was with me, and I said unto him: ‘This spirit—whose is it whose voice goeth forth and maketh suit?’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} And he answered me saying: ‘This is the spirit which went forth from Abel, whom his brother Cain slew, and he makes his suit against him till his seed is destroyed from the face of the earth, and his seed is annihilated from amongst the seed of men.’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{8}} Then I asked regarding it, and regarding all the hollow places: ‘Why is one separated from the other?’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{9}} And he answered me and said unto me: ‘These three have been made that the spirits of the dead might be separated. And such a division has been made ‹for› the spirits of the righteous, in which there is the bright spring of water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{10}} And such has been made for sinners when they die and are buried in the earth and judgement has not been executed on them in their lifetime. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{11}} Here their spirits shall be set apart in this great pain till the great day of judgement and punishment and torment of those who curse for ever, and retribution for their spirits. There He shall bind them for ever. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{12}} And such a division has been made for the spirits of those who make their suit, who make disclosures concerning their destruction, when they were slain in the days of the sinners. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{13}} Such has been made for the spirits of men who were not righteous but sinners, who were complete in transgression, and of the transgressors they shall be companions: but their spirits shall not be slain in the day of judgement nor shall they be raised from thence.’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{14}} Then I blessed the Lord of glory and said: ‘Blessed be my Lord, the Lord of righteousness who ruleth for ever.’\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 23}
\markright{1 ENOCH 23}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} From thence I went to another place to the west of the ends of the earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And I saw a burning fire which ran without resting, and paused not from its course day or night but (ran) regularly. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I asked saying: ‘What is this which rests not?’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} Then Raguel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me and said unto me: ‘This course of fire which thou hast seen is the fire in the west which persecutes all the luminaries of heaven.’\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 24}
\markright{1 ENOCH 24}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} XXV. The Seven Mountains in the North-West and the Tree of Life.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 25}
\markright{1 ENOCH 25}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And he said unto me: ‘Enoch, why dost thou ask me regarding the fragrance of the tree, and why dost thou wish to learn the truth?’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Then I answered him, saying: ‘I wish to know about everything, but especially about this tree.’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And he answered, saying: ‘This high mountain which thou hast seen, whose summit is like the throne of God, is His throne, where the Holy Great One, the Lord of Glory, the Eternal King will sit, when He shall come down to visit the earth with goodness. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And as for this fragrant tree no mortal is permitted to touch it till the great judgement, when He shall take vengeance on all and bring (everything) to its consummation for ever. It shall then be given to the righteous and holy. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Its fruit shall be for food to the elect: it shall be transplanted to the holy place, to the temple of the Lord, the Eternal King. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Then shall they rejoice with joy and be glad. And into the holy place shall they enter; And its fragrance shall be in their bones, And they shall live a long life on earth, Such as thy fathers lived: And in their days shall no sorrow or plague Or torment or calamity touch them.’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{7}} Then blessed I the God of Glory, the Eternal King, who hath prepared such things for the righteous, and hath created them and promised to give to them. Jerusalem and the Mountains, Ravines, and Streams.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 26}
\markright{1 ENOCH 26}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And I went from thence to the middle of the earth, and I saw a blessed place in which there were trees with branches abiding and blooming . {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And there I saw a holy mountain, and underneath the mountain to the east there was a stream and it flowed towards the south. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I saw towards the east another mountain higher than this, and between them a deep and narrow ravine: in it also ran a stream underneath the mountain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And to the west thereof there was another mountain, lower than the former and of small elevation, and a ravine deep and dry between them: and another deep and dry ravine was at the extremities of the three mountains. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} And all the ravines were deep and narrow, (being formed) of hard rock, and trees were not planted upon them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} And I marvelled at the rocks, and I marvelled at the ravine, yea, I marvelled very much. XXVII. The Purpose of the Accursed Valley.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 27}
\markright{1 ENOCH 27}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} Then said I: ‘For what object is this blessed land, which is entirely filled with trees, and this accursed valley between?’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered and said: ‘This valley is for those who are accursed for ever: here shall all the accursed be gathered together who utter with their lips against the Lord unseemly words and of His glory speak hard things. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be their place of judgement. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} In the last days there shall be upon them the spectacle of righteous judgement in the presence of the righteous for ever: here shall the merciful bless the Lord of Glory, the Eternal King. Here shall they be gathered together, and here shall be the place of their habitation. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} In the days of judgement over the former, they shall bless Him for the mercy in accordance with which He has assigned them (their lot).’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Then I blessed the Lord of Glory and set forth His glory and lauded Him gloriously. XXVIII-XXXIII. Further Journey to the East.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 28}
\markright{1 ENOCH 28}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And thence I went towards the east, into the midst of the mountain range of the desert, and I saw a wilderness and it was solitary, full of trees and plants. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And water gushed forth from above. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Rushing like a copious watercourse towards the north-west it caused clouds and dew to ascend on every side.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 29}
\markright{1 ENOCH 29}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And thence I went to another place in the desert, and approached to the east of this mountain range. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And there I saw aromatic trees exhaling the fragrance of frankincense and myrrh, and the trees also were similar to the almond tree.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 30}
\markright{1 ENOCH 30}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And beyond these, I went afar to the east, and I saw another place, a valley (full) of water. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And therein there was a tree, the colour (?) of fragrant trees such as the mastic. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And on the sides of those valleys I saw fragrant cinnamon. And beyond these I proceeded to the east.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 31}
\markright{1 ENOCH 31}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And I saw other mountains, and amongst them were groves of trees, and there flowed forth from them nectar, which is named sarara and galbanum. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And beyond these mountains I saw another mountain to the east of the ends of the earth, whereon were aloe trees, and all the trees were full of stacte, being like almond trees. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And when one burnt it, it smelt sweeter than any fragrant odour.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 32}
\markright{1 ENOCH 32}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And after these fragrant odours, as I looked towards the north over the mountains I saw seven mountains full of choice nard and fragrant trees and cinnamon and pepper.\par
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} To the north-east I beheld seven mountains full of choice nard and mastic and cinnamon and pepper. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And thence I went over the summits of all these mountains, far towards the east of the earth, and passed above the Erythraean sea, and went far from it, and passed over the angel Zotîêl. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I came to the Garden of Righteousness, and saw beyond those trees many large trees growing there and of goodly fragrance, large, very beautiful and glorious, and the tree of wisdom whereof they eat and know great wisdom. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} That tree is in height like the fir, and its leaves are like (those of) the Carob tree: and its fruit is like the clusters of the vine, very beautiful: and the fragrance of the tree penetrates afar. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{5}} Then I said: ‘How beautiful is the tree, and how attractive is its look!’ {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{6}} Then Raphael, the holy angel who was with me, answered me and said: ‘This is the tree of wisdom, of which thy father old (in years) and thy aged mother, who were before thee, have eaten, and they learnt wisdom and their eyes were opened, and they knew that they were naked and they were driven out of the garden.’\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 33}
\markright{1 ENOCH 33}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And from thence I went to the ends of the earth and saw there great beasts, and each differed from the other; and (I saw) birds also differing in appearance and beauty and voice, the one differing from the other. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And to the east of those beasts I saw the ends of the earth whereon the heaven rests, and the portals of the heaven open. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And I saw how the stars of heaven come forth, and I counted the portals out of which they proceed, and wrote down all their outlets, of each individual star by itself, according to their number and their names, their courses and their positions, and their times and their months, as Uriel the holy angel who was with me showed me. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} He showed all things to me and wrote them down for me: also their names he wrote for me, and their laws and their companies.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 34}
\markright{1 ENOCH 34}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} XXXV. Enoch’s Journey to the North.\par
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And from thence I went towards the north to the ends of the earth, and there I saw a great and glorious device at the ends of the whole earth. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And here I saw three portals of heaven open in the heaven: through each of them proceed north winds: when they blow there is cold, hail, frost, snow, dew, and rain. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} And out of one portal they blow for good: but when they blow through the other two portals, it is with violence and affliction on the earth, and they blow with violence.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 35}
\markright{1 ENOCH 35}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And from thence I went towards the west to the ends of the earth, and saw there three portals of the heaven open such as I had seen in the east, the same number of portals, and the same number of outlets. XXXVI. The Journey to the South.\par
\subsection*{1 Enoch 36}
\markright{1 ENOCH 36}
\noindent {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{1}} And from thence I went to the south to the ends of the earth, and saw there three open portals of the heaven: and thence there come dew, rain, and wind. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{2}} And from thence I went to the east to the ends of the heaven, and saw here the three eastern portals of heaven open and small portals above them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{3}} Through each of these small portals pass the stars of heaven and run their course to the west on the path which is shown to them. {\color{tnaccent}\fontsize{6.4}{6.4}\selectfont\textsuperscript{4}} And as often as I saw I blessed always the Lord of Glory, and I continued to bless the Lord of Glory who has wrought great and glorious wonders, to show the greatness of His work to the angels and to spirits and to men, that they might praise His work and all His creation: that they might see the work of His might and praise the great work of His hands and bless Him for ever. THE PARABLES. XXXVII-LXXI.\par
